In 1459 Mahmud, son of Küchük Muhammad, made Hajji Tarkhan the capital of his own Astrakhan khanate, though the regime only became fully separate after the Great Horde fell in 1502. Afanasy Nikitin passed through around 1469 on his way to India; the Venetian Ambrogio Contarini in 1476 found mud-brick houses behind a low stone wall. Crimean troops seized the town briefly in 1523 and 1549. Ivan the Terrible's forces entered it in 1554 and abolished the khanate in 1556, closing the largest slave market on the Volga. Russians moved the town twelve kilometres downstream in 1558 and built a wooden kremlin, replaced in 1582 by stone walls and towers. An Ottoman-Tatar army failed to take the new fortress in 1569.

Muscovite rule brought merchants from Armenia, Safavid Persia, Mughal India and Khiva, and the delta supplied sturgeon, fish, salt and caravan supplies. Stenka Razin's Cossacks and townsmen held Astrakhan in 1670-71 before tsarist troops retook it. The Assumption Cathedral inside the kremlin was begun in 1699 and built over about twelve years with moulded brick and carved white stone. Streltsy, fishermen and townspeople rose again in 1705-06 against taxes, uniforms and foreign officers. Peter the Great made Astrakhan the seat of a governorate in 1717, placing the Volga mouth and the Caspian trade under a direct imperial administration.
zh:
阿斯特拉罕的前身哈吉塔尔汉位于伏尔加河三角洲上端的右岸，在后来城区以北十二公里。金帐汗国时期，萨莱商队把东方丝绸和香料经此运往亚速海畔的塔纳，威尼斯和热那亚商船在那里装货；鱼、盐、皮革和突厥奴隶则反向运送。1333年，伊本·白图泰随月即别汗在此过冬。1395年，帖木儿的军队洗劫并焚毁哈吉塔尔汉。1444年，它属于大帐汗国，是伏尔加河下游一座逊尼派鞑靼商镇；城中仍有被毁的街区，商路则连着萨莱、里海和黑海。

1459年，库楚克·马哈麻之子马哈茂德以哈吉塔尔汉为自己的阿斯特拉罕汗国都城；这个政权直到1502年大帐汗国灭亡后才完全独立。阿法纳西·尼基特约在1469年前往印度途中经过此地。1476年，威尼斯人安布罗焦·孔塔里尼看到的是矮石墙内的一片土坯屋。克里米亚军队曾在1523年和1549年短暂占城。伊凡雷帝的军队1554年进入哈吉塔尔汉，1556年废除汗国，关闭伏尔加河上最大的奴隶市场。1558年，俄罗斯人把城南迁十二公里，先修建木构克里姆林，1582年又改筑石墙和塔楼。1569年，奥斯曼与鞑靼联军未能攻下这座新要塞。

莫斯科统治时期，亚美尼亚、萨法维波斯、莫卧儿印度和希瓦的商人来到这里，三角洲则出产鲟鱼、鱼货、盐，并为商队提供补给。1670年至1671年，斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克和市民占据阿斯特拉罕，最后被沙皇军队夺回。克里姆林内的圣母安息主教座堂1699年动工，用时约十二年，以模制砖和白石雕刻装饰。1705年至1706年，射击军、渔民和市民因赋税、军服和外籍军官问题再度起事。1717年，彼得大帝设立阿斯特拉罕省，把伏尔加河口和里海贸易直接置于帝国行政之下。

en:
The lower Yaik, renamed the Ural in 1775, crosses the flat Caspian steppe to its delta, past self-sown salt lakes; Inder, the largest of them, supplied the salt carried by steppe traders. Fifty kilometres above the delta stood Saraychik, on the right bank where the road from Tana to Khwarazm crossed the river by a bridge of boats. Ibn Battuta passed through around 1333, sold his horses and bought camels for the run to Konye-Urgench; the Florentine merchant Pegolotti also listed the town on the same route. Under the Golden Horde it struck coins, worked metal and pottery, and used ceramic water pipes. Abu al-Ghazi names it as the burial place of the khans Jani Beg and Berdi Beg. Timur's army sacked the city in 1395, but it was rebuilt in 1430–1440. In 1444 the heirs of Edigu ruled there over the Sunni Manghit clans of the Nogai yurt, while caravans again watered their animals between the Yaik and Volga.

From the 1490s Saraychik was the capital and only real city of the Nogai Horde, where furs, livestock and salt commonly changed hands by barter. Qasim Khan's Kazakhs took it around 1520 and used it as an administrative base for their western lands; Qasim was later buried there. After Muscovy conquered Astrakhan in 1556, the bey Ismail accepted Ivan the Terrible's suzerainty, and a rival group under Kazi Mirza moved to the Kuban in 1557 to form the Lesser Nogai Horde. Haqnazar Khan seized Saraychik again in 1577. Three years later the free Cossack atamans Nechai and Bogdan Barbosha stormed and burned the city, and survivors fled to Khiva. The Kalmyks of Kho-Urluk overran the Great Nogai Horde in 1628–1634, after which most Nogais moved from the Yaik to the Volga. Russian settlers built a small ostrog beside the ruins in 1640.
zh:
亚伊克河（1775年改名乌拉尔河）下游穿过平坦的里海草原，经多座自沉积盐湖注入里海；最大的因杰尔湖出产食盐，由草原商人转贩。萨莱楚克在三角洲以北约50公里的右岸，塔纳通往花剌子模的商道在此用舟桥渡河。约1333年，伊本·白图泰途经此城，卖掉马匹、换成骆驼，再前往库尼亚乌尔根奇；佛罗伦萨商人裴哥罗梯也在商路手册中记过这座城。金帐汗国时期，萨莱楚克自铸钱币，有金属器和陶器作坊，还用陶管供水。阿布勒·哈齐记载，札尼别汗和别儿迪别汗都安葬于此。1395年帖木儿军队洗劫城市，1430至1440年间城址得到重建。1444年，也迪古的后裔在此统辖诺盖帐的逊尼派曼吉特各部，商队又在亚伊克河与伏尔加河之间歇脚饮马。

1490年代起，萨莱楚克成为诺盖汗国的都城，也是汗国唯一真正的城市，毛皮、牲畜和盐多在市上以物易物。1520年前后，哈斯木汗率哈萨克人夺取此城，把它当作治理西部疆土的据点，哈斯木后来也葬在这里。1556年莫斯科攻灭阿斯特拉罕后，诺盖别克伊斯梅尔向伊凡雷帝称臣；1557年，哈孜·米尔咱率一支异己部众迁往库班，建立小诺盖帐。1577年，哈克纳扎尔汗再次攻占萨莱楚克。三年后，不受莫斯科管束的哥萨克首领涅恰伊和波格丹·巴尔博沙攻破并焚毁城市，幸存者逃往希瓦。1628至1634年，霍·乌尔留克率领卡尔梅克人击灭大诺盖帐，多数诺盖人随后从亚伊克河迁往伏尔加河。1640年，俄罗斯移民在废墟旁建起一座小堡。

en:
Sarai was the khan's court on the lower Volga, set among Akhtuba channels, pastures and landing grounds. Batu founded it in the early 1250s, and William of Rubruck found a new town on the Itil in 1254. Under Öz Beg and Jani Beg it became the main city of the Golden Horde, where envoys, caravan merchants and steppe nobles met. Florentine handbooks listed raw silk, furs, sturgeon, caviar, hides and Turkic slaves among its goods. Ibn Battuta described broad streets and crowded bazaars, with separate quarters for Mongols, Kipchaks, Circassians, Russians and visiting merchants. Timur's army destroyed the newer of the two places called Sarai in 1395. In 1444 Sarai was the capital of Küchük Muhammad's Great Horde, though archaeologists still debate which ruined site held the khan's court and whether the older town survived.

Afanasy Nikitin passed the lower Volga around 1469 on his journey to India. Vyatka river raiders sacked Sarai in 1471, and in 1502 the Crimean khan Mengli I Giray, allied with Ivan III of Moscow, burned the city and overthrew the Great Horde. Crimea then claimed the Golden Horde's inheritance. Sarai was not rebuilt; its brick remains stood in pastures used by Nogai herdsmen. After Moscow took Kazan and Astrakhan in 1552-56, Muscovite boats and patrols moved along the lower Volga past the old khan's grounds. Stenka Razin's Cossacks swept the river in 1670, and Yemelyan Pugachev's rebels crossed these same lower Volga pastures in 1774.
zh:
萨莱是伏尔加河下游的汗廷，坐落在阿赫图巴河汊、牧场和泊地之间。1250年代初拔都建城，1254年鲁不鲁乞见到它时，伊蒂尔河畔已是一座新城。月即别和札尼别统治时期，萨莱成为金帐汗国的主城，使节、商队和草原贵族都在这里会合。佛罗伦萨商人的行商手册把生丝、毛皮、鲟鱼、鱼子酱、皮革和突厥奴隶列为当地货物。伊本·白图泰写到这里宽阔的街道和拥挤的市集，蒙古人、钦察人、切尔克斯人、罗斯人和外来商人各有居住区。1395年，帖木儿的军队摧毁了两处萨莱遗址中较新的一座。1444年，萨莱是库楚克·马哈麻治下大帐汗国的都城；但哪一处遗址曾是汗廷、旧城是否仍存，学界仍有争议。

阿法纳西·尼基特约在1469年前往印度途中经过伏尔加河下游。1471年，维亚特卡河上武装洗劫萨莱；1502年，与莫斯科伊凡三世结盟的克里米亚可汗明里一世·格莱焚毁城市，攻灭大帐汗国，克里米亚随后宣称继承金帐汗国。萨莱没有重建，砖构遗址留在诺盖牧人的牧场中。1552年至1556年莫斯科攻灭喀山和阿斯特拉罕后，莫斯科的船只和巡逻队沿伏尔加河下游驶过旧汗廷之地。1670年，斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克席卷这条大河；1774年，叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的叛军也穿过伏尔加河下游的这些牧场。

en:
The Borisoglebsk country is forest-steppe between the upper Khopyor and its tributary the Vorona, where oak woods, above all the great Tellerman forest, break up the open grassland. In 1444 these pastures were the north-western fringe of the Great Horde: Tatar herds grazed here in summer, and Crimean and Nogai raiding parties rode through on their way north to Ryazan. A few Mishar and Mordvin fishing and beekeeping camps were the only settled spots. As Muscovy built its fortified frontier lines southward, Voronezh and Tambov went up nearby in the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries, while the empty woods and waters here were leased out as hunting and fishing grounds.

The place first mattered to Moscow through timber. While preparing his Azov campaigns, Peter I had Tellerman oaks felled here and built into barges and auxiliary vessels for the Azov fleet, and in 1698 the Pavlovsk fortress rose on the Vorona to guard the district against Crimean, Azov and Nogai raids. A church of Saints Boris and Gleb was built in 1704, and the fort took the name Borisoglebsk. Four years later the townsmen joined Kondraty Bulavin's Cossack revolt and held the town until the tsar's troops retook it; the last Kalmyk and Tatar raid reached the walls in 1713. With the frontier pushed farther south the fortress became a market town, sending sixty to ninety barges a year of rye, flour, oats and timber down the Khopyor and the Don to Azov and the Black Sea. In 1779 Borisoglebsk became an uyezd town of Tambov Governorate.
zh:
鲍里索格列布斯克一带位于霍皮奥尔河上游与其支流沃罗纳河之间，属森林草原，开阔草场间散布着成片橡林，其中以泰列尔曼大橡林最有名。1444年，这片牧场是大帐汗国的西北边缘：鞑靼牧群夏天在此吃草，克里米亚与诺盖的劫掠队伍则取道北上奔袭梁赞，全境只有米萨尔鞑靼人和莫尔多瓦人几处零星的捕鱼、养蜂营地。莫斯科公国把设防边墙向南推进时，16世纪末至17世纪初附近先后建起沃罗涅日和坦波夫要塞，此地空旷的林地和水面则被出租作渔猎场。

这里最早因木材进入莫斯科的视野。彼得一世筹备亚速远征时，命人砍伐泰列尔曼橡林，就地建造驳船和辅助船只供亚速舰队使用；1698年，沃罗纳河畔建起巴甫洛夫斯克要塞，防备克里米亚、亚速和诺盖人入寇。1704年，圣鲍里斯与格列布教堂落成，要塞得名鲍里索格列布斯克。四年后，市民加入孔德拉季·布拉文的哥萨克起义，据城坚守，直到被沙皇军队夺回；1713年，卡尔梅克与鞑靼人的最后一次入寇兵临城下。边界继续南移后，要塞变成商镇，每年有六十至九十条满载黑麦、面粉、燕麦和木材的驳船顺霍皮奥尔河、顿河驶往亚速和黑海。1779年，鲍里索格列布斯克成为坦波夫省的县城。

en:
Manych takes its name from the shallow, brackish Manych, whose salt lakes and marshes string out along the Kuma-Manych Depression, the low trough between the Don, the lower Volga and the Caucasus. In 1444 these grasslands belonged to the Great Horde, the surviving core of the Golden Horde ruled from Sarai. Astrakhani Tatar and Nogai herders drove sheep, cattle and horses between the Manych pastures and the Volga crossings, and caravans and river boats carried goods down toward Hajji-Tarkhan, the great market at the Volga mouth. A black-earth bluff on the Volga's right bank, later called Chyorny Yar, commanded a stretch of that road, but no fort stood there yet.

Mahmud, son of Küchük Muhammad, formed the Astrakhan polity around Hajji-Tarkhan in 1459, and it became fully independent only after the Crimeans destroyed the Great Horde in 1502. Nogai riders held most of the western steppe and crossed the Volga against Astrakhan in 1521. Moscow set Dervish Ali on the khan's throne in 1554; in June 1556 a Cossack vanguard found Hajji-Tarkhan abandoned, and Russian troops ended the khanate. The Persian diplomat Oruj beg Bayat, travelling to Spain by way of the Volga in 1599, recorded the black bluff under the name Chyorny Yar. In 1627 the Russians built the fort of Mikhailov Novgorod there to guard the Volga trade route; a collapsing bank forced it half a mile upstream in 1634 under the name Chyorny Yar, which neighbouring Nogais called Yankala, 'new town'. Kalmyk victories over the Great Nogai Horde in the 1630s pushed the surviving Nogais west to the right bank. Stenka Razin's rebels took the fort in 1670-1671, and Astrakhan rebels seized it again in 1705. In 1785 Chyorny Yar became an uyezd town of Astrakhan Governorate.
zh:
马内奇得名于水浅味咸的马内奇河；一连串咸水湖和沼泽沿库马—马内奇洼地展开，横在顿河、伏尔加河下游与高加索之间的低槽中。1444年时，这片草原属于以萨莱为都的大帐，即金帐汗国残存的核心。阿斯特拉罕鞑靼人与诺盖牧人赶着羊、牛和马，在马内奇牧场与伏尔加河渡口之间转场，商队与河船把货物运往伏尔加河口的大市场哈吉—塔尔汗。伏尔加河右岸有一道黑土崖，后来称乔尔内亚尔，扼守这段河路，当时崖上还没有要塞。

1459年，小穆罕默德之子马哈茂德以哈吉—塔尔汗为中心建立阿斯特拉罕政权，直到1502年克里米亚人攻灭大帐后才完全独立。诺盖骑兵掌握着西部草原的大部，1521年渡过伏尔加河进攻阿斯特拉罕。1554年，莫斯科把德尔维什·阿里扶上汗位；1556年6月，一支哥萨克前锋抵达时哈吉—塔尔汗已是空城，俄军随即灭亡汗国。1599年，取道伏尔加河出使西班牙的波斯外交官奥鲁奇·别克·巴亚特把这道黑土崖记作乔尔内亚尔。1627年，俄国人在此修筑米哈伊洛夫新城要塞，护卫伏尔加商路；河岸崩塌迫使要塞在1634年向上游迁移半英里，定名乔尔内亚尔，邻近的诺盖人称之为扬卡拉，意为「新城」。1630年代，卡尔梅克人连破大诺盖帐，残存的诺盖部众西迁至右岸。斯坚卡·拉辛的起义军在1670—1671年攻占要塞，1705年阿斯特拉罕起义者再次夺取。1785年，乔尔内亚尔成为阿斯特拉罕省的县城。

en:
The Ryn sands fill the watershed between the lower Volga and the lower Yaik, a belt of dunes and salt-marsh in the Caspian lowland where shallow streams run out among reed-fringed lakes. No town stood here and the grass was thin, but the hollows gave shelter from winter winds, so the Nogai Horde used the desert as its southern pasture. In 1444 Manghit herdsmen grazed sheep, horses and camels around the wells and took sturgeon from the two great rivers bordering the sands.

Kazakh pressure pushed the Nogais west of the Volga in the early sixteenth century, and the empty sands passed to the Kalmyks: Kho-Urluk's Torghut Oirats crossed the Yaik in 1628–1630 and made the Ryn their winter ground. They held it until 1771, when the Torghuts struck their camps and marched back to Dzungaria, leaving the desert nearly uninhabited. During Pugachev's revolt of 1773–1774 Kazakh bands from beyond the Yaik rode across these pastures with the rebels. In 1801 Tsar Paul allowed Bukey, a sultan of the Junior Jüz, to bring five thousand tents, more than 22,000 people, across the Yaik into the vacant steppe; their Bukey Horde, also called the Inner Horde, held the Ryn under Russian suzerainty.
zh:
莱恩沙地横亘在伏尔加河下游与亚伊克河下游的分水岭上，是里海低地上一片沙丘与盐沼交错的地带，水浅的河流消失在芦苇丛生的湖泊之间。这里没有城镇，草也稀疏，只有洼地能避冬风，诺盖汗国便把这片沙漠当作南部牧场。1444年，曼格特牧人绕着水井放牧羊、马和骆驼，还在沙地两侧的两条大河里捕捞鲟鱼。

16世纪初，哈萨克人的压力把诺盖人赶过伏尔加河以西，空旷的沙地转手卡尔梅克人：1628至1630年，和鄂尔勒克率土尔扈特卫拉特人渡过亚伊克河，把莱恩沙地变成自己的冬牧场。他们一直占有此地，直到1771年土尔扈特人拔营东归准噶尔，沙漠几乎空无一人。1773至1774年普加乔夫起义期间，亚伊克河以东的哈萨克队伍随起义军驰骋过这片牧场。1801年，沙皇保罗准许小玉兹苏丹布克依率五千帐、两万两千余人渡过亚伊克河，进入空旷的草原；他们的布克依斡耳朵又称内帐，在俄国宗主权下领有莱恩沙地。

en:
Bayuly is open grazing country east of the middle Yaik, running toward the Irgiz and the dry steppe beyond it. No walled town held these pastures. Horses, sheep and cattle moved between summer grass up the rivers and winter camps in the warmer south, with wells marking every stage; caravans from Saraychik to the Syr Darya used the same chain of water points. In 1444 Sunni Manghit clans of the Nogai Horde pastured their herds here. The name Bayuly belongs to the later Kazakh order, when twelve rods including the Adai, Berish and Zhappas formed one of the two great branches of the Alshyn tribe in the Little Jüz.

The twelve rods followed Abulkhair Khan when he took the Russian oath in 1731, but the frontier soon restricted the old movements of their herds. Their best-known leader, Syrym Datuly, rode with Pugachev's Cossacks in 1774 and then led the Little Jüz rising from 1783 to 1797. The Ural Cossacks captured him in the first year, and Khan Nuraly ransomed him; the same khan became one of the rebels' targets after Cossack patrols barred herders from the Yaik's right bank. Nuraly was driven out in 1786, and when the rising collapsed Syrym took his followers to Khiva in 1797. In 1801 Nuraly's son Bukey led about five thousand families across the Yaik into the thinly populated Volga steppe and founded the Inner, or Bukey, Horde with Russian permission.
zh:
巴伊乌勒是亚伊克河中游以东的开阔牧地，一直延伸到伊尔吉兹河和更干燥的草原。这里没有城墙围起的城镇，马、羊、牛沿着一处处水井，往返于河流上游的夏牧场与温暖南方的冬营地；从萨莱楚克前往锡尔河的商队也靠这串水井前行。1444年时，诺盖汗国的逊尼派曼吉特各部在此放牧。巴伊乌勒这个名称属于后来的哈萨克部落格局：阿代、别里什、扎帕斯等十二支，成为小玉兹阿尔申部落两大分支之一。

1731年，十二部随阿布勒海尔汗向俄罗斯宣誓，但边防很快限制了牧民旧有的转场路线。各部最知名的首领瑟雷姆·达托夫1774年曾随普加乔夫的哥萨克作战，1783至1797年又领导小玉兹起义。起义头一年，乌拉尔哥萨克俘获了他，努拉里汗将他赎出；后来哥萨克巡哨禁止牧民前往亚伊克河右岸，努拉里也成了起义者反对的目标之一。努拉里1786年被逐，起义失败后，瑟雷姆在1797年率部众退往希瓦。1801年，努拉里之子布克依经俄罗斯允许，率约五千户越过亚伊克河，进入人烟稀少的伏尔加草原，建立内帐，也称布克依斡耳朵。

en:
Alimuly covers the drier southern pastures of the Nogai steppe. The stony Mugodzhar hills rise between the Yaik and the Irgiz, and the grazing runs south-east to the reedy north-eastern shore of the Aral Sea and the edge of the Ustyurt plateau. Wells along this line carried caravan traffic from Saraychik toward Khiva. In 1444 Sunni Manghit herders moved between Mugodzhar springs and Aral reed beds, choosing camps by water rather than by any fixed town. The later Kazakh name belongs to six Alshyn rods, the Shekty and Tortkara among them; the Shekty used especially the north-eastern Aral lands.

During the seventeenth century these pastures were exposed to Kalmyk raids from the west and Dzungar pressure from the east. The great Dzungar invasion of the 1720s drew the six rods behind Abulkhair Khan, whose strongest tribal following lay among them. Kazakh oral tradition preserves the battle at Añyraqai as a victory for the Kazakh army under his overall command. Abulkhair took the Russian oath in 1731, which left the Little Jüz with a khan backed by the tsar while quarrels over his Russian alignment continued. Baraq Sultan killed him in 1748; the Shekty tradition adds that Sultan Batyr helped plan the killing. The Shekty then rejected Abulkhair's son Nuraly, proclaimed Batyr their khan, and split the Little Jüz into two rival khanates.
zh:
艾力木乌勒是诺盖草原上更干旱的南部牧场。多石的穆戈贾雷山隆起在亚伊克河与伊尔吉兹河之间，牧地向东南延伸到芦苇丛生的咸海东北岸和乌斯秋尔特高原边缘。沿这条线分布的水井，支撑着从萨莱楚克通向希瓦的商队。1444年时，逊尼派曼吉特牧人在穆戈贾雷山泉水和咸海芦苇滩之间转场，按水源而不是城镇选择营地。这个省名来自后来哈萨克阿尔申部落的六个分支，谢克特、托尔特卡拉都在其中，谢克特人尤其常在咸海东北一带游牧。

17世纪时，这片牧场西受卡尔梅克人袭扰，东遭准噶尔人进逼。1720年代准噶尔大举入侵，六部聚集到阿布勒海尔汗麾下，他最稳固的部众也来自这些分支。哈萨克口头传说把安拉凯之战传为其统一指挥下哈萨克军队的一场胜仗。阿布勒海尔1731年向俄罗斯宣誓，使小玉兹有了沙皇支持的汗，但部众对他亲俄路线的争执没有停止。1748年，巴拉克苏丹杀死阿布勒海尔；谢克特人的说法还称巴蒂尔苏丹参与谋划。谢克特人随后拒认阿布勒海尔之子努拉里，拥立巴蒂尔为汗，小玉兹分裂成两个对立的汗廷。

en:
The Zhetyru steppe lies where dry grassland climbs into the wooded southern Urals. Along the upper Yaik and the Tobol headwaters, birch and pine cover the ridges while black-earth glades open below them, giving herds both summer grazing and sheltered winter camps. Bashkir herders already used the nearby mountains, and the forest edge marked the limit between herders who lived in felt tents and trappers who worked the Ural valleys. In 1444 this was the north-eastern march of the Nogai Horde, where Sunni Manghit clans camped close to Bashkir pastures.

The later Kazakh name belongs to seven old Desht-i-Kipchak rods, Tabyn and Tama among them. Kazakh genealogies say Tauke Khan joined the weak clans in the late seventeenth century, an account also preserved through Abulkhair Khan's report to the Russian envoy Tevkelev. Each rod kept its own tamga mark and war cry, and the new union was attached to the Little Jüz. Dzungar raids in the 1720s pushed the seven rods into Abulkhair's alliance and the Russian oath of 1731. Ivan Kirilov's Orenburg expedition then built its first fort at the mouth of the Or in 1735, the post later called Orsk, and Kirilov presented it as a step toward routes to Bukhara and India. The Bashkir rising of 1735–1740 swept these hills while the line was being built; Chelyaba covered the Miass flank to the north-east and Orenburg became the final headquarters in 1743.
zh:
杰特鲁草原位于干旱草地抬升为南乌拉尔林地的地带。亚伊克河上游和托博尔河源头一带，山脊上长满桦树和松树，山下展开黑土林间空地，既有夏牧场，也有可避风寒的冬营地。巴什基尔牧人已在附近山地活动，林缘大致分开了住毡帐的牧人和乌拉尔山谷中的猎户。1444年时，这里是诺盖汗国的东北边地，逊尼派曼吉特各部在巴什基尔牧场旁扎营。

杰特鲁这个名称来自塔本、塔马等七个古老的钦察草原氏族。哈萨克谱系说，17世纪末头克汗把这些弱小氏族合并起来；俄国使者捷夫克列夫转述阿布勒海尔汗的说法，也留下了同样记载。每一支都保留自己的塔姆加印记和战吼，这个新联合体后来并入小玉兹。1720年代准噶尔袭扰，七部加入阿布勒海尔的联盟，并于1731年随他向俄罗斯宣誓。随后，伊万·基里洛夫的奥伦堡考察团在1735年把第一座要塞修在奥尔河口，即后来的奥尔斯克；基里洛夫把它看作通向布哈拉和印度商路的一步。要塞线修建期间，1735至1740年的巴什基尔起义席卷这片山地；切利亚巴拱卫东北方的米阿斯河侧翼，奥伦堡则在1743年成为整条防线的最终大本营。

en:
Samara lies where the Samara River joins the Volga, on the great loop called the Samara Bend. Ahmad ibn Fadlan, travelling to the Volga Bulgars in 921, noted the river, and Italian charts of the fourteenth century already mark a Volga port named Samara. Under the Golden Horde the peninsula of the bend was a pirates' nest: lookouts watched for passing boats, crossed the neck of the peninsula to give warning, and the freebooters put out after their prey. In 1444 the left bank was the steppe edge of the new Khanate of Kazan, pasture for Nogai herds, with no Russian town yet built.

After Moscow took Kazan in 1552 it moved to secure the Volga road to Astrakhan. In 1586, on Tsar Fyodor's order, voevoda Grigory Zasekin built a wooden fortress at the river mouth between 9 May and 6 August, manned by streltsy, gunners and gate guards; to keep the Nogai mirza friendly Moscow told him the fort was there only to shield his people from Cossack raiders. A customs house followed in 1600, and Samara became a meeting place for Russian merchants and envoys travelling to the East. Stepan Razin's rebels took it in 1670, and in 1773 it was the first town to go over to Yemelyan Pugachev. In the 1740s the Orenburg Expedition made the town its base; Vasily Tatishchev was one of its heads, and the expedition founded Orenburg and Stavropol on the Volga. Catherine II made Samara an uyezd town of Simbirsk Governorate in 1780.
zh:
萨马拉位于萨马拉河注入伏尔加河处，坐落在萨马拉河湾的大弯环上。阿拉伯使者艾哈迈德·伊本·法德兰921年出使伏尔加保加利亚途中记下了这条河，14世纪的意大利海图上也已标出伏尔加河畔一处叫萨马拉的港口。金帐汗国时期，河湾围出的半岛是盗匪盘踞之地：望手盯梢过往船只，穿过半岛地峡报信，匪徒便驾船出掠。1444年时，伏尔加左岸是新兴喀山汗国的草原边缘，诺盖牧人在此放牧，俄国人的城镇尚未出现。

1552年莫斯科攻陷喀山后，着手保障通往阿斯特拉罕的伏尔加水路。1586年奉费奥多尔沙皇诏令，督军格里戈里·扎谢金于5月9日至8月6日间在河口筑起木堡，由射手、炮手和守门兵戍守；为安抚诺盖米尔扎，莫斯科对他说，筑堡只是为了保护其部众不受哥萨克盗匪袭扰。1600年这里设立海关，萨马拉成为俄国商人和使者前往东方的会集地。1670年，斯捷潘·拉辛的起义军攻占此城；1773年，它又是第一座倒向叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的城市。1740年代，奥伦堡考察团以该城为驻地，瓦西里·塔季谢夫是负责人之一，奥伦堡和伏尔加河畔的斯塔夫罗波尔都由该考察团主持建立。1780年，叶卡捷琳娜二世把萨马拉设为辛比尔斯克省的县城。

en:
The Yaik carries the snowmelt of the southern Urals some twelve hundred kilometres to the Caspian, and in 1444 its middle course was Nogai country. Manghit clans pastured sheep and horses along the banks and camped on the river islands to fish, and the sturgeon runs were already prized. No town stood on this stretch; the Horde's only city, Saray-Jük, lay far downstream near the mouth.

Fugitive Volga Cossacks who had helped sack Saray-Jük settled the middle river in the 1580s. The Nogais destroyed their first fort in 1613, and the survivors refounded it on the peninsula between the Yaik and the Chagan; 1613 became the accepted founding year of Yaitsk. A charter from Tsar Michael granted the host the entire river from source to mouth, and sturgeon and caviar made the Cossacks rich, though fifteen hundred of them died on Bekovich-Cherkassky's Khiva expedition of 1717. Quarrels over fishing rights and the loss of their self-government brought a rising in 1772, when they cut down General von Traubenberg, and the repression that followed drove them to Yemelyan Pugachev. On 17 September 1773 the Don Cossack deserter proclaimed himself Tsar Peter III at the Budarinsky outpost and raised his standard. Yaitsk fell to him, and a loyal garrison held out for months in the fortified cathedral of the Archangel Michael until relieved in April 1774. In January 1775 Catherine II erased the name Yaik from the map: the river became the Ural, the host the Ural Cossacks and the town Uralsk.
zh:
亚伊克河承接南乌拉尔山的融雪，流过约一千二百公里注入里海。1444年，其中游是诺盖人的土地：曼格特诸部在两岸放牧羊马，在河洲上扎营捕鱼，河中的鲟鱼鱼汛已为人看重。这一河段没有城镇，汗国唯一的城市萨莱楚克远在靠近河口的下游。

1580年代，参与洗劫萨莱楚克的一批出逃伏尔加河哥萨克在中游落脚。1613年他们的第一座堡寨被诺盖人摧毁，幸存者在亚伊克河与恰甘河之间的半岛上重建，1613年便被定为亚伊茨克的建城年份。米哈伊尔沙皇的诏书把整条河自源头到河口赐给哥萨克军，鲟鱼和鱼子酱让他们富足，1717年却有一千五百人在别科维奇-切尔卡斯基的希瓦远征中丧命。渔业权益之争加上自治被夺，引发1772年暴动，哥萨克杀死冯·特劳本贝格将军，随之而来的镇压把他们推向叶梅利扬·普加乔夫。1773年9月17日，这个顿河哥萨克逃兵在布达林斯基哨所自称沙皇彼得三世，举旗起事。亚伊茨克陷落，忠于政府的守军据守天使长米哈伊尔大教堂数月，直到1774年4月解围。1775年1月，叶卡捷琳娜二世把「亚伊克」一名从地图上抹去：河改名乌拉尔河，哥萨克军改称乌拉尔哥萨克军，城镇改称乌拉尔斯克。

en:
Bashkortostan covers the middle course of the Belaya, called Aghidhel in Bashkir, where the forest belt opens into steppe and Bashkir tribes grazed cattle and horses between the two. On the hill above the river medieval maps already mark a substantial town: the Pizzigano map of 1367 and the Catalan Atlas of 1375 call it Pascherti, Mercator keeps the name in 1554, and Ibn Khaldun lists Bashkort among the great cities of the Golden Horde. In the sixteenth century the same ground held Imen-kala, the oak-built seat of the Nogai governors. When the Golden Horde broke up, the western Bashkir tribes fell to the Kazan khanate. In 1444 they were Hanafi Sunni herdsmen, Kazan's subjects, exposed to Nogai raids out of the open steppe.

After Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in October 1552, Bashkir embassies treated with his governors in 1554 to 1557 and took charters confirming their ancestral pasturelands. In 1574 the voevoda Mikhail Nagoy raised a wooden fortress on the Tura-Tau hill, the future Ufa, granted town status in 1586; for two centuries it was the main Russian strongpoint east of the Volga. Its garrison beat off the Siberian tsarevich Ablai and his Kalmyks in 1635 and took him prisoner. Bashkir risings swept the country round the walls more than once; the bloodiest, in 1735 to 1740, answered the building of the Orenburg chain of forts across the pasturelands. In the winter of 1773 to 1774 Ufa withstood a months-long siege and assault by Pugachev's rebels, even as Bashkir horsemen joined the rising.

Catherine II's government made the town the seat of the Ufa viceroyalty in December 1781. On 4 December 1789 the Orenburg Mohammedan Spiritual Assembly opened here under her charter of 1788, a state muftiate that appointed imams and judged family law for the Muslims of the Volga, Urals and Siberia. In 1798 the Bashkirs were mustered into a Cossack-style irregular host, their cavalry posted on the empire's eastern edge.
zh:
巴什科尔托斯坦占据别拉亚河（巴什基尔语称阿吉代尔）中游一带，林带在此铺展为草原，巴什基尔诸部在林草之间放牧牛马。河畔山丘上曾有一座颇具规模的城镇：1367年的皮齐加诺地图和1375年的《加泰罗尼亚地图集》把它标作帕什凯尔季，1554年墨卡托的地图沿用此名，伊本·赫勒敦也把巴什科特列入金帐汗国的大城市。16世纪时，同一处地点是诺盖比伊的橡木驻地伊缅卡拉。金帐汗国解体后，巴什基尔西部诸部归于喀山汗国。1444年时，他们是奉哈乃斐教法的逊尼派牧人，臣服喀山，南面草原上的诺盖骑兵随时可能来袭。

1552年10月伊凡雷帝攻灭喀山后，巴什基尔各部使团在1554至1557年与沙皇的总督谈判，领到确认祖传牧场的特许状。1574年，督军米哈伊尔·纳戈伊在山丘上筑起木要塞，即后来的乌法，1586年获准设城；此后两百年间，它是伏尔加河以东俄国最主要的据点。1635年，守军击退西伯利亚王公阿布莱及其卡尔梅克盟军的来犯，将阿布莱生擒。巴什基尔人的起义一再席卷城外四乡，最惨烈的一次在1735至1740年，起因是奥伦堡要塞链穿过牧场修筑。1773至1774年冬，乌法顶住普加乔夫义军长达数月的围攻和强攻，与此同时大批巴什基尔骑兵加入了起义。

1781年12月，叶卡捷琳娜二世的政府把乌法设为乌法总督区驻地。依女皇1788年的诏令，奥伦堡穆罕默德宗教会议于1789年12月4日在此开幕：这是国家管理的穆夫提公署，为伏尔加、乌拉尔和西伯利亚的穆斯林任命伊玛目、裁断家事教法。1798年，巴什基尔人被编为哥萨克式的非正规军，其骑兵驻守帝国东缘。

en:
Kypshak is the central Kazakh steppe used by Kipchak clans, a country of dispersed wells and seasonal pastures later counted among the tribes of the Middle Jüz. There were few walled towns here; authority moved with tents, herds and cavalry between summer and winter grazing. After the eastern Golden Horde fragmented, Abu'l-Khayr Khan united the Shibanid clans of Dasht-i Qipchaq and took the khan's title in 1429. He campaigned toward Khwarezm and the lower Volga, and in 1431-32 seized Orda-Bazar. Russian sources describe it chiefly as a nomadic khan's headquarters and market rather than a fixed city, a place where coin could be struck for an ulus on the move. In 1444 Orda-Bazar was the camp centre of Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation; two years later he took Sighnaq, Sozak and other Syr Darya towns. Kipchak, Kerey and Naiman clans pastured horses and sheep under his uneasy rule.

Two Chinggisid sultans, Kerei and Janibek, rejected that authority and withdrew toward Moghulistan; Kazakh tradition dates their khanate from 1465. Abu'l-Khayr died in battle in 1468, and when the sultans returned to central Kazakhstan much of the steppe followed them. Under Burunduk from 1480 and Qasim Khan from 1511 to 1521, the Kazakh confederation became the leading power of the eastern steppe, with its authority reaching toward the Urals. Dzungar armies overran the pastures in spring 1723, sending Middle Jüz refugees toward Samarkand and Khujand; Kazakh forces recovered after victories in 1728 and 1730. The Middle Jüz accepted nominal Russian suzerainty soon after 1731, while Ablai Khan used the collapse of Dzungaria between 1771 and 1781 to rebuild Kazakh power. After Vali Khan died in 1817, Russian forts and frontier officials pressed increasingly close to the old Kipchak grazing grounds.
zh:
钦察是哈萨克中部草原上钦察氏族的牧地，水井分散，牧场随季节转换，这里后来归入中玉兹诸部。这片土地上少有城墙环绕的城镇；权力跟着毡帐、畜群和骑兵在夏冬牧场之间移动。金帐汗国东翼瓦解后，阿布勒海尔汗统一钦察草原上的昔班尼诸部，于1429年称汗。他向花剌子模和伏尔加河下游用兵，并在1431至1432年夺取奥尔达-巴扎尔。俄罗斯资料主要把它记作游牧汗廷和市集，而非固定城市，却可以为移动的兀鲁思铸造钱币。1444年，奥尔达-巴扎尔是阿布勒海尔乌兹别克联盟的驻营中心；两年后，他攻取昔格纳黑、苏扎克等锡尔河城市。钦察、克列和乃蛮等氏族在其并不稳固的统治下放牧马和羊。

克列和贾尼别克两位成吉思汗系苏丹拒绝接受这一权威，率部迁往蒙兀儿斯坦；哈萨克传统把他们建国定在1465年。1468年阿布勒海尔战死，两位苏丹返回哈萨克中部后，草原上的许多部众随之归附。1480年起在位的布伦杜克和1511至1521年在位的卡西姆汗，使哈萨克联盟成为东部草原的首要强权，势力向西延伸到乌拉尔河一带。1723年春，准噶尔军队席卷各牧场，中玉兹难民涌向撒马尔罕和苦盏；哈萨克人在1728年和1730年取胜后逐渐恢复。1731年后不久，中玉兹接受俄国名义上的宗主权；1771至1781年，阿布赉汗趁准噶尔崩溃重建哈萨克权势。瓦里汗1817年去世后，俄国要塞和边疆官员日益逼近旧日的钦察牧场。

en:
The Nadym pasture is the dry middle course of the Sarysu, arid grassland between the oasis towns of the Talas valley and the low ridges of the Sary-Arka. Wells are few and often brackish, and southward the grass thins into the hunger-steppe of Betpak-Dala. Clans that wanted grain, cloth or metal goods drove their herds down to the Syr Darya, above all to the walled market of Sighnaq, which had been the capital of the Blue Horde in the thirteenth century. In 1444 the Kipchak clans camping here belonged to Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus, the strongest power on the eastern Dasht-i Qipchaq, whose khan still held court at Tura in western Siberia; its horses and wool moved south along the caravan tracks to Sighnaq.

In 1457 Oirats under Uz-Temur-tayishi routed Abu'l-Khayr's army near Sighnaq, and when he died on campaign in 1468 the ulus fell apart. Kerei and Janibek, Jochid princes who had led their followers off to the Zhetysu a few years before, returned at the head of the clans now called Kazakhs, and the Sarysu pastures became grazing ground of the Middle Jüz. The worst blow came in 1723, when Dzungar armies overran the southern steppe in the 'Years of the Great Disaster': the auls left their winter camps and stock behind and fled to the Syr Darya. The united militia answered with victories at Bulanty in 1726 and near Lake Balkhash in 1729. The rulers of the Middle Jüz accepted Russian suzerainty in 1740, and Abylai Khan, a veteran commander of the Dzungar wars who was elected khan of all three jüzes at Turkestan in 1771, held the confederation together until his death in 1781.
zh:
纳德姆牧地是萨雷苏河中游一带的干旱草原，处在塔拉斯河谷的绿洲城镇与萨雷阿尔卡丘陵之间。水井稀少，水多苦咸；向南草木渐稀，没入别特帕克-达拉「饥饿草原」。需要粮食、布匹或金属器的部落，赶着牲畜南下锡尔河，主要去往筑有城墙的市集昔格纳克，它在13世纪曾是蓝帐汗国的都城。1444年，在此游牧的钦察诸部属于阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思，他是东钦察草原最强的势力，汗廷还设在西西伯利亚的图拉城；马匹和羊毛沿商道南下，运到昔格纳克售卖。

1457年，乌兹帖木儿太师率领的卫拉特人在昔格纳克附近大败阿布勒海尔；1468年他死于出征途中，兀鲁思随之瓦解。数年前率领部众迁往七河之地的术赤系宗王克烈与贾尼别克，此时率领改称哈萨克的诸部重返草原，萨雷苏牧场后来成为中玉兹的游牧地。最重的一击在1723年：准噶尔军队席卷南部草原，史称「大灾难年代」，诸部抛下冬营地和牲畜逃往锡尔河。联军1726年在布兰泰、1729年在巴尔喀什湖附近先后取胜。1740年中玉兹诸汗接受俄国宗主权；阿布莱汗本是准噶尔战争中打出来的将领，1771年在突厥斯坦被三玉兹推举为汗，把联盟维系到1781年去世。

en:
The Argyn are the most numerous tribe of the Kazakh Middle Jüz. Their clans range over the dry Sary-Arka steppe from the Turgai plateau in the west to the Chingiz mountains below the Altai, and south to the north-western shore of Lake Balkhash, moving sheep, horses and wool-bearing flocks between summer and winter pastures. Their genealogies name Karakhodzha, a fourteenth-century emir of the Golden Horde, as their ancestor; his descendants split into the Meiram and Momyn branches, and the tribe charges to the cry 'Akzhol'. In 1444 the Argyn auls pastured within the Uzbek ulus of Abu'l-Khayr Khan, between his Syr Darya towns and the Irtysh frontier.

Abu'l-Khayr's death in 1468 undid his ulus, and the Argyns went over to the sultans Kerei and Janibek, becoming the leading tribe of the Middle Jüz. Their biys sat in the khan's council. The most famous was Kazybek (1667–1763) of the Karakesek clan, one of the three great judges of the Kazakhs, an orator and envoy who under Tauke Khan helped compile the Zhety Zhargy, the code of steppe customary law; he was born on the Syr Darya and died at his winter camp by the Terakty spring in the Sary-Arka. The Dzungar war brought forward Abylai, who had risen as leader of the large Atygai clan. The invasion of 1741 carried him off to Galdan Tseren's camp, where he was held until 1743, a year after the Middle Jüz accepted Russian suzerainty. In 1771 the three jüzes raised him as their khan at Turkestan.
zh:
阿尔浑是哈萨克中玉兹人数最多的部落。各部在干旱的萨雷阿尔卡草原游牧，在夏牧场与冬营地之间辗转，地域西起图尔盖高原，东到阿尔泰麓的成吉思山脉，南抵巴尔喀什湖西北岸，牧放绵羊、马匹和毛用羊群。谱系把始祖追溯到14世纪金帐汗国的埃米尔卡拉霍加，后裔分为梅拉姆、莫温两大支，部族冲锋时高呼「阿克卓勒」。1444年，阿尔浑的阿乌尔在阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思中游牧，牧地夹在他的锡尔河城镇与额尔齐斯河边地之间。

1468年阿布勒海尔一死，兀鲁思瓦解，阿尔浑人投奔克烈、贾尼别克两位苏丹，成为中玉兹首屈一指的部落。阿尔浑的比位列汗廷，其中最有名的是喀拉克塞克氏族的哈孜别克（1667—1763）：他是哈萨克三大比之一，以雄辩和出使闻名，头克汗时期参与编纂草原习惯法典《七项法典》；他生于锡尔河畔，晚年在萨雷阿尔卡捷拉克特泉边的冬营地去世。准噶尔战争中，因统领大阿提盖部而起家的阿布莱崭露头角。1741年的入侵把他掳往噶尔丹策零的营地，一直囚禁到1743年；此前一年，中玉兹接受了俄国宗主权。1771年，三玉兹在突厥斯坦推举他为汗。

en:
Kerey is named for both a closed salt lake in the basin of Lake Tengiz and the river that drains the dry pasture around it. The camps along their shores belonged to the Kerei, a Kazakh tribe whose genealogies reached back to the Altai; most scholars trace them to the Keraites of Wang Khan, broken by Genghis Khan in the early thirteenth century. In later tribal reckonings the Kerei were counted among the six tribes of the Middle Jüz. In 1444 these pastures owed allegiance to Abu'l-Khayr, the Shibanid khan of the Uzbek nomads, while the herdsmen who moved across them spoke Kazakh and were Sunni Muslims.

The secession that produced the Kazakh khanate began among steppe tribes like these. In the late 1450s the sultans Kerei and Janibek led perhaps 200,000 nomads away from Abu'l-Khayr to the Chu and Talas valleys in Moghulistan. Abu'l-Khayr marched against them in 1468 and died on campaign, and Kerei ruled as the first Kazakh khan until he was killed fighting the Shibanids. The Kerei clans stayed with the Middle Jüz through the long wars against the Dzungars. The invasion of 1739-1741 forced its sultans to surrender hostages, and the Middle Jüz khan accepted Russian subjecthood in 1740. Ablai Khan, the last independent Kazakh khan, led the struggle against the Dzungars and later the Qing, and kept room to negotiate until his death in 1781; afterwards the northern pastures faced the Russian fortified lines with no khan between them.
zh:
凯里既是田吉兹湖流域一座没有出流的咸水湖之名，也是排泄湖畔干草原的同名河之名。湖河沿岸的营地属于克烈部，其谱系追溯到阿尔泰山，多数学者认为他们是王罕克烈部人的后裔，该部在13世纪初被成吉思汗击败。后来的部落划分把克烈列为中玉兹六大部落之一。1444年，这片牧场臣属于乌兹别克游牧人的昔班尼系汗王阿布勒海尔，而在牧场上转场的牧民说哈萨克语，是逊尼派穆斯林。

哈萨克汗国的分立正是从这样的草原部落中发端的。15世纪50年代末，克列汗与贾尼别克苏丹率约20万游牧人脱离阿布勒海尔，西迁蒙兀儿斯坦的楚河与塔拉斯河谷。阿布勒海尔1468年发兵来攻，死在出征途中，克列成为第一位哈萨克汗，后来在同昔班尼系的战争中被杀。克烈诸部留在中玉兹，经历了同准噶尔的长期战事。1739—1741年的入侵迫使中玉兹诸苏丹交出人质，中玉兹汗于1740年接受俄国臣属。最后一位独立的哈萨克汗阿布赉汗先后领导对抗准噶尔和清朝的战事，把周旋的余地维持到1781年去世；此后北部牧场直接面对俄国的筑垒防线，中间再没有汗王缓冲。

en:
Pegaya Orda covers the Kulunda steppe, the grassland and salt-lake country south of Baraba, reaching from the Ob and Irtysh lowlands toward the Altai foothills. Its wealth moved on four legs: sheep supplied wool, horses and cattle supported the camps, and hunting and the salt of inland lakes added to the herds' value. The Telengets, usually called Teleuts in Russian records and later named White Kalmyks there, pastured these lands in seasonal camps and winter quarters. They spoke a Turkic language and called their polity the Telenget ulus. In 1444 no walled town or fixed frontier stood here; the camps lay within the Oirat world and owed service or tribute when Oirat power reached the steppe.

Around 1600, Russian documents describe about 4,000 Telenget tents between the Irtysh and the Ob. The ulus then became a buffer between Muscovy and the Dzungar Khanate, and its princes changed alliances as the two powers pressed in. Prince Abak made an agreement with Moscow in 1609 and joined Russian campaigns in 1611 and 1615. Prince Koka swore to the Dzungars in 1645, submitted to the tsar in 1658 and resumed war in 1659. Russian voevodes drove him from the Meret camp across the Ob in 1661, and the Dzungar ruler Sengge subdued the ulus in 1663. In 1703 more than 20,000 Telengets were removed towards the Altai and the Ili. By 1717 the Telenget princes had become Dzungar officials, and the old steppe ulus no longer acted as an independent power.
zh:
佩加亚奥尔达地处库伦达草原，牧地和盐湖从巴拉巴草原以南铺展，由鄂毕河与额尔齐斯河之间的低地伸向阿尔泰山麓。这里的财富随牲畜移动：绵羊提供羊毛，马匹和牛支撑营地，狩猎和内流湖泊出产的盐也增加了牧群的价值。捷连格特人在俄国文献中多称捷列乌特人，后来又被称为「白卡尔梅克人」；他们按季节在这片土地上扎营、过冬。他们操突厥语，把自己的政治联合体称为捷连格特兀鲁思。1444年，这里没有城墙城镇或固定边界；各营地处在瓦剌势力范围内，瓦剌军力抵达草原时便要服役、纳贡。

约1600年前后，俄国文献记载额尔齐斯河与鄂毕河之间约有四千顶捷连格特人的毡帐。这个兀鲁思随后夹在莫斯科与准噶尔汗国之间，历代王公在两大势力挤压下反复改换盟邦。阿巴克王公1609年与莫斯科订约，并在1611年和1615年参加俄国远征。科卡王公1645年向准噶尔宣誓，1658年臣服沙皇，1659年又重启战事。1661年，俄国督军把他从梅列特营地逐过鄂毕河；1663年，准噶尔首领僧格征服这个兀鲁思。1703年，两万多名捷连格特人被迁往阿尔泰和伊犁方向。到1717年，捷连格特王公已成为准噶尔官吏，旧的草原兀鲁思不再作为独立势力行动。

en:
Bermuda is a remote North Atlantic archipelago of cedar-covered islands ringed by coral reefs, set far out beyond the nearest American coast. Seabirds and turtles nested on its shores, but the reefs and the storms gathering over the open ocean made the approaches dangerous for shipping. No Indigenous people ever settled the islands, so in November 1444 Bermuda was uninhabited land, unknown to European pilots and absent from their charts.

Early in the sixteenth century the Spanish captain Juan de Bermúdez sighted the islands that took his name; by 1511 they were on Spanish charts, though Spain used them only for water and fresh meat. English settlement grew out of a shipwreck. On 3 August 1609 the Sea Venture, flagship of a Virginia Company fleet bound for Jamestown, was caught in a hurricane and deliberately run onto the reefs to keep her from foundering. Everyone aboard reached the shore, spent nine months on the islands, and built two small ships, the Deliverance and the Patience, to carry them on to Virginia. Their account was read in London, and the wreck is widely thought to have helped give William Shakespeare his plot for The Tempest. Settlers sent out in the Plough founded St George's in 1612; the Somers Isles Company took over in 1615, an assembly first met in 1620, and the first enslaved people, one Black and one Native American, were brought from the West Indies in 1616.

Tobacco grew badly on the islands, and after the Crown took over from the company in 1684 the islanders lived by their yards and the sea: shipbuilding from Bermuda cedar, whaling, salt and privateering. In 1775 they shipped gunpowder to the American rebels. Work began on the Royal Naval Dockyard on Ireland Island in 1811, and Bermuda served as a base for British Atlantic operations through the War of 1812.
zh:
百慕大是北大西洋深处的遥远群岛，岛上遍布刺柏林，四周被珊瑚礁环绕，与最近的美洲海岸也隔着大片大洋。海鸟和海龟在岸边栖息，但暗礁和外洋上生成的风暴让通往群岛的水路十分凶险。岛上从未有原住民定居，所以1444年11月的百慕大是一片无人之地，欧洲领航员不知道它，海图上也没有它。

16世纪初，西班牙船长胡安·百慕大望见这片后来以他姓氏命名的群岛；到1511年，群岛已标在西班牙海图上，但西班牙人只把这里当作补给淡水和鲜肉的停泊地。英国人的定居始于一场海难。1609年8月3日，弗吉尼亚公司驰援詹姆斯敦的船队旗舰「海洋冒险号」遭遇飓风，为避免沉没而主动冲上暗礁。船上所有人都上了岸，在岛上停留九个月，造出「拯救号」和「忍耐号」两艘小船驶往弗吉尼亚。他们的记述在伦敦广为传阅，这场海难也被普遍认为是威廉·莎士比亚《暴风雨》的情节来源之一。1612年，乘「犁号」前来的移民建立圣乔治镇；萨默斯岛公司1615年接手，议会1620年首次召开，1616年首批奴隶从西印度群岛运来，共两人，一名黑人、一名美洲原住民。

烟草在岛上长势不好，1684年英国王室收回殖民地后，岛民转而靠船坞和海洋为生：用刺柏木材造船，以及捕鲸、晒盐和私掠巡航。1775年，岛民把一批火药运给美洲起义者。1811年，爱尔兰岛上的皇家海军造船厂动工，1812年战争期间，百慕大是英国大西洋作战行动的基地。

en:
The Bahamas are a long chain of low islands and cays on the Great Bahama Bank, north of Cuba and Hispaniola. The Lucayans, a Taino people who called themselves Lukku-Cairi, 'people of the islands', had paddled across from Cuba or Hispaniola in dugout canoes centuries before and spread through the nineteen largest islands. In 1444 they lived in small chiefdoms, fishing the grass flats and reefs, diving for conch, tending cassava and weaving cotton, perhaps 30,000 strong. No European had yet seen the harbour on New Providence where Nassau now stands.

Columbus made his first landfall in the Americas on one of these cays on 12 October 1492 and named it San Salvador. The meeting brought the Lucayans little good: Spanish slavers carried them off to labour in Hispaniola and dive for pearls off Cubagua, with Vespucci alone taking 232 in 1500, and by 1520 a Spanish search found only eleven islanders alive. The cays then lay empty for roughly 130 years. Bermudian religious exiles, the Eleutheran Adventurers, settled Eleuthera in 1648; Charles Town was founded on New Providence in 1670, and after Spanish raiders burned it in 1684 it was rebuilt in 1695 as Nassau, named for William III of Orange-Nassau.

Nassau's fame in this age was piracy. Henry Every sailed in aboard the plunder-laden Fancy in 1696 and bribed the governor, and after Franco-Spanish raids drove the settlers out in 1703 and 1706, the wreck of the 1715 Spanish treasure fleet drew swarms of jobless privateers. Hornigold, Jennings, Vane and Blackbeard made New Providence their base, roughly a thousand pirates against a hundred townspeople. Woodes Rogers, the English captain who had rescued the castaway Alexander Selkirk, the model for Defoe's Robinson Crusoe, reached Nassau as royal governor in 1718: he pardoned those who submitted, hanged nine of the holdouts on 12 December 1718, and held the town against a Spanish attack in 1720. American marines raided Nassau for gunpowder in 1776 and Spain took it in 1782, but it was British again in 1783; Loyalist planters then arrived with enslaved Africans and planted cotton.
zh:
巴哈马是大巴哈马浅滩上一长串低矮岛屿和珊瑚礁，位于古巴与伊斯帕尼奥拉以北。卢卡扬人是泰诺人的一支，自称卢库凯里，意为「岛屿之人」，他们在几个世纪前乘独木舟从古巴或伊斯帕尼奥拉渡来，逐渐散布到十九个最大的岛屿。1444年，他们以小型酋邦为社会组织，在海草浅滩和礁岩间捕鱼、潜水采螺、种植木薯、纺织棉花，人口约有三万。那时还没有欧洲人见过新普罗维登斯岛上那处港湾，后来的拿骚就建在那里。

1492年10月12日，哥伦布在美洲的首次登陆就在其中一座珊瑚礁，他将其命名为圣萨尔瓦多。这次相遇没有给卢卡扬人带来什么好处：西班牙掠奴者把他们掳走，送到伊斯帕尼奥拉做苦役、去库瓦瓜附近采珠，仅韦斯普奇1500年就带走232人；到1520年，一场西班牙搜索只找到11名还活着的岛民。此后群岛荒芜了约130年。1648年，来自百慕大的宗教流亡者埃留特拉冒险者在埃留特拉岛定居；查尔斯顿1670年建于新普罗维登斯，1684年被西班牙袭掠者焚毁，1695年重建后改名拿骚，以奥兰治-拿骚家族的威廉三世命名。

这个时代拿骚的名气全在海盗身上。1696年亨利·埃夫里驾着满载赃物的「幻想号」进港，重金贿赂总督；1703和1706年法西联军两度袭城、居民逃散后，1715年西班牙珍宝船队的沉船又引来大批失业私掠者。霍尼戈、詹宁斯、韦恩和黑胡子都以新普罗维登斯为巢穴，海盗约有上千，镇上居民却不过一百。曾救起荒岛余生者亚历山大·塞尔扣克（笛福《鲁滨逊漂流记》主人公的原型）的英格兰船长伍兹·罗杰斯，1718年以皇家总督身份抵达拿骚：归顺者赦免，顽抗者中的九人在1718年12月12日被绞死，他又在1720年守住城镇、击退西班牙进攻。1776年美国海军陆战队为夺取火药袭占拿骚，西班牙1782年占城，1783年英国恢复统治；效忠派种植园主随后带着被奴役的非洲人到来，开辟棉花种植园。

en:
The Turks Islands are the dry south-eastern end of the Lucayan Archipelago: Grand Turk, Salt Cay and a scatter of smaller keys, low, flat and short of fresh water. They take their name from the Turk's cap cactus, whose bristly red top European sailors likened to a Turk's fez. Lucayan islanders kin to the Taino of Hispaniola had lived here since about 500, with a fresh Taino settlement wave around 1200, and in 1444 they fished the banks, gathered conch, tended gardens and made pottery. Their shallow salinas, where the sun evaporated seawater into salt, were the islands' distinctive resource.

The first documented European to sight the islands was Juan Ponce de Leon in 1512; a Columbus landfall here in 1492 remains conjecture. Slavers and disease had emptied the islands by about 1513, and for a century and a half the only regular visitors were Bermudians, who came in the 1660s to rake the salt pans each season and shipped the salt to the North American fishing fleets. Balfour Town on Salt Cay dates from 1673, and Cockburn Town on Grand Turk, the first permanent settlement, from 1681; the raking was done by enslaved Africans, who before long outnumbered the white salt workers. Spain seized Grand Turk in 1710 and Bermudan privateers took it back. When France pressed its claim with crosses and royal arms in 1753, crews from two British warships hacked the marks down on 21 January 1754, and Britain asserted ownership in 1764. French troops landed in February 1783, and on 9 March Captain Horatio Nelson, in HMS Albemarle, led a counterattack that was beaten off in the shallows; the Treaty of Paris returned the islands to Britain later that year. Loyalist planters then tried cotton and sisal with more than a thousand enslaved Africans, but by 1820 most had left and sea salt carried the islands' trade.
zh:
特克斯群岛是卢卡亚群岛干旱的东南端，由大特克、盐岛和散落的小礁屿组成，地势低平、淡水稀少。群岛得名于「土耳其帽仙人掌」，欧洲水手觉得它带刺的红色顶部像土耳其毡帽。与伊斯帕尼奥拉泰诺人有亲缘关系的卢卡扬人约500年起在此居住，约1200年又有一批泰诺人迁来；1444年，他们在浅滩捕鱼、采集凤凰螺、耕作园圃、制作陶器。岛上浅浅的盐田靠日光把海水晒成盐，是这群礁屿最特别的物产。

首次有记载望见群岛的欧洲人是1512年的胡安·庞塞·德莱昂，1492年哥伦布曾登此岛只是推测。到约1513年，掠奴者和疫病已使群岛人烟断绝；此后一个半世纪里，常来的只有百慕大人：他们1660年代起每年到盐田刮盐，再把海盐运往北美渔船队。盐岛的鲍尔弗镇建于1673年，大特克的科伯恩城是第一个永久定居点，建于1681年；刮盐的苦役由被奴役的非洲人承担，他们不久就在人数上超过白人盐工。西班牙1710年攻占大特克，百慕大私掠者又将其收复。1753年法国竖起十字架和王徽宣示主权，两艘英国军舰的船员便在1754年1月21日把标记拆除，英国1764年正式宣布主权。1783年2月法军登陆，3月9日霍雷肖·纳尔逊乘「阿尔伯马尔」号率队反攻，在浅水区被击退；同年《巴黎条约》把群岛归还英国。效忠派种植园主随后带着一千多名被奴役非洲人试种棉花和剑麻，但到1820年多数人已经离开，支撑群岛贸易的只剩海盐。

en:
The finest harbour on Cuba's north coast opens on the island's north-west shore, a sheltered bay with a narrow mouth and deep anchorages. In 1444 the land around it belonged to the Taino chief Habaguanex; his people planted cassava and maize, fished the bay and paddled the coast in dugout canoes. The anchorage, later called Puerto de Carenas, had never seen a European ship, and all of Cuba remained in indigenous hands.

Sebastian de Ocampo careened his ships there during his circumnavigation of Cuba in 1508. The town of San Cristobal de la Habana was founded on the swampy south coast in 1514 and moved to the bay in 1519. After the French corsair Jacques de Sores sacked and burned it in 1555, Spain ringed the harbour with forts, the Fuerza, La Punta and El Morro, and from 1561 made Havana the rendezvous where the galeones and the flota, heavy with silver from Veracruz, Cartagena and Portobelo, gathered for the crossing to Seville. The governor moved his seat from Santiago, and in 1592 Philip II gave the city the title 'Key to the New World and Rampart of the West Indies'. A university opened in 1728, and by 1740 Havana held the only dry dock in the Americas, fitting out the ships of Spain's Atlantic trade.

Britain struck during the Seven Years' War. In June 1762 a British fleet came up from an unexpected quarter, trapped the Spanish squadron in the bay and battered El Morro from a hill the governor had left unfortified; after the fort's commander Luis Vicente de Velasco was mortally wounded, British troops entered the city on 13 August. With more than 70,000 people it was the third largest city in the Americas. Spain ransomed it back in the 1763 Treaty of Paris at the price of Florida, and immediately raised the great fortress of San Carlos de la Cabana on the ridge above the bay. Columbus's remains were brought from Santo Domingo in 1796, and by 1821 Havana presided over a slave-worked sugar boom that made Cuba Spain's richest colony.
zh:
古巴北岸最好的港湾开在岛屿西北岸，口狭水深、四面遮风。1444年，港湾四周是泰诺酋长阿瓦瓜内克斯的领地，部民种植木薯和玉米、在湾中捕鱼、划独木舟往来沿岸。这个后来得名卡雷纳斯港的锚地还没见过欧洲船帆，整个古巴仍在原住民手中。

1508年塞瓦斯蒂安·奥坎波环航古巴时在此倾修船底。圣克里斯托瓦尔·德拉阿瓦纳1514年初建于泥泞的南海岸，1519年迁至湾畔，再未移动。1555年法兰西海盗雅克·德·索雷斯攻陷并焚毁城镇后，西班牙在港湾周围接连筑起皇家力量堡、蓬塔堡和莫罗堡；1561年起，又把哈瓦那定为珍宝船队的集结地，满载韦拉克鲁斯、卡塔赫纳和波托韦洛白银的大帆船和商船队在此会齐，再横渡大西洋驶往塞维利亚。都督把驻地从圣地亚哥迁来，1592年腓力二世赐该城「新世界的钥匙、西印度的壁垒」之名。大学1728年开办，到1740年哈瓦那又有了美洲唯一的干船坞，为西班牙大西洋贸易的船只修造装备。

七年战争中英国发难。1762年6月，英国舰队从西班牙人意料之外的方向驶来，把西班牙分舰队困在湾内，又在总督疏于设防的山丘上轰击莫罗堡；要塞司令路易斯·维森特·德·贝拉斯科受致命伤后，英军8月13日入城。此时城中有七万多人，是美洲第三大城。1763年《巴黎条约》中，西班牙以佛罗里达为代价将它换回，随即在湾畔山脊修筑宏大的圣卡洛斯·德拉卡瓦尼亚要塞。1796年，哥伦布的遗骨从圣多明各迁葬于此；到1821年，哈瓦那支配着奴隶劳动支撑的蔗糖繁荣，古巴已是西班牙最富庶的殖民地。

en:
Moron lies on the marshy north coast of central Cuba, behind a chain of offshore cays and reefs cut through by mangrove channels. In 1444 Taino villages fished those channels and tended conucos along the shore, while the wet savanna stretching inland was only thinly peopled.

Spaniards first sailed these waters with Sebastian de Ocampo's voyage around Cuba in 1508, and after the conquest the district became cattle land. On 24 May 1543 the cabildo of Sancti Spiritus granted the hato of Moron, a stock ranch on the Rio del Roble, to Luis de Almeida; its first settlers were creoles from Sancti Spiritus and sailors from Andalusia and the Canary Islands, and floods later pushed the hamlet onto higher ground. For two centuries it stayed a remote ranching town on a smuggler's coast, selling hides and dried meat to passing ships while its cays sheltered pirates. The town's best-known saying came from its Spanish namesake, Moron de la Frontera: legend there tells of an overbearing official who boasted that no other rooster dared crow where he did, until the townspeople thrashed him and tore off his clothes, and an Andalusian copla mocked him as 'the rooster of Moron, without feathers and still crowing'. The refrain was current in Cuba by 1763, and the Cuban town took a feathered rooster as its own emblem. A few small trapiches ground sugar cane, but in 1821 Moron remained a quiet cattle town at the end of a mule track.
zh:
莫龙位于古巴中部多沼泽的北海岸，外海是一串礁屿和珊瑚礁，红树林水道穿行其间。1444年，泰诺人的村落在此捕鱼、耕作岸边田园，向内陆延伸的湿草原上人烟稀少。

1508年塞瓦斯蒂安·奥坎波环航古巴，欧洲船首次驶过这片海域；征服之后，此地成了牧牛之乡。1543年5月24日，圣斯皮里图斯市政会把罗布莱河畔的养牛庄园莫龙牧场授予路易斯·德·阿尔梅达，最早的居民是圣斯皮里图斯的土生白人和安达卢西亚、加那利水手，后来洪水又把村落逼到地势较高处。两个世纪里，它一直是走私者海岸边一座偏远牧镇，向过往船只出售皮革和肉干，近海礁屿则容海盗藏身。莫龙最有名的那句话来自同名的西班牙小镇莫龙-德拉弗龙特拉：相传那里有个横暴的官吏夸口，他打鸣的地方容不得第二只公鸡，乡民便把他痛打一顿、剥得只剩衬衣，安达卢西亚民谣便把他唱作「莫龙的公鸡，掉光了毛还在打鸣」。这句歌谣至迟1763年已在古巴流传，这座古巴小镇也把一只长着羽毛的公鸡认作自己的标志。当地只有几座小糖坊榨蔗，到1821年，莫龙仍是骡道尽头一座安静的牧牛小镇。

en:
Guantánamo is a broad southeastern Cuban valley between steep hills and the largest harbor on the island's southern coast. The Bano, Jaibo and Guaso rivers cross its fields on the way to the bay; Taíno potters and farmers occupied those banks, and fishermen knew the anchorage by a name Spanish writers translated as 'land between the rivers'. In 1444 manioc villages and canoe landing places lined the shore, before Spanish forts and sugar estates were built.

Columbus reached the harbor in 1494 and called it Puerto Grande. His men found fishermen preparing a feast for their chief. After the conquest reached eastern Cuba, the Taíno cacique Guamá kept a revolt alive in the mountains from 1522, raiding as far west as Camagüey. His brother Oliguama killed him with an axe while he slept on 6 June 1533, after Guamá had taken Oliguama's wife. The harbor kept drawing fleets. Edward Vernon entered it in 1741 with eight warships and 4,000 soldiers, briefly renamed the anchorage Cumberland Bay, and planned to march on Santiago, but local guerrillas blocked the route and forced him out. In 1760 two British frigates cut out two French privateers in the bay and compelled the French to burn a third. Santa Catalina de Guantánamo was founded in the valley in 1796, and sugar mills and coffee farms then spread along the three rivers.
zh:
关塔那摩是古巴东南部一片宽阔河谷，处在陡山与岛南最大港湾之间。巴诺河、海博河和瓜索河穿过农田注入海湾；泰诺制陶者和农民居住在河畔，渔民使用的港湾名被西班牙作者释为「河流之间的土地」。1444年，沿岸分布着木薯村落和独木舟停泊点，西班牙要塞与糖坊尚未出现。

1494年，哥伦布抵达港湾，将它命名为大港。他的部下在这里看见一群正在为首领宴会备食的渔民。征服扩展到古巴东部后，泰诺首领瓜马从1522年起在山区坚持反抗，袭扰范围远达卡马圭。1533年6月6日，他的兄弟奥利瓜马因妻子被瓜马夺走，趁他熟睡时用斧头将他杀死。港湾仍不断吸引舰队。1741年，爱德华·弗农率八艘战舰和四千名士兵进入，一度把锚地改称坎伯兰湾，打算进军圣地亚哥，但当地游击武装堵住道路，迫使其撤走。1760年，两艘英国巡防舰在湾中夺获两艘法国私掠船，并迫使法国人烧掉第三艘。1796年，圣卡塔利娜·德·关塔那摩在河谷中建立，糖厂和咖啡种植园随后沿三条河扩展。

en:
Jamaica is the third-largest island of the Greater Antilles, a rugged country of forested mountains, fast rivers and harbours along the southern plain. The Taíno called it Xaymaca, the land of wood and water, and by the fifteenth century lived from farming and fishing in villages ruled by caciques, most thickly settled along the south coast; their numbers on the island may once have reached about 60,000. In 1444 the whole island belonged to that Taíno world, beyond the routes of Spanish caravels.

Christopher Columbus landed in 1494 and claimed the island for Spain, and on his last voyage, in 1503, his worm-eaten ships had to be beached here and he spent a year stranded before rescue reached him. Juan de Esquivel founded Sevilla in 1509, but the settlement was abandoned around 1524, and Spanish Town became the island's chief town around 1534. Disease and enslavement broke Taíno society, and African slaves were brought in to take its place; runaways who reached the mountains joined surviving Taíno as Maroons. An English army under William Penn and Robert Venables seized Jamaica in May 1655, and the Treaty of Madrid confirmed the conquest in 1670. Port Royal, on a sandspit guarding Kingston harbour, became the buccaneers' home port: Henry Morgan sailed from it against Portobello, Maracaibo and Panama, and the 300 men who followed him to Portobello in 1668 came home with at least £60 a head in plunder. Its taverns and gambling houses earned the place the name 'the wickedest city on Earth', until an earthquake and the tsunami it set off destroyed most of the town on 7 June 1692; Kingston then took its trade. Sugar had already made enslaved Africans the majority by the early 1670s, and the eighteenth century ran on sugar, coffee, cotton and indigo.

Queen Nanny led the Windward Maroons of the eastern mountains through years of guerrilla war, until a treaty in 1740 granted her followers their land; Maroon oral tradition makes her an Asante woman carried into slavery. The British recognised the other Maroon towns in treaties of 1739 and 1740. Tacky's Revolt swept the plantations in 1760, and a Second Maroon War followed in 1795 and 1796. Britain abolished the slave trade in 1807; in 1821 slavery itself still governed the island.
zh:
牙买加是大安的列斯群岛第三大岛，岛上林木茂密的山地崎岖起伏，河流湍急，南部平原沿岸分布着港口。泰诺人称此岛为沙伊马卡（Xaymaca），意为水与树木之地；到15世纪，他们在酋长管辖的村落里农耕渔猎，南海岸一带人口最密，全岛人口可能一度达到六万左右。1444年，整个牙买加都属于泰诺人的世界，西班牙卡拉维尔帆船的航路还没有延伸到这里。

哥伦布1494年登陆并宣布该岛归西班牙所有；1503年最后一次航行时，他的船被船蛆蛀坏，不得不拖上牙买加海岸，在此困居一年才等来救援。胡安·德·埃斯基维尔1509年建立塞维利亚，聚落到约1524年被放弃，西班牙城约1534年成为全岛首要城镇。疾病和奴役压垮了泰诺社会，非洲奴隶被运来顶替劳力；逃进山区的奴隶与幸存的泰诺人结为马龙人。1655年5月，威廉·宾和罗伯特·维纳布尔斯率英军夺取牙买加，1670年的《马德里条约》确认了这次征服。扼守金斯顿港外沙洲的罗亚尔港成了海盗的母港：亨利·摩根从这里出发攻打贝略港、马拉开波和巴拿马，1668年随他出征贝略港的三百人每人至少分到六十英镑赃物。港中酒馆和赌馆林立，为它挣得「世上最邪恶的城市」之名；1692年6月7日，地震和随之而来的海啸摧毁了港城大部，金斯顿接手了它的贸易。其实到17世纪70年代初，甘蔗种植园已使非洲黑奴成为岛上人口的多数，18世纪的岛上经济则靠蔗糖、咖啡、棉花和靛蓝运转。

马龙人用武力保住了自由。第一次马龙战争中，南妮女王率领东部山区的向风马龙人坚持多年游击战，1740年的条约把土地划给她的部众；按马龙人的口传说法，她本是被掳为奴、运来岛上的阿散蒂人。英国又在1739年和1740年以条约承认其他马龙城镇。1760年，塔基起义席卷各种植园，1795年至1796年又爆发第二次马龙战争。英国1807年废除奴隶贸易，而1821年时，奴隶制本身仍支配着这座岛。

en:
The low coast around the Bay of Les Cayes, sheltered by offshore cays and Île-à-Vache, was Zui, Taíno country on the southern shore of Hispaniola's Tiburon Peninsula. Villages fished the Caribbean, grew cassava and traded along the beach; inland rose the mountains later called the Massif de la Hotte. Spanish accounts remembered Zui and neighbouring Yáquimo as the two parts of Jaragua, greatest of the island's five chiefdoms, ruled when the ships came by Bohechío. In 1444 local caciques still held the district, and no European settlement had been built on the bay.

Spanish colonists founded Salvatierra de la Zabana there in 1503, during Nicolás de Ovando's governorship, but the town was abandoned in 1540. The empty coast afterwards suited buccaneers: Henry Morgan made Île-à-Vache, then called Isla Vaca, his forward anchorage, and in January 1669 his flagship Oxford blew up in a drunken gunpowder salute before a raid on Cartagena, killing about 200 of his men. A planned French town, Aux Cayes, was laid out in 1726 and became the southern sugar and coffee port of Saint-Domingue, until hurricanes flattened it in 1781 and 1788. The rising of 1791 reached the southern plantations, and in July 1793 the white inhabitants of Les Cayes were killed in the civil war. André Rigaud lost the south to Toussaint Louverture in 1800, and after independence the town's Conseil du Sud broke with Alexandre Pétion in 1810 and 1811. In December 1815 Simón Bolívar landed at Les Cayes; Pétion armed and supplied his expedition after Bolívar promised to abolish slavery in every land he freed.
zh:
莱凯湾一带的低地海岸受近海沙洲和瓦什岛屏护，是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛蒂伯朗半岛南岸的泰诺人之地祖伊。村落居民在加勒比海捕鱼、种植木薯、沿海滩交换物产，内陆隆起后来称为拉霍特山的山地。西班牙记载把祖伊和相邻的亚基莫并称为哈拉瓜的两个组成部分，而哈拉瓜是岛上五大酋长国中疆域最大的一个，欧洲人到来时由博埃奇奥统治。1444年，地方酋长仍掌握着这片地区，湾畔还没有欧洲人的定居点。

1503年，西班牙殖民者在尼古拉斯·德·奥万多总督任内于湾畔建立萨尔瓦铁拉·德拉萨瓦纳，1540年该城废弃。空虚的海岸正合布坎尼尔海盗之用：亨利·摩根把当时叫伊斯拉巴卡（牛岛）的瓦什岛当作前进锚地，1669年1月，他的旗舰「牛津号」在出征卡塔赫纳前的醉酒鸣炮中炸毁，约两百名部众丧命。1726年，法国人按规划建起新城奥凯，即后来的莱凯，成为法属圣多明各南部输出蔗糖和咖啡的港口，却在1781年和1788年两度被飓风夷平。1791年大起义蔓延到南部种植园，1793年7月，莱凯的白人居民在内战中被杀。1800年，安德烈·里戈在南方之争中败给杜桑·卢维杜尔；海地独立后，设在莱凯的南方委员会于1810年、1811年两度与亚历山大·佩蒂翁决裂。1815年12月，西蒙·玻利瓦尔在莱凯登陆；他承诺在所解放的每一块土地上废除奴隶制，佩蒂翁便为他的远征提供了武器和补给。

en:
Tortuga is a long, mountainous island in the Windward Passage, a few kilometres off the north-west corner of Hispaniola. Cliffs shut in its northern shore, while a sheltered roadstead, later called Cayona, cuts into the south. In 1444 the island belonged to the Taíno sea-world of the neighbouring mainland, with no European settlement and no European name; the turtle-shaped outline that prompted Columbus to call it Tortuga in December 1492 had yet to be seen from a ship.

French and English settlers from Saint Kitts arrived in 1625, and for thirty years expeditions from Santo Domingo expelled them every few years. Fadrique de Toledo cleared the island in 1629, and further Spanish occupations followed in 1635 and 1638. In 1640 the French engineer Jean Le Vasseur seized Cayona and built Fort de Rocher on the rock above it, its guns covering every vessel entering the roadstead. He declared the port open to outlaws of all nations in return for a share of their plunder, and Tortuga became the first great pirate rendezvous of the Caribbean; by 1641 its buccaneers called themselves the Brethren of the Coast. Le Vasseur was murdered by two of his lieutenants in 1653, and in 1654 a fourth Spanish expedition dragged cannon onto the height above the fort, forced the garrison out after a nine-day siege and demolished the works. English and French adventurers were back the following year.

In June 1665 Bertrand d'Ogeron took over for the French West India Company and brought out settlers, who planted tobacco and, after 400 colonists arrived from Anjou later in the decade, laid out the first sugar plantations of Saint-Domingue. Henry Morgan called at Cayona to recruit before his sack of Panama in 1671, when he sailed with roughly 2,000 buccaneers. The French moved their administration across to Port-de-Paix on the mainland in 1676, and Spain recognised French possession at the Treaty of Ryswick in 1697. During the Haitian revolution General Charles Leclerc died on Tortuga on 2 November 1802, and the French garrison abandoned the island in April 1803.
zh:
托尔图加（中文常译托尔蒂岛）是向风海峡中的狭长多山岛屿，距伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西北角仅数公里。北岸崖壁环峙，南岸凹进一处避风锚地，后来称卡约纳。1444年，该岛属于邻近大陆的泰诺人海世界，没有欧洲人定居，也没有欧洲名字；直到1492年12月哥伦布望见它海龟形的轮廓，才以海龟为它命名。

1625年，来自圣基茨的法国和英国移民抵达，此后三十年里，西班牙人每隔几年就从圣多明各派兵把他们赶走。法德里克·德·托莱多1629年肃清全岛，1635年和1638年西班牙又两度占领。1640年，法国工程师让·勒瓦瑟尔夺取卡约纳，在锚地上方的巨岩上修筑罗谢堡，炮火覆盖每一艘进港的船。他宣布港口对各国亡命徒开放，只抽取一份战利品，托尔图加成了加勒比头一个大海盗聚集地；到1641年，岛上的布坎尼尔已自称海岸兄弟会。勒瓦瑟尔1653年被两名副手谋杀。1654年，西班牙第四次远征把大炮拖上堡垒上方的高地，围攻九天后逼降守军，拆毁了堡垒。第二年，英国和法国冒险者又回到岛上。

1665年6月，贝特朗·多热龙代表法国西印度公司接管托尔图加，招徕移民种植烟草；同一十年后期，四百名来自安茹的殖民者抵达，开辟了圣多明各最早的甘蔗种植园。1671年，亨利·摩根到卡约纳招募人手，随后率约两千名布坎尼尔洗劫巴拿马。1676年，法国把行政机构迁到大陆上的和平港；1697年，《里斯维克条约》确认法国占有托尔图加。海地革命期间，夏尔·勒克莱尔将军1802年11月2日在岛上去世，法国守军于1803年4月弃岛。

en:
The southern coast of Hispaniola, from the Nizao and Ocoa lowlands to the bay later called Barahona, was Taíno country in 1444. The Baní plain was a nitainato, a district under a local noble, attached to the chiefdom of Maguana, while the drier southwest around Barahona belonged to Jaragua, the largest of the island's five chiefdoms, ruled from beyond the hills by Bohechío and, after him, his sister Anacaona. Taíno villages farmed the river valleys and fished the Caribbean under their own caciques, and no European ship had yet reached them.

Columbus's men came to this coast in the 1490s, and the Spanish brothers Barahona gave the southwestern bay their name. In July 1503 Governor Nicolás de Ovando broke Jaragua at a single blow: at a staged celebration his men seized the chiefs, burned some eighty caciques in their meeting house and hanged Anacaona. Sugar mills soon went up along the rivers, among them an important one on the Ocoa belonging to Alonso de Suazo, judge of the Audiencia of Santo Domingo. The chiefdom's heir was Enriquillo, born on the shores of Lake Jaragua, whose father, the crown prince, died in the massacre. Raised and baptised in a Santo Domingo monastery and able to read and write Spanish, he withdrew to the Bahoruco mountains above this coast in 1519 with a band of Taínos after a Spaniard named Valenzuela raped his wife Mencía and the courts gave him no redress. For fourteen years his irregulars held the hills, in a rising that cost the Crown more than 40,000 gold pesos and moved Bartolomé de las Casas to write in his defence; the king's envoy Francisco de Barrionuevo negotiated a treaty in 1533 granting Enriquillo and his people freedom and land.

Canary Islander families settled the Baní plain from 1680 to 1684, and the town of Baní was formally founded on 3 March 1764, when its householders bought the Cerro Gordo site for 370 pesos fuertes. In 1802 Toussaint Louverture's administration made the Barahona valley a military post under Azua; Jean-Jacques Dessalines burned Baní in 1805, and the rebuilt town received its first council in 1810.
zh:
1444年，伊斯帕尼奥拉岛南部从尼萨奥、奥科阿低地到后来称巴拉奥纳的海湾一带，都是泰诺人的土地。巴尼平原是附属于马瓜纳酋长领地的尼塔伊纳托，即由地方贵族管辖的辖区；巴拉奥纳周围更干旱的西南地带则属于哈拉瓜，岛上五大酋长领地中最大的一个，由博埃奇奥及其身后的妹妹阿纳卡奥娜在山地另一侧统治。泰诺人的村落耕种河谷、在加勒比海捕鱼，听命于本村首领，此时还没有欧洲船只到来。

1490年代，哥伦布的手下来到这片海岸，巴拉奥纳兄弟等西班牙人把自己的姓氏给了这座西南海湾。1503年7月，总督尼古拉斯·德·奥万多一击摧毁了哈拉瓜：在一场安排好的庆典上，他的手下擒住众首领，把约八十名酋长烧死在集会的大屋里，又将阿纳卡奥娜处以绞刑。沿河很快建起榨糖作坊，圣多明各检审庭法官阿隆索·德·苏亚索在奥科阿河畔的一座便是其中重镇。酋长领地的继承人恩里基略出生在哈拉瓜湖畔，他的王储父亲便死于这场屠杀。他在圣多明各的修道院长大受洗，能读写西班牙文；一个叫巴伦苏埃拉的西班牙人奸污了他的妻子门西娅，法庭却不予受理，他遂于1519年带一批泰诺人退入海岸上方的巴奥鲁科山地。十四年间，他的非正规武装据守群山，这场起事耗去西班牙王室四万多金比索，也促使巴托洛梅·德·拉斯卡萨斯撰文为他辩护；1533年，西班牙王室派来的使者与他缔约，恩里基略和他的人获得自由和土地。

1680年至1684年，加那利群岛移民家庭定居巴尼平原；1764年3月3日，居民以370枚银比索买下塞罗戈多址，巴尼正式建镇。1802年，杜桑·卢维杜尔政权把巴拉奥纳河谷设为阿苏阿治下的军事据点；让-雅克·德萨林1805年焚毁巴尼，重建后的城镇于1810年设立首个市政会。

en:
Aruba and Curaçao are dry, reef-bound islands off the Paraguaná Peninsula of Venezuela, covered in cactus scrub and cut by gullies, with sheltered bays on the side facing the mainland. Caquetío farmers and fishers had crossed from the Venezuelan coast before 1000, and in 1444 their villages made up the western edge of an Arawakan world joined by canoe. They traded salt, tobacco, beads and dugouts along that coast, and no European cattle yet grazed the thin pasture.

A Spanish expedition under Alonso de Ojeda reached the islands in 1499. Between 1513 and 1515 Diego Salazar deported some 2,000 Caquetío from the ABC islands to Hispaniola, and after Spain settled Curaçao in 1527 the islands were run chiefly as cattle ranges; Spanish settlers called Curaçao the useless island, for its thin soil yielded little gold or grain. The Dutch West India Company took Curaçao in 1634 and occupied Aruba in 1636, and built Willemstad on the Schottegat, a deep inlet that became a harbour for shipping, salt and privateers. From 1662 the port was a main mart of the Atlantic slave trade, and in 1674 it became a free port. Sephardic Jews from Portugal, Brazil and the Netherlands handled much of that business: their congregation dated from 1651, and the synagogue completed in 1732 is the oldest surviving one in the Americas. A French fleet sent against the islands in 1678 lost seven men-of-war and two more vessels on the reefs off Las Aves before it came near Curaçao. In 1795 Tula Rigaud led as many as 4,000 slaves in a rising in the north-west of the island, put down after a month. British forces held the islands for intervals during the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars, and Dutch rule was restored by 1816.
zh:
阿鲁巴和库拉索是委内瑞拉巴拉瓜纳半岛外海的干旱岛屿，四周多暗礁，陆上遍布仙人掌灌丛和冲沟，面朝大陆一侧有可避风浪的海湾。1000年以前，卡克蒂奥农民和渔民已从委内瑞拉海岸渡海而来；1444年，他们的村落构成阿拉瓦克世界的西缘，各岛靠独木舟彼此相连。岛民沿大陆海岸交易盐、烟草、珠饰和独木舟，贫瘠的牧场上还没有欧洲牛群。

1499年，阿隆索·德·奥赫达率领的西班牙探险队到达这一带。1513年至1515年间，迭戈·萨拉萨尔把阿鲁巴、博奈尔和库拉索三岛约两千名卡克蒂奥人强行迁往伊斯帕尼奥拉；1527年西班牙在库拉索设殖据点后，这些岛屿主要被当作牧场。西班牙移民把库拉索叫作「无用之岛」，因为薄土里淘不出多少黄金，也长不出多少粮食。荷兰西印度公司1634年夺取库拉索、1636年占领阿鲁巴，在斯霍特加特深水湾畔建起威廉斯塔德，把这里经营成航运、盐业和私掠船的港口。1662年起，该港成为大西洋奴隶贸易的主要集散地，1674年又成为自由港。来自葡萄牙、巴西和荷兰的塞法迪犹太人经手了大半贸易：他们的教会始于1651年，1732年落成的犹太会堂是美洲现存最古老的一座。1678年，一支奉命来攻的法国舰队还没靠近库拉索，就在拉斯阿韦斯群岛外海触礁，七艘战舰和另外两艘船葬身礁石。1795年，图拉·里戈在岛的西北部领导多达四千名奴隶起义，一个月后被镇压。法国革命战争和拿破仑战争期间，英军曾几度占领这些岛屿，到1816年荷兰统治已完全恢复。

en:
Borikén was the Taíno name for the easternmost and smallest of the Greater Antilles, a mountainous island between the Atlantic and the Caribbean, ringed by smaller cays. Its people lived in yucayeques, villages under caciques, farming their plots, fishing and making canoes and pottery; the best land lay on the coastal plains and in the river valleys. In November 1444 the island's chiefdoms were linked by language and exchange, and no caravel had yet anchored off its shores.

Columbus reached the island on 19 November 1493 and named it San Juan Bautista. Juan Ponce de León founded Caparra in 1508; the settlers moved to a sheltered northern bay in 1521 and called the town Ciudad de Puerto Rico, until island and town exchanged names and became Puerto Rico and San Juan. Gold washing and the encomienda brought war: after the cacique Agüeybaná II's coalition killed Cristóbal de Sotomayor, Ponce de León crushed the first Taíno rising in 1511, Caparra was burned in 1513, and fugitive fighting lasted into the 1520s. The Crown licensed African slave imports in 1517; the first large slave revolt came in 1527, and survivors fled to the mountains with the remaining Taíno. After the gold gave out around 1570, the colonists lived by ginger, tobacco, cotton, cacao and, in time, sugar.

San Juan stood on the route of Spain's annual treasure fleet, and the Crown called the island the key to the Indies. Work on El Morro began in 1539 on the headland commanding the bay, and by the 1590s a chain could be drawn across the harbour mouth between its guns. Its gunners beat off Francis Drake in 1595, putting a cannonball through the cabin of his flagship. In 1598 the Earl of Cumberland marched in from the landward side and took the fortress, the only time it fell to assault, but dysentery drove his garrison out within months. Balduino Enrico's Dutch fleet sacked and burned the city in 1625 without reducing El Morro, and Ralph Abercromby's invasion of 1797 failed beneath the same walls. In 1815 the Royal Decree of Graces offered free land to Catholic immigrants who swore loyalty to the Crown, as Spain struggled to hold one of its last two American colonies.
zh:
博里肯是泰诺人对大安的列斯群岛最东端、也是四大岛中最小一岛的称呼。岛屿多山，夹在大西洋与加勒比海之间，周围散布着小礁。岛民住在称为「尤卡耶克」的村落里，由酋长统辖，耕种土地、捕鱼，也制造独木舟和陶器，最好的农田在沿海平原和河谷。1444年11月，岛上各酋长领地以语言和物产交换相互往来，还没有卡拉维尔帆船在岛边停泊。

1493年11月19日，哥伦布抵达博里肯，将它命名为圣胡安包蒂斯塔。胡安·庞塞·德·莱昂1508年建立卡帕拉；1521年殖民者迁到北岸一处避风海湾，把新城叫作波多黎各城，日久之后岛与城互换名字，岛称波多黎各，城称圣胡安。淘金和监护征赋制引发战争：酋长阿圭巴纳二世的联盟杀死克里斯托瓦尔·德·索托马约尔后，庞塞·德·莱昂在1511年镇压了第一次泰诺人大起义，卡帕拉1513年被焚，零星战斗延续到16世纪20年代。王室1517年获准输入非洲奴隶，1527年第一次大规模奴隶起义爆发，幸存者和残留的泰诺人一同退入山区。金矿约在1570年枯竭后，殖民者改靠生姜、烟草、棉花、可可，以及后来的蔗糖为生。

圣胡安位于西班牙年度珍宝舰队的航路上，王室把这座岛称为「西印度群岛的钥匙」。埃尔莫罗堡1539年在扼守海湾的岩角上动工，到16世纪90年代，港门已可用铁链在炮火之间横锁。1595年，要塞击退弗朗西斯·德雷克，一发炮弹打进了他的旗舰舱室。1598年，坎伯兰伯爵从陆路进军攻下要塞，这是它唯一一次被武力攻占，但痢疾在几个月内逼走了守军。1625年，巴尔多伊诺·恩里科的荷兰舰队洗劫并焚毁城市，却拿不下埃尔莫罗堡；1797年拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比的入侵也折在同一道城墙前。1815年，《皇家恩典法令》向宣誓效忠王室的天主教移民授予免费土地，此时的西班牙正力图保住它在美洲仅剩的两个殖民地之一。

en:
St. Thomas is a hilly island in the Virgin group, and the deep, almost landlocked harbour on its south coast is one of the finest in the Lesser Antilles. Ciboney fishers settled it around 1500 BC, Arawak villagers followed, and Carib groups had reached the Virgins by the fifteenth century. In 1444 its people farmed and fished along the bays, and no European had yet sighted the island.

Columbus passed in 1493, but Spain left St. Thomas alone, and its sheltered coves became a haunt of buccaneers and passing traders. The Dutch West India Company opened a post in 1657, and on 25 May 1672 Governor Jørgen Iversen Dyppel landed a permanent Danish colony and began Fort Christian at the harbour mouth, the oldest standing structure in the Virgins. A watchtower went up on Government Hill in 1679, later named Blackbeard's Castle: the pirate Edward Teach used the harbour, and governors such as the Esmit brothers dealt with his fraternity openly. The first slave ships came in 1673, and St. Thomas became a slave market as sugar plantations spread inland. In 1685 the Danish company leased part of the island to a Brandenburg company. The town below the fort was called Taphus, 'tap house', for its rum shops until 1691, when it took the name Charlotte Amalie from Christian V's queen. Moravian missionaries came from Saxony in 1732 to live among the enslaved. Frederick V made the port free in 1764, and ships of every flag crowded in with sugar, rum and slaves; by the end of the century Charlotte Amalie ranked, after Copenhagen, as the second-largest town in the Danish realm, and a Sephardic congregation had formed there in 1796. The British seized the island in 1801, handed it back under the Peace of Amiens, and occupied it again from 1807 to 1815.
zh:
圣托马斯是维尔京群岛中的多山岛屿，南海岸那处几乎被陆地环抱的深水港是小安的列斯群岛最好的港湾之一。约公元前1500年，西沃内渔民最先在此定居，讲阿拉瓦克语的村民随后迁来，到15世纪加勒比人也已抵达维尔京群岛。1444年时，岛民沿各海湾农耕渔猎，欧洲人还未曾望见这座岛。

哥伦布1493年从这一带经过，西班牙却没有染指圣托马斯，岛上避风的小海湾成了海盗和过路商人的出没之地。荷兰西印度公司1657年开设商站；1672年5月25日，总督约恩·伊弗森·迪佩尔率永久殖民地登岸，在港口动工修建克里斯蒂安堡，这是维尔京群岛现存最古老的建筑。1679年，政府山顶建起一座瞭望塔，后来得名「黑胡子城堡」：海盗爱德华·蒂奇曾在此港落脚，埃斯米特兄弟等几任总督还公开和海盗打交道。第一批贩奴船1673年抵达，随着甘蔗种植园向岛内铺开，圣托马斯成了奴隶贸易市场。1685年，丹麦公司把岛上部分地盘租给勃兰登堡公司。堡垒下的城镇因朗姆酒肆林立被叫做塔府斯，原义「酒馆」，1691年改用克里斯蒂安五世王后之名，称夏洛特阿马利亚。1732年，摩拉维亚弟兄会传教士从萨克森前来，住进奴隶中间传教。腓特烈五世1764年宣布自由港，各国船只满载蔗糖、朗姆酒和奴隶蜂拥而至；到18世纪末，夏洛特阿马利亚是丹麦王国仅次于哥本哈根的第二大城，塞法迪犹太会众也于1796年在此形成。英军1801年攻占该岛，依《亚眠和约》归还，1807年再度占领，直到1815年才交还丹麦。

en:
St. Kitts is a volcanic island in the northern Leewards, its centre occupied by the forested cone of Mount Liamuiga. The Kalinago who took the island around 1300 called it Liamuiga, 'the fertile isle', after its dark volcanic soil. In 1444 their villages lay along the shore, and no European power had yet laid claim to it.

Columbus claimed St. Kitts for Spain in 1493, but the first lasting settlements were English and French: Thomas Warner brought English settlers in 1623, French planters followed in 1625 and laid out Basseterre, and the island became the oldest English colony in the West Indies and the base from which both nations peopled neighbouring islands. They divided the land, English in the centre and French at the two ends. Forewarned that the Kalinago meant to fall on them, the settlers struck first, massacred the islanders and drove the survivors out. A Spanish expedition expelled both nations in 1629; the English returned with the peace of 1630. Tobacco held the fields until 1640, when Virginia leaf undercut it and sugar took over, bringing enslaved Africans in by the thousand. On the west coast the steep, 972-foot Brimstone Hill became the island's strong point: the French mounted cannon there in 1689 to reduce Fort Charles, and the English retook the hill a year later and spent decades building it into the largest fortress in the eastern Caribbean, its stone walls raised by enslaved labour. Men called it the Gibraltar of the Caribbean, yet in January 1782 a French army and fleet under de Grasse and the marquis de Bouillé laid siege; Admiral Hood could not break through, and the cut-off garrison surrendered after a month, with Nevis falling in the same campaign. The Treaty of Paris returned St. Kitts to Britain in 1783, the works were rebuilt stronger, and a French naval attack in 1806 was beaten off.
zh:
圣基茨是背风群岛北部的火山岛，中央是林木覆盖的利亚穆伊加山。约1300年攻取此岛的卡利纳戈人称其为利亚穆伊加，意为「肥沃之岛」，得名于岛上深色的火山土。1444年时，他们的村落沿海岸分布，还没有任何欧洲势力提出主权要求。

1493年哥伦布以西班牙之名宣布占有圣基茨，但最早扎下根的是英格兰人和法国人：托马斯·沃纳1623年率英格兰移民登岛，法国种植园主1625年接踵而至，辟建巴斯特尔；圣基茨成了西印度群岛最古老的英格兰殖民地，也是两国向邻近岛屿移民的跳板。双方瓜分土地，英格兰人居中，法国人据守两端。移民预先得知卡利纳戈人打算动手，便先发制人，大肆屠杀岛民，把幸存者逐出岛屿。1629年一支西班牙远征军把两国人一并赶走，1630年议和后英格兰人返回。1640年之前岛上种的是烟草，因竞争不过弗吉尼亚烟叶而改种甘蔗，数以千计的非洲奴隶随之被运到岛上。西海岸陡峭的硫磺山高972英尺，是全岛的要害：法军1689年在山上架炮轰降查尔斯堡，英军次年夺回，此后用了数十年把山顶建成东加勒比最大的要塞，石墙全部由奴隶劳力砌成。它被称作「加勒比的直布罗陀」，但1782年1月，德格拉斯伯爵和布耶侯爵率法国陆海军前来围攻，胡德海军上将无法突破解围，孤立无援的守军一个月后投降，尼维斯也在同一战役中陷落。1783年《巴黎条约》把圣基茨归还英国，要塞重修后更加坚固，1806年法国海军的进攻被击退。

en:
Antigua is a lower, drier island than its volcanic neighbours, and on its south-eastern coast English Harbour cuts deep inland, one of the safest anchorages in the eastern Caribbean. Its people knew it as Waladli, roughly 'our own'; Arawak farmers grew cassava, cotton and the sweet, dark Antiguan pineapple until Carib canoe parties pressing north from Venezuela drove most of them away around 1100. In 1444 Carib parties used its beaches and cays, and no European had yet landed.

Columbus sighted Antigua in 1493 and named it Santa María de la Antigua, after the Virgin's chapel in Seville Cathedral, but Spain never stayed. English colonists crossed from St. Kitts in 1632, and around 1674 Christopher Codrington set up Betty's Hope, the first great sugar estate, worked by enslaved Africans; by the mid-1770s they numbered about 37,500, far more than the white planters. In 1736 an enslaved man his masters called Court was crowned King Klaas of the Coromantees in a pasture outside St. John's, and planned to kill the planters and found an African kingdom. A slave warned the colonists and the rising never came off. Klaas and four accomplices were broken on the wheel, six men were hanged or left to starve, and fifty-eight were burned at the stake. The navy valued English Harbour for its shelter: a hurricane in 1723 drove thirty-five ships ashore in the island's other roadsteads while two men-of-war rode it out there unharmed, and a dockyard was begun in 1725, built largely by enslaved labour. Captain Horatio Nelson held the Leeward Islands station from 1784 to 1787 and seized American ships under the Navigation Acts; the merchants of St. John's, who lived by that trade, hated him for it, and he called the Antiguan colonists as great rebels as any in America.
zh:
安提瓜地势低平，比邻近的火山岛干燥；东南海岸的英吉利港深入陆地，是东加勒比最安全的锚地之一。原住民称此岛为瓦拉德利，大意是「我们自己的」。阿拉瓦克农夫在此种植木薯、棉花和味道浓甜的安提瓜黑菠萝，约1100年，从委内瑞拉乘独木舟北上的加勒比人把他们大多逐走。1444年时，加勒比队伍利用岛上的海滩和礁屿，欧洲人尚未在此登陆。

1493年哥伦布望见安提瓜，依塞维利亚大教堂中的圣母礼拜堂将其命名为圣玛利亚·拉安提瓜，但西班牙人从未来此长住。1632年，英格兰移民从圣基茨渡海而来；约1674年，克里斯托弗·科德林顿建起岛上第一座大型甘蔗种植园「贝蒂的希望」，由非洲奴隶劳作，到1770年代中期，奴隶约有三万七千五百人，远远超过白人种植园主。1736年，一名被奴隶主叫做考特的奴隶在圣约翰郊外的牧场上加冕为科罗曼特人的克拉斯王，密谋杀光种植园主、建立非洲人王国；一名奴隶向殖民者告了密，起义没能发动。克拉斯与四名同谋被处轮刑，六人被绞死或任其饿死，五十八人被烧死在火刑柱上。海军看重的是英吉利港的遮蔽：1723年一场飓风把三十五艘船掀上岛上其他锚地的岸边，港内的两艘军舰却安然无恙，船坞遂于1725年动工，主要由奴隶劳力建成。1784至1787年，霍雷肖·纳尔逊舰长驻守背风群岛，依《航海条例》扣押美国商船；靠这门生意过活的圣约翰商人对他恨之入骨，他则说安提瓜的殖民者和美洲的叛乱者一样叛逆。

en:
Guadeloupe is not one island but two: mountainous Basse-Terre in the west and the flatter Grande-Terre in the east, separated by the narrow Rivière Salée channel, with Marie-Galante and the Saintes lying off. The Kalinago who displaced its earlier Arawak farmers called Basse-Terre Karukera, 'the island of beautiful waters'. In 1444 their villages held every good beach and anchorage, and Spain had not yet found a way to stay.

Columbus landed on 4 November 1493 and named the islands after Our Lady of Guadalupe, the shrine in Extremadura, but Kalinago resistance broke every Spanish attempt to settle. A French chartered company occupied Guadeloupe in 1635; Charles Houël turned Basse-Terre into a fortified post in 1650, the first enslaved Africans arrived that same year, and an open slave revolt flared in 1656. The crown took the island in 1674, and the Code Noir of 1685 set the rules of a sugar economy later joined by coffee and cocoa. The canes paid for the wars that followed: the British held Guadeloupe from 1759 to 1763, and at the peace France gave up Canada to get the sugar island back. British troops seized it again in April 1794, until Victor Hugues landed with a republican force, drove them out by June and proclaimed abolition on 7 June 1794. Eight years later General Richepanse arrived with orders to restore slavery. Louis Delgrès, the commandant of Basse-Terre, issued a proclamation against it on 10 May 1802 and fought the French columns in the hills; on 28 May, surrounded at Matouba, he and his last followers blew up their powder store and died rather than be taken. Slavery was formally restored on 14 May 1803. The British conquered the island in 1810 and ceded it to Sweden in name in 1813, though no Swede ever came to take possession; Guadeloupe returned to France in 1814.
zh:
瓜德罗普其实是两座岛：西面多山的巴斯特尔岛和东面低平的格朗德特尔岛，中间隔着狭窄的萨莱水道，附近还有玛丽加朗特岛和桑特群岛。逐走早先阿拉瓦克农夫的卡利纳戈人把巴斯特尔岛称作卡鲁克拉，意为「碧水之岛」。1444年时，他们的村落占据着每一处好用的海滩和锚地，西班牙人还找不到立足之法。

1493年11月4日哥伦布登陆，以埃斯特雷马杜拉的瓜达卢佩圣母圣地为群岛命名，但西班牙人的历次定居尝试都被卡利纳戈人击退。1635年，一家法国特许公司占领瓜德罗普；夏尔·乌埃尔1650年把巴斯特尔修成设防据点，第一批非洲奴隶同年抵达，1656年便爆发了公开的奴隶起义。1674年法兰西王室收回该岛，1685年的《黑人法典》为蔗糖经济立下规矩，后来又添上咖啡和可可。甘蔗的收益撑起了此后的战事：英军1759至1763年占据瓜德罗普，议和时法国宁可放弃加拿大也要换回这座糖岛。1794年4月英军再度夺岛，维克托·于格率共和军登陆，6月便将英军逐出，6月7日宣布废除奴隶制。八年后，里什庞斯将军奉命前来恢复奴隶制。巴斯特尔指挥官路易·德尔格雷斯1802年5月10日发表公告反对重立奴隶制，率部在山地与法军周旋；5月28日被围于马图巴时，他和最后一批随从引爆火药库，宁死不做俘虏。1803年5月14日，奴隶制正式恢复。英军1810年征服全岛，1813年名义上将其割让给瑞典，却没有一个瑞典人前来接收；瓜德罗普1814年归还法国。

en:
Dominica is a steep, rainforested volcanic island between Guadeloupe and Martinique, its highest peak Morne Diablotins; the Kalinago called it Wai'tu kubuli, 'tall is her body'. Arawakan villagers had settled there from the fifth century, and Kalinago canoe-warriors from the South American coast made it their own by the fourteenth. In 1444 it was a land of Carib villages, garden plots and fast rivers, and no European had yet seen its forested ridges.

Columbus sighted it on Sunday 3 November 1493, on his second voyage, and named it Dominica, but Spanish expeditions through the 1500s broke against Carib resistance. In 1660 France and England agreed to leave Dominica and St Vincent as neutral Carib ground, yet French woodcutters from Martinique and Guadeloupe drifted in, and the island was divided into coffee quarters worked by enslaved Africans. Andrew Rollo's British expedition took it in 1761 and the Treaty of Paris ceded it to Britain in 1763; the French retook it with the colonists' help in 1778. From 9 to 12 April 1782 Rodney met de Grasse off the Cabrits, in what the French call the battle of Dominica: he broke the line, took de Grasse and four ships of the line, and wrecked the planned invasion of Jamaica. The peace of 1783 gave the island back to Britain, and a French attack in 1805 failed, although the invaders burned much of Roseau on 22 February.

By then a second war ran in the interior. Runaway slaves had camped in the forest since 1785 and raided the estates; one chief, who fled a plantation in the late 1760s and styled himself 'governor of the woods', held a highland camp for more than forty years until he was killed there on 12 July 1814. On the northern headland above Prince Rupert's Bay stood the British fort guarding the island's best anchorage. In April 1802 its African soldiers, recruited as slaves into the 8th West India Regiment, seized the garrison for three days, and their mutiny helped carry the 1807 act that freed the regiment's slave-recruited soldiers.
zh:
多米尼克是瓜德罗普与马提尼克之间一座山势陡峭、雨林密布的火山岛，最高峰迪亚布洛廷山高出林梢；卡利纳戈人称它瓦伊图库布利，意为「她身躯高大」。5世纪起阿拉瓦克人在此建立村落，到14世纪，从南美海岸沿小安的列斯群岛逐岛北上的卡利纳戈独木舟战士成了岛屿的主人。1444年，这里是一片由加勒比村落、园圃和湍急河流组成的土地，林木覆盖的山岭还从未有欧洲人见过。

1493年11月3日星期日，哥伦布第二次远航时望见该岛，取名多米尼克，即拉丁语的「星期日」，但整个16世纪西班牙人的多次远征都在加勒比人的抵抗下碰壁。1660年，法国与英国约定把多米尼克和圣文森特留作加勒比人的中立之地，来自马提尼克和瓜德罗普的法国伐木者却仍陆续迁入，后来首任法国长官把全岛划为若干咖啡种植区，由被贩来的非洲黑奴劳作。1761年安德鲁·罗洛率英国远征军攻占该岛，1763年《巴黎条约》确认割让；1778年法国又在当地居民协助下夺回。1782年4月9日至12日，罗德尼在卡布里茨外海迎战德·格拉斯的舰队，法国人把这一仗称作多米尼克海战：英军切断法军战列，生擒德·格拉斯，俘获四艘战列舰，法方袭占牙买加的计划随之破产。1783年的和约把岛屿归还英国；1805年法军再度来攻失败，却在2月22日焚毁了罗索的大半城区。

这时岛的内陆还打着另一场战争。逃亡黑奴从1785年起在林中结营，从营地四出袭击种植园；一名在1760年代末逃出庄园的酋长自称「森林里的总督」，他在高地上的营地据守四十余年，直到1814年7月12日在营中被杀。岛北鲁珀特王子湾畔的海岬上，英军筑有守卫全岛最佳锚地的要塞。1802年4月，堡中当兵前身为奴隶的黑人士兵（西印度第八团）哗变，占据要塞三天；这次哗变推动了1807年的法案，使各西印度团里以奴隶身份入伍的士兵获得自由。

en:
Martinique is a rugged island between Dominica and St Lucia, dominated in the north by the volcano Mount Pelée; the Kalinago called it Madinina. Arawak farmers from the Orinoco settled there in the first century, and Carib groups from the Venezuelan coast reached it around the seventh. In 1444 Kalinago clans held its valleys and shores.

Columbus anchored there only on 15 June 1502, during his fourth voyage, and Spain left the island alone. On 15 September 1635 Pierre Belain d'Esnambuc landed at Saint-Pierre with 80 to 150 settlers driven out of St Kitts, claiming Martinique for Louis XIII's Company of the American Islands. Dutch Jews expelled from Brazil brought sugar plantations in 1654, and coffee shrubs carried from France in the 1720s gave Martinique the first coffee plantations in the western hemisphere. The Kalinago rising of 1658 was crushed and the survivors driven out to Dominica and St Vincent; after 1674, when Louis XIV took the island into direct royal rule, enslaved Africans made up most of its people.

Two women linked with the island married French rulers. Françoise d'Aubigné, later Louis XIV's unacknowledged wife Madame de Maintenon, lived on Martinique as a child from 1639 to 1647; the future Empress Joséphine, born in 1763, grew up on her family's sugar estate at Trois-Îlets and left for France in 1779. A British army took Fort-Royal in February 1762 and gave the island back the next year. In 1794 planters who feared the Revolution's abolition decrees called the British in, and they stayed until the Treaty of Amiens of 1802. Back at war, the British fortified the sea-stack of Diamond Rock off Fort-de-France, mounted guns on its summit and rated it a sloop of the Royal Navy; a Franco-Spanish force sent by Villeneuve retook it on 2 June 1805 after the garrison ran out of water. General Beckwith's 12,000 men reconquered the island in February 1809, and the Treaty of Paris of 30 May 1814 returned it to France, with slavery restored.
zh:
马提尼克是多米尼克与圣卢西亚之间一座地势崎岖的岛屿，北部佩莱火山雄踞其间，卡利纳戈人称之为马迪尼纳。1世纪时，来自奥里诺科流域的阿拉瓦克农人到此定居，约7世纪，委内瑞拉海岸的加勒比人又接踵而至。1444年，岛上的谷地与海岸都掌握在卡利纳戈各氏族手中。

哥伦布迟至1502年6月15日第四次远航时才在此停泊，西班牙对该岛始终没有染指。1635年9月15日，被英国人逐出圣基茨的皮埃尔·贝兰·德南比克率八十至一百五十名殖民者在圣皮埃尔登陆，以路易十三的美洲群岛公司名义占领马提尼克。1654年，被逐出巴西的荷兰犹太人带来了甘蔗种植园；1720年代，从法国携来的咖啡苗又使马提尼克有了西半球第一批咖啡种植园。1658年卡利纳戈人起义被镇压，幸存者被逐往多米尼克和圣文森特；1674年路易十四把岛屿收归国王直接统治，此后非洲黑奴很快占了人口的多数。

两位与这座岛有关的女人嫁给了法国的统治者。弗朗索瓦丝·德·奥比涅童年在1639年至1647年间住在马提尼克，后来成为路易十四未公开的妻子曼特农夫人；1763年出生的约瑟芬在家族的甘蔗种植园长大，1779年赴法，后来成为拿破仑的皇后。1762年2月英军攻陷法兰西堡，次年议和又把岛屿归还。1794年，惧怕革命废奴法令的种植园主把英军请进岛来，英军一直留到1802年《亚眠条约》签订。战火重开后，英军在法兰西堡外海的钻石岩孤峰上设防，把大炮搬上峰顶，还把这座岩礁当作一艘军舰编入皇家海军；1805年6月2日，缺水的守军被维尔纳夫派出的法西联合舰队逼降。1809年2月，贝克威思将军率一万二千人再度征服该岛；1814年5月30日《巴黎条约》把它还给法国，奴隶制也随之恢复。

en:
