Raichur is the fortress town at the centre of the Raichur Doab, the fertile wedge between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra whose silt and water make some of the best crop land in the Deccan. The first fort on the hill went up under the Kakatiyas of Warangal in 1294; an inscription names Raja Vithala as its builder, acting for Gona Gannaya, minister of Queen Rudrama Devi, and the Bahmanis later enlarged the walls. The doab was the prize of the long border war between the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara, whose armies came against the forts of Raichur and Mudgal again and again; after taking the town in 1363 the Bahmanis held it. In 1444 Raichur is their garrison town set in a Kannada-speaking Hindu countryside, facing the emperors beyond the Tungabhadra.

When the Bahmani kingdom broke up the fort passed to the Adil Shahi sultans of Bijapur in 1489. Krishnadevaraya conquered the doab for Vijayanagara in 1512 and won the decisive Battle of Raichur in 1520, driving the Bijapur army back across the Krishna; he marked the victory by raising the fort's north gate. Forty-five years later the confederate Deccan sultans destroyed Vijayanagara at Talikota in 1565 and Bijapur retook the doab. Aurangzeb's Mughals took Raichur in 1686, and from 1724 the district was held for the Nizam of Hyderabad. Its walls carry inscriptions in several languages, cut by the dynasties that garrisoned it in turn.
zh:
赖丘尔（中文维基译赖久尔）是赖丘尔河间地中心的要塞城镇。这片夹在克里希纳河与栋格珀德拉河之间的肥沃三角地，靠两河的淤泥和水源成为德干最好的农耕地之一。山上最初的城堡建于瓦朗加尔卡卡提雅王朝治下的1294年；铭文记载营建者为维塔拉王，他奉鲁德拉玛·德维女王的大臣戈纳·甘纳亚之命修城，后来巴赫曼尼王朝又扩建了城墙。河间地是巴赫曼尼苏丹国与毗奢耶那伽罗长期边境战争的争夺目标，赖丘尔和穆德加尔两堡一再遭到围攻；巴赫曼尼1363年取城后一直据守。1444年，赖丘尔是他们的驻军城镇，坐落在说卡纳达语的印度教乡野中，与栋格珀德拉河彼岸的帝国对峙。

巴赫曼尼王国解体后，要塞于1489年归比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙希王朝。克里希纳德瓦拉亚1512年为毗奢耶那伽罗夺取河间地，又在1520年的赖丘尔战役中取得决定性胜利，把比贾布尔军队逐过克里希纳河；他还修筑城堡的北门以纪念这场胜利。四十五年后的1565年，德干诸苏丹联盟在塔利科塔摧毁毗奢耶那伽罗，比贾布尔夺回河间地。1686年奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队攻占赖丘尔；1724年起，这片地区由海得拉巴尼扎姆的手下管辖。城墙上留有多种语言的铭文，都是历代在此驻军的王朝所刻。

en:
The Mysore country is rolling upland south of the Kaveri. Above the fort-town of Mysore rise the Chamundi Hills, where the Wadiyar rajas worshipped their tutelary goddess Chamundeshwari; legend derives the name Mysore from the buffalo demon she slew on the hill. Around 1399 the chief Yaduraya founded the Wadiyar line there with the title wodeyar, 'lord', and in 1444 his successors still rule a small chiefdom of villages as feudatories of the Vijayanagara emperors. South-east of Mysore, at Ummattur near Yelandur, another line of palaigars holds an older fortified town: a thirteenth-century Jain basadi and garuda pillars stand before its Ranganatha temple, and the place is named in eleventh-century Jain inscriptions.

Krishnadevaraya's armies crushed the rebel palaigar of Ummattur between 1512 and 1514, and Chamaraja Wodeyar III built the fort of Mysore in 1524. After the Vijayanagara collapse at Talikota the Wadiyars struck out on their own. In 1610 Raja Wodeyar I took Srirangapatna from the emperor's governor, moved his court to the island and held Navaratri there, the nine-night feast of Chamundeshwari at which the state sword, weapons and elephants were displayed; every Wadiyar after him kept the festival as the rite of kingship. Chikka Devaraja added Bangalore and Salem before 1700. In 1761 the general Hyder Ali seized power, planted mulberry for silk and fought four wars against the British alongside his son Tipu Sultan, who fell defending Srirangapatna in 1799. The boy Krishnaraja Wodeyar III was restored, the court returned to Mysore, and the Dasara procession set out each autumn from the palace below Chamundi Hills.
zh:
迈索尔地方是高韦里河以南一片起伏的高原。迈索尔堡城背后矗立着查蒙迪山，瓦迪亚罗阇世代祭祀的保护神查蒙德斯瓦里神庙就在山顶；相传女神在山上诛杀牛魔，迈索尔的地名便由这位魔神而来。约1399年，首领亚杜拉亚在迈索尔开创瓦迪亚家族，取号「瓦迪亚」，意为领主；1444年，其后人仍作为毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝的藩臣，统治着由若干村落组成的小酋邦。迈索尔东南、耶兰杜尔附近的乌马图尔另有一支帕莱加尔，守着一座更古老的堡城：13世纪的耆那教天衣派寺院和嘉鲁达石柱立在朗加纳塔神庙前，11世纪的耆那教铭文已提到此地。

1512至1514年，克里希纳德瓦拉亚的大军讨平乌马图尔帕莱加尔的叛乱；1524年，查马拉贾·瓦迪亚三世修筑迈索尔堡。毗奢耶那伽罗在塔利科塔之战崩溃后，瓦迪亚家族自立门户。1610年，拉贾·瓦迪亚一世从帝国总督手中夺取塞林伽巴丹，把宫廷迁上河洲，并在岛上举行九夜节：祭祀查蒙德斯瓦里的九夜庆典上陈列国刀、兵器和象队，此后每一代瓦迪亚君主都把它当作王权仪式。奇卡·德瓦拉贾在1700年前后兼并班加罗尔和塞勒姆。1761年，将领海德尔·阿里夺权，种桑养蚕，并和儿子蒂普苏丹一道同英国四度开战；1799年蒂普在守卫塞林伽巴丹时战死。幼王克里希纳拉贾三世复位，宫廷迁回迈索尔，达萨拉节的队伍每年秋天从查蒙迪山下的王宫出发。

en:
Calicut, the City of Spices, faces an open roadstead on the Malabar coast. The Eradi lords of inland Nediyiruppu fought their way to this shore in the 13th century and moved their seat to the new port; their ruler took the title Samoothiri, which Europeans wrote as Zamorin. He kept the harbour open to ships buying pepper, ginger and other Malabar goods. Arab and Persian merchants lived around its bazaars, Muslim Mappila merchants ran much of the sea trade, and cotton cloth shipped from here gave English the word calico. Ibn Battuta visited six times in the 1340s and found merchants from many countries; Zheng He's Ming fleets also returned here, and Chinese sources place the admiral's death at Calicut in 1433. In 1444 the Zamorin was the strongest ruler on this coast, with chiefs north of Cochin acknowledging his overlordship and cargoes waiting in the anchorage.

Vasco da Gama landed near Kappad on 20 May 1498, and the Portuguese soon tried to turn the pepper trade into a controlled route. Their fleet destroyed the combined Mamluk, Gujarati and Calicut force at Diu in 1509, but the Zamorin's admirals, the four Kunjali Marakkars, organised prolonged naval defence along the Malabar shore between 1520 and 1600. A Portuguese fort built at Calicut in 1511 was gone by 1525, and Calicut troops stormed the Portuguese fort at Chaliyam in 1571. The Dutch East India Company signed its first treaty with an Indian ruler with the Zamorin in 1604, and Dutch forces helped clear the Portuguese from their Malabar strongholds in 1663. English and French factories followed in the same century.

The Zamorin's final defeats came by land. Travancore defeated his army at Purakkad in 1755, and when Hyder Ali of Mysore occupied Calicut in 1766, the reigning Zamorin set fire to his palace and died there. The peace of 1792 placed Malabar in British hands, and Calicut became the chief town of the British Malabar District.
zh:
卡利卡特又称「香料之城」，面朝马拉巴尔海岸的开阔锚地。13世纪，内陆内迪伊鲁普的埃拉迪领主打到这段海岸，把治所迁到新港口；其统治者采用「萨穆特里」称号，欧洲人写作「扎莫林」。他向收购胡椒、生姜和其他马拉巴尔货物的船只开放港湾，阿拉伯、波斯商人住在市肆周边，穆斯林马皮拉商人掌管大量海运，从这里运出的棉布还使英语有了「卡利科布」一词。伊本·白图泰在14世纪40年代六次到访，见到各国商人；郑和的宝船也曾多次停泊，中文史料把这位航海家1433年的去世之地记在卡利卡特。1444年，扎莫林已是这片海岸最强的统治者，科钦以北的酋长承认其宗主权，港湾中停满待运的货物。

1498年5月20日，瓦斯科·达·伽马在卡帕德附近登陆，葡萄牙人随即将胡椒贸易纳入受控航路。1509年，他们在第乌击溃马穆鲁克、古吉拉特和卡利卡特的联合舰队；但扎莫林的四代海军统帅昆贾利·马拉卡尔，在1520至1600年间沿马拉巴尔海岸长期组织海上抵抗。葡萄牙人1511年在卡利卡特筑堡，1525年前即已失去，1571年卡利卡特军队又攻破查利亚姆的葡军要塞。1604年，荷兰东印度公司与扎莫林签约，这是它同印度统治者订立的第一份条约；1663年，荷兰军队又协助把葡萄牙人赶出马拉巴尔各据点。英国和法国商馆也在同一世纪相继设立。

扎莫林最后的失败来自陆上。1755年，特拉凡哥尔在普拉卡德击败其军队；1766年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里占领卡利卡特时，在位的扎莫林纵火焚毁宫殿，自焚而死。1792年和议后，马拉巴尔落入英国之手，卡利卡特成为英属马拉巴尔县的首城。

en:
Kochi occupies a sheltered chain of lagoons and islands on the Malabar Coast. The Periyar flood of 1341 opened a harbour here as the old spice roadstead at Muziris silted up, and the Perumpadappu rulers moved their seat to the rising port. Arab, Chinese, Jewish, Syrian Christian and Malayali merchants dealt in pepper, and Chinese fishing nets introduced in the fourteenth century became a familiar sight along the water. Ma Huan described Kochi after sailing with Zheng He's fleets, and Niccolò da Conti visited in 1440. In 1444 the Hindu raja ruled a Malayalam-speaking trading state, while the Zamorin of Calicut had exploited quarrels among the royal branches, stripped away vassals and pressed on its northern approaches.

On 24 December 1500 Raja Unni Goda Varma welcomed Pedro Álvares Cabral and made Cochin Portugal's first ally on this coast. In September 1503 the raja allowed Afonso de Albuquerque to build Fort Emmanuel, the first European fort in Asia. Its first walls were double rows of coconut timber packed with rammed earth and protected by a water-filled ditch, and the Portuguese settlement behind them included St Francis Church. The fort's guns helped Cochin survive the Calicut siege of 1504. Vasco da Gama was buried in that church in 1524 before his remains were returned to Portugal. A Dutch fleet took Fort Cochin in 1663. Mysorean invasions after 1766 forced Cochin to pay tribute, British power displaced the Dutch in the 1790s, and the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 placed Fort Kochi under British rule while the raja retained his inland state.
zh:
科钦位于马拉巴尔海岸一串受潟湖和岛屿掩护的水域。1341年培里亚尔河洪水冲出海口，古老香料港穆济里斯逐渐淤塞，佩鲁姆巴达普统治者把驻地迁往这座兴起的港口。阿拉伯、中国、犹太、叙利亚基督教和马拉雅拉姆商人在此交易胡椒，14世纪传入的中式吊网成为水边常见景象。马欢随郑和船队记录过科钦，尼科洛·达·孔蒂也在1440年到访。1444年，印度教罗阇统治着这个讲马拉雅拉姆语的贸易小国；卡利卡特扎莫林利用王族分支间的纷争，夺去其属国，并从北方施压。

1500年12月24日，罗阇乌尼·戈达·瓦尔马迎接佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔，使科钦成为葡萄牙在这片海岸的第一个盟友。1503年9月，罗阇准许阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克修建伊曼纽尔堡。这是亚洲第一座欧洲堡垒，最初的墙体以双排椰木夹住夯土，外有灌水壕沟，堡后聚落中建有圣弗朗西斯教堂。堡垒炮火帮助科钦挺过1504年卡利卡特的围攻。瓦斯科·达·伽马1524年在科钦去世，葬于这座教堂，遗骨后来才运回葡萄牙。1663年，荷兰舰队攻占科钦堡。1766年后的迈索尔入侵迫使科钦纳贡，英国势力在1790年代取代荷兰；1814年《英荷条约》把科钦堡划归英国统治，罗阇则保留内陆土邦。

en:
Madurai lies on the banks of the Vaigai, deep in the Tamil country, and for close on two thousand years it was the seat of the Pandyas. Their kings patronised the third Tamil Sangam, the assembly of Tamil poets, and the Meenakshi temple on the river drew pilgrims from across southern India; the second book of the Tamil epic Silappatikaram is set in the city's streets. The Cholas held Madurai through most of the 9th to 13th centuries, until a revived Pandya line made it their capital again. In 1311 Malik Kafur, the general of Alauddin Khalji, sacked the city on his raid into the far south, wrecked the Meenakshi shrine and carried its gold and jewels to Delhi, and the governors the sultan left behind broke away as the Madurai Sultans. The Vijayanagara prince Kumara Kampana overthrew their kingdom in 1378, brought the hidden idols back into the rebuilt temple, and his queen Gangadevi sang the campaign in her Sanskrit poem Madhura Vijayam. In 1444 Madurai is a southern governorship of Vijayanagara, a Tamil Hindu temple city living by weaving and the coastal trade.

In 1529 the emperor made Viswanatha Nayak governor of Madurai, and his house turned the office into a hereditary kingdom. Viswanatha fortified the temple and, with his minister Ariyanatha Mudaliar, added its hall of a thousand pillars; the Nayaks ruled the countryside through the palaiyakkarar military chieftains. Tirumala Nayak brought the court back from Tiruchirappalli in 1635, raised the great Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, stopped his tribute to Vijayanagara and set the sultans of Golconda and Bijapur against the failing empire. From 1689 the regent Rani Mangammal kept the peace for fifteen years, building roads and pilgrim rest houses and paying the Mughal armies besieging Gingee. After a bitter succession quarrel the Arcot general Chanda Sahib swore his way into the Tiruchirappalli fort and seized the kingdom, ending Nayak rule in 1736; the widowed queen Meenakshi died by poison in his custody three years later, by traditional account. Madurai changed hands through the Carnatic Wars until the English East India Company annexed it to the Madras Presidency in 1801.
zh:
马杜赖位于韦加伊河畔，地处泰米尔之地腹地，近两千年间是潘地亚王朝的都城。潘地亚诸王赞助了第三届泰米尔桑伽姆诗人集会，河畔的米纳克希神庙吸引着南印度各地的香客；泰米尔史诗《脚镯记》的第二篇就以这座城的街巷为背景。9至13世纪的大部分时间里马杜赖在朱罗治下，其后复兴的潘地亚再次定都于此。1311年，阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉的将领马利克·卡富尔南征至此，洗劫城市、捣毁米纳克希神庙，把金器珠宝掠往德里；苏丹留守的将领随后割据，建立马杜赖苏丹国。1378年，毗奢耶那伽罗王子库马拉·坎帕纳攻灭苏丹国，迎回藏匿的神像、重修神庙，王妃甘加黛维以梵语长诗《马杜拉之捷》（Madhura Vijayam）歌咏这场远征。1444年的马杜赖是毗奢耶那伽罗南部的一处总督辖地，一座以纺织和沿海贸易为生的泰米尔印度教圣城。

1529年，皇帝任命维斯瓦纳特·纳亚克为马杜赖总督，他的家族把这一职位变成世袭王国。维斯瓦纳特加固神庙，并在大臣阿里亚纳塔·穆达利尔主持下增建千柱厅；纳亚克诸王通过帕莱亚卡拉尔军事首领治理乡野。蒂鲁马拉·纳亚克1635年把宫廷从蒂鲁吉拉帕利迁回马杜赖，兴建宏伟的蒂鲁马拉·纳亚克宫，停止向毗奢耶那伽罗纳贡，并挑动戈尔康达与比贾布尔的苏丹去对付走向末路的帝国。1689年起，摄政的芒格玛尔女王主政十五年间维持安定，修筑道路和香客旅舍，并向围攻金吉的莫卧儿大军纳贡。继承之争激化后，阿尔科特将领昌达·萨希卜立誓进入蒂鲁吉拉帕利堡，随即夺权，于1736年终结纳亚克统治；守寡的米纳克希女王三年后在囚禁中服毒而死，这是传统的说法。卡纳提克战争期间马杜赖几度易手，1801年被英国东印度公司并入马德拉斯管区。

en:
Venad lay between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea, with its rulers at Quilon on Ashtamudi Lake. The roadstead was one of Malabar's oldest pepper ports: Arab, Persian, Chinese, Jewish, Syrian Christian and Malayali merchants had long done business there, and Chinese junks had called there for centuries. Ibn Battuta listed Quilon among the Indian ports he saw, and local tradition also places one of Saint Thomas's seven churches and an early mosque in the town. Ravi Varma Kulasekhara used the Pandya civil wars to lead Venad raids into the Tamil country in 1312-1316, while Deva Raya II of Vijayanagara received tribute from Kollam in 1426. In 1444 Venad was a Hindu, Malayalam-speaking coastal kingdom whose rulers lived on pepper trade and balanced stronger powers beyond the Ghats.

The Portuguese opened a trading post at Tangasseri in 1504 and built St Thomas Fort there in 1518 to cover their pepper purchases. In 1578 Quilon printed the Tamil Christian book Thambiran Vanakkam, the first book published in an Indian language. A Dutch force took the town and fort in 1661 and made Tangasseri the capital of Dutch Malabar. The English East India Company opened a factory at Vizhinjam in 1664 and built Anjengo Fort in 1695; resentment of the English connection helped bring on the Attingal attack of 1721. Marthanda Varma, ruling from 1729 to 1758, broke the regional nobles and reshaped Venad into Travancore. British forces took Quilon in 1795 and defeated Velu Thampi Dalawa's rising at the Battle of Quilon in 1809.
zh:
韦纳德位于西高止山脉与阿拉伯海之间，统治者驻在阿什塔穆迪湖畔的奎隆。这片锚地是马拉巴尔最古老的胡椒港之一，阿拉伯、波斯、中国、犹太、叙利亚基督教和马拉雅拉姆商人久已在此交易，中国帆船也已停泊数百年。伊本·白图泰曾把奎隆列入他见过的印度港口；当地相传，圣多马建立的七座教堂之一和一座早期清真寺都在城中。1312年至1316年，拉维·瓦尔马·库拉谢卡拉乘潘地亚内战，率军攻入泰米尔地区；1426年，毗奢耶那伽罗的德瓦·拉亚二世接受奎隆纳贡。1444年，韦纳德是一个印度教、马拉雅拉姆语的海岸王国，统治者依靠胡椒贸易，同时周旋于西高止山以东的强国之间。

1504年，葡萄牙人在坦加塞里开设贸易站，1518年又在当地修建圣多马堡，掩护胡椒采购。1578年，泰米尔语基督教著作《坦比兰·瓦纳卡姆》在奎隆印成，是第一本以印度语言出版的书。1661年，荷兰军队夺取城镇和堡垒，并把坦加塞里设为荷属马拉巴尔的首府。英国东印度公司1664年在维津詹姆开设商馆，1695年修建安金戈堡；对英国势力的不满推动了1721年的阿廷加尔袭击。1729年至1758年在位的玛尔坦达·瓦尔马打击地方贵族，把韦纳德改造为特拉凡哥尔。英军1795年占领奎隆，1809年在奎隆战役击败韦卢·坦皮·达拉瓦的起事。

en:
Kongu is the upland country west of the Tamil plain, where the Kaveri, Bhavani, Amaravati and Noyyal cut valleys through the Ghats. Its town of Karur was ancient Karuvur, a Chera seat on the road from the Malabar port of Muziris through the Palghat Gap to Arikamedu on the Coromandel coast. Excavations at Karur and Kodumanal have yielded Roman amphorae, coins, beads and traces of jewellery workshops, and Ptolemy described Karuvur as an inland trading centre. Cholas, Pandyas and Western Gangas held the country in turn before Vijayanagara arrived in the fifteenth century. In 1444 Kongu was a Tamil Hindu border country under Vijayanagara, valued for the Palghat road, river crossings and the cloth, gems and other goods moving between the two coasts.

After 1646 Nayak governors divided Kongu into palayams, whose military chiefs held forts beside the roads and fords. The kingdom of Mysore pressed into the country in the eighteenth century, and Karur passed back and forth during the Anglo-Mysore wars. British troops took the town for the third time in 1790, and after Tipu Sultan's defeat in 1799 Kongu was attached to the Madras Presidency. Karur fort remained a Company garrison until 1801, the year the Kongu chieftain Dheeran Chinnamalai fought in these hills during the Second Polygar War; he was hanged in 1805.
zh:
贡古是泰米尔平原以西的山地，高韦里河、巴瓦尼河、阿默拉沃蒂河和诺伊尔河在高止山中切出河谷。首府卡鲁尔古称卡鲁武尔，曾是哲罗人的要地；从马拉巴尔港口穆济里斯穿过帕尔加特山口、通往科罗曼德海岸阿里卡梅杜的商路经过这里。卡鲁尔和科杜马纳尔的发掘出土过罗马陶罐、钱币、珠饰和珠宝作坊遗迹，托勒密也曾把卡鲁武尔记为南印度内陆商镇。朱罗、潘地亚和西恒伽王朝先后统治此地，15世纪毗奢耶那伽罗势力进入。1444年，贡古是毗奢耶那伽罗治下的泰米尔印度教边地，价值在帕尔加特商路、各处渡口以及往来两海之间的布匹、宝石和其他货物。

1646年后，纳亚克总督把贡古划分为若干帕莱亚姆，军事首领在道路和渡口旁筑堡据守。18世纪，迈索尔王国不断压入此地，英迈战争中卡鲁尔反复易手。英军1790年第三次攻占该城；提普苏丹1799年战败后，贡古并入马德拉斯管辖区。卡鲁尔堡垒作为东印度公司驻军据点使用至1801年，就在这一年，贡古首领迪兰·钦纳马莱在第二次波利加尔战争中转战这些山地，后于1805年被处以绞刑。

en:
Tondainadu is the northernmost plain of the Tamil country, flat land of weaving villages and palm-fringed backwaters behind the Coromandel shore. Its seaward gate is Pulicat, the town on the long sandspit that walls a salt lagoon from the Bay of Bengal. Pallavas and Cholas ruled the plain in turn, the Madurai Sultans passed over it after the Pandya collapse, and Vijayanagara's generals secured it in the 1360s. In 1444 it is a prosperous Tamil province of Deva Raya II's empire: its cotton looms feed the coasting trade, and the Gajapati kings of Odisha press against the northern marches.

The frontier wars came in the next reign, when Kapilendra Deva's Gajapatis overran Udayagiri and Chandragiri in 1463; the general Saluva Narasimha won the country back and later seized the Vijayanagara throne for himself. Europeans then made Pulicat their own. The Portuguese opened a trading post in 1502; the Dutch drove them out and raised Fort Geldria, the first Dutch fort in India, in 1613. For most of the seventeenth century the town was the seat of the Dutch government on the Coromandel, shipping the cloth of more than a thousand inland looms to Batavia and minting copper coins for the eastern trade; from 1621 to 1665 its slavers also carried some 38,000 people taken on the Coromandel coast to the plantations of Java. After Vijayanagara fell, the coast passed to Golconda and then to the Nawabs of Arcot, and in 1760 the Carnatic Wars ended nearby when Eyre Coote defeated Lally at Wandiwash. British troops occupied Pulicat in 1795 and blew up Fort Geldria nine years later.
zh:
通代纳杜（Tondaimandalam）是泰米尔之地最北端的平原，科罗曼德海岸内侧是一片平地，遍布织村和椰林环抱的潟湖。平原面向大海的门户是布利格德（泰米尔语称帕扎韦尔卡杜），长沙洲把咸水潟湖与孟加拉湾隔开，城镇就坐落在沙洲上。帕拉瓦与朱罗两朝先后统治此地，潘地亚衰亡后马杜赖苏丹国一度席卷而过，14世纪60年代毗奢耶那伽罗的将领平定了平原。1444年，这里是德瓦·拉亚二世治下富庶的泰米尔省份：棉织机供养着沿海贸易，奥里萨的加贾帕提王则压迫着北方边境。

边境战争在下一朝爆发：卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂大军1463年攻陷乌德耶吉里和昌德拉吉里，将领萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈收复故土，后来还自己夺取了毗奢耶那伽罗皇位。随后欧洲人把布利格德据为己有：葡萄牙人1502年开设商馆，荷兰人将其逐出，并在1613年建起印度第一座荷兰堡垒海尔德兰堡。17世纪的大部分时间里，此城是荷兰在科罗曼德的统治中心，上千架内地织机的布匹经此运往巴达维亚，还铸造铜币供应东方贸易；1621至1665年，这里的奴隶船又把约三万八千名从科罗曼德沿海掳来的人运往爪哇的种植园。毗奢耶那伽罗灭亡后，海岸先归戈尔康达，再属阿尔科特的纳瓦布；1760年，艾尔·库特在附近的万迪瓦什击败拉利，卡纳提克战争就此终结。1795年英军占领布利格德，九年后炸毁海尔德兰堡。

en:
Cuddalore is a Tamil roadstead on the Coromandel coast, where the Ponnaiyar and Kedilam rivers meet the sea through a tangle of backwaters; its Tamil name Kudalur means 'confluence'. A few miles up the shore lies Pondicherry. Roman traders knew an emporium here as Poduke, and beads and wine jars from the Mediterranean have been dug up at Arikamedu. Pallavas, Cholas and Pandyas held the coast in turn before Vijayanagara, whose vassals the Nayaks of Gingee governed it by the fifteenth century. In 1444 it is a string of fishing and weaving villages in Deva Raya II's empire, and its cloth moves down the estuaries to foreign shipping.

In 1608 Krishnappa Nayak of Gingee let the Dutch build at Devanampatnam, but Portuguese pressure on his Vijayanagara overlord made him revoke the grant. Francois Martin founded French Pondicherry on the same shore in 1674, and in 1690 the Maratha ruler Rajaram, besieged by the Mughals in Gingee, sold the half-built fort to the highest European bidder. Elihu Yale, the Welsh-born governor of Madras, bought it for the English and named it Fort St David after the patron saint of Wales; the sale covered every village within range of a cannon shot, the settlements known as the 'cannonball villages'. After Madras fell to the French in 1746, Fort St David became the British headquarters in south India and Dupleix's attacks were beaten off. Robert Clive was its governor when Lally stormed it in 1758; Eyre Coote retook it two years later after Wandiwash, and Pondicherry fell in January 1761. A French fleet put troops back into Cuddalore in 1782 and the garrison withstood a British siege in 1783, but in 1785 the fort passed back to the British and changed hands no more. Pondicherry, occupied again in 1793, was returned to France in 1814.
zh:
古达罗尔（泰米尔语名库达卢鲁，意为「汇流」）是科罗曼德海岸的泰米尔锚地，蓬奈亚尔河与凯迪拉姆河穿过纵横潟湖在此汇流入海，沿海岸北上不远便是本地治里。罗马商人早就知道此地有个叫波杜凯的商站，阿里卡梅杜还出土过地中海来的珠子和酒罐。帕拉瓦、朱罗、潘地亚先后据有这片海岸，其后归入毗奢耶那伽罗，到15世纪由封臣金吉纳亚克治理。1444年，这里是德瓦·拉亚二世帝国境内一串渔村与织村，布匹已顺着河口运上外洋商船。

1608年，金吉的克里什纳帕·纳亚克准许荷兰人在德瓦南帕特纳姆筑堡，葡萄牙人却向其宗主毗奢耶那伽罗施压，特许终被收回。1674年，弗朗索瓦·马丹在同一海岸建起法属本地治里；1690年，被莫卧儿大军围困在金吉的马拉塔君主拉贾拉姆把半成的堡垒卖给出价最高的欧洲人。生于威尔士的马德拉斯总督伊莱胡·耶鲁替英国人买下，以威尔士主保圣人之名称为圣大卫堡；交易把一炮射程内的村落尽数划给英方，这些村落后来被称作「炮弹村」。1746年马德拉斯陷敌后，圣大卫堡成为英国在南印度的总部，杜布雷的进攻被击退。1758年拉利攻陷堡垒时，堡督正是罗伯特·克莱夫；两年后艾尔·库特在万迪瓦什大捷后将其收复，本地治里也于1761年1月陷落。1782年法国舰队派兵重占古达罗尔，守军顶住了1783年的英军围攻，但1785年堡垒还是交还英国，再未易手。本地治里1793年再被占领，1814年归还法国。

en:
Vijayanagara, the City of Victory, occupied a granite stretch of the Tungabhadra around Hampi, already a Shaiva pilgrimage place around the Virupaksha temple. Harihara I and Bukka, commanders from the fallen kingdom of Kampili, founded the capital in 1336, by tradition with the guidance of the Sringeri sage Vidyaranya. Their Sangama dynasty used the river, ridges and tanks as defence against the Bahmani sultans to the north. Niccolò de' Conti, visiting about 1420, reckoned the walls and suburbs stretched for sixty miles. In 1444 Deva Raya II ruled from the city; his campaigns had reached Ceylon and drawn tribute from Pegu and Tenasserim, while renewed war with the Bahmanis in 1443 strained the frontier. The Persian envoy Abdur Razzak described seven layers of fortification and bazaars crowded with overseas merchants.

The capital reached its peak under Krishna Deva Raya of the Tuluva line, who reigned from 1509 to 1529. He defeated Ismail Adil Shah of Bijapur at Raichur in 1520, the same year Domingo Paes came with Goa traders and compared the well-supplied city with Rome. Foreign estimates put its population near half a million, making Hampi-Vijayanagara one of the largest cities in the world. Krishna Deva Raya raised the Vitthala and Krishna temple complexes, enlarged the waterworks, and wrote the Telugu poem Amuktamalyada; his court also gathered the eight Telugu poets called the Ashtadiggajas.

After his death, power passed to the regent Rama Raya. His interventions in Deccan wars brought Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar and Berar into one coalition. At Rakshasi-Tangadi, usually called the battle of Talikota, on 23 January 1565, the allied army defeated the Vijayanagara forces and killed Rama Raya. The victors occupied the capital and looted and burned it for six months. The court fled to Penukonda; two years later Cesare Federici found empty houses where tigers and other wild animals were said to live. Colin Mackenzie's surveyors recorded the Hampi ruins in the early 19th century.
zh:
毗奢耶那伽罗意为「胜利之城」，位于栋格珀德拉河的花岗岩河段，环绕着早已是湿婆朝圣地的亨比和维鲁帕克沙神庙。1336年，亡国的坎皮利王国将领诃里诃罗一世与布卡兄弟在此奠都，相传得到斯林格里圣人维迪亚兰雅指点。桑伽马王朝以河流、山脊和蓄水池为屏障，抵御北方的巴赫曼尼苏丹国。约1420年到访的尼科洛·达·康提估算，城墙和郊区绵延六十英里。1444年，德瓦·拉亚二世在此统治；他的兵锋远达锡兰，勃固和丹那沙林也向他纳贡，而1443年重开的巴赫曼尼战事正压迫着边境。波斯使者阿卜杜勒·拉扎克记载，都城有七层防御工事，市集中挤满来自海外的商人。

都城在图卢瓦王朝的克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚治下达到极盛，他于1509至1529年在位。1520年，他在赖丘尔击败比贾布尔的伊斯梅尔·阿迪勒·沙阿；同年随果阿商人到此的多明戈·派士，把供给充足的毗奢耶那伽罗比作罗马。外来者估计城中人口接近五十万，使亨比和毗奢耶那伽罗成为世界最大城市之一。克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚修建维塔拉神庙与克里希纳神庙群，扩建水利，还写下泰卢固语长诗《阿姆克塔马利亚达》；他的宫廷聚集了被称为「八方诗雄」的八位泰卢固诗人。

他死后，政权落入摄政拉马·拉亚手中。拉马·拉亚干预德干战事，使比贾布尔、戈尔孔达、艾哈迈德讷格尔、比达尔和贝拉尔结成联盟。1565年1月23日，联军在拉克沙西—坦加迪，即通常所称的塔里科塔战役中击败毗奢耶那伽罗军队，杀死拉马·拉亚。胜方进占都城，焚掠六个月。朝廷逃往佩努孔达；两年后，切萨雷·费代里奇见到空屋，据说其中已有虎和其他野兽栖息。19世纪初，科林·麦肯齐的测绘人员记录下亨比废墟。

en:
Golconda stands on a granite rise west of Hyderabad. Its Telugu name Golla Konda means shepherd's hill, from a story that a cowherd unearthed a sacred idol there in 1143. The Kakatiya rajas of Warangal turned the shrine into a mud fort, and Ganapati Deva placed a stone outpost on the hilltop to guard his western lands. Ulugh Khan took it with Warangal for the Tughluqs in 1323, and Kapaya Nayaka later ceded it to the Bahmani sultan Mohammed Shah in 1363. The Bahmanis made the fort the seat of their governor of Telangana, one of the four chief provinces of the sultanate. In 1444 its garrison watched over the eastern Telugu lands and the approaches to Warangal.

The break-up of the Bahmani kingdom turned this provincial fort into a royal capital. The Bahmani sultan appointed Sultan Quli, a Turkoman officer from Hamadan, governor in 1496; he rebuilt the old earthworks and in 1518 founded the Qutb Shahi sultanate. The first three Qutb Shahi sultans spent sixty-two years clothing the hill in granite, with an inner wall about five kilometres around the citadel. Diamonds from the Kollur workings on the Krishna were graded and sold here, and stones traditionally counted among the Golconda diamonds include the Koh-i-Noor; the fort's name became a European word for a source of treasure. Its weavers also produced muslin and calico for Persia, Java and European buyers. In 1591 Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah began the new city of Hyderabad below the hill and set the Charminar at its centre.

The Mughals ended Qutb Shahi rule. Shah Jahan forced Golconda to accept Mughal overlordship in 1636. Aurangzeb directed the next attack in person in 1687, and the granite citadel held out for eight months before bribery and treachery ended the defence. The last sultan, Abul Hasan, spent the rest of his life imprisoned at Daulatabad. When the Mughal viceroy Asaf Jah made himself the first Nizam of Hyderabad in 1724, Golconda served as the fortified storehouse of his treasury; it still kept that role in 1821.
zh:
戈尔孔达坐落在海得拉巴以西的花岗岩山冈上。泰卢固语称戈拉孔达，意为「牧人山」；相传1143年一个牧童在此掘出神像，因而得名。瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚诸王把圣地修成土堡，加纳帕蒂·提婆又在山顶设置石寨，守卫西部领地。1323年，乌鲁格汗代表图格鲁克王朝攻陷瓦朗加尔和此堡；后来卡帕亚·纳亚卡在1363年把它交给巴赫曼尼苏丹穆罕默德沙。巴赫曼尼王朝将此堡设为特伦甘纳总督驻节地，是苏丹国四个主要行省之一。1444年，堡内驻军镇抚东方的泰卢固之地，也扼守通往瓦朗加尔的道路。

巴赫曼尼王国瓦解后，这座行省要塞变成王都。1496年，巴赫曼尼苏丹任命来自哈马丹的土库曼将领苏丹·库利为总督；他重修旧土工，并于1518年建立库特布沙希苏丹国。前三代库特布沙希苏丹用六十二年时间，把整座山包进花岗岩城墙，内堡城墙周长约五公里。克里希纳河科卢尔矿场出产的钻石在此分级、出售，传统上列入戈尔孔达名钻的宝石包括「光明之山」；这座要塞的名字也进入欧洲语言，成为宝藏来源的代称。本地织工还生产平纹细布和印花布，销往波斯、爪哇和欧洲。1591年，穆罕默德·库利·库特布沙在山下营建新都海得拉巴，并把查尔米纳尔门放在城中心。

莫卧儿人终结了库特布沙希王朝。1636年，沙贾汗迫使戈尔孔达接受莫卧儿宗主权。1687年，奥朗则布亲自指挥进攻，花岗岩堡垒坚守八个月，最后因贿赂和叛卖失守。末代苏丹阿布勒·哈桑被囚禁在道拉塔巴德，在那里度过余生。1724年，莫卧儿总督阿萨夫·贾自立为海得拉巴第一代尼扎姆后，戈尔孔达成为他设防的府库；1821年，它仍承担这一职责。

en:
Velanadu is the Telugu coastal plain between the Krishna and the Penna, where the great river splits into its delta before meeting the Bay of Bengal. Its seaward town was Masulipatnam, the Bandar or 'port' of later Persian usage, an anchorage Greek and Roman sailors knew as Maisolos or Masalia; the word muslin is traced to that old name, and the fine cottons woven in the delta villages already left on Indian Ocean ships. After the Kakatiya empire broke up, the Reddy rajas of Kondavidu ruled from their hill fort west of the plain, patrons of Telugu poets holding the Krishna delta against rival Deccan powers, until the Gajapatis of Odisha began pressing down the coast. In 1444 Velanadu was a Hindu Telugu country of rice fields, weaving villages and boatyards under its own Reddy raja, with Kapilendra Deva's armies gathering on the northern frontier.

The Gajapatis took the country in 1448. Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara stormed Kondavidu in 1516, and the Qutb Shahis of Golconda made themselves masters of Guntur and Bandar in 1541 and of the last Circar forts by 1571. Golconda made Bandar its chief seaport: Godavari and Krishna cloth, printed kalamkari hangings and indigo went out through it, and with them diamonds dug from the Krishna gravels, the stones sold in Europe as Golconda diamonds, the Koh-i-Noor among them. The English opened a factory in 1611, the French in 1669, while Portuguese, Dutch and Mughal merchants kept houses beside them. Aurangzeb's conquest of Golconda in 1687 drew the port into the Mughal Deccan.

In the middle of the eighteenth century the French ran the Northern Circars from the town, until Colonel Francis Forde's small British army besieged and stormed it in April 1759; the fall of the place helped raise the French siege of Madras. When the rest of the Circars went back to the Nizam, Masulipatnam stayed in British hands, and the treaty of 1768 confirmed the company's title to the coast, with Guntur reserved until 1788.
zh:
贝拉纳杜是克里希纳河与彭纳河之间的泰卢固沿海平原，克里希纳河在这里分汊入海，积出大片三角洲。平原的出海之城是默吉利伯德讷姆，波斯语称「班达尔」，意为港口；古希腊、罗马水手称这处锚地为迈索洛斯或马萨利亚，后来欧洲人说的 muslin（平纹细布）一词便得自这个旧名，三角洲村落织出的细棉布也早随印度洋商船远行。卡卡蒂亚帝国瓦解后，孔达维杜的雷迪王公在平原以西的山城设朝，庇护泰卢固诗人，凭克里希纳三角洲与德干诸强抗衡，直到奥里萨的加贾帕蒂人开始沿海岸南下。1444年的贝拉纳杜是印度教泰卢固人的土地，稻田、织村和船场归自己的雷迪王公管辖，卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的大军已集结在北方边境。

加贾帕蒂于1448年夺取此地；毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚1516年攻陷孔达维杜，戈尔康达的库特布沙希军队1541年拿下贡土尔和班达尔，到1571年又控制了其余西尔卡尔要塞。戈尔康达把班达尔建成首要海港：戈达瓦里与克里希纳的棉布、印花卡拉姆卡里挂毯和靛蓝经此外运，同行的还有克里希纳河谷砾石坑里挖出的钻石，这些石头在欧洲被当作戈尔康达钻石出售，光之山便出自其中。英国1611年开设商馆，法国1669年紧随其后，葡萄牙、荷兰和莫卧儿商人也都在城中设有馆舍。1687年奥朗则布征服戈尔康达，港口并入莫卧儿德干。

18世纪中叶，法国人以该城经营北西尔卡尔，直到弗朗西斯·福德上校率领兵力不多的英军围城强攻，于1759年4月夺城，此役也解了马德拉斯之围。其余西尔卡尔归还尼扎姆时，默吉利伯德讷姆留在英国人手中；1768年的条约承认公司对北西尔卡尔的权利，只有贡土尔一地保留到1788年。

en:
In 1444 the valley of the Sina river was the north-western march of the Bahmani sultanate, governed from Bidar, with the old settlement of Bhingar and the great fortress of Daulatabad guarding the road north. Marathi-speaking Hindu peasants worked the cotton lands of the Desh, and their revenues passed through Deccani and Habshi officers. Half a century later one of those officers' sons, Malik Ahmad, governor of Junnar, defeated the armies sent from Bidar, declared independence on 28 May 1490 and founded the Nizam Shahi dynasty. In 1494 he marked out a walled city on the Sina beside the battlefield of Bhingar and named it Ahmadnagar after himself; the chronicler Firishta writes that within two years its palaces and gardens rivalled Baghdad and Cairo. Daulatabad fell to him in 1499.

His successors made Ahmadnagar one of the leading powers of the Deccan. At Talikota in 1565 Sultan Hussain Nizam Shah commanded the league of Deccan sultans that broke the army of Vijayanagara, and he himself beheaded the captured Rama Raya. The dynasty later annexed Berar and beat off an invasion by Akbar. When the Mughal army returned, Chand Bibi, who had already ruled Bijapur as regent, held the fort through the siege of 1595; her own men killed her five years later, and the city was stormed. The Nizam Shahi cause passed to Malik Ambar, an Ethiopian-born slave who rose to be the kingdom's peshwa, led a mercenary army fifty thousand strong, checked the Mughals with guerrilla tactics, and ruled from his new city of Khirki until his death in 1626. A Mughal army under Shah Jahan's son Aurangzeb annexed what remained in 1636, and Aurangzeb himself died at Ahmadnagar in 1707 after twenty-six years campaigning in the Deccan. The fort passed to the Maratha Peshwa and then to Daulat Rao Sindhia; a British force stormed it in 1803, and after a brief Maratha restoration the Treaty of Poona ceded the town to the East India Company.
zh:
1444年，锡纳河谷是巴赫曼尼苏丹国的西北边疆，政令出自比达尔；旧聚落宾加尔和扼守北路的道拉塔巴德大要塞拱卫着这一带。德什的棉田由讲马拉地语的印度教农民耕种，赋税经朝中德干派和哈比舍人将领上缴。近半个世纪后，这样一位将领之子、朱尼尔总督马利克·艾哈迈德击败比达尔派来的大军，于1490年5月28日宣布独立，建立尼扎姆·沙希王朝。1494年，他在锡纳河畔、宾加尔战场旁勘定一座带城墙的新城，以自己的名字命名为艾哈迈德讷格尔；据当时史家记载，不出两年，城中的宫殿和园林便可与巴格达、开罗媲美。1499年，道拉塔巴德也落入他手。

此后的尼扎姆·沙希王朝长期称雄德干。1565年塔利科塔一役，侯赛因·尼扎姆沙统率德干苏丹联军击溃毗奢耶那伽罗大军，并亲手斩下被俘的拉马·拉亚。王朝后来兼并贝拉尔，击退了阿克巴的入侵。莫卧儿大军再至时，曾在比贾布尔摄政的昌德·比比据守要塞，熬过1595年的围攻；五年后她被自己人杀死，城池随即失守。延续尼扎姆·沙希事业的是马利克·安巴尔：他出身埃塞俄比亚奴隶，官至王国的佩什瓦，统领五万人的雇佣军，以游击战术遏制莫卧儿，并在新城赫德基发号施令，直到1626年去世。1636年，沙贾汗之子奥朗则布吞并残余疆土；奥朗则布本人在德干征战二十六年后，于1707年死在艾哈迈德讷格尔。要塞后来转入马拉地佩什瓦之手，又归道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚；英军1803年攻陷要塞，城市短暂归还马拉地人后，终依《浦那条约》割让给东印度公司。

en:
Daulatabad, the 'abode of fortune', crowns a sheer rock hill in the Marathwada uplands, where the caravan roads from Gujarat and northern India turn south into the Deccan. It began as Devagiri, the stronghold of the Yadava king Bhillama V, who fortified the hill about 1187. Alauddin Khalji raided it in 1296 and forced the Yadava king to become his vassal in 1308. Muhammad bin Tughluq renamed the hill Daulatabad and in 1327 ordered the population of Delhi to move south to his new capital; the arid site defeated the plan, he reversed it in 1334, and the episode earned him the name of the 'Mad King'. The fort then passed to the Bahmani sultans, and in 1444 it was one of the great strongholds of their kingdom above Marathi-speaking farmland. The next year they raised the Chand Minar beside it, a 63-metre tower modelled on Delhi's Qutb Minar and faced with Persian blue tiles, to mark Ala-ud-din Ahmad Shah's victory over Vijayanagara.

In 1490 the Bahmani governor Malik Ahmad broke away to found the Nizam Shahi sultanate of Ahmadnagar, and his men took Daulatabad in 1499 and kept it as a second capital. After Akbar's armies took Ahmadnagar city in 1600, Malik Ambar, an Ethiopian-born slave who had risen to command the Nizam Shahi armies, carried on the cause from a new capital he built at Khadki in 1610; with a mercenary force of more than 50,000 men he wore the Mughals down in guerrilla raids until his death in 1626. Imperial troops stormed the hill in 1633 and annexed the sultanate soon afterwards. In 1653 Prince Aurangzeb, viceroy of the Deccan, renamed Khadki as Aurangabad, and from 1681 he kept his camp and court there through the long wars against the Marathas. In 1724 the Mughal viceroy Asaf Jah made Aurangabad the first capital of the Hyderabad state he founded, and in 1760 Maratha forces stormed the old Yadava fort.
zh:
道拉塔巴德意为「幸运之城」，雄踞马拉特瓦达高地一座陡峭岩山，古吉拉特与北印度来的商路在此折入德干南部。其前身是亚达瓦王朝的都城德瓦吉里，约1187年亚达瓦人开始在山上筑垒。1296年阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉纵兵劫掠，1308年迫使亚达瓦国王称臣。穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克将山堡改名道拉塔巴德，1327年强令德里居民南迁新都；当地干旱缺水，迁都计划失败，他1334年收回成命，也因此落得「疯王」的称号。堡垒此后归入巴赫曼尼苏丹国，1444年时是苏丹国几大重镇之一，俯瞰着马拉塔人耕作的原野。次年，巴赫曼人在堡旁建起月塔：这座63米高的塔楼仿德里顾特卜塔而建，镶着波斯蓝砖，用以纪念阿拉乌德丁·艾哈迈德沙战胜毗奢耶那伽罗。

1490年，巴赫曼尼总督马利克·艾哈迈德自立，开创艾哈迈德讷格尔的尼扎姆沙王朝，其部众1499年攻克道拉塔巴德，作为新王朝的第二都城。阿克巴的军队1600年拿下艾哈迈德讷格尔城后，出身埃塞俄比亚奴隶、后来执掌尼扎姆沙大军的马利克·安巴尔扛起抵抗的旗号：他1610年新建都城哈德基，率五万余人的雇佣军以游击战袭扰莫卧儿大军，直到1626年去世。1633年帝国军队攻克岩山，随即吞并苏丹国。1653年，时任德干总督的奥朗则布王子将哈德基改名奥兰加巴德，1681年起在此设营驻跸，支撑对马拉塔人的长期战争。1724年，莫卧儿德干总督阿萨夫·贾以奥兰加巴德为他所建海得拉巴国的第一个都城；1760年，马拉塔军队攻克了这座亚达瓦古寨。

en:
East Berar is the open black-soil plain of the upper Wainganga and Kanhan rivers, the future Nagpur country, planted with cotton and girdled to the east by dense teak forest. Its forest forts, or garh, belonged to Gond rajas; Wairagarh, the strongest of them, had first been fortified centuries before by the Mana dynasty, whose line the Gonds overthrew. Since 1347 the Bahmani sultans had run Berar as a province from Gawilgarh and Ellichpur, but their officers seldom pushed far beyond the plain, and in 1444 the eastern villages paid tribute as much to the Gond strongholds in the hills as to the governor at Ellichpur.

The plain followed the fate of Berar: the Imad Shahi sultanate founded in 1490, conquest by Ahmadnagar in 1574, cession to Akbar's Mughals in 1596. The lords of the eastern forest, the Gond house of Deogarh, kept their lands as Mughal tributaries. Abul Fazl describes the Deogarh raja keeping two thousand horse, fifty thousand foot and more than a hundred elephants; the raja Jatba waited on the emperor Jahangir in 1616. In January 1637 the Mughal general Khan-i-Dauran marched on Nagpur, and the raja Kok Shah surrendered his fort, paying one and a half lakh rupees and a hundred and seventy elephants. The kingdom came under direct Mughal rule in 1669, until one of Kok Shah's sons went to Aurangzeb's camp, accepted Islam as Bakht Buland Shah, and won the kingdom back under Mughal suzerainty; he founded the city of Nagpur in 1702. His son Chand Sultan ruled at the kingdom's height, but after Chand Sultan's death in 1739 a succession war brought in the Maratha general Raghoji I Bhonsle, and in 1743 the Gond raja became a pensioner while Nagpur became a Maratha capital.
zh:
东贝拉尔是韦恩根加河与卡南河上游开阔的黑土平原，即后来的那格浦尔一带，遍植棉花，东面环绕着茂密的柚木林。林中的堡寨（加尔）归贡德酋长所有，其中最坚固的瓦伊拉加尔最早是数百年前马纳王朝修筑的要塞，马纳王统后来被贡德人推翻。1347年起，巴赫曼尼苏丹以加维尔加尔和埃利奇布尔为中心把贝拉尔作为一行省治理，但官吏很少深入平原之外；到1444年，东部村庄向山中贡德堡寨缴纳的贡赋，不亚于交给埃利奇布尔省督的部分。

平原随贝拉尔的大势沉浮：1490年法图拉·伊马德-穆勒克建立伊马德·沙希苏丹国，1574年被艾哈迈德讷格尔征服，1596年割给阿克巴的莫卧儿。东部森林的主人代奥格尔贡德家族则作为莫卧儿附庸保住了领地。阿布勒·法兹勒记载，代奥格尔酋长养有骑兵两千、步兵五万、战象百余；酋长贾特巴还曾在1616年朝见皇帝贾汉吉尔。1637年1月，莫卧儿将领汗伊道兰进军那格浦尔，酋长科克·沙阿献堡投降，纳银十五万卢比、象一百七十头。1669年王国被莫卧儿直接统治，后来科克·沙阿的一个儿子投奔奥朗则布的大营，改奉伊斯兰教，得名巴赫特·布兰德·沙阿，在莫卧儿宗主权下恢复了故国，于1702年修建那格浦尔城。其子昌德·苏丹在位时国力最盛，但他1739年死后的继承之争引来了马拉地将领拉古吉·邦斯勒一世；1743年，贡德王沦为领取年金者，那格浦尔成了马拉塔人的都城。

en:
Bastar fills the forests of Dandakaranya, the sal-cloaked hills of the upper Indravati where Gondi and Halba villagers farm the clearings and gather lac, wax and honey. Ridges, rivers and monsoon forest shut the country off from the plains, and few outsiders entered without an army. Its rajas traced their line to Annamadeva, said to be a Kakatiya prince of Warangal who left the falling kingdom and founded a state here about 1324 under the protection of the goddess Danteshwari; the Kakatiya kinship first appears in a royal genealogy of 1703. In 1444 Bhaitai Deva ruled from the old capital at Bastar, a forest raja rich in timber whom the plains scarcely knew, his dynasty the patrons of Danteshwari's temple at Dantewada.

Purushottama Deva, who came to the throne in 1468 and ruled into the 1530s, began the Bastar Dussehra, a festival unlike the Dussehra of the plains: ten nights devoted to Danteshwari rather than Rama's victory, the goddess drawn through the town on a great wooden chariot, a girl with a wooden sword standing in a warlike posture whose leave the raja asked before he formally handed power to his diwan, and a darbar on the last day when petitioners came before him. In the fifteenth century the kingdom split and Kanker broke away to the north, while the Bastar forests kept the rajas beyond the reach of the Deccani sultanates. When Rajapala Deva died in 1721 his elder queen set her own brother on the throne; Dalapati Deva fled to Jeypore and regained the crown only in 1731, after which he moved the court from old Bastar to Jagdalpur. Maratha armies were crossing central India in those years, but the rajas kept their dynasty and Danteshwari's rites in the woods around the new capital.
zh:
巴斯塔尔占据丹达卡兰亚的林海，在因德拉瓦蒂河上游萨尔木覆盖的山丘间，贡德人和哈尔巴人在林隙地上耕作，采紫胶、取蜂蜡和蜂蜜。山岭、河道和季风雨林把此地与平原隔开，外部大军之外少有人入内。诸罗阇把世系追溯到阿南马提婆，据说他是瓦朗加尔的卡卡提耶王子，在故国倾覆时离开，约1324年在丹特什瓦里女神护佑下建国；而与卡卡提耶王室的亲缘最早只见于1703年的一份王室谱系。1444年，巴伊塔伊·提婆在旧都巴斯塔尔临朝，这位森林罗阇坐拥木材之利，平原上却少有人知他的名号，他的王朝一直供养丹特瓦达的丹特什瓦里神庙。

1468年即位、统治延续到16世纪30年代的普鲁肖塔马·提婆，开创了巴斯塔尔十胜节，一种与平原不同的节庆：十个夜晚敬拜丹特什瓦里，而非罗摩的胜利；女神乘木制大战车巡行全城，一名持木剑、作武士姿态的少女在首夜授准，罗阇须先得她许可，才正式把权力移交迪万，最后一天再升堂开设达尔巴受理请愿。15世纪，王国分裂，坎凯尔在北方自立，而巴斯塔尔的丛林使诸王始终在德干诸苏丹国的势力之外。1721年罗阇波罗·提婆去世，长后立自己的兄弟为王，达拉帕蒂·提婆出逃杰伊布尔，直到1731年才夺回王位，随后把宫廷从旧都巴斯塔尔迁往贾格达尔普尔。那些年马拉塔军队正横扫中印度，但诸王在新都周围的林地中保住了王朝和丹特什瓦里的祭典。

en:
Ellichpur, as the old city of Achalpur was called under Muslim rule, was the chief city of Berar, set beneath the Satpura passes whose keys were the hill forts of Gawilgarh and Narnala. Counted among the famous cities of the Deccan in the thirteenth century, it passed to Delhi's sultans after 1294 and to the Bahmanis in 1347. In 1425 Ahmad Shah Wali rebuilt Gawilgarh while encamped here, and Firishta records that he repaired Narnala at the same time; when Nasir Khan of Khandesh invaded in 1437, the Bahmani governor shut himself in Narnala and held out until a relieving army arrived. In 1444 Ellichpur was the seat of the Bahmani governor of Berar, a Muslim garrison town ringed by the cotton fields and villages of Maratha-speaking Hindu landholders.

In 1490 the governor Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk, once a Kanarese Hindu boy carried off in war, made himself the first Imad Shah and kept Ellichpur as his capital, fortifying Gawilgarh and Narnala and annexing Mahur. His successors leaned on Gujarat and Bijapur against a hungry Ahmadnagar. In 1572 the minister Tufal Khan imprisoned his own sultan Burhan Imad Shah in Narnala; Murtaza Nizam Shah I marched in, and in 1574 overran Berar, took the fort and put both men to death. Chand Bibi surrendered Berar to Akbar in 1596, and from 1636 Ellichpur served as the capital of the Mughal subah of Berar, with Gawilgarh as its citadel; Aurangzeb twice held the viceroyalty of the Deccan there. Maratha inroads opened the way to the Nizam, who took the province in 1724. Gawilgarh gave the old citadel its last famous fight on 15 December 1803, when Arthur Wellesley, later the Duke of Wellington, stormed it in the Second Anglo-Maratha War. Two assaults on the main gate failed before Captain Campbell's Highlanders climbed the ravine between the inner and outer forts, broke into the inner fort and opened the gates. The fortress was handed back after the peace but abandoned.
zh:
埃利奇布尔是贝拉尔的首城，即古城阿恰尔普尔在穆斯林统治时期的称呼，坐落在萨特普拉山脉诸隘口之下，扼守山口的是加维尔加尔和纳尔纳拉两座山堡。它在13世纪就被列为德干名城，1294年后臣服德里苏丹，1347年归入巴赫曼尼。1425年艾哈迈德·沙阿·瓦利在此驻营时重修加维尔加尔，菲里什塔还记载他同时修缮了纳尔纳拉；1437年坎德什的纳西尔汗来犯，巴赫曼尼的省督闭守纳尔纳拉，一直撑到援军赶到。1444年的埃利奇布尔是巴赫曼尼贝拉尔省督的驻地、一座穆斯林驻军城镇，四周是说马拉地语的印度教地主的棉田和村庄。

1490年，省督法图拉·伊马德-穆勒克自立为第一代伊马德·沙阿。他幼年本是卡纳拉印度教徒，在战争中被掳，仍以埃利奇布尔为都，加固加维尔加尔与纳尔纳拉，并吞并马胡尔。其后诸王借古吉拉特和比贾普尔之力抵挡虎视眈眈的艾哈迈德讷格尔。1572年，权臣图费勒汗把苏丹布尔汉·伊马德·沙阿囚禁在纳尔纳拉，穆尔塔扎·尼扎姆·沙阿一世随即出兵，1574年攻陷贝拉尔，拿下堡垒，将二人一并处死。1596年昌德·比比把贝拉尔献给阿克巴；1636年起埃利奇布尔成为莫卧儿贝拉尔苏巴的首府，加维尔加尔为其主堡，奥朗则布曾两度在此出任德干总督。马拉塔人的入侵为尼扎姆打开道路，后者于1724年取有此地。1803年12月15日，后来受封惠灵顿公爵的阿瑟·韦尔斯利在第二次英国—马拉地战争中强攻加维尔加尔，这是这座老要塞最后一场名战。正门的两次进攻都被打退，坎贝尔上尉麾下的苏格兰高地兵最后攀上内外堡之间的沟壑，杀入内堡，打开了层层大门。战后堡垒被归还，却遭废弃。

en:
Kalingandhra is the Telugu-speaking southern end of Kalinga, the narrow coastal corridor squeezed between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal as it runs from Odisha toward the Godavari. The Eastern Ganga kings held it until Kapilendra Deva overthrew the last Ganga ruler in 1435 and made it the southern march of his Gajapati Empire. In 1444 there was still no capital town here: Telugu cultivators and weavers worked the coastal plain and river valleys, while hill chiefs held forts for Gajapati governors answering to the Jagannath-centred court at Cuttack. Power in this country lay in hill forts and the allegiance of the lords who garrisoned them.

Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara broke Gajapati power in the early sixteenth century, and later in the century Golconda's governors made themselves masters of the Northern Circars; a century afterwards the Mughal conquest of Golconda passed the coast to the Deccan viceroys, who ruled it as the Nizams of Hyderabad. In the confusion the Pusapati chieftain Vijayaram Raju broke from Jeypore and founded his own town at Vizianagaram in 1713, its fort rising in the same years. His estate grew strong enough to court the French commander Bussy, and in 1757 a French and Vizianagaram army marched on the small rival fort of Bobbili. The Bobbili garrison, a few thousand against tens of thousands, fought until the walls were breached and the fort's women and children died in its fires; on the third night Tandra Paparayudu, a Bobbili captain who had been away, made his way into the victor's tent and stabbed Vijayaram Raju to death before he was cut down, and Telugu ballads made him the Tiger of Bobbili. Francis Forde's campaign of 1759 took the Circars from France, and in 1768 the Nizam conceded them to the East India Company. Vizianagaram resisted and was broken at Padmanabham in 1794: Vijayaram Raju II was killed, and the house became a tributary zamindari.
zh:
羯陵伽案达罗是羯陵伽的泰卢固语南缘，即东高止山与孟加拉湾之间夹出的狭长沿海走廊，自奥里萨伸向戈达瓦里河。东恒伽诸王长期据有此地，1435年卡皮伦德拉·德瓦推翻末代恒伽君主，把这里变成加贾帕蒂帝国的南境。1444年，这一带还没有首府城镇：泰卢固农耕者和织户经营着沿海平原与河谷，山地首领则替加贾帕蒂长官据守各处山寨，听命于远在克塔克、以札格纳特崇拜为中心的朝廷。这里的权柄系于一座座堡垒和守堡首领的归附。

16世纪初，毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚击破加贾帕蒂，16世纪后期戈尔康达的长官取得北西尔卡尔，一个世纪后莫卧儿对戈尔康达的征服又把海岸交给德干总督，后者以海得拉巴尼扎姆之名世袭统治。乱局之中，普萨帕蒂首领维贾亚拉姆·拉朱脱离杰伊布尔，于1713年另建维济亚讷格勒姆城，城堡也在同年动工。其土邦日渐强盛，结交法国司令比西；1757年，法国与维济亚讷格勒姆的数万联军进攻素有世仇的小堡博比利。博比利守军以数千敌数万，战至城墙失守，堡中妇孺尽殁于大火；第三夜，外出未归的博比利将领坦德拉·帕帕拉尤杜（Tandra Paparayudu）潜入胜者营帐，刺死维贾亚拉姆·拉朱，自己也被乱刀砍杀，泰卢固弹唱因此奉他为「博比利之虎」。1759年，弗朗西斯·福德的战役从法国手中夺取西尔卡尔，1768年尼扎姆将其割让给东印度公司。维济亚讷格勒姆起兵反抗，1794年在帕德马纳巴姆溃败：维贾亚拉姆·拉朱二世战死，家族降为纳贡的柴明达尔。

en:
Mahakoshal is the upper valley of the Narmada, a grain country of alluvial plains split by sandstone ridges. Its old strongholds were the fort-town of Garha that gave the Garha kingdom its name and, on a hill above nearby Jabalpur, the compact Gond fort of Madan Mahal, with its own reservoir, stables and chambers. Gond tradition remembered the dynasty's founder as Jadurai, a captain who rose in the service of the declining Kalachuri kings of Tripuri and then made himself master of Garha. In 1444 the raja Kharji was enlarging his army, and Hindu, Gondi-speaking Garha was a growing power in the forests on the eastern flank of the Muslim sultanate of Malwa.

Garha's great age came with Sangram Shah, who ruled from about 1480 and carried its arms through the Narmada valley and over the Satpura hills. His conquests were secured with fifty-two forts, and he wrote the Sanskrit Rasratnamala at a court that patronised letters; the Akbarnama reckoned his kingdom at 70,000 villages. His son Dalpat Shah married Durgavati, a Chandela Rajput princess, and from 1550 the young widow ruled as regent for their son Vir Narayan. She dug tanks and built temples around Garha, and it was said that in her years the people paid their taxes in gold; when Baz Bahadur of Malwa invaded, she routed his army. In 1564 Akbar sent Asaf Khan against her with a much stronger force. She made her stand at Narrai on 24 June, and when the battle was lost she stabbed herself rather than be taken. The Mughals carried off gold, jewels and thousands of elephants, and the kingdom went back to a collateral Gond prince, Chandra Shah, only after he ceded ten forts and accepted Mughal suzerainty. Garha shrank thereafter: the Marathas imposed tribute in 1742 and deposed the last Gond raja in 1781, and the upper Narmada passed to the East India Company in 1818.
zh:
马哈高沙尔即讷尔默达河上游河谷，是一片被砂岩丘陵割裂的冲积平原谷物之乡。旧日的重镇，一是为加哈王国得名的堡城加哈，一是附近贾巴尔普尔山头上贡德人所建的小堡马丹玛哈尔，堡内自有蓄水池、马厩和厅室。贡德人的传说把王朝始祖记作贾杜拉伊：他在特里普里卡拉楚里诸王的朝廷中当差起家，趁王权衰微取加哈而代之。1444年，国王卡尔吉正在扩充军备；信奉印度教、通行贡德语的加哈，是穆斯林摩腊婆苏丹国东侧山林里一个正在崛起的政权。

加哈的鼎盛之世随桑格拉姆沙阿而来：他约1480年继位，兵锋遍及讷尔默达河谷与萨特普拉群山。他以五十二座堡垒镇守新得的疆土，本人通晓梵文、撰有论著，宫廷也崇奉学术；《阿克巴本纪》称其国领有七万个村庄。他的儿子达尔帕特·沙阿娶了昌德拉王族的拉杰普特公主杜尔加瓦蒂；1550年丧夫后，年轻的王后为儿子维尔·纳拉扬摄政。她在加哈一带广修池塘、营建神庙，据说治下百姓以黄金纳税；摩腊婆的巴兹·巴哈杜尔来犯，也被她击溃。1564年，阿克巴遣阿萨夫汗率大军来攻，6月24日她在纳尔赖力战，兵败后自刎，不肯被俘。莫卧儿人掳走黄金、珠宝和数千头战象；直到旁支王公旃陀罗沙阿割让十座堡垒、接受莫卧儿宗主权，王国才还给他。此后加哈日渐削弱：马拉塔人1742年强征贡赋，1781年末代贡德王被废，讷尔默达河上游于1818年归入东印度公司。

en:
Mandla sits in a great loop of the Narmada, which wraps the town on three sides; down to Ramnagar, fifteen miles away, the river runs through a deep bed unbroken by rocks. The Narmada is worshipped here, and stone ghats step down to the water, while the hills behind yield tropical timber. This was forest Gond country on the eastern edge of the Garha kingdom: an inscription at Ramnagar traced the Gond line to the adventurer Jadho Rai, who married an old king's daughter and took the throne, and Mandla, Ramnagar and Garha served in turn as the dynasty's seats. In 1444 Mandla was still a forest chiefship, its river ghats drawing pilgrims to the holy Narmada.

Sangram Shah's expansion after 1480 drew this country into the heart of his kingdom, and it became the dynasty's last refuge. When Asaf Khan invaded in 1564, Rani Durgavati met him first near Singorgarh, then fell back past Garha towards Mandla and took position in a narrow defile. An arrow pierced her eye there, and the river behind her, nearly dry at dawn, suddenly rose and became unfordable, cutting off her retreat; she snatched a dagger from her mahout and killed herself on 24 June. The Mughals carried off more than a thousand elephants, and Garha never recovered. Ruling as a Mughal tributary, Hriday Shah moved his court from Chauragarh to Ramnagar, and in 1670 Mandla itself became the capital of the shrunken kingdom. The Peshwa invaded in 1742 and imposed chauth, the last Gond raja was deposed in 1781, and the town passed to the Bhonsles of Nagpur in 1799; they walled the open landward side, and Pindari raiders harried the district for eighteen years without taking Mandla. In 1818, at the end of the Third Anglo-Maratha War, a British force under General Marshall stormed the riverside fort after its Maratha garrison refused to surrender.
zh:
曼德拉地处讷尔默达河的一个大河湾中，三面环水；从这里向下游15英里外的拉姆纳加尔，河床深阔、没有礁石。讷尔默达河在此被奉为圣河，石砌的渡口石阶层层入水，镇后的丘陵出产热带木材。这里本是加哈王国东境贡德人的林海：拉姆纳加尔的一处碑文把王朝始祖溯至冒险者贾杜·拉伊，说他娶了老国王的女儿、继而登上王位，曼德拉、拉姆纳加尔和加哈都曾是这个王朝的治所。1444年，曼德拉仍是一处林间酋邦，河畔石阶吸引着前来圣河沐浴的朝圣者。

1480年后桑格拉姆沙阿的扩张把这片土地纳入王国腹心，它最终又成了王朝最后的避难所。1564年阿萨夫汗入侵，杜尔加瓦蒂先在辛戈尔加尔附近迎战，随后经加哈向曼德拉且战且退，在一道狭窄隘口列阵据守。她在那里被箭射穿眼睛，身后的河水拂晓时还几乎干涸，却突然暴涨、无法涉渡，断了退路；6月24日，她夺过象夫的匕首自尽。莫卧儿人仅战象便掳走千余头，加哈再未恢复。以莫卧儿藩臣身份在位的赫里代沙阿把王廷从乔拉加尔迁往拉姆纳加尔，1670年，曼德拉本城成为这个已被削弱的王国的都城。1742年佩什瓦来犯、强征乔特税，1781年末代贡德王被废，1799年曼德拉转归那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族；他们在无河可守的陆面一侧修筑城墙，此后18年间平达里骑兵反复蹂躏县境，却始终没能拿下曼德拉。1818年第三次英国与马拉塔战争末期，马歇尔将军所部英军在马拉塔守军拒降之后，强攻拿下这座河湾城堡。

en:
Cuttack, in Odia Kataka or 'the fort', grew up beside Barabati Fort at the head of the Mahanadi delta, its oldest quarter lying on a narrow spit of land between the Mahanadi and the Kathajodi. The Somavamshi kings built the fort in the tenth century, and a stone embankment raised soon afterwards kept the two rivers' floods off the town. In 1211 Anangabhima Deva III of the Eastern Gangas made Barabati his capital. Kapilendra Deva, who seized the throne in 1434 and founded the Suryavamsi Gajapati line, kept his court there; his long reign carried Odia arms from the lower Ganges to the Kaveri, and in 1444 Cuttack was the Hindu, Odia-speaking capital of that kingdom. River boats ran from the fort wharves to the Jagannatha shrine at Puri, weavers sold cotton and silk, and goldsmiths worked the silver filigree, tarakasi, that gave the town its name of the Silver City.

Independent rule ended in 1568, when Kalapahad, a general of the Bengal sultan Sulaiman Khan Karrani, defeated Mukunda Deva, the last Hindu king of Odisha, and occupied Cuttack; Odia tradition set down in later centuries calls Kalapahad a Brahmin convert and charges him with the destruction of the kingdom's temples. Afghan chiefs held the region after the Mughal victory at Rajmahal in 1576, until Man Singh's campaign of 1590-1593 forced them out of Cuttack in 1592, and under Shah Jahan the city became the seat of a separate Orissa Subah. The Nagpur Bhonsles obtained Odisha by treaty in 1751, and Maratha dominion was then said, in a contemporary phrase, to run from Attock to Cuttack. British forces took the city in 1803 during the Second Anglo-Maratha War, and in 1816 Cuttack became the capital of the British Orissa division. The old fort now survives only as a moat, a gate and the earthen mound of its nine-storey palace.
zh:
克塔克的奥里亚语名称为卡塔卡，意为「要塞」，城因巴拉巴蒂堡而兴，坐落于默哈讷迪河三角洲顶端，旧城在默哈讷迪河与卡塔焦迪河之间的一条狭长地带。10世纪时，索马瓦姆希（凯沙里）王朝建起这座城堡，不久后修筑的石堤为城区挡住两河洪水。1211年，东恒伽王朝的阿南加比马·德瓦三世以巴拉巴蒂为都。1434年卡皮伦德拉·德瓦夺取王位、开创苏里耶瓦姆希·伽贾帕蒂王朝，朝廷仍设在此堡；他长期在位，把奥里萨兵锋推进到北起恒河下游、南抵高韦里河。1444年，克塔克是这个印度教奥里亚语王国的都城：河船从堡下码头驶往普里的贾格纳特神庙，织工出售棉布和丝绸，金匠制作的银丝累丝工艺「塔拉卡锡」让这座城有了银城之称。

独立王朝的统治于1568年终结：孟加拉苏丹苏莱曼·汗·卡拉尼的将领卡拉帕哈德击败奥里萨末代印度教国王穆昆达·德瓦，占领克塔克。后世笔录的奥里亚传说称卡拉帕哈德本是改宗伊斯兰教的婆罗门，并把王国各地的毁庙之事归在他名下。1576年莫卧儿赢得拉杰马哈尔之战后，阿富汗首领仍盘踞此地，直到曼·辛格1590年至1593年的远征于1592年把他们逐出克塔克；沙贾汗时期，这里成为单独的奥里萨苏巴治所。1751年，那格浦尔的邦斯莱家族经条约取得奥里萨，当时有说法称马拉塔疆域「从阿塔克到克塔克」。1803年第二次英马拉塔战争期间，英军夺取该城，1816年克塔克成为英属奥里萨专区的首府。旧堡只剩护城河、一座城门和九层宫殿的土丘。

en:
Sambalpur sits on the Mahanadi where the forests of western Odisha open into the upper river valley. The country was ancient Hirakhand, the 'land of diamonds': the Roman geographer Ptolemy, writing in the second century, described a diamond-producing river town called Sambalaka that some scholars identify with Sambalpur. The town itself is named after Samalei, the goddess whose riverside shrine drew forest peoples, Garjat hill-men and river traders. In 1360 Ramai Deva, a Chauhan Rajput, overthrew the Eastern Ganga governor and founded Chauhan rule in the Patna kingdom. In 1444 Bhojaraj Deva ruled from Patna and Sambalpur was not yet a separate state; boats crossed by the shrine, weavers brought cloth to market, and in the dry season men washed diamond-bearing gravel from the riverbeds.

In 1540 the Patna kingdom was divided along the Ang River: Narasingh Deva kept Patna while his younger brother Balarama Deva took the northern Huma tract, raised forts at Nuagarh and Bargarh, and made Sambalpur his capital. His Chauhan successors ruled Hirakhand with the eighteen Garjat chieftains as vassals, and the town's weavers developed the tie-dyed cotton later sold across India as Sambalpuri cloth. In the seventeenth century Jean-Baptiste Tavernier found 8,000 people working the dry-season diamond diggings around the place he called Sumelpur. The Nagpur Bhonsles made Sambalpur tributary in 1800 and occupied it from 1808 to 1817. After the Third Anglo-Maratha War the British returned the town to Jayant Singh in 1817 but detached the Garjat vassal states; British officials administered it until 1820, when the Chauhan raja returned under British protection.
zh:
萨姆巴尔普尔（今通译森伯尔布尔）位于默哈讷迪河畔，西奥迪沙的森林在此展开为上游河谷。这一带古称希拉坎德，意为「钻石之地」：公元2世纪的罗马地理学家托勒密记述过一座出产钻石的河畔城镇桑巴拉卡，一些学者把它考定为萨姆巴尔普尔。城名来自萨玛莱女神，河边的女神祠吸引着森林族群、迦贾德山民和河上商人。1360年，乔汉族拉杰普特人拉迈·德瓦推翻东恒伽王朝的地方长官，建立巴特那王国的乔汉统治。1444年，波杰拉杰·德瓦在巴特那执政，萨姆巴尔普尔尚未成为独立邦国；人们在祠旁渡河，织工到市集出售布匹，旱季时则到河滩淘洗含钻的砂砾。

1540年，巴特那王国沿昂河分裂：纳拉辛哈·德瓦保留巴特那，其弟巴拉罗摩·德瓦取得北方的胡马地区，在努阿加尔和巴尔加尔筑堡，随后定都萨姆巴尔普尔。他的乔汉后裔统领希拉坎德，十八家迦贾德首领称臣，城中织工发展出扎染棉布，即后来行销印度各地的萨姆巴尔普里织物。17世纪，让-巴蒂斯特·塔韦尼耶在他笔下的苏梅尔普尔见到八千人在旱季采掘钻石。1800年，那格浦尔的邦斯莱家族迫使萨姆巴尔普尔称臣，并于1808年至1817年实际占领。第三次英马拉塔战争后，英国在1817年把城池交还贾扬特·辛格，却剥离了迦贾德附庸诸邦；此后由英国官员管理，直到1820年乔汉王公在英国保护下复位。

en:
Jumla lies high in the Karnali basin, whose Sinja valley was the seat of the Khasa Malla kings of the 11th to 13th centuries; the Khas speech of Sinja is the parent tongue of Nepali. Khasa kings carried their inscriptions far into the plains: Ashok Challa set his name at Bodh Gaya, and in 1312 Ripu Malla cut his onto the Ashokan pillar at Lumbini. When the Khasa realm broke apart, its lands split into the Baisi Rajya, the 'twenty-two kingdoms' of the Karnali and Bheri hills, and Jumla grew into the strongest of them. Around 1404 Baliraja of the Kalyal line married the daughter and heiress of the last Malla raja of the Yatse kingdom and succeeded to his lands. His line kept the Chandannath temple in the town, where a sage of that name from Kashmir is said to have installed an image of Dattatreya and to have first sown the hardy brown rice of the high valleys. In 1444 the aged Baliraja still ruled from Jumla, first among the fractious twenty-two.

His successors waged hill war for three centuries, and under Bhanashahi, who reigned from about 1529, Jumla was the dominant power of western Nepal. In 1760 its forces crossed the high passes and seized the trans-Himalayan kingdom of Mustang. Jumla beat off the first Gorkha attack, and legend says Prithvi Narayan Shah himself was wounded in the fighting; but in 1789 the regent Bahadur Shah sent Kaji Shiva Narayan Khatri at the head of the combined hill-state levies and annexed the kingdom. In Jumla's great days its sway had run from Mustang to the Kumaon border, and in 1816 the lands west of the Mahakali passed to the East India Company.
zh:
久姆拉雄踞格尔纳利盆地高处，境内的辛贾河谷是11至13世纪卡萨·末罗诸王的都城所在；辛贾的卡萨语正是尼泊尔语的母语。卡萨国王的铭文远布平原：阿索格·察拉曾在菩提伽耶留下铭文，1312年里普·末罗又把字迹刻上蓝毗尼的阿育王石柱。卡萨王国瓦解后，故土分裂为格尔纳利河与贝里河山区的「二十二王国」，即拜西拉贾，久姆拉逐渐成为其中最强的一个。约1404年，迦利耶尔世系的巴利拉贾娶了雅特瑟（末罗）王国末代罗阇的女儿兼继承人，接管了其国土。其家族供奉镇上的旃檀那特庙：相传一位同名的克什米尔圣人把达塔特雷亚神像安置于此，还最早带来了高山谷地种植的耐寒褐稻。1444年，年迈的巴利拉贾仍在久姆拉执政，是纷争不断的二十二邦之长。

此后三个世纪里，后继诸王征战于群山之间；约1529年即位的巴那沙希治下，久姆拉称霸尼泊尔西部。1760年，其军队翻越高山口，夺取了喜马拉雅山以北的穆斯塘王国。久姆拉击退了廓尔喀人的第一次进攻，传说普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿本人都在战斗中负伤；但1789年，摄政巴哈杜尔·沙阿遣卡吉·湿婆·纳拉扬·卡特里率各山邦联军攻来，吞并了这个王国。久姆拉强盛时势力东起穆斯塘、西抵库毛恩边界，1816年，马哈卡利河以西的土地转归东印度公司。

en:
Jaunpur sits on a bend of the Gomti in the eastern Ganges plain. Firuz Shah Tughlaq founded the town in 1359 and named it for his cousin Jauna Khan, the future Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq. As the Delhi Sultanate broke up after Timur's sack, the eunuch governor Malik Sarwar, titled Malik us-Sharq, made himself independent in 1394 and founded the Sharqi dynasty. His successors built Jaunpur into a capital of Islamic learning: Ibrahim Shah (1402–1440) opened colleges and patronised treatises on theology and law, raised mosques in a new Sharqi style, ruled from Kanauj to Bihar, and once marched on Delhi; writers called the city Shiraz-e-Hind, the Shiraz of India. In 1444 Mahmud Shah Sharqi sits on the throne, and Jaunpur counts among the strongest Muslim powers of the Ganges plain, facing the Sayyid rulers of a weakened Delhi.

The Sharqis spent their strength against the Lodis. Mahmud Shah besieged Delhi in 1452 and was routed by Bahlul Lodi. Husain Shah led to the Yamuna what was said to be the largest army in India in 1478, and came back twice in 1479; Bahlul defeated him every time, and in 1486 placed his own son Barbak Shah on Jaunpur's throne. Husain fled to Kahalgaon in Bihar, where the sultan of Bengal gave him land, and died there in 1505. Sikandar Lodi demolished most of the dynasty's palaces and the Jhanjri mosque, but the Atala, Lal Darwaza and Jama mosques survived. The Jama Masjid, founded by Ibrahim Shah in 1438 and completed by Husain in 1473, is one of the largest mosques in India, its stonework joining Muslim forms to Hindu brackets and lotus motifs. In Husain's years the Jaunpur-born sayyid Muhammad Jaunpuri, whom the sultan admired, taught the doctrines that took him to Mecca, where he proclaimed himself the Mahdi at the Kaaba in 1496. Under Akbar the governor Munim Khan built the stone Shahi Bridge over the Gomti, completed in 1564.
zh:
章普尔位于恒河平原东部，坐落在戈马蒂河的一处河湾。1359年，菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克在此建城，以表兄焦纳汗（即后来的苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克）的名字命名。帖木儿洗劫德里后，德里苏丹国土崩瓦解，受封「马利克·乌什·沙尔格」号的宦官总督马利克·萨尔瓦尔于1394年自立，开创沙尔吉王朝。后继诸君把章普尔经营成伊斯兰学术之都：易卜拉欣沙（1402—1440年在位）开设经学院，扶持神学与法学著述，以新兴的沙尔吉风格修建清真寺，疆域西起卡瑙季、东抵比哈尔，还曾一度进军德里；文人称这座城为「印度的设拉子」。1444年在位的是马哈茂德沙·沙尔吉，章普尔是恒河平原上最强盛的穆斯林政权之一，与赛义德王朝治下衰微的德里东西相望。

沙尔吉王朝的国力耗尽在对洛迪人的战争中。1452年马哈茂德沙围攻德里，被巴赫卢勒·洛迪击溃。胡赛因沙于1478年率号称印度最庞大的军队进抵亚穆纳河，1479年又两度来攻，每一次都被巴赫卢勒击败；1486年，巴赫卢勒把自己的儿子巴尔巴克沙扶上章普尔王位。胡赛因逃到比哈尔的卡哈尔冈，孟加拉苏丹赐他封地，1505年死于当地。西坎达尔·洛迪拆毁了沙尔吉王朝的大部分宫殿和詹吉里清真寺，阿塔拉清真寺、拉尔门清真寺和聚礼清真寺则留存下来。聚礼清真寺1438年由易卜拉欣沙奠基、1473年由胡赛因完工，是印度规模最大的清真寺之一，石雕把伊斯兰形制与印度教式托架、莲花纹样合在一起。胡赛因在位时，章普尔出生的赛义德·穆罕默德·贾恩普里在城中传道，深受苏丹推崇；他后来前往麦加，1496年在天房前自称马赫迪。阿克巴时期，省督穆尼姆汗主持在戈马蒂河上修建石砌皇家桥，1564年完工。

en:
The Lower Doab is the bottom of the wedge between the Ganges and the Yamuna, and its whole history gathers at Prayag, where the two rivers meet in the Triveni Sangam; tradition adds a third river, the unseen Sarasvati, and no confluence in India draws more pilgrims to bathe. In the seventh century the Chinese monk Xuanzang watched kings give away their wealth at the great alms-ground beside the water. The old city later slipped into the shifting sands, and the tract was run through the middle ages from the river-fortresses of Kara and Manikpur above the confluence, which the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur held with the rest of the lower Ganges. In 1444 Prayag is first of all a pilgrimage ground, its winter Magh fair drawing crowds of bathers under the sultan's officers, while grain and cloth move through the quays between Bengal, Delhi and the Deccan.

The fortress that commands the rivers is Akbar's. He came to the confluence in 1583, laid out the town of Ilahabas, soon called Allahabad, and built the largest of his forts around the Akshayavata, the undying banyan tree that pilgrims had worshipped there for centuries. The fort became at once a seat of imperial government and a place for the imperial family's quarrels: in 1602 the rebel Prince Salim had the khutba read and coin struck there in his own name, and in 1659 its commandant handed it to Aurangzeb's officers during the war against Shah Shuja. After Buxar the Treaty of Allahabad was signed inside the fort in 1765, when Clive, Shuja-ud-Daulah and the emperor Shah Alam II settled the revenues of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa on the East India Company; Shah Alam went on living in the fort under a British guard until he slipped away to Delhi. The Nawabs of Awadh ceded the fort in 1798 and the whole Lower Doab in 1801, and Allahabad became the Company's chief stronghold on the middle Ganges.
zh:
下河间地是恒河与亚穆纳河之间楔形地带的下段，整部地方史都汇于普拉亚格：两河在此相汇，称特里韦尼桑加姆，传说还汇入第三条无形的萨拉斯瓦蒂河，印度没有哪处河口圣地比它更吸引沐浴的香客。7世纪时，中国僧人玄奘在此目睹君王在河边大施场倾财布施。后来河道改徙，旧城没入流沙；整个中古时期，这一带由汇流口上游卡拉与曼尼克布尔两座临河要塞管辖，章普尔的沙尔基苏丹把它们连同恒河下游一并据有。1444年的普拉亚格首先是一处朝圣之地，冬季的摩伽庙会把成群沐浴者引来河口，一切都在苏丹官吏眼目之下，码头上谷物与布匹往来于孟加拉、德里与德干之间。

扼住两河的城堡是阿克巴所建。1583年他亲临汇流口，规划伊拉哈巴斯城，不久改称安拉阿巴德，又筑起他所有城堡中最大的一座，把香客膜拜千百年的「不死榕树」阿克夏瓦塔圈在堡内。这座堡既是朝廷在东方的治所，也装着皇室的家务之争：1602年，反叛的萨利姆王子在此以自己的名义诵读呼图白、铸造钱币；1659年对沙舒贾的战争中，守将把城堡献给奥朗则布的将领。布克萨尔战役后，克莱武、舒贾—乌德—道拉与皇帝沙阿拉姆二世1765年在堡内签订《安拉阿巴德条约》，把孟加拉、比哈尔和奥里萨的财税权交予东印度公司；沙阿拉姆继续在英军看守下住在堡中，后来寻机脱身前往德里。阿瓦德纳瓦卜1798年交出城堡，1801年又割让整个下河间地，安拉阿巴德成为东印度公司在恒河中游的首要要塞。

en:
The Kathmandu valley is a high green basin between the Himalaya and the middle hills, and its road has always run north to Tibet: Newar caravans carried cloth and metalware over the passes and brought back musk, herbs and incense, and Nepali coin became the standard currency of trans-Himalayan trade. The valley towns grew rich on that road, Kathmandu above all; its name comes from the Kasthamandap, a three-storey timber pavilion put up without a single iron nail, said by local tradition to have been built from the wood of one tree. Licchavi kings ruled from the fourth century, and the Hindu shrines of Pashupatinath and the Buddhist stupa of Swayambhunath drew pilgrims from both sides of the mountains. An earthquake in 1255 killed about a third of the valley, and a raid from Bengal in 1345 and 1346 sacked its shrines, but Jayasthiti Malla reunited the valley at the end of the fourteenth century. In 1444 his grandson Yaksha Malla rules the united Nepal Mandala, a Hindu king over Buddhist and Hindu Newars, while the merchants of Kantipur grow rich on the Tibet road.

When Yaksha Malla died in 1482 his kingdom split into Kantipur, Patan and Bhaktapur, and the three rival courts spent three centuries trying to outbuild one another; the pagodas and durbar squares of the three cities, including Bhaktapur's five-storey Nyatapola temple, come from this contest. Pratap Malla of Kantipur, reigning from 1641 to 1674, monopolised the Tibet trade, wrote Newar poetry, filled Kathmandu's Durbar Square with temples and received Jesuit priests in 1670. The rivalry left the valley open to Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha, who took Kirtipur in 1767 and entered Kathmandu on the night of the Indra Jatra festival in September 1768 almost without a fight. Bhaktapur fell the next year, and the Gorkha kings made the city the capital of a unified Nepal. Their armies then fought the Qing in Tibet from 1788 to 1792 and the East India Company from 1814 to 1816, the second war ending in the Treaty of Sugauli, which fixed the Himalayan frontier.
zh:
加德满都谷地是喜马拉雅山脉与中部丘陵之间一个苍翠的高山盆地，谷中的商路历来向北通往西藏：尼瓦尔商队驮着布匹和金属器皿翻山而去，带回麝香、药材和熏香，尼泊尔铸币成为跨喜马拉雅贸易的通用货币。谷中城镇靠这条路致富，尤以加德满都为最；城名来自「独木庙」，这座三层木亭不用一根铁钉，相传整座建筑取自一棵树的木材。4世纪起李查维诸王统治谷地，印度教的帕苏帕提那特神庙与佛教的斯瓦扬布纳特佛塔吸引着山脉两侧的香客。1255年大地震夺去谷地约三分之一人口，1345至1346年孟加拉军队入寇、劫掠神庙，14世纪末贾亚斯提·马拉重新统一谷地。1444年，其孙亚克沙·马拉统治着统一的尼泊尔曼陀罗，作为印度教君王君临兼奉佛、印两教的尼瓦尔人，坎蒂普尔的商人靠西藏商路致富。

1482年亚克沙·马拉死后，王国分裂为坎蒂普尔、帕坦、巴克塔普尔三国，三个互相争胜的宫廷此后三百年竞相筑造：三座城市的塔式神庙与王宫广场，包括巴克塔普尔五层的尼亚塔波拉神庙，都出自这场竞赛。坎蒂普尔的普拉塔普·马拉1641至1674年在位，垄断对藏贸易，以尼瓦尔语作诗，在加德满都王宫广场广建神庙，1670年还接见了耶稣会士。列国相争使谷地暴露在廓尔喀的普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿面前：他1767年攻下基尔蒂普尔，1768年9月因陀罗节之夜几乎兵不血刃进入加德满都，次年巴克塔普尔陷落，廓尔喀诸王以此城为统一后尼泊尔的首都。此后尼泊尔军队1788至1792年在西藏与清朝交战，1814至1816年又与东印度公司开战，后一场战争以《苏高利条约》告终，划定了喜马拉雅山麓的边界。

en:
Pataliputra, whose site is occupied by Patna, lies on a broad reach of the Ganges where the Son and Gandak draw close. The kings of Magadha fortified the place around 490 BCE, and it became the imperial capital of the Mauryas and later the Guptas. Megasthenes described its long timber walls and enormous ground plan, and the astronomer Aryabhata worked in the city. After the Gupta collapse it shrank, and the raids of Bakhtiyar Khalji around 1200 destroyed the great Buddhist monasteries of Bihar. The region then passed to the Delhi sultans and, in the fifteenth century, to the Sharqi rulers of Jaunpur. In 1444 Mahmud Shah Sharqi held Bihar from Jaunpur, while Patna shipped rice and paper along the Ganges but had long ceased to be an imperial capital.

Sher Shah Suri brought the old site back into dynastic wars. His Sur family held land around Sasaram, and by 1530 Sher Shah was the effective master of Bihar. On 26 June 1539, at Chausa west of Buxar, he and his Rajput allies routed the Mughal army of Humayun. After taking Delhi, Sher Shah rebuilt Pataliputra as Patna and raised a fort and congregational mosque on the river. Akbar marched here in person in 1574 to defeat the Afghan chief Daud Khan Karrani, and Abul Fazl later listed Patna's paper, glass and long-grained rice among its products. The English opened a factory in 1620, and saltpetre became its most profitable cargo; Peter Mundy called it the greatest mart of the eastern regions in 1632.

The tenth Sikh Guru, Gobind Singh, was born in Patna in 1666, which made the city a Sikh place of pilgrimage. In 1704 Aurangzeb let his grandson Prince Azim rename the town Azimabad, although the older name remained in use. In 1763 Nawab Mir Qasim had his English prisoners killed at Patna; his defeat at Buxar the next year transferred Bihar's revenues to the East India Company, which took direct charge in 1793.
zh:
巴连弗邑的旧址即今巴特那，位于恒河宽阔河段，宋河与甘达克河在附近相靠。约公元前490年，摩揭陀国王在此筑塞，此后它成为孔雀帝国和后来笈多帝国的都城。麦加斯梯尼记述过它绵长的木栅城墙和巨大城区，天文学家阿耶波多也曾在此治学。笈多衰落后城市萎缩，1200年前后巴赫蒂亚尔·卡尔吉的侵袭摧毁了比哈尔的大型佛教寺院。这一地区先归德里苏丹，15世纪时转入章普尔的沙尔基王朝。1444年，马哈茂德·沙·沙尔基从章普尔统治比哈尔；巴特那沿恒河运输稻米和纸张，但早已不是帝国都城。

舍尔沙让旧址重新卷入王朝战争。他出身的苏尔家族在萨萨拉姆一带领有土地，到1530年，舍尔沙已是比哈尔的实际主宰。1539年6月26日，他在布克萨尔以西的恰乌萨，同拉杰普特盟友一起击溃胡马雍的莫卧儿军队。夺取德里后，舍尔沙把巴连弗邑重建为巴特那，并在河边筑起城堡和聚礼清真寺。1574年，阿克巴亲征至此，击败阿富汗首领达乌德·汗·卡拉尼；阿布勒·法兹勒后来把纸张、玻璃和长粒稻米列为巴特那物产。英国人1620年在此开设商馆，硝石成为利润最高的货物；1632年，彼得·蒙迪称它为东方最大的商埠。

锡克教第十代祖师戈宾德·辛格1666年生于巴特那，这座城市也因此成为锡克教圣地。1704年，奥朗则布允许皇孙阿齐姆把城改名为阿济姆阿巴德，但旧名仍被使用。1763年，纳瓦卜米尔·卡西姆在巴特那处死被囚的英国人；次年他在布克萨尔战败，比哈尔的税收权转入东印度公司，公司又于1793年直接接管。

en:
Jhansi lies between the Pahuj and the Betwa at the southern edge of the Gangetic plain, where the land rises into the wooded hills of Bundelkhand; its name means 'thicket-covered'. Rajput Khangars ruled these parts from Garh Kundar before the Bundela clans overshadowed them. In 1444 there was no town here, only jungle and grazing grounds on the slopes of Bangra hill, land belonging to the small Muslim kingdom of Kalpi down on the Yamuna. That kingdom had just come through a Jaunpur invasion, met by Mahmud Khalji of Malwa marching to its defence, and the peace of that year left this border country a client of Malwa.

The town grew up around its fort. Two Ahir herders had supposedly put up huts at the foot of Bangra hill before the Orchha raja Bir Singh Deo built Jhansi Fort there in 1613, and the settlement below the walls was first called Balwantnagar. Bir Singh was the Bundela chief who in 1602 waylaid and killed Akbar's historian and minister Abul Fazl on his road back from the Deccan, at the bidding of Prince Salim, the future Jahangir. After Bir Singh's son Jhujhar Singh rebelled and perished, the place passed to the Mughals. Chhatrasal of Bundelkhand seized it, lost it to Muhammad Khan Bangash, won it back with Maratha help, and on his death in 1731 left Jhansi to the Peshwa Baji Rao. The Maratha governor Naru Shankar enlarged the fort and settled the town with families moved from Orchha. Shuja-ud-Daula of Awadh stormed it in February 1762 after a siege, and Malhar Rao Holkar restored Maratha rule four years later. Under the Newalkars Jhansi became the capital of a Maratha state: their men beat a Mughal army outside its walls, the city ramparts went up, and in 1817 the Newalkars accepted British paramountcy.
zh:
占西地处帕胡杰河与贝德瓦河之间、恒河平原南缘，地势从这里抬升为本德尔肯德林木覆盖的丘陵；「占西」一名的意思是「灌木丛生之地」。拉杰普特人的坎加尔族早先以加尔昆达尔堡为据点统治这一带，后来才被本德拉诸部盖过。1444年这里还没有城镇，班格拉山坡上只有丛林和牧场，土地属于亚穆纳河下游的穆斯林小邦迦尔毗王国。迦尔毗刚顶住江布尔的入侵，马尔瓦的马哈茂德·哈尔吉曾出兵相救，同年的和议使这片边地沦为马尔瓦的附庸。

城镇是随堡垒兴起的。据说在堡垒动工之前，已有两名阿希尔牧人在班格拉山脚搭起牧棚；1613年，奥尔查罗阇比尔·辛格·德奥在山上修筑占西堡，堡墙下最早形成的聚落叫巴尔万特纳格尔。比尔·辛格是本德拉首领，1602年他奉萨利姆王子（后来的贾汉吉尔）之命，在阿布·法兹尔从德干返回的路上伏击并杀死了这位阿克巴的史官兼大臣。比尔·辛格之子朱杰哈尔·辛格反叛败亡后，此地归于莫卧儿。本德尔肯德的查特拉萨尔夺取过占西，一度失给穆罕默德·汗·班加什，又借马拉塔之力收复，1731年去世时把占西留给佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥。马拉塔总督纳鲁·尚卡尔扩建堡垒，把从奥尔查迁来的家庭安置在镇上。阿瓦德的舒贾-乌德-道拉围城后于1762年2月强攻得手，四年后马尔哈尔·拉奥·霍尔卡恢复了马拉塔的统治。纽瓦尔卡家族治下，占西成为一个马拉塔政权的都城：他们的军队在城外击败一支莫卧儿军队，筑起城墙，1817年纽瓦尔卡人接受英国的最高统治权。

en:
The Koel and the Son cut through the forested north-western corner of the Jharkhand plateau, ridges of sal broken by a few open valleys, one of them guarded by an old fort on the Auranga River. The jungles yielded elephants, timber and iron, and the plains of Bihar to the north lay within easy raiding distance. Through the twelfth and thirteenth centuries Chero chieftains, driven south out of Bhojpur and Saran by the Ujjainiya Rajputs, made their home in these woods, but by 1444 the country belonged to the Raksel Rajputs, who held the riverside fort and answered to neither the sultans of Jaunpur nor those of Bengal.

The Cheros came back from within. Around the turn of the seventeenth century Bhagwant Rai, a Chero in service of the Raksel raja Man Singh, seized power while his master was away; Man Singh never returned, retreating into Surguja, where his line founded Surguja State. Earlier the Chero raider Maharata had defied Sher Shah Suri over a white elephant, and Sher Shah's commander Khawas Khan had to besiege him into surrendering it. Akbar's general Man Singh brought the country under Mughal administration in 1590 and carried off fifty-four elephants, but the Cheros expelled its garrison as soon as Akbar died.

The strongest Chero ruler was Medini Ray. He rebuilt the old Raksel fort and raised the new lower fort near Satbarwa from the spoils of his southern wars, when his armies sacked the Nagvanshi capital of Navratangarh; local memory also made him a generous raja, granting land to the poor. The jungle could not keep every army out. Shaista Khan's Mughal column needed six months to thread its way to the forts before the Cheros submitted, and in 1660 Daud Khan marched from Patna and stormed both strongholds after the raja rejected his terms, tribute and the conversion of every Hindu in the land, and destroyed the temples. In 1771 Captain Camac's sepoys took the hill fort and trained its cannon on the old one, which held out into the next year; a Chero rising in 1800 failed, and in 1814 the bankrupt estate of the last raja, Churaman Rai, was confiscated.
zh:
科埃尔河与松河切过贾坎德高原西北缘的丛林山地，娑罗双林覆盖的山脊间只豁开少数谷地，奥朗加河畔的旧堡便扼守着其中之一。林中出产大象、木材和铁矿，北面的比哈尔平原更是方便的劫掠之地。12至13世纪，被乌贾因尼亚拉杰普特人从博杰普尔、萨兰逐到南方的切罗首领们在这片山林立足，但到1444年，据有河堡的是拉克塞尔拉杰普特人，江布尔和孟加拉的苏丹都号令不到他们。

切罗人从内部卷土重来。17世纪初前后，在拉克塞尔首领曼·辛格麾下效力的切罗人巴格万特·拉伊趁主人外出夺取政权；曼·辛格再未回来，退入苏尔古贾，其后人在那里建立了苏尔古贾邦。更早时，切罗首领默赫尔达还为一头白象与舍尔沙·苏利反目，舍尔沙的大将哈瓦斯汗围攻之后才逼他交出大象。1590年，阿克巴的大将曼·辛格把这里纳入莫卧儿管辖，掳走五十四头大象，但阿克巴刚死，切罗人就赶走了帝国驻军。

王朝最强者是梅迪尼·拉伊。他重修拉克塞尔旧堡，又用南征的战利品在萨特巴瓦附近建起下方的新堡；他的军队曾洗劫那格万什人的都城纳夫拉坦加尔，民间也记得他是把土地分给穷人的宽厚罗阇。丛林挡不住每一支军队：沙伊斯塔汗的莫卧儿纵队花了六个月才穿林抵达堡前，切罗人被迫投降；1660年，达乌德汗从巴特那进军，在罗阇拒绝纳贡和让全境印度教徒改宗的条件后攻陷两座堡垒，捣毁神庙。1771年，卡马克上尉的土兵夺取山上的新堡，调转炮口轰击旧堡，旧堡一直守到次年；1800年的切罗起义归于失败，1814年末代罗阇朱拉曼·拉伊债台高筑，领地被没收。

en:
In the western Bengal delta the Bhagirathi becomes the Hooghly as it bends south toward the sea, and ocean-going ships went no farther upstream than the deep water off Bator, a market town on the west bank beside Shibpur in Howrah, with Salkia at its side. Across the water lay the villages of Kalikata, Sutanuti and Gobindapur and the small Kali sanctuary at Kalighat. The countryside belonged to Bhurshut, a Hindu realm whose rajas held the west bank. In 1444 these river marts were part of the Bengal Sultanate of Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah, of the restored Ilyas Shahi line. Bengali Hindu merchants, boatmen and weavers lived under a Muslim court whose revenues moved up and down the Hooghly as rice, silk, cotton cloth and salt.

Bipradas Pipilai's Bengali poem of 1495 shows Bator as a large market where travellers bought provisions and worshipped the goddess Chandi; Kalikata was then only a village passed on the way, and Sutanuti and Gobindapur did not yet exist. In the 1570s Cesare Federici watched great ships anchor off 'Buttor' because the river shallowed upstream. After Akbar's armies defeated Daud Khan Karrani in 1576, Bhurshut entered the Mughal revenue system as a wealthy pargana while its Hindu rajas kept much of their power. In 1690 Job Charnock's East India Company settled at the three east-bank villages, and from 1696 the first Fort William rose to guard the factory. Siraj-ud-Daulah's army took the fort on 20 June 1756 after the governor escaped by boat, and the town was renamed Alinagar; the prisoners left behind were held in a dungeon called the Black Hole of Calcutta, where the Company official John Holwell said 123 of 146 captives died in one night, a toll later disputed. Robert Clive and Charles Watson retook the town on 2 January 1757, and victory at Plassey that June opened Bengal to the Company. Mir Qasim ceded Howrah in 1760, and in 1772 Calcutta became the capital of the Company's Indian territories.
zh:
在孟加拉三角洲西部，帕吉勒提河南折入海后称胡格利河。海船沿河上驶，最远只能到贝托尔附近的深水区。贝托尔是西岸豪拉希布布尔一带的大市镇，旁边就是萨尔基亚；对岸散布着卡利卡塔、苏塔努蒂和戈宾德普尔等村，还有迦梨戈特的小型迦梨女神祠。这一带乡野属于印度教政权布尔舒特，其罗阇据有西岸。1444年，这些河口市集归纳西尔丁·马哈茂德沙赫复辟的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝孟加拉苏丹国；孟加拉印度教商人、船工和织工生活在穆斯林朝廷治下，稻米、丝绸、棉布和食盐沿胡格利河上下转运，构成朝廷的岁入。

诗人比普拉萨德·皮皮莱1495年写下的孟加拉语长诗提到，贝托尔已是一座大市集，旅人在此补给，并祭拜昌迪女神；那时卡利卡塔只是途经的一座小村，苏塔努蒂和戈宾德普尔还未出现。1570年代，切萨雷·费代里西看到大船在「布托尔」停泊，因为再往上游河水变浅。1576年阿克巴的军队击败达乌德汗·卡拉尼后，布尔舒特作为富庶的帕尔加纳纳入莫卧儿税收体系，本地印度教罗阇仍保有很大权力。1690年，约伯·查诺克代表东印度公司在东岸三村落脚，1696年起第一座威廉堡动工，守卫商馆。1756年6月20日，总督乘船逃走，西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉的军队攻下堡垒，城镇改名阿里讷格尔；未及撤走的俘虏被关进一间土牢，即后来所称的「加尔各答黑洞」，公司官员约翰·霍尔韦尔称146名囚犯中有123人一夜死去，这个死亡数字后来一直有争议。1757年1月2日，罗伯特·克莱夫与查尔斯·沃森收复该镇，同年6月普拉西获胜，孟加拉向公司敞开。1760年米尔·卡西姆割让豪拉，1772年加尔各答成为东印度公司印度领地的首府。

en:
Koch is the monsoon-watered North Bengal plain of western Kamata, between the Karatoya and the Torsa, with Kamatapur, later called Gosanimari, as its capital. A Kamata kingdom had formed when the kings of Kamarupa moved their court west in the thirteenth century. In 1440 Niladhwaj founded the Khen line, and in 1444 he ruled from Kamatapur over the Koch villages of the plain. Its kings honoured Kamateshwari, their guardian goddess. Their realm lay between Gaur to the south, the Baro-Bhuyan chiefs to the east, and the Himalayan passes where Bhutanese traders and raiders came and went.

In 1498 Alauddin Husain Shah of Gaur sacked Kamatapur; Nilambar died that year, Khen rule ended, and within a few years the Baro-Bhuyans killed the Bengal governor Danyal and took the country. In 1515 the Koch leader Bisu defeated the Bhuyans, taking their hardest fort only by a trick during the Bihu festival, and was crowned at Kamatapur as the Hindu king Biswa Singha, with Brahmins supplying him a new pedigree as a son of Shiva. Under his son Nara Narayan, with the king's brother Chilarai as commander, the kingdom reached its height; Chilarai moved his troops as fast as a kite, the bird from which he took his name. The saint Sankardev preached his Ekasarana faith under the court's protection and died in Koch Bihar in 1568. After Nara Narayan's death in 1586 the country split into Koch Bihar and Koch Hajo. The western court accepted Mughal suzerainty, fought its way in and out of Bengal's wars, and in 1772 drove out a Bhutanese garrison with British help; the treaty of 1774 left Koch Bihar a tributary state.
zh:
科奇是季风雨浇灌的北孟加拉平原，地处旧卡马塔之西、加拉托亚河与托尔萨河之间，都城在卡马塔布尔，后来又称戈萨尼马里。13世纪迦摩缕波的王廷西迁后，卡马塔王国在此成形。1440年，尼拉德瓦杰建立肯王朝；1444年，他在卡马塔布尔统治平原上的科奇村落。诸王供奉守护女神迦摩特什瓦里。王国南接高尔，东临巴罗-布安诸酋长，北方则对着不丹商队和袭掠者出入的喜马拉雅山口。

1498年，高尔的阿拉丁·侯赛因·沙阿洗劫卡马塔布尔，尼兰巴尔同年死去，肯王朝告终；不出几年，巴罗-布安人便杀掉孟加拉派来的达尼亚尔，接管此地。1515年，科奇首领比苏击败布安人，他靠在比呼节上施计才拿下对方最坚固的堡垒，随后在卡马塔布尔以印度教国王身份加冕，称比什瓦·辛哈；婆罗门又为他编出新世系，称他是湿婆之子。其子那拉纳拉扬在位、王弟奇拉莱统军时，王国达到极盛，奇拉莱行军迅如鸢鸟，名字便得自这种飞鸟。圣徒巽格尔代沃在朝廷庇护下传播一神虔信教义，1568年终老于库奇比哈尔。1586年那拉纳拉扬死后，王国分裂为库奇比哈尔和科奇哈乔。西支接受莫卧儿宗主权，在孟加拉的战事中时战时和，1772年靠英国援兵赶走不丹驻军；1774年的条约把库奇比哈尔定为纳贡土邦。

en:
The province takes its name from Gaur, also called Lakhnauti, the old Ganges city, but in 1444 the Bengal Sultanate's court lay nearby at Pandua. Since Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah united Bengal in 1352, this walled capital had drawn soldiers, Sufis, Persian-speaking officials and travelling merchants, and its many holy men earned it the name Hazrat Pandua. After beating off an invasion from Delhi, Sikandar Shah raised the Adina Mosque on the model of the Great Mosque of Damascus, and none in the subcontinent was larger. Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah, the sultan born a Hindu raja's son, was buried under the terracotta Eklakhi Mausoleum. Ma Huan, interpreter of Zheng He's Ming treasure fleets, saw its bazaars stocked with six kinds of fine muslin and silk and mulberry-bark paper thin as white cotton cloth. Under the restored sultan Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah, Pandua remained a Muslim royal centre in a Bengali Hindu countryside, while older Gaur stood beside the shifting Ganges.

Mahmud Shah moved the court south to Gaur in 1450, and for more than a century the sultans ruled Bengal from it. A moat on three sides joined the royal citadel to the Ganges, and nine guarded gates ran from the Dakhil Darwaza to the durbar; the palace quarters were faced with coloured glazed tiles, and Chinese porcelain has been dug up in the grounds. Portuguese visitors compared the city's wealth with Lisbon, and in 1521 one of them watched Sultan Nusrat Shah at polo below the citadel. A Vaishnava poet records Alauddin Husain Shah watching the saint Chaitanya's devotional procession on the far bank and ordering it left unmolested. Humayun occupied Gaur in 1538 and renamed it Jannatabad, but Sher Shah Suri's Afghans retook and sacked it within the year. Sultan Sulaiman Karrani moved his capital to Tanda in 1565; Mughal troops under Munim Khan took Gaur in 1575, and the Battle of Rajmahal the next year ended the sultanate. Plague and the Ganges shifting into the Padma channel emptied the site, and the Venetian Cesare Federici found seagoing ships could no longer reach its old river port. Under Shah Shuja the two-storey Tahakhana, a cooled lodge and Sufi hostel, rose amid ruins the jungle was already overgrowing.
zh:
本省因恒河河畔古城高尔得名，高尔又称拉赫纳乌蒂；但1444年时，孟加拉苏丹国的王庭设在不远的潘杜亚。自沙姆苏丁·伊利亚斯沙1352年统一孟加拉以来，这座有城墙的都城聚集了士兵、苏菲行者、说波斯语的官员和往来商人，因圣者众多而有「圣城潘杜亚」之名。击退德里入侵之后，西坎达尔沙仿大马士革大清真寺修建阿迪纳清真寺，其规模为整个次大陆之冠。生为印度教王公之子的苏丹贾拉鲁丁·穆罕默德沙，安葬在陶土饰面的埃克拉希陵墓。曾随郑和船队、担任通事的马欢出使到此，记下整齐的市集上有六种精细平纹细布和丝绸，还有桑树皮造的纸，薄如白色棉布。在复辟的苏丹纳西鲁丁·马哈茂德沙治下，潘杜亚是穆斯林王都，周围乡野以孟加拉印度教徒为主，古老的高尔就坐落在改道频繁的恒河旁。

1450年，马哈茂德沙把王庭南迁高尔，此后百余年间苏丹都在此统治孟加拉。王宫城堡三面有壕沟与恒河相通，达卡伊尔门之内，九道重兵把守的宫门直通朝殿，后宫寝殿贴满各色琉璃砖，宫殿遗址中还出土过中国瓷器。葡萄牙访客把高尔的富庶比作里斯本，1521年一名葡萄牙人还看见苏丹努斯拉特沙在城堡下的平地上打马球。一位毗湿奴派诗人记载，阿拉丁·侯赛因沙望见对岸圣徒柴坦亚率领的唱颂游行，吩咐部下不得惊扰。1538年胡马雍占领高尔，改名詹纳塔巴德，不到一年舍尔沙·苏尔的阿富汗军队便夺回并洗劫了此城。1565年苏丹苏莱曼·卡拉尼迁都坦达；1575年穆尼姆汗率莫卧儿军队攻占高尔，次年拉杰马哈尔战役终结了苏丹国。瘟疫加上恒河主泓改走博多河河道，城池就此荒废，威尼斯人切萨雷·费代里奇已发现海船无法再驶到高尔的旧港。沙舒贾任总督时，废墟间建起两层的塔哈卡纳，一座凉爽的行馆兼苏菲道院，丛林随后没过了四周。

en:
Dhaka lies in the river-webbed Ganges Delta, its old quarters pressed against the Buriganga. Tradition credits the twelfth-century Sena raja Ballal Sena with the Dhakeshwari temple, the city's chief Hindu shrine, and weavers and shell-cutters kept bazaars along the landings long before Turkic and Afghan governors arrived. By 1444 the town belonged to the Bengal Sultanate's eastern Sonargaon lands, smaller than the royal capital at Gaur and the admin centre at Sonargaon, but already living by its Bengali cotton cloth and the river trade.

The small brick Binat Bibi Mosque of 1454 is the oldest surviving building in the city. Across the water at Sonargaon, Isa Khan and his son Musa Khan led the twelve-chief confederacy of the Baro-Bhuiyan, who held the Mughal armies at the edge of the delta until the last sultanate forces were broken in 1576. In 1610 the governor Islam Khan moved Bengal's capital from Rajmahal to Dhaka and named the new city Jahangirnagar, the staging ground for Mughal campaigns into Assam and Arakan. Dhaka then became the centre of the muslin trade: its weavers' finest cotton sailed out on the port's ships, and the cloth was known as 'Daka' as far away as Central Asia; the river yards also built ships for the Mughal navy, and Portuguese, Armenian, Dutch, French and English merchants kept houses by the bank. Under the long governorship of Shaista Khan the city was at its richest, and the English mariner Thomas Bowrey, visiting in those years, judged it more populous than London. Prince Muhammad Azam began Lalbagh Fort in 1678, but after Shaista Khan's daughter Pari Bibi died and was buried within its walls he held the fort unlucky and never finished it. Murshid Quli Khan moved the government to Murshidabad in 1717; after the East India Company took the revenues in 1765, the old Mughal city slowly emptied and its palaces were left as ruins.
zh:
达卡位于河网密布的恒河三角洲，旧城紧贴布里甘加河。相传12世纪犀那王朝的巴拉拉尔·犀那修建了达卡什瓦里神庙，它是城中最主要的印度教神庙；早在突厥和阿富汗统治者到来之前，织工与贝壳匠已在河码头一带排开市集。到1444年，达卡属孟加拉苏丹国东部的索纳尔冈辖地，规模不及王都高尔和索纳尔冈行政城，但已靠孟加拉棉布与河运立足。
