Portuguese ships bound for the Moluccas first sighted the island in 1512, and a later expedition sent from Malacca was wrecked on the Bukit reefs; Cornelis de Houtman opened Dutch contact in 1597, but the VOC post attempted soon after was abandoned, for Bali exported rice rather than spices. In 1639 Gelgel backed Blambangan against Mataram. Strife after 1651 broke the kingdom apart, and in 1686 a new paramount seat was set up at nearby Klungkung as the island split into competing kingdoms, each with its own puri and rites. Gianyar itself became a royal seat in 1771, when Ida Dewa Manggis Sakti founded its court.
zh:
巴厘位于爪哇与龙目岛之间的狭窄海峡一侧，火山坡辟成层层水稻梯田，由古老的苏巴克沟渠灌溉，岛上政权以印度教宫廷为中心。1342至1343年，加查·马达派来的满者伯夷军队攻克巴厘，在贝杜卢击败巴厘国王，把室利·阿吉·克雷斯纳·克帕基西封在后来以吉安雅为中心的桑普兰甘；其弟达伦·克图特又在附近的格尔格尔另立王庭。1444年，这个王朝仍把巴厘与日渐衰微的满者伯夷世界连在一起。16世纪初，满者伯夷在兴起的穆斯林苏丹国淡目的压力下崩溃，贵族、祭司和工匠渡海逃到格尔格尔，带来典籍与仪轨，巴厘便成了保存旧式印度教爪哇宫廷文化的最后王国。

16世纪，格尔格尔在达伦·巴图伦贡治下达到全盛，他接纳来自爪哇的贤者尼拉尔塔，势力遍及龙目、松巴哇西部和爪哇东端的布兰班甘。1512年，驶往摩鹿加的葡萄牙船只首次望见巴厘，后来一支从马六甲派出的队伍又在布吉礁盘失事；科内利斯·德·霍特曼1597年开启了荷兰人的接触，但荷兰东印度公司随后尝试开设的商站并未维持多久，因为巴厘输出的是稻米而不是香料。1639年，格尔格尔支持布兰班甘对抗马打兰。1651年后的内乱使王国瓦解，1686年，新的共主王庭设在附近的克隆孔，巴厘分裂为彼此争战的诸王国，各有宫殿与仪轨。吉安雅本身在1771年成为王庭所在地，由伊达·德瓦·芒吉斯·萨克蒂开基。

en:
The west of Sumbawa, called Samawa by its people, is grassland country: open plains where horses and cattle graze and deer run, with harbours on the Java Sea to the north and the Flores Sea to the south. Long before European ships came, Javanese and Makassar traders loaded honey and beeswax, sandalwood for incense and medicine, and sappanwood for red dye. Four small river polities shared the west, Sumbawa with its vassals Taliwang, Seran and Jereweh, and the fourteenth-century Nagarakretagama counts them among Majapahit's dependencies. In 1444 the rajas of Samawa still kept their old cults, touched only lightly by Hinduism, while Majapahit's power ebbed across the water.

Muslim merchants from Java and Palembang, with preachers such as Sunan Prapen, brought Islam to the coast between about 1450 and 1540, and the Balinese kingdom of Gelgel held part of the west for a time. In the next century Samawa accepted the protection of Gowa, the Makassar power, whose agents removed its last Hindu-leaning ruler, Mas Goa, in 1673; the Dutch East India Company arrived the same year. On 12 June 1674 the west became an independent sultanate under Harunnurrasyid I, called Mas Bantan in the local chronicle and the son of a Banjarmasin prince, who gave up his claim to Selaparang in Lombok in exchange for Dutch protection. His son Jalaluddin I made war on Selaparang, and after the reign of Kaharuddin I the queen I Sugiratu ruled as sultana until she was deposed in 1761 as the Dutch hold tightened. In 1815 Tambora, the great volcano at the island's eastern end, erupted; its ash blotted out the sun over western Sumbawa, and famine and sickness followed.
zh:
松巴哇岛西部，本地人自称萨马瓦，是一片草原乡野：开阔的草地上放牧着马匹和牛，也有鹿群奔走，港口北临爪哇海、南濒弗洛勒斯海。早在欧洲船只到来之前，爪哇和望加锡的商人就在此装走蜂蜜、蜂蜡、供焚香和入药的檀香，以及制取红色染料的苏木。西部有四个河畔小邦，松巴哇本邦带着附庸塔利旺、瑟兰和哲雷韦；14世纪的《爪哇史颂》把它们都算作满者伯夷的藩属。1444年，萨马瓦的拉惹们仍守着旧有信仰，印度教的影响很浅，而满者伯夷的威势正在海对岸消退。

约1450至1540年间，来自爪哇和巨港的穆斯林商人，以及苏南·普拉彭等传教士，把伊斯兰教带到海岸；巴厘的格尔格尔王国也曾短期占据西部的一部分。进入下个世纪，萨马瓦接受望加锡强国戈阿的保护，1673年戈阿人废黜了仍倾向印度教的君主马斯·果阿，荷兰东印度公司也在同年到来。1674年6月12日，西部成为独立苏丹国，初代苏丹哈伦拉希德一世在本地编年史中称马斯·班坦，是一位马辰王子之子；他放弃对龙目塞拉帕朗的权利，换取荷兰保护。其子贾拉鲁丁一世曾攻打塞拉帕朗；卡哈鲁丁一世之后，王后伊·苏吉拉图以苏丹娜称制，1761年荷兰控制收紧时被废。1815年，岛东端的大火山坦博拉喷发，火山灰遮蔽了西部的天空，饥荒和疫病随之而来。

en:
Flores is a long volcanic island in the Lesser Sunda chain between Sumbawa and Timor. Sikka oral tradition called it Nusa Nipa, Snake Island; European sailors later gave the name Flores from cabo de flores, or cape of flowers. Manggarai, Ngada, Ende, Sikka and Lamaholot communities spoke separate Austronesian languages and lived in hill chiefdoms bound by ancestor cults and megalithic rites. Their praus used the island's anchorages on the route that carried Timor sandalwood toward Malacca. In 1444 no foreign ruler or faith controlled Flores.

European power first gathered on nearby Solor rather than on Flores. Dominican friars built a palm-timber fort there in 1562; Javanese Muslims burned it, the post was rebuilt in stronger materials, and the Dutch took Solor in 1613. Portuguese traders and friars then moved to Larantuka on Flores' eastern tip. Refugees from Malacca after 1641 and from Makassar in 1660 married local women, and their settlement produced the Larantuqueiros, also called Topasses or black Portuguese. The da Costa and de Hornay families supplied muskets in the Timor sandalwood trade, backed local rajas and ignored letters from Lisbon. When royal officials tried to take charge in 1769, the Larantuqueiros drove them away. As sandalwood profits fell, the families lived from their estates; in 1821 the highlands of Flores remained under local rajas.
zh:
弗洛勒斯是小巽他群岛中的狭长火山岛，位于松巴哇与帝汶之间。锡卡一带的口传传统称它为努萨尼帕，意为「蛇岛」；欧洲水手后来以葡萄牙语「花之角」称它为弗洛勒斯。芒加莱、恩加达、恩德、锡卡、拉马霍洛特等族群各说不同的南岛语，生活在由祖先崇拜和巨石仪式维系的山间酋邦中。他们的船使用岛上锚地，沿帝汶檀香木运往马六甲的航路贸易。1444年，弗洛勒斯没有外来统治者，也没有外来宗教。

欧洲人的势力最初集中在邻近的索洛岛，而不是弗洛勒斯。1562年，多明我会修士在索洛修建棕榈木要塞；爪哇穆斯林将其焚毁后，据点以更坚固的材料重建，荷兰人又在1613年占领索洛。葡萄牙商人和修士随后迁到弗洛勒斯东端的拉兰图卡。1641年后离开马六甲的葡萄牙人、1660年因荷兰进攻望加锡而迁出的人到这里与当地女子通婚，形成拉兰图卡人，也称托帕塞人或「黑葡萄牙人」。达科斯塔和德奥奈两大家族在帝汶檀香木贸易中提供火器，扶持本地拉惹，也不理会里斯本的命令。1769年，王室官员前来接管，被拉兰图卡人赶走。檀香木利润下降后，这些家族改靠庄园生活；1821年，弗洛勒斯高地仍由本地拉惹统治。

en:
Sumba lies south of Flores across the Sumba Strait, a dry, grassy island unlike the lusher islands around it. Its people kept the Marapu ancestor cult and buried their dead under dolmens, upright stones and carved megaliths, and the greater the tomb raised for a dead chief and the longer the funeral feast, the higher his house stood. Javanese writings, the Pararaton chronicle and Gajah Mada's Palapa oath, numbered Sumba among the lands claimed by Majapahit, but no outside power actually ruled it. In 1444 the sandalwood forests of the interior belonged to independent clan lords, who traded on the northern beaches with ships putting in from Sumatran and Javanese ports.

The Portuguese reached Sumba in 1522 in search of sandalwood, and Dutch East India Company skippers followed from the 1600s; European geographers took to calling it the Sandalwood Island. The grasslands also bred the small, fast Sandalwood ponies, horses with much Arabian blood that islanders raced bareback over courses nearly five kilometres long. In the western districts riders held the pasola, a mounted spear-fight at the start of the rice-planting season: teams on horseback threw wooden spears at one another to spill blood for the Marapu and so secure a good harvest, and the opening date was fixed by a certain sea worm that swarmed to the shore when the rains ended. Neither company nor sultanate conquered the island, and through 1821 its lords still bargained with every fleet that anchored off the north coast while the tombs and Marapu rites continued.
zh:
松巴岛隔着松巴海峡与弗洛勒斯岛相望，气候干燥、草原广布，和周围湿润的岛屿很不一样。岛民信奉马拉普祖先崇拜，把死者葬在石棚墓、立石和雕凿的巨石之下；为去世酋长营造的墓越大、丧宴摆得越久，这个家族的地位就越高。爪哇古籍《爪哇诸年纪》和加查·马达的帕拉帕誓约把松巴列入满者伯夷声言的属地，但从无外来政权真正统治此岛。1444年，内陆的檀香林归各自独立的氏族长老所有，他们在北部海滩同从苏门答腊、爪哇各港驶来的船只交易。

1522年，为檀香而来的葡萄牙人最早抵达松巴，1600年代起荷兰东印度公司的船只继至，欧洲制图者索性把这里称作「檀香岛」。草原还培育出矮小而迅捷的檀香马，这种混入大量阿拉伯马血统的小马耐力出众，岛民骑它无鞍竞速，赛程将近五公里。岛的西部举行帕索拉骑枪战：水稻播种季开始时，骑手上马互掷木矛，以血献祭马拉普，祈求丰收；开赛的日子由一种海虫群游到岸边的时间确定，那意味着雨季结束。无论公司还是苏丹国都没有征服松巴，直到1821年，岛上长老依旧同每一支停泊北岸的船队讨价还价，巨石墓与马拉普祭仪也照旧延续。

en:
West Timor is the drier western half of the sandalwood island, and Kupang Bay was the finest natural anchorage in the Lesser Sunda chain. The Atoin Meto lived alongside Helong, Tetum, Kemak and Bunak communities in scores of small kingdoms. Wehale, whose lord ruled at Laran, served as the island's ritual centre, while Sonba'i took shape in the west after that model. Malay, Javanese and Chinese junks loaded white sandalwood from the inland hills and also took away beeswax. In 1444 the rajas answered to no foreign power.

António de Abreu sighted Timor around 1512 while searching for the Spice Islands. Dominican friars began work on the north coast after 1556, and in 1641 they baptised Ambeno's royal family at Lifau. Topasses from Flores and Solor had reached the place around the previous year, and a permanent Portuguese settlement took shape there in the 1650s. After Francisco Fernandes overran Sonba'i and Wehale in 1642, the Hornay and Costa clans controlled much of the sandalwood traffic. The Dutch raised their first fort near Kupang in 1640, destroyed the Portuguese post in 1653 and stormed its fort in 1656, yet they secured the bay only in 1688 through treaties with five small loyal-allied rajas; malaria thinned their garrison throughout those years. At Penfui in 1749 the Topass army was routed and Gaspar da Costa killed. In 1769 the Topasses drove the Portuguese governor from Lifau to Dili. British troops held Kupang from 1811 to 1816, and when Dutch rule returned the inland kingdom of Amanuban still brought column after column to a standstill.
zh:
西帝汶是檀香木之岛较干燥的西半，古邦湾是小巽他群岛最好的天然锚地。阿托尼梅托人与赫龙、德顿、克马克、布纳克等族群生活在数十个小王国中。君主驻在拉兰的韦哈莱是全岛的礼仪中心，西部的松巴伊便按这一模式兴起。马来、爪哇和中国商船装运内陆丘陵出产的白檀，也收购蜂蜡。1444年，各位拉惹都不臣服于外来强权。

约1512年，安东尼奥·德·阿布雷乌在寻找香料群岛时望见帝汶。1556年后，多明我会修士开始在北岸传教；1641年，他们在利福为安贝诺王室施洗。来自弗洛勒斯和索洛的托帕塞人约在前一年到达，永久葡萄牙定居点到1650年代才成形。1642年弗朗西斯科·费尔南德斯连克松巴伊和韦哈莱后，奥尔奈与科斯塔两大家族控制了檀香木贸易的大半。荷兰人1640年在古邦附近修建第一座堡垒，1653年摧毁葡萄牙商站，1656年强攻其堡垒，却到1688年才通过与五个「忠盟」小邦立约稳住海湾；这些年里，疟疾不断削弱他们的驻军。1749年彭富伊之战，托帕塞军队溃败，加斯帕尔·达科斯塔战死。1769年，托帕塞人把葡萄牙总督从利福逐往帝力。1811至1816年，英军占领古邦。荷兰人恢复统治时，内陆的阿马努班仍让一支支远征军受阻。

en:
This province centred on the sheltered Brunei River estuary on Borneo's northwest coast, where South China Sea shipping met river routes into the island. Chinese and Arab records knew the trading polity there as Po-ni. In 1365 the Javanese Nagarakretagama counted Brunei among Majapahit's tributaries, bound for forty katis of camphor a year, and a Sulu attack in 1369 looted the capital and left it weaker. During the fifteenth century Brunei broke from Majapahit and became a Sunni Muslim sultanate; local tradition says its first Muslim ruler landed at the estuary crying 'Baru nah!', 'that is it!', and gave the place its name. In 1444 the river capital was an independent Bornean Muslim port, living on camphor and spices carried between Borneo, the Philippines and China, with merchants' houses raised on wooden piles over the water.

Brunei's maritime power peaked under Sultan Bolkiah (1485–1528), whose suzerainty ran over much of coastal Borneo, the Sulu Islands and the Muslim settlement at Manila. Survivors of the Magellan expedition visited in 1521, and Antonio Pigafetta described a wealthy court and a city of 25,000 hearths built on tall wooden pillars over the salt water. In March 1578 a Spanish expedition sailed from Manila: 400 Spaniards and Mexicans, 1,500 Filipinos and 300 Borneans under Francisco de Sande, guided by two dissident Bruneian nobles. They took the Kota Batu capital on 16 April and Sultan Saiful Rijal fled to Jerudong, but cholera and dysentery thinned the invaders and they withdrew on 26 June after seventy-two days. The court survived; its succession quarrels did not. In the civil war of 1665–1673, Abdul Hakkul Mubin killed Sultan Muhammad Ali and proclaimed himself ruler, while Muhyiddin fought him and called in the Sultan of Sulu with the promise of Kimanis; Mubin was finally killed on Cermin Island. The war loosened Brunei's hold on its outer lands, and the Sulu claim to eastern Sabah grew out of the bargain, but the old capital on the Brunei River remained an independent sultan's seat at the end of the eighteenth century.
zh:
这一省的核心是婆罗洲西北岸隐蔽的文莱河口，南海航运与深入岛内的河路在此相接。中国和阿拉伯记载称当地的贸易政权为渤泥。1365年，爪哇的《爪哇史颂》把文莱列为满者伯夷属国，每年须纳四十卡提樟脑；1369年苏禄人攻陷劫掠都城，使其实力受损。15世纪，文莱摆脱满者伯夷，成为逊尼派苏丹国；相传其第一位穆斯林统治者在河口登岸，喊了一声「Baru nah!」（意为「就是这里」），便以此为地名。1444年，河口都城是独立的婆罗洲穆斯林港口，靠婆罗洲、菲律宾与中国之间贩运的樟脑和香料立足，商人的木屋架在河面的木桩上。

苏丹博尔基亚在位时（1485—1528），文莱的海上势力达到顶峰，势力遍及婆罗洲大部分沿海、苏禄群岛和马尼拉的穆斯林聚落。1521年麦哲伦船队的幸存者到访，随队的安东尼奥·皮加费塔记述了富庶的宫廷，还看到一座立在海水中高木桩上的水城，有二万五千户人家。1578年3月，西班牙远征军从马尼拉出发，弗朗西斯科·德·桑德率四百名西班牙人和墨西哥人、一千五百名菲律宾人、三百名婆罗洲人，由两名异议贵族引路，4月16日攻占哥打峇都都城，苏丹弃城西逃；但霍乱和痢疾在军中流行，72天后即6月26日便撤回马尼拉。文莱宫廷幸存下来，继承之争却未止息。1665—1673年内战中，阿卜杜勒·哈库勒·穆宾杀死苏丹穆罕默德·阿里自立，穆希丁起而对抗，以基马尼斯为酬请来苏禄苏丹助战，穆宾最终在镜岛被杀。长期战争削弱了文莱对外围属地的控制，苏禄对沙巴东部的要求也源于这笔交易；但直到18世纪末，文莱河畔的旧都仍是独立苏丹的宫廷所在。

en:
Api-Api is the fishing anchorage on Gaya Bay along Borneo's northwest coast, where Gaya Island shelters the roadstead and Mount Kinabalu rises behind the shore. Kadazan-Dusun, Bajau and other coastal peoples fished the bay and passed forest and sea produce through Bruneian ports; a Dutch map of Borneo labels the settlement Api Api in 1657, a name probably taken from the mangrove tree called api-api, 'fire'. In 1444 the coast belonged to the Sultanate of Brunei, the Muslim maritime power whose merchants gathered spices, camphor, beeswax, rattan and pearls along the Bornean shore.

Brunei stood at its height under Sultan Bolkiah, who reigned from 1485 to 1524 and held suzerainty along the Bornean coast and into the southern Philippines; Antonio Pigafetta, sailing with Magellan's fleet, visited the court in 1521 and left an account of its wealth. This coast was drawn into Brunei's succession war of 1665 to 1673, when Sultan Abdul Hakkul Mubin, who had killed his predecessor and seized the throne, was driven from the capital and made Kinarut south of the bay his stronghold with Bajau and Dusun support, while his rival Muhyiddin bought Sulu aid with the promise of Kimanis, the pledge on which Sulu later based its claims to northern Borneo. Farther north the East India Company tried a station of its own on Balambangan: Alexander Dalrymple obtained Sulu's leave in 1761, the factory opened in 1773 and was sacked within two years, and a brief restoration in 1803 ended in abandonment in 1805. Api-Api itself stayed a small Bruneian fishing and trading anchorage.
zh:
亚庇是婆罗洲西北岸加雅湾里的渔港锚地，加雅岛为港湾挡住外海，岸后耸立着京那峇鲁山。卡达山-杜顺人、巴瑶人和其他沿海族群在湾中捕鱼，把山林与海产经文莱港口转运；1657年的一幅婆罗洲荷兰地图已把这里标为「Api Api」，其名大概来自当地一种名叫「api-api」（火）的红树林。1444年，这片海岸属于穆斯林海上强权文莱苏丹国，其商人在婆罗洲沿岸收购香料、樟脑、蜂蜡、藤条和珍珠。

文莱在苏丹博尔基亚1485年至1524年在位时达到全盛，宗主权遍及婆罗洲沿岸与菲律宾南部；1521年，随麦哲伦船队航行的安东尼奥·皮加费塔到访其宫廷，记下了那里的富庶。这片海岸后来被卷入1665至1673年的文莱继承战争：杀害前任苏丹、自立为主的阿都·哈库·穆宾被逐出都城，在海湾以南的京那律依靠巴瑶人和杜顺人建立据点，对手穆希丁则以许诺割让金马尼士请来苏禄援兵，苏禄日后对北婆罗洲的领土主张正源于这次许诺。更北的巴兰邦安岛上，英国东印度公司也尝试建立自己的据点：亚历山大·达尔林普尔1761年取得苏禄许可，商站1773年开张，不出两年便遭洗劫，1803年短暂恢复，1805年废弃。亚庇本身始终只是文莱治下一个小小的渔贸锚地。

en:
The Mahakam delta and riverine lands below its forested interior were the old territory called Kutai, home to river-dwelling Kutai communities related to the Dayak peoples of the basin. Around the year 400 a Hindu king, Mulavarman, ruled upstream at Muara Kaman; seven stone yupa pillars raised for him by brahmins carry Sanskrit inscriptions, the oldest known in Indonesia, that record his gifts of thousands of cattle and gold. A newer coastal power, Kutai Kartanegara, arose at Kutai Lama near the river mouth in 1300 under Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti and adopted Hindu-Javanese titles. In 1444 its court commanded the estuarine fisheries and traffic between the Mahakam interior and the sea, while the older Martapura realm still centred on Muara Kaman.

Muslim traders and teachers gained influence along the coast during the sixteenth century, and in 1575 Aji Raja Mahkota Mulia Alam made Islam the religion of the court. In 1635 Kutai Kartanegara defeated Martapura, annexed the old Hindu kingdom and joined its name to its own. The royal centre then shifted down the lower Mahakam for defence and trade, moving to Jembayan in 1732 and to Tenggarong in 1782. From these river landings Kutai's rulers exchanged fish, forest produce and sea goods with passing traders and drew the upriver communities into the sultanate.
zh:
马哈坎河三角洲及其密林下游的河畔土地，古称古泰，居住着与流域达雅克各族有亲缘关系的古泰人。约公元400年，印度教国王穆拉瓦尔曼在上游的穆阿拉卡曼立国；婆罗门为他立起七根尤帕祭柱，柱上梵文铭文记下他施舍的成千头牛和黄金，这是印度尼西亚已知最古老的梵文石刻。较晚的滨海政权古泰卡塔内加拉于1300年在河口附近的古泰拉马兴起，开国者阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·德瓦·萨克蒂采用印度教—爪哇式尊号。1444年，这个政权控制着河口渔业以及马哈坎内陆与海洋之间的往来，而更古老的马尔塔普拉王权仍以穆阿拉卡曼为中心。

16世纪，穆斯林商人和传道者在沿海逐渐扩大影响；1575年，阿吉·拉贾·马科塔·穆利亚·阿拉姆定伊斯兰教为宫廷宗教。1635年，古泰卡塔内加拉击败马尔塔普拉，吞并这个古老印度教王国，并将其国名并入己名。为兼顾防御与贸易，王都随后迁到马哈坎河下游，1732年定都占巴延，1782年再迁登加龙。统治者以这些河畔泊地与过往商人交换鱼类、林产和海货，也把上游社群逐渐纳入苏丹国。

en:
Banjar lies at the wet southern edge of Borneo, where the Barito and Martapura rivers reach the Java Sea through a maze of tidal channels. Its river port, Banjarmasin, began as Bandar Masih, the port of a local chief named Patih Masih; Ngaju Dayaks upriver called its Malay traders oloh masih, people of the coast. Foreign sailors knew it early: around 1325 the Italian friar Odoric of Pordenone stopped at a place he called Thalamasin and described sago eaters and hunters with poisoned blowpipes, and Wang Dayuan listed it as Pa-nan-pa-hsi in 1349; later scholars identified both with this port. Real power lay upriver at Negara, seat of the Hindu kings of Negara Daha. In 1444 the lowlands were Hindu, their praus carrying rice and forest goods to Java and the Malay ports; at Cempaka diggers were already washing diamonds from the gravel, a trade later hedged by a sultan's edict reserving every stone of four carats or more for the ruler.

The Hindu kingdom ended in a family feud. Raden Samudra, heir to Negara Daha through both parents, fled his usurping uncles to the river mouth and, with troops from Demak sent on condition that he turn Muslim, took the title Sultan Surianshah on 24 September 1526. Pepper then made Banjar's fortune: the English East India Company came in 1602 and the Dutch in 1603, and under Sultan Mustain Billah Banjarmasin traded from Malacca and Brunei to Gowa and the Moluccas. Two early Dutch expeditions came to nothing, a direct assault on the port failed in 1633, and the VOC was driven out altogether in 1638. The Dutch returned as kingmakers in the civil war of 1663-1679, when their candidate Tahlilullah took Banjarmasin in 1679. In 1757 the pretender Prince Amir sailed in with a Bugis fleet, and VOC troops under Captain Hoffman helped beat it back; Amir was exiled to Ceylon in 1787 and Banjar became a Dutch protectorate. The English made their own treaty with the sultan during their occupation of Java in 1812, but an agreement of January 1817 handed the port back to the Netherlands.
zh:
班贾尔位于婆罗洲湿润的南缘，巴里托河与马塔普拉河穿过潮水纵横的河网注入爪哇海。这里的河港马辰本名班达尔马西，得名于地方首领帕提赫·马西（Patih Masih）；上游的雅朱达雅克人把港中的马来商人称作奥洛马西，意思是海边的人。外国水手很早就知道它：约1325年，意大利修士鄂多立克在一个他记作塔拉马辛（Thalamasin）的地方停靠，写下吃西米粉、用毒箭吹筒打猎的土人；汪大渊1349年《岛夷志略》中的「巴南巴西」，后世学者也考订为这座港口。真正的权柄在上游的尼加拉，那是印度教王国尼加拉·达哈的都城。1444年的低地信奉印度教，当地船队把稻米和林产品运往爪哇和马来港口；切姆帕卡（Cempaka）的矿工已在砂砾中淘洗钻石，后来苏丹还专门下令，四克拉以上的钻石只能卖给君主。

这个印度教王国亡于一场家族内讧。兼具父母两系王裔血统的拉登·沙穆德拉（Raden Samudra）被篡位的叔父们逼到河口，以改信伊斯兰教为条件换来淡目的援军，1526年9月24日称苏丹·苏利安沙（Sultan Surianshah）。随后是胡椒造就班贾尔的时代：英国东印度公司1602年、荷兰人1603年先后来航，在苏丹慕斯泰因·比拉（Mustain Billah）治下，马辰的商路西起满剌加和文莱，东抵戈瓦和马鲁古。荷兰人早先两次远征无果，1633年强攻港口又告失败，1638年荷兰东印度公司更被尽数逐出。1663至1679年的内战中，荷兰人以拥立新君的姿态卷土重来，他们支持的塔赫利卢拉（Tahlilullah）于1679年攻占马辰。1757年，觊觎王位的阿米尔王子（Prince Amir）率布吉斯舰队来攻，荷兰东印度公司派霍夫曼船长带兵将其击退；阿米尔1787年被流放锡兰，班贾尔成为荷兰保护国。英国占领爪哇期间于1812年与苏丹另订条约，但1817年1月的协议又把港口交还荷兰。

en:
Sambas occupies the north-western coast of Borneo around the lower Sambas River, where coastal Malays had long mingled with Dayak farming and seafaring peoples. A kingdom called Sambas is named in the fourteenth-century Javanese poem Negarakertagama; its fifteenth-century king Tan Unggal was overthrown by his own people for his cruelty, and for decades the river districts lived under no raja. In 1444 the coast lived by fishing and the exchange of forest produce, its villages taking in traders who sailed the South China Sea route between Java, Melaka and China.

In 1530 more than five hundred Hindu nobles of fallen Majapahit, descendants of King Wikramawardhana, settled upriver at Kota Lama and founded the Hindu Panembahan Sambas. Its ruler Ratu Sapudak made the land's first trade agreement with the Dutch East India Company in 1609. His daughter married Radin Sulaiman, the eldest son of Sultan Tengah of Sarawak, and that prince took the throne in 1631 as Sultan Muhammad Shafiuddin I, the first Muslim ruler of Sambas. The sultanate grew rich on the upriver goldfields and the traffic of the Borneo straits. Chinese miners opened the fields at Monterado and ran them through self-governing kongsi, the strongest of them the Heshun Confederation. By the early nineteenth century Sambas was also a centre of sea-raiders led by the sultan's son Pangeran Anom. British expeditions out of Java were beaten back in 1812 but took the town in 1813; the British restored the sultan within the year and pardoned Anom, who later came to the throne himself. The Dutch took the coast in 1819 and intervened in every succession after.
zh:
三发位于婆罗洲西北海岸的三发河下游，沿海马来人与务农、航海的达雅克人早在此杂居。以「三发」为名的王国在14世纪的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》中已有记载；15世纪的国王丹·翁加尔因残暴被民众推翻，此后数十年三发河流域再无君主。1444年的三发以捕鱼和林产物交易为生，各村迎送着往来于爪哇、满剌加与中国之间南海航道上的商人。

1530年，五百余名仍信印度教的满者伯夷贵族（国王威克拉玛瓦尔达纳的后裔）在三发河上游的哥打拉马定居，建立印度教的三发潘嫩巴汉王国。1609年，统治者拉杜·萨普达克与荷兰东印度公司达成当地第一份通商协议。他的女儿嫁给砂拉越苏丹登加的长子拉登·苏莱曼，这位王子于1631年即位，称苏丹穆罕默德·沙菲乌丁一世，是三发第一位穆斯林统治者。苏丹国靠上游金矿和婆罗洲海峡的航运致富，华工在打劳鹿一带开矿，以自治的「公司」管理，最大的是和顺总厅。19世纪初，三发又是海寇聚集之地，首领为苏丹之子邦格兰·阿诺姆。英国从爪哇派出的远征军1812年被击退，1813年攻占三发城；同年英国人恢复苏丹的地位，阿诺姆也获赦免，后来自己登上王位。荷兰人于1819年接管海岸，此后每次王位继承都要插手。

en:
Makassar lies at the south-western tip of Sulawesi, the last landfall for ships sailing from Java and the Malay world to the Spice Islands. Its Makassarese people were rice-growers and sailors ruled by chiefs whose line became the kings of Gowa, until a succession quarrel split it into Gowa and the river kingdom of Tallo, which fought for generations. In 1444 the people still kept their old animist rites, Malukan cloves and nutmeg mostly travelled in Malay and Javanese bottoms, and Gowa was only the strongest of several squabbling little states; the free port of later fame did not exist yet.

King Tunipalangga (r. 1512-1546) reunited the two realms as Gowa-Tallo and built Sombaopu harbour. Malay merchants fleeing Portuguese Malacca arrived, and by the 1540s the Portuguese used the port as their Maluku base. On 22 September 1605 the ruler accepted Islam from three Minangkabau ulama and took the name Sultan Alauddin; the wars of 1608 to 1611 then brought the Bugis lands, Bone among them, to their knees. Makassar kept the port open to every flag: the English opened a factory in 1613, the Danes followed, and after Malacca fell in 1641 the Portuguese made the town their greatest base east of India. The chancellor Karaeng Pattingalloang spoke Portuguese like a man of Lisbon, kept a library in Portuguese, Spanish, Latin and Malay, had military manuals translated into Makassarese and pestered passing ships for books; he sent a shipload of sandalwood to Batavia to order a globe from Amsterdam, its labels to be in Spanish, Portuguese or Latin, not Dutch.

Sultan Hasanuddin held out against the Dutch longest. Cornelis Speelman's VOC fleet, seconded by the Bugis prince Arung Palakka, forced on him the treaty of Bungaya on 18 November 1667; fighting resumed, and on 12 June 1669 the Dutch stormed Sombaopu. Hasanuddin stepped down and died exactly a year later. Speelman razed the old fortress and built Fort Rotterdam, named for his birthplace, and the Dutch town around it grew into Makassar. In the eighteenth century Makassarese proas still sailed to the Australian coast for trepang, while sandalwood, pearls and rattan changed hands along the quay.
zh:
望加锡位于苏拉威西岛西南端，是船只从爪哇和马来世界驶往香料群岛前最后一个可以靠岸补给的地方。当地望加锡人世代种稻航海，首领的后裔成为戈瓦诸王；后来一场继位之争把土地分成戈瓦与河口王国塔洛克，两国世代攻战。1444年时，人们仍守着古老的泛灵仪式，摩鹿加的丁香和豆蔻多由马来和爪哇商船转运，戈瓦不过是半岛南端几个相争小国里最强的一个，日后那个万国云集的自由港尚不存在。

1512至1546年在位的国王图尼帕朗加以「二王一民」之约重新合并两国，建成戈瓦—塔洛克，并在松巴乌普营建港口。1511年后逃离葡属马六甲的马来商人到此落脚，到1540年代葡萄牙人也把这里当作经营摩鹿加贸易的基地。1605年9月22日，国王经三位来自米南佳保的乌理玛归信伊斯兰教，改名苏丹阿劳丁；1608至1611年的征战又使包括波尼在内的布吉人诸邦臣服。望加锡向所有旗号开放港口：英国人1613年开设商馆，丹麦人随之而来，1641年马六甲陷落后，葡萄牙人更把这里经营成他们在印度以东最大的据点。宰相卡朗·帕廷加洛昂说葡萄牙话如同里斯本本地人，藏有葡萄牙文、西班牙文、拉丁文和马来文书籍，命人把欧洲兵书译成望加锡文，逢船便打听新书；他曾运一船檀香到巴达维亚，用来向阿姆斯特丹订购地球仪，还要求标注文字用西班牙文、葡萄牙文或拉丁文，而不是荷兰文。

苏丹哈桑丁对荷兰人的抵抗最久。科内利斯·斯皮尔曼的荷兰东印度公司舰队在布吉王子阿隆·帕拉卡相助下，于1667年11月18日逼他签订《邦加亚条约》；战火重燃后，1669年6月12日松巴乌普陷落，哈桑丁退位，恰在一年后死去。斯皮尔曼拆毁旧堡，建起以自己故乡命名的鹿特丹堡，堡周的荷兰城镇发展成望加锡城。整个18世纪，望加锡人的帆船仍远航至澳大利亚海岸采集海参，檀香、珍珠和藤条在码头边交易。

en:
Kolaka faces the Gulf of Bone from the east, beneath the forested Mekongga highlands. Its people were Tolaki of the Mekongga branch, whose chiefs held the title bokeo and ruled first from Bende and later from Wundulako; their country was also called Wonua Sorume, the land of orchids. Local tradition derives the name Mekongga from kongga, the eagle, and tells of a giant eagle killed by the first leader, Sangia Larumbalangi. Around 1300 Bugis settlers began occupying the coast, bringing iron tools and weapons to exchange for hill and sea produce, and in 1365 the Majapahit court poem Nagarakretagama listed Luwu among Sulawesi's powers. In 1444 the Kolaka shore lay under Luwu's loose overlordship: Mekongga chiefs governed the interior, while the datu at Malangke kept exchange moving across the gulf.

The earliest named Luwu ruler, Bataraguru, appears in a mid-fifteenth-century peace treaty with Bone; Dewaraja's wars against Wajo and Sidenreng around 1495-1520 did not restore Luwu's old primacy. On 4 or 5 February 1605 the Luwu ruler La Patiwareq became the first major South Sulawesi ruler to accept Islam, ruling as Sultan Muhammad Wali Mu'z'hir al-din. Around 1620 his successors abandoned Malangke for Palopo, on the opposite shore facing Kolaka across the gulf.
zh:
科拉卡位于波尼湾东岸，后方是森林覆盖的梅孔加山地。居民是托拉基人的梅孔加支系，首领称博凯奥，早期驻在本德，后来迁至温杜拉科；他们的地方又叫沃努阿·索鲁梅，意为「兰花之地」。相传梅孔加得名于「孔加」，也就是鹰，第一位首领桑吉亚·拉伦巴兰吉杀死一只巨鹰，梅孔加也因这只巨鹰得名。约1300年起，布吉斯定居者进入海岸，用铁制工具和武器交换山林与海产；1365年满者伯夷宫廷诗《爪哇史颂》已把鲁乌列为苏拉威西的强权之一。1444年，科拉卡沿岸处在鲁乌松散的宗主权下：梅孔加首领治理内陆，马朗凯的达图维持波尼湾两岸的交易。

可考的最早鲁乌君主巴塔拉古鲁，出现在15世纪中叶与波尼的和约中；德瓦拉查约在1495年至1520年间进攻瓦久和西登伦，未能恢复鲁乌旧日的优势。1605年2月4日或5日，鲁乌君主拉·帕蒂瓦雷克成为南苏拉威西第一位接受伊斯兰教的主要统治者，称苏丹穆罕默德·瓦利·穆扎希尔·丁。约1620年，后继者放弃马朗凯，迁都海湾对岸的帕洛波，与科拉卡隔海相望。

en:
At the narrow waist of Sulawesi, the Poso River drains the long mountain lake of Poso into the Gulf of Tomini. The lake runs for 32 kilometres and is the third deepest in Indonesia, filling a highland basin. River banks and surrounding hills are the country of the Pamona, Bare'e-speaking Toraja villagers who farmed the highland valleys, fished lake and shore, and honoured the ancestral spirits they called Lamoa. They lived under a scattering of small domains, among them Poso, Napu, Mori and Tojo, each ruled by local chiefs and councils of elders, and their coast was pulled into the trade of greater neighbours: the Bugis kingdom of Luwu to the south smelted the interior's iron ore at Malangke, Sigi lay beyond the western mountains, and Ternate's sway reached across the gulf to the eastern islands. In 1444 no town yet stood at the river mouth, and the craft beached there were Bugis and Ternatan, not European.

The Islamic kingdom of Parigi, founded about 1515 on the gulf's northern shore, later brought much of the Tomini coast under its hand. On 4 February 1605 the Datu of Luwu became the first ruler in South Sulawesi to accept Islam, and when his court moved from Malangke to Palopo around 1620, Muslim merchants and teachers followed the trade route into the southern Poso lands. The Pamona had by then formed their own kingdom there in the course of the seventeenth century. The inland Toraja kept to Lamoa, and through 1821 the country remained a remote fringe of small chiefdoms, with no European fort or factory on its shores.
zh:
在苏拉威西岛的蜂腰地带，波索河把狭长的波索湖之水送入托米尼湾。波索湖长32公里，是印尼第三深湖，卧在高山盆地之中。河两岸与周围山地是帕莫纳人的家园，这支操巴雷埃语的托拉查人在高地山谷务农，在湖中与近海捕鱼，信奉名为拉莫阿的祖灵信仰。他们分处波索、纳普、莫里、托约等众多小邦，由酋长和长老议事会统领，沿海则被强邻的贸易牵动：南方的布吉斯王国卢雾在马来诺冶炼产自内陆的铁矿，西山之外有锡吉，特尔纳特的势力越过海湾波及东侧群岛。1444年的河口还没有城镇，在此泊岸的是布吉斯和特尔纳特商船，而不是欧洲人。

约1515年在托米尼湾北岸建立的伊斯兰王国帕里吉，后来把海湾大半海岸收入掌中。1605年2月4日，卢雾的达图成为南苏拉威西第一位皈依伊斯兰教的统治者；约1620年王都从马来诺迁往帕洛波后，穆斯林商人和教师沿商路进入波索地方南部，帕莫纳人也在17世纪里建成了自己的王国。内陆的托拉查人仍守着拉莫阿；直到1821年，这片地方仍是一众小酋长国的偏远边陲，海岸上没有一座欧洲人的要塞或商馆。

en:
At the far tip of the Minahasa peninsula, Manado looks out over a bay ringed by volcanic peaks and set with islands, among them Bunaken and old Manado Tua. Behind the shore lived the Minahasa, warrior villagers of independent hill districts (walak) such as Tombulu, Tonsea, Tontemboan and Tondano, who spoke nine related languages and kept the rites of their ancestors; the coastal hamlet of Wenang was their oldest settlement on the bay. The Sultans of Ternate across the sea exacted tribute and carried the faith of Islam along the sea road, and Bugis, Malay and Chinese skippers called at the bay on voyages to and from the clove islands, yet the hill peoples held to their old gods. In 1444 Manado was still only such a roadstead, known to Ternatan and Bugis seamen and unheard of in Europe.

Europeans began fighting over the bay early. A Portuguese ship first coasted the peninsula in 1523, when Simão d'Abreu sighted Manado Tua, and by mid-century the Portuguese kept a factory at Wenang. Spaniards sailing from Manila seized the Portuguese fort at Amurang in the 1550s and raised one of their own at Manado; one of the archipelago's first mestizo communities grew up there, and in 1630 Muntu Untu, the son of a Spanish mestizo, was acknowledged as the first king of Manado. Spain later renounced its Minahasa claims to Portugal in return for a payment of 350,000 ducats, and the Minahasan chiefs Supit, Pa'at and Lontoh turned to the VOC. The Company built Fort Amsterdam in 1658 and expelled the last Portuguese a few years later; on 10 January 1679 its governor of Maluku, Robertus Padtbrugge, signed an alliance with twenty-three walak chiefs against Bolaang Mongondow, tying Minahasa to the Dutch for generations. In 1808 the districts rose in the Tondano War rather than furnish levies for Java, and in June 1810 the British warship Dover captured the bay, holding it until Dutch rule returned in 1817.
zh:
在米纳哈萨半岛的最北端，万鸦老朝向被火山群峰环抱的海湾，布纳肯和古万鸦老等岛屿浮在海面。岸后的内陆是米纳哈萨人的家园，通布卢、通西、通滕博安、通达诺等各自独立的山地区域（瓦拉克）村民尚武，操九种互有关联的语言，恪守祖先的祭仪；海边的韦南村是他们在湾畔最古老的定居点。海那边的特尔纳特苏丹向这里索取贡赋，也把伊斯兰教随商路带来；布吉斯、马来和中国的商船在往返摩鹿加香料群岛的途中在此停泊，山地各部却仍守着自己的神明。1444年的万鸦老只是这样一处锚地，闻名于特尔纳特和布吉斯水手之间，欧洲人对它还一无所知。

欧洲人很早就为这片海湾交兵。1523年，葡萄牙船只沿半岛航行，西芒·德·阿布雷乌望见万鸦老岛；到16世纪中叶，葡萄牙人已在韦南设有商馆。来自马尼拉的西班牙人在1550年代夺取阿穆朗的葡军要塞，又在万鸦老自建堡垒，群岛上最早的混血社群之一便在这里形成；1630年，西班牙混血儿之子蒙图·温图被承认为第一位万鸦老国王。后来西班牙以35万达克特的代价把在米纳哈萨的权益让给葡萄牙，米纳哈萨酋长苏皮特、帕阿特和隆托转而联络荷兰东印度公司。公司的阿姆斯特丹堡于1658年建成，最后一批葡萄牙人几年后被逐走；1679年1月10日，驻摩鹿加的荷兰总督罗伯特斯·帕德特布鲁赫与二十三位瓦拉克首领缔约结盟，共同对抗博拉翁蒙贡多，把米纳哈萨与荷兰人绑在一起数代人之久。1808年，各部因拒绝为爪哇出兵而起兵，是为通达诺战争；1810年6月，英国战舰多佛号攻占海湾，直到1817年荷兰人才恢复统治。

en:
Buru lies between the Banda and Seram seas, the third largest island in the Moluccas. Mountain forest covers most of the interior, and on the ring of coastal plains Buru clans grew rice and sago and, above all, the cloves that drew merchants from Java, Sulawesi and the Malay ports. The Old Javanese eulogy Nagarakretagama counted the island in 1365 as Hutan Kadali, one of the lands subordinate to Majapahit, but no Javanese official ever reached its villages. In 1444 the island was still governed by its clan heads, and no outside power held it.

The clove trade brought the rivals on. In the sixteenth century the sultans of Ternate and the Portuguese each claimed Buru, but neither occupied it; traders from Makassar went further, raising fortifications and making the islanders extend their clove gardens. A Dutch East India Company expedition drove the Makassar out in 1648 and burned more than three thousand clove trees rather than leave them for a rival. In 1658 the Company built a fort on Kayeli Bay, held by twenty-four soldiers and four cannon, and moved about two thousand islanders, most of the tribal nobility among them, into thirteen villages around it to work the new plantations. The mixed Kayeli community that grew up beside the fort supplied the rajas through whom the Company ruled Buru until its charter lapsed in 1799 and the island passed to the Dutch crown.
zh:
布鲁岛地处班达海与塞兰海之间，是摩鹿加群岛第三大岛。内陆大部为山林覆盖，四周沿海平原上的布鲁诸部种植水稻和西谷，最要紧的物产则是丁香，爪哇、苏拉威西和马来诸港的商人为此而来。1365年的古爪哇颂诗《爪哇史颂》把该岛以「胡坦·卡达利」之名列为满者伯夷的属岛，但爪哇的官员从未踏足岛上的村落。1444年，布鲁仍由氏族首领治理，没有外来政权据有此岛。

引来争夺的是丁香生意。16世纪，特尔纳特苏丹和葡萄牙人都宣称拥有布鲁，却谁也没有占领；望加锡商人走得更远，他们在岛上修筑工事，强迫岛民扩种丁香。1648年，荷兰东印度公司的远征队逐走望加锡人，烧毁三千余株丁香树，不让它们落入竞争者之手。1658年，公司在卡耶利湾筑起一座要塞，驻兵24人、配炮4门，又把包括大批氏族贵族在内的约两千名岛民迁入要塞周边十三个村庄，为新辟的种植园劳作。要塞旁形成的混血卡耶利人共同体世代出任岛上的拉贾，公司便通过他们统治布鲁，直到1799年特许状到期，岛屿转归荷兰国家。

en:
Ambon is a small, fertile island off the south coast of Seram, where two mountainous peninsulas, Hitu and Leitimor, enclose a broad sheltered bay. Its cloves drew Malay and Javanese merchants to a patchwork of village realms, and in 1444 the islanders followed the old beliefs and no foreign lord ruled the harbor, though sailors from Malacca to the spice markets of Java already knew it. Around 1470 the northern villages turned to Islam with the rise of the kingdom of Hitu, which kept trade and religious ties with the Muslim ports on Java's north coast; Leitimor in the south accepted Christianity in the following century.

The Portuguese landed in 1512 and opened a factory in 1521, but Muslim Hitu harried them for decades and they held Ambon securely only after raising a stone fort in the 1570s. In February 1605 Steven van der Hagen took that fort for the Dutch East India Company without a shot, and Ambon served as the Company's eastern headquarters from 1610 until Batavia was founded in 1619. An English factory opened at Cambello around 1615 lasted only until 1623, when the Dutch destroyed it and put its men to death after torture, the affair remembered as the Amboyna massacre. Oliver Cromwell extracted an indemnity of 300,000 gulden in 1654, and John Dryden turned the story into a London tragedy in 1673.

Ambon's own clove wars lasted longer. Kakiali of Hitu held out in his stronghold of Wawani until a traitor killed him in 1643, and his successor Telukabesi defended the rock fastness of Kapahaha with three hundred men until Dutch troops found a steep track up the rock and stormed it in July 1646. A wider rising, the Great Ambon War, aided by Makassarese fighters, was not crushed until 1656. The Company then confined clove production to Ambon and its immediate neighbours and had the trees destroyed on the other islands. British squadrons seized Ambon in 1796 and again in 1810 and returned it in 1802 and 1814, and in 1821 Fort Victoria still guarded the clove capital of the Moluccas.
zh:
安汶是斯兰岛南岸外一座肥沃小岛，希图与莱蒂莫尔两个多山半岛环抱着一处宽阔的避风海湾。岛上的丁香把马来和爪哇商人引到林立的村邦。1444年，岛民仍守旧俗，没有外来君主统治这座港湾，但从马六甲到爪哇香料市场的水手都已知道它。约1470年希图王国兴起，北岸诸村随之改宗伊斯兰教，希图同爪哇北岸的穆斯林港口保持着通商和传教往来；南岸的莱蒂莫尔则在下一世纪接受了基督教。

葡萄牙人1512年登岛，1521年设立商馆，但穆斯林的希图数十年间不断袭扰，直到1570年代筑起石砌要塞，葡萄牙人才稳固据有安汶。1605年2月，史蒂文·范德哈根兵不血刃地为荷兰东印度公司夺下这座要塞，安汶从1610年起成为公司在东方的总部，直到1619年巴达维亚建立。英国人约1615年在坎贝洛开设的商馆只维持到1623年：荷兰人摧毁商馆，对馆员施以酷刑后处死，史称「安汶大屠杀」。1654年，奥利弗·克伦威尔为此索取30万荷兰盾赔款；1673年，约翰·德莱顿又把这段故事写成在伦敦上演的悲剧。

安汶本地人自己的丁香战争持续得更久。希图的卡卡亚利据守瓦瓦尼要塞，1643年被叛徒杀害；继任者特卢卡贝西率300人死守绝壁上的卡帕哈要塞，荷兰兵找到一条攀上岩壁的陡径，于1646年7月苦战攻陷。范围更大的「大安汶战争」有望加锡战士相助，也到1656年才被镇压。此后公司把丁香生产限制在安汶及其邻近小岛，在其他岛屿铲除丁香树。英国舰队1796年、1810年两度攻占安汶，又于1802年和1814年交还荷兰；1821年时，维多利亚要塞仍拱卫着这座摩鹿加的丁香之都。

en:
Seram, called Nusa Ina, the Mother Island, by central Moluccans who count it their ancestral home, is the largest island of the Moluccas, a rugged mountain mass across a narrow strait from Ambon. Its interior peoples lived by the sago palm and the forest in autonomous clan societies, while coastal villages traded with Ternatan merchants for the spices of the smaller islands. In 1444 there was no sultan yet in Ternate, whose court accepted Islam only after 1465, and Seram's clans kept the old beliefs, loosely caught up in the trade networks of the spice islands.

António de Abreu and Francisco Serrão charted the southern coast for Europeans in 1512, and Portuguese missionaries followed later in the century. Ternate ruled the western Hoamoal peninsula through noble chiefs until the Great Ambon War of 1651 to 1656 broke their power and left Seram under nominal Dutch control, while the sultans of Tidore held suzerainty in the east from 1700 to 1768. In 1780 Prince Nuku of Tidore raised his standard against the Dutch and made Seram a chief base of a thirty years' revolt, gathering discontented islanders from the Moluccas to New Guinea with British East India Company backing; he was enthroned as sultan in Tidore in 1797 and helped the British take the Dutch stronghold of Ternate in 1801. After his death in 1805 the rising ran on until 1810, and in 1821 Seram was back under the Dutch flag with its mountain interior still unconquered.
zh:
塞兰岛被中摩鹿加人称作「努萨·伊纳」，意为母岛，被视为他们的祖居之地。它是摩鹿加群岛第一大岛，与安汶隔一道狭窄海峡相望，全岛山岭崎岖。内陆居民以西谷椰和山林为生，结成自治的氏族社会；沿海村落同特尔纳特商人交易，换取更小岛屿上出产的香料。1444年时特尔纳特还没有苏丹，其宫廷要到1465年以后才接受伊斯兰教，塞兰诸部仍守旧俗，只被松散地卷入香料群岛的贸易网络。

1512年，安东尼奥·德·阿布雷乌和弗朗西斯科·塞朗首次为欧洲人测绘了塞兰南海岸，葡萄牙传教士随后在该世纪晚些时候登岛。特尔纳特通过贵族首领统治西部的霍阿莫阿尔半岛，直到1651至1656年的大安汶战争终结他们的权势，塞兰便处于荷兰的名义统治之下；1700至1768年，蒂多雷苏丹在岛的东部保有宗主权。1780年，蒂多雷王子努库举旗反荷，以塞兰为主要基地打了三十年战争，在英国东印度公司支持下把从摩鹿加到新几内亚心怀不满的岛民聚集到自己麾下。他1797年在蒂多雷加冕为苏丹，1801年协助英军攻下荷兰人据守的特尔纳特。努库1805年死后，起义坚持到1810年；1821年塞兰重归荷兰旗下，内陆山区却始终未被征服。

en:
Halmahera, called Jilolo or Jailolo on early European maps, is the largest island in the Moluccas but drew less foreign notice than Ternate and Tidore, the small clove islands off its west coast. Jailolo Bay held one of the four Maloko Kie Raha kingdoms; its ruler bore the title Jika ma-kolano, Lord of the Bay, and once took precedence over Ternate, Tidore and Bacan. Ternatan expansion under Komalo Pulo, who reigned from 1377 to 1432, took Halmaheran villages and that precedence with them. Animist highland communities were led by a Raja Papua, a lord with access to highland gold, while wild cloves and sago tied the island to the spice marts. In 1444 Jailolo still followed the old rites.

Late in the fifteenth century the preacher Mahadum converted King Yusuf. Francisco Serrao reached Ternate in 1512, and the Portuguese post there pushed Jailolo toward the Spaniards on Tidore. Tristao de Atayde sacked Jailolo in 1533, but Katarabumi seized power afterward and made its stone fort the strongest obstacle to European entry into Halmahera; local tradition also credits him with a script for the local language. Bernaldim de Sousa and Sultan Hairun of Ternate starved the fort into surrender in 1551. Katarabumi took poison the next year, and Jailolo became a Ternatan vassal paying tribute in sago. The royal title survived defeat. Sultan Nuku of Tidore revived it for Muhammad Arif Bila in 1804, but Dutch power returned to the region and Arif Bila died in the Halmahera forest. His brother Hajuddin was proclaimed sultan after 1818 and led raiding fleets that Dutch expeditions could not catch in 1819 and 1820.
zh:
哈马黑拉在早期欧洲地图上称吉洛洛或贾伊洛洛，是摩鹿加最大的岛屿，却不如西海岸外盛产丁香的特尔纳特和蒂多雷两岛引人注目。贾伊洛洛湾畔立着「摩鹿加四山」四大王国之一，君主称吉卡马科拉诺，即「海湾之主」，位次曾在特尔纳特、蒂多雷和巴坎之上。科马洛·普洛1377年至1432年统治特尔纳特期间夺取哈马黑拉村庄，也夺走这一首席地位。腹地的泛灵社群由一位能取得高地黄金的「巴布亚拉惹」统辖；岛上林间有野丁香，西谷米则随香料贸易外运。1444年，贾伊洛洛仍守旧礼。

15世纪末，传教士马哈德姆使国王优素福皈依。1512年，弗朗西斯科·塞拉昂抵达特尔纳特；葡萄牙人在那里设立据点后，贾伊洛洛转向驻在蒂多雷的西班牙人。1533年，特里斯唐·德·阿泰德洗劫贾伊洛洛，但卡塔拉布米随后夺取政权，把石堡变成欧洲人进入哈马黑拉的最大阻碍；当地传说还称他为当地语言创制文字。1551年，贝尔纳丁·德·索萨和特尔纳特苏丹哈伦以围城耗尽守军粮草。卡塔拉布米次年服毒，贾伊洛洛成为特尔纳特附庸，以西谷米纳贡。王号没有随战败消失。1804年，蒂多雷苏丹努库拥立穆罕默德·阿里夫·比拉恢复王号；荷兰人重新控制这一海域后，阿里夫·比拉死于哈马黑拉山林。1818年后，其弟哈朱丁被拥立为苏丹，率领船队袭扰，1819年和1820年的荷兰远征都没能追上他。

en:
Ternate is a small island dominated by the volcano Gamalama, and its cloves made its kolano one of the richest rulers in the Moluccas. Migrants from Halmahera had united its villages under one king by 1257, and in the 1400s Ternate subdued the Sula Islands and Seram and shipped cloves to China and Java; Javanese and Chinese merchants kept their own quarters by the shore. Across a narrow stretch of sea lay Tidore, also thick with clove trees, and the two islands spent their wealth warring against each other. In 1444 Ternate still kept the old Moluccan rites, though Muslim traders already lived in the port. Zainal Abidin, who ruled from 1486 to 1500, was its first ruler to take the title sultan and make Islamic law the basis of government.

The first Portuguese came as shipwrecked guests. Francisco Serrão, wrecked off Seram, was brought to Ternate in 1512 by Sultan Bayan Sirrullah, who let the Portuguese build Kastela fort from 1522. The friendship ended in blood: they deposed Sultan Tabariji in 1535, and in 1570 murdered Sultan Hairun and displayed his head on a pike. His son Baabullah besieged Kastela for five years and took it in 1575, making the fort his palace, and under him Ternate's power ran from Ambon and the Bandas to parts of Mindanao. Francis Drake called in 1579 aboard the Golden Hind and was feasted by the sultan, but he bought almost no cloves, his hold already crammed with gold taken from Spanish treasure ships.

A Spanish fleet conquered the island in 1606 and exiled its sultan to Manila, and the Dutch built Fort Malayo the next year and backed a rival claimant, so that Ternate stayed split between the two powers until Spain withdrew in 1663. Sultans Hamzah and Mandar Syah ceded outlying islands to the Dutch East India Company in return for its help against rebels, and Ternate became a client of the Company. The British held the island from 1810 until its return to the Netherlands in 1817.
zh:
特尔纳特是一座以加马拉马火山为主的小岛，岛上出产的丁香让它的科兰诺成为摩鹿加最富有的统治者之一。来自哈马黑拉的移民到1257年已把诸村统一于一位君王；15世纪里特尔纳特征服苏拉群岛和斯兰岛，把丁香销往中国和爪哇，爪哇和中国商人在岸边各有聚居区。窄海对面的蒂多雷也遍植丁香，两岛把财富都花在彼此攻战上。1444年，特尔纳特仍奉行摩鹿加旧礼，港中却已有穆斯林商人。1486年至1500年在位的扎伊纳尔·阿比丁是第一位称苏丹的统治者，他以伊斯兰教法为治国之本。

最早的葡萄牙人是以沉船遇难者的身份到来的。1512年，在斯兰岛外海沉船的弗朗西斯科·塞朗被巴彦·西鲁拉苏丹接到特尔纳特，1522年起苏丹允许葡萄牙人修建卡斯特拉堡。这场交谊以流血告终：1535年葡萄牙人废黜塔巴里吉苏丹，1570年又杀害海伦苏丹，把他的头颅挑在矛尖上示众。其子巴布乌拉围攻卡斯特拉堡五年，1575年破城后把堡垒改成自己的王宫；在他治下，特尔纳特的势力从安汶、班达群岛一直延伸到棉兰老部分地区。1579年，弗朗西斯·德雷克乘「金鹿号」到访，受到苏丹盛宴款待，却几乎没买丁香，他的船舱早已塞满从西班牙宝船上劫来的黄金。

1606年西班牙舰队征服全岛，把苏丹流放马尼拉；荷兰人次年修筑马来尤堡，另立一位争位者，特尔纳特由两国分据，直到1663年西班牙撤离。哈姆扎和曼达尔·夏两位苏丹以边远岛屿换取荷兰东印度公司出兵平乱，特尔纳特沦为公司的附庸。1810年至1817年英国一度占据该岛，随后交还荷兰。

en:
Tidore is a single volcanic cone rising from the sea, an hour's sail south of its rival Ternate, and its cloves drew the same Malay and Chinese prahus. Its kolano, the King of the Mountain, held southern Halmahera, Buru and the islands off the Papuan coast; tradition says a Tidore expedition reached New Guinea in 1453 with the Papuan sea captain Gurabesi of Waigeo and bound the Raja Ampat lords of Waigeo and Salawati to the court. The two rivals were also kin, for Tidore's princesses married Ternate's sultans, giving the Tidore court a ritual standing its fleets could not always match. In 1444 the court still kept the old Moluccan cults. Islam reached the elite only in the 1460s and 1470s, when the Arab preacher Syekh Mansur converted the ninth king, Ciri Leliatu, who took the name Jamaluddin.

In November 1521 the survivors of Magellan's expedition reached Tidore, and Sultan al-Mansur loaded their ships with cloves and took Spain as his ally against the Portuguese of Ternate. The wars went against Tidore for decades, and after Baabullah of Ternate broke with the Portuguese the court changed sides and let them build a fort on its island in 1578. A Spanish-Tidore army conquered Ternate in 1606, and Spain kept forts on Tidore until it withdrew from the Moluccas in 1663. Sultan Saifuddin (r. 1657-1689) then kept his kingdom largely independent, spending Dutch payments for its cloves on gifts that held the outer islands to his court.

The Company's extirpatie undid him: Dutch parties felled clove trees outside the licensed plots, and the island grew poor. A treaty of 1780 reduced Tidore to a vassal, and Prince Nuku fled the same year. From Gebe he gathered Papuan and Halmaheran followers, at one point assembling 300 prahus, and fought the Dutch for a generation with British arms. He took Tidore in 1797, was enthroned as Sultan Muhammad al-Mabus Amiruddin and restored the old sultanate of Jailolo; in 1801 his men helped the British storm Ternate. After his death in 1805 his brother lost the island and died in exile in 1810, and the Dutch reoccupied the Moluccas in 1817.
zh:
蒂多雷是一座拔海而起的锥形火山岛，在劲敌特尔纳特以南仅一小时航程，岛上的丁香同样吸引着马来和中国快船。它的科兰诺号称「山之王」，领有南哈马黑拉、布鲁和巴布亚沿岸诸岛；相传1453年，一支蒂多雷远征队在瓦伊盖奥的巴布亚船主引领下到达新几内亚，把瓦伊盖奥、萨拉瓦蒂等拉贾安帕特（四王）诸小王绑在宫廷一边。两个对头之间也有姻亲，蒂多雷的公主常嫁给特尔纳特的苏丹，这给了蒂多雷宫廷一种舰队未必撑得起的礼制地位。1444年的宫廷仍奉行摩鹿加旧俗。伊斯兰教迟至1460至1470年代才进入统治层：阿拉伯传教师谢赫·曼苏尔使第九代王西里·莱利亚图皈依，后者取了穆斯林名字贾马卢丁。

1521年11月，麦哲伦远征队的幸存者抵达蒂多雷，曼苏尔苏丹用丁香装满他们的船，与西班牙结盟对抗盘踞特尔纳特的葡萄牙人。此后数十年战事多对蒂多雷不利；特尔纳特的巴布乌拉与葡萄牙反目后，蒂多雷宫廷反而改换阵营，于1578年允许葡萄牙人在岛上筑堡。1606年西班牙与蒂多雷联军攻克特尔纳特，西班牙在蒂多雷保有要塞，直到1663年撤出摩鹿加。赛夫丁苏丹（1657—1689年在位）治下，王国大体保持独立，他把荷兰人收购丁香的货款换成礼物，维系外岛首领对宫廷的效忠。

荷兰东印度公司的除树政策改变了局面：公司的队伍砍光特许种植区之外的丁香树，岛上日渐穷困。1780年的条约把蒂多雷降为附庸，王子努库同年出逃。他在格贝岛集结巴布亚和哈马黑拉部众，一度聚起三百艘快船，又凭英国军火与荷兰人周旋了二十余年。1797年他攻占蒂多雷，登基称苏丹，并恢复了古老的贾伊洛洛（Jailolo）苏丹国；1801年他的部众助英军攻下特尔纳特。1805年努库死去，其弟守不住该岛，于1810年流亡而亡，荷兰人在1817年重新占领摩鹿加。

en:
The Sulu islands run between Borneo, Mindanao and Palawan, and Jolo sits among the sea lanes carrying Chinese goods, Bornean forest produce and spices from the Moluccas. Tausug traders and fishermen lived around its harbours, while the shoals off the islands were prized for pearls. Arab teachers reached the area in the 14th century; Karim ul-Makhdum is said to have built the first mosque in the Philippines on Simunul in 1380. Sulu genealogies name Sharif ul-Hashim as the first sultan and place his court at Buansa, near Jolo, giving 1405 or 1457 as the year. In 1444 Jolo was a Muslim port ruled from the settlements around Buansa, the polity that Sulu tradition calls the early sultanate. Its contacts reached Ming China: in 1417 Paduka Pahala, the East King, sailed to the Yongle Emperor with the West King and the Cave King, died on the return journey, and was buried at Dezhou in Shandong.

Sulu's later power rested on war fleets as much as cargoes. Tausug, Iranun and Banguingui crews sailed lanong and garay warships into the Visayas and across the Sulu Sea, bringing captives to Jolo's slave market and exchanging them for weapons and cloth. From Zamboanga, Spain fought the sultanate for centuries, while Sulu held the island passages and gave up Palawan only in 1705. The islands had earlier accepted Bruneian overlordship and broke away in 1578; in 1658 Brunei granted Sulu lands on the northeast coast of Borneo for aid in a civil war, the basis of the later claim to Sabah. Trade with Qing China revived between 1726 and 1733. Alexander Dalrymple then occupied Balambangan for the East India Company in 1763. A company factory was planted there in 1773 and destroyed in 1775; the second British attempt, begun in 1803, was abandoned two years later.
zh:
苏禄群岛伸展在婆罗洲、棉兰老和巴拉望之间，霍洛正处在中国货物、婆罗洲林产与摩鹿加香料往来的海路上。陶苏格商人、渔民环港而居，岛外浅滩又以珍珠闻名。14世纪，阿拉伯教士来到群岛；据说卡里姆·马克敦1380年在锡穆努尔岛建起菲律宾第一座清真寺。苏禄谱系把谢里夫·哈希姆称为第一代苏丹，说他的王廷在霍洛附近的布安萨，建国时间则有1405年和1457年两说。1444年的霍洛已是穆斯林港市，由布安萨一带的政权统治，苏禄传统将其视为早期苏丹国。它同明朝也有往来：1417年，东王巴都葛·叭哈喇与西王、峒王一同朝见永乐帝，归国途中病逝，安葬在山东德州。

苏禄后来称雄，靠商船，也靠战船。陶苏格、伊拉农和巴京吉水手驾驶兰农、加莱战船进入米沙鄢并横行苏禄海，把俘虏带到霍洛奴隶市场，再换取武器和布匹。西班牙人以三宝颜为据点，同苏丹国打了数百年；苏禄则守住岛间水道，直到1705年才让出巴拉望。苏禄早先曾臣服文莱，1578年脱离；1658年，文莱为酬答苏禄援助内战，把婆罗洲东北沿岸土地赐给它，这成为后来沙巴主权主张的依据。1726年至1733年，苏禄恢复了对清朝的贸易。亚历山大·达尔林普尔随后在1763年替英国东印度公司占领巴兰邦岸岛；公司1773年在岛上设立商馆，1775年商馆被毁，1803年再度尝试，两年后又告放弃。

en:
The Cotabato basin is the floodplain of the Pulangi, the great river of Mindanao, whose delta channels run through mangrove and rice land to Illana Bay. In 1444 Maguindanaon and Iranun fishermen and traders lived along these banks, with the Teduray in the nearby hills, all keeping their ancestral cults. Malay and Chinese junks already put in for wax and forest produce, and the river chiefs looked across the water to Muslim Brunei and Johor. No sultan yet ruled the valley.

Islam and the sultanate arrived together with Sharif Kabungsuwan of Johor, who married local princesses and in 1515 founded the Sultanate of Maguindanao, first seated at Tubok. Local tradition keeps the story of the brothers Tabunaway and Mamalu: when Tabunaway accepted the new faith and went down to the river plain, Mamalu kept the old ways and withdrew to the hills, and their vow of kinship became the unwritten peace between Maguindanaons and Teduray. Spain twice reached for the valley and was bloodied. An expedition of 1579 came to nothing, and in 1596 Esteban Rodríguez de Figueroa, holder of the royal grant to conquer Mindanao, was beaten at Buayan and killed in an ambush. The valley's great ruler was Muhammad Dipatuan Kudarat (r. c. 1619–1671): under him allied raiding fleets harried the Visayas and the spread of Catholicism on Mindanao was halted, and war praus sent from his ally Ternate in the Moluccas fought beside him. In 1637 Governor Corcuera stormed his river capital of Lamitan, but Kudarat escaped to the hills and recovered all he had lost when the Spaniards withdrew in 1663. His later successors ceded Palawan to Spain and moved the royal seat to Tamontaka; the Spanish rebuilding of Fort Pilar at Zamboanga opened a long decline, and in the 1730s civil war split the valley between rival courts at Buayan and Cotabato.
zh:
哥打巴托盆地是棉兰老大河普兰吉河的冲积平原，三角洲上的河汊穿过红树林与稻田，注入伊拉纳湾。1444年，马京达瑙人和伊农人在河畔渔猎贸易，特杜赖人居住在附近山地，都奉行祖先旧俗。马来和中国的帆船已来此收购蜂蜡和山林物产，河畔诸首领则与穆斯林的文莱、柔佛隔海相望，河谷里还没有苏丹。

伊斯兰与苏丹国一同随柔佛的谢里夫·卡本苏安到来：他娶了当地首领之女，于1515年创立马京达瑙苏丹国，最初定都图博。当地流传着塔布纳韦与马马卢兄弟的故事：塔布纳韦皈依新教、走下河谷平原，马马卢坚守旧俗、退入山中，二人不失亲情的誓约，成了马京达瑙人与特杜赖人之间不成文的和约。西班牙人两次进兵河谷都遭重创：1579年的远征无功而返；1596年，获封棉兰老征服权的埃斯特万·罗德里格斯·德·菲格罗阿在布亚延兵败，又死于伏击。河谷最了不起的君主是穆罕默德·迪帕图安·库达拉特（约1619—1671年在位）：他治下盟军的袭掠船队让米沙鄢沿岸不得安宁，天主教在棉兰老的传播也被挡住，盟友摩鹿加的特尔纳特还派来战船助战。1637年，总督科尔奎拉攻破他在河畔的都城拉米坦，库达拉特却逃入山中，并在1663年西班牙撤军后收复全部失地。他身后的苏丹把巴拉望割让给西班牙，王都迁往塔蒙塔卡；西班牙人重建三宝颜的皮拉尔堡，开启了苏丹国的长期衰落，1730年代的内战又把河谷分裂为布亚延与哥打巴托两庭相争。

en:
Lanao is the country of Lake Lanao, the great lake of central Mindanao, whose waters drain north through the Agus river. The Maranao, the 'people of the lake', built their tall-roofed torogan houses along the shore, grew rice on the surrounding plains, cast brass and carried it downriver to trade with the Maguindanaon of the Pulangi. In 1444 they still kept the old ways sung in the Darangen, an oral epic of seventeen cycles and some 72,000 lines that preserves their pre-Islamic life; no preacher had yet reached the lake, and no sultan ruled its chiefs.

Islam came up the valley from Maguindanao with Sharif Makaalang, the Maranao son of Sharif Kabungsuwan, and for generations the two lands chose their common ruler in rotation. The bond broke in 1616, when Datu Kudarat took the sultanate for himself against the Maranao turn. Balindong B'sar of Masiu gathered the lake lords at Taraka, and the four states of Bayabao, Masiu, Unayan and Balo-i seceded as the Confederate States of Lanao, though Maranao oarsmen and fighters still strengthened the Maguindanao fleet against Spain. On 4 April 1639 Governor Corcuera sent Francisco de Atienza and the missionary Agustín de San Pedro against the lake with Boholano troops, and the garrison planted the year after was stormed and destroyed by the Maranao. No Spaniard held the lake again for 250 years. The lakeside settlement of Dansalan, at the northern end of the lake and the seed of later Marawi, was first recorded by the Spanish in 1689.
zh:
拉瑙是棉兰老腹地拉瑙湖一带的国度，湖水经阿古斯河北泄入海。马拉瑙人，即「湖畔之民」，沿湖岸建起高脊飞檐的托罗甘大宅，在周围平原种稻、铸造黄铜，再顺河而下与普兰吉河流域的马京达瑙人交易。1444年，他们仍奉行古老的旧俗，这些礼俗由《达兰根》吟唱流传：这部口传长诗分为十七章、约七万二千行，保存着伊斯兰传入以前的马拉瑙人生活；那时没有传教师涉足湖区，也没有苏丹统辖诸首领。

伊斯兰随谢里夫·卡本苏安的马拉瑙人之子谢里夫·马卡朗从马京达瑙河谷传来，此后两地长期按轮替惯例共推一位君主。1616年纽带断裂：达图·库达拉特不顾轮到马拉瑙人的旧例自取苏丹之位，马西乌的一位首领在塔腊卡召集湖区首领，巴亚包、马西乌、乌纳扬、巴洛伊四邦就此独立，结成拉瑙四邦同盟；但对西班牙作战时，马拉瑙的桨手和战士仍为马京达瑙的船队添力。1639年4月4日，总督科尔奎拉派弗朗西斯科·德·阿蒂恩萨和传教士阿古斯丁·德·圣佩德罗率保和兵进犯湖区，次年设立的西班牙要塞旋即被马拉瑙人攻陷摧毁，此后二百五十年间再无西班牙人在湖区立足。湖北端的湖畔聚落丹沙兰是后来马拉维的前身，最早于1689年为西班牙人记载。

en:
Samar is the third-largest island of the Philippines and the eastern edge of the Visayas, a wet, jungle-cloaked land facing the open Pacific. At its northern tip the island and the Bicol peninsula of Luzon pinch the San Bernardino Strait, the narrow passage between the Philippine Sea and the Samar Sea. Its Waray people lived in coastal chiefdoms such as Laoang, Palapag and Sulat; early Spaniards saw datus rowed out to their ships by oarsmen collared in gold, and heard the island called Ibabao or Tandaya, which Pigafetta wrote down as Zamal. Samar lay a little off the main China-Maluku lane and traded mostly in gold and beeswax. In 1444 it knew no sultan and no foreign master, only rival datus and the anito rites.

On 16 March 1521 Magellan's fleet, sailing from the Marianas, made Samar the first Philippine land it sighted, and the next day the crews landed at Homonhon to take water; Pigafetta named the archipelago San Lazaro. In 1543 the Villalobos expedition gave Samar and Leyte the name Filipinas, after the prince who became Philip II, a name that later passed to the whole colony. After 1565 the galleons returning from Acapulco made landfall at Cape Espiritu Santo on Samar's northeast coast and threaded the San Bernardino Strait on the last leg to Manila, yet Spanish rule on the island itself only began with the first missions in 1596, and Samar was long run from Cebu. On 1 June 1649 the Waray leader Agustin Sumuroy killed the friar at Palapag and raised a revolt against the forced-labor levy that sent islanders to the Cavite shipyards; the rising ran across the Visayas and into Mindanao before it was put down in 1650. Samar was joined to Leyte in 1735 with Carigara as capital and split off again in 1768. In 1821 it remained a poor, storm-beaten province of friar parishes and scattered coastal towns.
zh:
萨马是菲律宾第三大岛，也是米沙鄢的最东缘，一座湿润的丛林之岛直面开阔的太平洋。岛的北端与吕宋的比科尔半岛夹着圣贝纳迪诺海峡，这是菲律宾海与萨马海之间的狭窄水道。岛上的瓦瑞人分属拉旺、帕拉帕格、苏拉特等沿海达图领地；早期西班牙人看到达图由颈戴金圈的桨手划船出迎，听到此岛叫伊巴奥或坦达亚，皮加费塔则记作扎马尔。萨马稍稍偏离中国到摩鹿加的主航道，贸易以金和蜂蜡为主。1444年的萨马既无苏丹，也无外来宗主，只有相互争雄的达图和阿尼托祖灵祭祀。

1521年3月16日，从马里亚纳群岛驶来的麦哲伦船队把萨马作为望见的第一块菲律宾土地，次日船员在霍蒙洪岛登陆取水，皮加费塔将这片群岛命名为圣拉扎罗。1543年，维拉洛沃斯探险队以后来成为腓力二世的王子之名，把萨马和莱特称作「菲律宾」，这个名字日后才扩及整个殖民地。1565年后，从阿卡普尔科返航的大帆船先在萨马东北岸的埃斯皮里图桑托角靠岸，再穿过圣贝纳迪诺海峡走完前往马尼拉的最后一程；但岛上的西班牙统治迟至1596年随首批传教士到来才开始，萨马长期由宿雾管辖。1649年6月1日，瓦瑞人首领阿古斯丁·苏莫罗伊在帕拉帕格杀死修士，起兵反抗强征服役，当时岛民被征往甲米地船场做工；起义席卷米沙鄢并蔓延到棉兰老，直到1650年才被镇压。1735年萨马与莱特合并，以卡里加拉为首府，1768年又重新分设。1821年时，它仍是个贫穷、常遭风暴的省份，散布着修士教区和沿海小镇。

en:
Southern Palawan faces the Sulu Sea, and off its tip lies Balabac, the last island before the island-studded passage to Borneo. Tagbanwa, Palaw'an and Batak groups kept to the interior forests and their ancestral anito rites; Islamized Molbog farmers held the far south, and Malay-speaking traders ran the coasting trade to Borneo and Sulu. The older orbit of Ma-i and its vassal Sandao, known from Chinese records, had given way to Brunei's maritime empire, though Sulu datus held most of the immediate power along the shore. In 1444 the island provisioned passing ships with rice, coconuts and sugarcane, but the sultan's authority ran thin among the interior hills.

In 1521 the starving survivors of Magellan's expedition reached the island they called Pulaoan, and Pigafetta named it la terra de missione, the land of promise. A local datu sealed friendship with a blood compact and sent out rice cooked in bamboo tubes, rice wine, bananas, pigs, goats, chickens, coconuts and sugarcane; Pigafetta also noted iron-tipped blowpipes that served as spears when the darts ran out, and roosters kept for cockfighting. Spanish power moved south only slowly. Recollect missions met Muslim resistance in the seventeenth century, and the Spanish built churches enclosed by garrisons, Balabac among them, against raiders from Sulu. The Sultan of Brunei ceded southern Palawan to Spain in 1749. An expedition sent to secure Balabac in 1753 lost 116 men to fever, half its strength, with another 200 sick; its officers reported that the islanders had no king and were hostile to all comers. The south remained a fortified frontier, and an 1818 census found only 4,486 native families and 29 Spanish-Filipino families on Paragua under the Calamianes jurisdiction.
zh:
南巴拉望面朝苏禄海，岛的南端之外是巴拉巴克，再往南就是通往婆罗洲、岛礁密布的航道。塔格巴努阿人、巴拉望人和巴塔克人居于内陆森林，保持祖灵祭祀；伊斯兰化的莫尔博格农人住在最南端，操马来语的商人经营着通往婆罗洲和苏禄的沿岸贸易。中国古籍所记的麻逸及其属国三屿的旧圈已经让位于文莱的海上帝国，沿岸实权却多在苏禄达图手中。1444年，岛上以稻米、椰子和甘蔗补给过往船只，但苏丹的势力很难深入内陆山地。

1521年，饥肠辘辘的麦哲伦船队幸存者抵达他们称作普劳安的岛屿，皮加费塔称之为「应许之地」。当地达图以歃血为盟缔交，送来竹筒饭、米酒、香蕉、猪羊、鸡、椰子和甘蔗；皮加费塔还记下岛民使用铁尖吹箭，射完箭簇后能当长矛，以及养来斗鸡的公鸡。西班牙势力南下缓慢：17世纪雷科莱传教团遭到穆斯林抵抗，西班牙人又在包括巴拉巴克在内的据点修建带驻军的教堂，防备苏禄袭掠者。文莱苏丹于1749年把南巴拉望割让给西班牙。1753年，一支为控制巴拉巴克、清剿苏禄海盗而来的远征队遭热病打击，116人病死，占兵力一半，另有200人病倒；带队军官报告说岛民没有君主，对谁都怀有敌意。南部始终是设防边疆，1818年的普查显示，归卡拉棉管辖的帕拉瓜仅有4486户本地家庭和29户西班牙裔菲律宾家庭。

en:
Maynila occupied the south bank of the Pasig delta, where the river enters Manila Bay. Tondo held the north bank, and the two Tagalog settlements divided the archipelagic sale of Chinese porcelain and silk brought by Fujian junks. Maynila was protected by wooden palisades and ruled by datus. In 1444 its people still followed local animist cults; the Muslim rajahs known from Spanish records belonged to the next century. Marriages with Bruneian families then tied its rulers to the sultan's court, and by 1570 Rajah Matanda and Rajah Sulayman governed a port used by Malay, Tagalog, Chinese and Bornean merchants. Its ramparts carried lantaka bronze guns, some cast by the local smith Panday Piray.

Martin de Goiti's expedition stormed Maynila in 1570 and left the palisaded town in ashes. Miguel Lopez de Legazpi returned with the main Spanish force in 1571; after Sulayman's boats were broken at Bangkusay channel, he proclaimed Manila on 24 June and laid out Intramuros on the old riverbank settlement. The new city became Spain's chief base in the Philippines. From nearby Cavite, Manila galleons carried Chinese silk and porcelain, Moluccan spices and Indian goods to Acapulco, returning with New World silver. Chinese traders were settled in the Parian outside the walls after Limahong's 62 warships failed to take Manila in 1574. During the Seven Years' War, a British army took the city after a siege from September to October 1762 and held it for eighteen months, while Simon de Anda organised Spanish resistance in the provinces; the occupiers withdrew after peace was made. The last galleon sailed in 1815.
zh:
梅尼拉位于巴石河三角洲南岸，河水从这里注入马尼拉湾；北岸则是另一个政体汤都。两地分工经销福建帆船带来的中国瓷器和丝绸，再转卖到群岛各处。梅尼拉以木栅为防，由达图治理。1444年时，居民仍信奉本地泛灵信仰；西班牙记载中的穆斯林拉者要到下个世纪才出现。与文莱家族联姻后，当地统治者同苏丹朝廷建立联系；到1570年，拉者·马塔达和拉者·苏莱曼治下的港口已有马来、他加禄、中国和婆罗洲商人往来，城墙上架着青铜旋炮，其中一些出自本地铁匠潘代·皮雷之手。

1570年，马丁·德·戈伊蒂的远征军攻破梅尼拉，木栅城镇化为灰烬。1571年，米格尔·洛佩斯·德·莱加斯皮率主力返回；苏莱曼的船队在邦库赛海峡被击溃后，他于6月24日宣布建立马尼拉，并在河畔旧地规划王城。马尼拉成为西班牙在菲律宾的主要据点：大帆船从附近的甲米地启航，把中国丝绸瓷器、摩鹿加香料和印度货物运往阿卡普尔科，再载回美洲白银。1574年林凤率六十二艘战船攻城失败，此后中国商人被安置在城墙外的涧内。七年战争期间，英军1762年9月至10月围城后占领马尼拉达十八个月，西蒙·德·安达则在外省组织西班牙抵抗，和约达成后英军撤离。最后一艘大帆船于1815年启航。

en:
The narrow coastal plain caught between the Cordillera mountains and the South China Sea was Samtoy, the Ilocano land: trading towns strung where the highlands meet the shore. Junks from Fujian unloaded porcelain and silk at Vigan, Japanese merchants kept a settlement at Agoo, and the markets carried Cordillera gold, beeswax, cotton and the heavy burnáy stoneware jars used to store rice and wine. The monsoons tied this coast to China, Japan and the Spice Islands, and in 1444 the Ilocanos still lived under their own datus, drawing wealth from the China trade and the gold trails over the mountains behind them.

Juan de Salcedo, Legazpi's grandson, sailed north with eighty men in 1572 and founded Villa Fernandina at Vigan, which became the seat of the diocese of Nueva Segovia; Augustinian friars began the conversion of the coast two years later. Spanish tribute and monopolies bred revolt after revolt. During the British occupation of Manila, Diego Silang, an Ilocano who spoke Spanish well, seized Vigan with British backing, demanded an end to tribute and proclaimed an independent Ilocano state; he was murdered in 1763, and his wife Gabriela, an Itneg highlander, led the rising on until she was taken and hanged at Vigan. The last great rising came from the wine-makers. Basi, the fermented sugar-cane wine of the Ilocos, was placed under a government monopoly, and in 1807 the people of Piddig marched on Vigan until royal troops cut them down at the Bantaoay River. In 1818 Madrid split the province into Ilocos Norte and Ilocos Sur.
zh:
夹在中科迪勒拉山与南海之间的狭长海岸平原，是伊洛卡诺人的萨姆托伊故地，城镇背山面海、连成一串。福建帆船在维甘卸下瓷器和丝绸，日本商人在阿戈设有聚居地，市场上流转着中科迪勒拉山的黄金、蜂蜡、棉布，还有用来存米盛酒的布尔奈粗陶大瓮。季风把这条海岸与中国、日本和香料群岛连在一起；1444年，伊洛卡诺人仍在自己的达图治下，财富来自对华贸易和身后山间的运金小道。

1572年，黎牙实比的外孙胡安·德·萨尔塞多率八十人北上，在维甘建立费尔南迪纳镇，这里后来成为新塞哥维亚主教区驻地；两年后，奥斯定会修士开始在海岸传教。西班牙人的贡赋和专卖激起一次又一次起义。英军占领马尼拉期间，讲一口流利西班牙语的伊洛卡诺人迭戈·西朗借英军支持夺取维甘，要求废除贡赋，宣布建立独立的伊洛卡诺国家；1763年他遇刺身亡，出身伊特内格高地部族的妻子加芙列拉继续领导起义，最终被俘，在维甘被处绞刑。最后一次大起义出自酿酒人。巴锡是伊洛卡诺人的甘蔗发酵酒，被官府列为专卖，1807年皮迪格的酿酒者向维甘进军，被王家军队在班陶伊河畔截杀。1818年，马德里朝廷把伊罗戈分为北伊罗戈与南伊罗戈两省。

en:
Cagayan is the long river valley of northern Luzon, walled between the Cordillera and the Sierra Madre and opening north through marshland to the Babuyan Channel. Ibanag, Itawes, Gaddang and their kin farmed and fished in villages along the river and its tributaries, while the older Atta hunter-gatherers kept to the hills; the shell mounds at Lal-lo and Gattaran record centuries of that river life. Junks from China, Japan and the Indies entered the river mouth along the old Maritime Jade Road, trading porcelain and metalware for gold, beeswax and forest produce. In 1444 the Cagayanes answered only to their own datus.

The Spaniards first traced this coast with Juan de Salcedo in 1572, but the conquest fell to Juan Pablo de Carrión, who entered the valley in 1581 with a hundred soldiers and settler families. The hard fighting was on the north coast, where Japanese wokou had built a riverside stronghold near the river mouth. In 1582 Carrión's outnumbered men stormed the fort of the pirate lord Tay Fusa and drove his bands, part Japanese ronin and part Asian rovers, off Luzon; Spanish firearms carried the day. He founded Nueva Segovia at Lal-lo, garrisoned by Spaniards and soldiers levied in Mexico, and a royal decree of 1583 organised the whole valley as the province of Cagayan, with Ibanag as its common tongue. Dominicans staffed the bishopric created in 1595 and moved the see to Vigan in 1758. By the later eighteenth century tobacco estates were drawing Ilocano settlers up the valley, and the census of 1818 counted at old Nueva Segovia 975 native and 513 Spanish-Filipino families.
zh:
卡加延是吕宋北部的长河谷，西倚中科迪勒拉山、东靠马德雷山，北端穿过沼泽通向巴布延海峡。伊巴纳格人、伊塔韦人、加丹人及其亲族在干支流沿岸的村落里农耕渔捞，更古老的阿塔采猎者则退守山地；拉洛和加塔兰的贝丘记录着千百年的河畔生活。中国、日本和南洋的帆船沿着古老的海上玉石之路驶入河口，用瓷器和金属器换取黄金、蜂蜡和山林物产。1444年，卡加延人只听命于自己的达图。

1572年，西班牙人随胡安·德·萨尔塞多首次巡航这段海岸，但征服河谷的是胡安·巴勃罗·卡里昂：1581年，他带着百名士兵和移民家属进入卡加延。恶战在北海岸，日本倭寇在河口附近的河畔筑起据点。1582年，兵力悬殊的卡里昂所部强攻海盗首领泰·富萨的寨子，把他的队伍（一部分是日本浪人，其余是各处流亡者）逐出吕宋，取胜靠的是西班牙人的火器。卡里昂在拉洛建立新塞哥维亚，由西班牙人和从墨西哥征募的士兵驻守；1583年的王室敕令把整条河谷编为卡加延省，以伊巴纳格语为通用语。1595年设立的主教区交由多明我会主持，1758年主教座迁往维甘。到18世纪后期，烟草种植园把伊洛卡诺移民不断引入河谷；1818年的户口册载，旧新塞哥维亚有975户本地家庭和513户西菲家庭。

en:
The Lingga Islands are a scattered equatorial group between Sumatra and the southern end of the Strait of Malacca. Daik, on Lingga Island, lies beneath Mount Daik, whose three sharp peaks gave the archipelago its name: their profile resembles a Hindu lingam, and Malay poets made the three-toothed mountain an image of endurance. Fishing grounds and sheltered anchorages sustained Malay boatmen on the smaller islands. In 1444 this was a quiet fishing stop on the sea lane from Jambi toward Melaka, valued for fish, fresh water and safe anchorage rather than for a court or fortress.

Later in the fifteenth century Tun Perak, the bendahara of Melaka, brought the Riau Islands into the Malaccan sphere, and after Melaka fell to the Portuguese in 1511 Lingga passed into the maritime empire of Johor. Its importance came suddenly in 1788, when Sultan Mahmud Shah III, refusing to remain a Dutch figurehead, left his capital at Riau on Bintan for Daik with some 2,000 followers, while his bendahara led another 1,000 to Pahang; when the Dutch reached Riau they found only a few Chinese planters. Mahmud laid out houses and roads at Daik, opened tin mines on Singkep and sold tin, gambier and spices to British ships. He died on Lingga in 1812, and the succession split the Johor empire. His elder son Hussein was away marrying in Pahang and missed his father's deathbed, so his half-brother Abdul Rahman was installed; an agreement of 1818 stationed a Dutch garrison at Riau and required Dutch consent for every future sultan. The British answered by crowning Hussein in Singapore as Sultan of Johor.
zh:
林加群岛是苏门答腊与马六甲海峡南口之间一组横跨赤道的岛屿。林加岛上的岱克坐落在岱克山下：山顶三峰峭立，轮廓状如印度教的林伽，群岛也因此得名；马来诗人还把这座三尖山写成坚韧的象征。各小岛的渔场和避风水泊供养着马来船户。1444年，这里只是占碑驶往马六甲航道上一处安静的渔业停靠点，价值在鱼类、淡水和避风港，而非宫廷或要塞。

15世纪后期，马六甲宰相敦霹雳把廖内诸岛纳入马六甲的势力范围；1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙人之手后，林加转归柔佛的海上帝国。1788年，其地位骤然改变：苏丹马哈茂德·沙阿三世不愿继续做荷兰人的傀儡，带着约两千名随从离开民丹岛上的都城廖内，迁到岱克，宰相另率一千人前往彭亨；荷兰人赶到廖内时，只剩几名中国种植园主。马哈茂德在岱克营建房屋道路，在新及岛开采锡矿，把锡、甘密和香料卖给英国商船。1812年他在林加去世，继承之争把柔佛帝国一分为二：长子东姑胡先正在彭亨成婚，未能赶回父亲临终的床前，异母弟东姑阿都拉曼被拥立继位；1818年的条约使荷兰人在廖内驻军，并规定此后每任苏丹继位都须经荷兰同意。英国人则把胡先迎到新加坡加冕，立为柔佛苏丹。

en:
Sipsong Panna, 'twelve rice-plain districts', is the Tai Lü country on the upper Mekong, here called the Lancang, where the capital Chiang Hung, the 'city of dawn' later named Jinghong, straddles the river. Around 1180 the chieftain Paya Chueang unified the neighbouring mueang and founded a kingdom whose sway once reached Kengtung and Chiang Saen. The Mongols entered the valley in the 1290s, and in 1296 the Yuan installed the Cheli native office under the Dao line, who kept it for centuries. Dai chronicles date the white stupa group at Manfeilong, south of Chiang Hung, to 1204, one of the oldest Theravada monuments in the valley. In 1382 the chao phaendin Dao Kan submitted to the Ming and was recognised two years later as pacification commissioner of Cheli. In 1444 this Buddhist land of wet-rice plains and forest tea gardens, where the Six Tea Mountains later fed the Pu'er trade, lay under loose Ming overlordship, while just to the north Wang Ji's armies were marching on Mong Mao in the second Luchuan campaign.

After Bayinnaung's Burmese made Lanna a vassal in 1558, Chiang Hung became in the 1560s a joint tributary of Burma and the Ming, each new ruler installed at a ceremony attended by both, and in 1570 the local chao phaendin divided his domain into twelve banna. The Qing tightened their hold in 1729, detaching the six banna east of the Mekong into the new Pu'er Prefecture, through which the hill tea grown by Tai Lü and Bulang villagers was carried north to fame as Pu'er tea. Sipsong Panna then became the battleground of the Qing-Konbaung war of 1765-1769, and the fighting emptied many villages. Around the turn of the nineteenth century the Siamese king Rama I and Kawila of Chiang Mai sent armies to raid Chiang Hung and carry its people south, and the Tai Lü villages of Nan and Chiang Mai descend in part from these captives; the Tai Lü court at Jinghong nevertheless kept its tusi rank to the end of the period.
zh:
西双版纳，傣语意为「十二千田」，是傣仂人在澜沧江（湄公河上游）沿岸居住的坝子之地，首府景洪傣语意为「黎明之城」，跨江而立。1180年前后，首领叭真（帕雅真）统一各勐，建立景陇金殿国，势力一度远达景栋、清盛。13世纪90年代蒙古军进入滇南，1296年元朝设彻里军民总管府，以刀氏世袭总管。据傣文史料，景洪以南的曼飞龙白塔建于1204年，是滇南最早的上座部佛教塔群之一。1382年召片领刀坎归附明朝，两年后受封为车里军民宣慰使。1444年，这个种稻植茶、信奉上座部佛教的地方处在明朝松散统辖之下，后来供应普洱茶的六大茶山就在其境内；北面王骥二征麓川的大军正在征讨孟卯。

1558年缅甸东吁王朝莽应龙使兰纳称臣，16世纪60年代景洪又沦为缅甸与明朝共同的朝贡之地，新召片领即位须由两方使者共同到场主持；1570年，第二十四世召片领召应勐将三十多个勐整编为十二个版纳。清朝于1729年加强控制，把澜沧江以东六个版纳划归新设的普洱府，傣仂、布朗村民种植的山茶经此北运，成就了普洱茶的名声。1765年至1769年，西双版纳成为清缅战争的战场，许多村落为之一空。18世纪末19世纪初，暹罗国王拉玛一世和清迈王迦威罗派军劫掠景洪，把人口掳往南方，难府和清迈的傣仂村落有不少是这些人的后裔；景洪的傣仂朝廷仍保有清朝土司之位，一直延续到本时期之末。

en:
Dali lies on a narrow shelf of farmland between the Cangshan range and Erhai Lake, the old country of the Bai people. In 738 Piluoge united the six zhao around the lake with Tang backing and founded Nanzhao; his successors moved the capital to Yangjumie, on the site of old Dali, in 779. Tang armies sent against Nanzhao in the 750s were destroyed, though the Cangshan oath of 794 restored good terms. Duan Siping founded the Dali kingdom at Yangjumie in 937. Its Bai court sold horses to the Song, who were content to draw their border at the Dadu River and leave Dali alone; Buddhism ran so deep that of the kingdom's twenty-two kings, seven abdicated to become monks. Chongsheng Temple was the royal temple, and its three pagodas, led by the ninth-century Qianxun Pagoda, rose north of the town. Kublai's Mongol army conquered Dali in 1253, after which the Duan family ruled on as hereditary governors under the Yuan. Ming forces under Lan Yu and Mu Ying took the city in 1382, carried the last Duan governor away to Nanjing, and built the walled town later called Dali Old Town. In 1444 it was a Bai-speaking frontier prefecture and a Buddhist market town on the Yunnan caravan routes.

Horse caravans carried tea, salt and silk from Dali toward Tibet along the Tea Horse Road, while the Bonan Road ran west from Xiaguan through Yongping to Baoshan and the lands beyond the Yunnan border. The most famous local cargo was the veined Dali stone, so widely admired that Chinese borrowed the town's name for the rock itself. In 1515 an earthquake split the Qianxun Pagoda from top to bottom; local records say an aftershock ten days later closed the crack again. The prefecture passed from Southern Ming resistance to the Qing in 1659, and through the eighteenth century the walled town kept its place as an administrative and caravan centre for the Bai people beside Erhai.
zh:
大理在苍山与洱海之间的一片平地上，是白族世代居住的地方。738年，蒙舍诏首领皮罗阁在唐朝支持下统一洱海六诏，建立南诏；779年南诏迁都羊苴咩城，城址就在后来的大理旧城。750年代唐朝三次出兵南诏都告失败，794年南诏王异牟寻与唐使在苍山会盟，双方恢复和好。937年，段思平在羊苴咩城建立大理国。大理宫廷以白族贵族为主，向宋朝市易马匹，宋朝也乐于以大渡河为界、互不打扰；佛教在这里极盛，大理国二十二代国王中，有七代禅位出家。崇圣寺是王家寺院，寺前三塔中最大的千寻塔建于9世纪，矗立在城北。1253年忽必烈率蒙古军攻灭大理，段氏转而出任元朝的世袭大理总管。1382年，蓝玉、沐英率明军攻占大理，把末代总管执送南京，并修筑了后世所称的大理古城。1444年的大理，是白语居民的边地府城、佛教市镇，也是云南马帮商路上的一站。

马帮从大理出发，沿茶马古道把茶、盐和丝织品驮往西藏；博南古道则由下关向西，经永平抵达保山，再接云南边外的路。最有名的本地货是带天然纹理的大理石，受人珍爱到汉语直接借大理的地名来称呼这种石料。1515年地震把千寻塔自上而下震裂，地方志记载，十天后的余震又让裂缝合拢。1659年，大理府从南明抵抗势力手中转入清朝；整个18世纪，这座洱海旁的城垣仍是白族地区的行政中心和马帮商镇。

en:
This province centres on Kunming, on the plain north of Dian Lake. The Dian kingdom rose around the lake before Han armies took it as Yizhou Commandery in 109 BC, and in 765 Nanzhao built its eastern city of Tuodong here. The Mongols took it in 1254, and in 1276 the Yunnan Branch Secretariat made Zhongqing, as Kunming was called, the provincial capital, replacing Dali as the centre of Yunnan. The Ming conquest of 1381 and 1382, led by Fu Youde, Lan Yu and Mu Ying, overthrew the Mongol Prince of Liang; a brick walled city went up, and Mu Ying and his heirs garrisoned the southwest for the Ming from Kunming. One boy caught in that conquest was Ma He, born to a Hui family at Kunyang on the Dian shore. Castrated and posted to the household of the Prince of Yan, he took the name Zheng He and from 1405 commanded the seven treasure voyages to the Indian Ocean. In 1444 Wang Ji's second campaign against the Luchuan tusi was drawing Yunnan's guards and native chiefs into a frontier war beyond the prefecture's western approaches.

Wang Ji's third campaign of 1449 broke Luchuan but tied down Ming armies for years. At the Ming collapse the Yongli Emperor of the Southern Ming made Kunming his last capital, until Wu Sangui's Qing army entered Yunnan in 1659 and he fled into Burma; in 1662 Wu had him strangled in Kunming and enlarged his own princely palace there. When the court moved to cut down the feudatories in 1673, Wu raised his rebellion from Kunming, and Qing troops did not recover the city until 1681. Under the high Qing, Yunnan lived on copper: by 1725 its mints ran forty-seven furnaces, and after Ortai's reforms of 1726 Yunnan cash coins sold profitably to other provinces while Dian copper fed mints across the empire. The Golden Horse and Jade Rooster memorial archways, first raised in the Xuande reign, were destroyed in the 1657 fighting and rebuilt in 1687. By the early nineteenth century Kunming was a fortified provincial capital and copper market at the head of the caravan routes to Southeast Asia.
zh:
这片地区以滇池北岸的昆明为中心。滇国曾在湖畔兴起，公元前109年被汉军并入益州郡；765年南诏在这里筑起东面的拓东城。1254年蒙古军取城，1276年云南行中书省以中庆（昆明）为省会，昆明便取代大理成为云南的政治中心。1381至1382年，傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率明军攻灭元梁王政权，随后修筑砖城，沐英及其后裔便世代镇守云南，驻地就在昆明。在这场战事中被掳走的男孩马和，出生在滇池南岸昆阳的一个回族家庭；他受阉后被分派到燕王府，后来改名郑和，1405年起率领船队七下西洋，远航印度洋。1444年，王骥第二次征讨麓川土司，云南各卫所和土司都被卷入府城以西的边疆战争。

1449年王骥第三次出征压下麓川，也把明军多年拖在西南。明末，南明永历帝以昆明为最后的都城；1659年吴三桂率清军入滇，永历帝逃入缅甸，1662年被吴三桂绞杀于昆明，吴三桂又在城中大修平西王府。1673年朝廷议撤藩，吴三桂在昆明起兵，直到1681年清军才收复城池。清代盛期，云南靠铜矿支撑：1725年省内铸钱局开着47座炼炉；1726年鄂尔泰整顿铸务后，云南制钱销往外省仍有厚利，滇铜还供应全国许多钱局。金马、碧鸡两座牌坊初建于宣德年间，1657年毁于兵火，1687年重建。到19世纪初，昆明已是墙垣坚固的云南省会和滇铜集散地，马帮商路从这里通向东南亚。

en:
Guangnan sits in the karst hills of south-eastern Yunnan, where tracks run toward Guangxi and the Annamese frontier. The Yuan opened a pacification office here in 1275, and the Ming replaced it with Guangnan Prefecture in 1382. The new prefecture was not run like an interior county. The Nong clan, traditionally held to descend from Nong Zhigao, supplied hereditary native assistant prefects and kept their native office in the prefectural town. In 1444 Guangnan was therefore a Ming border prefecture whose Zhuang lords kept most local authority in their own hands.

The fall of the Southern Ming brought the Yongli emperor's wandering court through these hills. Princess Anhua, one of his sisters, was left behind either at Guichao in Fuzhou or at Gerong near Guangnan; local tradition says she died of grief after the emperor was killed. At Gerong villagers raised her tomb and the Imperial Aunt Temple and kept an annual rite called Receiving the Imperial Aunt. The Qing placed the prefecture under appointed officials in 1661, added former Vimo lands in 1669, and in 1736 established Baoning County in the same walled town.
zh:
广南位于云南东南的喀斯特山地，山路通往广西和安南边地。元至元十二年（1275年）设广南西路宣抚司，明洪武十五年（1382年）改置广南府。这座边府并不按内地州县的方式治理：侬氏土司相传为侬智高后裔，明代世袭土同知，衙署就设在府城中。1444年的广南由壮族侬氏首领掌握大部分地方权力，是明朝以土官治理的边府。

南明败亡时，永历帝的流亡朝廷往来于这片山地。安化郡主是永历帝的姐妹，途中被留在富州皈朝或广南革农村；相传永历帝被杀后，她因悲痛而逝。革农村乡民为她建墓和皇姑庙，每年举行「接皇姑」祭祀。清顺治十八年（1661年），广南府改派流官；康熙八年（1669年）划入原维摩州地；乾隆元年（1736年），又在这座筑城之地设宝宁县。

en:
Lingyun lies in the forested mountains of northwestern Guangxi, where Zhuang stockaded villages hold the tracks leading toward Yunnan and Guizhou. The Song created Sicheng Subprefecture here in 1053 after the defeat of Nong Zhigao. Under the Ming the Cen, a Zhuang native-official house, moved the seat to Gukandong, the later Sicheng town, and Sicheng became a subprefecture directly under the provincial government; in 1409 Cen Zicheng, son of the native officer Cen Shanzhong, was put over the newly established Shanglin Chief's Office. In 1444 the Ming court still ruled these hills through the Cen family rather than through appointed magistrates, and its commissions reached farther than its day-to-day power.

The Cen chieftains used that room to fight their own wars. Under the Chenghua reign Sicheng's Cen Bao attacked Shanglin and drove its administration west into Guangnan, and in 1490 Cen Ying occupied eighteen fortified places in Shanglin and Zhenning in Guizhou before withdrawing. The Qing raised Sicheng to a native prefecture in 1658 and replaced the chieftains with appointed magistrates in 1727, when the southwest's native offices were brought under direct rule. Xilong and Xilin were attached to the new prefecture in 1730, and Lingyun County was created at the prefectural seat in 1740, fixing the town's later name.
zh:
凌云地处广西西北山林密布的山地，壮族村寨守着通往云南、贵州的山路。1053年侬智高兵败后，宋朝在这里设泗城州。明代，壮族岑氏土司把州治迁到古磡峒，也就是后来的泗城镇，泗城成为直隶广西行省的土州；1409年，土官岑善忠之子岑子成受命管辖新设的上林长官司。到1444年，朝廷对这片山地仍靠岑氏世袭治理，不派流官，封授的名号远及于日常的政令。

岑氏头目借着这份自主自行征战：成化年间岑豹攻打上林，把长官司署往西赶进广南；1490年岑应又占据上林和贵州镇宁一带十八处城寨，随后退回。1658年清朝升泗城为土府，1727年西南改土归流，岑氏被朝廷委派的流官取代；1730年西隆、西林划归泗城府，1740年府城所在地增设凌云县，县城后来的名称就此定下。

en:
Zhaoqing holds a bend of the Xi River above the gorges leading down to the Pearl River delta; every boat between Guangzhou and the Two Guangs passes below its walls. Under the Sui it was Duanzhou, the fief of the Song prince Zhao Ji before he took the throne as Emperor Huizong; in 1118 he gave his old seat the name Zhaoqing, 'the beginning of good fortune'. Its best-known product was the Duan inkstone, quarried since the early Tang from stream beds in the Lingyang Gorge and counted first among China's four great inkstones; the Song court took them as tribute, and when Bao Zheng, later worshipped across China as Lord Bao, governed Duanzhou in the 1040s, he stopped his predecessors taking dozens of tribute inkstones for court gifts and left without one. In 1444 Zhaoqing was the walled seat of Zhaoqing Prefecture in Ming Guangdong, a Cantonese town living by the river trade and the inkstone quarries.

In 1564 the supreme commander of Liangguang moved his headquarters upriver from Wuzhou to Zhaoqing, which for the next 182 years was the centre of both provinces. His court also brought the first Europeans to settle on the Chinese mainland. Summoned from Macao, the Jesuits Michele Ruggieri and Matteo Ricci were allowed in 1583 to open a residence and church; the prefect Wang Pan, impressed by Ricci's mathematics and maps, had him draw the first Chinese world map, printed there in 1584. Ricci worked in Zhaoqing until a new viceroy expelled him to Shaozhou in 1589.

As Ming rule collapsed, the Prince of Gui was enthroned at Zhaoqing in November 1646 as the Yongli Emperor, last of the Southern Ming, and the city served on and off as his capital. Two Jesuits attended his court, the Austrian Andreas Koffler and the Pole Michal Boym. In 1648 the empress dowager, the empress and the infant crown prince were baptised Catholics, and two years later Boym sailed for Rome with their letters asking the Pope for aid. He reached Rome, obtained nothing, and died in 1659, sick and poor, on the Guangxi border. Qing armies took Zhaoqing in 1650, and in 1746 the viceroy moved to Guangzhou, leaving Zhaoqing a quiet prefectural city above the gorges.
zh:
肇庆扼守西江在珠江三角洲上游的一处江湾，广州与两广山区往来的船只都要从城墙下经过。隋代置端州，端王赵佶曾以这里为封地，他后来即位为宋徽宗，1118年把这座潜邸之地赐名「肇庆」，意为吉庆之始。肇庆最出名的物产是端砚：自唐初起石工就在羚羊峡的溪涧老坑采石制砚，端砚位列中国四大名砚之首，宋代列为贡品；后来被民间尊为包公的包拯在1040年代知端州，他革除历任知州借进贡之名多取端砚馈赠朝官的积弊，任满北归时一方砚台也没带走。1444年的肇庆是明朝广东肇庆府的治所，城墙临江，操粤语的居民靠江路商运和砚石生计。

1564年，两广总督把驻地从梧州移到肇庆，此后182年这里是广东、广西两省的军政中心。总督驻节也把欧洲人带进了城：耶稣会士罗明坚、利玛窦从澳门应召而来，1583年获准在肇庆建起住院和教堂，这是欧洲人在中国大陆最早的常住传教之所；知府王泮赏识利玛窦的历算舆地之学，请他绘制中文世界地图，1584年在肇庆刊成，是第一幅中文世界地图。利玛窦在此制图译书，直到1589年新任总督把他逐往韶州。

明末天下崩解，桂王朱由榔1646年11月在肇庆称帝，年号永历，是南明最后一位皇帝，肇庆几度成为他的行都。他的宫廷里有两位耶稣会士：奥地利人瞿安德和波兰人卜弥格。1648年，太后、皇后和年幼的太子都受洗入教；两年后，卜弥格带着宫廷致教宗的信驶往罗马求援。他到了罗马却一无所获，1659年贫病交加，死于返程的广西边境。肇庆则在1650年被清军攻占；1746年两广总督移驻广州，肇庆仍是府城，守着西江上的峡谷。

en:
Qiongshan and its port Haikou face the Leizhou Peninsula across the narrow Qiongzhou Strait, the shortest crossing between Hainan and the mainland. Han armies set up the Zhuya commandery on the island in 110 BC, and the Tang made Qiongshan a county in 627; the prefecture seated here was Qiongzhou, and under the Ming it administered the whole island. Song and Yuan courts used Hainan as a place of exile, while settlers who sailed from Fujian gave the northern coast its Min speech. In 1444 Qiongshan was the walled prefectural city, and Haikou, walled as a garrison in 1395, guarded the strait through which tropical hardwoods, incense, betel nut and island sugar went north; Li peoples held the wooded highlands of the interior.

The prefectural city produced two of the most admired officials of the Ming. Qiu Jun (1421-1495), a poor island boy, became Minister of Revenue and a grand secretary, and his Supplement to the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning laid out a complete programme of statecraft. Hai Rui (1514-1587), born in the same city, made his name as a magistrate so honest and unbending that people called him Hai the Clear Sky. In 1565 he sent up a memorial accusing the Jiajing Emperor of abandoning his duties; the emperor flung it to the ground in a rage and had him condemned to death, and Hai Rui walked free only when the emperor died. He later governed the Suzhou region, where he forced the retired grand secretary Xu Jie to hand back half the land his family had seized, and in 1587 he died in office at Nanjing and was buried near Haikou.

On 13 July 1605 a magnitude-7.5 earthquake struck Qiongshan. The coast beside the strait dropped below the sea and seventy-two coastal villages went under the water, the 'undersea villages', the only recorded earthquake in China that sank a stretch of land into the sea.
zh:
琼山与它的外港海口隔一道狭窄的琼州海峡与雷州半岛相望，是海南岛渡海北上最近的渡口。公元前110年汉军在岛上设珠崖郡，627年唐代置琼山县，此后设治于此的州郡称琼州，到明代琼州府统辖全岛。宋元两朝把海南作为流放官员之地，从福建渡海而来的移民则把闽地乡音带到岛北。1444年，琼山是筑有城墙的府城，1395年筑城的海口所把守海峡，岛上的热带硬木、香料、槟榔和蔗糖经此外运，黎族则住在林木幽深的内陆山地。

这座府城走出了明代最受敬重的两位名臣。丘濬（1421—1495）由岛上孤学的童子位至户部尚书、武英殿大学士，所撰《大学衍义补》提出了一套完整的经世治国方案。海瑞（1514—1587）也生于琼山城，为官清廉刚硬到不近人情，百姓称他「海青天」。1565年他上《治安疏》，指斥嘉靖帝荒废朝政；皇帝读罢震怒，把奏疏摔在地上，将他下诏狱论死，直到嘉靖帝去世他才出狱。后来他巡抚应天，逼退休首辅徐阶退回徐家强占的一半民田；1587年卒于南京任上，归葬海口。

1605年7月13日，琼山发生7.5级大地震，海峡岸边的陆地整块沉入海中，七十二座沿海村庄没入波涛，这是中国地震史上唯一一次陆陷成海的大震，史称「海底村庄」。

en:
