In 1444 the valley lay on the post-Yuan Mongol frontier, between Baikal and the steppe, with no Russian post and no town.

During Ligdan Khan's wars, around 1613, part of the Hori clans withdrew from the Onon and Argun to the Uda and fought the local Evenks for its meadows; within a generation Russian Cossacks appeared from the north. They built the Udinskoye winter settlement on the high right bank in 1666, to collect fur yasak from the local Tungus clans. It became the Udinsky ostrog and was rebuilt as the Verkhneudinsk fortress in 1689, an administrative centre of Transbaikalia from the following year. After the 1727 Treaty of Kyakhta opened the Russo-Chinese border trade, caravans used the Selenga-Uda route between the frontier and Russia, taking Siberian furs south and bringing Chinese tea, silk and porcelain north. Udinsk merchants paid for the stone Odigitrievsky Cathedral, raised near the mouth from 1741 over more than forty years, the first permanent stone building in the town. Udinsk received town status in 1775 and took the name Verkhneudinsk eight years later, 'Upper Udinsk', to mark it off from Nizhneudinsk on another Uda river west of Irkutsk.
zh:
乌达河源出维季姆高原，向西南流淌467公里，在日后成为乌兰乌德的地方汇入色楞格河。鄂温克猎人在它上游的森林和渡口活动，布里亚特氏族则在宽阔的下游草甸放牧马、牛、羊。其中有分作十一个支系的霍里人：相传他们的先祖在贝加尔湖奥尔洪岛上藏起一位天鹅仙女的羽衣，仙女无法随同伴飞走，留下嫁给他，生下十一个儿子；待她年老，要回羽衣披上，化作天鹅从毡帐的烟孔飞走。天鹅从头顶飞过时，霍里牧民会向空中洒一点奶茶或鲜奶。1444年，河谷处在元代以后蒙古势力的北缘，北接贝加尔湖、南连草原，没有俄国人的据点，也没有城镇。

林丹汗战乱时，约1613年，一部分霍里氏族从鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河退到乌达河，为争夺草甸同当地鄂温克人交战；不到一代人，俄国哥萨克便从北面出现。1666年，哥萨克在高高的右岸建起乌金斯科耶冬营，向当地通古斯氏族征收毛皮实物税。这里后来称乌金斯克堡，1689年改建为上乌金斯克要塞，第二年成为外贝加尔的行政中心。1727年《恰克图条约》开通俄中边境贸易后，往来边境与俄国腹地的商队走色楞格河至乌达河一线，把西伯利亚毛皮南运，再把中国的茶叶、丝绸和瓷器带往北方。乌金斯克商人出资在河口附近修建石造的奥迪吉特里耶夫斯基大教堂，工程自1741年起修了四十多年，是城里第一座永久性石建筑。1775年乌金斯克设城，八年后改名上乌金斯克，为的是同伊尔库茨克以西另一条乌达河畔的下乌金斯克区分开。

en:
The Onon rises in the Khentii highlands, runs north for over a thousand kilometres through the Transbaikal steppe and joins the Ingoda to form the Shilka, headwater of the Amur. The Secret History of the Mongols opens at its source beneath the sacred mountain Burkhan Khaldun, and there in 1206 Temüjin was proclaimed Chinggis Khan at a great kurultai. By the fifteenth century the lower Onon and the Nercha, where Buryat and Evenki clans pastured herds and trapped sable, were the north-eastern edge of the Mongol world. In 1444 the Northern Yuan khans held often only nominal authority over a divided Mongolian plateau.

Russian Cossacks reached the Nercha in 1653, when the sotnik Pyotr Beketov's men built the Nelyudsky ostrog opposite its mouth; Evenki and Daur bands under Prince Gantimur burned it down. Afanasy Pashkov raised a new Nerchinsk ostrog in 1658 and opened the road from the Transbaikalian forts to the Russian posts on the Amur. Gantimur himself went over to the tsar in 1667 with more than twenty clans and was baptised in Nerchinsk in 1684. In 1689 Fyodor Golovin and the Qing envoy Songgotu signed the Treaty of Nerchinsk there; the Jesuits Jean-Francois Gerbillon and Thomas Pereira interpreted, and the authoritative text was written in Latin. The first treaty between Russia and China, it made Nerchinsk the chief emporium of the Siberian fur trade with China until the Kyakhta road drew the caravans west after 1728. Rich silver mines and the Nerchinsk katorga, the convict mining camp, kept the town the leading settlement of Transbaikalia. In 1712 it raised the first stone building east of Lake Baikal, and floods in 1812 moved the town upstream to a new site on the Nercha.
zh:
斡难河（今称鄂嫩河）发源于肯特山，向北流淌一千多公里，穿过外贝加尔草原，与音果达河汇成石勒喀河，即黑龙江的源头之一。《蒙古秘史》开篇便写圣山不儿罕·合勒敦山下的河源，1206年铁木真就是在这里的大忽里勒台上被推举为成吉思汗。到15世纪，鄂嫩河下游与涅尔查河一带是布里亚特、鄂温克氏族游牧和猎貂之地，已是蒙古世界的东北边缘。1444年，蒙古高原分裂，北元大汗的权威往往有名无实。

1653年，哥萨克百人长彼得·别凯托夫的部众抵达涅尔查河，在河口对岸建起涅柳德斯基寨堡，旋即被根特木尔王公率领的鄂温克、达斡尔人焚毁。1658年，阿法纳西·帕什科夫另筑尼布楚寨堡，并打通了外贝加尔诸寨到黑龙江俄国据点的道路。根特木尔本人于1667年率二十余氏族归附沙皇，1684年在尼布楚受洗。1689年，费奥多尔·戈洛文与清朝使臣索额图在此签订《尼布楚条约》，法国耶稣会士张诚和葡萄牙耶稣会士徐日昇担任翻译，条约正式文本用拉丁文写成。这是中俄之间的第一个条约，尼布楚随之成为西伯利亚毛皮对华贸易的首要商埠，直到1728年后商队改走恰克图一路。丰富的银矿和流放苦役犯的尼布楚苦役营使它长期居于外贝加尔首镇之列。1712年，这里建起贝加尔湖以东第一座石砌建筑；1812年又因水患把城池迁到涅尔查河上游的新址。

en:
The lower Angara taiga around the Kezhma bend was Evenki country; the Russians called these people Tungus. Clans rode reindeer between winter and summer camps, ran down elk and wild reindeer on wide hunting skis, fished through holes in the river ice and trapped sable. They lived in conical chum tents that could be struck and loaded onto reindeer, and sable skins moved between clans as gift and barter. In 1444 no fort, customs post or Orthodox parish stood on this stretch of the Angara, and no Siberian khan could reach the hunters of the deep taiga.

Cossacks reached the Ilim River in 1627, and in 1630 Ivan Galkin built the wintering place that became Ilimsk and opened the Lena portage, a short overland carry that let boat parties cross from the Angara system into the Lena and descend to Yakutia. For the rest of the century the portage was the main freight route into north-eastern Siberia, and the Angara reaches that fed it, including the Kezhma crossing, carried explorers, supply boats and yasak convoys. The Evenki clans along the way were registered for the sable tribute, and some met the collectors with arms; Russian ferrymen and peasants then settled the sloboda later recorded as Kezhemskoye to serve the traffic. It stayed a stage on the road east, never a merchant town of its own.
zh:
克日马河湾一带的安加拉河下游泰加林，是埃文基人的土地，俄国人称他们为通古斯人。各氏族骑着驯鹿往来于冬夏营地，脚踩宽滑雪板追逐驼鹿和野鹿，在冰面凿洞捕鱼，套猎紫貂。他们住的锥形毡帐可以随时拆下驮走，紫貂皮以馈赠和交换在氏族之间流转。1444年，这段安加拉河上还没有要塞、税卡或东正教教区，也没有哪个西伯利亚汗能号令密林深处的猎人。

1627年，哥萨克进抵伊利姆河；1630年，伊万·加尔金建起后来成为伊利姆斯克的越冬地，找到勒拿连水陆路：船只和人员经这段短途旱路就能从安加拉水系进入勒拿河，直下雅库特。此后近一个世纪，这条连水陆路是进入东北西伯利亚的主要货运通道，通往它的安加拉河段，包括克日马渡口，往返着探险队、补给船和雅萨克毛皮队。沿途的埃文基氏族被登记征收紫貂贡，也有氏族拿起武器对付税吏；俄罗斯渡船工和农民随后在后来记作克热姆斯科耶的村镇定居，为过往船队效劳。这里始终只是东进路上的一处驿站，没有成为自己的商业城镇。

en:
Irkutsk province fills the Angara valley where the Irkut enters it, on the forest-and-steppe edge west of Lake Baikal. In 1444 it was Buryat country with no Russian town. Clans followed cattle and horse herds between river pastures, hunted sable in the taiga, fished the Angara, lived in felt gers, and mixed Tengri devotion with shamanic rites. Their kinship and tribute ties reached into the Mongol world, while the Angara already carried local exchange between the Baikal lands and the Yenisei.

Russian servicemen reached Lake Baikal in the 1640s, and in 1661 Yakov Pokhabov's Cossacks raised a wooden ostrog at the mouth of the Irkut to collect Buryat fur tribute; twenty-five years later it was a town. The wealth came from the east. After the 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk the state caravans to China passed through, carrying Siberian sable out and Chinese tea, silk and porcelain back by way of the Selenga and Baikal. A fire in 1716 burned the fort walls, the merchants' court and the old cathedral of the Savior, and trade paid to build them again. When Kyakhta opened on the Qing border in 1727, the caravans gave way to merchant barter; the end of the state fur monopoly in 1762 opened the golden age of the Irkutsk houses, as the Sibiryakov, Basnin and Trapeznikov families bought furs for China and sold Chinese goods on toward Moscow on the new Siberian road. In 1799 the fur enterprise of the Irkutsk merchant Grigory Shelikhov, who had planted the first Russian settlements in Alaska and died in the town four years before, was chartered as the Russian-American Company. Irkutsk became the supply base for the North Pacific voyages, with its ropewalk, tar yard and fur workshops, and townspeople held nearly a tenth of the company's shares.
zh:
伊尔库茨克地区位于贝加尔湖以西的森林草原交界，涵盖安加拉河与伊尔库特河汇合处一带。1444年，这里是布里亚特人的土地，还没有俄罗斯人的城镇。诸氏族赶着牛马在沿河牧场间转场，在泰加林猎取紫貂，在安加拉河捕鱼，住毡帐，崇奉腾格里并行萨满仪式。他们的亲族与贡赋关系通向蒙古世界，安加拉河上也早有本地往来，连通贝加尔湖地带与叶尼塞河。

俄国军役人员17世纪40年代抵达贝加尔湖，1661年雅科夫·波哈博夫的哥萨克在伊尔库特河口筑起木堡，向布里亚特人收取毛皮贡赋；二十五年后这里正式成为城镇。财富来自东方：1689年《尼布楚条约》后，赴华国家商队途经此地，西伯利亚紫貂从这里外运，中国茶叶、丝绸和瓷器经色楞格河与贝加尔湖运回。1716年大火烧毁堡墙、商馆和旧救主堂，又靠贸易收入重建。1727年恰克图在清境边境开市，国家商队贸易转为商人易货；1762年国家毛皮专卖取消，伊尔库茨克商号进入黄金时期，西比里亚科夫、巴斯宁、特拉佩兹尼科夫等家族收购毛皮输往中国，再把中国货沿新修的西伯利亚驿路转销莫斯科。1799年，伊尔库茨克商人格里戈里·舍利霍夫的毛皮公司获得特许，改组为俄美公司；他在阿拉斯加建立了俄国最早的定居点，四年前在本城去世。伊尔库茨克成为北太平洋航行的补给基地，城里有缆绳厂、焦油坊和毛皮作坊，市民持有公司近十分之一的股份。

en:
West of the Yenisey, marsh and pine taiga run from the Ket River toward the Sym and the Tungus hunting grounds. Evenki clans whom the Russians called Tungus moved through this country with reindeer and hunting skis, taking elk, wild reindeer, fish and sable by season. In 1444 their conical camps and clan trails crossed land no Siberian khan administered, and furs moved through kinship networks rather than any customs book. What gave this country its place on the map was the Ket portage, the short overland carry between the Ob system and the Yenisey that any Russian advance east had to use.

In the summer of 1619 Tobolsk Cossacks under Pyotr Albychev and Cherkas Rukin built a stockade at the Yenisey end of the portage, first called Tungussky and soon renamed Yeniseysk, the first Russian town on the great river. Sables from the surrounding taiga filled its market, whose turnover passed 60,000 rubles in 1645-46. In 1677 the town was put over every Russian fort on the Yenisey and beyond, as far as Nerchinsk, and hunters and explorers outfitted here before striking south and east; by 1690 it held about 3,000 people. The sables thinned so fast that in 1684 Moscow banned hunting them in the Yeniseysk districts and made the fur trade a state monopoly. On a hill above the town the monk Timofey Ivanov had settled as a hermit in 1592, and his community became the Transfiguration Monastery, confirmed in 1642; its stone church was raised between 1731 and 1756. Farther upstream, Novoselovo was a Russian village by about 1720, acquired its Church of Peter and Paul in 1737 and became the seat of Novoselovo Volost in 1783; in 1804 the district passed to Tomsk Governorate.
zh:
西通古斯位于叶尼塞河以西，沼泽与松林泰加从克特河伸向瑟姆河和通古斯猎场。俄国人称作通古斯人的埃文基氏族带着驯鹿和滑雪板往来于此，按季节猎捕驼鹿、野鹿，捕鱼并套取紫貂。1444年，他们的锥形营地和氏族小径穿过的土地不受任何西伯利亚汗廷管辖，毛皮走的是亲族网络，而不是税关的账册。让这片地方在地图上变得要紧的是克特连水陆路：鄂毕水系与叶尼塞河之间只隔这段短途旱路，俄国人向东推进非走这条线不可。

1619年夏，彼得·阿尔贝切夫和切尔卡斯·鲁金率领托博尔斯克哥萨克，在连水陆路的叶尼塞河一端筑起寨堡，初名通古斯基，不久改称叶尼塞斯克，这是叶尼塞河上第一座俄罗斯城镇。周围泰加林的紫貂涌入市场，1645至1646年市面成交超过六万卢布；1677年，叶尼塞河上乃至远达涅尔琴斯克的所有俄国寨堡都划归它管辖，猎人和探险者也都在这里备好行装，再向南方和东方出发；到1690年，城中约有三千居民。紫貂衰减得极快，1684年莫斯科禁止在叶尼塞斯克各县猎貂，把毛皮贸易收归官营。城外高地上，修士季莫费·伊万诺夫1592年便在后来的城址旁结庐而居，他的团体发展成主易圣容修道院，1642年获正式批准，石砌教堂于1731至1756年建成。更靠上游的新肖洛沃约在1720年成为俄罗斯人的村庄，1737年建起圣彼得与圣保罗教堂，1783年成为新肖洛沃乡治所；1804年，这一带划归托木斯克省。

en:
The middle Angara crosses this province through taiga and the Padun rapids before the Oka joins it from the south. In 1444 its banks were Buryat country. Clans herded cattle, horses and sheep between summer pastures and hay meadows, hunted the forest and fished above the falls; the Russians later took their name for these people, bratskie liudi, 'brotherly men', and Bratsk keeps it. No boat could run the Padun without unloading and portaging, and that carrying place made the Angara the route fur canoes used between the Yenisei country and the Lena, well worth a fort.

Maksim Perfilyev's Cossacks first wintered below the Bratsk rapids in the 1620s, and in 1631 they raised a wooden ostrog beside the Padun rather than at the Oka mouth, because the ground proposed at the mouth lay almost in the middle of Buryat camps. Prince Bayarakan's forces besieged it and burned it in 1634. Nikolai Radukovsky rebuilt it in 1635; the garrison beat off one attack the next year, but Angara and Uda Buryats destroyed the fort again in 1637. It went up on another Angara site in the 1640s, and Dmitry Firsov moved it to the Oka mouth in 1654. The fortress was small but its site mattered. It covered the portage road from the Yenisei to the Lena and took the Buryat fur tribute; the parties pushing beyond Lake Baikal also fitted out here. Through the seventeenth century it answered to Yeniseysk, and after the Buryat wars it shrank into the village of Bratsk-Ostrozhnoe, while Padun pilots earned their living taking boats through the rapids.
zh:
安加拉中游穿过泰加林和帕敦险滩，奥卡河自南方在这一带汇入。1444年，河畔是布里亚特人的土地。诸氏族在夏季牧场和草场之间放牧牛、马、羊，入林狩猎，在瀑布上方捕鱼；俄国人后来沿用他们对这些人的称呼「兄弟般的人」，布拉茨克的名字就来自这个称呼。船只过不了帕敦险滩，必须卸货转运，这个转运点使安加拉河成为毛皮独木舟往来叶尼塞地带与勒拿河的通道，很值得设堡据守。

17世纪20年代，马克西姆·佩尔菲利耶夫的哥萨克首次在布拉茨克险滩下方过冬；1631年，他们把木堡修在帕敦旁边而不是奥卡河口，因为河口的拟定地点几乎处在布里亚特营地中央。巴亚拉坎首领的队伍围攻木堡，1634年将它焚毁。尼古拉·拉杜科夫斯基1635年重建，守军次年击退一次进攻，但1637年安加拉与乌达的布里亚特人再次把它摧毁。17世纪40年代，堡寨在安加拉河另一处重建；1654年，德米特里·菲尔索夫把它迁到奥卡河口。堡子不大，位置却要紧。它扼守叶尼塞河通往勒拿河的转运路，收取布里亚特人的毛皮贡赋，深入贝加尔湖以东的队伍也在这里整装。整个17世纪它隶属叶尼塞斯克，布里亚特战事结束后缩为布拉茨克-奥斯特罗日诺耶村，帕敦的引航人则靠引导船只过滩为生。

en:
The Sayan province covers the northern spurs of the Eastern Sayan and the upper Uda valley, where passes climb south over the ridge and forest-steppe opens north toward the Angara. In 1444 Uda Buryat clans pastured cattle and horses, trapped sable along the taiga edge, and moved between lowland meadows and highland hunting grounds, mixing Tengri devotion with shamanic rites. Furs, livestock and tribute moved along the mountain trails between the Baikal country and the Yenisei steppe, but no Russian fort or tax post stood on the Uda.

The Cossacks moving up from Krasnoyarsk met the Uda Buryats united under Prince Oylan, also called Ilanko, and broke their main force in August 1645. Oylan submitted two years later with an unusual petition: he asked the tsar to build a fort on his own land, to shield his people from raids out of 'other unpeaceful lands' and to organize the fur tribute. On 14 October 1648, the feast of the Intercession, Elisey Tyumentsev's Krasnoyarsk Cossacks raised the Pokrovsky settlement, the 'sovereign's winter quarters', on the high right bank of the Uda. It grew into an ostrog and a centre of trade and agriculture, until Yenisei Kirghiz under Irenek sacked it in the summer of 1666. In 1700 it was renamed Nizhneudinsk, to distinguish it from the Uda fort in Transbaikalia that became Verkhneudinsk. The Russian-Qing settlement of 1727 drew the frontier along the high Sayan. When the Moscow road came through in the mid-eighteenth century, with a post station, an inn and a winter trail on to the Lena, the old fort became a district town in 1783, and Yeniseysk townsmen built its stone cathedral of the Resurrection in those years.
zh:
萨彦地区覆盖东萨彦岭北坡和乌达河上游，山口向南翻越山脊，林地草原则向北朝安加拉河展开。1444年，乌达布里亚特氏族在河谷放牧牛马，沿泰加林缘猎取紫貂，在低地草场与高山猎场间转徙，崇奉腾格里并行萨满仪式。毛皮、牲畜和贡赋沿山径往来于贝加尔地带与叶尼塞草原之间，但乌达河畔还没有俄罗斯人的堡寨或税站。

向萨彦岭外围推进的哥萨克遇上了首领奥兰（又称伊兰科）联合的乌达布里亚特人，1645年8月击溃其主力。两年后奥兰臣服，递上一份不寻常的呈文：他请求沙皇在自己的土地上建堡，保护部众抵御「其他不驯之地」的袭扰，也为了组织毛皮贡赋。1648年10月14日圣母帡幪日，叶利谢伊·秋缅采夫率克拉斯诺亚尔斯克哥萨克在乌达河高岸上筑起波克罗夫斯基城，即「君主冬营」。它发展成堡寨和贸易、农耕中心，直到1666年夏被伊列涅克率领的叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人洗劫。1700年改名为下乌金斯克，以区别外贝加尔那座后来成为上乌金斯克的乌达堡。1727年俄清定界，边界沿萨彦高山划定。18世纪中叶莫斯科驿路经过，设了驿站和客店，还有通往勒拿河的冬季雪道，老堡在1783年成为县治；叶尼塞斯克的市民工匠还为它建起石筑的复活大教堂。

en:
The Tom carries the waters of the Kuznetsk hills through the western Siberian taiga toward the Ob lowlands, and in 1444 its lower course held only riverbank and forest, without a Russian town. Eushta Tatars lived there, Samoyedic forest people who had adopted Turkic speech; they fished, hunted, kept cattle and traded with neighboring forest bands, themselves hard pressed by raids from Yenisei Kyrgyz and Kalmyk horsemen.

A Tatar prince brought Muscovy to the Tom. In January 1604 Toian of the Eushta sent envoys to Tsar Boris Godunov in Moscow, asking for a fortified town and the tsar's protection, and ceded the ground himself. Two hundred Cossacks under Vasily Tyrkov and Gavriil Pisemsky raised the Tomsk kremlin on the riverbank before the year ended, and its timber walls withstood steppe attacks in 1614, 1617, 1657 and 1698. The town became the seat of its own Siberian district in 1629, and a new wooden kremlin went up on Resurrection Hill in 1648. The Siberian trakt later carried Moscow-bound trade through Tomsk on the way to Kyakhta; a post station was set up in 1738, and in 1804 the town became the capital of a governorate whose districts reached as far as the Krasnoyarsk country.
zh:
托姆河汇集库兹涅茨克山地的水流，穿过西西伯利亚泰加林，流向鄂毕河低地。1444年，它的下游一带只有河岸与林地，还没有俄罗斯城镇。住在这里的是埃乌什塔鞑靼人，他们本属萨莫耶德系森林居民，后来改用突厥语，以渔猎、养畜和同邻近森林部落贸易为生，又苦于叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人与卡尔梅克骑兵不断南下袭掠。

把莫斯科引到托姆河畔的是一位鞑靼王公。1604年1月，埃乌什塔的托扬遣使觐见鲍里斯·戈东诺夫沙皇，请求修建设防城镇、接受沙皇庇护，并主动献出建城的土地。沙皇派来的两百名哥萨克当年就在河畔筑起托木斯克克里姆林，木墙先后在1614年、1617年、1657年和1698年击退草原骑兵的进攻。1629年，托木斯克成为单独的西伯利亚行政区中心，1648年又在复活山建起新的木构克里姆林。后来西伯利亚官道经此通往恰克图，把莫斯科方向的贸易带过托木斯克；1738年这里设立驿站，1804年托木斯克成为省会，辖地一直延伸到克拉斯诺亚尔斯克一带。

en:
Before it was a Russian town, Kuznetsk was the smithing country of the Turkic-speaking Shor clans. Their uluses dotted the upper Tom, Kondoma and Mras-Su valleys in the mountain taiga, where they mined and smelted iron ore, fished, and hunted furs. Yenisei Kyrgyz and Oirat lords bought their ironware, and later Russian documents called the clans Kuznetskie Tatary, or smithing Tatars. In 1444 no fortress stood on the Tom. The camps lay on a cold edge of the Oirat world, but tribute was usually collected by local Kyrgyz princes rather than by a distant Mongol court.

Tomsk servicemen entered Kuznetsk Land in 1607 to trade and collect fur yasak, and they secured the native Abin stronghold in 1615. In April 1618 Cossacks from Tomsk raised the first permanent Kuznetsk ostrog near the mouth of the Kondoma. It became an uyezd seat in 1622 and received town status in 1689. About fifteen peasant households were settled on state ploughland in the mid-1620s, while Shor hunters found themselves increasingly bound to fur tribute. In 1821 Kuznetsk remained a small, remote Siberian uyezd town surrounded by Shor hunting grounds.
zh:
在成为俄国城镇以前，库兹涅茨克先是讲突厥语的绍尔部族的打铁之地。他们的乌卢斯散布在托木河、孔多马河和姆拉斯苏河上游的山地泰加林，居民开采、冶炼铁矿，在河中捕鱼，也猎取毛皮。叶尼塞吉尔吉斯和瓦剌领主购买他们的铁器，后来的俄国文献把这些部族称作「库兹涅茨克鞑靼」，也就是铁匠鞑靼。1444年，托木河畔还没有堡垒；这些营地处在瓦剌世界的寒冷边缘，贡赋通常由当地吉尔吉斯王公收取，而不是由远方的蒙古宫廷直接征发。

1607年，托木斯克军役人员进入库兹涅茨克土地贸易并征收毛皮牙萨克，1615年控制当地的阿宾斯克堡。1618年4月，来自托木斯克的哥萨克在孔多马河口附近建起第一座常设的库兹涅茨克堡。它1622年成为县治，1689年取得城镇地位。1620年代中期，约十五户农民被安置到官地上耕作，绍尔猎人则日益受到毛皮贡赋约束。1821年，库兹涅茨克仍是一座偏远的西伯利亚小县城，四周仍是绍尔人的猎场。

en:
The Altai mountains rise between the Siberian taiga and the open Kazakh and Dzungar steppes, with the headwaters of the Irtysh and Ob cutting through their valleys. Mongol lords used the name Uriankhai for the forest bands who trapped sable and squirrel in these uplands and paid their pelts as tribute; their camps also kept horses, sheep and camels on the high pastures. In 1444 the country belonged to the Oirats, whose taishi Esen had already subdued the Uriankhai and seized Hami on the caravan road to the west. Five years later he captured the Zhengtong Emperor at Tumu. For the mountain camps, Oirat power meant herds, tribute furs and the worship of the eternal sky.

Northern Uriankhai groups from central Mongolia began moving into the range in the early 16th century. After Bodi Alagh Khan broke the rebellious Uriankhai tumen in 1538, many of its people joined the Khalkha, while the Altai bands passed under the Four Oirat and later the Dzungars. Russian Cossacks built Kuznetsk fort in 1618 and pressed from the north for yasak furs, so the mountains became a frontier between Dzungar herdsmen, Russian fur collectors and the advancing Qing. The Altai Uriankhai submitted to the Qianlong Emperor in 1754, before the final Qing campaigns against the Dzungars. They were registered as seven banners, the zaisan Chadak was named their commander in 1755, their pastures between the Altai and the Irtysh were fixed in 1759, and the banners were divided into left and right wings under the Khovd amban in 1763.
zh:
阿尔泰山脉横在西伯利亚泰加林与开阔的哈萨克、准噶尔草原之间，额尔齐斯河和鄂毕河的上游从山谷中发源。蒙古领主把在山地捕貂、捕灰鼠并以皮货纳贡的森林部落称作乌梁海；各部营地也在高山牧场放养马、羊和骆驼。1444年，阿尔泰乌梁海属于瓦剌，太师也先此时已经收服乌梁海，并夺取了西边商路上的哈密。五年后，他在土木堡俘虏明英宗。对山中营地来说，瓦剌的统治意味着畜牧、毛皮贡赋和对长生天的崇拜。

16世纪初，蒙古中部的北方兀良哈各部陆续迁入阿尔泰。1538年博迪阿拉克汗平定反叛的兀良哈万户后，许多部众被并入喀尔喀，阿尔泰山区诸部则转归卫拉特四部，后来又臣属准噶尔。俄国哥萨克1618年筑起库兹涅茨克堡，从北方索取毛皮税，这片山地于是成了准噶尔牧民、俄国毛皮征收者和西进清军之间的边地。阿尔泰乌梁海在清朝最后攻灭准噶尔之前，已于1754年归附乾隆皇帝，被编为七旗；宰桑察达克1755年受命统领各部，1759年其牧地被划定在阿尔泰山与额尔齐斯河之间，1763年七旗又分左右两翼，隶属科布多参赞大臣。

en:
Turukhan is the lower Yenisei country around the mouth of the Turukhan River, north of the taiga line where the woods thin into Arctic forest-tundra. In 1444 only Samoyed camps moved here, following fish, wild reindeer and sable between the tundra and the tree line and paddling the Yenisei, Turukhan and Lower Tunguska in summer. No Russian had yet built on these banks, though the sable taken in the northern woods was already the fur that Muscovite traders wanted most.

The first Russian post, a winter camp founded by Davyd Zherebtsov and Kurdyuk Davydov in 1607, lay a short river journey from Mangazeya, the boom town on the Taz where Cossacks gathered the far northern fur tribute. In 1619 the Muscovite government closed the Arctic sea lane to Mangazeya for fear English ships would follow it into Siberian waters, and fires gutted the town in 1619, 1642 and 1662. Its trade moved onto the Yenisei: the voevoda's administration came in 1670, and in 1672 the rebuilt town was named New Mangazeya. A folk legend says the voevoda Naumov chose its site with a throw of dice. The fort rose on a hill ringed by rivers on three sides, with four corner towers and a two-tier gate tower about 25 metres high facing the Yenisei; each tower carried a pair of cannon and held cauldrons of boiling water against storming parties. The Peter and Paul fair opened on 29 June for two weeks every summer and drew merchants from all over Russia, its merchants' court holding twenty-five shops while a second fair crowded onto boats 25 kilometres away. Khariton Laptev and Semyon Chelyuskin passed through on their Arctic voyages. The town became an uyezd centre in 1735 and took the name Turukhansk in 1780, but the fur frontier had moved south: by 1801 only 498 people remained.
zh:
图鲁汉位于图鲁汉河汇入叶尼塞河的下游地带，泰加林带以北，林木渐疏，过渡为北极林苔原。1444年，这里只有萨莫耶德人的营地：他们在苔原与林线之间追逐鱼群、野生驯鹿和黑貂，夏季划舟往来于叶尼塞河、图鲁汉河和下通古斯卡河。河岸上还没有俄罗斯人的建筑，但北方林中出产的黑貂，已是莫斯科商人最渴求的毛皮。

1607年，达维德·热列布佐夫和库尔久克·达维多夫在此设立冬营，走水路不远就是塔兹河畔的富庶边城曼加泽亚，哥萨克在那里征收极北毛皮贡赋。1619年，莫斯科政府担心英国船循北极海路闯入西伯利亚水域，将这条海路封禁；曼加泽亚又在1619年、1642年和1662年连遭大火。贸易就此转到叶尼塞河：督军衙门1670年迁来，1672年重建的城镇定名新曼加泽亚。民间传说督军纳乌莫夫是掷骰子选定城址的。城堡建在三面环水的高地上，有四座角楼和一座朝向叶尼塞河、高约25米的两层门楼，每座塔楼上都架着一对火炮，还备下滚水和石块对付强攻的人。彼得保罗集市每年6月29日开市，持续两周，招来全俄商人；客商大院里有25间铺面，25公里外还有一场挤满船只的水上集市。哈里顿·拉普捷夫和谢苗·切柳斯金进行北极航行时都曾途经此城。1735年新曼加泽亚成为县城，1780年改名图鲁汉斯克，但毛皮前线已经南移，到1801年城中只剩498人。

en:
Ket is the marshy taiga basin of the Ket River, a long westward tributary of the Ob whose upper waters come close to the Yenisei watershed. In 1444 Selkup and Ket bands had its quiet channels to themselves, fishing, trapping sable and travelling by canoe in the country beyond the eastern edge of the Sibir Khanate. Local princes ruled the upper and lower Narym districts, while the loose forest confederacy the Russians later named the Skewbald Horde had not yet formed.

The Russians came for the fur and the crossing. In the 1590s the Narym princes Vonya and Kichey withheld yasak and dealt with Küchüm Khan; Narym Ostrog was built on the Ket in 1596 and Ketsk followed on the upper river in 1602. Makovsk went up near the head of navigation in 1618, and its long Makarskoi Portage to Yeniseysk, one of the longest in Siberia, made the Ket the principal road between the Ob and Yenisei after the Arctic passage to Mangazeya was closed. In 1610 Taybokhta Vonin entered the tsar's service at Narym, joining the old forest elite to the new garrison order. Travellers remembered the river rather than the forts. In August 1722 the Scottish doctor John Bell, returning with the Russian embassy from China, found the Ket so desolate that he compared it to the Styx; sandbars and mosquitoes made the voyage from Makovsk to the Ob last twenty-five days. In 1725 Vitus Bering's party crossed the same portage on its way to the First Kamchatka Expedition.
zh:
克季是克季河流域的沼泽泰加林地；这条长河向西注入鄂毕河，上游水域接近叶尼塞河分水岭。1444年，塞尔库普人与凯特人的群体独占这些平静水汊，在西伯利亚汗国东界之外捕鱼、猎貂、划独木舟往来。上纳雷姆和下纳雷姆一带有本地首领，俄罗斯人后来所称的佩加亚奥尔达这个松散森林联盟尚未形成。

俄罗斯人来到这里，为的是毛皮和水陆转运。1590年代，纳雷姆首领沃尼亚和基切伊拒缴毛皮贡赋，又与库楚姆汗往来；1596年纳雷姆堡建于克季河畔，1602年克季堡建于上游。1618年，马科夫斯克堡在通航水道源头附近建成；通往叶尼塞斯克的马卡尔旱路是西伯利亚最长的旱路之一，曼加泽亚北极海路封闭后，克季河成为鄂毕河与叶尼塞河之间的主要通道。1610年，泰博赫塔·沃宁在纳雷姆为沙皇服役，把旧森林贵族并入新的要塞体系。相比堡垒，旅人记住的反而是这条河。1722年8月，随俄国使团从中国返回的苏格兰医生约翰·贝尔觉得克季河荒凉得如同冥河斯堤克斯，沙洲和蚊虫让他从马科夫斯克到鄂毕河走了二十五天。1725年，维图斯·白令的队伍跨过同一条旱路，前往第一次堪察加探险。

en:
Surgut province covers the middle Ob, where the river breaks into channels through taiga and broad flood meadows. The kin principalities of Yugra built fortified river towns, with fishing and hunting settlements around them. In 1444 Khanty and Selkup families still held the Ob crossings and winter trails. Novgorod merchants had long traded iron goods and cloth for Ob furs, using river routes from Ustyug and, in some years, the Arctic sea route, but no Muscovite fortress stood on this stretch of the river. Fish, game and sable supported the camps along the banks.

In 1594 Tsar Feodor I ordered a fortress built near the Khanty stronghold of Prince Bardak. Vladimir Anichkov and Fyodor Baryatinsky placed Surgut on a cape, with a moat, two gates and five wooden towers so that boats and men approaching from the land side could be seen. A merchants' court followed in 1596, and customs were collected there until 1753, making the fort one of the posts through which Ob furs entered the Russian treasury. A list of 1625 named 222 servicemen, though disease steadily cut the garrison down. Surgut also received political exiles, including prisoners from the Russo-Polish wars, followers of Stepan Razin and Old Believers. It became a district town in 1782 and took a black fox for its coat of arms three years later; when its administrative role faded, fishermen, hunters and river traders kept the settlement going.
zh:
苏尔古特地区位于鄂毕河中游，河水在泰加林和广阔河滩间分成多条河汊。尤格拉的亲族首领们修筑设防河镇，镇外散布着渔猎村落。1444年，汉特人和谢尔库普人仍掌握着鄂毕河渡口与冬季道路。诺夫哥罗德商人早用铁器和布匹交换鄂毕河毛皮，他们或从乌斯秋格走河路，或在某些年份取道北极海路，但这一段鄂毕河畔还没有莫斯科的要塞。河畔营地以鱼、猎物和紫貂为生。

1594年，沙皇费奥多尔一世下令在汉特人首领巴尔达克的要塞附近修筑堡垒。弗拉基米尔·阿尼奇科夫和费奥多尔·巴里亚京斯基把苏尔古特建在一处岬角上，外设壕沟，木墙开两门、立五座塔楼，河上来船和陆路接近的人都能被发现。1596年这里增设商馆，海关税卡一直运行到1753年，使该堡成为鄂毕河毛皮送入俄国国库的据点之一。1625年的名册列有222名军役人员，但疾病不断削弱这支卫戍队。苏尔古特也接收政治流放者，包括俄波战争俘虏、斯捷潘·拉辛的追随者和旧礼仪派。1782年它成为县城，三年后以黑狐为城徽；行政地位下降后，渔民、猎人和河上商人仍维持着这座聚落。

en:
Narim is the swampy Ob country around the future Russian post of Narym, near where the Ket comes down to the great river; its name comes from Southern Selkup nyar, 'marsh'. In 1444 Southern Selkup families lived from river fish and forest sable, moving between camps and yurts on the low, flood-prone banks. Their clans formed the core of the Skewbald Horde, a Selkup and Ket association holding the Narym and Tom basins in alliance with the Tatar Khanate of Sibir. Its upper Narym prince Vonya kept the country out of Russian hands until the 1590s, evaded the fur tribute and sent to Kuchum Khan for common action. No kremlin or customs post yet stood above the floods.

When Vonya refused yasak, Moscow sent ataman Tugarin of Surgut, who raised Narym Ostrog in 1596 or 1598, the first Russian stronghold in the Ob-Ket marshes. It guarded the river road that ran up the Ob and the Ket and over a short portage to the Yenisei, by which the Russians pushed on into eastern Siberia. Narym received town status in 1601, though floods and fires moved the settlement twice in the early decades. Tomsk later supervised the post, which collected furs from Selkup trappers and received exiles as well; the first were two peasants off Prince Dmitry Pozharsky's estates in 1626, and many others followed. In 1785 the town counted 827 inhabitants, a four-towered kremlin and a month-long summer fair where merchants from Moscow, the Makaryev Fair and Irbit dealt. By 1819 its revenues were so thin that the town duma asked to be dissolved, leaving only a ratusha.
zh:
纳里木（通行译名纳雷姆）是鄂毕河上的沼泽之乡，在克季河汇入大河处一带，地名来自南塞尔库普语的「尼亚尔」，意为沼泽。1444年时，南塞尔库普人家族以河鱼和林中紫貂为生，在低洼易涝的河岸营地与帐幕间迁徙。他们的氏族是花斑部落联盟的主体：这个塞尔库普人与凯特人的联盟据有纳雷姆河和托木河流域，与鞑靼人的西伯利亚汗国结盟。联盟的上纳雷姆首领沃尼亚直到1590年代仍拒不臣服、不缴毛皮贡赋，还遣使联络库楚姆汗采取共同行动。此时河畔还没有凌驾于洪水之上的克里姆林或税关。

沃尼亚拒绝缴纳毛皮贡赋后，莫斯科派苏尔古特首领图加林前来，他在1596或1598年筑起纳雷姆堡，这是鄂毕河与克季河沼泽地带的第一座俄罗斯要塞。它扼守沿鄂毕河、克季河上行、再经短途水陆联运进入叶尼塞河的航路，俄国人循此继续向东进入西伯利亚。1601年纳雷姆取得城镇地位，但洪水和火灾在最初几十年里两度迫使全城迁址。要塞后来归托木斯克管辖，向塞尔库普猎人收取毛皮，也接收流放者：最早一批是1626年德米特里·波扎尔斯基王公领地上的两名农民，后来又有许多人被送到这里。1785年，纳雷姆有827名居民、一座四塔克里姆林和为期一个月的夏季集市，莫斯科、马卡里耶夫和伊尔比特的商人在此交易。到1819年，市税收入微薄到市议会请求解散，只留一座市政厅。

en:
The middle Irtysh, where the Tara comes in, marks the line where Siberian forest gives way to steppe. Siberian Tatar fishing and herding villages stood along the banks under the Taibugid princes, Muslims who ruled the country between the Tobol and the Irtysh within Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek horde; farther inland, Khanty and Selkup hunters trapped sable, squirrel and ermine that went south through Tatar middlemen. The river's Tatar name means 'the narrow one'. In 1444 the woods and fords here were a remote northern march of the Uzbek ulus, and no Russian had yet reached them.

After Yermak's Cossacks broke the Sibir khanate, the tsar sent Prince Andrei Yeletsky with orders to raise a fort, start ploughland, press Kuchum and find salt. Tara went up in 1594 on the Tatar settlement of Yalom, the first Russian town on this stretch of the Irtysh. Four years later a force of streltsy, Cossacks and serving Tatars sent out from the town under Andrei Voeikov overtook Kuchum on the Irmen, a tributary of the Ob, and scattered his last camp, finishing the conquest Yermak had begun. Tara's servicemen opened the first tsarist ploughland in Siberia and found the salt lakes that supplied the western forts; caravans from Bukhara, Tashkent and China came along the Tobolsk-Tomsk road to buy furs and sell silk, tea and fruit. Kalmyks besieged the town in 1634, and in 1716 its commanders had a fortress raised farther up the Irtysh, the seed of Omsk. In 1722 part of the garrison refused to swear to the heirs Peter the Great had named for the succession, and the Tara Mutiny followed: seventy rebels held a colonel's house, forty-nine surrendered, and the rest set off a powder charge rather than give themselves up; the wounded were nursed back to health and then executed, and the reprisals cut Tara's population by half. From its early years the town was also a place of exile, and the writer Alexander Radishchev passed through it on his way to Siberian banishment, followed later by Decembrist officers.
zh:
塔拉河汇入额尔齐斯河的中游一带，是西伯利亚森林与草原的分界。河畔是西伯利亚鞑靼人的渔村和牧村，统治者是泰布加家族的王公；这些穆斯林王公据有托博尔河与额尔齐斯河之间的土地，处在阿布勒海尔的乌兹别克汗国之内。更内陆住着汉特人和谢尔库普人的猎户，紫貂、松鼠和白鼬皮经鞑靼中间商南运。「塔拉」这个鞑靼河名意为「窄河」。1444年，这里的林地和渡口还是乌兹别克兀鲁思偏远的北境，俄罗斯人尚未到来。

叶尔马克的哥萨克击灭西伯利亚汗国之后，沙皇派安德烈·叶列茨基公爵前来，命令他筑堡、开荒、逼迫库楚姆并寻找盐源。1594年，塔拉在鞑靼聚落亚洛姆的故地上筑起，是额尔齐斯河这一段第一座俄国城镇。四年后，安德烈·沃耶伊科夫率塔拉派出的射击军、哥萨克和军役鞑靼人，在鄂毕河支流伊尔缅河追上库楚姆，打散他最后的营地，完成了叶尔马克开始的征服。塔拉的军役人员开出西伯利亚第一块官家耕地，又最早探明盐湖，供西部各堡食盐；布哈拉、塔什干和中国的商队沿托博尔斯克至托木斯克的商道前来，买走毛皮，卖来丝绸、茶叶和水果。1634年卡尔梅克人围攻塔拉；1716年，塔拉将领又在额尔齐斯河上游督建一座堡垒，即后来的鄂木斯克。1722年，部分驻军拒绝对彼得大帝所定的继承人宣誓，酿成塔拉兵变：七十名起事者据守一名上校的宅院，四十九人投降，其余点燃火药自爆，不肯就擒；伤者被治好后照样处决，这场清算使塔拉人口减半。从早年起塔拉也是流放地，作家亚历山大·拉季谢夫流放西伯利亚时途经此地，后来又有十二月党人军官在此服刑。

en:
Obdorsk province covers the lower Ob where the river leaves the northern forest and runs through tundra toward the Kara Sea. In 1444 the riverside height of Pulnovat-Vosh was the capital of the northern Khanty Obdorsk principality. A fox served as its princely emblem. Its rulers kept marriage and military ties with the Lyapin princes, fought raids from the Koda principality and shared the tundra edge with Nenets camps; nobles, warriors and tribute families followed shamanist and animist rites. Muscovite soldiers had not yet reached the Arctic Ob.

The Obdorsk princes accepted Moscow's protectorate in 1500, and the title Obdorsky entered the grand prince's titulature soon afterward. Direct rule came only in 1595, when Cossacks built Obdorsky ostrog on the site of Pulnovat-Vosh, the northernmost Russian fort in Siberia. One Obdorsk prince was baptised in Moscow as Vasily in 1600, and a church of St Basil was raised two years later, but Russian authority still rested on bargains with local princes. In 1631 Prince Mamruk encouraged Nenets to attack Mangazeya. His son Yermak Mamrukov tried to unite the volosts of Berezov district in 1662 and 1663 and make Berezov his own base; the plot was uncovered and he was hanged there. By then the ostrog had become the permanent Obdorsk zastava, collecting yasak and guarding river traffic. In 1679 Prince Ginda Molikov won the right to petition Moscow directly, and later Obdorsk princes acted as intermediaries with nomadic Nenets. The fortifications were dismantled in 1807, leaving Obdorsk as a river village and volost centre.
zh:
鄂毕多尔斯克地区位于鄂毕河下游，大河在这里离开北方森林，穿过冻原流向卡拉海。1444年，河畔高地普尔诺瓦特-沃什是北汉特人鄂毕多尔公国的都城，狐狸是其王公徽记。这里的统治者与利亚平王公保持婚姻和军事联系，抵御孔达公国的袭扰，并在冻原边缘与涅涅茨人的营地相邻；贵族、战士和纳贡部众奉行萨满教与万物有灵仪式。莫斯科的军队此时尚未抵达北极鄂毕河。

1500年，鄂毕多尔王公接受莫斯科的保护，「鄂毕多尔」称号很快进入莫斯科大公头衔。直接统治要到1595年才到来：哥萨克在普尔诺瓦特-沃什修建鄂毕多尔斯克寨堡，这是俄国在西伯利亚最北的要塞。1600年，一位鄂毕多尔王公在莫斯科受洗，取名瓦西里；两年后，圣瓦西里教堂建起，但俄国权力仍要依靠与本地王公的妥协。1631年，马姆鲁克王公鼓动涅涅茨人进攻曼加杰亚。他的儿子叶尔马克·马姆鲁科夫在1662至1663年试图联合别列佐夫县各乡，以别列佐夫为自己的据点；密谋败露后，他在那里被绞死。此时寨堡已改为常住的鄂毕多尔关卡，负责征收牙萨克和守卫河路。1679年，金达·莫利科夫王公获得绕开托博尔斯克督军、直接向莫斯科请愿的权利；后来的鄂毕多尔王公则充当俄国与游牧涅涅茨人之间的中间人。1807年防御工事拆除，鄂毕多尔斯克成为河畔村庄和乡治中心。

en:
Berezov province lies on the North Sosva route between the lower Ob and the Northern Urals. In 1444 the Khanty settlement of Sugmut Vosh stood among birch woods and fisheries in the country of the Konda princes. Hunters and traders used its rivers and portages toward the Taz fur country, the land later known around Mangazeya. There was no Russian ostrog here, only a Khanty river town and the trails carrying sable toward Arctic and Ural routes.

Nikifor Trakhaniotov and Mikhail Volkonsky founded a fortress on the site in 1593 while Konda was being annexed. Berezov guarded the western approaches to Mangazeya, collected fur tribute and became one of the early Siberian service towns. Fires largely destroyed it in 1642 and 1719, and much of the Mangazeya traffic had shifted south to Verkhoturye by the late seventeenth century as the northern fur grounds were worked out. Its remoteness then gave the town a different use. A special exile ostrog was built in 1724. Alexander Menshikov, the powerful favourite of Peter the Great, died in Berezov in 1729 with his family; his daughter Maria, once meant to marry Peter II, is buried by the old cathedral. Alexei Dolgorukov and his family were confined there in 1730, and Andrei Ostermann died there after Empress Elizabeth banished him in 1742. In 1740 the French astronomer Joseph-Nicolas Delisle reached Berezov to observe a transit of Mercury, only for cloud to cover the sky. Mid-century gold finds made Siberia's first important gold mine nearby, worked by serfs and convicts.
zh:
别列佐夫地区位于北索西瓦河通道上，这条河路连接下鄂毕河与北乌拉尔山。1444年，汉特人的聚落苏姆特沃什坐落在孔达王公境内的桦林和渔场之间。猎人与商人经这里的河道和连水陆路，前往塔兹河一带的毛皮之地，也就是后来以曼加杰亚闻名的地区。此时这里还没有俄国寨堡，只有一座汉特河镇，以及把紫貂送往北极和乌拉尔商路的猎道。

1593年俄国兼并孔达期间，尼基福尔·特拉哈尼奥托夫和米哈伊尔·沃尔孔斯基在聚落旧址修建要塞。别列佐夫守卫通往曼加杰亚的西部门户，负责征收毛皮贡赋，成为西伯利亚最早的军役城镇之一。1642年和1719年的大火几乎将它焚毁；到17世纪后期，北方毛皮源渐趋枯竭，曼加杰亚商路的大量贸易南移至韦尔霍图里耶。偏远随后给这座城镇带来另一种用途。1724年，这里建起专门的流放寨堡。彼得大帝的宠臣亚历山大·缅希科夫与家人在1729年死于别列佐夫；他的女儿玛丽亚曾被许配给彼得二世，葬在旧大教堂旁。1730年，阿列克谢·多尔戈鲁科夫全家被软禁于此；安德烈·奥斯特曼在伊丽莎白女皇1742年将他流放后死在这里。1740年，法国天文学家德利斯勒远道而来，准备观测水星凌日，却被云层挡住视线。18世纪中期，附近发现金矿，成为西伯利亚第一座重要金矿，劳力是农奴和囚犯。

en:
Qashliq, also called Isker or Sibir, was the fortress on the middle Irtysh that gave the northern fur lands their political centre. The strongpoint stood on the river's right bank, seventeen kilometres above later Tobolsk. Khanty, Mansi and Selkup hunters lived in the forests and paid sable tribute, while Siberian Tatar beks of the Taibugid house controlled the river towns from Chimgi-Tura. In 1444 these lands were a remote northern appanage of Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus. The Tatar ruling house was Sunni Muslim, among the northernmost Muslim rulers of the period, while many of its forest subjects still followed shamans.

As Golden Horde power split apart, the Shaybanid Ibak built an independent Tyumen khanate and seized Chimgi-Tura. Around 1495 the Taibugid Muhammad killed Ibak and moved his capital from Chimgi-Tura to Qashliq; the state then became known as the Khanate of Sibir. Shaybanid and Taibugid princes continued to contest the throne. After Ivan IV took Kazan in 1552, Yadigar Khan sought Moscow's protection, but Kuchum, a grandson of Ibak, overthrew him in 1563, stopped the sable payments and pressed Islam among the Tatar and forest populations.

Kuchum's attacks on Stroganov trading posts brought the Cossack ataman Yermak east with 840 men. On 26 October 1582, after winning at Chuvash Cape, Yermak occupied Qashliq. Kuchum withdrew into the steppe, and in 1585 his men surprised Yermak's camp and killed him. Muscovite commanders then secured the river route with permanent forts: Tyumen in 1586 and Tobolsk in 1587. Qashliq did not keep its place beside the new strongpoints; in 1588, after a Tatar prince was seized there, its inhabitants abandoned the old fortress. Kuchum fought on until 1598, when he was defeated on the Ob and fled to the Nogai steppe. His khanate's name, Sibir, passed to the whole country east of the Urals.
zh:
喀什里克又称伊斯克尔或失必儿，坐落在额尔齐斯河中游右岸，在后来的托博尔斯克上游约17公里，是北方毛皮之地的政治中心。森林中的汉特、曼西和谢尔库普猎人缴纳紫貂皮，泰布吉家族的西伯利亚鞑靼伯克则以成吉-图拉为中心控制各处河上据点。1444年，这里是阿布勒海尔汗乌兹别克兀鲁思偏远的北方封地。统治家族信奉逊尼派伊斯兰教，属当时最靠北的穆斯林统治者之一，而许多森林属民仍信奉萨满教。

金帐汗国分裂时，昔班尼系的伊巴克建立独立的秋明汗国并夺取成吉-图拉。约1495年，泰布吉系的穆罕默德击杀伊巴克，把都城从成吉-图拉迁到喀什里克，这个国家此后称西伯利亚汗国。昔班尼系与泰布吉系王公仍持续争夺汗位。1552年伊凡四世攻灭喀山后，叶吉格尔汗向莫斯科寻求庇护，但伊巴克之孙库楚姆于1563年推翻他，停止缴纳紫貂贡，并向鞑靼居民和森林诸部推行伊斯兰教。

库楚姆袭击斯特罗加诺夫家族的商站，后者便派哥萨克首领叶尔马克率840人东进。1582年10月26日，叶尔马克在楚瓦什角取胜后进占喀什里克。库楚姆退入草原，于1585年派人突袭叶尔马克的营地并将其杀死。莫斯科督军随后用永久要塞控制这条河路：1586年筑秋明，1587年筑托博尔斯克。喀什里克未能在新要塞旁维持下去；1588年一名鞑靼王公在此被俘后，居民放弃了旧堡。库楚姆坚持到1598年，最终在鄂毕河畔战败，逃往诺盖草原。他的汗国之名「失必儿」，被用来称呼乌拉尔山以东的整片土地。

en:
The Tura valley lies where the Siberian forest opens into grassland and the Tyumen Portage carries travel between the northern rivers and the old roads toward the Volga and Central Asia. Sable and squirrel pelts from Khanty and Mansi hunting grounds moved south through this country, and the Tatar town of Chimgi-Tura on the Tyumenka collected them. The town was the early seat of the Taibugid khans, a Muslim ruling house over Siberian Tatar herdsmen and largely shamanist Khanty, Mansi and Selkup forest peoples. The name Tyumen appears in a Russian chronicle in 1406. In 1444, as the Golden Horde broke apart, the country lay within Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation, while Taibugid and Shaybanid Chinggisids disputed the khan's title.

Around 1493 the Taibugid Muhammad killed the Shaybanid Ibak and moved his capital north to Qashliq, also called Sibir. The contest resumed when Kuchum, a Shaybanid, seized the throne in 1563, pressed Islam on his forest subjects and raided the trading posts of the Stroganov family. The Stroganovs sent Yermak east with 840 Cossacks. They stormed Chimgi-Tura on 1 August 1581, broke Kuchum at Chuvash Cape in 1582 and occupied Qashliq. Kuchum's men ambushed and killed Yermak in 1584, and the khan himself was not finally defeated on the Ob until 1598. On 29 July 1586 Tsar Fyodor ordered a wooden fort raised on the ruins of the Tatar town. Tyumen became the first Russian settlement in Siberia, held by streltsy and Cossacks against Tatar and Kalmyk raiders. A post station followed in 1605, Trinity Monastery in 1616, and stronger fortifications in 1640-1642. By the eighteenth century the garrison town had become a fur, leather and blacksmith market between central Russia, Siberia and China, with about seven thousand people in 1763.
zh:
图拉河谷位于西伯利亚森林接入草原的地带，秋明连水陆路把北方水系与通往伏尔加河、中亚的老路连接起来。汉特人和曼西人猎地出产的紫貂、灰鼠皮张经此南运，秋明卡河畔的鞑靼城镇钦吉-图拉负责收拢皮货。这座城镇早年是台不花别系诸汗的驻地，穆斯林王族统治着西伯利亚鞑靼牧民，以及大多仍信萨满的汉特、曼西和塞尔库普森林居民。1406年的一部俄国编年史已经出现「秋明」之名。1444年金帐汗国瓦解，这片土地处在阿布勒海尔的乌兹别克联盟范围内，台不花别系与昔班系的成吉思汗后裔正在争夺汗位。

约1493年，台不花别系的穆罕默德杀死昔班系的伊巴克，把都城北迁到又称失必儿的卡什雷克。1563年，昔班系的库楚姆夺取汗位，向森林属民推行伊斯兰教，并袭掠斯特罗加诺夫家族的商站。斯特罗加诺夫家族派叶尔马克率领八百四十名哥萨克东征。1581年8月1日，他们攻下钦吉-图拉；1582年在楚瓦什岬击败库楚姆，进占卡什雷克。1584年，库楚姆的人马伏击并杀死叶尔马克，库楚姆本人则到1598年才在鄂毕河畔最终战败。1586年7月29日，沙皇费奥多尔一世下诏在鞑靼旧城废墟上修建木堡。秋明成为俄国人在西伯利亚的第一处定居点，由射击军和哥萨克驻守，防范鞑靼与卡尔梅克袭掠者。1605年这里设置驿站，1616年三一修道院建成，1640至1642年又加固城防。到18世纪，这座军堡城镇已经成为俄罗斯中部、西伯利亚与中国之间的毛皮、皮革和铁匠业市场，1763年约有七千居民。

en:
Kurgan covers the middle Tobol in the southern Trans-Urals, where birch woods and forest-steppe give way to open grassland. Long before any Russian settlement, burial mounds called kurgans rose above its pastures, and the large mound beside the later fort gave the town its name. Tatar and Siberian inhabitants hunted furs, raised cattle and horses, and moved between river meadows and dry grazing. In 1444 the Tobol lands were ruled by Tatar beks of the Tyumen country, within Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus. No fixed Russian town stood there yet.

Yermak's 1582 campaign opened the Tobol to Muscovite forts and peasant settlements. The strongest local post came later: in 1679 Timofey Nevezhin, a farmer from Tyumen, founded Tsaryovo Gorodishche, or Imperial Citadel, on the river. Its wooden stockade covered nearby Russian villages against nomad raids, although attackers several times plundered and burned the post itself. In 1782 Empress Catherine II granted the settlement town rights, made it the seat of an uyezd and renamed it Kurgan after the burial mound beside the old fort.
zh:
库尔干位于南乌拉尔以东的托博尔河中游，白桦林和森林草原逐渐让位于开阔草场。俄国村落出现以前，牧场上已矗立着许多被称为库尔干的古墓；后来要塞旁的大墓又给城镇提供了名字。当地鞑靼与西伯利亚居民猎取毛皮、饲养牛马，在河漫滩和干旱牧场之间转场。1444年，托博尔河一带由秋明地方的鞑靼伯克统治，归入阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思，固定的俄国城镇尚未出现。

1582年叶尔马克远征后，莫斯科的要塞和农民村落沿托博尔河推进。本地最重要的据点出现较晚：1679年，来自秋明的农民季莫费·涅韦任在河畔建立皇堡村，名字意为「皇城」。木栅栏护卫附近的俄国村屯抵御游牧民袭扰，但据点本身也几度遭劫掠焚毁。1782年，叶卡捷琳娜二世授予它城市权利，定为县治，并依旧堡旁的古墓将其命名为库尔干。

en:
The Usolka runs into the Kama in Great Perm, the Komi-Permyak country whose princes held Cherdyn and Pokcha while fur traders used the upper Kama and its portages. Around 1430 merchants from Vologda, the Kalinnikov family, began boiling brine on the Borovaya; when its springs proved weak they moved to the Usolka and raised brine pipes, towers and vats on the bank. The works became Usolye Kamskoye, the salt town later called Solikamsk. In 1444 it was a young industrial settlement of the Perm princes, profitable but exposed to Mansi raiders from beyond the Urals.

Moscow subjected Great Perm in 1472, and Ivan IV's charter of 1558 to the Stroganovs opened the Kama lands to wider settlement. The 1579 survey found a fortified posad of 190 households, 16 saltworks and 26 shops; two years later Pelym prince Kihek burned the town in a Mansi and Tatar raid. Artemy Babinov's road to Verkhoturye, opened in 1597, made Sol Kamskaya the starting point of the only overland road from European Russia into Siberia. Voivodes were appointed from 1613, and the Pyskor works that opened in 1635 was the first copper smelter in Russia; a later copper factory made samovars and table services for the imperial family. By the 1680s the district had 249 saltworks, 78 of them Stroganov property, and Solikamsk boiled more than half of the salt sold in Russia. It entered Siberia Governorate in 1708. Ninety-seven Swedish prisoners of the Great Northern War were billeted in the town in 1711, among them Captain Philipp von Strahlenberg, who went on to make the first study of Ural antiquities. A newer Siberian highway through Perm and Kungur then bypassed the town; Solikamsk became a uyezd town in 1781, and by the early nineteenth century lived on smaller soap, glass and leather works.
zh:
乌索尔卡河在大彼尔姆的土地上注入卡马河。这里是科米-彼尔姆人的家园，彼尔姆王公据有切尔登和波克恰，毛皮商人利用卡马河上游和各处连水陆路往来。约1430年，来自沃洛格达的商人卡林尼科夫家族先在博罗瓦亚河煮盐，因卤水淡薄，又转到乌索尔卡河畔，竖起提卤管、井塔和煮盐灶。这片盐场就是乌索利耶卡姆斯科耶，后来得名索利卡姆斯克。1444年时，它是彼尔姆王公治下一座新兴的工业聚落，靠盐获利，也时常遭到乌拉尔山外曼西人袭扰。

1472年，莫斯科迫使大彼尔姆臣服；1558年，伊凡四世下诏把卡马河一带的大片土地封给斯特罗加诺夫家族，引来更多移民。1579年税册记载，这里已是设防城郊区，有190户、16处盐场和26家店铺；两年后，佩雷姆王公基赫克在曼西人和鞑靼人的袭掠中烧毁全城。1597年，阿尔捷米·巴比诺夫开通通往韦尔霍图里耶的道路，卡姆斯卡亚盐镇成为俄罗斯欧洲部分进入西伯利亚的唯一旱路起点。1613年起向这里派驻督军；1635年投产的佩斯科尔工厂是俄罗斯第一座炼铜厂，后来的铜器厂还生产茶炊和皇室餐具。到1680年代，全地区有249处盐场，其中78处归斯特罗加诺夫家族，索利卡姆斯克出产的盐占俄罗斯市场售盐的一半以上。1708年它划入西伯利亚省。1711年，97名大北方战争中的瑞典战俘被安置到城中，瑞典军上尉菲利普·冯·施特拉伦贝格也在其中，他后来最早系统研究乌拉尔古物。新的西伯利亚大道改经彼尔姆和昆古尔，绕开了这座城；1781年它成为县城，到19世纪初只靠肥皂、玻璃和皮革等小厂维持。

en:
Tura is the upper Tura River country, where the Middle Urals sink low enough to let travellers pass from the Kama basin toward the Ob. Mansi hunters and fishermen, whom Russians called Voguls, lived in timber settlements along the river, keeping reindeer and trapping sable, and Neromkar was one of their strong places on the ground later occupied by Verkhoturye. In the fifteenth century the Mansi were grouped into small principalities such as Pelym and Konda, and southern communities felt the pull of the Tatar khanates. In 1444 Perm and Moscow still lay far beyond the pass: Tura was a pagan Uralic country, and its sable pelts moved through native traders rather than a Russian market.

That pass became valuable once Russia began the conquest of Siberia. A Muscovite river army had already beaten the Mansi prince Asyka near Pelym in 1483, but the first lasting road was Artemy Babinov's route from Solikamsk across the mountains in 1597. Vasily Golovin and Ivan Voyeykov raised the Verkhoturye ostrog on Neromkar the next year, and a customs house followed in 1600. Every winter sledge trains hauled goods from Solikamsk and stacked them in the town until the thaw. Furs paid as yasak went on to the Sable Treasury in Moscow, private pelts leaving Siberia paid a tenth of their value, and guards patrolled the woods to stop merchants slipping around the customs post. In 1695 the government closed every other legal road out of the Kama basin, leaving Verkhoturye the sole gate into Siberia; a men's monastery founded in 1604, the oldest women's monastery beyond the Urals from 1621, and a stone kremlin built between 1698 and 1714 gave the town its permanent shape. When the Siberian Route opened through Yekaterinburg in 1763 the trade drove south, and in 1783 Verkhoturye passed to Perm Viceroyalty, by then a quiet monastery and old-road town.
zh:
图拉是图拉河上游一带，中乌拉尔山在这里低伏下来，留出一条从卡马河流域通往鄂毕河流域的通道。曼西人（俄罗斯人旧称沃古尔人）是这里的居民：猎人和渔夫住在河畔的木寨里，养鹿、捕紫貂，涅罗姆卡尔便是他们的据点之一，后来的韦尔霍图里耶就建在这片地上。15世纪的曼西人分成佩雷姆、孔达等小公国，南部各部受鞑靼汗国影响。1444年，彼尔姆和莫斯科仍远在山口之外，图拉是信奉本地信仰的乌拉尔地方，紫貂皮经本地商人之手流转，还不进俄国市场。

俄国征服西伯利亚之后，这个山口身价倍增。莫斯科水路军队早在1483年就在佩雷姆附近击败曼西王公阿西卡，但第一条常年通行的路是阿尔捷米·巴比诺夫1597年探出的路线，从索利卡姆斯克翻越山岭。次年，瓦西里·戈洛文和伊万·沃耶伊科夫在涅罗姆卡尔筑起韦尔霍图里耶寨堡，1600年又设海关。每年冬天，雪橇队把货物从索利卡姆斯克拉来，堆在城里等开春解冻。作为牙萨克上缴的毛皮继续运往莫斯科的紫貂库，私商带出西伯利亚的毛皮要缴纳十分之一的税，林中还有巡逻队防备商人绕关。1695年，官府封闭了卡马河流域其他所有合法出路，只留韦尔霍图里耶这一道进入西伯利亚的大门；1604年创办的男修道院、1621年设立的乌拉尔山以东最古老的女修道院，以及1698年至1714年建起的石砌克里姆林宫，使小城初具规模。1763年西伯利亚大路改走叶卡捷琳堡，商路南移；1783年韦尔霍图里耶改隶彼尔姆总督区，那时已是一座安静的修道院城镇和旧路驿站。

en:
The Vyatka country fills the forested river basin that joins the Volga system northeast of Moscow. Its older population was Permian, the ancestors of the Udmurts; Russian settlers traditionally linked with Novgorod built Khlynov on the Vyatka, and the settlement enters reliable chronicles in 1374, when Vyatka boatmen sailed to Sarai on a raid. Those boatmen were ushkuyniki, fighters in shallow-draft vessels that could be carried across portages. Thick forests separated Khlynov, Kotelnich and Orlov from Moscow, and a popular assembly ran local affairs. In 1444 the land was not an ordinary Muscovite district: its boyars and armed merchants had backed Yury of Galich and Dmitry Shemyaka against Vasily II, and they bargained with Moscow and Kazan as their own wars required.

Vasily II's first two commanders failed outside Khlynov, reportedly after being bought off, and the third campaign forced submission in 1459. Khan Ibrahim of Kazan then extracted a promise that Vyatka would not join Moscow's campaigns against him. Ivan III ended the arrangement in 1489: Daniil Shchenya took Kotelnich and Orlov, besieged Khlynov, and deported its leading families after three atamans were executed in Moscow. The town later made its living as a mart. Siberian furs reached its Semyonovskaya fair with goods from the Urals and the White Sea country; the five-domed Assumption Cathedral went up in 1689, and five years later the merchant Spiridon Lyangusov led the first Russian trade caravan from Moscow to China.
zh:
维亚特卡指莫斯科东北、接入伏尔加水系的森林河流域。这里的原住民是彼尔姆人，即乌德穆尔特人的先民；相传与诺夫哥罗德有关的罗斯拓殖者在维亚特卡河畔建起赫雷诺夫。它在可靠编年史中首次出现于1374年，当时维亚特卡河兵乘船劫掠萨莱。这些河兵叫乌什库伊尼克，驾着可以拖过联运道的浅水船。密林把赫雷诺夫、科捷利尼奇和奥尔洛夫与莫斯科隔开，本地事务由市民会议处理。1444年的维亚特卡并不是安分的莫斯科属地：贵族和武装商人曾支持加利奇的尤里与德米特里·舍米亚卡对抗瓦西里二世，又按战事需要在莫斯科和喀山之间讨价还价。

瓦西里二世的前两任将领在赫雷诺夫城下失败，据说还被收买；第三次出征才在1459年迫使它臣服。喀山汗易卜拉欣随后逼维亚特卡许诺，不随莫斯科进攻喀山。1489年，伊凡三世终结了这种状态：丹尼尔·谢尼亚攻占科捷利尼奇和奥尔洛夫，围困赫雷诺夫；三名阿塔曼被解往莫斯科处死后，望族也被迁居他地。后来这座城靠商站立稳，西伯利亚毛皮连同乌拉尔和白海地区的货物来到谢苗诺夫市集；五穹顶的圣母安息大教堂建于1689年，五年后，商人斯皮里东·良古索夫率领第一支从莫斯科前往中国的俄国商队。

en:
Pelym is the cold northern Ural country around the meeting of the Pelym River and the Tavda, a land of taiga, portages and the old Cherdyn road across the mountains into Siberia. It was the seat of the Pelym princes, one of the Mansi (Vogul) chiefdoms whose hunters and reindeer herders trapped sable and travelled between the Kama and Ob basins. In 1444 Muscovite power stopped far to the west, and Pelym remained a pagan Uralic strongpoint from which Mansi raiding parties struck the Perm lands; furs, river routes and forest craft made the small chiefdom count for more than its population.

In 1455 Prince Asyka raided Ust-Vym, killed Bishop Pitirim and carried his plunder back to Pelym; a Muscovite river army under Fyodor Kurbsky-Cherny and Ivan Saltyk-Travin beat him outside Pelym on 29 July 1483, though Asyka got away. The last Pelym prince, Ablegirim, was defeated while the Russians secured the Cherdyn route and was taken with his family as hostages to Moscow. Cherdyn voivodes Pyotr Gorchakov and Nikifor Trakhaniotov built the Pelym ostrog on the site of his moving camp in 1591-1593, marking the eastern end of the road from Europe. A prefabricated timber fort was floated down from Upper Lozva in 1597 with the family of Ignaty Khripunov, the first Russians exiled to Siberia; Uglich townspeople implicated in the death of Tsarevich Dmitry followed, along with streltsy and Cossacks. Pelym served as a customs and yasak station on the Tavda, but the shorter Babinov road soon drew the Siberian trade south. Burned twice in the seventeenth century and twice rebuilt, it lived on as a remote place of exile for grandees: the Duke of Courland, Ernst Johann von Biron, was held here in 1741-1742, and Field Marshal Burkhard von Munnich from 1742 to 1762.
zh:
佩雷姆地处北乌拉尔的严寒地带，佩雷姆河与塔夫达河在此相汇，泰加林、水陆联运的渡口和翻山西伯利亚的古切尔登路都在这里。曼西人（俄罗斯人旧称沃古尔人）的佩雷姆王公以此为据点，部众猎紫貂、养鹿，往来于卡马河与鄂毕河流域之间。1444年，莫斯科的势力远止于西方，佩雷姆仍是信奉本地信仰的乌拉尔据点，曼西袭掠队从这里奔袭彼尔姆诸地；毛皮、河路与林中本事，让这个人口不多的小公国分量不轻。

1455年，王公阿西卡袭破乌斯季-维姆，杀死皮季里姆主教，带着战利品退回佩雷姆；1483年7月29日，费奥多尔·库尔布斯基-乔尔内和伊万·萨尔特科夫-特拉温率莫斯科水路军队在佩雷姆城外将他击败，阿西卡却脱身逃走。俄国人肃清切尔登路时，末代佩雷姆王公阿布列吉里姆兵败，与家人一起被作为人质送往莫斯科。1591年至1593年间，切尔登督军彼得·戈尔恰科夫和尼基福尔·特拉哈尼奥托夫在他移动王帐的旧址筑起佩雷姆寨堡，这里便是欧洲来路的东端。1597年，一座预制木寨从上洛兹瓦顺流漂来，同行的伊格纳特·赫里普诺夫一家是最早被流放西伯利亚的俄国人；因皇储德米特里之死获罪的乌格利奇市民随后也被押来，同行的还有射击军和哥萨克。佩雷姆本是塔夫达河上的海关兼牙萨克征收点，但更短的巴比诺夫路很快把西伯利亚贸易引向南方。它在17世纪两度焚毁又两度重建，此后作为遥远的要人流放地存续：库尔兰公爵恩斯特·约翰·冯·比龙1741年至1742年被囚于此，陆军元帅布尔克哈德·冯·明尼希1742年至1762年流放于此。

en:
Above the Samara Bend the Volga's right bank rises into a steep ridge called the Venets, on which the Russians later built Simbirsk; on the opposite bank stood the old Bulgar stronghold remembered as the Sinbirskoye gorodishche, which gave the place its name. After the break-up of the Golden Horde this country belonged to the Khanate of Kazan, its riverbank dotted with Tatar villages and weathered Bulgar earthworks, while the open steppe to the south and east was Nogai grazing ground. In 1444 there was no town here, only river landings and abandoned fortifications.

In 1648 the voevoda Bogdan Khitrovo, acting for Tsar Alexei Mikhailovich, raised a wooden eight-towered kremlin on the Venets to close the eastern end of the Belgorod defence line against raiders from the steppe. In the autumn of 1670 Stepan Razin's army battered the kremlin for a month and four assaults were beaten off; on 4 October Razin was twice wounded fighting Voevoda Baryatinsky's troops, and his men carried him to a boat and fled down the Volga. His ataman Fyodor Sheludyak failed before the same walls the following summer, and the tsar granted the town its first coat of arms for the two defences. Royal exiles and travellers also stopped here: in 1666 the widowed queen of Kakheti, Elena, lodged three months on her way to Moscow with her young son Nikoloz, who later ruled as King Erekle I. Peter I, driven ashore by a storm on his voyage to Astrakhan, presented the Trinity Cathedral with an icon of the Mother of God, and Catherine II wrote to Nikita Panin after her visit in 1767 that this was the sorriest town in Russia, every house but her merchant host's confiscated for tax arrears. In October 1774 Alexander Suvorov brought the captured Yemelyan Pugachev here in an iron cage to be interrogated before he was sent on to Moscow. Simbirsk became the seat of its governorate in 1796, and the novelist Ivan Goncharov was born here in 1812.
zh:
萨马拉河湾上游，伏尔加河右岸隆起一道名为「冠冈」的陡岭，俄国人后来在岭上建起辛比尔斯克；对岸立着伏尔加保加利亚时代的古堡辛比尔城址，辛比尔斯克之名即由此而来。金帐汗国瓦解后，这一带归属喀山汗国，河岸散布鞑靼人的村落和风化的保加利亚工事，东南方的开阔草原则是诺盖人的牧场。1444年这里还没有城镇，只有河埠与被弃的旧垒。

1648年，奉沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇之命，督军博格丹·希特罗沃在冠冈筑起八塔木构克里姆林，封住别尔哥罗德防线的东端，用以抵挡草原袭掠。1670年秋，斯捷潘·拉辛的大军围攻克里姆林整整一个月，四次强攻均被击退；10月4日，拉辛在与督军巴里亚京斯基所部交战时两次负伤，被部下抬上小船顺伏尔加河逃走。次年夏天，他的首领费奥多尔·舍卢佳克再攻同一道城墙仍告失败，沙皇因这两次守城赐下城徽。流落的王族也曾在此落脚：1666年，卡赫季王太后叶莲娜带着幼子尼古拉赴莫斯科，途中在此住了三个月，这个孩子后来成为伊拉克利一世。彼得一世乘船前往阿斯特拉罕时为风暴所阻曾在此停泊，向三一教堂赠予一尊圣母像；1767年叶卡捷琳娜二世到访后写信给尼基塔·帕宁，说这是全俄国最破烂的城，除她下榻的商人家外，全城房屋都因欠税被抄没。1774年10月，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫把被俘的叶梅利扬·普加乔夫装进铁笼押到这里审讯，随后转送莫斯科。1796年，辛比尔斯克成为辛比尔斯克省首府，小说家伊万·冈察洛夫1812年出生于此。

en:
Kazan lies where the little Kazanka River runs into the Volga. It began around the turn of the 11th century as a white-stone northern border fortress of Volga Bulgaria, facing the Mari and Udmurt forests, and under the Golden Horde it became the chief market of the middle Volga, coining money as 'New Bolgar' and linking the furs of Perm and Vyatka with Persia and Central Asia. In 1438 the ousted Horde khan Ulugh Muhammad seized the town, ringed it with a timber Kremlin and made it the capital of his new Kazan Khanate; its bazaars dealt in leather, weapons, grain and slaves, and in 1439 his army stood before Moscow. In 1444 Kazan was the strongest Muslim power on the Volga, its horsemen raiding Nizhny Novgorod and Ryazan.

In 1445 the khan crushed a Muscovite army at Suzdal and led Grand Prince Vasily II away captive. Ivan III broke the khanate's freedom after a long siege in 1487 and set a Moscow-backed ruler on the throne; when the Crimean Girey dynasty took power in the 1520s, Kazan launched some forty raids into Russian lands before 1545. The regent Söyembikä, a Nogai princess, held the city for her young son until the Russians built the river fortress of Sviyazhsk nearby in 1551, cutting her off from the Volga. Ivan IV's army closed on Kazan in 1552, breached the walls with mines after forty-nine days and stormed it on 2 October; mosques and palaces were ruined and many Tatars killed, exiled or baptised. The survivors were moved beyond the Bulak stream into the Old Tatar Quarter, while a white-stone Kremlin rose from 1556. In 1579, after a great fire, the girl Matrona dug up in the ruins the icon the Virgin had shown her in a dream, Our Lady of Kazan; Prince Pozharsky carried a copy before the militia that freed Moscow in 1612. Pugachev's rebels burned the wooden city in 1774 but could not take the Kremlin, and under Catherine II the Marjani Mosque became the first mosque lawfully built since the conquest. The Qur'an was printed in Kazan in 1801, and the university founded in 1804 made the city Russia's leading school of Oriental studies.
zh:
喀山位于卡赞卡小河汇入伏尔加河之处。11世纪之交，它本是伏尔加保加利亚一座白色石砌的北部边塞，面向马里人和乌德穆尔特人的森林；金帐汗国时期，它成为伏尔加河中游最大的商埠，以「新保加尔」之名自铸钱币，把彼尔姆和维亚特卡的毛皮同波斯、中亚连通起来。1438年，被逐下台的金帐汗兀鲁·穆罕默德夺取该城，围起木构克里姆林，以新建的喀山汗国为都；市集上交易皮革、兵器、粮食和奴隶，1439年他的大军甚至兵临莫斯科城下。1444年的喀山是伏尔加河上最强大的伊斯兰政权，骑兵四出袭掠下诺夫哥罗德和梁赞。

1445年，喀山军队在苏兹达尔击溃莫斯科军，俘虏大公瓦西里二世而去。1487年，伊凡三世经长期围城攻破喀山，改立受莫斯科支持的统治者；16世纪20年代克里米亚格莱王朝掌权后，到1545年为止喀山约四十次攻入罗斯土地。诺盖公主出身的摄政苏尤姆别卡代幼子守着喀山，直到1551年俄军在附近伏尔加河上筑起斯维亚日斯克要塞，切断了她与伏尔加河的联系。1552年伊凡四世的大军压境，经四十九天围攻，用地雷炸开城墙，10月2日突入喀山；清真寺和宫殿被毁，大批鞑靼居民被杀、流放或受洗。幸存者被迁往布拉克河沟外的老鞑靼街区，白石克里姆林则从1556年起在城中建起。1579年大火之后，女孩马特廖娜按圣母在梦中的指点，在废墟里掘出一尊圣像，即后来的喀山圣母像；1612年波扎尔斯基带着它的摹本，随民军解放莫斯科。1774年普加乔夫起义军焚毁木城，却没能拿下克里姆林；叶卡捷琳娜二世时代，马尔贾尼清真寺成为征服以来第一座获准合法修建的清真寺。1801年喀山印行《古兰经》，1804年创办的大学使这座城市成为俄国首屈一指的东方学中心。

en:
The Vetluga is a long left-bank Volga river through marshy forest, and its middle valley was Mari country, the Cheremis of Russian chronicles. Mari clans held the route between the Northern Dvina and Volga systems: boats and portages carried furs south, while a land road ran from the Kostroma lands deeper into Mari territory. Their stronghold was Yur, probably beside the later town of Vetluga. In the fourteenth century the kuguz Osh Pandash united local clans, brought in Tatar bands, and wore down Prince Andrey of Galich in a nineteen-year war. From 1443 the Mari on this border were tied to Kazan, so in 1444 Yur guarded a fur-hunting people of the old forest faith, between Galich, Nizhny Novgorod and the khanate.

At Epiphany in January 1468, Prince Semyon Yaroslavsky led a Galich army out for Ivan III, marching without roads through a bitterly cold winter. The chronicle says the troops killed or captured people, burned settlements and slaughtered livestock they could not carry away, returning when they were within a day's march of Kazan; Yur was completely burned and the middle Vetluga stayed thinly settled for decades. After Kazan fell in 1552, Mari risings known as the Cheremis Wars continued into the 1580s, and Russian forts along the Volga and Vyatka secured the conquest. Russian peasants resettled the valley and sent grain and timber rafts down to the Volga. A village near Yur became Voskresenskoye, and Catherine II chartered it as the town of Vetluga in 1778. Local legend adds that its petitioners danced in bast shoes before the empress to win the charter.
zh:
韦特卢加河是伏尔加河左岸的长河，穿过多沼泽的森林；其中游是马里人的土地，罗斯编年史称他们为切列米斯人。马里各部控制着北德维纳河水系与伏尔加河水系之间的通道：毛皮随小船和联运道南下，一条陆路又从科斯特罗马地区通向马里腹地。他们的要塞是尤尔，位置大约在后来的韦特卢加城一带。14世纪，首领奥什·潘达什联合各部，招来鞑靼武装，用十九年战争拖垮加利奇王公安德烈。1443年起，这一带的马里人臣属喀山，所以1444年的尤尔护卫着这个仍守山林旧信、以猎取毛皮为生的民族，夹在加利奇、下诺夫哥罗德和喀山汗国之间。

1468年1月主显节，谢苗·雅罗斯拉夫斯基奉伊凡三世之命率领加利奇军队出征，在严寒中离开道路穿越森林。编年史称他们杀戮或掳走人口，焚毁村落，宰杀带不走的牲畜，回师时距喀山只剩一日路程；尤尔被彻底烧毁，韦特卢加中游此后数十年人烟稀少。1552年喀山陷落后，马里人的起义以「切列米斯战争」之名延续到1580年代，伏尔加河和维亚特卡河沿线的俄罗斯要塞巩固了征服。俄罗斯农民重新垦殖河谷，把粮食和木材放排运往伏尔加河。尤尔故址附近的村庄后来成为沃斯克列先斯科耶，1778年由叶卡捷琳娜二世颁诏改建为韦特卢加城。当地传说还称，请愿者穿着树皮鞋在女皇面前跳舞，才换来这道建城诏令。

en:
The estuary of the Swan and Canning Rivers and the wetlands of the coastal
plain behind it are Wadjuk country, one of the Noongar lands of
south-western Australia. The two rivers divided Wadjuk groups, who moved by
six seasons rather than a fixed village: summer families took fish and
abalone on the coastal reefs; winter rains drew them inland to the Darling
Scarp, to hunt kangaroo and dig roots. Red ochre from the river country and
quartz from the scarp entered neighbouring trade, the Wagyl was remembered
as the being who shaped the rivers and lakes, and the island offshore was
the place 'across the water where the spirits are'. In 1444 this
harbourless coast was known only to Noongar clans.

Dutch ships had sighted reefs farther north along the coast by 1619, but no
European entered the Swan River until January 1697, when Willem de
Vlamingh, sent in search of a lost Dutch ship, landed beside the site of
present Perth. He named the river for its black swans, rowed upstream as
far as Heirisson Island, and called the island offshore 't Eylandt 't
Rottenest, 'rats' nest', after the quokkas his men found there; he charted
the waters and sailed away without founding anything. A French expedition
under Nicolas Baudin examined the river in 1801. At the end of 1821 the
Wadjuk still moved between the estuary, wetlands and scarp by their six
seasons, and no European settlement had yet been built on the river.
zh:
天鹅河与坎宁河的河口，以及身后海岸平原上的湿地，是瓦迪尤克人的土地，也是澳
大利亚西南部农雅诸地之一。两条河把瓦迪尤克人的不同居群分开，他们不定居一
村，而按六季迁徙：夏季全家到海边礁岩间捕鱼、采鲍鱼，冬季雨水把他们引向内
陆的达令崖，猎袋鼠、挖块根。河畔的红赭石和崖地的石英进入邻近部族的商路；
在传说里，瓦吉尔塑造了这些河流与湖泊，海外那座岛则是「水那边灵魂所在之
地」。1444年，这段没有良港的海岸只有农雅诸氏族知晓。

到1619年，荷兰船只已在这段海岸更北处望见礁石，但直到1697年1月，为搜寻一
艘失踪荷兰船而来的威廉·德·弗拉明才驶入天鹅河，在后来的珀斯所在地登陆。他
以河中的黑天鹅为这条河命名，乘船上溯到海里森岛一带；近海一座岛上，部下见
到短尾矮袋鼠，他便用荷兰语把该岛称作「老鼠巢」。弗拉明测绘水势后离去，没
有留下任何定居点。1801年，尼古拉·博丹率领的法国探险队考察了这条河。1821
年底，瓦迪尤克人仍随六季往返于河口、湿地与崖地之间，河畔还没有欧洲人的定
居点。

en:
Paredarerme, also called Oyster Bay Tasmanian, was the language of the peoples on Tasmania's central eastern coast, whose country centred on broad Great Oyster Bay. The Freycinet Peninsula, with its granite Hazards peaks and Schouten Island off its tip, shelters the bay; at its head the Aspley and Swan rivers feed Moulting Lagoon. From autumn through winter, Oyster Bay bands gathered on the shore to gather shellfish and sea vegetables. At the end of July swans and ducks came to the lagoon to nest, and in August most bands moved up the Little Swanport and Prosser Rivers to the Eastern Marshes, hunting birds, kangaroos and wallabies, while the Linetemairrener kept to the lagoon all year. In 1444 these rounds joined bay, rivers and inland marshes as one country.

Europeans long knew this coast only from seaward. Abel Tasman's ships passed in 1642: he mistook the narrow-necked Freycinet Peninsula for an island, named it Vanderlyn Island, and sailed on to New Zealand without entering the bay. On 3 July 1789 John Henry Cox brought the Mercury in, called the water Oyster Bay after the seal colonies he had heard of, and met Aboriginal people; on 27 July 1791 Captain Weatherhead of the Matilda made the first recorded landing on the peninsula, which he too took for an island. In 1802 Nicolas Baudin's French expedition charted these shores and named the peninsula after his officer Louis de Freycinet. Hobart was founded far to the south in 1803–04, but the Oyster Bay people kept their bay until 1821, when George Meredith arrived from Wales with family and workers and, holding a grant from Lieutenant-Governor William Sorell, set up Great Swanport, later Swansea, with farms, a tannery, a flour mill and whaling stations nearby.
zh:
帕莱达勒米又称牡蛎湾塔斯马尼亚语，通行于塔斯马尼亚岛中东部各族群，他们的土地以宽阔的大牡蛎湾为中心。弗雷西内半岛上花岗岩群峰耸立，尖端外是斯豪滕岛，为海湾挡住外海；湾顶的阿斯普利河与斯旺河汇入莫尔廷潟湖。秋季到冬季，牡蛎湾各群聚到海边采集贝类和海菜。7月底天鹅和野鸭来到潟湖筑巢，8月多数群体沿小天鹅港河和普罗瑟河上溯到东部沼泽，捕猎鸟类、袋鼠和沙袋鼠，利内特马伊雷纳人则全年守在潟湖旁。1444年，这些季节性往返把海湾、河流和内陆沼泽连成同一片土地。

欧洲人在很长时间里只从海上望见这片海岸。1642年，阿贝尔·塔斯曼的船队经过，他把地峡窄小的弗雷西内半岛误认成岛屿，命名为范德林岛，随后驶向新西兰，没有进入牡蛎湾。1789年7月3日，约翰·亨利·考克斯乘「水星号」驶入湾中，按听说的海豹群把这片水域命名为牡蛎湾，并与原住民接触；1791年7月27日，「马蒂尔达号」船长韦瑟黑德首次有记录地登上半岛，他同样把半岛误认成岛屿。1802年，尼古拉·博丹的法国考察队测绘这片海岸，以其副手路易·德·弗雷西内之姓为半岛命名。1803至1804年，霍巴特在遥远的南方建立，但牡蛎湾人一直保有自己的海湾，直到1821年乔治·梅雷迪思带着家人和雇工从威尔士前来，凭副总督威廉·索雷尔的批地建起大天鹅港，即后来的斯旺西，开办农场、鞣皮坊、磨坊，并在附近设立捕鲸站。

en:
The Adelaide Plains between Gulf St Vincent and the Mount Lofty Ranges are Kaurna country. The people called the gulf Wongga Yerlo, the western sea, and the River Torrens Karrawirra Pari; Tarndanyangga, the red kangaroo place on that river, is the ground later covered by central Adelaide. More than twenty family bands held the plain, each with a pangkarra, a tract that ran from the coast, where they fished and gathered shellfish, inland to grassy flats and wooded foothills. Every band was divided between two exogamous moieties, Karuru and Mattari, and men married women of the other moiety. They burned the grasslands to keep them open for murnong roots and kangaroo, and returned over generations to the same raised grounds. Their language belonged to the Thura-Yura family, and their country ran from Cape Jervis to Port Wakefield. In 1444 these bounds were kept by Kaurna families alone.

British and French ships reached the gulf in 1802. Matthew Flinders, surveying for the British Admiralty, named it St Vincent after the Earl of St Vincent on 30 March, and on 8 April he met Nicolas Baudin's French expedition at Encounter Bay, south of the Kaurna plain. The two navigators swapped charts and news without suspicion, each believing his country was still at war with the other; the Peace of Amiens had been signed two weeks earlier, but word of it had not reached them. Baudin's surveyors then mapped the waters Flinders had named. Neither expedition left a settlement. In 1821 the river camps, the coastal fishing grounds and the red kangaroo country were still wholly Kaurna.
zh:
圣文森特湾与洛夫蒂山脉之间的阿德莱德平原，是高纳（Kaurna，中文资料常译考尔纳）人的土地。他们称海湾为翁加耶洛（Wongga Yerlo，意为西海），称多伦士河为卡拉维拉帕里（Karrawirra Pari）；河畔的塔恩丹扬加（Tarndanyangga）意为红袋鼠之地，后来的阿德莱德市中心就在那里。平原上住着二十多个家族居群，每个居群都有自己的「潘卡拉」（pangkarra）领地：从捕鱼拾贝的海岸一直延伸到开阔草地和林木山麓。每个居群又分属卡鲁鲁和马塔里两个外婚半偶族，男子必须娶另一半偶族的女子。人们烧荒保持草地开阔，以利采集山药菊（murnong）块根和捕猎袋鼠，又世代回到同一批高地营地。他们的语言属图拉—尤拉语系，地界南起杰维斯角，北至韦克菲尔德港。1444年，这些地界全靠高纳各家族自己维系。

1802年，英国和法国船只先后进入这座海湾。为英国海军部测绘海岸的马修·弗林德斯，于3月30日以圣文森特伯爵之名将海湾命名为圣文森特湾；4月8日，他在高纳平原南方的因康特湾遇到尼古拉·博丹率领的法国探险队。两位航海家毫无戒心地交换海图和消息，都以为两国仍在交战：《亚眠和约》已在两周前签订，只是消息还没有传到他们耳中。随后博丹的制图师测绘了弗林德斯刚命名的水域。两支探险队都没有留下定居点。1821年，河畔营地、海边渔场和红袋鼠之地仍完全属于高纳人。

en:
The Yarra, Birrarung to its Wurundjeri owners, winds from forested ranges into Port Phillip, the great Kulin bay called Naarm. The Wurundjeri spoke Woiwurrung and shared the lower bay and its fishing grounds with the Boonwurrung. They moved through a year of seven seasons, burning the grasslands to keep them open for the murnong yam daisy, their staple starch, while Bolin Bolin lagoon yielded eels, fish and possums. Their most valued trade goods came from Mount William, where the clans quarried diorite in pits several metres deep and ground greenstone axe heads; the quarry had been worked for more than 1,500 years, and its axes were exchanged as far as New South Wales and Adelaide. Several hundred, at times as many as eight hundred, Kulin people gathered near the bay for marriage, ceremony and the settlement of disputes. In 1444 the Wurundjeri numbered perhaps four hundred.

British ships entered the bay in 1802: John Murray claimed it for Britain in March, and Matthew Flinders spent five days surveying it after sailing in on 26 April. Early in 1803 Charles Grimes took a boat up the Maribyrnong and the Yarra as far as Dights Falls. David Collins landed a convict and marine party at Sullivan Bay on the southern shore on 16 October 1803, but scarce water, thin soil, an exposed anchorage and armed resistance around the bay defeated him; the camp was abandoned within months and the settlers removed to Van Diemen's Land. One convict, William Buckley, escaped into the bush instead, and in 1821 he was still living with the Wathaurong people west of the bay, eighteen years after his escape. No British town yet stood on the Yarra.
zh:
雅拉河在伍伦杰里人口中叫比拉朗（Birrarung），它从林木山地蜿蜒流入库林人的大海湾菲利普港，也就是纳姆（Naarm）。伍伦杰里人说沃伊沃隆语，同布翁隆人共用海湾下游渔场。他们的一年分为七季，按时烧荒，保持草地开阔，好采挖作为主食淀粉来源的山药菊（murnong）；博林博林潟湖则出产鳗鱼、鱼和负鼠。他们最受看重的出产来自威廉山：各家族在数米深的坑穴里开采闪长岩，磨制绿岩斧头；采石场已开采一千五百多年，成品远销到新南威尔士和阿德莱德一带。数百人、有时多至八百名库林人在湾边聚会，联姻、举行仪式、调解争端。1444年，伍伦杰里人约有四百口。

英国船只在1802年进入海湾：约翰·默里于3月代表英国宣布占有，马修·弗林德斯4月26日驶入后用五天测绘港湾。1803年初，查尔斯·格莱姆斯率船探入马里巴农河，又沿雅拉河上溯到迪茨瀑布。1803年10月16日，大卫·柯林斯带着罪犯和海军卫队在湾南岸的沙利文湾登陆，但淡水匮乏、土壤瘠薄、锚地无屏蔽，加上湾周原住民的武装抵抗，使他放弃了营地；几个月后营地撤空，人员迁往范迪门斯地。罪犯威廉·巴克利却逃进丛林，1821年仍和海湾西侧的瓦萨龙人生活在一起，距他逃入丛林已有十八年。雅拉河畔还没有英国城镇。

en:
The Wimmera River and a chain of lakes, Hindmarsh, Albacutya and Tyrrell, water a flat country of mallee scrub and grassland between the Grampians, Gariwerd to the people who lived there, and the Murray plains. It is held by the Wergaia, who call themselves Maligundidj, people of the mallee, perhaps twenty clans arranged under two matrilineal moieties, gabadj the black cockatoo and grugidj the white. Their first question to a stranger was ngaia yauarin, 'what is your flesh', asking where he stood in that order of kin and totem. Beside Lake Tyrrell the Boorong clan read the seasons in the stars: the northern rise of Marpeankuurk, Arcturus, told them to gather wood-ant larvae, and when Neilloan, Vega, set at dusk the malleefowl eggs were ready. A Wudjubalug story tells how the spirit Pupperimbul made the sun Gnowee by hurling an emu egg into the dark sky. In 1444 that calendar still moved the clans from lake to lake, and no European had entered the mallee.

The first outsiders reached them unseen. After the British landed at Sydney in 1788, smallpox very likely travelled Aboriginal trade routes faster than any settler and came down the Murray into the Wimmera, killing widely years before any European walked there; the Wudjubalug called the sickness thinba micka and said hostile sorcerers to the north had sent it.
zh:
维么拉河与欣德马什湖、阿尔巴库蒂亚湖、蒂勒尔湖等一串湖泊，滋养着格兰扁山脉（当地人称作加里沃德）与墨累河平原之间一片平坦的马利桉灌丛草原。这里是韦尔盖亚人的家园，他们自称马利贡迪吉，意为马利桉之地的人，约有二十个氏族，分属黑凤头鹦鹉加巴吉（gabadj）与白凤头鹦鹉格鲁吉吉（grugidj）两个母系半偶族。见到外人，他们先问一句「恩盖亚·瑶阿林」（ngaia yauarin），意为「你是什么血肉」，问的是对方在这套亲属与图腾秩序中的位置。蒂勒尔湖畔的布龙氏族观星定时令：玛潘库尔克（Marpeankuurk，即大角星）从北方升起，便去采集木蚁幼虫；奈洛安（Neilloan，即织女星）黄昏落下，眼斑冢雉的蛋就可以捡拾。伍朱巴卢格氏族相传，神灵普佩林布尔（Pupperimbul）把一枚鸸鹋蛋抛进黑暗的天空，造出了太阳诺威（Gnowee）。1444年，这套时令仍安排着各氏族在湖泊间的迁徙，还没有欧洲人走进马利桉灌丛。

最先抵达的外来者看不见摸不着。1788年英国人在悉尼登陆后，天花很可能沿原住民的往来网络、比任何殖民者都先一步沿墨累河进入维么拉，在任何欧洲人踏进维么拉之前多年已夺去许多人的性命；伍朱巴卢格人把这种病叫做「辛巴米卡」（thinba micka），说它是北方心怀敌意的巫师放来的。

en:
West of the Blue Mountains three rivers, the Wambuul, Kalari and Murrumbidgee, the Macquarie, Lachlan and 'big water' of the settlers, wind across open plains, reed beds and marshes. The country between them is the land of the three rivers, home of the Wiradjuri, the largest Aboriginal people of New South Wales. Their clans dug the sweet tubers of murnong, the yam daisy, from the floodplain soils with digging sticks, burned the grass to draw kangaroo and emu, and wore possum-skin cloaks, mandiyaba, incised with burwurr designs. The Muurrai clan called the rich Bathurst Plains dalman, a place of plenty. In 1444 the rivers, the yam grounds and the hunting fires were all still wholly their own.

In May 1813 Blaxland, Wentworth and Lawson found a way across the Blue Mountains, and the surveyor George Evans, following them, sighted the Bathurst Plains and named the Macquarie. William Cox's convict-built road reached the plains in January 1815, and on 7 May 1815 Governor Lachlan Macquarie raised the flag at its depot and named the place Bathurst, Australia's first inland British settlement. Evans reached the Lachlan that year, and John Oxley traced its course in 1817 and the Macquarie's in 1818. When the governor opened the district to settlers in 1818, sheep and cattle spread over the old murnong grounds, their hooves tearing up the yam fields that had fed the clans for thousands of years. By 1821 Wiradjuri clans and newcomers faced each other uneasily across the Bathurst Plains.
zh:
蓝山以西，万布尔河、卡拉里河与马兰比吉河蜿蜒流过开阔平原、芦苇荡和沼泽；欧洲人后来把它们称作麦夸里河、拉克兰河与马兰比吉河，马兰比吉本意是「大水」。三河之间是「三河之地」，维拉度里人的家园，他们是新南威尔士最大的原住民族群。各氏族用掘土棒从河漫滩的土里挖出默农（murnong，俗称山药菊）的甘甜块根，放火烧草引袋鼠和鸸鹋出猎，身披刻有「伯乌尔」纹样的负鼠皮斗篷「曼迪亚巴」。穆赖氏族把丰饶的巴瑟斯特平原称作「达尔曼」，意为丰足之地。1444年，河流、芋田和猎火都还完全属于他们。

1813年5月，布拉克斯兰、温特沃思和劳森找到了翻越蓝山的路径，测量员乔治·埃文斯循路望见巴瑟斯特平原，并为麦夸里河命名。威廉·考克斯率流放犯修筑的公路1815年1月通到平原；同年5月7日，总督拉克伦·麦夸里在终点营地升旗，定名巴瑟斯特，这是澳大利亚内陆第一个英国人定居点。埃文斯同年抵达拉克兰河，约翰·奥克斯利1817年溯流勘测拉克兰河，1818年又勘测了麦夸里河。1818年总督开放这一地区供人定居，牛羊散布到旧日的默农田上，蹄足刨毁了滋养各氏族数千年的山药菊田。到1821年，维拉度里各氏族与新来者已隔着巴瑟斯特平原紧张对峙。

en:
The sheltered coves and fishing grounds of Port Jackson and Botany Bay are
Eora country. Its coastal clans, the Cadigal among them on the southern
shore of Port Jackson, spoke a coastal dialect of Dharug and took fish and
shellfish from the harbour, birds and plant foods from the beaches and the
sandstone country behind them, paddling from cove to cove in bark canoes.
Clans kept their boundaries while ceremonies, marriage and trade linked the
shore with inland Dharug and the Dharawal to the south. In 1444 no chart
showed the harbour; only the people who lit their campfires along its bays
knew these waters.

On 29 April 1770 James Cook landed at Botany Bay, on the coast's southern
edge. The First Fleet reached the same bay in January 1788, but Arthur
Phillip soon moved his convicts and guards north to Sydney Cove in Port
Jackson, and the colony of New South Wales was proclaimed there on 7
February. The settlers occupied the fishing grounds and carried off Eora men
as go-betweens. An epidemic in April 1789 killed about half the harbour
people, and the canoes vanished from the water. From 1790 Pemulwuy, a
Bidjigal spiritual healer, waged a twelve-year guerrilla war around Botany
Bay until he was shot in 1802. Bennelong, whom Phillip had abducted to
learn the colonists' ways, sailed for London in 1792 and came back three
years later, the first Australian Aboriginal to visit Europe and return; he
died among the surviving clans in 1813. From 1810 to 1821 Governor Lachlan
Macquarie's convict gangs laid out Sydney's streets, wharves and public
buildings along water that living Eora still called their own.
zh:
杰克逊港和植物学湾一带避风的海湾与渔场，是约拉人的土地。杰克逊港南岸的卡地
哥等滨海氏族使用达鲁格语的海岸方言，乘树皮独木舟往来于各海湾之间，从港中捕
鱼和贝类，在海滩与身后的砂岩地带捕鸟、采集植物食物。各氏族严守地界，又靠仪
式、婚姻和贸易，同内陆的达鲁格人、南方的塔尔瓦人往来。1444年，还没有任何
海图标出这座港湾，熟悉这些水面的只有在湾边生火扎营的约拉人。

1770年4月29日，詹姆斯·库克在这段海岸南端的植物学湾登陆。1788年1月，第一
舰队抵达同一处海湾，但亚瑟·菲利普很快带着罪犯和守军北上杰克逊港内的悉尼
湾，于2月7日宣布建立新南威尔士殖民地。殖民者占据渔场，又掳走约拉人充当中
介。1789年4月的一场疫病使港湾族群约减半数，海面上的独木舟也随之消失。
1790年起，比吉加尔人的灵医佩姆乌在植物学湾周围打了十二年游击战，直到1802
年被枪杀。被菲利普掳去了解殖民者底细的班尼朗，1792年乘船前往伦敦，三年后
才返回，成为第一个到过欧洲又活着回来的澳大利亚原住民，1813年死在幸存的同
族中间。1810年至1821年，拉克伦·麦觉理总督的罪犯工队在水边铺出悉尼的街
道、码头和公共建筑，而健在的约拉人仍把这片水称作自己的土地。

en:
Kamilaroi is the Gamilaraay country of the Namoi, Peel and Mooki river flats and the Liverpool Plains, shut in by the Great Dividing Range, the Liverpool Range and the Warrumbungles. Small family bands hunted kangaroos, emus and possums, fished the rivers, and gathered yams and sterculia grain ground into bread, and no one ate the animal that was his own totem. Neighbouring clans met for large intertribal ceremonies, and the Gamilaraay were counted fierce fighters. Their belief centres on Baiame, the sky being who made the rivers and gave people their law, and on the bora grounds where boys passed through initiation into manhood. In 1444 the plains carried only seasonal camps and paths, not towns.

John Oxley was the first European to cross the plains, in 1818, while following the Macquarie River inland, and he named them for the Earl of Liverpool, the British prime minister. The next year, Aboriginal guides on the upper Hunter River told John Howe of 'Coomery Roy' country stretching north-west beyond the Liverpool Range, the first time the name reached colonists. By 1821 no station had been taken up on the plains; they remained entirely Gamilaraay country.
zh:
卡米勒罗伊是加米拉赖人的土地，位于纳莫伊河、皮尔河、穆基河的河滩与利物浦平原，被大分水岭、利物浦岭和沃伦邦格尔岭围在当中。小型家族群猎取袋鼠、鸸鹋和袋貂，在河中捕鱼，采集薯蓣和苹婆树籽磨成面饼，谁也不食用属于自己图腾的动物。相邻氏族常举行跨部族的盛大仪典，加米拉赖人也以善战著称。他们的信仰围绕拜阿米展开，这位自天而降的神灵开辟河流、把律法传给人；男童则在博拉场上经成年礼成为部族成员。1444年，平原上只有季节性营地和小路，没有城镇。

1818年，约翰·奥克斯利沿麦夸里河深入内陆，成为第一个穿过这片平原的欧洲人，并以英国首相利物浦伯爵之名为它命名。次年，亨特河上游的原住民向导向约翰·豪说起「库默里罗伊」之地向西北越过利物浦岭延展，这个名字第一次传到殖民者耳中。到1821年，平原上还没有开辟牧场，这里仍是加米拉赖人的土地。

en:
Gubbi-Gubbi is the coastal Kabi Kabi country of south-eastern Queensland, running from the thirteen volcanic plugs of the Glass House Mountains to the mouth of the Burrum River. It takes in Noosa, the Mary River, called Moocooboola, and the rainforest ranges behind Gympie, about 21,000 square kilometres of surf beaches, tidal estuaries and bunya-covered high ground. In 1444 family bands moved with the seasons between coastal camps and river crossings, fishing and gathering shellfish. Every few years, when the bunya pines of the hinterland ranges carried a heavy crop, messengers went out hundreds of kilometres and thousands of people camped together for months to feast on the nuts, trade goods, settle disputes and arrange marriages, one of the largest regular gatherings in Aboriginal Australia.

Europeans knew this country only from the sea. On 17 May 1770 James Cook sailed past and named the Glass House Mountains because the peaks put him in mind of the glass furnaces of his native Yorkshire. In 1799 Matthew Flinders took a boat through Pumicestone Passage and climbed Mount Beerburrum, but neither explorer went inland. In 1821 the coast still had no European settlement.
zh:
古比-古比是昆士兰东南部卡比卡比人的海岸家园，南起十三座火山岩颈组成的格拉斯豪斯山，北至巴勒姆河口，包括努萨、古称穆库布拉的玛丽河和金皮后方的雨林山岭，约2.1万平方公里的浪滩、潮汐河口与大叶南洋杉林地。1444年，各个家族群随季节往返于海滨营地和河流渡口，捕鱼、采贝。每隔几年，当腹地山岭上的大叶南洋杉遇上大年果期，信使便被派往数百公里外，数以千计的人赶来同住数月，食松子、换货、调解纠纷、议定婚姻，这是澳大利亚原住民中规模最大的定期集会之一。

欧洲人最初只从海上认识这片海岸。1770年5月17日，詹姆斯·库克的船经过此地，他觉得这些孤峰很像家乡约克郡玻璃窑的炉顶，便取名格拉斯豪斯山。1799年，马修·弗林德斯乘小艇穿过普米斯通海峡，登上比尔伯勒姆山，但两人都没有深入内陆。到1821年，这片海岸仍没有欧洲人定居点。

en: The inland country of Yagalingu, centred on Barunggam, is Baruŋgam land on the headwaters of the Condamine River. From near Dalby the red-soil Western Downs run west through Chinchilla to the foot of the Great Dividing Range, open woodland and grassland where early travellers found grass tall enough in places to brush a rider's head. The Condamine often ceased to flow and held its water in a chain of deep holes, where clans camped on Dogwood Creek and at Chinaman's Lagoon near later Miles. The Baruŋgam spoke Murrumningama, a Pama–Nyungan language close to Wakka Wakka; Jarowair country bordered theirs to the east, Wakka Wakka to the north and Mandandanji to the west. In 1444 the whole 7,900 square miles of waterhole and grassland belonged to Aboriginal clans, and no European party had crossed the downs before 1821.
zh: 亚加林古的内陆以巴伦加姆为中心，坐落在康达明河源头，是巴伦加姆人的土地。西部平原的红色土壤从达尔比向西，经钦奇拉直抵大分水岭脚下，开阔林地与草原相间，早期旅人见到有些地方的草高可拂过骑者头顶。康达明河时常断流，河水蓄在一连串深水塘中，各氏族在多格伍德溪畔、以及后来迈尔斯附近的华人潟湖扎营取水。巴伦加姆人使用与瓦卡瓦卡语相近的帕马—尼永甘语穆鲁姆宁加马语；贾罗韦尔人在东、瓦卡瓦卡人在北、曼丹丹吉人在西与他们相邻。1444年，这7900平方英里的水塘与草原全部属于原住民氏族，到1821年为止，还没有欧洲队伍越过这片平原。

en:
Turrbal country follows Maiwar, the Brisbane River, from open woodlands and wetlands to the sandy fishing grounds of Moreton Bay. At Mianjin, a double bend forms a pointed peninsula and a natural crossing between camps. Barambin, upstream, was a major meeting ground, and the hill later called Mount Coot-tha supplied honey from native bees. Turrbal tracks led to resource grounds and ceremonies, including the Bunya feasts in neighbouring Wakka Wakka country. The river provided fish and shellfish, fire kept hunting country open, and Quandamooka families held the bay islands. In 1444 Mianjin was still a Turrbal crossing, with no European port at the mouth of Maiwar.

European ships reached the outer coast before anyone charted the river. In the Endeavour on 17 May 1770, James Cook named the Glass House Mountains and Morton's Bay but did not enter the bay. Matthew Flinders arrived in the Norfolk in 1799 with Bungaree, an Awabakal seaman who acted as negotiator. They landed at Pumicestone Passage, Redcliffe and Coochiemudlo Island; on Bribie Island, Bungaree spoke with the Djindubari until a dispute over a hat brought gunfire at Point Skirmish. Flinders still missed the mouth of Maiwar, so in 1821 the Turrbal camps and crossings around Mianjin had no British settlement.
zh:
图尔巴之地沿迈瓦（布里斯班河）展开，从开阔林地和湿地通向摩顿湾的沙质渔场。米安金位于河道双曲环绕形成的尖角半岛，是各营地之间的天然渡口；上游的巴兰宾是重要集会地，后来称库萨山的高地则出产本地蜂蜜。图尔巴人的步道通往各资源地和仪典，其中一条通向相邻瓦卡瓦卡之地的布尼亚坚果集会。河流提供鱼和贝类，定期用火维持猎场，海湾岛屿属于宽达穆卡家族。1444年，迈瓦河口还没有欧洲人的港口，米安金仍是图尔巴之地内的渡口。

欧洲船先抵达外海，却没有马上找到河口。1770年5月17日，詹姆斯·库克乘「努力号」命名玻璃屋山脉和莫顿湾，但没有驶入海湾。1799年，马修·弗林德斯乘「诺福克号」到来，阿瓦巴卡尔水手班加里负责与当地人联络。一行人在浮石海峡、雷德克利夫和库奇穆德洛岛登陆；在布莱比岛，班加里与津杜巴利人商谈，最后因一顶帽子引发争执，冲突角响起枪声。弗林德斯仍未发现迈瓦河口，到1821年，图尔巴人的营地和米安金附近渡口还没有英国定居点。

en:
The Falklands are East Falkland, West Falkland and 776 smaller islands set on the Patagonian Shelf about 500 kilometres east of the South American mainland. Peat banks and tussac grass cover much of the low ground, while sheltered sounds offer fresh water and game and give access to seals, sea lions and large seabird colonies. Canoe voyagers from Tierra del Fuego may have reached the islands in prehistoric times, but no camp or indigenous community remained there when Europeans arrived. In 1444 the harbours had no permanent shipping and no crown kept a garrison.

The first unquestionable European visitor was the Dutch mariner Sebald de Weert, who sighted the Jason Islands in 1600. John Strong landed and sailed the sound between the two main islands in 1690, giving it the name Falkland. The islands then became a small but sharp colonial dispute. Louis-Antoine de Bougainville founded Port Louis in 1764 with settlers from Saint-Malo, the port behind the French name Malouines and the Spanish name Malvinas; John Byron founded the British post of Port Egmont the next year. France handed its settlement to Spain in 1767, and Spanish forces seized Port Egmont in 1770, then returned it after the two crowns avoided war. Britain withdrew its garrison in 1774 but left a plaque claiming the islands for George III.
