By the fifteenth century the heads of its richest Muslim families, the wazee, governed a Swahili town whose merchants sent out ivory, rhinoceros horn, coconuts, oranges, millet and rice. In 1414 its ruler sent an envoy with a giraffe aboard one of Zheng He's fleets bound for China. In 1444 Malindi was a prosperous sultanate and the persistent rival of Mombasa for leadership of this coast.

Where Mombasa fought the Portuguese, Malindi used them. Vasco da Gama was welcomed by the sultan in 1498, signed a trade agreement, hired a pilot for the voyage to India and set up the limestone padrao on the shore now called the Vasco da Gama Pillar. A factory followed in 1502, and Malindi ships helped Francisco de Almeida take Kilwa and Mombasa in 1505. A Portuguese chapel stood in the town by 1542, when Francis Xavier visited and said mass there. The Zimba raiders who had slaughtered their way through Kilwa and Mombasa were beaten off outside Malindi in 1589 by the Segeju. Malindi remained Portugal's main base on the East African coast until 1593, when Fort Jesus was built at Mombasa and the sheikh moved his court there; the town then lost its merchants and its patronage. By 1800 Swahili accounts described only bush and ruins, with the sea pillar rising above them.
zh:
马林迪位于加拉纳河口的马林迪湾，早在第一批石屋建起之前，班图语农民和渔夫已在此冶铁。到15世纪，由最富有的穆斯林望族家长组成的长老会「瓦齐」治理着这座斯瓦希里城邦，商人出口象牙、犀牛角、椰子、橙子、小米和稻米。1414年，马林迪统治者派使者带上一只长颈鹿，随郑和的一支船队前往中国。1444年的马林迪是繁荣的苏丹国，也是蒙巴萨争夺海岸霸权的老对手。

蒙巴萨以武力对抗葡萄牙人，马林迪则借葡萄牙人自重。1498年，瓦斯科·达·伽马受到苏丹欢迎，双方签订贸易协定，他雇了领航员引航印度，并在岸边竖起石灰岩标柱，即后世所称的瓦斯科·达·伽马柱。1502年葡萄牙商馆设立，1505年马林迪船只又协助弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达攻取基尔瓦和蒙巴萨。1542年方济各·沙勿略到访时，城中已有一座葡萄牙小教堂，他在此主持弥撒。一路屠戮过基尔瓦和蒙巴萨的津巴武装，1589年在马林迪城外被塞格朱人击退。直到1593年，马林迪都是葡萄牙人在东非海岸的主要基地；耶稣堡在蒙巴萨建成后，谢赫把宫廷一并迁去，马林迪随之失去商人和主顾。到1800年，斯瓦希里人的记载里只剩丛林与废墟，唯有海边石柱兀自立于其间。

en:
Lamu, Amu to its own people, is a coral-stone town on an island of the same name, with its harbour in the narrow channel between Lamu and Manda islands. Founded around 1370, it counts as the oldest continually inhabited town on the Kenyan coast and was one of the Swahili trading cities. Its dhows sailed to Arabia and India with ivory, tortoiseshell, grain and mangrove poles, timber the white ants will not eat, and came back with cloth and porcelain; an Arab traveller first left a written note of it in 1441, after meeting a Lamu judge on the pilgrimage at Mecca. Its patrician families governed through a council of elders, the Yumbe, ruling from a palace in the town. In 1444 Lamu was a rich, self-ruling Muslim commonwealth of merchants, craftsmen and Quranic teachers.

In 1506 a Portuguese fleet under Tristão da Cunha blockaded the channel and made the town pay 600 meticals down and a yearly tribute. In the 1580s, when Ottoman corsairs raided the coast, Lamu put itself at the head of the Swahili revolt and was subdued only with difficulty; Omani fleets came to its help from 1652 and cleared the Portuguese out in 1696. Under loose Omani overlordship Lamu ran its own affairs, and the eighteenth century was its best years. Its merchants worked the Indian Ocean carrying trade, its patricians built the coral houses and mosques of the old town, and Lamu became a centre of Swahili poetry and religious learning for the whole coast.

Rivalry with Pate clouded the years after 1800: Sultan Fumo Madi ibn Abi Bakr of Pate controlled the town and began a great fort on the seafront, and work stopped at his death in 1809. In 1813, at nearby Shela, Lamu's fighters caught a Pate and Mazrui invasion army in its boats on the beach and destroyed it. Fearing another attack, the town called in Said bin Sultan of Oman, who sent a governor around 1814 with a Baluchi garrison; the fort was completed by 1821, and Omani troops used Lamu as their base against the Mazrui of Mombasa.
zh:
拉穆，本地人自称阿姆，是同名岛屿上的珊瑚石城，港口在拉穆岛与曼达岛之间的狭窄水道上。城镇约建于1370年，是肯尼亚海岸上一直有人居住的最古老城镇，也是斯瓦希里商业城市之一。岛上的独桅船满载象牙、玳瑁、粮食和红树木材驶往阿拉伯与印度，这种木材白蚁不蛀，是上好的建材；返航时运回布匹和瓷器。1441年，一位阿拉伯旅行家在麦加遇到前去朝觐的拉穆法官，拉穆之名始见于文字。城中望族通过长老会议「永贝」治政，在城内的宫殿发号施令。1444年的拉穆是一个富庶、自治的穆斯林城邦，商人、工匠和古兰经师父各安其业。

1506年，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚率葡萄牙舰队封锁港道，迫使拉穆一次交出六百梅提卡尔金币，此后年年纳贡。1580年代奥斯曼私掠船袭掠海岸，拉穆领头举城反抗，葡萄牙人费尽周折才将其压服；阿曼舰队从1652年起跨海来援，1696年把葡萄牙人彻底逐出。在阿曼宽松的宗主权下，拉穆照旧自行其是，18世纪是它最风光的年代：商人经营印度洋贩运贸易，望族筑起老城的珊瑚石宅邸与清真寺，拉穆还成为整个海岸的斯瓦希里诗歌和宗教学问中心。

1800年以后，与帕泰的争霸给拉穆蒙上阴影：帕泰苏丹富莫·马迪·伊本·阿比·巴克尔控制该城，着手在海滨修建大堡垒，1809年他死后工程停工。1813年，在附近的谢拉，拉穆人趁帕泰和蒙巴萨马兹鲁伊家族的入侵联军困在滩头船上之际发动攻击，将其歼灭。担心联军再来，拉穆向阿曼苏丹赛义德·本·苏丹求援；后者1814年前后派来总督和一队俾路支驻军。堡垒到1821年完工，阿曼军队以拉穆为据点征讨蒙巴萨的马兹鲁伊家族。

en:
Mogadishu, called Xamar by its people, is the old stone harbour at the centre of the Benadir coast. Its medieval core, the two quarters of Hamarweyn and Shingani, was ringed by stone walls; da Gama saw houses four or five storeys high, palaces and mosques with cylindrical minarets. It first grew rich as the seat of its own sultanate under Fakhr ad-Din, and after the thirteenth century it kept its court and trade inside the Ajuran Sultanate. Ships from Cambay and Aden, and Jewish merchants from Hormuz, brought cloth, spices and fruit and carried away gold, ivory and beeswax, while its own toob benadir cloth was woven for the markets of Egypt and Syria. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1331, Sultan Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh 'Umar kept viziers, commanders and eunuchs at a court where Somali and Arabic were both spoken. One of its sons reached the Maldives: Ibn Battuta met Abd al-Aziz of Mogadishu ruling the islands as governor and island chief, and the Abdul-Aziz Mosque at home was named for him. In the early fifteenth century Zheng He's Ming fleets called at Mogadishu, and its envoys reached the Yongle Emperor's court with giraffes and other African animals. In 1444 the Sunni Somali city stood near the peak of its medieval wealth.

The Portuguese never took it. Da Gama's homeward fleet bombarded the town in 1499 without landing, and after the sack of Barawa Tristão da Cunha found its walls manned by horsemen, soldiers and warships and sailed on to Socotra. In 1542 João de Sepúlveda seized an Ottoman ship off the roadstead and shelled the city until its sultan accepted a Portuguese peace; when the Portuguese armada retook the Swahili cities in the 1580s, it again spared Mogadishu. In the seventeenth century the city passed, with much of southern Somalia, under the Hiraab Imamate, whose imams took a third of the port's customs revenue. In 1701 the two old quarters joined forces against seven French ships whose crews tried to seize the city and beat them off after eleven days. Mogadishu kept its independence and its Indian Ocean shipping through the following century.
zh:
摩加迪沙在当地又称哈马尔，是贝纳迪尔海岸中心的古老石港，面朝西印度洋。老城由哈马尔韦恩和欣加尼两个城区组成，四周绕着石墙；瓦斯科·达·伽马见到的是四五层高的宅第、城中的宫殿和一座座带圆柱宣礼塔的清真寺。这里最初是法赫尔·丁所建摩加迪沙苏丹国的都城，13世纪以后在阿朱兰苏丹国之内仍保留着自己的宫廷和贸易。坎贝、亚丁的商船和霍尔木兹的犹太商人运来布匹、香料和果品，换走黄金、象牙和蜂蜡；本地出产的贝纳迪尔布则专门销往埃及和叙利亚市场。1331年伊本·白图泰在此停留时，苏丹阿布·贝克尔·伊本·谢赫·奥马尔的朝堂上有维齐尔、将领和宦官，索马里语和阿拉伯语并用。城中子弟还曾远赴异乡：伊本·白图泰在马尔代夫遇到了任当地长官兼岛主的摩加迪沙人阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹，城中的阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹清真寺即以他得名。15世纪初，郑和的明朝船队停泊摩加迪沙，岛上使臣也带着长颈鹿等非洲动物抵达永乐帝的朝廷。1444年，这座逊尼派索马里城市正处在中世纪最为富庶的年代。

葡萄牙人始终没能拿下它。1499年达·伽马返航途中的舰队炮轰城区，但没有登陆；洗劫巴拉韦之后，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚发现摩加迪沙城墙前布满骑兵、步兵和战船，便转航驶往索科特拉。1542年，若昂·德·塞普尔韦达在锚地外俘获一艘奥斯曼船并炮击城市，迫使苏丹接受葡萄牙人的和约；1580年代葡萄牙舰队重新夺取斯瓦希里诸城时，再次放过了摩加迪沙。17世纪，摩加迪沙与索马里南部大片地区转入希拉布教长国，教长抽取港口关税的三分之一。1701年，两个老城区合力抵御七艘试图夺城的法国船，十一天后将攻击者击退。此后一个世纪里，摩加迪沙始终保持着独立，印度洋上的航行也未曾中断。

en:
Qardho, also called Gardo, lies on the dry Bari uplands between the Cape Guardafui coast and the Nugaal valley, one of a chain of old Somali settlements strung along the country's northeastern mountains. Nearby, in the Arie valley, stand the ruins of a sizeable walled town, and the place lies close to the tomb of the forefather of the Marehan Darod clan, a site of standing among the pastoral clans who graze camels and goats in the thorn scrub. They gathered frankincense and myrrh in the hills and carried both down to boats working the Guardafui shore, watering at the wells on the way. From the early fifteenth century the Majeerteen, a Darod sub-clan, built up a seafaring sultanate, the Migiurtinia of later maps, around the port of Aluula. In 1444 the Sunni Muslims of Qardho lived on the edge of that rising power.

The Portuguese chaplain Francisco Álvares, writing from Abyssinia in the 1520s, gives the clearest early picture of the coast beneath the cape. Its ruler, he learned, was a vassal of Adal; the thirty-six miles between Guardafui and Mount Felis were barren ground where coin was not used and thick cloth served as money, the thicker the better. The land sold goats, white salt and white gum, and the Portuguese tested the gum and judged it excellent for caulking their ships. As the sultans at Aluula grew stronger, Qardho remained what its position made it: an inland market and watering point on the road between the hills and the ports.
zh:
加尔多（Gardo）位于瓜达富伊角海岸与努加尔河谷之间干旱的巴里高地上，是索马里东北部山地一连串古老定居点之一。附近的阿里河谷留有一座规模不小的带墙城镇遗址，城外不远处便是达鲁德族马雷汉支系始祖的坟墓，在灌丛中放牧骆驼和山羊的游牧氏族中很有分量。他们从山间采集乳香和没药，运到瓜达富伊角沿岸卖给航船，沿途在水井歇脚。15世纪初起，达鲁德人的马吉尔廷支系以阿卢拉港为中心，建立起擅长航海的苏丹国，即后来地图上的米朱提尼亚。1444年，加尔多的逊尼派穆斯林生活在这个新兴政权的边缘。

1520年代，身在阿比西尼亚的葡萄牙神父弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯留下了海角下方海岸最早的清楚记述。据他所知，那里的统治者向阿达尔称臣；瓜达富伊角与费利斯山之间36英里的土地荒瘠，不用钱币，厚布就是货币，越厚越值钱。当地出售山羊、白盐和白胶，葡萄牙人试过这种胶，认为拿来填船缝极好。随着阿卢拉的苏丹们势力日强，加尔多依旧是它的位置所决定的角色：山地与港口之间道路上的内陆集市和水源地。

en:
The Ogaden is the broad semi-arid plateau between the Ethiopian highlands and the Somali coast, rangeland crossed by the camel herds of Darod Somalis, above all the Ogaden clan, as they move between the wells of the Haud. Its earlier inhabitants, the Harla, are counted as kin of the Harari and the Somali clans, and Islam came here early: the country belonged first to the Ifat sultans and then to Adal. On the plateau's western edge, around the headwaters of the Shebelle, lay Bale, a Muslim land of cotton weavers that the Egyptian writer al-Umari credited with 18,000 horsemen; the Emperor Amda Seyon conquered it for Christian Ethiopia in 1332. In 1444 these plains were the western pastureland of the Adal sultan Badlay ibn Sa'ad ad-Din, who ruled from the Harar plateau and was gathering his riders for a fresh war with the highlands.

That war began at Gomit in 1445, where Emperor Zara Yaqob defeated Badlay and killed him. Raiding parties under Imam Mahfuz of Zeila kept crossing these marches for decades afterward. The next Adal wave came with Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, called Gragn in Amharic and Gurey in Somali, both meaning 'the left-handed': Bale was the first Ethiopian land he subdued, in 1531, and after the bloody Battle of Bali its people turned to Islam, the chronicler writes. Somali riders from the Ogaden filled his ranks until he was killed at Wayna Daga in 1543. From the 1530s Oromo migrants spread over the open plains of Bale, while Ajuran sultans governed the eastern Ogaden from Qalafo on the upper Shebelle until their power faded in the seventeenth century. The Emirate of Harar kept walled trading settlements in the region after 1647, its caravans carrying Arsi slaves north to Berbera, and in the eighteenth century Harari scholars led by Sheikh Muhammad Tilma Tiamo carried Islam to the Oromo of Bale.
zh:
欧加登是埃塞俄比亚高原与索马里海岸之间辽阔的半干旱高原，是达鲁德系索马里人（尤以欧加登氏族为众）的牧地，驼群往来于豪德高原各处水井之间。更早的居民哈拉人被视为哈勒尔人和索马里诸族的亲族。伊斯兰教很早就传到这里，此地先后归属伊法特和阿达尔两个苏丹国。高原西缘、谢贝利河源头一带是穆斯林地区巴勒，盛产棉织品，据埃及作者欧麦里记载能出一万八千骑兵；1332年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝阿姆达·塞约恩征服巴勒，把它并入基督教帝国。1444年，这片平原是阿达尔苏丹巴德莱·伊本·萨阿德丁的西部牧场，他以哈勒尔高原为根基，正在集结骑手，准备与高原王朝再战。

1445年，战争在戈米特打响，皇帝扎拉·雅各布击败并斩杀巴德莱。此后数十年，泽拉的伊玛目马赫富兹不断派劫掠队穿过这些边区。下一波阿达尔攻势来自伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐，阿姆哈拉语称他「格兰」、索马里语称「古雷」，都是「左撇子」之意：巴勒是他最先征服的埃塞俄比亚土地，事在1531年；巴勒之战血流成河，编年史家称战后当地人尽奉伊斯兰教。他军中多的是欧加登的索马里骑手，直到1543年他战死瓦伊纳达加。1530年代起，奥罗莫移民散布到巴勒的开阔平原；阿朱兰苏丹则以谢贝利河上游的卡拉福为治所统辖东欧加登，到17世纪势衰。1647年以后，哈勒尔酋长国在这一带维持筑墙商站，商队把阿尔西奴隶运往北方的柏培拉；18世纪，以谢赫·穆罕默德·提勒马·蒂亚莫为首的哈勒尔学者把伊斯兰教传给巴勒的奥罗莫人。

en:
Degehabur, in Somali Dhagaxbuur, sits on the northern edge of the Ogaden, where the Jarar valley cuts through the Haud on the line between the Harar plateau and the Gulf of Aden coast. Camels use that line too: Ogaden herdsmen move camels, sheep and goats between the district's scattered wells, and caravans follow the same valley carrying livestock and hides toward Zeila and Berbera. Beside the pastoral clans live Madhibaan families, who kept to hunting and leatherwork outside the Somali camel economy. The country belonged to Adal in the 15th century, and in 1444 its amirs were gathering at the call of Sultan Badlay ibn Sa'ad ad-Din for a new war against Christian Ethiopia.

Badlay led that army to defeat and death at Gomit in 1445, when Emperor Zara Yaqob met the invasion. The lowlands went on supplying men for Adal's wars: at the turn of the 16th century Imam Mahfuz of Zeila led raiders through the Jarar on their way into the highlands, and Somali levies from these wells fought for Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi at Shimbra Kure in 1529, the victory that opened most of Ethiopia to his armies until he fell at Wayna Daga in 1543. When the Adal court withdrew to Aussa in 1577, Oromo migrants spread across the plains to the west, while the Haud around Degehabur remained Somali and Muslim grazing country.
zh:
德格赫布尔（索马里语名Dhagaxbuur）在欧加登北缘，贾拉尔河谷在这里穿过豪德高原，正处在哈勒尔高原通往亚丁湾海岸的路上。沿着这条路走的是骆驼：欧加登氏族的牧民赶着骆驼、绵羊和山羊辗转于各处水井之间，商队也顺同一条河谷把牲畜和皮革运往泽拉与柏培拉。与游牧氏族同住此地的还有马迪班人，他们不在索马里人的骆驼经济中谋生，世代以狩猎和制皮为业。15世纪时这一带归属阿达尔；1444年，诸埃米尔正奉苏丹巴德莱·伊本·萨阿德丁之命集结，准备与基督教埃塞俄比亚重开战端。

巴德莱亲率这支军队，1445年在戈米特迎战皇帝扎拉·雅各布时兵败被杀。低地仍不断为阿达尔的战争输送人手：15、16世纪之交，泽拉的伊玛目马赫富兹率劫掠队伍沿贾拉尔河谷深入高原；1529年，这些水井旁的索马里牧民跟随伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐在欣布拉库雷作战，此役打开了征服埃塞俄比亚大部的大门，直到他1543年战死瓦伊纳达加。1577年阿达尔宫廷迁往奥萨，奥罗莫移民随之散布到西面的平原，德格赫布尔周围的豪德则仍是索马里穆斯林的牧场。

en:
Berbera has the only sheltered roadstead on the southern shore of the Gulf of Aden, an open anchorage protected by a spit of land running out from the east. Greek sailors of the first century knew it as Malao, where ships loaded myrrh, the frankincense called far-side, cinnamon and a few slaves, and Arab geographers named these waters the Gulf of Berbera; in 863 the Tang scholar Duan Chengshi described the same port, which he called Bobali, trading in slaves, ivory and ambergris. With Zeila it was one of the two great harbours of the Adal Sultanate, and early in the sixteenth century Duarte Barbosa watched Cambay ships carry off gold and ivory while Aden ships loaded meat, honey and wax. In 1444 its Somali townsmen, Sunnis of the Shafi'i school, worked the port for the sultans of Adal, who ruled from Dakkar on the Harar plateau.

A Portuguese fleet under Lopo Soares de Albergaria and António de Saldanha sacked Berbera between 1516 and 1518. The coast was then drawn into the jihad of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, who conquered most of Abyssinia before falling at Wayna Daga in 1543. After Adal collapsed the port passed to its own Somali clans, above all the Habr Awal, whose Sa'ad Musa merchant houses ran the town and its annual fair, held through the cool months from October to April. Caravans came in from Harar and Shewa, Banyan merchants arrived from the Indian ports, and no Arab, Indian or European trader was allowed past the market into the interior. The Isaaq clans crowned their first sultan, Guled, in July 1750, while the Habr Awal lineages kept charge of Berbera itself, and by the late eighteenth century it was the busiest port on the Somali seaboard. Its merchants carried Harar coffee to Aden and Mocha in their own dhows, shutting Arab shipping out of the trade, and Arabian buyers knew the beans as Berbera coffee.
zh:
柏培拉拥有亚丁湾南岸唯一有遮蔽的锚地，一道从东边伸出的沙嘴挡住外海。1世纪的希腊水手称它为马劳，船只在此装载没药、号称「远方」的乳香、肉桂和少量奴隶；阿拉伯地理学家把这片水域命名为柏培拉湾。863年，唐代学者段成式笔下的「拨拔力」贩卖奴隶、象牙和龙涎香，学者认为就是这座港口。它与泽拉并称阿达尔苏丹国的两大港口，16世纪初杜阿尔特·巴尔博萨亲眼见到，坎贝商船从这里载走黄金和象牙，亚丁商船装满肉类、蜂蜜和蜂蜡。1444年，城里信奉逊尼派沙斐仪学派的索马里商民，为定都哈勒尔高原达卡尔的阿达尔苏丹经营这座港口。

1516至1518年间，洛波·苏亚雷斯·德·阿尔贝尔加里亚与安东尼奥·德·萨尔达尼亚率领的葡萄牙舰队洗劫柏培拉。随后这片海岸被卷入伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的圣战，他征服阿比西尼亚大部，1543年战死于瓦伊纳达加。阿达尔崩溃后，港口转入本地索马里氏族、主要是哈布尔阿瓦尔人之手，其萨阿德穆萨商人世家掌管城务，以及每年凉季10月到次年4月的年集。哈勒尔和绍阿的商队、印度各港的巴尼亚商人汇聚而来，阿拉伯、印度和欧洲商人一律不许越过市集深入内陆。1750年7月，艾萨克诸氏族拥戴古莱德为第一任苏丹，柏培拉本身仍由哈布尔阿瓦尔商人世家治理；到18世纪末，它已是索马里海岸最繁忙的港口。当地商人用自己的独桅船把哈勒尔咖啡运往亚丁和穆哈，把阿拉伯船只挡在这门生意之外，阿拉伯买家把这种豆子称作「柏培拉咖啡」。

en:
Dawaro was a Muslim principality on the eastern escarpment of the Ethiopian highlands, covering most of the Arsi country between Hadiya and the southern province of Bale, with its capital at Sabboch. The Egyptian writer al-Umari, writing in the 14th century, measured it at five days' journey long by two wide: a country of cereals and fruit where horses and pack animals were bred and trade ran on hakunas, needle-length pieces of iron used as money, with a cow priced at five thousand and a goat at three thousand. Its people were Sunnis of the Hanafi school. After the ruler Haydara rebelled, Emperor Amda Seyon ravaged the country and garrisoned it in the 1320s, and Dawit I later planted military colonists there. In 1444 Fitawrari Barje held the province for Zara Yaqob while the rising Sultan Badlay of Adal pressed it from the east, and Dawaro was the most fiercely contested borderland in the Horn.

Badlay's invasion ended at Gomit in 1445, where Zara Yaqob killed him, but the province changed hands in every war that followed. Imam Mahfuz of Zeila took it for Adal after defeating Emperor Na'od, and Dawit II won it back before Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi made it his first target. His raiders stripped it of horses, slaves and sheep in 1526–27; the imperial army raised to stop him was destroyed at Shimbra Kure in 1529; in summer 1531 Dawaro was occupied and its great church burned, while at Geberge the people were offered Islam or the poll tax. Fifty nobles converted, and Amir Husain al-Gaturi became governor. After the Imam fell at Wayna Daga in 1543, his nephew Abbas, who ruled Dawaro with Fatagar and Bale, was killed by the young Emperor Gelawdewos. Gelawdewos later banished 140 Portuguese there; when the governor Khalid tried to kill them, they shot him and held the province for four months. Oromo migrants then poured in; the Portuguese fought eleven or twelve days, fired their last powder and withdrew, meeting Gelawdewos marching too late to relieve them. After that the old border province drops out of the chronicles.
zh:
达瓦罗是埃塞俄比亚高原东缘的穆斯林小邦，辖地大体相当于今阿尔西地区，位于哈迪亚与南方的巴勒之间，都城在萨博奇。14世纪的埃及作者欧麦里记其地长约五日路程、宽约两日：出产谷物和水果，饲养马匹与驮畜，买卖用一种叫哈库纳的铁针钱，一头牛值五千枚，一只羊值三千枚，居民是遵奉哈乃斐学派的逊尼派穆斯林。本地统治者海达拉反叛后，皇帝阿姆达·塞约恩在1320年代纵兵蹂躏、留军驻守，达维特一世后来又迁来军屯户。1444年，菲茨乌拉里·巴尔热替扎拉·雅各布守着此省，东面压着阿达尔苏丹巴德莱崛起的势力，达瓦罗是当时非洲之角争夺最激烈的边地。

巴德莱的入侵1445年终结于戈米特，他被扎拉·雅各布击败击杀，但此后每一场大战都要让达瓦罗易一次手。泽拉的伊玛目马赫富兹击败皇帝纳奥德后替阿达尔夺下此地，达维特二世又将其收回；艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐兴起后，把这里列为开刀的第一个省份。1526至1527年，他的人掠走大批马匹、奴隶和羊群；皇帝为阻他集结的大军1529年覆没于欣布拉库雷；1531年夏达瓦罗被占领，大教堂焚毁，在格贝尔格，居民只能在改宗伊斯兰教和缴纳人头税之间作选择，五十名贵族改宗，埃米尔·侯赛因·勒加图里出任总督。伊玛目1543年战死于瓦伊纳达加后，兼治达瓦罗、法塔加尔和巴勒的其侄阿巴斯被年轻的皇帝加拉德沃斯击杀。加拉德沃斯后来把一百四十名葡萄牙人流放到达瓦罗；总督哈立德想除掉他们，反被开枪打死，葡萄牙人接管此省四个月。奥罗莫移民随后大量涌入，这些人激战十一二天，打光火药后撤走，途中正遇上赶去救援却来迟一步的加拉德沃斯。这个古老的边地省份之后再不见于史籍。

en:
Harar occupies a cool hilltop on Ethiopia's eastern plateau, above the roads that carried coffee,
skins, cloth and captives down to Zeila and the Arabian shore. Islam reached the plateau through
that trade by the tenth or eleventh century. Local tradition makes Abadir Umar ar-Rida one of the
founders, saying he settled with other Muslim preachers around 1216; the town's mosques and
shrines later gave it the Arabic name City of Saints. The Walashma dynasty returned from Yemen in
1415 and built Adal around nearby Dakkar. In 1444 Harar was the sultanate's richest market and a
seat of Muslim learning, but the ruler's court remained at Dakkar.

Sultan Abu Bakr moved the court into Harar in 1520. Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, called Gragn
the Left-handed, then made the town his base, installed a puppet sultan and led the invasions that
broke Christian Ethiopia until his death at Wayna Daga in 1543. His widow Bati del Wambara held
the war party together and married Nur ibn Mujahid, who brought Emperor Galawdewos's head back to
Harar after Fatagar in 1559. After Oromo horsemen defeated Nur at Hazalo and wasted the
countryside, he enclosed Harar with the Jugol wall. Refugees crowded inside during the raids,
famines and plague that followed, while the walled core held. The Walashma court withdrew to Aussa
in 1577, but Harar's merchants and scholars stayed. In 1647 they chose Ali ibn Da'ud as emir, and
the town remained a separate caravan power behind its wall; an Oromo raid reached Asmadin Gate in
1662 and killed the emir's son, but did not enter. Copyists produced illuminated Qur'ans, and
caravans linked the city with Zeila and Shewa. In 1821 the emir governed a compact walled town
whose merchants still supplied the routes between the highlands and the sea.
zh:
哈勒尔位于埃塞俄比亚东部高原的凉爽山头，俯临把咖啡、兽皮、布匹和俘虏运往泽拉与阿拉伯
海岸的道路。10至11世纪，伊斯兰教已顺着这条商路传入高原。当地传说把阿巴迪尔·奥马尔·
里达奉为奠基者之一，称他在1216年前后与其他穆斯林传教士到此定居；后来城中清真寺和圣徒
墓密集，得到阿拉伯语称号「圣徒之城」。1415年，瓦拉什马王朝从也门返回，在附近的达卡尔
周围建立阿达尔。1444年，哈勒尔是苏丹国最富庶的市场，也是穆斯林学者的讲学地，但统治者
的宫廷仍在达卡尔。

1520年，苏丹阿布·巴克尔把宫廷迁入哈勒尔。伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐，又称
「左撇子」格兰，随后把此城作为基地，扶立傀儡苏丹，率军攻入基督教埃塞俄比亚，直到1543年
死于瓦伊纳达加。他的遗孀巴蒂·德尔·万巴拉维系主战集团，后来嫁给努尔·伊本·穆贾希德；
1559年，努尔在法塔加尔战后把皇帝加拉德沃斯的头颅带回哈勒尔。奥罗莫骑兵在哈扎洛击败
努尔、蹂躏乡野后，他环哈勒尔筑起贾戈勒城墙。随后的袭掠、饥荒和瘟疫中，难民挤入城门，
城墙围合的内城没有失守。1577年，瓦拉什马宫廷退往阿乌萨，哈勒尔的商人和学者却留了下来。
1647年，他们拥立阿里·伊本·达乌德为自己的埃米尔，哈勒尔凭城墙维持为独立的商路势力；
1662年奥罗莫人一度攻到阿斯马丁门，杀了埃米尔之子，却没能入城。抄经人制作彩绘《古兰经》，
商队往来于泽拉和绍阿之间。1821年，哈勒尔埃米尔统治着一座紧凑的城墙城市，商人仍为高原
与海岸之间的道路供货。

en:
Zeila is a flat anchorage on the Gulf of Aden, sheltered by small islands, where the caravan road
from Harar and the Ethiopian highlands meets the sea. The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea calls
this coast Avalites, and first-century traders shipped frankincense north from its ports. Islam
arrived early: Masjid al-Qiblatayn, with two mihrabs, has been dated to the seventh century. By
the ninth century Zeila was a capital of the Muslim kingdom of Adal, and it later became a capital
of Ifat. Al-Maqrizi records the capture and execution of Sultan Sa'ad ad-Din II at Zeila in the
early fifteenth century, after which the Walashma princes took refuge in Yemen. They returned in
1415 and ruled from inland Dakkar. In 1444 Zeila was Adal's main port, a Muslim town of Somali
merchants, Shafi'i scholars and caravan brokers loading incense, ivory, gold and slaves for Aden.

Early in the sixteenth century Duarte Barbosa saw whitewashed stone houses and regular streets in
a town trading directly with Aden. Portuguese squadrons sacked Zeila in 1517 and again in 1528,
but it remained Adal's arsenal during Ahmad Gragn's wars, with Ottoman muskets and cannon coming
ashore on its quays. Nomad pressure later led Garad Lado to ring the town with five gates. During
the Adal civil wars a Somali clan stormed and plundered the place anyway. From 1630 the rulers of
Mocha across the water controlled Zeila and farmed out its customs, while a local emir held the
walls with a few cannon and matchlockmen. Harar caravans still came down to the port in 1821,
under loose Yemeni and Ottoman protection.
zh:
泽拉是亚丁湾上一处平坦锚地，外有小岛屏蔽，哈勒尔和埃塞俄比亚高原的商路在这里入海。
《厄立特里亚海航行记》把这一带海岸称作阿瓦利特斯，1世纪的商人已从沿岸港口把乳香北运。
伊斯兰教传入很早：设有两座米哈拉布的双朝向清真寺可追溯到7世纪。9世纪时，泽拉已是穆斯林
阿达尔王国的都城，后来又成为伊法特的都城。麦格里齐记载，15世纪初苏丹萨阿德丁二世在
泽拉被擒杀，瓦拉什马王子们随后避居也门；他们1415年返回，改从内陆的达卡尔实施统治。
1444年，泽拉是阿达尔的主要港口，索马里商人、沙斐仪派学者和商队经纪人住在这里，把熏香、
象牙、黄金和奴隶装上运往亚丁的船。

16世纪初，杜阿尔特·巴尔博萨见到白石房屋排列在整齐街道两旁，商船直航亚丁。葡萄牙舰队在
1517年和1528年两度洗劫泽拉，但格兰战争期间，这里仍是阿达尔的军火口岸，奥斯曼火枪和火炮
就在这些码头起卸。后来游牧民不断施压，加拉德·拉多下令环城建起五座城门。阿达尔内战期间，
一个索马里氏族还是攻破并劫掠了城市。1630年起，海对岸的穆哈统治者控制泽拉，把关税承包
出去；本地埃米尔则靠几门炮和火绳枪手守着城墙。1821年，哈勒尔商队仍会下到这座港口，
泽拉处在也门与奥斯曼松散的保护下。

en:
Shewa is the broad highland region in central Ethiopia, Amhara country above the gorges of the Awash and the upper Blue Nile. The Solomonic restoration began here when Yekuno Amlak of Tegulet overthrew the Zagwe dynasty in 1270, and for generations the emperors kept their moving camps and capitals at Tegulet and Barara. Saint Tekle Haymanot founded his monastery here in 1284 as Debre Atsbo, renamed Debre Libanos in the fifteenth century; by then its abbot, the Ichege, ranked second in the Ethiopian Church after the Egyptian Abuna, and pilgrims crossed the empire to pray in the saint's cave. Fatagar, the southern district with its royal town of Badeqe, faced the Muslim principalities of Hadiya and Adal. In 1444 Shewa was the Christian core of Zara Yaqob's empire, rich in horses and grain, and its southern lords watched the frontier.

Zara Yaqob founded Debre Birhan after a celestial light in 1456 and spent his last years there; under his son the court returned to its wandering camps and the town shrank. In September 1528 Ahmad Gran's Adal army fell on Badeqe, the first named battle of its conquest of the empire. Shewa was overrun and its towns and monasteries sacked; Gran's follower Ura'i Abu Bakr burned Debre Libanos after the monks failed to ransom the church. The imam's death at Wayna Daga in 1543 let the emperor Galawdewos restore Christian rule, though Galawdewos himself later fell fighting in Fatagar. From the 1570s Oromo clans moving north occupied most of the region, and the Amhara who remained held out in mountain enclaves around Menz. Negasi Krestos united those districts about 1682 and carried the reconquest south; his successors ruled as meridazmachs, and his descendant Amha Iyasus fixed the Shewan capital at Ankober on the escarpment in the mid-eighteenth century. Through the Era of Princes the kingdom of Shewa kept its own armies and borders, its kings moving their camps between Ankober, Debre Birhan and Angolalla.
zh:
绍阿是埃塞俄比亚中部一片广阔高地，阿瓦什河与青尼罗河上游峡谷之上的阿姆哈拉之地。所罗门王朝的复辟从这里发端：1270年，特古莱特的叶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝；此后几代皇帝把移动营帐和都城设在特古莱特和巴拉拉。圣徒特克勒·海马诺特1284年在此创建德卜勒阿茨博修道院，15世纪改名德卜勒利巴诺斯；院长称「伊切戈」，在埃塞俄比亚教会中地位仅次于埃及来的阿布纳，全国各地的朝圣者翻山越岭，到圣徒修行过的洞穴祈祷。南部法塔加尔区以王城巴德盖为中心，正对哈迪亚和阿达尔等穆斯林小邦。1444年的绍阿是扎拉·雅各布帝国的基督教腹地，马匹成群、粮仓充实，南边的领主们守望边疆。

1456年天现异光，扎拉·雅各布为此修建德卜勒伯尔汉，并在那里度过晚年；他儿子在位时朝廷回到移动营帐，这座城随之败落。1528年9月，艾哈迈德·格兰的阿达尔军队突袭巴德盖，这是其征服战争中第一场有名称的战役。绍阿沦陷，城镇和修道院遭到洗劫；僧侣出资赎买教堂不成，格兰的部将乌莱·阿布·贝克尔纵火烧毁德卜勒利巴诺斯。1543年伊玛目在韦纳达加战死，盖劳德沃斯皇帝得以恢复基督教统治，但他本人后来也战死于法塔加尔。1570年代起，北迁的奥罗莫诸氏族占据绍阿大部，留下的阿姆哈拉人退守门兹一带的山地据点。内加西·克雷斯托斯约在1682年统一这些据点，向南反攻；后继者称默里达兹马奇，他的后裔阿姆哈·伊亚苏斯于18世纪中叶把绍阿都城定在陡崖上的安科伯尔。整个「王侯时代」，绍阿王国自掌军队和边界，诸王的营帐在安科伯尔、德卜勒伯尔汉和安戈拉拉之间移徙。

en:
Wollo, called Bete Amhara in the Middle Ages, is the highland between the Bashilo and Wanchet rivers, falling away east into the Afar desert. Its monasteries schooled the kings who restored the Solomonic line: Abba Iyasus Mo'a founded the island house of Istifanos in Lake Hayq in 1248, his pupil Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe in 1270, and another pupil, Tekle Haymanot, carried the renewal south to Debre Libanos. At Ambassel the flat-topped Amba Geshen held the emperor's male kinsmen for life and kept the imperial treasury, and its scriptorium turned out some of the finest manuscripts of the age; Zara Yaqob spent nearly thirty years on its summit before his enthronement in 1434. Local tradition also places a fragment of the True Cross on the mountain, buried there by Saint Helena. In 1444 Bete Amhara was the most devoutly Christian province of Zara Yaqob's empire, a grain plateau of churches governed by the highest officer after the emperor.

On 28 October 1531 Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, called Gran, routed Lebna Dengel at Amba Sel and overran the country. His men looted and burned Istifanos that November. Amba Geshen beat off assaults in 1531 and 1533 and fell only in 1540, when its garrison and inhabitants were put to the sword. Mekane Selassie, the vast church begun by the emperor Na'od and finished by his son around 1520, which Francisco Álvares had seen sheathed in gold, was destroyed in the same war. From the 1570s Oromo clans moving north settled the land, took Islam and gave their own lineages' names to its districts; Christian Amhara held on only in the western highlands and around Ambassel. By the later eighteenth century the Muslim lords of Wollo could defy the Emperor Tekle Giyorgis I, and his campaigns failed to bring them to heel.
zh:
沃罗中世纪称贝特阿姆哈拉，是巴希洛河与万切特河之间的高地，东缘直落阿法尔沙漠。这里的修道院教出了恢复所罗门王朝的君主：伊亚苏斯·莫阿1248年在海格湖岛上创建伊斯蒂法诺斯修道院，门生耶库诺·阿姆拉克1270年推翻扎格维王朝，另一位门生特克勒·海马诺特则把这场复兴带到南方的德卜勒利巴诺斯。安巴塞尔的格申山是一座平顶山，皇帝的男性亲族终身囚禁于此，国库也存在山上，缮写室还出产那个时代最精美的一批抄本；扎拉·雅各布1434年登基前在山顶度过近三十年。当地相传，圣海伦娜曾把一块真十字架残片埋在山顶。1444年，贝特阿姆哈拉是扎拉·雅各布帝国中基督教信仰最虔诚的省份，这片谷物丰足的高原教堂林立，总督位列皇帝之下第一人。

1531年10月28日，绰号「格兰」的伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐在安巴塞尔击溃勒布纳·丹加尔，席卷此地。同年11月伊斯蒂法诺斯修道院遭洗劫焚毁。格申山在1531、1533年两度击退围攻，1540年才告陷落，守军和山上居民尽数被杀。梅卡内·塞拉西大教堂由纳奥德皇帝兴工、其子约于1520年建成，弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯曾见它通体包金，也毁于这场战争。1570年代起，北迁的奥罗莫诸部落地居于此，改信伊斯兰教，以本部落的名号重命各区；信奉基督教的阿姆哈拉人只在西部高地和安巴塞尔一带守住脚跟。到18世纪后期，沃罗的穆斯林领主已能抗拒特克勒·吉约吉斯一世，皇帝几番亲征也没能压服他们。

en:
Tadjoura, Tagórri in Afar, clusters round its wells on the north shore of the gulf of the same name. The word means roughly 'the place with goatskin water-flasks', and the town is counted the oldest on the Djibouti coast. Its Muslim Afar, the Danakil of Arab writers, herded camels and goats along the arid shore and sent caravans inland to the Awash valley and Shewa. In the fourteenth century the coast obeyed the rulers of Zeila, and in 1444 Tadjoura was part of the Adal sultanate as Sultan Badlay gathered his forces for war with Christian Ethiopia. Zeila quite overshadowed it, and ships called at the anchorage only to take on water, salt and livestock.

Afar tradition dates the local sultanate, whose rulers bore the title dardar, to the fifteenth century, and from the sixteenth the Ad-Ali line kept its seat at Tadjoura. The port stayed small through Adal's wars with Ethiopia and the Ottoman seizure of Massawa in 1557, and European travellers of the eighteenth century barely mention it. Its rise began in 1810, when the Adoimara Afar, the 'white house', defeated the Asa-yamara, the 'red house', and opened the caravan roads from Shewa and Aussa. Where Zeila took the trade of Harar and the Ogaden, Tadjoura drew the goods of the Ethiopian interior: ivory from the Shewa markets, gold, wheat, honey and ostrich feathers, and above all slaves, bought at the port for shipment across the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.
zh:
塔朱拉（阿法尔语称塔戈里）在同名海湾北岸依水井聚落成镇，地名大意是「有羊皮水囊的地方」，被视为吉布提海岸最古老的城镇。当地的穆斯林阿法尔人（阿拉伯文献称达纳基尔人）在干旱的海岸放牧骆驼和山羊，商队则深入内陆，前往阿瓦什河谷和绍阿。14世纪时这一带海岸听命于泽伊拉的统治者；1444年，塔朱拉属阿达尔苏丹国，苏丹巴德莱正集结兵力，准备与基督教埃塞俄比亚开战。泽伊拉的光芒完全盖过它，船只停靠这个锚地，只为补充淡水、装运食盐和牲畜。

按阿法尔人的传说，当地苏丹国建于15世纪，统治者号称「达尔达尔」；16世纪起，阿德阿里世系以塔朱拉为都城。在阿达尔与埃塞俄比亚交战、奥斯曼1557年夺取马萨瓦的那些年，这座港口始终没有发展，18世纪的欧洲旅人几乎没有提过它。它的转机从1810年开始：阿多伊马拉阿法尔人，即「白房子」，击败了阿萨亚马拉，即「红房子」，打通了绍阿和奥萨方向的商路。泽伊拉经营的是哈拉尔和欧加登的贸易，塔朱拉则吸纳埃塞俄比亚内陆的货物：绍阿市场来的象牙，还有黄金、小麦、蜂蜜和鸵鸟羽，其中数量最多的是奴隶，他们在港口被买下，运往红海和亚丁湾对岸。

en:
The Taqali massif is the high core of the Nuba Mountains, a rocky island of terraced valleys rising out of the dry Kordofan plain. The Tagale and their Nuba neighbours farmed the hillsides, spoke Kordofanian languages and kept their own gods while Muslim states rose and fell along the Nile. Two things kept those states out: the semi-desert around the hills could not feed an invading army, and the rocks themselves made a fortress. In 1444 the highland villages obeyed no outside master, and no chronicle yet knew a kingdom of Taqali.

The kingship has two founding stories. Oral tradition places it in the early sixteenth century, when the Funj set up the kingdom of Sennar; some scholars instead put the state's birth in 1750–1780, with Muhammad Wad Jayli, who began the work of uniting the hills. His brother Umar succeeded him, until about 1783 the queen mother, Ajaid, and Muhammad's son Ismail overthrew him together. Ismail then brought the '99 hills' of the Nuba under a single makk, and his son Abakr followed him without bloodshed in 1800. Sennar was bought off with an annual tribute and never came through the passes. The arrangement ended in 1821, when Egyptian armies overran the Funj kingdom and the hills stood alone.
zh:
塔哥里高原是努巴山脉高耸的核心，如同一座岩石岛屿浮在干旱的科尔多凡平原上。塔哥里人和相邻的努巴各部在山坡梯田里耕作，操科尔多凡语族的语言，信奉自己的神祇，任凭穆斯林政权在尼罗河畔更迭。两样东西挡住了外来者：山外的半荒漠养不起入侵的大军，岩石山地本身就是要塞。1444年，高原村落不奉外来的主人，任何史籍中也还没有塔哥里王国这个名字。

关于王权的开端有两种说法。口传传统把它定在16世纪初丰吉人建立森纳尔王国之时；一些学者则认为国家诞生于1750至1780年间，着手统一群山的是穆罕默德·瓦德·吉里。继位的是其弟欧麦尔，约1783年，太后阿贾伊德与穆罕默德之子伊斯玛仪合力将他推翻。伊斯玛仪随后把努巴的「九十九山」归于同一位马克（国王）治下，他的儿子阿布·巴克尔又于1800年和平继位。森纳尔每年收取贡物，便始终没有破关而入。这种相安无事的局面在1821年结束：埃及军队攻灭丰吉王国，群山独自面对强敌。

en:
Fazughli is hill country on the Sudanese-Ethiopian frontier, where Blue Nile highlands look down on the gold-bearing Tumat valley. Gumuz, Burun and Bertha farmers held the ridges and watercourses, washing gold and breeding horses for the Ethiopian market. Nubian settlers had been moving into the Qwara hills since the fourteenth century as the Christian kingdom of Alodia declined, and they built their Jebel Mahadid villages on naturally defended ridge-tops. In 1444 the Funj had not yet risen at Sennar, and neither the Nile rulers below the hills nor the Ethiopian crown firmly held the scattered settlements; neighbouring princes already knew the worth of their goldfields.

After Alodia's capital Soba fell around 1500, its exiles are said to have withdrawn into these mountains and forged the Kingdom of Fazughli, which held the border between Sennar and Ethiopia. Portuguese visitors heard of it on the Ethiopian side: early seventeenth-century reports speak of much fine gold and good horses, and in 1622 Emperor Susenyos himself told a Portuguese writer that the finest gold in all his lands came from Fazughli. His armies conquered the kingdom in 1615, but Ethiopian control slipped after the death of Yohannes I, and in 1685 Sennar subdued the local Hamaj princes and kept one of them in office with the title of manjil. The Hamaj remained Christian for at least a generation before turning to Islam. In 1761-1762 a Fazughli commander, Muhammad Abu Likayik, seized power at Sennar and reduced the Funj sultan to a figurehead, opening the Hamaj Regency that lasted until the Turco-Egyptian invasion of 1821.
zh:
法索格利（中文资料常作法祖格利）是苏丹与埃塞俄比亚交界处的山地，青尼罗河高地俯瞰着产金的图马特河谷。古穆兹人、布龙人和贝尔塔农人据有山脊与河谷，淘洗黄金、繁育马匹，销往埃塞俄比亚。14世纪起，随着基督教努比亚王国阿勒底亚衰落，努比亚定居者陆续进入夸拉山区，把杰贝勒马哈迪德的村落都建在易守难攻的山脊上。1444年，丰吉人尚未在森纳尔兴起，山下尼罗河谷的统治者和埃塞俄比亚皇帝都未牢固控制这些分散的聚落，周边王公却已清楚此地金矿的价值。

约1500年阿勒底亚首都索巴陷落后，据说遗民退入这片山区，聚合出法索格利王国，扼守森纳尔与埃塞俄比亚之间的边地。葡萄牙人在埃塞俄比亚一侧听说了它：17世纪初的记载称这里多优质黄金和良马，1622年，皇帝苏斯尼约斯亲口对一位葡萄牙作者说，他全部国土上最好的黄金就产自法索格利。1615年，苏斯尼约斯的军队征服该王国，但约翰尼斯一世死后埃塞俄比亚的控制逐渐松动，1685年森纳尔降服哈马杰诸酋长，留任其中一人并授予「曼吉尔」头衔。哈马杰人在至少一代人的时间里仍信奉基督教，后来才改宗伊斯兰教。1761至1762年，出身法索格利的将领穆罕默德·阿布·利凯利克夺取森纳尔大权，把丰吉苏丹变成虚君，开启的哈马杰摄政一直延续到1821年土埃入侵。

en:
Sidamo is the green highland country between lakes Hawassa and Abaya, east of the Bilate River. Wild arabica grew in its mountain forests, and beans gathered here went out with caravans bound for the Red Sea; the Sidama lived on coffee plots, cattle herds and the false banana, whose starchy stems carried them through dry years. Their land belonged to the clans, and in 1444 these valleys lay beyond both the Christian empire to the north and the Muslim sultanates to the east; the clans honoured a sky god called Magano and the spirits of their ancestors.

The clans fell into two groups: the eight Yemericho clans, first comers who held the best land, and the twelve more numerous Aletta, who fought them in constant small wars. Each clan followed its mootichcha, a king taken from the ruling lineages and shown to the people at the Fichche, the new-year gathering whose date the star-observers fixed from the moon; the Sidama week had four days, and the festival opened on a moonless night. Oral tradition remembers the Sidama dwelling earlier in Bale on the upper Dawa, until the expanding Oromo drove them west into the lake country early in the sixteenth century, when they in turn drove out the earlier Hofa. Oromo raiders struck these valleys repeatedly through the seventeenth century.
zh:
锡达莫是阿瓦萨湖与阿巴亚湖之间、比拉特河以东的青翠高地。山林间野生着阿拉伯咖啡，采摘的豆子随商队运往红海；锡达莫人靠咖啡园、牛群和假香蕉过活，假香蕉富含淀粉的茎帮他们度过旱年。土地分属各个氏族，1444年，这片谷地位于北方基督教帝国和东方穆斯林苏丹国的势力之外，族人敬奉天神马加诺和祖先的神灵。

诸氏族分成两支：最早定居、占有良田的八支耶梅里乔氏族，和人数更多的十二支阿莱塔氏族，两边为争地常年小规模交战。各氏族奉自己的穆蒂恰，即出自首领世家、在新年集会「菲切」上向族人亮相的王；新年的日子由观星者依月相推定，锡达莫人一周只有四天，节庆在无月之夜开始。口述传统称，锡达莫人原住达瓦河上游的巴莱，16世纪初扩张的奥罗莫人把他们逐到湖群地带，他们又驱走了早先的霍法人。整个17世纪，奥罗莫袭掠者仍不断攻进这些谷地。

en:
Darfur is the Sahelian country around the volcanic Marrah Mountains, whose springs and wells support villages and fields in an arid plateau. The Daju had a kingdom there by the twelfth century, and Tunjur rulers later held the mountain centres of Uri and Ain Farah. In 1444 they took tribute from Fur villages and from the caravan roads running north to Egypt and east to the central Sudan; slaves, ivory, horses, cloth and salt moved along those desert-edge routes. The future capital Al-Fashir did not yet exist, and the sultans still held court in moving camps.

Around 1600 Sulayman Solong, 'the Red' of Fur tradition, founded the Keira sultanate, made Islam the religion of his court, built its first mosques and pushed his power over the Masalit, Zaghawa, Birged, Beigo and Tunjur. From the seventeenth century the Forty Days Road carried caravans from Kobbei to Asyut in Egypt: the sultans sent raids into the southern lands and exchanged slaves and ivory for Egyptian horses, weapons and cloth. Under Ahmad Bukr those same Egyptian arms helped throw back a Wadai army that had reached Kabkabiya. Muhammad Tayrab, ruling from about 1753, conquered Kordofan around 1785 and raided as far as the Nile near Shendi, then died at Bara. After a three-year civil war Abd al-Rahman al-Rashid, campaigning in the north, pitched his fashir, his itinerant court, at Rahad Tendelti; the town that grew around the palace took the name Al-Fashir in 1792. In 1821 Muhammad Ali's Turco-Egyptian army seized Kordofan and routed a Darfur army near Bara on 19 August, but troubles on the Nile kept the invaders out of the Marrah Mountains.
zh:
达尔富尔是环绕火山高地迈拉山的萨赫勒之地，山上的泉水和水井让村庄与农田能在干旱高原上立足。达朱人12世纪已在这里立国，后来通朱尔统治者占据乌里、艾因法拉赫等山地据点。1444年，他们向富尔人的村落，以及北通埃及、东连苏丹中部的商路征取贡赋；奴隶、象牙、马匹、布匹和盐顺着沙漠边缘的道路流动。后来的首府法希尔此时尚不存在，苏丹们仍在移动的营地中理政。

1600年前后，富尔传统中绰号「红人」的苏莱曼·索龙建立凯拉苏丹国，把伊斯兰教立为王庭宗教，建起最早的清真寺，并把势力扩展到马萨利特、扎加瓦、比尔吉德、贝戈和通朱尔诸部。17世纪起，「四十日路」上的商队往返于科贝与埃及艾斯尤特之间：苏丹派人到南方猎奴，用奴隶和象牙换取埃及的马匹、武器和布匹。艾哈迈德·巴克尔在位时，正是这些埃及武器帮助达尔富尔击退了进抵卡卜卡比耶的瓦达伊大军。穆罕默德·泰拉布约1753年即位，约1785年征服科尔多凡，兵锋一度抵达尚迪附近的尼罗河，他本人后来死在巴拉。三年内战之后，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·拉希德在北方征战时把流动王庭「法希尔」设在拉哈德·坦德勒提，围绕王宫兴起的城镇于1792年得名法希尔。1821年，穆罕默德·阿里的土埃军队夺取科尔多凡，8月19日在巴拉附近击溃达尔富尔军队，但尼罗河地区的麻烦使入侵者没能进入迈拉山。

en:
The Bayuda is the stony and sandy desert inside the great bend of the Nile, from the crossings below Korti south to the river confluence, bounded on the west by the Wadi Muqaddam and split by the Wadi Abu Dom. Its wells let caravans cut straight across the bend instead of following the long river loop, and diggers had worked its gold-bearing wadis since the New Kingdom pharaohs, with the workings renewed in the early Arab centuries. The scorched pasture supports the Arabized Nubian clans of the Ja'al country, Ja'ali and Shaigiya herdsmen moving camels, sheep and cattle between desert and river. By the fifteenth century Christian Makuria had gone from Dongola and the desert clans answered to no strong master; in 1444 they lived by their herds and wells and the escort they sold caravans, while Nubian-speaking farmers still held the Nile villages.

The Ja'ali clans claim descent from the Prophet's uncle al-Abbas through Ibrahim Ja'al, and they sacked the old Alodian capital of Soba in 1476 and overran much of Nubia before the Funj founded Sennar. Funj rule reached up to Dongola by 1523, and the Abdallabi chiefs of Qarri governed the northern marches for it; under Sheikh Ajib their power ran from Dongola to the Ethiopian hills, until the Funj broke him at the battle of Karkoj in 1611–12 and confirmed his sons as vassal lords of the whole north. Around 1690 the Shaigiya threw off Qarri and Sennar. They fought entirely on horseback, in coats of mail, with lance, shield and sabre on Dongola stallions, and raided villages and caravans as far north as Wadi Halfa and as far south as Shendi; the Swiss traveller Burckhardt, who lived among them shortly before 1820, found them continually at war and famed for horsemanship and hospitality alike. Mamluk fugitives from Egypt seized Dongola in 1812, and in 1820 the Shaigiya charged the Turks at Korti, roused it is said by the poet and heroine Mihera Bint Abboud; their mailed riders were broken by firearms and cannon, opening the desert road to the conquest of Sennar.
zh:
百卢达是尼罗河大弯环抱中的石质沙海，北起库尔提以下的渡河处，南到两河汇流之地，西以穆卡达姆干河为界，阿布多姆干河横贯其间。有了沿途水井，商队可以径直横穿河曲，不必绕行尼罗河的漫长大弯；早自埃及新王国时期，采金人就在这些干河翻掘含金矿脉，阿拉伯时代初期又再度开采。焦渴的牧场上，达尔贾阿尔的阿拉伯化努比亚牧人，即贾阿林和沙伊吉亚诸部，驱赶骆驼、绵羊和牛群，在沙漠与河岸之间转徙。到15世纪，基督教的马库里亚已退出栋古拉，沙漠部族不再有强势的君主；1444年，他们靠畜群、水井和为商队护航为生，两侧河畔的村庄里仍住着说努比亚语的农人。

贾阿林诸部自称是先知叔父阿拔斯的后裔易卜拉欣·贾阿尔的子孙，1476年攻毁阿勒底亚旧都索巴，在丰吉人兴建森纳尔之前已征服努比亚大部。到1523年，丰吉人的统治北达栋古拉，北方边事由驻在加里的阿卜杜拉比酋长代管；谢赫阿吉布当权时，其势力从栋古拉一直伸展到埃塞俄比亚山地，最终在1611至1612年的卡尔科杰之战被丰吉人击灭，他的儿子们被确认为整个北方的藩属首领。约1690年，沙伊吉亚人摆脱加里与森纳尔自立。他们全员骑马、身披锁子甲，持长矛、盾牌和马刀，骑乘栋古拉种骏马，四处劫掠村落和商队，兵锋北至瓦迪哈勒法、南达尚迪；1820年之前不久曾在他们中间生活的瑞士旅行家布尔克哈特发现，沙伊吉亚人连年征战，骑术和好客都远近闻名。1812年逃出埃及的马穆鲁克余部夺取栋古拉；1820年，沙伊吉亚人在库尔提向土耳其人发起冲锋，相传鼓动他们的是女诗人兼女杰米赫莱·宾特·阿卜武德；披甲骑手终究被火枪和火炮粉碎，横穿沙漠、征服森纳尔的道路就此打开。

en:
El Obeid began as a cluster of deep wells in the sandy wastes of central Kordofan, a caravan halt called Lobeid, 'the little white one', later nicknamed the 'bride of the sands'. The acacia scrub around the wells yielded gum arabic, and the country also gave millet and livestock; traders made the halt a link between Darfur and Dongola, Egypt and the Nile, and some of the goods came on from Abyssinia. The Nuba and Nubian villagers of the fringe kept their old beliefs. Local tradition gives the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries to the Musaba'at, under whom Lobeid prospered on the passing caravans; afterwards the Funj of Sennar pulled the strings through their clients, the Ghudiyat. In 1444 no one held the wells firmly, yet the great caravans still came.

The eighteenth century made the wells a battlefield. In 1734 Isawi of the Musaba'at, of an exiled branch of Darfur's royal house, drove out the Ghudiyat and beat off the Funj, but after his death Kordofan fell to Muhammad Abu Likaylik, the strongman of Sennar. Hashim of the Musaba'at won the country back around 1772 and began to build a state, until the Funj expelled him in 1780. Their defeat four years later left Kordofan to the viceroys of Darfur, who let merchants trade untaxed while the Dongolawi built a second market town at Bara. In 1821 Muhammad Ali Pasha sent his son-in-law the Defterdar with about 4,500 men and eight guns to take Kordofan, and the Egyptian army founded the town of El Obeid beside the old wells.
zh:
奥贝德（即欧拜伊德）起于科尔多凡中部沙海里的几眼深井，最初是个叫卢拜德的商旅歇脚地，名字意为「小白城」，后来又得了「沙漠新娘」的别称。井边的金合欢灌木产阿拉伯胶，当地还出粟和牲畜；商人把这处歇脚地当作达尔富尔与栋古拉、埃及与尼罗河之间的枢纽，有些货物更从阿比西尼亚一路转贩而来。边缘地带的努巴人和努比亚村民仍守着旧有信仰。按当地传统，15至16世纪是穆萨巴阿特人的时代，卢拜德靠过往商队兴盛；后来森纳尔的丰吉人通过附庸古迪亚特人在此发号施令。1444年，没有谁牢牢握有这些水井，大商队却依旧往来不息。

18世纪，水井一带成了战场。1734年，出身达尔富尔王族流亡支系的穆萨巴阿特首领伊萨维赶走古迪亚特人、击退丰吉人，但他死后，科尔多凡落入森纳尔强权人物穆罕默德·阿布·利凯利克之手。约1772年，穆萨巴阿特人哈希姆收复此地、着手建国，1780年又被丰吉人驱逐。四年后丰吉人战败，科尔多凡归达尔富尔的总督治理：商人免税通商，栋古拉人另建了第二座商镇巴拉。1821年，穆罕默德·阿里帕夏派女婿德夫特达尔率兵约四千五百人、携炮八门前征拿下科尔多凡，埃及军队在老井边筑起欧拜伊德城。

en:
The Gezira, the 'island' of alluvial plain enclosed by the White and Blue Niles above their meeting, was for centuries the granary of the Christian Nubian kingdom of Alodia. After Soba, Alodia's capital, ceased to function in the twelfth century, Arab Bedouin drifted into the pastures with Islam and Arabic, and by the fifteenth century the Abdallabi tribal federation dominated the old farmland while ancient towns such as Arbagi lived on as Muslim settlements. In 1444 Nubian lords and Arab sheikhs ruled the confluence country in fragments, and grain and cattle went north down the Nile and east by caravan to the Red Sea.

In 1504 the Funj of Amara Dunqas came up the Blue Nile, made common cause with the Abdallab and founded Sennar as their capital, making the Gezira the centre of the sultanate later called the Blue Sultanate. The Jewish traveller David Reubeni, passing through in 1523, met a Muslim sultan who kept touring his herds instead of holding court in one place. The Funj brought in Sufi holy men, who settled in the villages and spread Arabic and Islam, and royal caravans carried gold, ivory and slaves between Sennar and the Red Sea. Arbagi, one of the oldest towns in the Sudan, remained a market town until the Shukria Arabs destroyed it. Between 1700 and 1821 the number of towns in the plain rose from one to about thirty. Sultans who raised slave armies against their own aristocracy touched off revolt after revolt, and in 1762 the Hamaj commander Muhammad Abu Likaylik marched into Sennar and turned the sultan into a figurehead. After 1802 the Gezira was all that remained of the sultanate. The regent Muhammad Adlan held it together for thirteen years until his murder early in 1821; in May the Turco-Egyptian army reached the confluence, and the Sennar the soldiers entered in June was a heap of ruins, where Badi VII made his submission.
zh:
杰济拉在阿拉伯语中意为「岛屿」，是白尼罗河与青尼罗河汇流前环抱的冲积平原，几个世纪里一直是基督教努比亚王国阿洛迪亚的粮仓。阿洛迪亚都城索巴在12世纪失去都城功能之后，阿拉伯贝都因人带着伊斯兰教和阿拉伯语进入这片牧场；到15世纪，阿卜杜拉布部落联盟已主导旧日的农田，阿尔巴吉等古城作为穆斯林聚落延续下来。1444年，这片两河汇流之地由努比亚首领和阿拉伯谢赫分地而治，谷物和牲畜或沿尼罗河北运，或由商队东销红海。

1504年，阿马拉·敦卡斯率丰吉人沿青尼罗河北上，与阿卜杜拉布人合力创业，在森纳尔定都，把杰济拉变成这个后来被称为「蓝色苏丹国」的苏丹国中心。犹太旅行家大卫·鲁本尼1523年路过时，见到的是一位不肯久居宫廷、不断巡行牧群的穆斯林苏丹。丰吉人延揽苏菲派圣徒，他们在村落中定居，传播阿拉伯语和伊斯兰教；王室商队载着黄金、象牙和奴隶往返于森纳尔与红海之间。苏丹最古老的城镇之一阿尔巴吉一直是座商镇，最终被舒克里亚阿拉伯人摧毁。1700年到1821年间，平原上的城镇从一个增加到约三十个。历代苏丹征发奴隶军压制贵族，激起一次又一次叛乱；1762年，哈马吉将领穆罕默德·阿布·利凯莱克进军森纳尔，把苏丹变成傀儡。1802年以后，苏丹国只剩杰济拉一地。摄政穆罕默德·阿德兰勉强维持了十三年秩序，于1821年初遇刺；5月土埃军队抵达两河汇流处，6月他们进入的森纳尔已是一片废墟，巴迪七世就在那里投降。

en:
Gojjam fills the broad highland inside the great loop of the Abbay, the Blue Nile, with Mount Choqa at its centre and the southern shore of Lake Tana for its northern edge. Amda Seyon's campaigns of 1316–17 folded it into the Christian empire, but it kept the rank of a kingdom: an Italian map of about 1451 marks it as one, and in 1526 Lebna Dengel still wrote to the king of Portugal of a kingdom within his empire. From Queen Eleni's day its revenues paid for the empress's household. The monk who founded the island monastery of Daga Estifanos in Lake Tana had trained at Hayq, across the river. In 1444 Gojjam was Amhara Christian country under its own governor, its plateaus given over to grain and pasture.

After the battle of Zari in 1531 Ahmad Gran's men killed its governor and overran the province, one of the conquests counted in the Futuh al-Habasha. Oromo bands crossed into it during the luba of Robale, 1570–1578, and Christian Gafat fleeing them forded the Abbay to settle on the Gojjam side. On 10 March 1607 Susenyos defeated the Emperor Yaqob at Gol in the south and took the crown; the Catholic revolts of his later years were fought partly on this ground too, where his half-brother held Melka Amba until he was beaten. Fasilides threw stone bridges across the Abbay gorges, and later emperors beat off Oromo raids through the rest of the century. In the eighteenth century Gojjam coffee went out through Massawa with beans from Ennarea and the Lake Tana shore. As imperial power faded the province passed to local warlords, and on 14 November 1770 the Scot James Bruce reached the springs of Gish Abay below Mount Gish, which Europe then took for the headwaters of the Nile.
zh:
戈贾姆是被阿巴伊河（青尼罗河）大河湾环抱的广阔高地，乔卡山耸峙中央，北缘抵塔纳湖南岸。阿姆达·塞约恩1316至1317年的征伐把它收入基督教帝国，但它一直保持王号：约1451年的意大利地图仍把它标作王国，1526年勒布纳·丹加尔致葡萄牙国王的信里也称戈贾姆是帝国之内的王国。从埃莱妮皇后的时代起，这里的赋税就供养皇后一宫。塔纳湖达加岛上的伊斯蒂法诺斯修道院，创建者正是在海格湖学成的修士。1444年，戈贾姆是由本地总督治理的阿姆哈拉基督徒之地，高原上遍布农田和牧场。

1531年扎里之战后，艾哈迈德·格兰的军队杀死总督、占领全省，《富图赫·哈巴沙》将其列入征服之地。1570至1578年罗巴莱轮值期，奥罗莫武装攻入此地，逃难的基督教加法特人涉过阿巴伊河，到戈贾姆一侧定居。1607年3月10日，苏西约斯在南部戈尔击败皇帝雅各布，夺得皇位；他晚年因天主教而起的叛乱也有一部分在这里交战，其弟据守梅尔卡安巴，最终兵败。法西里德斯在阿巴伊河峡谷上架起石桥，此后历代皇帝在17世纪余下的年月里不断击退奥罗莫袭扰。18世纪，戈贾姆咖啡与恩纳雷亚、塔纳湖畔出产的咖啡豆一同经马萨瓦出海。皇权衰微后，全省落入本地军阀之手；1770年11月14日，苏格兰人詹姆斯·布鲁斯抵达吉什山下吉什阿拜的泉眼，当时的欧洲把那里当作尼罗河的源头。

en:
The grain country north of Lake Tana lies below the Semien peaks, where the Lesser Angereb and
Qaha streams water cool Amhara and Qemant farmlands. Roads from Sudan and the Red Sea met nearby
on their way into the Ethiopian highlands. Under the early Solomonic emperors, Gondar was only a
military settlement in Wegera; the name first appears when Amda Seyon I posted a regiment there
to watch the roads. Emperors still moved with tents and armies from province to province. In 1444,
under Zara Yaqob, Gondar was a village with useful springs, fields and caravan tracks, not a royal
capital.

The lake country saw the worst of the Adal war before Galawdewos, aided by Portuguese
musketeers, killed Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi at Wayna Daga on 21 February 1543. A later religious
crisis ended in 1632 when Susenyos gave up the Roman rite and abdicated for his son Fasilides.
Four years later Fasilides fixed his camp at Gondar and replaced the old mobile kingship with a
permanent court. The Indian mason Abdal Kerim built the stone keep of Fasil Ghebbi, set among
churches, while the royal bath and pool rose by the Qaha. Later rulers added Iyasu I's palace,
Dawit III's hall and Empress Mentewab's castle; Beta Israel craftsmen worked as masons, smiths
and carpenters, and Yohannes I assigned Muslims and Beta Israel their own quarters in the lower
town. The French physician Charles Poncet found more than 60,000 people here. In May 1769 Ras
Mikael Sehul of Tigray killed Emperor Iyoas. Gondarine kings kept the palaces after that, while
regional nobles commanded the armies, and in 1821 the imperial enclosure still housed a king whose
orders rarely reached far beyond its gates.
zh:
塔纳湖北面的谷物之乡位于瑟门群峰之下，小安格雷布河与卡哈河灌溉着阿姆哈拉人和克曼特人
的凉爽农田。从苏丹和红海伸入埃塞俄比亚高原的道路在附近会合。所罗门王朝早期，贡德尔只是
韦盖拉的一处军屯；这个名字最早出现时，阿姆达·塞永一世正派一支军团驻守道路。皇帝们仍旧
带着营帐和军队巡行各省。1444年扎拉·雅各布在位时，贡德尔还是一座有泉水、农田和商路的
村庄，并非王都。

湖畔地带后来卷入阿达尔战争最激烈的阶段。1543年2月21日，加拉德沃斯在葡萄牙火枪手协助下，
于瓦伊纳达加击杀艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐。后来的宗教危机在1632年收束：苏塞尼奥斯
放弃罗马礼仪，禅位给儿子法西利德斯。四年后，法西利德斯把行营固定在贡德尔，用常设王廷
取代旧有的移动王庭。印度石匠阿卜杜勒·凯里姆主持修建法西尔格赫比石堡，教堂环布四周，
卡哈河畔又建起皇家浴场和水池。后继统治者添建伊亚苏一世宫、达维特三世厅和门特瓦布女皇
城堡；贝塔以色列工匠担任石匠、铁匠和木匠，约翰尼斯一世则把穆斯林和贝塔以色列人安排在
下城各自的坊区。法国医生夏尔·庞塞来到这里时，城中已有六万多人。1769年5月，提格雷的
拉斯·米卡埃尔·苏胡尔杀死皇帝伊约亚斯。此后贡德尔君主仍住在宫殿里，军队却归各地贵族
掌握。1821年，皇城之内仍有一位皇帝，但号令已经很少能走出城门。

en:
The Butana is the grazing plain between the Nile, the Atbara and the Blue Nile, the 'Island of Meroe' of the Kushite kings; the ruins of Meroe itself, Naqa and Musawwarat es-Sufra stand over seasonal wells that in the fifteenth century still fattened the cattle named after the region. It was then the eastern farmland and cattle-ground of the Christian kingdom of Alodia, worked by Nubian villagers while Arab tribes, the future Abdallab among them, moved across it with their flocks. In 1444 the lords of Soba still held the Butana in name, though the camel tracks running east to Suakin and the Red Sea were already passing into the hands of Arab sheikhs.

Abdallah Jamma'a, the Arab chief who overthrew what remained of Alodia, made Qarri his seat, until Amara Dunqas's Funj defeated him near Arbaji in 1504. The Abdallab then ruled the Butana as viceroys of Sennar with the title manjilak, collecting customs from caravans plying between Mecca and Lake Chad. Their sheikh Ajib al-Kafuta repulsed an Ottoman invasion in 1576 and raided as far north as Aswan, then turned a Muslim holy war against Sennar itself, until Sultan Adlan I destroyed him at Karkoj in 1611 or 1612; his sons were pardoned and came back to Qarri. The open plain meanwhile went to the Shukria Arabs, who made themselves its overlords by force of arms. In the mid-eighteenth century the Abdallabi sheikh moved his court south to Halfayat al-Muluk, and Qarri, a customs post with little trade of its own, fell into ruin; its last sheikh, Nasir, submitted to the Turco-Egyptian army without a fight in 1821.
zh:
布塔纳是尼罗河、阿特巴拉河与青尼罗河之间的草原，即库施国王的「麦罗埃岛」；麦罗埃、纳加和穆萨瓦拉特苏夫拉的废墟散布在季节性水井之间，15世纪时这些水井养肥了以这片土地命名的牛群。当时这里是基督教阿洛迪亚王国东部的农田和牧地，努比亚农人在村中耕作，后来构成阿卜杜拉布人的阿拉伯部落已赶着畜群穿行于平原。1444年，索巴的君主名义上仍领有布塔纳，但东通萨瓦金和红海的骆驼商道已在落入阿拉伯谢赫手中。

推翻阿洛迪亚残余的阿拉伯首领阿卜杜拉·詹马以盖里（Qarri）为据点，直到1504年阿马拉·敦卡斯的丰吉人在阿尔巴吉附近将他击败。此后阿卜杜拉布人以「曼吉拉克」之衔充当森纳尔的北方副王，统治布塔纳，向往返麦加与乍得湖之间的商队征收关税。其谢赫阿吉卜·卡富塔1576年击退奥斯曼入侵，北掠远达阿斯旺，随后又把伊斯兰圣战的兵锋转向森纳尔本身，1611年或1612年被苏丹阿德兰一世歼灭于卡尔科季；他的儿子获赦，回到盖里。旷野平原则落入舒克里亚阿拉伯人之手，他们靠武力称雄。18世纪中叶，阿卜杜拉布谢赫把宫廷南迁哈勒法耶特穆鲁克，盖里这个自身没有多少贸易的税卡就此荒废；末代谢赫纳西尔于1821年向土埃军队不战而降。

en:
East of the Atbara the steppe climbs to the Taka hills, where the Gash river spreads its seasonal flood over the pastures around what is now Kassala. This was the inland country of the Beja, Cushitic-speaking herdsmen who had grazed camels and cattle between the Nile and the Red Sea since the days of the pharaohs, when the Egyptians knew them as the Medjay. A tenth-century geographer still called them Christians; trade with Suakin and intermarriage with incoming Arab tribes made Muslims of them by the fifteenth century. In 1444 the Beja clans owned no prince. They moved between wells under their own sheikhs and drove their herds to the coast to sell at Suakin.

After the Funj founded Sennar in 1504 the Taka entered the loose orbit of the new sultanate, and at its height Sennar levied camels from the Beja clans. The Ottomans seized Suakin in 1526, and a few years later the slaving armies of Ahmad Gragn swept west out of the Ethiopian highlands and reached the Taka hills before turning back. Through the seventeenth century Beja clans pushed south after fresh grazing, and the Hadendoa, whose name one scholar renders as 'lion clan', emerged as the dominant tribe of eastern Sudan, endlessly feuding with the Bisharin. When Sennar tore itself apart in civil war the Taka slipped from its grasp after 1791. The Turco-Egyptian army that conquered Sennar in 1821 got no further than the Nile and the Gezira; in the eastern hills the Beja kept their wells, their pastures and their independence.
zh:
阿特巴拉河以东，草原渐次抬升为塔卡丘陵，加什河的季节性洪水在今卡萨拉一带漫过牧场。这是贝扎人的内地家园：操库希特语的牧民从法老时代起就在尼罗河与红海之间放牧骆驼和牛群，埃及人曾称他们为梅德杰人。10世纪的一位地理学家仍说他们是基督徒；到15世纪，经与萨瓦金通商、与迁入的阿拉伯部落通婚，他们已成了穆斯林。1444年的贝扎各部不奉君王，随各自的谢赫辗转于水井之间，把牲畜赶到红海之滨的萨瓦金出售。

1504年森纳尔建立后，塔卡进入这个新苏丹国的松散势力范围，丰吉势力最强时向贝扎各部征取骆驼。奥斯曼人1526年夺取萨瓦金；几年后，艾哈迈德·格兰的掠奴大军从埃塞俄比亚高原向西席卷，直抵塔卡丘陵方才折返。整个17世纪，贝扎部落不断向南寻找新牧场，哈登多亚人在18世纪成为苏丹东部的主导部落，有学者把他们的名字解作「狮族」，他们与比夏林人争斗不休。森纳尔在内战中四分五裂，1791年以后塔卡脱离了它的控制。1821年攻灭森纳尔的土埃军队止步于尼罗河和杰济拉；在东部丘陵里，贝扎人保住了水井、牧场和自己的独立地位。

en:
The highlands around Aksum and Debarwa are the old Christian core of northern Ethiopia. As capital of the Aksumite kingdom, Aksum once linked the Red Sea port of Adulis with the ivory country of the interior, and its kings left granite stelae and inscribed stone thrones that stood there centuries after the court moved south. Under the Solomonic dynasty it became Ethiopia's shrine city. The Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion, restored by Dawit I in 1406, was said to house the Ark of the Covenant with the tablets of the Ten Commandments. Emperors came to be crowned there: Zara Yaqob in 1436 sat on an ancient stone throne while a cord held by the 'daughters of Aksum' was cut, marking him 'king of Zion'. North across the Mereb, Debarwa stood on a high rock as the seat of the Bahr Negash, the governor of the Medri Bahri march on the road climbing inland from Massawa. In 1444 these grain lands were the Orthodox, Tigrinya-speaking northern edge of Zara Yaqob's united empire.

Francisco Álvares in the 1520s found ancient figures of lions, dogs and birds cut into ordinary houses at Aksum, and at Debarwa a fortress-house guarded by over three hundred horsemen and a Thursday market of three or four hundred traders. In 1535 Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi sacked and burned Aksum and destroyed the church; the Book of Aksum records that Emperor Lebna Dengel had already distributed its treasure among his governors, one thousand seven hundred and five golden objects. Cristovão da Gama's Portuguese passed a depopulated Debarwa in the rainy season of 1542. The Ottomans seized Massawa in 1557 and garrisoned Debarwa behind 'a long wall and a very high tower' said to be full of gold and silver, and the rebel Bahr Negash Yeshaq relied on them against Emperor Menas. In 1576 Sarsa Dengel took Debarwa, the garrison surrendered, and he had fort and mosque pulled down; he rebuilt Mary of Zion in 1580 and held his coronation there. Oromo raiders burned the church in 1611, Fasilides restored it in 1655, and Iyasu I was crowned in it in 1693. Around 1700 Charles-Jacques Poncet still heard Debarwa called Tigray's capital, though Adwa was overtaking it; the Tigray ruler Wolde Selassie granted lands to the church in 1794.
zh:
阿克苏姆与德巴尔瓦周围的高地，是埃塞俄比亚北部古老的基督教腹地。阿克苏姆曾是阿克苏姆王国的都城，把红海港口阿杜利斯与出产象牙的内陆连在一起；诸王留下的花岗岩方尖碑和刻铭石座，在王廷南移数百年后依旧立在城中。所罗门王朝时期，它成为埃塞俄比亚的圣城。锡安圣母教堂经达维特一世于1406年重修，相传堂中藏有约柜和刻有十诫的石板。皇帝们到此加冕：1436年扎拉·雅各布坐在古代石座上，由「阿克苏姆的女儿们」牵绳再将绳割断，以此宣告他成为「锡安之王」。马雷布河以北，德巴尔瓦高居岩上，是「海主」巴赫里·尼加什的驻地，他作为梅德里·巴赫里的总督，扼守从马萨瓦登上高原的道路。1444年，这片谷物之乡是扎拉·雅各布统一帝国的北缘，居民是操提格雷尼亚语的正教徒。

1520年代，弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯在阿克苏姆看到寻常人家屋上雕着古老的狮子、狗和鸟石像；在德巴尔瓦，堡垒般的宅邸有三百多名骑兵护卫，周四集市上有三四百名商人。1535年，艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐洗劫并焚毁阿克苏姆、拆毁教堂；《阿克苏姆书》记载，皇帝勒布纳·丹格尔此前已把教堂财宝分送各地总督保管，光金器就有一千七百零五件。1542年雨季，克里斯托旺·达·伽马率领的葡萄牙军经过德巴尔瓦，那里的居民已经逃散。奥斯曼人1557年夺取马萨瓦，在德巴尔瓦驻军，筑起「一道长墙和一座高塔」，据说里面满是金银；反叛的总督伊沙克借奥斯曼人对抗米纳斯皇帝。1576年萨尔萨·丹格尔攻克德巴尔瓦，守军投降，他下令拆毁堡垒和清真寺；他于1580年重建锡安圣母教堂，并在那里加冕。1611年奥罗莫袭击者烧毁教堂，法西利德斯1655年重修，伊亚苏一世1693年在堂中加冕。1700年前后，夏尔-雅克·蓬塞仍听人把德巴尔瓦称作提格雷的都城，不过阿杜瓦已经超过它；1794年，提格雷统治者沃尔德·塞拉西向教堂赐地。

en:
Dunqula, Old Dongola, lies on the east bank of the Nile opposite the Wadi Howar, with the caravan road to Darfur and Kordofan starting at its gates. Founded as a fortress in the fifth century, it became the capital of the Christian kings of Makuria and Nubia's chief city for nine hundred years. Arab armies attacked it in 642 and 652 and smashed its two chief churches, but the town was rebuilt and stayed Christian; its Church of the Granite Columns, sixteen granite columns with carved capitals, is thought to have been the cathedral. The kings held court in a fortified Throne Hall on a rocky spur east of the citadel. Genoese merchants had settled here by the mid-fourteenth century, perhaps through Genoa's commercial treaty with Egypt of 1290. Then came decline. Arab raids emptied the streets, the Throne Hall was turned into a mosque in 1317 under the Egyptian sultan's Nubian nominee Sayf al-Din Barshambu, and the royal court left in 1364. In 1444 a hereditary Nubian lord styled mekk held the old citadel of a half-deserted Muslim town, and caravans still set out from it for Darfur and Kordofan.

By 1523 the Funj of Amara Dunqas held Dongola, and the old town became the seat of their northern provinces: the mekk kept local rule and even took the Arabic title of malik while sending tribute to Sennar. In 1585 an Ottoman army marching up the Nile was routed by the Funj at Hannik, just south of the Third Cataract, and the frontier with Egypt was fixed there. Around 1600 the mekk Qashqash ruled the town; the French traveller Poncet in 1699 found half-deserted streets and a castle that still, he wrote, kept the Arabs of the open country in awe. Trade dried up as the Shaigiya horsemen made themselves masters of the river to the south and took Dongola itself around 1782. In 1812 Mamluk refugees from Muhammad Ali's purges in Egypt seized the old town and built a new Dongola downstream. When the Turco-Egyptian army of Ismail arrived in 1821, the former northern capital was already a ruin.
zh:
栋古拉旧城（旧栋古拉）在尼罗河东岸，与豪瓦尔干河口隔河相望，通往达尔富尔和科尔多凡的商路就从城门口开始。它本是5世纪修筑的要塞，后来成为基督教马库里亚诸王的都城，九百年间都是努比亚首城。阿拉伯军队642年、652年两度来攻，捣毁两座主教堂，但城很快重建，栋古拉仍是基督教的城；花岗岩柱教堂内，十六根花岗岩柱托着雕饰柱头，考古学者认为它可能就是主教座堂。国王在城东石角上一座堡垒式的王座厅临朝。到14世纪中期，已有热那亚商人在此定居，他们或许是借1290年热那亚与埃及通商条约之便而来。衰落随后而至：阿拉伯人的袭击使街巷荒废，1317年埃及素丹扶立的努比亚人赛义夫丁·巴尔尚布把王座厅改成清真寺，王室宫廷又在1364年迁走。1444年，一位称「梅克」的世袭努比亚首领据守着这座半荒废穆斯林城镇的旧堡，前往达尔富尔和科尔多凡的商队仍从城中出发。

到1523年，阿马拉·敦卡斯的丰吉人已进据栋古拉，旧城成为丰吉苏丹国北方诸省的治所：梅克在本地执政，甚至采用阿拉伯语「马利克」（王）的称号，同时向森纳尔纳贡。1585年，一支沿尼罗河南上的奥斯曼军队在第三瀑布以南的哈尼赫被丰吉击溃，与埃及的边界就此划定。约1600年，梅克卡什卡什在位；1699年法国旅人蓬塞路过时，街巷已经半废，用他的话说，城中城堡仍能震慑旷野上的阿拉伯人。沙伊吉亚骑兵在南方河道割据自立，约1782年又攻占栋古拉，商路随之枯竭。1812年，逃出埃及躲避穆罕默德·阿里清洗的马穆鲁克人占据旧城，在下游另筑新栋古拉。1821年伊斯梅尔率领的土埃军队抵达时，这座北方旧都已成废墟。

en:
Berber lies on the east bank of the Nile just above the Atbara confluence, the point where the river road of Nubia meets the desert track to Sawakin, seven to twelve days' march away on the Red Sea. A town stood here in Meroitic times. By the fifteenth century its people were the Arabized Nubians of the Ja'al country, Muslim camel- and cattle-owners living beside Nubian-speaking villagers, who lived by the Nile traffic and the caravans crossing the Bayuda. Local accounts derive the name either from Berber merchants of North Africa passing through on their way to Sawakin, or from a Nubian queen named Barbra who once ruled the district. In 1444 it was a small market without a strong lord, the northern Sudan's nearest link between the Nile bend and the Red Sea.

Under the Funj sultans Berber became a busier place. Pilgrim caravans for the Hijaz crossed the Nile here, and its brick market, the qaysariyya, handled the trade of the Sudan: ivory, ostrich feathers and hides went out to Sawakin, cloth, silk, perfumes and spices came back, and travellers ranked it with the markets of Fez, Cairo and Jeddah. From the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the town drew students from all over the Sudan to its khalwa Quran schools; an Egyptian scholar, Muhammad al-Masri, came up from Upper Egypt and founded a mosque and a khalwa here. Berber was ruled first through the Abdallabi lords of Qarri, then by riverine Arab chiefs as Sennar weakened, while the independent Shaigiya raided it at will. Burckhardt in 1813 still found a busy caravan town, and eight years later the Ottoman Egyptian conquest put an end to the Funj order.
zh:
柏柏尔位于尼罗河东岸、阿特巴拉河汇入口以北不远，努比亚河路在此接上通往红海港口萨瓦金的沙漠道，单程要走七到十二天。早在麦洛埃时代这里已有城镇；到15世纪，居民是达尔贾阿尔的阿拉伯化努比亚人，穆斯林骆驼客、牧人与说努比亚语的村民为邻，靠尼罗河运输和横穿百卢达的商队为生。当地人讲城名的来历，一说源自取道此地前往萨瓦金的北非柏柏尔商人，一说源自曾统治此地的努比亚女王柏柏拉。1444年，柏柏尔是苏丹北部一座没有强势君主的小集镇，也是尼罗河大弯与红海之间最直接的一环。

丰吉苏丹治下，柏柏尔繁盛起来。赴汉志的朝觐商队在此渡过尼罗河，砖砌的盖萨里亚市场经手整个苏丹的买卖：象牙、鸵鸟羽和皮革运往萨瓦金，布匹、丝绸、香水和香料原路运回，行旅把这座市场与非斯、开罗和吉达的市集相提并论。16至17世纪，城里的赫勒瓦古兰经经学学校吸引苏丹各地的学生；埃及学者穆罕默德·马斯里从上埃及前来，建起一座清真寺和一所赫勒瓦。柏柏尔先由驻加里的阿卜杜拉比领主统辖，森纳尔衰落后落入河畔阿拉伯酋长之手，自立的沙伊吉亚人则随意入寇。1813年布尔克哈特到访时，它仍是繁忙的商队城镇；八年后，奥斯曼埃及的征服结束了丰吉的秩序。

en:
Massawa occupies two islands, Basé and Taulud, joined to each other and to the shore by causeways, across a narrow channel from the Dahlak Archipelago. It is one of the hottest of all Red Sea coasts, and it grew up only after the older port of Adulis, fifty kilometres to the south, fell into ruin. From the 11th century the sultans of Dahlak made it the point where Muslim shipping met caravans from the Christian Ethiopian highlands. Beja and Tigre villagers lived along the shore, a qadi headed the island merchant town, and local tradition attributes the island's Mosque of the Companions to followers of Muhammad who fled Arabia, counting it among the earliest mosques in Africa. The port's allegiance was loose: Massawa paid tribute only now and then to the Bahr Negash and other highland governors while remaining tied to Dahlak, itself a vassal of Aden. In 1444 it was the hot sea outlet of Medri Bahri, where highland politics met Indian Ocean commerce.

Emperor Zara Yaqob reached the coast at mid-century and fortified the Gerer peninsula facing the islands, and Abyssinian troops sacked both Massawa and Dahlak in 1464–65 and killed the town's qadi. Portuguese squadrons began using the harbour early in the next century, and in 1541 Cristóvão da Gama, a son of Vasco da Gama, landed here with four hundred musketeers to march inland against Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, though Adalite fighters ambushed his men at the harbour that same year. Da Gama won four battles in the highlands, was captured wounded in his fifth, and was executed on the Imam's order the following year. In 1557 Özdemir Pasha seized the port for the Ottomans and tried to make it the capital of the province of Habesh, but the highlands never submitted. Ottoman rule ran through a naib drawn from the Balaw, while the local sharia qadi kept jurisdiction along the coast from the Habab to the Afar shore. Governors sent from Istanbul, Turkish after 1809 and Egyptian after 1813, steadily tightened that loose old arrangement.
zh:
马萨瓦坐落在巴塞、陶卢德两座岛上，两岛彼此之间、岛屿与海岸之间都有堤道相连，隔一道窄海峡与达赫拉克群岛相望，是全世界最炎热的海岸之一。南边五十公里处的古港阿杜利斯荒废之后，它才发展起来。11世纪起，达赫拉克的苏丹把这里经营成穆斯林航运接上来往基督教埃塞俄比亚高地商队的地方：贝扎人和提格雷人住在沿岸，一名卡迪主持这座岛上商镇；当地相传，岛上的同伴清真寺是从阿拉伯半岛逃来的穆罕默德信徒所建，被视为非洲最早的清真寺之一。港口的臣属关系松散：马萨瓦只是偶尔向巴赫勒·尼加什等高地统治者纳贡，同时仍依附达赫拉克，而达赫拉克是亚丁的附庸。1444年，这里是梅德利巴赫里炎热的出海口，高地的权势与印度洋贸易在此相接。

15世纪中叶，皇帝扎拉·雅各布的势力抵达海岸，在正对两岛的格雷尔半岛修筑要塞；1464至1465年，阿比西尼亚军队洗劫马萨瓦和达赫拉克，杀了城中的卡迪。下个世纪初，葡萄牙分舰队开始使用此港；1541年，瓦斯科·达·伽马之子克里斯托旺·达·伽马率四百名火绳枪兵在这里登陆，准备深入内陆攻打伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐，同年他的部下又在港中遭到阿达尔人伏击。达·伽马在高原连赢四仗，第五仗受伤被俘，次年被伊玛目下令处死。1557年，厄兹代米尔帕夏为奥斯曼人夺取马萨瓦，想把它建为哈贝什省的省会，高地却始终没有屈服。奥斯曼人通过巴莱乌人出任的纳伊布进行统治，当地沙里亚法庭的卡迪则管辖着从哈巴布到阿法尔海岸的沿海地带。1809年以后，伊斯坦布尔先后派来土耳其总督，1813年又改派埃及总督，旧日松散的统治格局被一步步收紧。

en:
Aswan, ancient Syene, sits just below the Nile's first cataract, the last set of rapids before Egypt gives way to Nubia. Every dynasty kept a garrison in the town and levied tolls on boats passing north and south, because from here the river runs clear to the sea for more than a thousand kilometres. Its quarries of red syenite granite supplied the obelisks, colossal statues and sarcophagi of temples across Egypt, and one obelisk partly cut from the bedrock was never taken away. Nearby lie the island of Elephantine and, out on the desert edge, the mud-brick Monastery of St Simeon, founded in the seventh century. A desert road once led east to the Red Sea port of Aydhab, where ships sailed for the Hijaz, Yemen and India, until Sultan Barsbay had the port destroyed in 1426. Nubian caravans brought ivory, gold, slaves and livestock up to the Aswan markets. In 1444 it was the southernmost garrison of the Mamluk sultanate, a Sunni Egyptian town under a military governor.

After the Ottoman conquest of 1517, real power in the far south passed to the Hawwara Arabs. Their chief Humam ibn Yusuf held a domain stretching from Minya to Aswan after he succeeded his father in 1767. Ali Bey al-Kabir's Mamluks broke him two years later: a kinsman's treachery lost him the battle, the town of Farshut was burned to ashes, and Humam died on the desert road to Nubia while trying to raise another army. In 1799 the French pursuit of Murad Bey reached the cataract; Louis-Nicolas Davout, later a marshal of Napoleon, routed Osman Hassan Bey's Mamluk cavalry near Syene on 12 February, and Murad's raiders for a time forced the French to evacuate Aswan. After the French withdrawal in 1801 the town served Muhammad Ali as the base from which Cairo retook control of the southern frontier.
zh:
阿斯旺古称赛伊尼，位于尼罗河第一瀑布北侧；过了这道瀑布，埃及就让位于努比亚。历代王朝都在此驻军，向往来南北的船只征税，因为从阿斯旺往北，尼罗河一千多公里再无险滩，可一直通航入海。当地的红色正长岩花岗岩石场为埃及各地的神庙供应方尖碑、巨型雕像和石棺，还有一方只凿出一半、始终没有运走的方尖碑连在基岩上。附近有河中的象岛，以及沙漠边缘7世纪用泥砖修建的圣西门修道院。一条沙漠古道曾东通红海港口阿伊扎布，船只从那里启航前往汉志、也门和印度，1426年苏丹巴尔斯拜下令将该港摧毁；努比亚商队则把象牙、黄金、奴隶和牲畜带到阿斯旺的市集。1444年，这里是马穆鲁克苏丹国最南端的驻军要塞，一座由军事长官管辖的逊尼派埃及小城。

1517年奥斯曼征服后，南方实权转入哈瓦拉阿拉伯人之手。其首领胡马姆·伊本·优素福1767年继父位掌权，据有从明亚到阿斯旺的广大地区。两年后，阿里贝伊·卡比尔的马穆鲁克军将其击垮：族人的背叛使他输掉会战，法尔舒特（Farshut）被烧成灰烬，胡马姆在逃往努比亚另组军队的沙漠路上死去。1799年，法军追击穆拉德贝伊直达瀑布；后来成为拿破仑元帅的路易-尼古拉·达武于2月12日在赛伊尼附近击溃奥斯曼·哈桑贝伊的马穆鲁克骑兵，穆拉德的袭扰队还一度迫使法军撤出阿斯旺。1801年法军撤出后，这座城成为穆罕默德·阿里从开罗重新控制南部边疆的基地。

en:
Suakin occupies a coral island at the end of a long Red Sea inlet, with the mainland quarter of the Geyf facing it across a narrow channel. Medieval Arab writers counted it among the most luxurious ports of the Red Sea, its merchants' houses built of dressed coral. Al-Hamdani named it in the tenth century, when it was still a small Beja settlement; it expanded after the southern port of Badi was abandoned. Ships from India, African pilgrims crossing to Jiddah and, from the fourteenth century, Venetian merchants all paid customs here. In 1264 a Mamluk expedition drove out its ruler, who had seized the goods of merchants drowned off the coast, and in 1317 the town accepted Mamluk suzerainty. Ibn Battuta visited in 1332 and found a Muslim sultan who was the son of a Meccan sharif and had inherited his office through his Beja maternal uncles. When Mamluk power waned late in the fourteenth century, the Hedareb took the port and made it their capital. After Barsbay destroyed the rival port of Aydhab in 1426, the people of Aydhab who fled to Suakin were slaughtered, an old feud between the two towns. In 1444 Suakin was a wealthy Beja and Arab Muslim port under loose Mamluk overlordship.

A Portuguese fleet besieged the island in 1513, and another Portuguese force took and sacked it in 1541 during the war for the Red Sea. After the Ottoman conquest of Egypt the town entered the Ottoman sphere; Ozdemir Pasha occupied it in the early 1550s, and from 1555 Suakin was the seat of the pasha of Habesh. The Ottomans restored the Shafi'i and Hanafi mosques and rebuilt the coral fort and the walls. Caravans from the Funj sultanate of Sennar still brought up the trade of the Nile hinterland, but the sea route around Africa carried Indian commerce away around the Cape, and the port emptied. Early in the nineteenth century Johann Ludwig Burckhardt found two-thirds of its houses in ruins.
zh:
萨瓦金位于红海一道长湾尽头的珊瑚岛上，一道狭窄水道对岸是大陆上的盖夫街区。中世纪阿拉伯作家把它视为红海最奢华的港口，商人的宅院以加工过的珊瑚石砌成。10世纪哈姆达尼提到它时，这里还只是贝扎人的小聚落；南方港口巴迪被废弃后，萨瓦金才发展起来。印度商船、渡海前往吉达的非洲朝觐者，以及14世纪起到来的威尼斯商人，都在此缴纳关税。1264年，马穆鲁克远征军赶走了侵吞近海溺亡商人货物的萨瓦金统治者；1317年，该城接受马穆鲁克宗主权。伊本·白图泰1332年到访时，统治者是一位穆斯林苏丹，其父是麦加谢里夫，他本人则按贝扎人的习俗从舅父手中继承权位。14世纪末马穆鲁克势力衰弱，赫达雷布人夺取港口，定为本部都城。1426年巴尔斯拜摧毁与之竞争的阿伊扎布后，逃到萨瓦金的阿伊扎布人尽遭屠戮，两城结怨已久。1444年，萨瓦金是一座富裕的贝扎与阿拉伯穆斯林港口，处在马穆鲁克的松散宗主权之下。

红海争霸期间，葡萄牙舰队1513年围攻珊瑚岛，另一支葡军又于1541年攻占并洗劫该城。奥斯曼征服埃及后，萨瓦金进入奥斯曼势力范围：厄兹代米尔帕夏于1550年代初占领此地，1555年起萨瓦金成为哈贝什帕夏的驻地。奥斯曼人修缮沙斐仪派和哈乃斐派清真寺，重修珊瑚石要塞与城墙。来自森纳尔丰吉苏丹国的商队仍把尼罗河腹地的货物送到海岸，但绕非洲好望角的航路把印度贸易带走，港口日渐空虚。19世纪初，约翰·路德维希·布尔克哈特见到城中三分之二的房屋已成废墟。

en:
Kharga is the southernmost and largest of Egypt's western oases, a depression about 160 kilometres long and some 200 kilometres west of the Nile. Its wells made it the last oasis on Darb al-Arba'in, the Forty Days Road out of Sudan. Caravans sometimes thousands of camels strong came up from Darfur and Kordofan, driving camels, cattle and horses and carrying gold, ivory, slaves and salt, before climbing through the Kharga Pass to the Nile valley; the Romans had earlier built a chain of mud-brick forts to guard the same road, and near the town the Saite temple of Hibis stood in a palm grove. The oasis's most famous resident was a captive: Nestorius, patriarch of Constantinople, condemned at the Council of Ephesus in 431 and exiled in 435 to a monastery in the Great Oasis, where he was hurt in a bandit raid and died around 450 after finishing his last surviving work. In 1444 Kharga was a remote Arabic-speaking Muslim holding on the Burji Mamluks' desert edge, valued for water, herds and passage.

After the Ottoman conquest of 1517 the caravans still set the rhythm of the oasis. In 1698 the French traveller Poncet left Kharga for Ethiopia and described the waterless stages to the south, where he saw neither beast nor bird, only sand hills and the bleached bones of camels. In 1793 William George Browne joined a Darfur caravan and became the first Englishman to ride the road and publish an account; he found a Mamluk horseman in the service of Ibrahim Bey al-Kabir stationed at Kharga to police the caravan during its stay. European observers of that century put the number of slaves driven north along the road at between 3,000 and 12,000 a year.
zh:
哈里杰是埃及西部诸绿洲中位置最南、面积最大的一处，坐落在尼罗河西约200公里、长约160公里的沙漠洼地里。水井使它成为「四十日路」上最后一处绿洲：这条商路从苏丹腹地北上，有时多达数千峰骆驼的商队从达尔富尔和科尔多凡赶来，驱赶着骆驼、牛和马，驮着黄金、象牙、奴隶和盐，再穿过哈里杰隘口登向尼罗河谷；罗马人早就在沿路修筑过一连串土坯要塞护卫商旅，镇北的棕榈林中还有塞易斯王朝始建的希比斯神庙。这片绿洲最有名的住客是个囚徒：君士坦丁堡牧首聂斯脱里431年在以弗所公会议被判为异端，435年被放逐到「大绿洲」的一座修道院，他在一次强人袭击中受伤，约450年死于当地，死前完成了他唯一完整传世的著作。1444年，哈里杰是布尔吉马穆鲁克沙漠边缘一处遥远的阿拉伯语穆斯林属地，价值在水源、畜群和通行。

1517年奥斯曼征服后，定绿洲节奏的仍是商队。1698年，法国旅行者蓬塞从哈里杰出发行往埃塞俄比亚，他描写南面的无水路段：看不见走兽飞禽，只有沙山和发白的骆驼骨。1793年，威廉·乔治·布朗随一支达尔富尔商队同行，成为第一个走完这条路并留下记载的英国人；他发现哈里杰驻有马穆鲁克首领易卜拉欣贝伊手下的一名骑兵，负责在商队停留期间弹压管理。据18世纪几位欧洲观察者估计，每年沿四十日路被赶往北方的奴隶有三千至一万二千人。

en:
Qasr Ibrim is a fortress on a sheer cliff above the east bank of the Nile in Lower Nubia, about 240 kilometres south of Aswan. The Romans called it Primis, and after the prefect Gaius Petronius campaigned against Kush in 23 BC their military engineers rebuilt the place into the strongest stronghold in the Nile valley. It passed to the Christian kings of Makuria early in the eighth century and became the seat of the Eparch of Nobatia, the king's deputy over northern Nubia. Its cathedral was built in the first half of that century, and its ruins have since yielded the largest hoard of Old Nubian documents known, above all the eparchs' own archive; Timothy, the last known bishop of Faras, lived here and was buried in the cathedral around 1375. In 1444 the cliff still belonged to the Christian kingdom of Dotawo, the Nubian name under which Makuria lived on, while all of Egypt to the north was Muslim.

After Selim I's Ottomans conquered Egypt, a company of Bosnian soldiers was posted to the fortress and part of the cathedral was turned into a mosque; the Bosnians married Nubian wives, and their descendants held the rock for nearly three centuries. Its last garrison came from the Mamluks who escaped Muhammad Ali's massacre at the Cairo citadel in 1811: they drove out the Bosnian families and defied his armies until 1813, when Ibrahim Pasha dislodged them with cannon fire. No one garrisoned the cliff afterwards, and the old fortress was left empty above the river.
zh:
伊布里姆堡扼守下努比亚尼罗河东岸的一处陡崖，北距阿斯旺约二百四十公里。罗马人称它普里米斯：公元前23年，埃及长官盖乌斯·佩特罗尼乌斯征讨库施后，罗马军工把这座崖顶据点修成尼罗河谷最坚固的要塞。8世纪初它归入信奉基督教的马库里亚王国，成为诺巴蒂亚都督的驻节地，代表国王统辖北努比亚；大教堂建于8世纪上半叶，其废墟后来出土了已知数量最多的古努比亚语文献，最重要的是历代都督自己的档案。最后一位可考的法拉斯主教蒂莫西晚年居于此地，约1375年葬入大教堂。1444年，这座崖堡仍属马库里亚以努比亚语自称的基督教王国「多塔沃」，而北方整个埃及已是伊斯兰的天下。

塞利姆一世的奥斯曼军队征服埃及后，一支波斯尼亚士兵被派守此堡，大教堂的一部分改成清真寺；他们娶努比亚女子为妻，后裔在崖上据守近三百年。最后的驻守者是逃来的马穆鲁克人：1811年他们从穆罕默德·阿里在开罗城堡的大屠杀中脱身，逐走波斯尼亚人的后裔据堡抗衡，直到1813年易卜拉欣帕夏用火炮把他们赶走。此后再无人在此驻军，古要塞便空空地留在河水之上。

en:
Guam, Guåhan in Chamorro, is the largest and southernmost island in the Marianas. The Chamorros settled it around 1500 BC, one of the first long ocean voyages into Remote Oceania, and by 1444 their villages stood on rows of latte stones, limestone pillars capped with coral that are found nowhere outside the Marianas. Matua families kept the coastal fishing grounds and mana'chang communities lived inland, with achaot acting between them; clans traced descent through women, and sailing, pottery and weaving were old crafts. Hagåtña was one of the leading villages on the west coast. The island was a world of chiefs, ancestor spirits and independent settlements, and its name Guåhan, 'we have', speaks of a land that furnished all its people needed.

Ferdinand Magellan reached Guam on 6 March 1521 after his Pacific crossing; Chamorro proas swarmed the ships and carried off goods that local custom held in common, and the fleet named the islands the Ladrones, the Islands of Thieves. Legazpi claimed Guam for Spain in 1565, and from then until 1815 the Manila galleons watered here, at their only regular stop between Acapulco and the Philippines. In 1668 the Jesuit Diego Luis de San Vitores landed with a permanent mission and built his first church at Hagåtña on land given by Chief Kepuha. Chief Hurao besieged the new presidio soon after, and in 1672 Matå'pang killed San Vitores and his young assistant Pedro Calungsod at Tumon. Hagåtña endured three sieges and José de Quiroga led the campaigns that broke the fighting; before long some 180 villages had been gathered into seven towns under reducción, and the people of the northern islands were resettled on Guam as well. War, typhoons and the smallpox epidemic of 1688 cut the Chamorro population from perhaps 50,000 to fewer than 5,000. The galleon station outlasted the wars, and privateers such as William Dampier watered here in their turn. When the galleon line closed in 1815, Guam was left a small Spanish Catholic garrison island.
zh:
关岛在查莫洛语中称瓜汉，是马里亚纳群岛最大、最南的岛屿。查莫洛人约在公元前1500年定居于此，这是人类驶入远大洋洲最早的远洋航行之一。到1444年，岛上村落建在成排的拉提石上，这种石柱加珊瑚石帽的屋基仅见于马里亚纳群岛。沿海的马图亚家族掌握渔场，马纳昌社群居住内陆，阿查奥特人居中往来；氏族沿母系计算世系，航海、制陶和纺织都是古老技艺，哈加特纳是西岸首要村落之一。全岛由酋长、祖灵和各自独立的聚落分治；岛名瓜汉意为「我们有」，说的是这座岛什么都能供给岛民。

1521年3月6日，斐迪南·麦哲伦横渡太平洋后抵达关岛；查莫洛人的独木舟围上海船，按本地财物共有的习俗搬走货物，船队便把群岛命名为盗贼群岛。1565年米格尔·洛佩斯·德莱加斯皮替西班牙宣称占有关岛，此后直到1815年，马尼拉邮船都在此补给淡水，这里是它们在阿卡普尔科与菲律宾之间唯一的常泊港。1668年，耶稣会士迭戈·路易斯·德·圣维托雷斯率传教团登陆，在酋长克普哈赠出的哈加特纳土地上建起第一座教堂。酋长胡劳随即围攻新设的要塞，1672年，马塔庞在图蒙杀死圣维托雷斯和他年轻的助手佩德罗·卡隆索。哈加特纳三度被围，何塞·德基罗加督军进剿，结束战事；不久约180个村落按集村政策并入七座城镇，北方各岛的居民也被迁往关岛。战争、台风和1688年的天花，使查莫洛人口从约五万降到不足五千。邮船补给站在战乱后保留下来，威廉·丹皮尔这样的武装民船船长也曾在此加水。1815年邮船航线停闭，关岛成了一座小小的西班牙天主教驻军岛屿。

en:
The land around Rabaul is the northern tip of New Britain's Gazelle Peninsula, where a drowned volcanic caldera forms Simpson Harbour, a broad sheltered anchorage. The cones Tavurvur and Vulcan stand on its rim, and ash from past eruptions gives the coastal soil unusual fertility. The Baining are the likely earlier people of the peninsula, keeping to the forested inland mountains while coastal villages face New Ireland across St George's Channel. They garden taro on rotating clearings and hold night fire dances, where masked men in huge barkcloth masks and leaf headdresses leap through the embers of a bonfire; each mask is made for one ceremony and then destroyed. In 1444 no town stood on the mangrove-fringed harbour; kin groups, gardens, fishing and the threat of eruption set the rhythm of life, and no foreign power claimed the place.

The first recorded European was William Dampier, who reached the north coast of New Britain on 27 February 1700, named the island Nova Britannia and sailed on without leaving a post. In 1767 Philip Carteret brought HMS Swallow through St George's Channel between New Britain and New Ireland and named the Duke of York Islands in the passage, also without making a claim. The fine harbour then stayed quiet for more than fifty years. By 1821 no European fort, mission or settlement stood on the caldera, and the Gazelle Peninsula remained in the hands of its own villagers and elders.
zh:
拉包尔一带是新不列颠岛加泽尔半岛的北端，海水侵入火山口形成辛普森港，是一片宽阔的避风锚地。塔乌鲁尔和武尔坎两座火山锥守在港边，历次喷发落下的火山灰使沿海土壤异常肥沃。拜宁人很可能是半岛较早的居民，他们守在林木茂密的内陆山地，沿海村落则隔着圣乔治海峡与新爱尔兰相望。拜宁人在轮垦地上种植芋艿，夜间还要举行火舞：舞者戴着树皮布和树叶扎成的大面具，在篝火余烬间穿行跳跃，每副面具只在一次仪式中使用，随后即毁。1444年，红树林环绕的港湾旁还没有城镇，亲属群体、园圃、渔业和火山威胁构成生活的节奏，也没有外来政权宣称占有。

有记载的第一个欧洲人是威廉·丹皮尔。1700年2月27日，他到达新不列颠北岸，把该岛命名为新不列颠，随后继续航行，没有留下据点。1767年，菲利普·卡特里特指挥「燕子号」穿过新不列颠与新爱尔兰之间的圣乔治海峡，为水道中的约克公爵群岛命名，同样没有宣布吞并。此后这座良港又安静了五十多年。到1821年，火山口旁仍没有欧洲人的要塞、传教站或定居点，加泽尔半岛留在本地村民和长老手中。

en:
Hanuabada means 'big village' in Motu. In 1444 its houses stood on piles over a sheltered harbour on New Guinea's south-eastern coast, where the Motu fished the coastal waters and kept close ties with the Koitabu of the hills behind the shore. The two peoples intermarried, shared villages and organized themselves into iduhu clans. Motu women made cooking pots from local clay; men joined several dugout logs under a platform, fitted a crab-claw sail and built the lakatoi used in the annual hiri voyages. Fleets of up to twenty craft carried as many as 20,000 pots west into the Gulf of Papua and brought back sago and timber.

In 1606 the Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres explored the southern coast from Milne Bay to the Gulf of Papua, but its ships did not place a post at Hanuabada's harbour. No outside power ruled the village through 1821. The lakatoi continued to make the hiri voyage, taking clay pots from the Motu shore to the sago lands west of the gulf and returning with food and timber for the pile houses.
zh:
哈努阿巴达在莫图语中意为「大村」。1444年，村舍架在新几内亚东南海岸一处掩蔽港湾的木桩上，莫图人在近岸水域捕鱼，并同岸后山地的科伊塔布人保持密切关系。两族通婚、共居，村落按伊杜胡氏族组织。莫图女人用当地黏土烧制炊罐；男人把几根独木舟原木并排扎牢，上架平台，挂上蟹钳形帆，造出用于一年一度希里远航的「拉卡托伊」多体船。最多二十艘船组成的船队可载两万个陶罐向西驶入巴布亚湾，再带回西米和木材。

1606年，路易斯·巴斯·德·托雷斯率领的西班牙探险队考察了米尔恩湾至巴布亚湾的南部海岸，但船队没有在哈努阿巴达的港湾设立据点。到1821年，这里不受外来政权统治。拉卡托伊继续进行希里远航，把莫图海岸的陶罐运往海湾以西的西米产地，再把食物和木材带回木桩村舍。

en:
The Solomon Islands run in two parallel chains east of New Guinea; Guadalcanal, which its people call Isatabu, is the largest island, with rain-forested mountains rising behind its northern coast. Poha Cave and Vatuluma Posovi show people living here by 4500–2500 BC, and Lapita potters reached the chain around 1200–800 BC. By 1444 Melanesian villagers lived from taro and yam gardens, fishing and canoe voyages between islands; sacred shrines bound clans together across a sea of many languages, and no outside power ruled them.

The first Europeans came from Peru. Álvaro de Mendaña's two ships reached Santa Isabel on 7 February 1568, with Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa commanding the flagship, and spent six months surveying Malaita, Guadalcanal, Makira and their neighbours.
