Daniel Morgan raised his sharpshooters around Winchester and led them to Saratoga and Cowpens; Peter Muhlenberg, a Lutheran pastor at Woodstock, preached his farewell sermon in the pulpit and marched off at the head of a Virginia regiment.
zh:
本省是谢南多亚河谷，蓝岭山脉与阿勒格尼山脊之间一条漫长走廊，谢南多亚河的几支汊流向北注入波托马克河。1444年，河谷滩地属于塞内多人：这支务农的部族没有留下语言记录，他们在河滩上耕作，在河湾上方留下后人挖开的土墩。河谷还是一条征战通道：北方的塞内卡人和莱纳佩人列队南下，奔袭远方的卡托巴人，卡托巴的战队又循同一条路北上报复。

早期移民听来的说法是，塞内多人本人就在1700年之前被卡托巴袭掠者灭族。1716年，总督亚历山大·斯波茨伍德的「金马掌骑士」从斯威夫特河山口越过蓝岭；1727年，亚当·米勒在南汊辟下第一座农庄；1730年代，德意志和苏格兰－爱尔兰裔家庭沿古老的印第安小路（即大车道）南下，温彻斯特和伍德斯托克在定居点之间兴起。一向把河谷当作袭掠走廊的易洛魁人，于1744年以200英镑金币的价钱在《兰开斯特条约》中卖掉对河谷的权利，在温彻斯特附近扎营的肖尼人则在1754年迁往阿勒格尼山以西。独立战争中，河谷既向大陆军供应小麦，也送去步枪手：丹尼尔·摩根在温彻斯特一带募集神枪手，率他们参加萨拉托加和考彭斯之战；伍德斯托克的路德宗牧师彼得·米伦贝格在讲坛上作完告别布道，便率弗吉尼亚一团出征。

en:
Ersegonteog covered the basin of the Saint-François River, an Abenaki canoe route that climbs from Lake Saint-Pierre south-east through lakes and portages into the Appalachian hills. In 1444 this was Western Abenaki country with no European settlement. Bands followed the river by season, taking fish and game, raising maize, beans and squash at summer camps, and gathering in autonomous villages under no single chief.

Sokoki families were living on the lower river by the 1660s, and the French built Fort Crevier there in 1687. In 1700 Jacques Bigot moved the Jesuit mission of Saint-François-de-Sales from the failing Chaudière station to the river mouth; its village became Odanak, which the French palisaded and fortified with redoubts during the War of the Spanish Succession. After Dummer's War ended in 1725, Abenaki families from the Maine missions joined it. Saint-François became a base for raiding parties that struck New England as far south as Massachusetts, and in 1759 the British answered: on 4 October Robert Rogers led about 140 rangers into Odanak at dawn and burned the village. Rogers reported as many as 200 dead; French records put the figure at about thirty. The retreat through the Connecticut River valley nearly destroyed his command: starving and hunted, about a third of the men never returned. In 1791 the British opened the upper basin to township survey, and Dunham, the first township, was granted in 1796 to Loyalist and New England farmers moving up the old canoe route.
zh:
埃尔塞冈泰奥格位于圣弗朗索瓦河流域。这条阿贝纳基人的独木舟航路从圣皮埃尔湖向东南穿行于湖泊与搬运道之间，深入阿巴拉契亚丘陵。1444年时，这里是西阿贝纳基人的土地，没有欧洲人定居。各群体随季节往来河上，捕鱼狩猎，在夏季营地种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，聚居于各自作主的村落，并不受一位首领统辖。

1660年代，索科基人的家庭已在河流下游居住，1687年法国人在那里修起克雷维埃堡。1700年，雅克·比戈把耶稣会的圣弗朗索瓦·德萨勒传教站从连年歉收的肖迪耶尔站迁到河口，形成后来的奥达纳克村；西班牙王位继承战争期间，法国人又给村子围上栅栏、加筑棱堡。1725年达默战争结束后，来自缅因传教村的阿贝纳基家庭陆续迁入。圣弗朗索瓦后来成为袭掠队伍的出发地，南下远袭新英格兰，兵锋一直到达马萨诸塞；1759年英国人还以颜色：10月4日拂晓，罗伯特·罗杰斯率约一百四十名别动队突入奥达纳克，放火烧村。罗杰斯报告死者多达两百人，法国记录则称约三十人。他取道康涅狄格河谷撤退时队伍险些溃散：部下饥困交加、一路被追击，约三分之一的人再没回来。1791年，英国把上游盆地开放为乡镇勘测区，第一个乡镇邓纳姆于1796年批给定居者，效忠派和新英格兰农户沿旧日独木舟水路逆流而来。

en:
Allesikantekw covers the lower Kennebec. At Merrymeeting Bay the river meets the Androscoggin and spreads into a wide freshwater tidal basin before running south into the Gulf of Maine; tides run far upstream, and oceangoing ships could ride them to the head of navigation at the later site of Augusta. Eastern Abenaki families, the Wawenock among them, kept seasonal camps on the bay's islands, fished the tidal water for sturgeon and herring, planted corn on the intervales, and paddled the Kennebec north as a canoe road into the interior. Each band followed its own sagamore. In 1444 this was Wabanaki country, with no European post on the shore.

The lower-river sagamore Rawandagon was known to the English as Robin Hood, and the bay's English name is usually traced to the spring fur-trade rendezvous, a rowdy merry meeting of traders and trappers. George Weymouth visited in 1605 and seized five Wawenock men to carry to England. In 1607 the Plymouth Company landed about 120 settlers at the river mouth and raised the star-shaped Fort St George, the Popham Colony; in fourteen months they built the pinnace Virginia of Sagadahoc, the first ocean-going vessel English shipwrights launched in North America, and then abandoned the post. Traders opened Cushnoc at the head of navigation in 1628, and the Kennebec Proprietors built Fort Western on the spot in 1754, a log palisade with blockhouses. Abenaki raids struck the lower settlements through King Philip's War after 1675 and the frontier fighting that followed. In September 1775 Benedict Arnold's expedition to Quebec made Fort Western its staging point, where the men repaired their flat-bottomed bateaux; Daniel Morgan and Aaron Burr lodged in the garrison before the column rowed upstream into the wilderness.
zh:
阿莱西坎特库地处肯纳贝克河下游。肯纳贝克河与安德罗斯科金河在梅里米廷湾汇成一片宽阔的淡水潮汐湾，再南流注入缅因湾；潮水沿河上溯很远，海船能乘潮直抵后来奥古斯塔所在的通航顶端。东阿布纳基人中的瓦沃诺克等家族在湾中岛屿设立季节性营地，在感潮河段捕捞鲟鱼和鲱鱼，在河滩种植玉米，又把肯纳贝克河当作深入内陆的独木舟通道。各群体由各自的酋长统领。1444年时，这里仍是瓦巴纳基人的土地，岸上还没有欧洲人的据点。

下游酋长拉万达贡被英国人称作罗宾汉；梅里米廷湾的英文名字通常被认为来自毛皮贸易春季集会上商人和猎人的喧闹欢会。1605年，乔治·韦茅斯来到这里，掳走五名瓦沃诺克人带回英国。1607年，普利茅斯公司约一百二十名移民在河口登陆，筑起星形的圣乔治堡，即波帕姆殖民地；十四个月里，他们建成了英国造船工匠在北美下水的第一艘远洋船「萨加达霍克的弗吉尼亚号」，随后便放弃了据点。1628年，商人在通航顶端开设库什诺克贸易站，肯纳贝克业主会1754年又在原址修起带角楼的木栅堡垒韦斯特恩堡。1675年腓力国王战争爆发后，阿布纳基武装不断袭击下游定居点，此后多年边疆战事不断。1775年9月，本尼迪克特·阿诺德远征魁北克，以韦斯特恩堡为集结地，士兵在那里修缮平底船，丹尼尔·摩根和艾伦·伯尔也驻在堡中，随后队伍划向上游的荒野。

en:
Natchitoches was one of the three Caddo-speaking confederacies, with the Hasinai in eastern Texas and the Kadohadacho higher on the Red River. Its villages stood among the bayous and cane bottoms of northwestern Louisiana, where people farmed maize, beans and squash, made fine pottery, and traded with neighboring Caddo towns. In 1444 the old mound-building centers had become dispersed farming villages, but Natchitoches still controlled a useful stretch of the road between the Mississippi and Texas.

A Spanish entrada crossed Caddo country in the 1540s, yet the Europeans who changed the place were French. Louis Juchereau de St. Denis reached the Red River village in 1714 while pursuing trade toward Spanish Mexico, put up two huts and left a small detachment with stores. Two years later Du Tisne built and garrisoned Fort St. Jean Baptiste as France's answer to Spanish Texas. Epidemics had cut the Natchitoches sharply by then, but their town became the main French ally and supply point on the upper Red River, exchanging corn, game and bear oil for European goods and adding tobacco in the 1730s. In 1732 St. Denis defeated a Natchez attack near Cloutierville, and the post was strengthened afterward. It passed to Spain with Louisiana after 1763; Alejandro O'Reilly's suppression of the Creole revolt of 1768 made that rule effective. After the Louisiana Purchase of 1803, the United States opened a federal fur factory here, and in 1819 Natchitoches became a town, the oldest permanent European settlement in the purchased territory.
zh:
纳基托什是三大卡多语联盟之一，另外两支是东得克萨斯的哈西奈人和雷德河上游的卡多哈达乔人。他们的村落位于路易斯安那西北部的牛轭湖与芦苇低地间，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，制作精良陶器，并与邻近的卡多城镇贸易。到1444年，古老的筑丘中心已经变成分散的农业村落，但纳基托什仍控制着密西西比与得克萨斯之间一条有用通道的关键河段。

16世纪40年代，一支西班牙远征队穿过卡多土地，不过真正改变这里的是法国人。1714年，路易·朱谢罗·德·圣但尼在谋求与西属墨西哥通商时到达雷德河畔的村落，搭起两间棚屋，留下一支小分遣队和货物。两年后，迪蒂涅修建并驻守圣让巴蒂斯特堡，作为法国应对西属得克萨斯的据点。当时疫病已使纳基托什人口大减，但这座城镇仍成为法国在雷德河上游最重要的盟友和补给点，以玉米、猎物和熊油交换欧洲商品，18世纪30年代又开始种植烟草。1732年，圣但尼在克洛蒂维尔附近击败来犯的纳奇兹人，据点随后加固。1763年后，它随路易斯安那转入西班牙之手；亚历杭德罗·奥赖利镇压1768年克里奥尔起义后，西班牙的统治才真正生效。1803年路易斯安那购地后，美国在此设立联邦毛皮贸易站；1819年，纳基托什正式设镇，成为购得领土上最早的欧洲人永久定居点。

en:
The country around Lake Nipigon lies inland from the north-west shore of Lake Superior. The lake, Animbiigoo-zaaga'igan to its Ojibwe people, the waters that stretch to the horizon, is the largest body of fresh water wholly inside Ontario, and the short, fast Nipigon River carries its overflow south into Nipigon Bay. Ojibwe families took trout and whitefish from the cold water, hunted caribou in the shore forests and trapped beaver along the streams, and their canoes used the river to pass between Superior and the lakes of the northern fur country. In 1444 this was Anishinaabe land, thick with beaver and untouched by Europeans.

The first Frenchmen reached the lake in the wake of refugees. When the Iroquois overran the Nipissing country in 1649–50, Nipissing families sheltered on its shores, and in 1667 the Jesuit Claude Allouez said the first mass among them beside the Nipigon River. In 1683 the soldier and explorer Daniel Greysolon du Lhut, who later gave his name to the city of Duluth, built Fort La Tourette on the lake, probably in Ombabika Bay, and named it for his brother. The post lasted only thirteen years: in 1696 the crown closed the western posts when beaver pelts piled up unsold and the trading permits were withdrawn. British traders moved in later in the next century, the North West Company vying with the Hudson's Bay Company, which opened its first lake post in 1792; the two rivals merged in 1821, leaving the company to run the Nipigon fur trade alone.
zh:
尼皮贡湖一带位于苏必利尔湖西北岸的内陆。湖畔的奥吉布瓦人把大湖称作Animbiigoo-zaaga'igan，意为绵延至天际的水域；它是全境都在安大略境内的第一大湖，短而湍急的尼皮贡河把湖水向南送入尼皮贡湾。奥吉布瓦家庭在冷水中捕鳟鱼和白鱼，在沿岸森林猎驯鹿，沿溪涧诱捕河狸，独木舟借这条河往来于苏必利尔湖与北方湖泽密布的毛皮之地。1444年，这里是阿尼什纳比人的土地，河狸成群，欧洲人尚未来到。

最早来到湖畔的法国人追随难民而至。1649至1650年易洛魁人攻陷尼皮辛人的家园，尼皮辛部族到湖岸避难；1667年，耶稣会士克洛德·阿卢埃在尼皮贡河畔、在他们中间做了第一场弥撒。1683年，军人出身的探险家达尼埃尔·格雷索隆·迪吕特在湖畔修建拉图雷特堡，可能位于翁巴比卡湾，堡名得自他的兄弟，后来美国的杜鲁斯城也以他命名。商站只维持了十三年：1696年，海狸皮滞销积压、贸易特许被收回，王室下令关闭西部据点。进入十八世纪后英国商人接踵而来，西北公司与1792年在湖畔开设首个商站的哈德逊湾公司争利；两公司于1821年合并，尼皮贡的毛皮生意由哈德逊湾公司一家经营。

en:
Bungi, the Red River country, spreads across the flat bed of ancient Lake Agassiz, with the wooded Pembina and Turtle hills along its western edge. In 1444 the ground belonged to the Nakota bands the French later called Assiniboine. They followed the bison north each summer and wintered in sheltered parkland, hauling their lodges on dog travois, for neither horses nor guns had reached the northern plains. Their Hidatsa kinsmen called a broken, wooded hill country Amahami, and the Awaxawi band traced its origin to Devils Lake on the edge of this land before moving to the Missouri. Assiniboine brokers already carried beaver pelts, bison hides and Missouri corn along the native trade routes.

The French reached the Forks of the Red and Assiniboine in 1738, when La Vérendrye raised Fort Rouge there before going on to the Mandan; the post was abandoned by 1749. Traders returned in the 1790s and built facing one another at the Pembina mouth: Charles Chaboillez raised a North West Company post in 1797 and Alexander Henry the Younger another opposite it in 1801, while the Hudson's Bay Company kept a post on the Red. Métis hunters made Pembina the meeting ground of the great summer buffalo hunts, and Saulteaux under Peguis settled the river in the same decade; the smallpox of 1782 had thinned every camp before them.

In 1812 the Earl of Selkirk planted a Scottish farming colony on the plains, and in January 1814 its governor, Miles Macdonell, issued the Pemmican Proclamation, banning export of the dried-meat provisions the North West Company's brigades lived on. The Pemmican War followed. On 19 June 1816, at Seven Oaks, Governor Robert Semple and twenty of his party were killed by a Métis force that lost one man and afterwards raised its blue flag as the New Nation. Selkirk made treaty with the Cree, Assiniboine and Ojibwa in 1817, and the merger of the two fur companies in 1821 put the whole country under the Hudson's Bay Company.
zh:
邦吉即红河地区，铺展在古阿加西湖干涸后的平坦湖床上，西缘横亘着林木覆盖的彭比纳丘陵和龟山。1444年，这里是纳科塔诸氏族的土地，法国人后来叫他们阿西尼博因人。他们夏天随野牛群北上，冬天退入避风的林带，用狗拉拖杆搬运帐篷，因为马和火器都还没有传到北部大平原。他们的希达察亲族把丘陵破碎、林木交错之地称作「阿马哈米」，阿瓦克萨维一支传说起源于这片土地边缘的魔鬼湖，后来才迁往密苏里河。此时阿西尼博因中间人已沿着原住民商路贩运河狸皮、野牛皮和密苏里的玉米。

1738年，拉韦朗德里抵达红河与阿希尼伯恩河汇流处，在当地建起鲁日堡，随后继续前往曼丹人那里，商栈到1749年已废弃。1790年代贸易者重返，在彭比纳河口隔岸对筑：沙布瓦耶1797年为西北公司建栈，小亚历山大·亨利1801年在对面另筑一栈，哈得孙湾公司则在红河畔设有商馆。梅蒂猎人把彭比纳变成每年夏季大野牛猎的集合地；同一十年里，佩吉斯率领索尔特奥人在河畔定居。在此之前，1782年的天花已使沿途各营地人口大减。

1812年，塞尔扣克伯爵在草原上办起一片苏格兰农人垦殖地。1814年1月，垦殖地总督迈尔斯·麦克唐奈尔颁布《干肉饼公告》，禁止出口西北公司独木舟队赖以为生的肉糜口粮，干肉饼战争随之爆发。1816年6月19日在七橡树，总督罗伯特·森普尔率部众与梅蒂人交战，森普尔等二十一人被杀，梅蒂一方仅死一人，战后他们升起自己的蓝旗，以「新民族」自居。1817年，塞尔扣克与克里、阿西尼博因和奥吉布瓦人缔约；1821年两毛皮公司合并，整个地区归入哈得孙湾公司。

en:
The Matiyininiwak country is the belt of boreal forest and aspen parkland between the Peace and North Saskatchewan rivers, where Lesser Slave Lake drains through the Lesser Slave River into the Athabasca. In 1444 its moose ranges, beaver streams and fishing lakes belonged to small Athabascan-speaking hunting bands, kin of the Dane-zaa, or Beaver, and of the people who later became the Tsuu T'ina. They moved by birchbark canoe and snowshoe between winter camps, taking moose, woodland caribou and beaver, and traded skins and dried meat to the bison hunters of the open plains to the south.

Through the 1700s Cree bands armed by the Hudson's Bay trade pushed west as fur middlemen, pressing the Dane-zaa back toward the Peace River while the forest people who became the Tsuu T'ina broke away south for the plains. The long Cree-Beaver fighting ended only when the smallpox epidemic of 1781 devastated both sides, and the peace they made gave the Peace River its name. The traders came close behind. Peter Pond, a founding partner of the North West Company, crossed the twelve-mile Methye Portage into the Athabasca country in 1778 and built Pond House on the Athabasca River, the first fur-trade building in what is now Alberta; he took in so many pelts that his canoes could not carry them all out, and his maps later guided Alexander Mackenzie down the great river that bears his name. Fort Chipewyan rose on Lake Athabasca in 1788, and in 1802 the North West Company built at Buffalo Bay on Lesser Slave Lake, the earliest post in the lake country, tying these hunters to the northern fur brigades.
zh:
马蒂厄因伊瓦克之地是皮斯河与北萨斯喀彻温河之间的针叶林与白杨疏林草原带，小奴湖经小奴河注入阿萨巴斯卡河。1444年，这里的驼鹿猎场、河狸溪和鱼湖属于说阿萨巴斯卡语的小股游猎群，他们是戴尼扎人（即比弗人）和后来成为楚蒂纳人的人群的亲族。人们乘桦皮舟、踏雪鞋在各个冬营之间迁徙，猎取驼鹿、林地驯鹿和河狸，再把毛皮和肉干卖给南方开阔平原上的猎牛人。

整个18世纪，经哈得孙湾贸易获得枪械的克里诸部以毛皮中间商的身份西进，把戴尼扎人逼退到皮斯河一线，林中后来成为楚蒂纳人的人群则脱离出去、南下平原。克里人与比弗人的长年交战，直到1781年天花大流行重创双方才收场，他们缔结的和约给了皮斯河这个名字。商人紧随战火而来：西北公司的创始合伙人彼得·庞德越过一条长约十九公里、通往阿萨巴斯卡流域的陆路搬运道，于1778年在阿萨巴斯卡河畔建起庞德屋，这是今艾伯塔境内最早的毛皮贸易建筑；他收进的毛皮太多，独木舟一次都运不完，他绘制的地图后来引导亚历山大·麦肯齐沿以他命名的马更些河而下。1788年，阿萨巴斯卡湖畔建起奇普瓦恩堡；1802年，西北公司在小奴湖的布法罗湾设站，这是湖地一带最早的商站，把这里的猎人拴进了北方皮货运输队的航路。

en:
The Tsuu T'ina land is the eastern flank of the Rocky Mountains, forested foothills running down from the Banff and Jasper ranges toward the short-grass prairie. In 1444 small Athabascan-speaking bands hunted this forest edge. They were kin of the Dane-zaa, the Beaver people of the northern woods, and the Tsuu T'ina had not yet broken away: their tongue belonged with the far-northern Dene languages rather than with Blackfoot or Cree. Winter camps sat in timbered river valleys where they took moose and elk; in summer the bands moved out on to the prairie after buffalo, dragging their lodges with dog travois, for horses had not reached the northern plains. Beyond the last trees began the Blackfoot world, and Tsuu T'ina oral history long kept the memory of the time before the separation.

Early in the 18th century these bands parted from the Dane-zaa and moved south, becoming tipi-dwelling plains hunters. David Thompson found them living beside the Cree in the Beaver Hills near Edmonton in the 1810s, and only after that quarrel did they move further south and make their alliance with the Blackfoot Confederacy. The smallpox epidemic of 1781 swept through their camps with the rest of the northern plains. In September 1799 the North West and Hudson's Bay companies planted rival posts where the Clearwater joins the North Saskatchewan, Rocky Mountain House and Acton House, the westernmost forts on the river and within sight of the mountains. Blackfoot and Piegan traders kept the Kootenay from crossing down to them, holding the middleman's share of the gun trade. Thompson wintered at the posts, and in 1807 went upriver through Howse Pass to the Columbia, where he built Kootenay House beyond the divide.
zh:
楚蒂纳之地是落基山脉东麓，森林覆盖的山麓从班夫、贾斯珀一带的山岭降到短草平原。1444年，小股说阿萨巴斯卡语的游猎群在这条林缘活动。他们与北方林中的戴尼扎人（海狸人）同源，当时楚蒂纳人尚未分出：他们的语言属于遥远北方的戴尼语族，和黑脚语、克里语并不相亲。冬天，队伍在林木河谷扎营猎驼鹿和马鹿；夏天出平原追野牛，靠狗拉拖橇搬运帐篷，那时马还没有传到北部平原。林带尽头之外便是黑脚人的地盘，楚蒂纳人的口传史也长久记着分离之前的岁月。

18世纪初，这些队伍与戴尼扎人分手南下，改住圆锥帐篷，成为平原猎人。1810年代，戴维·汤普森在埃德蒙顿附近的比弗山见到他们与克里人比邻而居；后来两族反目，楚蒂纳人继续南迁，才与黑脚联盟结盟。1781年的天花大流行随北部平原其他各部一同扫过他们的营地。1799年9月，西北公司与哈得孙湾公司在克利尔沃特河汇入北萨斯喀彻温河处各建商栈相争——落基山屋与阿克顿商栈是北萨斯喀彻温河上最靠西的商栈，抬头便望得见山脉。黑脚人和皮甘人阻拦库特尼人下山入栈，把枪械贸易的中间之利握在手里。汤普森曾在商栈过冬，1807年溯河而上，取道豪斯山口抵达哥伦比亚河，在分水岭以西建起库特内屋（Kootenay House）。

en:
The Nimíipuu, whose name means 'we, the people,' held the lower Snake and Clearwater canyons and the grassy Camas Prairie. In 1444 their families moved between salmon fishing stations, root grounds, mountain hunting camps, and sheltered winter villages. Salmon, camas and cous roots, and game taken in the mountains filled the seasonal round. Canoes and foot trails linked their villages with Sahaptin neighbors and partners across the Columbia Plateau, the northern Great Basin, and the edge of the northwestern plains. No chief spoke for every village; experienced family leaders arranged camp movements and dealings with outsiders.

Horses came through Shoshone networks around 1730, and Nimíipuu herders made the most of protected grass around the Snake, Clearwater, and Palouse country. They gelded poor stallions, traded away weak animals, and kept selected breeding herds by 1750. Most horses were solid coloured, but their spotted stock later took the name Appaloosa from the Palouse River lands. When Lewis and Clark reached Weippe Prairie on 20 September 1805 after crossing the Bitterroots, the Nimíipuu fed the half-starved party, and Walammottinin, called Twisted Hair, kept their horses while the explorers went on to the Pacific. On the return in 1806, Lewis described the horses he saw as tall, active, and durable. French-Canadian trappers had by then fixed the name Nez Perce, or 'pierced nose,' on them, although the Nimíipuu did not pierce their noses. In 1821 the canyons and prairies were still Nimíipuu land.
zh:
尼米普人在自己的语言中意为「我们这些人」，居住在斯内克河下游、克利尔沃特河峡谷和卡马斯草原一带。1444年时，各家族按季节往返于鲑鱼渔场、根菜采集地、山间猎营和避风冬村之间。鲑鱼、卡马夏球茎、库斯根和山间猎物支撑着一年的生计；独木舟和步道把他们的村落同其他萨哈泼丁村落，以及哥伦比亚高原、北部大盆地和西北大平原边缘的贸易伙伴连接起来。没有哪个首领能代表所有村落，扎营迁徙和对外交涉多由经验丰富的家族首领安排。

马大约在1730年经肖肖尼人的交换网络传到这里。尼米普牧马人利用斯内克河、克利尔沃特河和帕卢斯河一带有山岭遮蔽的草场，阉割不合格的公马、卖出弱马，并在1750年前保有经挑选的繁育马群。他们的马多数毛色单一，但那些斑点马后来随帕卢斯河地区得名阿帕卢萨马。1805年9月20日，刘易斯和克拉克的队伍翻越比特鲁特山后抵达韦普草原，尼米普人给这些饿得发慌的旅人提供食物；绰号「缠发」的瓦拉莫蒂宁替他们照看马匹，让探险者继续前往太平洋。1806年返程时，刘易斯记载这里的马高大、敏捷又耐劳。此时法裔加拿大捕兽者已把「内兹珀斯」一名安在他们头上，意思是「穿鼻者」，但尼米普人并没有穿鼻习俗。1821年，这些峡谷和草原仍是尼米普人的土地。

en:
Banakwut is high, cold Shoshone country on the Snake River Plain, where sagebrush flats and sheets of black lava are cut by streams that run down to the Snake. In 1444 small Shoshoni-speaking bands kept to a seasonal round. They dug camas and yampah roots on the prairies, hunted mule deer and pronghorn on the flats, and went down to the river for salmon: below the falls the runs were thick, and families took the fish from wooden platforms and brush weirs. Dried salmon, roots and dressed hides were what carried a band through a hard winter.

Horses reached the Snake country in the late 1600s or early 1700s and changed that round entirely. During the eighteenth century a Northern Paiute band moved onto the plain to join the Northern Shoshone, and from it came the people later called the Bannock. Mounted parties rode south into the Great Basin and east through the Rockies on a long trail to the Montana bison grounds. Lewis and Clark, the first non-natives to see the Snake, crossed its watershed in 1805 and 1806. In 1811 Wilson Price Hunt's overland Astorians tried to canoe the river, lost a man in its rapids, and gave up at Caldron Linn, a churning fall on the plain; they cached their goods and struck out overland for the Columbia. American and British beaver trappers followed their trail, and by 1821 the first fur brigades were working the streams of Bannock and Shoshone country, though mounted camps still decided who could cross the interior.
zh:
巴纳库特是斯内克河平原上高寒的肖肖尼之地，艾灌丛荒原和黑色熔岩原被一条条汇入斯内克河的溪流切开。1444年，说肖肖尼语的小群体按季节迁徙：在草原上挖卡马夏和延帕草根茎，在荒原上猎骡鹿和叉角羚，再到河边等鲑鱼。瀑布以下鱼群密集，各家在木台和灌木鱼梁上捕鱼，鱼干、根茎和处理过的兽皮就是一群人熬过严冬的依靠。

马在17世纪末或18世纪初传入斯内克地区，彻底改变了这样的迁徙节奏。18世纪，一支北派尤特群体进入平原与北肖肖尼人合流，后来被称为班诺克人；骑马的队伍南下大盆地，向东穿过落基山脉，沿一条长路前往蒙大拿的野牛场。刘易斯与克拉克是最早见到斯内克河的非原住民，1805年至1806年穿行过它的流域。1811年，威尔逊·普赖斯·亨特率领阿斯托里亚陆路队试图顺河行舟，在急流中损失一人，到平原上考德伦林瀑布的翻涌水势前只得放弃，他们把货物就地窖藏，改走陆路前往哥伦比亚河。美国和英国的河狸猎人随后循迹而来，到1821年，最早的毛皮捕猎队已在班诺克与肖肖尼土地的溪流上作业，但内陆通道由谁经过，仍掌握在骑马营地手中。

en:
The Miwok of this coast are the Coast Miwok, whose country runs from the Golden Gate north to Duncans Point and takes in the Point Reyes peninsula, Tomales and Bodega bays and the tidal marshes of San Pablo Bay. In 1444 the Hookooeko of Marin, the Olamentko around Bodega and the Lekahtewutko of southern Sonoma lived in independent villages with no chief over all of them. They gathered acorns and buckeye, netted salmon in the creeks and camped on the shore in fishing season, and their shellmounds ringed the bays; at Tolay Lake they kept charmstones for ceremony and healing. No foreign sail had yet been seen from these headlands.

The first English ship they met was the Golden Hind. Francis Drake had spent months sacking Spanish ports and shipping off the Pacific coast of New Spain when he anchored under Point Reyes on 17 June 1579, looking for a quiet harbour to repair his ship before the voyage home around the world. His men beached and careened the Golden Hind for five weeks; Drake named the country New Albion and claimed it for Elizabeth I, England's first claim on the North American Pacific shore. Crowds of Coast Miwok came to the camp, and the ship's chaplain set down the first written description of them. No garrison was left when the Golden Hind sailed on 23 July.

Sixteen years later the Manila galleon San Agustin, under Sebastian Cermeno, was driven onto the same bay by a storm, and her Chinese cargo washed into Miwok villages. Spain never built a town on this shore. From 1783 Coast Miwoks were drawn across the Golden Gate into Mission San Francisco, and after 1814 others were sent on to Mission San Jose; by the end of 1817, 850 had been baptised. That December Father Vicente de Sarria founded Mission San Rafael Arcangel in their homeland as a hospital outstation for sick neophytes, the last and northernmost Spanish foundation in Alta California. Only the ocean coast from Point Reyes to Bodega remained Miwok land, and four years later Spanish rule ended with Mexican independence.
zh:
这一带的米沃克人是海岸米沃克人，他们的土地从金门向北到邓肯斯角，环抱着雷伊斯角半岛、托马莱斯湾、博德加湾和圣巴勃罗湾的潮汐沼泽。1444年，马林的胡库艾科人、博德加一带的奥拉门特科人和索诺马南部的莱卡特乌特科人住在互不统属的村庄里，没有统管各部的酋长。他们采拾橡子和七叶树果，在溪中网捕鲑鱼，渔汛时到海边扎营，贝丘环绕着海湾；人们在托莱湖安放护符石，用于仪式和疗愈。那时这些海岬上还没有人见过外来的帆影。

米沃克人遇到的第一艘英国船是「金鹿号」。此前几个月，弗朗西斯·德雷克在新西班牙的太平洋沿岸一路劫掠西班牙港口和商船，1579年6月17日，他把船停进雷伊斯角下的僻静海湾，要修妥船只再走环球返航的路。船员把金鹿号拖上海滩检修了五周；德雷克将这片土地命名为新阿尔比恩，以伊丽莎白一世的名义宣布占领，这是英国在北美太平洋沿岸的第一块领土宣称。成群的海岸米沃克人来到营地，随船牧师留下了关于他们最早的文字记载。7月23日金鹿号起航，没有留下一兵一卒。

十六年后，塞巴斯蒂安·塞尔梅尼奥的马尼拉大帆船「圣阿古斯丁号」在同一个海湾被风暴冲上礁岸，船上的中国货漂进了米沃克人的村庄。西班牙人始终没有在这片海岸建城。从1783年起，海岸米沃克人被陆续带入金门对岸的圣弗朗西斯科传教所，1814年后又有一些人被转送到圣何塞传教所；到1817年底，受洗者已有八百五十人。同年12月，文森特·德·萨里亚神父在他们的故地建立圣拉斐尔·阿坎赫尔传教所，作为患病新信徒的疗养分站，这是西班牙人在上加利福尼亚建立的最后、也是最北的一处传教所。那时只剩雷伊斯角到博德加的大洋沿岸还是米沃克人的土地；四年后，西班牙的统治随墨西哥独立而终结。

en:
Haida is Haida Gwaii, the archipelago beyond Hecate Strait built around Graham and Moresby islands and open to the full run of Pacific swells. The Haida speak a language with no proven kin, and their cedar canoes carried them across hundreds of miles of open water. They built plank longhouses fronted by carved poles, ranked themselves into Raven and Eagle clans, and settled rank and property at potlatches. Halibut, salmon, shellfish and cedar supplied the villages, while war canoes raiding south along the coast brought back captives and plunder. By 1444 more than a hundred villages stood on sheltered beaches and stream mouths, and their owners looked out to sea for trade and war rather than across the strait to the mainland.

Juan Pérez's Spanish ship Santiago drifted off the islands for two days in July 1774 and traded with Haida canoes, but the currents never let him land. James Cook sighted the islands in 1778, and when George Dixon arrived in 1787 he opened the sea-otter trade and named the group the Queen Charlotte Islands, after his ship. Haida sellers drove hard bargains with Spanish, British, Russian and American captains and mounted traded guns and swivel guns on their canoes for their own wars. Koyah, chief of Ninstints in the southern islands, traded peacefully with Dixon, Charles Duncan and Robert Gray, then fought two sharp engagements with John Kendrick in 1789 and 1791. In 1794 his allies under Chief Cumshewa took the American schooner Resolution, and his own warriors seized Simon Metcalfe's brig Ino; only one man from each crew lived. Koyah attacked John Boit's Union the next year and was driven off. Through 1821 Haida Gwaii remained an independent Haida country, its harbours feeding one of the richest sea-otter trades on the coast.
zh:
海达即赫卡特海峡外的海达瓜依群岛，以格雷厄姆岛和莫尔斯比岛为主体，直面太平洋涌浪。海达语没有找到可考的亲属语言，海达人的雪松独木舟能载着他们横渡数百里开阔洋面。他们建造木板大屋，门前立着雕刻柱，社会分为渡鸦和鹰两大家族，地位与财产在夸富宴上排定。大比目鱼、鲑鱼、贝类和雪松供养着村庄，南下的海上劫掠则带回俘虏和财物。到1444年，避风海滩和溪口边已有一百多座村庄，岛民的贸易与征战都面向大洋，而不是海峡对岸的大陆。

1774年7月，西班牙船「圣地亚哥号」在群岛外漂了两天，与海达独木舟交易，但海流始终没让胡安·佩雷斯登陆。詹姆斯·库克1778年望见群岛；1787年乔治·迪克森到来，打开了海獭贸易，并以自己的船把群岛命名为夏洛特皇后群岛。海达卖主与西班牙、英国、俄国和美国船长强硬议价，还把买来的火枪和回旋炮装上独木舟，用于自己的战事。南岛宁斯汀茨村的酋长科亚起初与迪克森、查尔斯·邓肯和罗伯特·格雷和平交易，随后在1789年和1791年两次与约翰·肯德里克激烈交火。1794年，他的盟友在卡姆谢瓦酋长率领下夺下美国纵帆船「决心号」，他自己的战士又俘获西蒙·梅特卡夫的双桅船「伊诺号」，两船都只有一人活命。第二年科亚又袭击约翰·博伊特的「联合号」，仍被击退。直到1821年，海达瓜依仍是独立的海达之地，各港湾供应着沿岸最丰厚的海獭贸易之一。

en:
Between the upper Delaware and the North Branch of the Susquehanna lie the wooded ridges of the Endless Mountains, broken by the long flat the Munsee called Wyoming, 'at the big river flat', now the Wyoming Valley. The Munsee were the northernmost division of the Lenape, and two of their stockaded villages stood opposite modern Wilkes-Barre in the fifteenth century. They raised maize on the floodplains, fished the river and hunted the oak and pine ridges, while the Iroquoian Susquehannock below the mountains were rivals and occasional trading partners. In 1444 neither the Minisink trail nor the Susquehanna carried any European goods, and these highlands were entirely Munsee country.

The loss of the flats began with a swindle to the east: in the Walking Purchase of 1737 Pennsylvania's agents claimed every acre a man could reach on foot in a day and a half and ran the line far past what the Lenape had understood. Five years later the Onondaga orator Canassatego ordered the Delaware River Lenape onto the Wyoming flats, where Shawnee bands had settled a generation earlier and Nanticoke families soon followed. Teedyuscung, who spoke for the displaced bands, led frontier raids during the French and Indian War and argued their case at Easton until assailants burned his cabin while he slept. Moravian missionaries like David Zeisberger preached in the valley.

A Connecticut company held a disputed Iroquois deed to the flats and sent settlers in force from 1769; its 'Yankees' and Pennsylvania's 'Pennamites' besieged each other's forts for years in the first of the Pennamite-Yankee Wars. On 3 July 1778 John Butler's Loyalist rangers with Seneca warriors overran the valley militia, leaving some three hundred dead in the Battle of Wyoming; hundreds of families then fled over the Poconos in the 'Great Runaway', and Sullivan's expedition marshalled on the flats the next year before marching against the Haudenosaunee. A Continental Congress tribunal at Trenton awarded the valley to Pennsylvania in 1782, fighting flared again two years later, and a compromise in 1799 closed the thirty-year quarrel. In 1808 Jesse Fell of Wilkes-Barre burned local anthracite in an iron grate, proving it worked as household fuel and opening the great coalfield beneath the flats.
zh:
在上特拉华河与萨斯奎哈纳河北支之间，横亘着林木覆盖的「无尽山脉」，群山之间夹着一道长长的河滩，蒙西人称之为怀俄明，意为「大河滩之地」，即怀俄明谷。蒙西人是特拉华人最北的一支，15世纪时今日威尔克斯-巴里对岸的滩地上就有他们的两座栅寨。他们在河漫滩种玉米，在河里捕鱼，在橡树与松树林覆盖的山梁上狩猎；山脉以南讲易洛魁语的萨斯奎哈纳人既是对手，也是偶尔往来的贸易伙伴。1444年，米尼辛克小路和萨斯奎哈纳河上都还没有欧洲货，这片高地完全是蒙西人的土地。

滩地的丧失始于东方的一场骗局：1737年的「步行购地」中，宾州当局声称购得一个人步行一天半所能走到的全部土地，把界线划得远超特拉华人的理解。五年后，奥农达加演说家卡纳萨特戈勒令特拉华河畔的特拉华人迁往怀俄明河滩；肖尼人早在一代人之前已落脚于此，南蒂科克人也很快随之而来。替流离失所的各部出头的特拉华首领蒂迪尤斯康，在英法北美战争中率部袭扰边疆，又在伊斯顿谈判中为族人申辩，最后被人趁夜放火烧死在棚屋里。摩拉维亚传教士大卫·蔡斯伯格等人也在那些年到谷地传教。

一家康涅狄格公司凭一份来路可疑的易洛魁地契，从1769年起大举向谷地移民；公司的「扬基」和宾州的「宾州仔」连年互相围攻堡垒，史称宾州仔与扬基之战。独立战争又把谷地变成战场：1778年7月3日，约翰·巴特勒的效忠派游骑兵会同塞内卡战士击溃谷地民兵，约三百人战死，是为怀俄明之战；数百户人家翻波科诺山而逃，史称「大逃亡」。次年，沙利文远征军在滩上集结，北上征讨豪德诺索尼。1782年，大陆会议在特伦顿的仲裁庭把谷地判给宾州；两年后战火又起，直到1799年宾州以妥协法案结束了这场三十年的争执。1808年，威尔克斯-巴里的杰西·费尔在铁炉箅上试烧本地无烟煤成功，证明它可以作家用燃料，滩地下方大煤田的开采随之开启。

en:
Garoowe lies in the wide Nugaal valley, where the seasonal Nugaal river runs east and ends at the old harbour of Eyl on the Indian Ocean. The valley is open grazing country: Darod Somali clans, the Marehan among them, watered camels and flocks at its wells, and routes from the Bari highlands, Mudug and the farther interior met at those same wells. Boats out of Eyl carried the valley's hides, livestock and dried fish up and down the coast. In 1444 Sunni Muslim clansmen pastured their herds and traded along these routes.

In later centuries the Nugaal valley fell within the Majeerteen sultanate ruled from Aluula, and by the nineteenth century it belonged to that kingdom. Garoowe itself stayed a well station and a market for the surrounding grazing grounds, and no town stood on the site before colonial times.
zh:
加罗韦地处宽阔的努加尔河谷，季节性的努加尔河向东流，在印度洋畔的古老港口埃伊尔入海。河谷是开阔的牧地：马雷汉等达鲁德系索马里氏族在井边给骆驼和羊群饮水，巴里高地、穆杜格和更远内陆的商路也在这些井边汇合。埃伊尔的船只把河谷的兽皮、牲畜和鱼干沿海岸南北贩运。1444年，逊尼派穆斯林氏族在这片牧地放牧，沿这些商路交易。

后来的几个世纪里，努加尔河谷归入以阿卢拉为中心的马吉尔廷苏丹国治下，19世纪时已属于这个王国。加罗韦本身始终只是周围牧地中的一处水井驿站和集市，殖民时代到来之前，当地并没有城镇。

en:
South Georgia is a rugged, mountainous island in the cold South Atlantic, about 1,400 kilometres east of the Falklands. A central ridge runs its length and rises to Mount Paget; glaciers fill the high valleys, while deep bays cut into the northern coast. The island had no indigenous inhabitants. In 1444 its beaches belonged to elephant seals, fur seals and seabirds, and European ships had not yet found a regular use for its harbours.

Its first appearance on European charts is disputed. The London merchant Anthony de la Roché may have sighted it in 1675, and early maps used the name Roche Island; Spanish accounts give the sighting to Gregorio Jerez in the merchant ship León on St Peter's Day in 1756, when it was called Isla San Pedro. James Cook made the first reliable landing in HMS Resolution on 17 January 1775, then surveyed and mapped the coast, claimed the island for George III and named it the Isle of Georgia. British and North American sealers began working the beaches in 1786. They came for fur-seal skins and elephant-seal oil and occupied temporary seasonal camps, but no company maintained a permanent station there. In 1821 South Georgia still had no permanent inhabitants.
zh:
南乔治亚是寒冷南大西洋上一座崎岖多山的岛屿，位于福克兰群岛以东约1400公里。中央山脊纵贯全岛，最高处为佩吉特山；冰川填在高山谷地中，北海岸被深湾切开。岛上没有原住民。1444年，海滩属于象海豹、海狗和海鸟，欧洲船只也尚未为这里的港湾找到固定用途。

它最早如何出现在欧洲海图上，说法并不一致。伦敦商人安东尼·德拉罗什可能在1675年望见此岛，早期地图把它标作罗奇岛；西班牙记载则把这次望见归于1756年圣彼得日驾驶商船「莱昂号」的格雷戈里奥·赫雷斯，岛名因此作圣佩德罗岛。1775年1月17日，詹姆斯·库克率「决心号」完成首次可靠登陆，随后测绘并绘制海岸，以乔治三世之名宣布占有，将岛屿命名为乔治亚岛。1786年起，英国和北美海豹捕猎者开始在海滩作业，收取海狗皮和象海豹油，只设立季节性临时营地，没有公司维持常驻站点。到1821年，南乔治亚仍没有常住居民。

en:
Thanjavur stands in the green Kaveri delta, the rice granary of the Tamil country. The imperial Cholas made it their capital from the ninth century, and around 1010 Rajaraja I raised the Brihadisvara temple in its heart: its granite tower rises over the city's weavers, merchants and brahman settlements, and a Nandi bull cut from a single block of granite lies before the shrine. Pandya armies took the city in 1279, and Malik Kafur's raids early in the fourteenth century opened it first to the Delhi sultans and then to the short-lived Ma'bar rulers. Vijayanagara's generals absorbed the delta from the 1360s, and an inscription of Deva Raya II dated 1443 shows that in 1444 Thanjavur was a provincial seat of the empire under a nayak governor, its looms and the delta's rice harvests filling its markets.

In 1532 the viceroy Sevappa Nayak made his office hereditary and founded the Thanjavur Nayak line, whose kings kept endowing temples and Telugu and Tamil poetry even after the Vijayanagara army went down at Talikota in 1565. In 1673 Chokkanatha Nayak of Madurai seized the city, but Ekoji, a Maratha feudatory of Bijapur and half-brother of Shivaji, took it the next year and founded a Maratha dynasty. Under his house Thanjavur became a centre of Carnatic music and home of the gilded, painted panels later called Tanjore painting. The Maratha rajas held their own against the nawab of Arcot and the European companies on the coast until 1799, when the British restored Serfoji II to the throne but took the kingdom's administration, leaving the raja his fort and court. Serfoji filled that court with scholars and pursued his own studies in European medicine, in particular ophthalmology.
zh:
坦焦尔（坦贾武尔）地处肥沃的高韦里河三角洲，是泰米尔之乡的米仓。9世纪起，称霸南印的朱罗王朝以此为都；约1010年，罗茶罗乍一世在城中心修建布里哈迪希瓦拉神庙，花岗岩高塔俯瞰着织工、商人和婆罗门的聚落，神殿前还卧着一整块花岗岩雕出的神牛南迪。1279年潘地亚军队攻取此城，14世纪初马利克·卡富尔的劫掠又使它先后落入德里苏丹国和短命的马巴尔苏丹之手。14世纪60年代起，毗奢耶那伽罗的将领们逐步吞并三角洲；一块镌于1443年的德瓦·拉亚二世铭文表明，1444年的坦焦尔是帝国一处由纳亚克总督治理的行省重镇，织机和三角洲稻米充实着城中市集。

1532年，地方长官塞瓦帕·纳亚克将权位转为世袭，建立坦焦尔纳亚克王朝；即便1565年毗奢耶那伽罗大军在塔利哥达战败，他的继承者仍继续统治，广修寺庙、庇护泰卢固语与泰米尔语诗歌。1673年，马杜赖的乔卡纳塔·纳亚克夺取此城，但为比贾普尔苏丹效力的马拉塔将领、希瓦吉的异母弟埃科吉次年便攻占坦焦尔，建立马拉塔王朝。在其家族治下，坦焦尔成为卡纳提克音乐的中心，也产生了描金敷彩、后世称作「坦焦尔画」的绘画风格。马拉塔罗阇们在阿尔科特纳瓦布与海岸上的欧洲公司之间周旋求存，直到1799年英国人扶立塞尔福吉二世复位，却把王国行政收归己手，只给罗阇留下城堡与宫廷；塞尔福吉在这座宫廷里庇护学者，自己也研习欧洲医学、尤其是眼科。

en:
Arcot, the Tamil Arkad or 'fig forest', lies on the southern bank of the Palar, where the road from the Coromandel coast climbs through a gap in the Javadi hills towards Mysore. In 1444 it was a fortified town of the Vijayanagara Empire, holding the pass and gathering the grain and iron of the Palar valley for merchants on the coastal plain. An imperial garrison kept the town for another two centuries.

When Vijayanagara collapsed, Golconda and Bijapur divided the Carnatic between them in the 1640s. In 1692 Aurangzeb made Arcot the seat of Zulfiqar Khan, his first subahdar of the Carnatic, a reward for his victory over the Marathas led by Rajaram; and when Saadatullah Khan moved his court from Gingee, the town became the capital of the nawabs of the Carnatic. In 1740 the Marathas poured through the Damalcherry pass, killed Nawab Dost Ali Khan and took Arcot almost without a fight. A disputed succession drew in the European companies: in 1751 Robert Clive marched from Madras with a small force, seized the town for Muhammad Ali Wallajah and held its fort for fifty-three days against the French-backed army of Chanda Sahib. Wallajah's long reign left the nawabate deep in debt to the East India Company, which took over the Carnatic outright in 1801, leaving the nawabs a pension and their title.
zh:
阿尔果德，泰米尔语称「阿尔卡德」，意为榕树林，坐落在帕拉尔河南岸，科罗曼德海岸通向迈索尔的道路在此穿过贾瓦迪丘陵的山口。1444年，它是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的要塞城镇，扼守隘口，把帕拉尔河谷的粮食和铁料汇集到沿海平原的商人手中。帝国驻军在此又守了两百年。

毗奢耶那伽罗崩溃后，高康达与比贾布尔在1640年代瓜分了卡纳提克。1692年，奥朗则布把阿尔果德设为祖勒菲卡尔汗的驻节地，他是首任卡纳提克总督，这一任命是犒赏其战胜拉贾拉姆所率马拉塔人的战功；萨阿达图拉汗把宫廷从京吉迁来后，此城便成为卡纳提克纳瓦布的都城。1740年，马拉塔人冲过达马尔切里山口，纳瓦布多斯特·阿里汗战死，阿尔果德几乎不战而降。随后的继承之争把欧洲商馆卷了进来：1751年，罗伯特·克莱武率一支小队伍从马德拉斯出发，替穆罕默德·阿里·瓦拉贾拿下此城，又据守要塞五十三天，顶住钱达·萨希布那支由法国撑腰的军队。瓦拉贾的长期统治使纳瓦布政权债台高筑，1801年东印度公司直接兼并卡纳提克，只给纳瓦布留下年金和名号。

en:
Mahur lies on wooded ridges above the Penganga, where the Marathwada uplands look into Berar and the Gond country. Its three hills are a Hindu pilgrimage ground: the Renuka temple is counted among Maharashtra's three and a half Shakti pithas, the hills are also named as the birthplace of the god Dattatreya, and a great fair gathers there every year at Vijayadashami. Below the temples stands Mahur Fort, a large hill stronghold attributed to the Gond king Khandkya Ballal Shah. The Bahmanis took the place in 1358, lost it to a Gond raja in 1398, and Ahmad Shah reconquered it in 1428. In 1444 Mahur is a newly subdued northern march of the Bahmani sultanate, its forests yielding timber and its fort watching the roads into Berar.

After the Bahmani breakup Mahur passed to the Imad Shahi sultans of Berar, then to Ahmadnagar in 1527, and to the Mughals in 1617, who granted the district as a jagir. Its best-known holder was Savitribai Deshmukh, widow of the Mughal commander Udaram: she took up her late husband's sword and his lands around Mahur, put down a rebel chief for Aurangzeb, and earned the title Rai Bagan, 'royal tigress', for her part in the succession war of 1658. Tradition adds that she rode with Kartalab Khan's army against Shivaji at Umberkhind, called Shivaji a lion, and pressed her commander to surrender to him. Shivaji's Marathas took Mahur in 1670; Mughal rule returned after 1689, and in 1724 the district passed to the Nizam of Hyderabad.
zh:
马胡尔位于彭甘加河上方林木覆盖的山脊上，从马拉特瓦达高地可望向贝拉尔和冈德人的土地。这里的三座山丘是印度教朝圣之地：雷努卡神庙被列为马哈拉施特拉的三个半萨克蒂座之一，这片山丘也被认为是神祇达塔特雷亚的诞生地，每年十胜节都有盛大庙会。神庙下方是马胡尔堡，这座庞大的山寨相传为冈德国王坎德克亚·巴拉尔·沙阿所建。巴赫曼尼王朝1358年攻取此地，1398年被一位冈德罗阇夺回，1428年艾哈迈德沙阿再度征服。1444年，马胡尔是巴赫曼尼苏丹国新近降服的北部边镇，山林出产木材，要塞监视着通往贝拉尔的道路。

巴赫曼尼解体后，马胡尔先归贝拉尔的伊马德沙阿苏丹，1527年转归艾哈迈德讷格尔，1617年落入莫卧儿之手，后者把这一地区封作札吉尔。最有名的札吉达尔是莫卧儿将领乌达拉姆的遗孀萨维特里拜·德什穆赫：她接过亡夫的刀和马胡尔一带的封地，替奥朗则布平定一名反叛首领，因1658年继承战争中的战功获封「拉伊·巴甘」，意为「王家母虎」。相传她还随卡尔塔拉布汗的军队在翁巴尔欣德之战对阵希瓦吉，她称希瓦吉为雄狮，并力劝主将向希瓦吉投降。1670年，希瓦吉的马拉塔军队取得马胡尔；1689年后莫卧儿统治恢复，1724年这一地区归入海得拉巴尼扎姆治下。

en:
South Kanara is the southern half of Tulu Nadu, a rainy strip between the Arabian Sea and the Western Ghats, where the Netravati and Gurupura pour into the broad Mangalore estuary. The town takes its name from the Mangaladevi temple, raised over a Malabar princess who, legend says, became a disciple of the Nath saint Matsyendranath. Greek sailors knew the coast as pepper country: Pliny warned of pirates off the river mouth, and the monk Cosmas in the sixth century counted Mangarouth among the five pepper ports of Malabar. Rice, areca, pepper and Ghats timber have moved through its roadstead ever since. The Alupa chiefs ruled as feudatories in turn of the Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas and Hoysalas until Vijayanagara took over in 1345; Ibn Battuta, landing three years earlier, found Manjarur among the busiest estuaries of the coast. In 1444 the country, split into the Mangalore and Barkur provinces, answers to Vijayanagara, its Tulu-speaking chiefs and Muslim merchants, whose Zeenath Baksh mosque local tradition counts among the oldest in India, shipping pepper and timber to Arabia.

Vasco da Gama landed on the St Mary's Islands off the coast in 1498, and eight years later Varthema counted nearly sixty rice ships waiting in the roads. In 1526 the viceroy Lopo Vaz de Sampaio seized Mangalore for Portugal, putting the coastal carrying trade under its guns. Vijayanagara had already entrusted the coast to Sadashiv Nayaka of Keladi, who made his authority good by 1554; after the empire fell at Talikota in 1565 the Keladi Nayakas ruled from Bednore and kept the old Mangalore and Barkur provinces. In 1695 Arab ships burned the town in reprisal for Portuguese controls on their trade.

Hyder Ali of Mysore conquered South Canara in 1763, lost it to the East India Company, and his son Tipu Sultan retook it in 1783 and called the town Jalalabad. On 11 March 1784 Tipu and the Company signed the Treaty of Mangalore here, each side handing back its conquests, and the Second Anglo-Mysore War ended in the town named on the treaty. When Tipu fell in 1799 the port passed to the Company, and Buchanan in 1801 found its rice sailing to Muscat, Goa and Bombay, with areca, pepper and sandalwood stowed after it.
zh:
南卡纳达是图卢纳德的南半，一条多雨的海岸夹在阿拉伯海与西高止山之间，内德拉瓦蒂河与古鲁普拉河在门格洛尔的宽阔河口入海。城镇得名于门格劳拉黛维神庙，相传庙里供奉的是一位马拉巴尔公主，她出家做了纳特派圣者马特斯延德拉纳特的弟子，死后人们为她立庙。希腊水手早把这一带当作胡椒之乡：老普林尼警告河口外海盗出没，6世纪修士科斯马斯把门格劳特列为马拉巴尔五大胡椒港之一。此后大米、槟榔、胡椒和高止山木材一直经此外港转运。阿卢帕酋长先后作为遮娄其、罗湿陀罗拘陀和曷萨拉的藩属统治此地，1345年并入毗奢耶那伽罗；伊本·白图泰早三年登岸时，已见曼贾鲁尔是沿岸最繁忙的河口之一。1444年，此地分设门格洛尔与巴尔库尔两行省，奉毗奢耶那伽罗为主；说图卢语的酋长和穆斯林商人经营港务，当地传统把他们的济纳特·巴赫什清真寺算作印度最古老的清真寺之一，胡椒和木材在这里装船运往阿拉伯。

1498年，瓦斯科·达·伽马在近海的圣玛丽群岛登岸；八年后瓦尔泰马在此点到近六十艘满载大米、待命出海的船只。1526年，葡属印度总督洛波·瓦斯·德·桑帕约为葡萄牙夺下门格洛尔，沿海航运落入其炮火控制。毗奢耶那伽罗此前已把海岸托付给凯拉迪的萨达希夫·纳亚卡，他到1554年已立稳脚跟；1565年帝国在塔利戈塔败亡后，凯拉迪纳亚卡家族从贝德努尔发号施令，保留门格洛尔和巴尔库尔旧行省。1695年，阿拉伯船队焚毁城镇，报复葡萄牙人对其贸易的管制。

1763年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里征服南卡纳达，后来港口落入东印度公司之手；其子提普苏丹1783年将其收复，把城镇改名贾拉拉巴德。1784年3月11日，提普与公司在此签订《门格洛尔条约》，双方互相交还攻占之地，第二次英国—迈索尔战争随之结束。1799年提普败亡，港口归公司所有；1801年布坎南到此，见大米运往马斯喀特、果阿和孟买，舱里还压着槟榔、胡椒和檀香木。

en:
Goa is the island-studded mouth of the Mandovi and Zuari rivers, where the Western Ghats drop to the Arabian Sea and the spice-growing Malabar coast meets the harbours of the Konkan. The Kadamba kings kept their port of Govapuri there before the armies of Delhi and then Vijayanagara took the islands. In 1444 Goa was a busy Vijayanagara harbour, its wharves landing Arab horses for the imperial cavalry and loading pepper and cardamom gathered in the Ghat forests. Mosques stood beside Jain and Hindu temples in a port long used to Arab, Persian and Gujarati merchants.

The Bahmani sultan's armies seized Goa in 1469, and after that sultanate broke up the Adil Shahis of Bijapur walled a new city on the Mandovi as their second capital. Timoji, a Goan privateer who had fled the Adil Shahi conquest as a boy, brought Afonso de Albuquerque to the city in 1510; the Portuguese took it, lost it within months, and retook it on 25 November, and Timoji was briefly made its chief magistrate. Goa became the capital of the Portuguese East, an archbishop's see and a port said to rival Lisbon. Francis Xavier preached there and lies buried in the Bom Jesus basilica, and a Jesuit press at Saint Paul's College printed the first books made in India in 1556. The Inquisition, set up in 1560, tried New Christians and anyone keeping Hindu or Muslim rites and burned books in Konkani and Sanskrit. Dutch blockades, Maratha raids and epidemics emptied the old city during the seventeenth century, the viceroy withdrew to Panjim, and a conspiracy of Goan priests and nobles against racial privilege was betrayed and crushed in 1787; when the Inquisition was abolished in 1812, the eastern capital had shrunk to a few great churches among ruins.
zh:
果阿是曼多维河与祖阿里河河口的群岛地带，西高止山在此俯临阿拉伯海，盛产香料的马拉巴尔海岸也在此接上孔坎诸港。卡丹巴王朝曾以这里的戈瓦普里为港，此后先后落入德里苏丹和毗奢耶那伽罗之手。1444年的果阿是毗奢耶那伽罗一座繁忙的海港：码头上卸下供帝国骑兵使用的阿拉伯马，再把西高止山林出产的胡椒、豆蔻装船外运；阿拉伯、波斯和古吉拉特商人往来已久，清真寺与耆那教、印度教寺院比邻而立。

1469年，巴赫曼尼苏丹的军队夺取果阿；苏丹国瓦解后，比贾布尔的阿迪尔沙王朝在曼多维河畔筑起城墙环绕的新城，作为第二都城。果阿私掠船长提莫吉童年时在阿迪尔沙征服中出逃，1510年把阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克带到这座城市；葡萄牙人攻下城后不出数月又失守，同年11月25日再度攻克，提莫吉一度被任命为城市治安长官。果阿此后成为葡属东方的首府、大主教驻节之地，富庶据说不输里斯本。方济各·沙勿略曾在此传教，遗体安葬在仁慈耶稣大殿；1556年，耶稣会在圣保罗学院印出印度最早的书籍。1560年设立的宗教裁判所审判新基督教徒和任何仍守印度教、伊斯兰教仪轨的人，还焚毁孔卡尼语和梵文书籍。荷兰人的封锁、马拉塔人的袭击和瘟疫使旧城在17世纪人口流散，总督迁往帕纳吉，1787年果阿教士与贵族反抗种族特权的密谋又被出卖并镇压；1812年宗教裁判所废除时，这座东方名城只剩几座宏伟教堂立于废墟之间。

en:
Morasanadu is the old Morasu Nadu, the high plateau east of the Mysore country and homeland of the Morasu Vokkaliga, a community of peasant warriors, watered by the Arkavati. A hero stone found at Begur names the village of Bengaluru in an inscription of 890; a later, apocryphal tale reads the name as bendakaal-uru, the 'town of boiled beans' served to a lost Hoysala king. Vijayanagara court records knew the same place as Devarayanagara. In 1444 this is Vijayanagara territory, governed from Yelahanka by hereditary nadaprabhus, its pastures and tanks lying beside the road between the imperial city and the Tamil lowlands.

In 1537 the Yelahanka chief Kempe Gowda I built a mud fort at Bengaluru, called the new town his Gandubhumi, or 'land of heroes', and laid out two long market streets, the petes, crossing at its centre, with tanks to water it; his successor Kempe Gowda II raised four watchtowers to mark its bounds. After Talikota the chiefs ruled without a suzerain until 1638, when a Bijapuri army under Ranadulla Khan and Shahaji Bhonsle, father of Shivaji, defeated Kempe Gowda III and made the town Shahaji's jagir, rebuilding its fortifications and reservoirs the next year. In 1687 the Mughal general Kasim Khan, acting for Aurangzeb, drove out Shahaji's son Ekoji and leased the district to Chikka Devaraja Wodeyar of Mysore. Hyder Ali took it over in 1759, added the Delhi and Mysore gates and laid out the Lal Bagh, but on 21 March 1791 Lord Cornwallis stormed the fort in the Third Anglo-Mysore War. Restored to the Wadiyars after Tipu's fall, the town received a British cantonment at nearby Ulsoor in 1809.
zh:
米罗桑达即旧籍中的莫拉萨纳德，是迈索尔以东的高原台地，农耕武士族群莫拉萨沃卡利加人的家乡，阿尔卡瓦蒂河滋养着这里的牧场和水塘。贝古尔出土的英雄石在890年的铭文中已提到本加卢鲁这个村名；还有一则晚出的传说把城名解作「煮豆城」，说曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉二世打猎迷路，吃了一位穷苦老妇人端上的煮豆，便以此赐名。毗奢耶那伽罗的宫廷文献则把同一处地方称作德瓦拉亚纳加拉。1444年，此地属毗奢耶那伽罗，由耶拉汉卡的世袭纳德帕布治理，牧场和水塘间的大道连接帝都与泰米尔平原。

1537年，耶拉汉卡长官肯佩·高达一世在本加卢鲁筑起土堡，把新城称作自己的「甘杜布米」，意为「英雄之地」，又在城心铺下两条十字相交的长市场街（佩泰），凿塘供水；继任者肯佩·高达二世立下四座瞭望塔，标明城界。塔利科塔之战后，肯佩家族一度不受王命，直到1638年拉纳杜拉汗与沙吉·邦斯勒（希瓦吉之父）率比贾布尔军队击败肯佩·高达三世，本加卢鲁成为沙吉的封地，次年他重修城防、新筑水塘。1687年，莫卧儿将领卡西姆汗奉奥朗则布之命逐走沙吉之子埃科吉，把这片地方租给迈索尔的奇卡·德瓦拉贾·瓦迪亚。海德尔·阿里1759年接掌此地，增修德里门与迈索尔门，辟建拉尔巴格园林；1791年3月21日第三次英迈战争中，康沃利斯督军攻破城堡。蒂普败亡后地方复归瓦迪亚家族，1809年英军在附近的乌尔苏尔设了兵营。

en:
Malenadu is the rainy spine of the Western Ghats between the Kanara coast and the Deccan: steep forested ridges, scattered villages and some of the heaviest rainfall in India. Along the headwaters of the Tungabhadra its woods yield pepper, cardamom, areca and teak, all carried down to the ports of Kanara. At its western foot lies Ikkeri, 'two streets' in Kannada, a small town below the Sahyadris. In 1444 the hill-chiefs of Malenadu hold their forests as vassals of Vijayanagara; the Keladi line that will turn Ikkeri into a royal capital has yet to rise.

The Nayakas of Keladi ruled these ridges from 1499, at first as Vijayanagara's feudatories and, after the empire went down at Talikota in 1565, as an independent power whose lands ran from the Tungabhadra to the sea. They built the Aghoreshvara temple at Ikkeri, their first capital, and later moved the court to the fortress-town of Bidanur. Shivappa Nayaka, who reigned from 1645 to 1660, was remembered as Sistina Shivappa for the land-tax settlement called the sist, and in 1653 he sent his general Timmanna Nayaka against the Portuguese and took Mangalore, Barkur, Basrur and Honnavar. Around 1670 the Sufi Baba Budan planted seven coffee beans brought from Mocha on the Chandradrona hills, and India's first coffee gardens grew on the Malnad slopes. Queen Chennamma, ruling from 1672, sheltered the fugitive Maratha king Rajaram and held off Aurangzeb's armies until a treaty in 1690 confirmed Keladi's autonomy; the Mughals never entered these forests as masters.

In 1763 Hyder Ali of Mysore stormed Bidanur, the last Keladi capital, and renamed it Hydernagar. A British force under General Matthews took the fort in 1783, but Tipu Sultan invested it, accepted its surrender on a promise of safe conduct to the coast, and then put Matthews and his chief officers to death. Tipu kept the Malnad until his own fall in 1799.
zh:
马伦达是西高止山多雨的山脊，夹在卡纳达海岸与德干高原之间，山岭陡峭、森林密布、村落分散，年降雨量居印度前列。栋格珀德拉河源流穿行山间，林中出产胡椒、豆蔻、槟榔和柚木，都运下卡纳达各港出海。山脊西麓坐落着伊凯里，卡纳达语意为「两条街」，是萨希亚德里山下的小镇。1444年，马伦达的山地酋长作为毗奢耶那伽罗的藩属据守山林；后来把伊凯里变成王都的凯拉迪家族此时还没兴起。

凯拉迪纳亚卡家族从1499年起统治这片山脊，初为毗奢耶那伽罗藩臣，1565年帝国在塔利戈塔败亡后独立，疆域从栋格珀德拉河一直伸到海边。他们在第一个都城伊凯里建起阿戈雷什瓦尔神庙，后来又把宫廷迁到堡垒城镇比达努尔。希瓦帕·纳亚卡1645至1660年在位，因一套叫「锡斯特」的地税清丈得名「锡斯特的希瓦帕」；1653年他派大将蒂曼纳·纳亚卡进攻葡萄牙人，连克门格洛尔、巴尔库尔、巴斯鲁尔和洪纳瓦尔四港。约1670年，苏菲行者巴巴·布登把从穆哈带回的七粒咖啡豆种在钱德拉德罗纳山坡，印度第一批咖啡园就长在马伦达的坡地上。琴纳玛女王1672年即位，收留逃亡的马拉塔国王拉贾拉姆，顶住奥朗则布的大军，1690年的条约确认凯拉迪自治；莫卧儿人始终没能以主人的身份踏进这片森林。

1763年，迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻陷凯拉迪末代都城比达努尔，改名海德尔讷格尔。1783年马修斯将军率英军夺堡，提普苏丹随即围城，受降时答应放守军安全撤往海岸，转头却把马修斯和主要军官处死。提普占有马伦达，直到1799年自己败亡。

en:
The Dharwad country sits on the line where the wet Malenadu forests of the Western Ghats give way to the open Deccan plains, and its name, from the Sanskrit dwarawata, means a gateway town where travellers rest before the hills. Dharwad's fort commanded the hill road, while the older settlement of Rayara Hubli served the cotton country below; local tradition attributes the fort to the Vijayanagara officer Dharav in 1403. Under the Rayas, Hubli dealt in cotton, saltpetre and iron. In 1444 the province was a heavily garrisoned Bahmani-Vijayanagara frontier: Kannada Hindu farmers and merchants lived around Hubli and Muslim troops held the strongest forts.

The Adil Shah of Bijapur stormed Dharwad in 1573 and raised a second fort of his own, Manna Killa, and the stronghold then drew a long line of besiegers. At Hubli the English opened a factory under Bijapuri rule, and Shivaji's horsemen sacked it in 1673. Aurangzeb took Dharwad in 1685, and Hubli passed to the Afghan Nawabs of Savanur, a family risen in Bijapuri and Mughal service; their town is also known for its ancient baobab trees, the Dodda Hunise Mara. In 1727 the merchant Basappa Shettar laid out New Hubli with its own fort. The nawabs gave endowments to Hindu temples and maths and kept their small state alive between the Marathas and Mysore, though Hyder Ali and later Tipu Sultan both marched on Savanur, and Hyder Ali took Dharwad fort in 1778 before the Marathas retook it. South of the province the Keladi Nayakas, independent after Talikota, held out until Mysore annexed them. The East India Company took the country in 1818.
zh:
达尔瓦德一带正处在西高止山湿润的马来纳德森林与德干平原的交界上，其名来自梵语 dwarawata，意为翻山前供旅人歇脚的门户城镇。达尔瓦德堡控扼山路，更古老的聚落拉亚拉·胡布利经营着山下的棉乡；当地传统把城堡的修筑归于1403年的毗奢耶那伽罗官员达拉夫。在拉亚们治下，胡布利买卖棉花、硝石和铁。1444年，这里是重兵驻守的巴赫曼尼与毗奢耶那伽罗边境：胡布利周围住着说卡纳达语的印度教农民和商人，最坚固的几座堡垒由穆斯林军队把守。

1573年，比贾布尔的阿迪勒沙攻破达尔瓦德，又另筑了自己的曼纳基拉堡，这座要塞此后招来一长串围攻者。比贾布尔治下，英国人在胡布利开设商馆，1673年被希瓦吉的骑兵洗劫。1685年奥朗则布攻取达尔瓦德，胡布利转归萨瓦努尔的阿富汗裔纳瓦布；这一家族在比贾布尔和莫卧儿军中发迹，其城镇还以古老的猴面包树闻名，当地称多达·胡尼塞·马拉。1727年，商人巴萨帕·谢塔尔建起带堡垒的新胡布利。纳瓦布们向印度教神庙和教团施赠，在马拉塔与迈索尔之间维持着小邦：海德尔·阿里和后来的蒂普苏丹都曾进兵萨瓦努尔，海德尔·阿里1778年拿下达尔瓦德堡，其后又被马拉塔人收复。省区南部的凯拉迪纳亚卡首领自塔利科塔后自立，直到被迈索尔吞并。1818年，东印度公司取得这一地区。

en:
Pune lies on the Mutha river in the northern Desh, where a black-soil basin sent grain to the forts and camps of the western Deccan. Ninth-century copper plates record an agricultural settlement called Punnaka, and the Pataleshwar cave temple was cut into the local rock in the same period. After Yadava rule from Devagiri ended in 1327, Muslim governors of the Deccan held the kasbah. In 1444 Bahmani officials governed its Marathi-speaking farmers, traders and weavers; the small town mattered because its grain reached northern Deccan garrisons.

In 1599 Ahmadnagar enfeoffed Pune to Maloji Bhosle, and the fief passed to his son Shahaji. Adil Shahi troops destroyed the town in 1636, but Shahaji recovered it after entering Bijapur service and settled his wife Jijabai and the young Shivaji at Lal Mahal, completed in 1640. Shivaji grew up there, and Jijabai's Kasba Ganapati became the town's presiding shrine. Years later, when Shaista Khan occupied Pune, Shivaji led a night raid on the Mughal general's quarters in the same palace; Shaista Khan escaped through a first-floor window and lost four fingers. Maratha forces retook Pune in 1670, and Aurangzeb occupied it for two years early in the eighteenth century and renamed it Muhiyabad. In 1728 the Peshwa Baji Rao I moved his base from Saswad to Pune and raised Shaniwar Wada on the Mutha, completed in 1732. Under Balaji Bajirao, Parvati Hill temples, the Katraj lake and aqueduct, new market wards and about two hundred and fifty temples and bridges gave the town the form of a capital. In 1802 Yashwantrao Holkar routed the Peshwa at the Battle of Poona, drawing the East India Company into the next Maratha war. The Peshwa's army broke at Khadki in 1817, the British occupied Pune, and Peshwa rule ended in 1818.
zh:
浦那位于德什北部的穆塔河畔，黑土盆地出产的谷物供应西德干的堡垒和兵营。9世纪的铜牌提到一个叫普纳卡的农业聚落，帕塔莱什瓦尔石窟神庙也在同期凿岩而建。1327年德瓦吉里的亚达瓦统治结束后，这座集镇落入德干穆斯林统治者手中。1444年，巴赫曼尼官员管理着这里说马拉地语的农夫、商人和织工；城镇虽小，出产的谷物却能运往北方的德干驻军处。

1599年，艾哈迈德讷格尔把浦那封给马洛基·邦斯莱，封地后来传给儿子沙吉。1636年阿迪勒·沙阿的军队摧毁城镇，但沙吉转投比贾布尔后收复封地，把妻子吉贾拜和年幼的希瓦吉安置在拉尔玛哈尔，宫殿于1640年落成。希瓦吉在此长大，吉贾拜供奉的卡斯巴·甘尼许成为城镇保护神。后来沙伊斯塔汗占据浦那时，希瓦吉夜袭这位莫卧儿将领在同一座宫殿中的住所；沙伊斯塔汗从一楼窗户逃走，被砍去四根手指。1670年，马拉塔军队夺回浦那；18世纪初奥朗则布又占据此地两年，并改名穆希阿巴德。1728年，佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥一世把驻地从萨斯瓦德迁到浦那，在穆塔河畔修建沙尼瓦尔瓦达，1732年完工。巴拉吉·巴吉拉奥时期，帕尔瓦蒂山神庙、卡特拉吉湖和引水渠、新的市集街区以及约两百五十座神庙和桥梁陆续建成，使城镇具备都城面貌。1802年，雅什万特·拉奥·霍尔卡在浦那战役击溃佩什瓦，把英国东印度公司卷入下一场马拉塔战争。1817年佩什瓦军队在卡德基溃败，英军占领浦那，佩什瓦统治于1818年结束。

en:
Gulbarga, the old Kalburgi or 'rocky land' of Kannada inscriptions, sits on a grain-growing plain in the northern Deccan. Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah made the town his first capital in 1347, renaming it Hasanabad, and for about eighty years its fort held the court of the new Bahmani sultanate. Ahmad Shah I moved that court to Bidar in the 1420s. In 1444 Gulbarga was a former royal capital with a strong fort, domed royal tombs and one of the Deccan's principal Sufi shrines; around it lay Kannada-speaking Hindu villages governed by Muslim officers.

The Friday Mosque inside the fort was commissioned by Muhammad Shah I in 1367. The Persian builder Rafi gave its courtyard a continuous roof of domes, following the manner of the Great Mosque of Córdoba, and it ranks among the earliest Friday mosques in South India. East of the town stand the Haft Gumbaz tombs of the early sultans. Gisu Daraz, the Chishti scholar better known as Bande Nawaz, had left Delhi after Timur's campaign and settled here at the invitation of Firuz Shah; when he died in 1422, his tomb became a major place of pilgrimage.

Armies kept returning to the old capital. Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara stormed Gulbarga in 1512, drove out the Bahmani minister Barid-i-Mamalik and then restored the puppet sultan as a client. When the Bahmani kingdom was dissolved in 1527, the district was divided between Bidar and Bijapur; Ibrahim Adil Shah II annexed Bidar to Bijapur in 1619. After Bijapur fell in 1686, Aurangzeb's conquest brought Gulbarga to the Mughals, and in the 1710s Nizam-ul-Mulk, later Asaf Jah I, incorporated it into his nearly independent Hyderabad realm.
zh:
古尔伯加在古卡纳达碑铭中称卡尔布尔吉，意为「石地」，坐落在德干北部一片产粮平原上。1347年，阿拉—乌德—丁·巴曼沙把这里定为最初的都城，改名哈萨纳巴德；此后约八十年间，新建的巴赫曼尼苏丹国宫廷一直设在城中堡垒。1420年代，艾哈迈德沙一世把宫廷迁往比达尔。1444年的古尔伯加已不是都城，却仍保有坚固堡垒、穹顶王陵和德干最重要的苏非圣陵之一；城周是讲卡纳达语的印度教村落，由穆斯林官员治理。

堡内的聚礼清真寺由穆罕默德沙一世在1367年下令修建。波斯匠师拉菲以连绵穹顶覆盖庭院，形制仿效科尔多瓦大清真寺，使它成为南印度最早的聚礼清真寺之一。城东分布着安葬早期苏丹的七穹顶陵墓群。契斯提教学者吉苏·达拉兹（更常见的称号是班德·纳瓦兹）在帖木儿攻占德里后离开北方，应菲鲁兹沙之邀定居此地；他于1422年去世，陵墓后来成为重要的朝圣地点。

军队仍一再回到这座旧都。1512年，毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚攻陷古尔伯加，赶走巴赫马尼权臣巴里德—伊·马马利克，随后又把傀儡苏丹扶回王位，作为自己的附庸。1527年巴赫曼尼王国解体，这一地区分属比达尔和比贾布尔；1619年，易卜拉欣·阿迪尔沙二世把比达尔并入比贾布尔。1686年比贾布尔陷落后，奥朗则布把古尔伯加纳入莫卧儿版图；1710年代，尼扎姆—穆勒克（后来的阿萨夫·贾赫一世）又将它并入几乎独立的海得拉巴国。

en:
Baglana is the hill country north of Nasik, where a line of forts above grain-growing valleys watches the trade road from Surat to Daulatabad, Burhanpur and Golkonda. Salher, at 1,567 metres the highest fort in the Sahyadris, and Mulher, the chiefs' seat called Mayuragiri in older records, guarded the passes every caravan had to cross. Its Rashtraudha rajas bore the title baharji, claimed Rathore descent from Kannauj and once coined their own money; by the late fourteenth century the little Hindu kingdom paid tribute to the sultans of Gujarat. In 1444 a Maratha-speaking raja still lived from the forts: his men escorted merchants between Gujarat and the northern Deccan and his valleys fed them.

Mughal armies besieged Pratap Shah for seven years and failed to force Mulher; the raja kept his forts by promising to guard every merchant who passed through, send regular presents and leave a son at Burhanpur as hostage. In 1638 the capital fort fell to an army led by Shah Jahan's young son Aurangzeb; the raja did not long outlive the conquest and his heir converted to Islam and entered Mughal service. Shivaji's columns came through the Baglana passes on the Surat raids, took Salher and Mulher, and in 1672 the Marathas routed a Mughal army on the open ground below Salher, their first victory in pitched battle against Mughal troops; the treasure carried off from Surat was stored at Salher. The Mughals recovered the forts with promises and gifts in 1684; they later passed to the Nizam and then to the Maratha Peshwa, until Mulher surrendered to the British on 3 July 1818.
zh:
巴格拉纳是纳西克以北的山地，盛产谷物的谷地之上堡寨连成一线，监视着从苏拉特通往道拉塔巴德、布尔汉布尔和戈尔孔达的商路。萨莱尔堡海拔1567米，是萨赫亚德里山脉最高的堡垒；穆勒赫尔堡是历代首领的驻地，旧籍写作马尤拉吉里，两座堡寨扼守商队必经的山口。这里的拉什特劳陀拉杰号称巴哈尔吉，自称是曲女城拉托尔人的后裔，过去还曾自铸钱币；到十四世纪末，这个印度教小邦已向古吉拉特的苏丹纳贡。1444年，一位说马拉地语的拉杰仍据堡自立，他的部众为往来古吉拉特与北德干的商人护送商队，谷地出产的粮食也卖给商队。

莫卧儿军队围攻普拉塔普沙阿七年，仍未能攻破穆勒赫尔；这位拉杰最终保住堡寨，条件是护卫所有过路商人、按时进献礼物，并把一个儿子留在布尔汉布尔为质。1638年，沙贾汗年幼的皇子奥朗则布率军攻破这座主城，亡国的拉杰不久死去，继承人改宗伊斯兰教，进入莫卧儿军中任职。希瓦吉的人马两度取道巴格拉纳的山口奔袭苏拉特，夺取萨莱尔和穆勒赫尔；1672年，马拉塔军队在萨莱尔山下的开阔地击溃莫卧儿围城军，这是他们首次在正面野战中击败莫卧儿人，从苏拉特掠得的财宝也先运到萨莱尔存放。莫卧儿人1684年以许诺和礼物收回诸堡，诸堡后来先后归入尼扎姆和马拉塔佩什瓦之手，1818年7月3日穆勒赫尔向英军投降。

en:
Warangal, also called Orugallu, was the fortified capital the Kakatiya kings built on the Telugu Deccan. Its walls ran in concentric circles, an earthen rampart with a ditch outside a stone citadel ringed by a moat, and four tall carved stone gates, the Kirti Toranam, fronted the great Swayambhu temple of the four-faced Shiva linga. Ganapatideva rebuilt the fort in stone; his daughter Rudrama Devi, one of the few queens regnant of the Deccan, ruled under the male royal title Rudradeva Maharaja, finished the walls and died putting down a revolt; her grandson Prataparudra II strengthened them further. The armies of Delhi broke in twice. In 1309 Malik Kafur came with 100,000 men, fought for six months and carried off tribute that included the Koh-i-Noor diamond. Ulugh Khan returned in 1323, pulled down the great temple and ended Kakatiya rule; Prataparudra died by the Narmada while being taken to Delhi. Local Nayakas recovered the fort in 1336, and Bahmani armies took it in 1435. In 1444 the ruined Hindu capital was a Bahmani garrison, the four carved gates standing over broken temples and tanks.

The Recherla Nayakas, who had displaced the recoverers in 1368, came back with an Orissan army under Hamviradeva and retook Warangal and Rachakonda by 1461, holding Orugallu as tributaries of the Gajapatis until a Bahmani army annexed their lands in 1475. After that Warangal passed from one Deccan power to the next: when the Bahmani sultanate broke apart it went to the Qutb Shahi sultans of Golconda in 1518, who added barbicans to the four gates. Aurangzeb's conquest of Golconda brought Mughal rule in 1687, and in 1724 the fort passed with the eastern Deccan to the Nizam of Hyderabad, whose officials made Warangal a district early in the nineteenth century.
zh:
瓦朗加尔又称奥鲁加卢，是卡卡提雅诸王在泰卢固德干营建的设防都城。城墙一圈套一圈：外圈是带壕沟的土城，内圈是有护城河环绕的石城；四座高耸的雕花石门（Kirti Toranam）立在供奉四面湿婆林伽的斯瓦扬布大寺前。加纳帕蒂提婆把旧堡改建成石堡；他的女儿鲁德拉玛·德维是德干少见的女主，以男子王号「鲁德拉提婆·摩诃罗阇」治国，督造完城墙，后在平定叛乱时战死；她的孙子普拉塔普鲁陀罗二世又继续加固。德里的军队两度攻破这座坚城：1309年，马利克·卡富尔率十万大军围攻半年，带走的贡物中有光之山钻石；1323年乌卢格汗再来，拆毁大寺，终结卡卡提雅统治，普拉塔普鲁陀罗在被押往德里途中死于讷尔默达河畔。当地纳亚卡首领1336年收复堡垒，巴赫曼尼军队又于1435年攻取。1444年，这座残破的印度教旧都是巴赫曼尼的戍城，四座雕花石门矗立在寺庙与水塘的废墟之间。

1368年赶走收复者的雷切尔拉纳亚卡，后来借哈姆维拉提婆率领的奥里萨军队反攻，到1461年前夺回瓦朗加尔和拉查孔达，以加贾帕蒂王朝藩属的身份据有奥鲁加卢，1475年被巴赫曼尼军队吞并。此后瓦朗加尔在德干诸势力间转手：巴赫曼尼苏丹国瓦解后，它于1518年归戈尔孔达的库特卜·沙希苏丹，四座城门在这一时期加筑了瓮城。1687年奥朗则布征服戈尔孔达，这里改受莫卧儿统治；1724年，堡垒随东德干转归海得拉巴尼扎姆，其官员在19世纪初把瓦朗加尔划为一处行政区。

en:
Midnapore lies on the Kangsabati River, behind the Hijli creek country on the coastal border where Orissa met Bengal. The older trading anchor in this tract was Tamralipta near Tamluk, a port whose spice traffic was recorded by Faxian and Xuanzang; local chiefs farther south controlled the Rasulpur and other river mouths. The tenth-century Chapaleswar and Mahamaya temples at Karnagarh kept the older Kalinga temple style north of the town. In 1444 the country was the Jaleswar march of Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati empire, a Bengali-speaking Hindu borderland from which Cuttack's armies pushed toward Gaur.

Chaitanya crossed the district around 1510 on his way from Puri to Varanasi, a route recorded in his devotional biographies. Afghan armies under Sulaiman Khan Karrani and Kalapahad overran Orissa in 1568, and after the Mughal conquest of the 1590s the tract became the Jaleswar sarkar. In Shah Jahan's reign, Shah Shuja defeated Bahadur Khan, the chief of Hijli. The district then suffered the yearly Maratha raids called the Bargi incursions: Mir Jafar and Mir Habib's men fought near Midnapore, Alivardi Khan retook the town in 1749, and the peace of 1751 left the border exposed. Mir Qasim ceded Midnapore to the East India Company in 1760 with Burdwan and Chittagong. In 1806 the defeated Gajapati Mukunda Deva II and his minister Jayi Rajaguru were brought to the town as prisoners; Rajaguru was executed there.
zh:
米德纳布尔位于甘萨巴蒂河畔，后方是希吉利河汊地带，地处奥里萨与孟加拉相接的沿海边界。这片地区更早的贸易据点是塔姆卢克附近的耽摩栗底，法显和玄奘都记载过那里的香料贸易；更南面的地方首领控制着拉苏尔布尔等河口。城北卡尔纳加尔的查帕莱什瓦尔神庙与摩诃摩耶神庙建于10世纪，延续着羯陵伽神庙样式。1444年，这里已是卡皮伦德拉·德瓦伽贾帕蒂帝国的贾莱什沃尔边区，是说孟加拉语的印度教边地，克塔克的军队也从这里向高尔方向推进。

1510年前后，柴坦尼亚从普里前往瓦拉纳西，途中穿过本县，这段路线见于他的虔信传记。1568年，苏莱曼·汗·卡拉尼与卡拉帕哈德率领的阿富汗军队席卷奥里萨；1590年代莫卧儿征服后，这一带成为贾莱什沃尔萨尔卡尔。沙贾汗在位时，沙·舒贾击败希吉利首领巴哈杜尔汗。此后，被称为「巴吉」的马拉塔骑兵年年入掠：米尔·贾法尔与米尔·哈比卜的部下曾在米德纳布尔附近交战，阿里瓦迪汗1749年收复城镇，1751年和约仍使边界暴露在袭掠之下。1760年，米尔·卡西姆把米德纳布尔连同布尔德万和吉大港割让给东印度公司。1806年，战败的伽贾帕蒂穆昆达·德瓦二世和大臣贾伊·拉杰古鲁被押到城中囚禁，拉杰古鲁在此被处死。

en:
The Sunderbans are the tide-washed southern fringe of the Ganges Delta, mangrove islands and salt creeks opening onto the Bay of Bengal; their name comes from the sundari, the mangrove that grows thickest in the brackish water. Fishermen, woodcutters and honey-collectors worked the forest at risk from tigers, and before they went in they called on Bonbibi, a lady of the woods whom both Hindus and Muslims venerated for protection, whose enemy Dakshin Rai came in the shape of a tiger. On the Bhairab river, where firm land began, stood Bagerhat. In 1444 it belonged to the Bengal Sultanate of Mahmud Shah, whose Turkic officer Khan Jahan Ali governed the forest frontier and was laying out roads, bridges, tanks and brick mosques at the town soon known as the mint town of Khalifatabad.

Its building inscriptions run from 1450 to 1459, and work on the Sixty Dome Mosque itself began in 1442 and ended in 1459. Sixty pillars carry its seventy-seven domes, and the building served as prayer hall, madrasa and assembly room; more than fifty sultanate monuments in plain baked brick, later called the Khan Jahan style, stood about the town, and two of his great tanks, the Ghoradighi and Dargadighi, supplied its water. Khan Jahan was governor and Sufi at once, and when he died in 1459 his followers buried him in a single-domed mazar beside a mosque and venerated him there as a saint. Under Mughal rule forest tracts were leased for clearing and new villages. The East India Company took the rights to the Sunderbans in 1757 and had the tidal forests surveyed by 1764, turning fishing grounds, woodlands and rice lands into assessed revenue country.
zh:
桑德班斯是恒河三角洲受潮汐冲刷的南缘，红树林岛屿与咸水溪汊在此通向孟加拉湾，地名就来自咸水中生长最密的红树林树种松达里树。渔民、伐木人和采蜜人进林谋生，常遭猛虎之祸，入林前他们向林中女神班比比祈求护佑，印度教徒和穆斯林都敬奉这位女神，她的对头达克辛·拉伊会化作猛虎现身。拜拉布河畔坚实陆地的尽头是巴盖尔哈德。1444年，这里属马哈茂德沙阿的孟加拉苏丹国；国王任命的突厥将领汗·贾汉·阿里管辖这片林莽边疆，正在当地修筑道路、桥梁、贮水池和砖造清真寺，这座新城不久以铸币镇哈利法塔巴德闻名。

城中铭文纪年从1450年延续到1459年，最大的六十圆顶清真寺1442年动工、1459年落成，六十根柱子撑起七十七个穹顶，兼作礼拜堂、经学堂和议事厅；全城五十多处苏丹国时代的建筑都用素面砖砌成，后世称为汗·贾汉风格，他开凿的戈拉迪吉、达尔加迪吉两大贮水池为全城供水。汗·贾汉身为总督同时是苏非行者，1459年去世后，追随者把他葬在清真寺旁的单穹顶圣墓中，在墓前奉他为圣徒。莫卧儿统治时期，林地被出租给人清理、开辟新村。1757年东印度公司取得桑德班斯的利权，到1764年完成潮汐林测绘，渔场、林地和稻田被逐丈登记、缴纳税赋。

en:
Sadiya is the easternmost town of the Assam valley, set on a grassy right bank of the Lohit where forested Himalayan foothills close in. It was the capital of the Hinduised Chutia kings, Sadhyapuri in their copper-plate grants, and the remains of its brick forts still marked the country in later centuries. The kings' wealth came from the hill trade: from Sadiya three routes climbed into Tibet, up the Dihang, the Dibang and the Lohit towards Zayul, while another ran through the Shan state of Mongkawng to Yunnan. Their court kept the fierce goddess Kechai-khati, also called Tamresvari, a hill deity outside the Brahmanical order who was served by her own Deori priesthood. In 1444 the Chutia raja still ruled this frontier from his Sadiya forts.

The kingdom fell within a year. In 1524 a Mongkawng army under Phukloimung came down from the Myitkyina direction and was beaten off, but Suhungmung's Ahoms annexed the state soon after and posted Prasengmung Borgohain as the first Sadiya Khowa Gohain, governor of the eastern marches, who managed relations with the Mishmi, Adi and Miri hill tribes. Ahom expeditions punished unruly Miri villages in 1665 and 1683, and in 1697 a great earthquake wrecked Sadiya and brought hillsides down. The Moamoria rising began among the Morans of this eastern tract in 1769, and its chiefs later set up the tributary Matak state at Bengmara nearby. A Khamti rising was dispersed in 1799, but in 1810–1811 Khamtis with Singpho allies drove out the last Sadiya Khowa Gohain, and after 1817 their chiefs guided the Burmese armies into the valley.
zh:
萨地亚是阿萨姆河谷最东端的城镇，坐落在洛希特河右岸的草原上，森林覆盖的喜马拉雅山麓在四周收拢。这里是印度教化的楚蒂亚王国的都城，铜版铭文中称萨达亚普拉，砖石堡寨的残迹在此后数百年间仍散布四野。楚蒂亚国王的财用来自山货贸易：从萨地亚入藏有三条路，分别溯迪杭河、迪邦河和洛希特河而上，后者通往察隅，另有商道经掸邦孟拱抵达云南。宫廷还奉祀凶猛的凯猜卡蒂女神（又名塔姆雷斯瓦里），她不在婆罗门神谱之内，由世代承袭的德奥里祭司专掌。1444年，楚蒂亚罗贾仍在这些堡寨中统辖这片东方边地。

楚蒂亚王国在一年之内倾覆。1524年，孟拱的普克洛伊蒙从密支那方向来攻，被击退，苏洪蒙的阿洪姆大军随即将其吞并，任命普拉森蒙·博尔戈海因为首任萨地亚科瓦·戈海因，总领东方边务，负责处置与僜人、阿迪人、米里人等山地部落的关系。1665年和1683年，阿洪姆两度出兵征讨不服管束的米里村落；1697年一场大地震摧毁萨地亚，多处山体崩塌。1769年，摩亚马里亚起义在这片东方摩朗人的土地上爆发，首领们后来在附近的本格马拉建立称臣纳贡的莫塔克政权。1799年坎底人的起事被驱散，但1810至1811年坎底人联合景颇人（辛颇人）赶走末任萨地亚科瓦·戈海因，1817年以后其酋长又为入侵河谷的缅甸军队引路。

en:
Manipur is the small rice plain of the Imphal valley, ringed by Naga and Kuki-Chin ridges. Meitei farmers worked the valley floor and related Tibeto-Burman clans kept the hills around it. The Ningthouja kings ruled from Kangla, their fortified palace on the Imphal River, where the court kept the old Meitei ancestral rites. Meitei riders played sagol kangjei, a ball game on horseback with a long-handled stick, and Imphal cloth went out along the hill tracks to Cachar, Tripura and the Shan country. A Pagan inscription of 1442 counted Kasan, as the Burmese called the valley, among the lands claimed by the Mong Mao ruler Thonganbwa; in 1444 the Meitei court of Kangleipak nonetheless held Kangla in its own right.

In 1559 Bayinnaung of Toungoo sent Binnya Dala with three Shan-led armies, and the king of Manipur surrendered without a fight. Khagemba, who took the throne in 1597 and was named Conqueror of the Chinese for a victory on the northern border, set the valley rebuilding: Chinese captives laid brick bridges and walls and built the Kangla gate, coinage came into wide use, the Ema market took shape, and Muslim settlers arrived from Bengal; he also revised the rules of sagol kangjei. Pamheiba, who took the name Gharib Niwaz, made Hinduism the state religion in 1717 and renamed Kangleipak as Manipur in 1724. His raids carried Meitei arms into Burma, where in 1714 his men entered a Burmese camp disguised as a wedding party and where he took Sagaing in 1738. A Burmese army invaded in 1819 and opened the Seven Years Devastation; Meitei refugees fled to Cachar, Tripura and Sylhet, and in 1821 the Burmese still held Kangla.
zh:
曼尼普尔是因帕尔河谷中的小片稻米平原，四周被那加与库基-钦丘陵环抱。梅泰农人耕作谷底，与他们同源的藏缅语氏族据有周围山地。宁托贾国王以因帕尔河畔设防的康拉堡为王庭，奉行梅泰人旧有的祖先仪轨。梅泰骑手在马背上挥杖击球，这种本地的萨戈尔康杰伊是马球的前身形态；因帕尔出产的布匹沿山路销往卡恰尔、特里普拉和掸地。1442年蒲甘的一方铭文把缅人所称的卡桑列入蒙毛统治者思昂法名义下的诸邦；1444年，坎格莱帕克的梅泰王庭仍据有康拉。

1559年，东吁国王勃印曩命彬尼亚·达拉率三支以掸人为主的军队来攻，曼尼普尔国王不战而降。1597年即位的卡格姆巴因北境战胜中国之役得名「征服者」，他着手重建河谷：中国俘虏烧砖造桥、筑墙，修起康拉门；铸币广为流通，埃马市集兴起，穆斯林移民也从孟加拉迁入；他还重订了萨戈尔康杰伊的规则。取名噶尔布·尼瓦兹的旁赫巴于1717年立印度教为国教，1724年把国名由坎格莱帕克改为曼尼普尔。他连年攻入缅甸，1714年部下曾扮作迎亲队伍混入亲敦江边的缅军营地，1738年又攻占实皆。1819年缅军入侵，开启「七年浩劫」，梅泰难民涌向卡恰尔、特里普拉和锡尔赫特；1821年，康拉仍在缅甸占领军手中。

en:
Gauhati is the place where the Brahmaputra narrows below the Nilachal hills, the first defensible ground on the river road up from Bengal, and every power that held it fortified it. Its older ground was Pragjyotishpura, a capital of ancient Kamarupa. On Nilachal above the town stood Kamakhya, one of the chief shrines of goddess worship in India: no image is kept there, only a natural fissure in the rock, and the kings of Kamarupa patronised the shrine for centuries. By 1444 Kamarupa had long been gone: Baro-Bhuyan chiefs held the ferries and hill-forts, Kamata ruled the lowlands to the west, and the town's own name spoke of its long rows of areca-nut stalls.

In 1498 Alauddin Husain Shah of Gaur overran Kamata and wrecked Kamakhya, but his son and governor Danyal was soon caught and killed by the Bhuyans under Harup Narayan, and the chiefs took the country back. Bisu, a Koch leader with the Hindu name Biswa Singha, subdued the Bhuyans from about 1509 and had himself crowned king of Kamata in 1515; under his son Nara Narayan and the general Chilarai the Koch power reached its height, and Kamakhya was rebuilt in 1565. The kingdom was divided in 1581, and its eastern half, Koch Hajo, fell to the Mughals in 1613–1614.

Gauhati then became the prize of the Ahom-Mughal wars. The Ahoms took it in 1658, lost it to Mir Jumla's invasion of 1662 and won it back in 1667; after their defeat on the Alaboi field in 1669, Lachit Borphukan destroyed Raja Ram Singh of Amber's fleet in the narrows at Saraighat in 1671, the last great Mughal attempt on the valley. One short Mughal occupation followed, but the Ahoms retook the Itakhuli fort for good in 1682 and made Gauhati the Borphukan's seat, turning the old Dighalipukhuri tank into a boatyard. Captain Welsh reoccupied the town for the Ahom king in 1792, and by 1821 Burmese garrisons held Gauhati.
zh:
高哈蒂（Gauhati，今古瓦哈蒂）位于布拉马普特拉河在尼拉查尔丘陵下收窄之处，是从孟加拉溯河入谷第一处可守的要地，据有者无不在此设防。其故城即迦摩缕波旧都波罗吉奥提什普尔。尼拉查尔山上的卡摩加耶庙是印度最重要的女神道场之一：洞中不设神像，只供奉岩石上一道天然裂缝，历代迦摩缕波国王皆为檀越。1444年迦摩缕波早已不存，巴罗—布扬豪酋据守渡口与山堡，西方低地归迦摩塔王国，而城名本身就来自成行成市的槟榔摊。

1498年，高尔的阿拉乌丁·侯赛因·沙阿攻灭迦摩塔、捣毁卡摩加耶庙，但他派驻当地的儿子达尼亚尔不久便被赫鲁普·纳拉扬率领的布扬人擒杀，土地重回诸豪酋之手。科奇首领比苏（印度教名比斯瓦·辛哈）约自1509年起逐一征服布扬首领，1515年加冕为迦摩塔国王；其子纳拉纳拉扬与名将奇拉莱把科奇势力推向鼎盛，卡摩加耶庙也于1565年重建。1581年王国分裂，东半科赫哈乔于1613至1614年被莫卧儿攻灭。

此后高哈蒂成了阿洪姆与莫卧儿长期争夺的目标。阿洪姆1658年据城，1662年在米尔·久姆拉的攻势中失守，1667年收复；1669年阿拉博伊野战失利后，拉吉特·博尔普坎于1671年在萨拉伊加特的狭窄河面歼灭安贝尔王公拉姆·辛格的舰队，这是莫卧儿最后一次大举进犯河谷。其间莫卧儿又短暂占据一次，阿洪姆终在1682年攻克伊塔库里要塞、永久收回此城，并以高哈蒂为博尔普坎驻地，把旧城的迪加利普库里塘辟为船坞。1792年韦尔什上尉替阿洪姆国王重占此城，到1821年，高哈蒂已由缅甸驻军把守。

en:
Balasore, or Baleshwar, occupies the northern Orissan coast where the Burhabalanga meets the Bay of Bengal. Its old local shrine was the Baneshwar Shiva temple in Puruna Baleswar, which gave the town its name. North along the shore, near the Subarnarekha, lay Pipili, the roadstead used before Balasore became the main port. In 1444 the coast belonged to Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati empire. Oriya farmers grew rice, weavers made fine cotton, and merchants anchored offshore to load cloth that later took Balasore's name.

The coast changed hands in the wars after the Gajapati collapse. Kalapahad's Afghan army conquered Orissa for Sulaiman Khan Karrani in 1568, and on 3 March 1575 Munim Khan defeated Daud Khan Karrani at Tukaroi in this district; the Treaty of Katak cut Daud's realm down to Orissa before he was killed at Rajmahal in 1576. Under Mughal rule, Balasore became the leading port of the Orissa coast. The English East India Company opened a factory in 1633, Portuguese ships carried rice, cotton and butter from its roadstead, and Balasore muslin was exported under the town's name. When Company ships bombarded the town in 1686, Mughal troops drove them off. The Bhonsle rajas of Nagpur held the district from 1751 until 1803, when the Treaty of Deogaon assigned it to the East India Company.
zh:
巴拉索尔又称巴莱什瓦尔，位于奥里萨北部沿海，布拉巴朗加河在此注入孟加拉湾。旧巴拉索尔的巴内什瓦尔湿婆神庙是本地旧神祠，城名便来自这座神庙。沿海岸向北，苏巴尔纳雷卡河附近有皮皮利港；在巴拉索尔成为主要港口前，海船多在那里锚泊。1444年，这片海岸属于卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的伽贾帕蒂帝国。奥里亚农民种植稻米，织工生产细棉布，商人在外海锚地装货，后来一种棉布便以巴拉索尔之名外销。

伽贾帕蒂崩溃后的战争改变了海岸归属。1568年，卡拉帕哈德率阿富汗军队为苏莱曼·汗·卡拉尼征服奥里萨；1575年3月3日，穆尼姆汗在本县的图卡罗伊击败达乌德·汗·卡拉尼，克塔克条约把达乌德的疆域压缩到奥里萨，他本人则于1576年在拉杰马哈尔被杀。莫卧儿治下，巴拉索尔成为奥里萨沿海首要港口。英国东印度公司1633年开设商馆，葡萄牙商船也从其锚地运走稻米、棉花和黄油，巴拉索尔细棉布以城名外销。1686年公司舰队炮轰城镇，被莫卧儿军队击退。1751年起，那格浦尔的邦斯勒罗阇占有此地；1803年德奥冈条约把它划给东印度公司。

en:
Bhagalpur, the old Champa Nagari, lies on the southern bank of the Ganges in the ancient country of Anga. Its weavers made tussar silk a staple of the river trade. Near Kahalgaon, at the village of Antichak, stand the ruins of Vikramashila, the Buddhist university founded by the Pala emperor Dharmapala in the late eighth century; with Nalanda and Odantapuri it ranked among the three great mahaviharas of eastern India, holding more than a hundred teachers and about a thousand students, and its master Atisha carried its tantric teaching on to Tibet. About 1193 the forces of Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji destroyed Vikramashila together with the other monasteries of the region. In 1444 the town was a western march of the Bengal Sultanate, ruled from Gaur by Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah of the restored Ilyas Shahi dynasty; its people were largely Hindu, and the Ganges road held the frontier together.

Early in the sixteenth century Kahalgaon sheltered Husain Shah Sharqi after Lodi power drove the last Jaunpur sultan from his capital. The same river road later carried Sher Shah Suri into Bengal: on 6 April 1538 he routed Ghiyasuddin Mahmud Shah, last sultan of the Husain Shahi line, and sacked Gaur, and the wounded sultan died a few days later near Kahalgaon. After the Suri collapse and Akbar's conquest of Bengal in 1576, Bhagalpur became part of Mughal Bihar, its tolls and silk traffic tied to the river route. In 1577 the Khanqah-e-Shahbazia was raised over the grave of the Sufi saint Shahbaz Muhammad; Aurangzeb later built its mosque and visited it often, and its library gathered Arabic and Persian theological manuscripts.
zh:
帕戈尔布尔古称占巴纳格里，位于古安伽国的恒河南岸。当地织工织造柞蚕丝，是恒河贸易的大宗。乔尔贡格附近的安蒂查克村坐落着超戒寺遗址：这座佛教学府由波罗皇帝达摩波罗在8世纪末创建，与那烂陀、欧丹塔普里并称东印度三大寺，最盛时有上百名教师和上千名学生，寺中大师阿底峡后来把密教传统带入西藏。1193年前后，穆罕默德·本·巴赫蒂亚尔·哈尔吉的军队把超戒寺与这一地区的其他寺院一并摧毁。1444年，帕戈尔布尔是孟加拉苏丹国的西部门户，由复辟的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝苏丹纳赛尔丁·马哈茂德·沙阿在高尔统辖，居民以印度教徒为主，恒河水道维系着这片边疆。

16世纪初，末代江布尔苏丹侯赛因·沙阿·沙尔基被洛迪势力逐出都城后，在乔尔贡格得到庇护。舍尔沙·苏利后来也沿这条恒河水道进兵孟加拉：1538年4月6日，他击溃侯赛因·沙希王朝末代苏丹吉亚斯丁·马哈茂德·沙阿并洗劫高尔，受伤的苏丹数日后死于乔尔贡格一带。苏尔王朝崩溃、阿克巴1576年征服孟加拉后，帕戈尔布尔并入莫卧儿比哈尔，关税和丝绸贸易仍系于恒河水道。1577年，沙赫巴济亚道堂在苏菲圣徒沙赫巴兹·穆罕默德的墓地建起；奥朗则布后来修建了道堂的清真寺并常来礼拜，堂中图书馆藏有大量阿拉伯文和波斯文典籍。

en:
Rangpur stands on the Ghaghat River near the Teesta, on the northern edge of the old Barind or Varendra country, whose red laterite fields run from the Karatoya to the plains of Gaur. Since the early thirteenth century the sultans of Bengal had kept Ghoraghat as a northern military post, watching the Koch, Bhuyan and Kamata marches. In 1444 Mahmud Shah ruled from Gaur at the head of the restored Ilyas Shahi dynasty, and Rangpur itself was still a scatter of markets and villages rather than the district town it later became. Its weavers made satranji, thick patterned floor coverings that wealthy North Bengal households laid out as a mark of standing.

In 1498 Alauddin Husain Shah's army passed this way against Kamata, overthrew the Khen kings and briefly held the country as far as Hajo. Humayun's campaign carried Mughal arms into Gaur in 1538, only for Sher Shah Suri to take Bengal for the Sur government the next year. Akbar's commander Raja Man Singh took Rangpur in 1575, and Todar Mal's revenue rolls made Ghoraghat a great sarkar of eighty-four mahals, with raw silk among its assessed goods. Local chiefs kept most of their autonomy, and the Mughals fully absorbed the tract only in 1686. A Koch raid on Ghoraghat in 1661 brought Mir Jumla's imperial army the other way: it stormed Koch Bihar, renamed the town Alamgirnagar, and marched on into the Ahom country.

After the Company received Bengal's diwani in 1765, Rangpur District was organised, and the town was confirmed as its seat on 16 December 1769. Bands of Muslim fakirs and Hindu sannyasis, among them the followers of the Sufi pir Majnu Shah, harried the Company's tax collectors through the northern jungles for decades afterwards.
zh:
朗布尔位于加加特河畔、邻近提斯塔河，地处古巴林德（又称瓦伦德拉）地区北缘，红色砖红壤田地从加拉托亚河铺向高尔平原。13世纪初以来，孟加拉苏丹便把戈尔加特作为北方军站，监视科奇人、布安酋长和卡马塔边地。1444年，马茂德沙阿在高尔执掌恢复后的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝；此时的朗布尔还是一片市集与村落，尚未成为后来的县城。当地织工织造萨特兰吉，这种厚实的带纹铺织物，是北孟加拉富户摆出身份的物件。

1498年，阿拉丁·侯赛因·沙阿的军队经此进攻卡马塔，推翻肯王朝，一度据地远至哈乔。1538年，胡马雍的征战把莫卧儿军队带进高尔，次年舍尔沙·苏利便为苏尔政权取下孟加拉。1575年，阿克巴的将领曼·辛格攻占朗布尔；在托达尔·马尔的税册中，戈尔加特成为下辖84个马哈尔的大萨尔卡尔，生丝也在计税物产之列。地方酋长仍保有大半自治权，莫卧儿直到1686年才完全消化这片地区。1661年科奇人袭击戈尔加特，引来米尔·朱姆拉的帝国军队反向推进：联军攻破库奇比哈尔，将该城改名阿拉姆吉尔讷格尔，随后继续攻入阿洪人的土地。

1765年东印度公司取得孟加拉迪万尼权后，朗布尔县组建，城镇于1769年12月16日被确认为县治。此后数十年间，穆斯林法基尔和印度教桑尼亚西的队伍，其中包括苏菲派皮尔马杰努·沙阿的追随者，一直在北方丛林中追袭公司税吏。

en:
Nasirabad is the later sultanate name for the Old Brahmaputra lowlands that became Mymensingh; the town did not bear it in 1444. Mahmud Shah's court at Gaur then claimed the tract between densely settled Bengal and the Garo Hills, but its channels, marshes and jungle left officials with little grip. Bengali Hindu villagers farmed the broader floodplains, while Garo, Hajong and Koch communities held the forested ground below the hills. Incoming zamindars took riverine and forest estates from the sultans. The name Nasirabad came later, attached to Nasiruddin Nasrat Shah in the early sixteenth century.

The river country gave Bengal's landholders a defensible march after the Karrani dynasty fell in 1576. Isa Khan united the Baro-Bhuyan chiefs of Bhati and kept Mughal armies out of eastern Bengal until his death in 1599. His son Musa Khan led the confederacy afterward, and even when Mughal titles and revenue papers reached the district, much power stayed with local landlords; the rajas of Susang kept their northern pargana beneath the Garo Hills. The East India Company acquired revenue rights in 1765. After the 1770 famine, armed Fakir and Sannyasi bands attacked landlords and Company parties from 1772 to 1790. The Company formed Mymensingh District in 1787, moving its headquarters from flood-wrecked Begunbari to the Mymensingh site. In the northern estates, Karam Shah's Pagal Panthi following drew Garo, Hajong and Rajbanshi peasants together; Tipu Shah led the movement after his father's death in 1813.
zh:
纳西拉巴德是后来苏丹朝给予旧布拉马普特拉河低地的名称，这片地区日后形成迈门辛；1444年时这座城镇还没有这个名字。当时，高尔的马茂德沙阿朝廷声称统治孟加拉人口腹地与加罗丘陵之间的地带，但河汊、沼泽和丛林使官员难以扎根。孟加拉印度教村民耕种开阔的泛滥平原，加罗人、哈宗人和科奇人占据丘陵脚下的林地；迁入的柴明达尔从苏丹手中取得河畔与林间封地。纳西拉巴德之名要到16世纪初纳西尔丁·努斯拉特沙阿时才出现。

1576年卡拉尼王朝灭亡后，河网地带成了孟加拉地主可守的边区。伊萨汗联合巴蒂的巴罗-布安首领，把莫卧儿军队挡在孟加拉东部之外，直到1599年去世。其子穆萨汗后来统领联盟；即使莫卧儿的封号和税册进入这里，大部分权力仍在地方地主手中，苏桑的罗阇也继续保有加罗丘陵脚下的北方帕尔加纳。东印度公司1765年取得税收权。1770年大饥荒后，武装的法基尔和桑亚西队伍在1772至1790年间攻击地主与公司武装。1787年，公司设立迈门辛县，把县治从遭洪水毁坏的贝贡巴里迁到迈门辛。北方领地内，卡拉姆沙阿的帕加尔潘提信众把加罗、哈宗和拉杰班希农民聚集起来；1813年卡拉姆沙阿死后，蒂普沙阿接领这场运动。

en:
Tirhut, the old Mithila, is the plain between the Gandaki and the Mahananda, where the Himalayan foothills slope down to the Ganges, and its people speak Maithili. Its Brahmins have long been the arbiters of sacred law and Sanskrit letters across the eastern Ganges country. The armies of Delhi drove the old Karnat kings into Nepal in 1324 and set a Maithil Brahmin scholar on the throne; the Oiniwar dynasty that followed ruled first from Oini and then from Sugauna, and its queens mattered as much as its kings. When King Sivasimha vanished in the wars of the early fifteenth century, his queen Lakhimadevi ruled in his place, then his brother Padmasimha, then Padmasimha's queen Vishwasa Devi. In 1444 the Brahmin rajas of Sugauna still hold a Hindu Mithila beyond the reach of Delhi, and at their court lives the old poet Vidyapati, who has served seven kings and two queens, writes hymns to Shiva and love songs of Radha and Krishna in the village tongue, and is making Maithili a language of literature.

The line ended when its last king tried to throw off Bengal and was killed by Sultan Nusrat Shah, who reigned from 1519 to 1533; rival Rajput clans fought over the country for the next thirty years. Akbar's government ended the disorder by naming the Maithil Brahmin scholar Mahesh Thakur caretaker of Tirhut in 1557, and the country became the largest sarkar of the Bihar subah, its revenue assessed from Darbhanga over more than a hundred mahals. The Darbhanga family turned their office into a lordship: a firman of Aurangzeb in 1684 made their lands hereditary and free of tribute to the nawabs of Bengal, and an army Alivardi Khan sent against them in 1750 was beaten. The diwani of Bihar passed to the East India Company in 1765, and by the early nineteenth century Tirhut was indigo country, its blue dye shipped from the Ganges factories to Europe.
zh:
蒂鲁德古称弥萨罗，是甘达基河与默哈嫩达河之间的平原，北倚喜马拉雅山麓，南抵恒河，居民操迈蒂利语。这里的婆罗门长期为恒河东部一带裁断圣法、传授梵学。1324年德里的军队把旧卡尔纳特诸王逐入尼泊尔，改立一位迈蒂利婆罗门学者为王；其后的奥伊尼瓦尔王朝先后定都奥伊尼与苏高纳，而几位王后和国王一样主政当国。15世纪初国王湿婆辛哈在战乱中失踪，王后拉希玛德维主政，继之的是其弟帕德马辛哈，再后是帕德马辛哈的王后毗湿瓦萨德维。1444年，苏高纳的婆罗门罗阇仍统治着不服德里管辖的印度教弥萨罗；老诗人维迪亚帕提就住在他们的宫廷里，曾侍奉七位国王和两位王后，用乡间语言写湿婆颂诗与拉达和黑天的情歌，把迈蒂利语变成文学语言。
