The rock is precipitous on most sides, and in the fourteenth century its rulers girdled both the town and the hill with walls; the works later climbed the slope in thirteen strongholds, eight above the town and five below, with temples, gardens and tanks between them. A jungle track on the east and a path on the west were the only ways in. The fort lay on the border between the Telugu-speaking Vijayanagara Empire and the Gajapati kings of Odisha, and in 1444 a Vijayanagara garrison held it, the nearest strongpoint to the Gajapati armies in the north.

It changed hands twice in the wars between the two kingdoms. In 1489 Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya, founder of the Saluva dynasty, fought Purushottama Deva of Odisha beneath Udayagiri, was captured, and won his release only by surrendering the fort and the country around it; by 1491 it was a Gajapati possession. Krishnadevaraya opened his campaign against the Gajapatis here in 1512, and the hill held out for eighteen months before his men forced their way in. After Vijayanagara's collapse the hilltop passed to local Muslim rulers, who built a mosque above the town with two Persian inscriptions; the Chinna Masjid and Pedda Masjid in the lower town and the tomb of the eighteenth-century Sufi Rahamathulla Nayab Rasool, where a sandal festival is held every year, date from their rule. In 1682 Abdullah Arafath made himself lord of Udayagiri, and his descendants held it through the eighteenth century.
zh:
优陀耶耆厘是内洛尔西北的要塞城镇，背靠一座高出沿海平原约一千英尺的山岩。山体四面多为绝壁，14世纪的统治者已在城镇和山岩外围筑起城墙；后来防线沿坡而上，共有十三处堡垒，八处在山上、五处在山下，其间分布着神庙、园林和水池，只有东侧一条丛林小径和西侧一条山道可以通行。它地处泰卢固人的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国与奥里萨加贾帕蒂诸王的边界，1444年由毗奢耶那伽罗驻军把守，是直面北方加贾帕蒂大军最近的要塞。

在两国交兵中，它两度易手。1489年，萨卢瓦王朝的开创者萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈·德瓦·拉亚在优陀耶耆厘城下与奥里萨的普鲁肖塔马·德瓦交战，兵败被俘，交出岩堡和周边土地后才获释；到1491年，这里已是加贾帕蒂的领地。1512年，克里希那德瓦拉亚在这里打响对加贾帕蒂的战事，守军据山坚守十八个月才被攻破。毗奢耶那伽罗崩溃后，山顶转入当地穆斯林统治者之手，他们在城镇上方修了一座清真寺，留存两道波斯语铭文；山下的奇纳清真寺、佩达清真寺，以及18世纪苏菲圣徒拉哈马图拉·纳亚卜·拉苏尔的陵墓（每年在此举行檀香节）也建于这一时期。1682年，阿卜杜拉·阿拉法特自立为优陀耶耆厘之主，他的后裔在整个18世纪都据有此地。

en:
Konaseema is the maze of green islands the Godavari threads on its last miles to the Bay of Bengal, and on the rising ground at the delta's head stands Rajahmundry, founded in the tenth century and made his capital by the Eastern Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra around 1022. At his court Nannayya, the first Telugu poet, began the Telugu Mahabharata, and Telugu letters have counted the town their birthplace ever since. After the Eastern Chalukyas and the Kakatiyas of Warangal it came to the Reddy kings, warrior chiefs who rose out of the Kakatiya collapse and held the Godavari delta from Rajahmundry as one of the last Hindu realms of coastal Andhra. In 1444 the Reddy raja still ruled here, his weavers' calico went out through the river ports, and Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati armies from Orissa were already pressing his northern frontier.

The Reddy kingdom fell to the Gajapatis by 1448, and for two generations Odisha, the Bahmanis and Vijayanagara fought over the delta before Krishnadevaraya's campaigns of the 1510s carried the coast into his empire. Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah of Golconda completed the Muslim conquest in 1572, and in 1602 the Dutch built a fort at Rajahmundry to buy its cloth. The town went to the Mughals with Golconda in 1687. Seventy years on, Forde's victory at Condore and his storm of Masulipatam moved the whole coast from French to British keeping, and a Mughal grant obtained by Clive, confirmed by the Treaty of Masulipatam in 1768, made the delta Company land.
zh:
坎纳斯马是戈达瓦里河奔入孟加拉湾前河道分汊、沙洲棋布的一片绿色水乡；三角洲上游的高地上矗立着拉贾蒙德里，该城建于10世纪，约1022年由东遮娄其王罗阇罗阇·纳伦德拉定为都城。泰卢固第一位诗人纳纳亚在他的宫廷中开始翻译泰卢固文《摩诃婆罗多》，泰卢固文学便以这座城为发祥地。历经东遮娄其与瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚王朝后，此地归雷迪诸王：他们是卡卡提亚崩溃中崛起的武将首领，以拉贾蒙德里为据点据有戈达瓦里三角洲，是安得拉海岸仅存的印度教政权之一。1444年，雷迪罗阇仍在此主政，织工的棉布经河港外运，卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂大军已从奥里萨压境而来。

雷迪王国于1448年为加贾帕蒂所灭，此后二十年间，奥里萨、巴赫马尼与维查耶纳伽尔轮番争夺三角洲，最终克里希纳德瓦拉亚在1510年代的征战中把海岸收入帝国版图。1572年，戈尔孔达的伊卜拉欣·库利·库特卜沙完成征服；1602年，荷兰人在拉贾蒙德里筑堡，收购当地棉布。1687年，此城随戈尔孔达并入莫卧儿。七十年后，福德在孔多尔获胜并攻克默苏利珀德姆，整段海岸由法国转入英国之手；克莱夫取得的莫卧儿诏谕经1768年的默苏利珀德姆条约确认，三角洲成为公司领地。

en:
Tiruchirappalli sits where the Kaveri breaks into its delta around Srirangam. An 83-metre granite rock rises beside the river: Pallava rulers cut cave temples into it, and later kings built the Rockfort above them. Nearby Uraiyur had been the Early Chola capital, while the Kallanai dam across the Kaveri, built by Karikala Chola in the second century, regulated delta water. On Srirangam island stood the Ranganathaswamy temple, one of South India's major Vaishnava sanctuaries. Delhi armies plundered it in 1311, and the image of Ranganatha disappeared for decades; after Kumara Kampana's Vijayanagara forces took Tiruchirappalli in 1371 and overcame Madurai, the image returned to a rebuilt Srirangam. In 1444 the Rockfort and rebuilt temples guarded a Vijayanagara stronghold at the entrance to the cotton-growing Kaveri delta.

Under the Madurai Nayaks, Vishwanatha Nayak walled Srirangam and laid out the Teppakulam tank in the sixteenth century; Tiruchirappalli served as the Nayak capital from 1616 to 1634 and again from 1665 to 1736. The line ended with Queen Meenakshi in 1736, when Chanda Sahib seized power. Raghuji Bhonsle's Marathas captured him in the 1741 siege, and Murari Rao held the Rockfort until the Nizam retook it two years later. During 1751-52 Chanda Sahib and a French army besieged Muhammad Ali Khan Wallajah in the city while British troops supported the defence, a major contest of the Second Carnatic War. Mysore attacks under Hyder Ali in 1780 and Tipu Sultan in 1793 failed, and in 1801 the city passed with the Carnatic to the East India Company.
zh:
蒂鲁吉拉帕利位于高韦里河绕斯利兰甘岛分流、进入三角洲的地方。河畔耸立着83米高的花岗岩山岩：帕拉瓦君主在岩中开凿石窟，后世诸王又在上方修筑岩堡。附近的乌拉尤尔曾是早期朱罗都城；高韦里河上的卡莱奈水坝由卡里卡拉·朱罗在2世纪修建，用来调节三角洲水量。斯利兰甘岛上的兰加纳塔斯瓦米神庙是南印度最重要的毗湿奴圣地之一。1311年德里军队洗劫神庙，兰加纳塔神像失踪数十年；库马拉·坎帕纳率领毗奢耶那伽罗军队1371年攻占蒂鲁吉拉帕利，毗奢耶那伽罗压服马杜赖后，神像才回到重建后的斯利兰甘。1444年，岩堡和修复的诸庙守卫着这座毗奢耶那伽罗要塞，它正位于产棉的高韦里河三角洲入口。

马杜赖纳亚克统治时期，维什瓦纳塔·纳亚克在16世纪为斯利兰甘修筑城墙，并营建特帕库拉姆水池；蒂鲁吉拉帕利于1616年至1634年、1665年至1736年两度成为纳亚克都城。1736年末代女王米纳克希败亡，昌达·萨希卜夺取政权。拉古吉·邦斯莱的马拉塔军队在1741年围城中俘获他，穆拉里·拉奥据守岩堡至1743年尼扎姆收复。1751年至1752年，昌达·萨希卜与法军在此围攻穆罕默德·阿里·汗·瓦拉哈，英军则协助守城，这是第二次卡纳蒂克战争中的重要战役。海德尔·阿里1780年和提普苏丹1793年的迈索尔进攻都被击退；1801年，此城随卡纳蒂克转入东印度公司之手。

en:
Cholistan, called Rohi in Punjabi, is the western tongue of the Thar Desert, where pastoral clans grazed camels and cattle among the dunes. The dry bed of the Hakra carried caravan traffic between Multan and the lands to the east and also served Muslims travelling to and from Mecca. Rajput forts guarded the wells along that route, above all Derawar, raised by Bhati rulers in the ninth century; its forty bastions stand on a walled circuit about 1,500 metres around and up to thirty metres high. At the desert edge stood Uch, the Noble Uch on an old bank of the Indus. From the twelfth to the seventeenth century it was a regional Muslim city, a refuge for scholars and a centre of Suhrawardi and Qadiriyya Sufis, with tile-covered shrines around the tombs of its teachers. In 1444 Uch was tied to Multan and assigned as a jagir to a Samma prince.

About 1494 the shrine of Bibi Jawindi, great-granddaughter of the Sufi teacher Jahaniyan Jahangasht, was built at Uch with the glazed tilework characteristic of southern Punjab. The Arghuns of Sindh invaded in 1525, and Sher Shah Suri took the city in 1540; Humayun entered Uch later that year, found the inhabitants unwilling to receive him, and was defeated by Sher Shah's forces. Under Akbar the Ain-i-Akbari listed Uch as a pargana of Multan, assessed at 1,910,140 dams and required to supply 100 cavalry and 400 infantry. The Sufi poet Bulleh Shah was born there in 1680. In the desert, Nawab Sadeq Muhammad Khan I took Derawar in 1733, Jaisalmer recovered it in 1747, and Nawab Mubarak Khan retook the fort in 1804. Ahmad Shah Durrani's general Jahan Khan attacked Uch in 1751, and the desert tract became the western lands of the Abbasi state of Bahawalpur.
zh:
焦利斯坦在旁遮普语中称罗希，是塔尔沙漠向西伸出的一角，游牧部落在沙丘间放牧骆驼和牛群。哈克拉河的干涸河床承载着木尔坦与东方之间的商队，也有往来麦加的穆斯林取道于此。拉杰普特要塞守卫沿途水井，其中最重要的是巴蒂统治者在9世纪修建的德拉沃尔堡；它有四十座棱堡，城墙周长约1500米，最高处达30米。沙漠边缘的印度河故道旁是乌奇，即「尊贵的乌奇」。12至17世纪，这里是穆斯林区域名城、学者避难所，也是苏赫拉瓦迪教团和卡迪里教团苏菲修士的中心，导师墓周围建有瓷砖贴面的圣祠。1444年，乌奇隶属木尔坦，作为采邑交给一位萨马王公。

约1494年，苏菲导师贾哈尼扬·贾汉加什特的曾孙女比比·贾温迪的圣祠在乌奇建成，饰有南旁遮普风格的琉璃砖。1525年，信德的阿尔浑人入侵；1540年，舍尔沙·苏利夺取乌奇。同年晚些时候，胡马雍进入乌奇，发现城民不愿接纳他，随后又被舍尔沙的军队击败。阿克巴时代，《阿克巴治典》把乌奇列为木尔坦的一个帕尔加纳，估税1910140达姆，并须提供100名骑兵和400名步兵。苏菲诗人布莱·沙阿于1680年出生于此。沙漠中，纳瓦卜萨迪克·穆罕默德汗一世于1733年取得德拉沃尔堡，杰伊瑟尔梅尔于1747年夺回，纳瓦卜穆巴拉克汗又在1804年收复该堡。1751年，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的将领贾汉汗进攻乌奇；这片沙漠地带后来成为阿巴西家族巴哈瓦尔布尔邦国的西部疆土。

en:
Ajmer, originally Ajayameru, the invincible hill, sits in an Aravalli valley under the scarp of Taragarh fortress. It was the capital of the Chauhan Rajputs until Muhammad of Ghor defeated Prithviraj Chauhan at Tarain in 1192 and took the town the following year. His general Qutb-ud-Din Aibak turned a Sanskrit college and pillars from demolished Hindu and Jain temples into the Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra, one of the oldest mosques in India; local legend says its first screen wall was raised in two and a half days, which gave the building its name. The Sufi preacher Mu'in al-Din Chishti died here in 1236, and his dargah grew into one of the most visited shrines of the subcontinent, revered by Muslims and Hindus alike. In 1444 Ajmer was a Mewar frontier town on the road through the Aravallis, with Taragarh guarding the pilgrim routes and the approaches to Chittor.

The Sisodias secured the town late in the fifteenth century. Akbar conquered it in 1556, made it the seat of a Mughal province and a base for his Rajput wars, walked barefoot to Chishti's shrine with his Hindu consort to pray for an heir, visited it fourteen times in all, and rebuilt its inner sanctum in 1579; Mughal governors added palaces and pavilions along the Ana Sagar lake. Shah Jahan's daughter Jahanara was born here in 1614 and his son Dara Shikoh in 1615. About ten kilometres to the west lay Pushkar, whose lake was called the king of Hindu pilgrimage places and held one of the few temples dedicated to Brahma. Mughal patronage ebbed during the eighteenth century, the Scindias took Ajmer in 1752, and in 1818 Daulat Rao Scindia ceded it to the English East India Company.
zh:
阿杰梅尔古称阿阇耶梅鲁，意为「不可战胜之山」，坐落在阿拉瓦利山脉的一道山谷中，塔拉尔加尔要塞高踞城后的山崖。它曾是乔汉拉杰普特人的都城；1192年穆罕默德·古尔在塔拉因战役击败普里特维拉杰·乔汉，次年攻占此城。其部将库特布丁·艾伊拜克把一座梵文学院和拆毁的印度教、耆那教神庙的石柱改建成清真寺，即阿代丁卡琼普拉，是印度最古老的清真寺之一；相传第一道影壁只花两天半就砌好，寺名「两天半的棚舍」由此而来。苏菲修士穆因丁·奇什提1236年在此去世，他的圣墓后来成为印度次大陆参拜者最多的圣所之一，穆斯林与印度教徒都来敬谒。1444年，阿杰梅尔是梅瓦尔的前沿城镇，塔拉尔加尔护卫着山口道路上的朝圣队伍，也扼守通往吉多尔的方向。

15世纪末，西索迪亚人稳固了对阿杰梅尔的控制。阿克巴1556年征服此地，将它设为一行省的首府，作为征讨拉杰普特的基地；他曾偕印度教王后赤脚前往奇什提圣墓求子，一生共拜谒十四次，1579年又重建圣墓内殿，莫卧儿官员还在阿纳萨格尔湖畔营建宫殿亭台。沙贾汗的女儿贾哈娜拉1614年、王子达拉·舒科1615年先后出生于此。城以西约十公里是普斯赫卡尔，那里的圣湖被称作印度教朝圣地之王，湖畔还有为数不多的梵天神庙之一。18世纪莫卧儿的庇护衰退，辛迪亚家族1752年夺取阿杰梅尔；1818年，道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚把它割让给不列颠东印度公司。

en:
Umarkot, formerly Amarkot, is a desert fort where the Thar runs into south-eastern Sindh. Its name recalls Umar Soomro, the ruler in the Sindhi tale of Umar and Marvi, who carried the village girl Marvi to his palace and offered to make her a queen; she refused him and chose her own village and people, and the story was later set down in Shah Jo Risalo. A branch of the Soomras founded the early settlement, the Sodha Rajputs took it in 1226, were expelled in 1330, and won it back in 1439. In 1444 a Sodha rana therefore held the fort, wells and grazing lands around Amarkot. Dhatki-speaking herders moved sheep, camels and wool along the tracks joining lower Sindh to Rajasthan, Hindu Rajput lords guarding this desert flank of the Muslim-ruled Indus lowlands.

The desert rana entered Mughal history when Rana Parshad Singh Sodha gave refuge to Humayun, driven out by Sher Shah Suri. On 15 October 1542 Hamida Banu Begum gave birth there to the future emperor Akbar. Umarkot was incorporated into the Mughal Empire in 1590, though an Arghun prince, Abu'l-Qasim Sultan, drove out its Mughal commander in 1599. Nur Muhammad Kalhoro expelled the last Sodha chief in 1736 and built a new fort on the site in 1746. The Rathors of Jodhpur took Amarkot from Sindh in 1779 and still held it in the opening years of the nineteenth century.
zh:
欧迈尔果德旧称阿马尔科特，是塔尔沙漠伸入信德东南缘处的一座沙漠要塞。城名来自苏姆拉首领乌马尔，即信德民间故事《乌马尔与马尔维》里的主人公：他把村女马尔维带回宫中、许以王后之位，马尔维却不肯相从，宁愿回到自己的村庄和乡亲身边；这个故事后来被收入诗集《里萨洛》。苏姆拉人的一支最早在此建立定居点，索达·拉杰普特人1226年夺取此地，1330年被逐，1439年又夺回。因此1444年时，一位索达拉纳据守阿马尔科特的堡垒、水井和牧场。说达特基语的牧人沿连接下信德与拉贾斯坦的沙路贩运羊、骆驼和羊毛，在穆斯林统治的印度河低地边缘，由印度教拉杰普特首领守着这片沙漠侧翼。

拉纳·普拉萨德·辛格·索达收留了被舍尔沙·苏利逐出的胡马雍，这座沙漠要塞就此进入莫卧儿历史。1542年10月15日，哈米达·巴努·贝古姆在此生下后来的皇帝阿克巴。1590年欧迈尔果德被并入莫卧儿帝国，但阿尔洪王公阿布·卡西姆·苏丹1599年赶走了当地的莫卧儿长官。努尔·穆罕默德·卡尔霍罗1736年驱逐末代索达首领，1746年又在旧址筑起新城堡。1779年，焦特布尔的拉托尔人从信德手中夺取阿马尔科特，到十九世纪初仍控制此地。

en:
Chaul, whose medieval harbour survives beside Revdanda on the Kundalika, was the chief mart on a coast of island sea forts reaching south to Janjira and Kolaba. Its cotton cloth drew ships up the creek while Muslim governors, Vijayanagara officers and local Koli and Maratha chiefs disputed every landing place. In 1444 the Marathi-speaking shore was a frontier. Vijayanagara still claimed it, Bahmani armies had marched through the Konkan in 1429 and brought the Rayagad chief to tribute in 1436, and neither side held every creek and hill pass; the cotton mart of Chaul was worth the fighting.

In March 1508 a Mamluk-Gujarat fleet caught the Portuguese in Chaul roads and killed Dom Lourenço de Almeida, son of the viceroy of Portuguese India and the commander who had made Ceylon tributary three years earlier. It was Portugal's first naval defeat in the Indian Ocean. The coast had since passed to the Ahmadnagar sultans, yet the Portuguese came back: Burhan Nizam Shah let them fortify Revdanda in 1521, the stone Santa Maria fortress stood there ten years later, and a league of Deccan sultans failed to storm Chaul in 1570. South along the coast, the Kolis' wooden stronghold at Janjira was rebuilt in stone, a work credited to the Habshi commander Malik Ambar; its Siddi chiefs became autonomous in 1621 and no one ever took the island. Shivaji's assault of 1676 failed at its twelve-metre granite walls, and his son Sambhaji besieged it in 1682, tried to tunnel in and fill the channel, and withdrew only when a Mughal army marched on the Maratha capital. From Kolaba the Maratha admiral Kanhoji Angre levied tribute on British, Dutch and Portuguese merchantmen and beat off every fleet sent against him. Under a settlement of 1740 Portugal handed Chaul to the Marathas, who held the coast until the British conquest of 1818.
zh:
焦尔的中世纪港湾保留在昆达利卡河畔的勒夫丹达旁，是这一带海岛堡垒海岸的首要商港，海岸向南一直连到詹吉拉和科拉巴。焦尔出产的棉布引船只驶入河口，穆斯林长官、毗奢耶那伽罗将领与本地科利人、马拉塔首领则争夺每一处登陆点。1444年，这段说马拉地语的海岸还是各方之间的前沿。毗奢耶那伽罗仍宣称主权，巴曼尼军队1429年开进康肯、1436年迫使赖加尔首领纳贡，但双方都没能控制每一处河口与山道，焦尔这座棉布商港值得一再动兵。

1508年3月，一支马穆鲁克与古吉拉特联合舰队在焦尔锚地突袭葡萄牙人，击毙葡属印度总督之子、三年前曾迫使锡兰纳贡的洛伦索·德·阿尔梅达。这是葡萄牙人在印度洋的首次海战失败。这段海岸后来转入艾哈迈德讷格尔苏丹国，葡萄牙人还是回来了。布尔汗·尼扎姆沙阿1521年允许他们在勒夫丹达筑垒，石砌的圣玛丽亚堡十年后落成，1570年德干诸邦联军又未能攻下焦尔。沿海向南，科利人在詹吉拉的木寨被改建为海岛石堡，相传出自哈布舍将领马利克·阿姆巴尔之手；西迪首领1621年成为自治势力，此后再无人能攻下这座岛。1676年希瓦吉进攻，被十二米高的花岗岩城墙挡住；其子桑巴吉1682年围攻，试图挖地道、填塞航道，直到莫卧儿军队进逼马拉塔都城才撤兵。马拉塔海军将领坎霍吉·安格雷以科拉巴为基地，向英国、荷兰和葡萄牙商船征收贡金，击退了派来围剿他的每一支舰队。根据1740年的协议，葡萄牙把焦尔交给马拉塔人，这片海岸由马拉塔人控制到1818年被英国征服。

en:
This land lies where the Tungabhadra leaves the Deccan for the eastern plains. Its caravan crossing of Kandanavolu, later Kurnool, stood on the great road from the Deccan into the Tamil country, and the name refers to the grease, kandana, with which bullock teams oiled their axles at the ford; the town is called the Gateway of Rayalaseema. Deeper in the Nallamala forests, at Srisailam above the Krishna, the Mallikarjuna temple carries a double claim on pilgrims: its lingam is one of the twelve jyotirlingas of Shiva while its goddess Bhramaramba is honoured at one of the fifty-two Shakta pithas, and Tamil Saivite saints also sang of it. Reddi chiefs built its mandapas and the long Pathala Ganga steps down to the river, and the first Vijayanagara kings raised its gopurams. In 1444 it was a Telugu heartland of Deva Raya II's empire: pilgrims climbed to Srisailam, caravans crossed at Kurnool, and the hills yielded iron.

Achyuta Deva Raya, who came to the throne in 1529, built Kurnool's fort; its one surviving work is a semicircular bastion crowned with a tower, Konda Reddy Buruju, named after Konda Reddy, last ruler of Alampur, whom the town's nawab imprisoned there and who escaped, local legend says, through a tunnel, though his lands passed to Golconda. Its gateways were raised by Gopal Raja, a grandson of Rama Raya, before the Abyssinian general Abdul Wahab Khan, in Bijapur's service, overthrew him and ruled Kurnool for sixteen years. The country passed to Aurangzeb's Mughals in 1687 and then to the Nizam of Hyderabad, under whose loose overlordship local nawabs kept Kurnool; Maratha tradition remembers Shivaji as a devotee who shielded Srisailam during the Deccan wars. In 1800 the Nizam ceded the surrounding country to the East India Company, leaving the nawab's state ringed by British territory.
zh:
这片地区地处栋格珀德拉河出德干高原、奔向东岸平原之处。坎达纳沃卢（后称卡努尔）是德干通往泰米尔南方大道上的牛车渡口，地名中的「坎达纳」即油脂，据说商队常在此给车轴上油；这座城镇也被称作「拉雅拉西玛的门户」。在纳拉马莱森林深处、克里希纳河畔的斯里赛拉姆，摩利迦周那神庙对香客有双重分量：庙里的林伽是湿婆十二林伽之一，女神布拉玛兰巴则是五十二个性力派圣地之一，泰米尔湿婆圣徒也曾为它唱颂。雷迪诸酋长修建了庙中的柱殿和直通河畔的帕塔拉甘加大石阶，毗奢耶那伽罗开国诸君又建起各座瞿布罗门塔。1444年，这里是德瓦拉亚二世帝国的泰卢固腹地：香客登斯里赛拉姆山，商队在卡努尔渡河，山间出产铁矿。

1529年即位的阿周多·德瓦·拉亚修筑了卡努尔堡，唯一残存的是一座顶上带塔楼的半圆形棱堡孔达·雷迪碉楼，名字来自阿兰布尔末代首领孔达·雷迪。相传他被纳瓦布囚于堡中，靠一条地道逃脱，领地却落入高康达诸纳瓦布之手。堡门由罗摩·拉亚之孙戈帕尔·拉贾所建，后来效力于比贾布尔的阿比西尼亚将领阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜汗推翻了他，统治卡努尔十六年。1687年此地并入奥朗则布的莫卧儿帝国，继而转归海得拉巴尼扎姆，在其松散宗主权下由本地纳瓦布世代保有；马拉塔传统称希瓦吉是斯里赛拉姆的虔诚信徒，在德干战乱中庇护过圣庙。1800年，尼扎姆把周围地区割让给东印度公司，纳瓦布的小邦就此被英国领土围住。

en:
Tripura is the hill country east of the Bengal delta, where the Gomti River comes down from forested ranges to the plains. Its people are the Tripuri, who honour the Chaturdasa Devata, the Fourteen Gods, beside the Hindu pantheon; their royal chronicle, the Rajmala, was written in Bengali verse in the fifteenth century. Coin evidence places the rise of the Manikya kings in the early fifteenth century, when Maha Manikya took the royal title after defeating Bengal and fixed his capital at Rangamati on the Gomti. In 1444 Dharma Manikya I, on the throne since 1431, drew tribute from the surrounding hill chiefs in war elephants and timber, and his frontier ran far out into the Bengal plains toward Chittagong and Comilla.

His strongest successor, Dhanya Manikya, carried Tripura's arms deep into eastern Bengal and in 1501 raised the temple of Tripura Sundari at Udaipur, on a hillock shaped like a tortoise's back. It is counted among the fifty-one Shakti pithas, where the right foot of Sati is said to have fallen, and the kings carried its smaller image of Chandi, the Chhoto-Ma, to war. Rangamati took the name Udaipur later in the century. The elephants that made Tripura rich drew the Mughals too: in 1618 the Bengal subahdar Ibrahim Khan Fath-i-Jang sent a land army and a fleet of three hundred war-boats up the Gomti, broke through the river barricades, sacked Udaipur and carried off Raja Yashodhar Manikya with his family, treasure and elephants. The dynasty returned as Mughal tributaries, and the fertile western plains slipped away to become the Mughal-held chakla of Roshnabad. There, in the mid-eighteenth century, a peasant soldier named Shamsher Gazi, the Tiger of Bhati, made himself master of Roshnabad and overran Tripura, until he was killed fighting the East India Company in 1757. The Manikyas then accepted British protection in 1809 and kept their hills, ruling from Udaipur and later Agartala.
zh:
特里普拉是孟加拉三角洲以东的丘陵之国，戈默蒂河从林海覆盖的山地流入平原。居民为特里普里人，在印度教众神之外另奉本族的「十四天神」；王室编年史《拉杰马拉》于15世纪以孟加拉韵文写定。据钱币史料，马尼基亚王权在15世纪初兴起，摩诃·马尼基亚战胜孟加拉后采用王号，定都戈默蒂河畔的朗加马蒂。1444年在位的是1431年即位的达尔马·马尼基亚一世，周边山林酋长以战象和木材纳贡，王国的疆界向西远伸入孟加拉平原，直抵吉大港和库米拉一带。

达尔马最强盛的继承者达尼亚·马尼基亚挥师深入东孟加拉，1501年在乌代布尔修建特里普拉孙达里神庙。神庙坐落在状如龟背的丘冈上，被列为印度教五十一处性力圣地之一，相传萨蒂的右脚就落在此处；国王们出征时还带着庙中较小的昌迪女神像「小母亲」。朗加马蒂后来在该世纪改名乌代布尔。让特里普拉富足的战象也引来了莫卧儿人：1618年，孟加拉苏巴达尔伊卜拉欣·汗·法特赫-江派出陆军和三百艘战船组成的舰队溯戈默蒂河而上，冲破河上栏栅，攻陷乌代布尔，俘走罗阇亚肖达尔·马尼基亚及其家眷、财宝和象群。王朝后来复辟，却沦为莫卧儿附庸，富庶的西部平原脱离王国，成为莫卧儿治下的罗什纳巴德恰克拉。18世纪中叶，人称「巴蒂之虎」的农家军汉沙姆谢尔·加齐自立为罗什纳巴德之主，席卷特里普拉，1757年在抗击东印度公司的战事中败死。马尼基亚王室随后在1809年接受英国保护，保住了山地，罗阇们仍在乌代布尔、后来在阿加尔塔拉统治。

en:
The Mahadeo hills are the forested spine of the Satpura range south of the Narmada, and their strong place was Kherla, seat of the oldest of the Gond kingdoms. A Rajput raja, Jaitpal, is credited with its first fortress, and the Gond raja Narsingh Rai, the first ruler said to have unified the Gond, made Kherla a power reaching west to Gawilghur, wedged between Mandu and the Bahmani Deccan. In 1398, at the prompting of the sultans of Malwa and Khandesh, he raided Bahmani lands as far as Mahur, was beaten by Firuz Shah Bahmani and became his vassal; Firuz also married one of his daughters. Hoshang Shah of Malwa invaded in 1425 and was beaten twice with Bahmani help, but in 1433 he took Kherla and killed Narsingh Rai, ending his line. In 1444 these woods, Gondi-speaking and Hindu, answer to Mandu. The southern hills hold the Jain temple complex of Muktagiri and, at Multai, the source of the Tapti, a place of pilgrimage and bathing ghats.

Sikh tradition holds that Guru Nanak later meditated for fifteen days at the Tapti spring. Kherla remained the prize in the long Malwa-Bahmani wars: in 1467 the governor of Berar took the fort after a pitched battle, and Firishta relates that the victors insulted the beaten garrison; two Rajput brothers came before the governor as if to kiss his feet, snatched swords from the guards, killed him and died fighting. In the negotiations that followed, Kherla was handed back to Malwa. Mughal armies assailed Kherla fort again and again through the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, and the country became the Kherla sarkar of the Ellichpur subah, though its forested north was never firmly held. As Mughal power ebbed, Bakht Buland Shah of Deogarh seized the district; in the eighteenth century it passed to the Bhonsles of Nagpur, and after the battle of Sitabuldi in 1818 Kherla and the Mahadeo hills came under British rule.
zh:
马哈德奥丘陵是讷尔默达河以南萨特普拉山脉的林莽脊梁，此地的重镇是凯尔拉，贡德诸王国中最古老者的王庭。相传最早的凯尔拉堡为拉杰普特王公贾特帕尔所修；此后的贡德拉贾纳尔辛·拉伊是见于记载第一位统一贡德人的首领，他使凯尔拉崛起，疆土向西直抵加维尔加尔，却夹在曼杜与巴赫曼尼两个穆斯林强国之间。1398年，他受摩腊婆与坎德什两位苏丹怂恿，攻入巴赫曼尼境内、远达马胡尔，被菲鲁兹沙阿击败后沦为其藩属，菲鲁兹沙阿还娶了他的一个女儿。摩腊婆的胡尚沙阿1425年来犯，靠巴赫曼尼援军两次被击退，但1433年他终于攻破凯尔拉、杀死纳尔辛·拉伊，终结了他的王统。1444年，这片通行贡德语、信奉印度教的山林向曼杜称臣。南山之中有穆克塔吉里的耆那教寺庙群，达布蒂河则发源于穆尔泰，河畔是朝圣沐浴之地。

锡克教相传，古鲁·那纳克后来曾在达布蒂河源禅定十五日。凯尔拉此后仍是摩腊婆与巴赫曼尼长期战争中反复争夺的要地：1467年，贝拉尔总督经一场鏖战夺下城堡；据菲里什塔记载，获胜者羞辱了投降的守军，两名拉杰普特兄弟便假装上前吻总督的脚，夺过卫兵的刀将他刺死，自己也力战而亡，随后的谈判又把凯尔拉交还摩腊婆。整个16至17世纪，莫卧儿军队屡次进攻凯尔拉堡，这一地区后来成为埃利奇布尔苏巴的凯尔拉萨尔卡尔，只是林木密布的北部始终没有被牢固控制。莫卧儿势力衰微之际，德奥加尔的巴克特·布兰德沙阿夺取此地，18世纪它转入那格浦尔邦斯勒家族之手；1818年西塔布尔迪之战后，凯尔拉与马哈德奥丘陵归入英国统治。

en:
Mandsaur is the ancient Dashapura, the town Kalidasa named in the Meghaduta, and it stands where the Malwa plateau breaks into the Mewar hills, on the road from Ujjain to Chittor. Pilgrims came to its Pashupatinath temple, one of the old Shiva shrines of Malwa, and armies came for the same road and its river crossings. In 1444 it was a north-western fortress of Mahmud Khalji's Malwa Sultanate, governed from the court at Mandu and facing a border the Rajputs of Mewar raided repeatedly.

Its great siege came in 1521. Malik Ayaz of Gujarat, joined by Mahmud Khalji II of Malwa, invested the fort with mines and covered ways, while Rana Sanga gathered Medini Rai, Silhadi and the other Rajput chiefs to relieve it. Quarrels among the Gujarati captains and failing supplies achieved what the relieving army had not: when Rana Sanga offered terms, Malik Ayaz broke up the siege without taking the fort and went home to a displeased sultan. Bahadur Shah overran Malwa in 1531 and Humayun campaigned along this border in 1535; after Baz Bahadur's defeat at Sarangpur, Akbar annexed Malwa in 1562 and Mandsaur passed into the Ujjain subah. In February 1732 Maratha cavalry trapped Jai Singh II of Amber outside the town, made him pay six lakh rupees and granted Holkar the chauth of twenty-eight Malwa parganas. On 6 January 1818 the defeated Holkar signed the Treaty of Mandsaur there, accepting British terms and ending the Third Anglo-Maratha War.
zh:
曼得萨尔古称达沙普拉，迦梨陀娑在《云使》中写到过这座城。它位于摩腊婆高原向梅瓦尔丘陵跌落之处，正当乌贾因通往奇托尔的大路。巡礼者来拜帕苏帕提那神庙，摩腊婆古老的湿婆神庙之一，军队也为同一条路和沿途渡口而来。1444年，它是马哈茂德·卡尔吉的摩腊婆苏丹国西北要塞，政令出自曼杜宫廷，城外则是梅瓦拉拉杰普特人一再入寇的边界。

这里最有名的围攻发生在1521年。古吉拉特的马利克·阿亚兹联合摩腊婆的马哈茂德·卡尔吉二世，挖掘地道、推进遮蔽甬道围攻要塞；拉那·桑伽则集结梅迪尼·拉伊、西尔哈迪等拉杰普特首领前来解围。古吉拉特将领的内讧和补给不继替拉那·桑伽解了围：他提出议和，马利克·阿亚兹放弃围攻、未克而还，回去面对苏丹的不快。巴哈杜尔沙1531年横扫摩腊婆，胡马雍1535年又在这一带用兵；巴兹·巴哈杜尔在萨兰布尔战败后，阿克巴于1562年兼并摩腊婆，曼得萨尔并入乌贾因苏巴。1732年2月，马拉塔骑兵在城外困住安贝尔的杰伊·辛格二世，逼他缴纳六十万卢比，并准许霍尔卡尔在摩腊婆二十八个帕尔格纳征收四一税。1818年1月6日，战败的霍尔卡尔在此签订《曼得萨尔条约》，接受英国条件，第三次英国—马拉塔战争就此结束。

en:
Bahraich stands on the Saryu beyond the Ghaghra, where the Awadh plain runs into the wet Tarai forests under the Himalayan foothills, hard by the Nepal frontier. The old country was Kosala, the land of Shravasti, and its people included the Bhar. What gave Bahraich its name in memory was a grave. In 1034, by the account of the Mirat-i-Masudi, a Persian hagiography written in the seventeenth century, the young Ghaznavid warrior Salar Masud Ghazi was defeated and killed beside Chittora lake by a league of rajas led by the Bhar king Suhaldev, and was buried where he fell. Firoz Shah Tughlaq built his grave up into a dargah, and Hindus and Muslims alike came to pray at it; the annual procession carrying Masud's spear drew pilgrims of both religions. From 1394 the district belonged to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, and in 1444 its Avadhi-speaking peasants obeyed Mahmud Shah Sharqi.

With the rest of the Sharqi kingdom Bahraich fell to the Lodi Afghans in the wars after 1478. Sikandar Lodi, a sultan of strict orthodoxy, banned the spear procession and barred women from visiting saints' tombs. Mughal rule followed: Akbar granted lands to the shrine in 1571, the Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula renewed the grant in 1765, and Asaf-ud-Daula came here on pilgrimage more than once. Under the nawabs Bahraich was a northern border district run from Faizabad and Lucknow; its forests served the court as a hunting ground and gave refuge close to the Nepal hills. In 1801 Saadat Ali Khan ceded it to the East India Company together with half of Awadh.
zh:
巴赫赖奇位于加格拉河以北的萨拉尤河畔，阿瓦德平原在这里没入喜马拉雅山麓潮湿的特莱森林，紧邻尼泊尔边境。这一带古称拘萨罗，即舍卫城所在之地，居民中有巴尔人。让巴赫赖奇留名的是一座墓。据17世纪的波斯语圣徒传《马苏德之鉴》记载，1034年，年轻的加兹尼武士赛义德·萨拉尔·马苏德·加齐在奇特罗拉湖畔被巴尔王苏赫尔提婆率领的诸王联军击败斩杀，就葬在阵亡之地。菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克在他的墓上营建圣祠，印度教徒和穆斯林都前来祈祷；每年一度抬着马苏德长矛的游行吸引两教的香客。1394年起，此地归章普尔的沙尔基苏丹；1444年，说阿瓦德语的农夫臣属于马哈茂德沙·沙尔基。

1478年后的战争中，巴赫赖奇随沙尔基王国落入洛迪阿富汗人之手。恪守正统的苏丹西坎达尔·洛迪取缔了长矛游行，还禁止妇女拜谒圣墓。莫卧儿时代继之而来：1571年阿克巴向圣祠颁赐地产，1765年纳瓦卜舒贾·乌德·道拉延续了这一颁赐，阿萨夫·乌德·道拉还不止一次前来朝圣。纳瓦卜时代，巴赫赖奇是北部边县，受治法扎巴德和勒克瑙；林间是王室游猎场，也是紧邻尼泊尔山地的一处避难地。1801年，萨阿达特·阿里汗把它随半个阿瓦德一起割让给东印度公司。

en:
Varanasi, the ancient Kashi, lies on the north bank of the Ganges between the Varuna and Assi streams. Hindus count it first among the seven cities that grant liberation: pilgrims crowd the stone ghats, and the cremation fires at Manikarnika never go out. Upstream at Sarnath the Buddha preached his first sermon when Kashi was already a kingdom; the Gahadavala rajas made the city their second capital in 1090, until Muhammad of Ghor defeated Jayachandra and sacked it in 1194. Its chief shrine, the Vishwanath temple, is one of Shiva's twelve jyotirlingas. In 1444 the city belongs to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, the greatest Hindu city of their dominions; Muslim weavers work its silk and gold brocade, and this is the Varanasi of the weaver-saint Kabir and of Ravidas, who earned his living in its tanneries.

The Vishwanath temple was rebuilt and pulled down again and again. The Sharqis had already damaged it when Sikandar Lodi had it demolished in 1490; after Panipat brought Benares to the Mughals in 1526, Raja Man Singh began rebuilding under Akbar and Todar Mal carried the work forward in 1585, while Tulsidas lived by the river and wrote the Ramcharitmanas. Aurangzeb ordered the temple destroyed in 1669, and the Gyanvapi Mosque rose on its plinth in 1678, with columns of the old shrine left in its walls. As Mughal power weakened, the Bhumihar zamindar Mansa Ram founded the Kashi kingdom in 1725; his son Balwant Singh built the sandstone fort at Ramnagar in 1750, across from Tulsi Ghat. The Nawab of Awadh ceded Benares to the East India Company in 1775. In 1780 Ahilyabai Holkar of Indore raised the present Vishwanath temple on a plot beside the mosque, and in August 1781 Chait Singh rose against Warren Hastings, was beaten and driven out, and died at Gwalior in 1810.
zh:
瓦拉纳西古称迦尸，位于恒河北岸，夹在瓦鲁纳河与阿西河之间。印度教徒把它列为七大解脱圣城之首：香客挤满石砌河坛，马尼卡尼卡河坛的火葬之火终年不熄。早在迦尸国时代，佛陀就在上游的鹿野苑作了第一次说法；1090年伽哈德瓦拉王公以此为第二都城，1194年古尔的穆罕默德击败阇耶旃陀罗、洗劫城市。城中主庙毗湿瓦纳特神庙是湿婆十二林伽之一。1444年，城市归章普尔的沙尔吉苏丹所有，是其疆域内最大的印度教城市；穆斯林织工织造丝绸和金银织锦，织匠圣者迦比尔生于此城，罗维达斯则在城中的制革坊谋生。

毗湿瓦纳特神庙在历代政权手中一毁再建。沙尔吉人已将它损坏，西坎达尔·洛迪又于1490年将其拆毁；1526年帕尼帕特之战后贝拿勒斯并入莫卧儿帝国，拉杰·曼·辛格在阿克巴朝着手重建，托达尔·马尔1585年接续工程，杜尔西达斯则住在河畔写成《罗摩功行录》。1669年奥朗则布下令毁庙，1678年庙基上建起吉扬瓦皮清真寺，旧庙石柱仍嵌在寺壁之间。莫卧儿势力衰落，布米哈尔族地主曼萨·拉姆1725年建立迦尸王国；其子巴尔万特·辛格1750年在杜尔西河坛对岸修建拉姆纳格尔砂岩要塞。1775年，阿瓦德纳瓦布将贝拿勒斯割让给东印度公司。1780年，印多尔的阿希莉娅芭伊·霍尔卡在清真寺旁建起现存的毗湿瓦纳特神庙；1781年8月查特·辛格起兵反抗沃伦·黑斯廷斯，兵败被逐，1810年死于瓜廖尔。

en:
The Rajmahal Hills rise out of the flat Bengal plain in long ridges of sal forest, a belt the Persians named Damin-i-koh, the skirts of the hills. For centuries their valleys held little but scattered villages of the Paharia clans, the Sauria, Mal and Kumarbhag, who lived beyond the reach of every raja on the Ganges. At the southern foot of the tract stands Deoghar, the seat of Baidyanath, one of Shiva's twelve jyotirlingas; each year pilgrims walk more than a hundred kilometres from Sultanganj carrying Ganges water to pour over the lingam. In 1444 the restored Ilyas Shahi sultans held the river plains, and Bengal's traders bought ivory and elephants from the woods, but no army had yet entered the hills, and the Paharias answered to no master.

The lowlands south of the range were a different country. In 1503 three Rajput brothers in service of the local Khetauri lords turned on them, overthrew all fifty-two Khetauri chiefs and founded the Kharagpur Raj under the eldest, Dandu Rai; his grandson Sangram Singh served Akbar and then rebelled in 1601, and when he fell in battle his son Toral Mal saved the estate by converting to Islam as Roz Afzun, founding a Muslim line that became one of the Mughals' firmest allies in Bihar. The Mughals garrisoned the plains but never mastered the Paharias, whose raids spread as imperial Bengal collapsed after 1700. The East India Company, holding the diwani from 1765, tried payment instead of war: Augustus Cleveland, collector of Bhagalpur, granted land to the hill chiefs and raised a corps of Hill Rangers from their own men, and the raids stopped within his few years in office before he died in 1784. By then Santal axemen were already clearing the southern forests, the first comers of the migration that later filled the tract.
zh:
拉杰马哈尔丘陵以一道道娑罗双林山岭耸立于孟加拉平原，波斯人把这道林带称作达明-伊库赫，意为山峦之裙。几个世纪里，谷间只有帕哈里亚诸族（索里亚、马尔和库马尔巴格）散落的村落，恒河畔的历代罗阇都管不到他们。丘陵南麓是德奥加尔，湿婆十二林伽之一拜迪亚纳特就在这里；每年香客从苏丹甘吉出发，携恒河水跋涉百余公里，到庙中浇淋林伽。1444年，复辟的伊利亚斯·沙希苏丹据有河畔平原，孟加拉商人从山林购得象牙和大象，但还没有哪支军队踏进丘陵，帕哈里亚人不臣服于任何人。

山麓以南的低地是另一番局面。1503年，替本地克陶里首领效力的三兄弟反戈，攻灭全部五十二名克陶里首领，由长兄丹杜·拉伊建立卡拉格普尔罗阇国；其孙桑格拉姆·辛格曾效力阿克巴，1601年起兵反叛，战败身亡，其子托拉尔·马尔改宗伊斯兰教，改名罗兹·阿夫祖恩，以这种方式保住封地，也开创了比哈尔最忠于莫卧儿的穆斯林统治支系之一。莫卧儿人在平原屯兵，却始终没能制服帕哈里亚人；1700年后孟加拉的帝国统治瓦解，山地的劫掠随之蔓延。东印度公司1765年取得迪万尼后改用收买之策：巴加尔布尔税务官奥古斯塔斯·克利夫兰向山地首领封赐土地，从他们的族人中招募山地突击队，在他任内的短短几年间劫掠便告停止，他本人则于1784年去世。此时桑塔尔人的伐木工已在南部林间开垦，成为后来充盈这片山林的移民潮的第一批来人。

en:
Baghelkhand is the hilly country east of the Vindhyas, crossed by the upper Son and thick sal forest, whose hard timber was the region's saleable product; older inscriptions call it Dahala. The Baghel Rajputs, a branch of the Solanki royal house of Gujarat, came into these hills in the thirteenth century. Vyaghra Dev seized Marpha fort beyond Kalinjar, and his son Karan Dev married a Kalachuri princess of Mandla and received Bandhavgarh as her dowry; when Ulugh Khan overthrew the last Vaghela raja of Gujarat in 1298, more of the clan withdrew to the same hills. Bandhavgarh, a fortress on a sheer rock, became the seat of their kingdom. In 1444 the Baghel raja still ruled from that rock, independent between the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur and the Delhi sultans, while Bagheli-speaking peasants worked the valley floors below.

Sikandar Lodi marched against Bandhavgarh in 1498 and withdrew after a year without taking it. In the 1550s Raja Ramchandra Singh kept a court devoted to music: the singer Tansen, born at Gwalior, spent most of his adult life there, and the fame he won at the rock court brought Akbar's summons in 1562. Mughal pressure ended the fortress's independence in 1597, when Akbar's captain Patr Das forced its surrender after an eight-month siege and had the works dismantled. In 1618 Maharaja Vikramaditya left the ruins and founded Rewa on the plain below; the Baghel rajas kept their state through the Mughal and Maratha wars, and in 1812 Maharaja Jai Singh accepted British protection.
zh:
巴克尔根德是温迪亚山脉以东的丘陵之地，松河上游穿境而过，娑罗双林茂密，所产硬木是这一带拿得出手的商货；古碑铭中称此地为达哈拉。巴格尔人是古吉拉特索兰基王族的一支拉杰普特，13世纪进入这片山地。维亚格拉·德夫夺取卡林贾尔以北的马尔法堡，其子卡兰·德夫娶曼德拉的迦罗珠利公主，以嫁妆得到班达迦；1298年乌卢格汗推翻古吉拉特末代瓦盖拉罗阇后，更多族人退入这一带山林。班达迦堡雄踞绝壁之上，成为这个王国的统治中心。1444年，巴格尔罗阇仍在那座岩石上治国，自立于江布尔沙尔吉苏丹与德里苏丹之间，说巴格尔语的农民在山下谷地耕作。

1498年，西坎达尔·洛迪进军班达迦，围攻一年仍未破城，只得退兵。1550年代，罗阇拉姆金德尔·辛格的宫廷崇尚音乐：出生在瓜廖尔的歌唱家坦森在这里度过了大半生，他在这座山崖宫廷赢得的名声引来阿克巴1562年的征召。1597年，莫卧儿大军终结了这座堡垒的独立，阿克巴的将领帕塔尔·达斯经八个月围城迫其投降，随后拆毁城防。1618年，摩诃罗阇维克拉马迪亚离开废墟，在山下平原营建新都雷瓦；巴格尔诸王在莫卧儿与马拉塔的战乱中保住了国家，1812年摩诃罗阇贾伊·辛格接受英国保护。

en:
Surguja is a broken plateau of forested ridges east of Baghelkhand, between the Son and the upper Mahanadi, where the high grassy tableland of Mainpat rises above the sal woods. Gond, Korwa, Oraon and other clans cleared its valleys and held its hill fields. The Ramgarh hills contain the rock-cut Sitabenga and Jogimara caves, cut between the 3rd and 1st centuries BC. Their stone benches and tiers of seating have been read as the oldest theatre in the Indian subcontinent, or as a rest-house on a forest trade route, and the caves carry a Brahmi inscription in the Magadhi tongue and some of the oldest painted frescoes known in Asia. Local tradition ties the woods to the exile of Rama: Ramgarh, Sita-Bhengra and Laxmangarh are all named for Rama, Sita and Lakshmana. In 1444 Surguja was a patchwork of Gond and other tribal rajas, who bowed to stronger neighbours in war and went their own way in peace.

The hills kept their own lords until 1613, when a Rajput raja of the Raksel clan marched in from Palamu with his followers and made himself master of Surguja. His line ruled from Ambikapur, the town named for the goddess Ambika, and came to be acknowledged as overlord of the fringe states of Udaipur, Jashpur, Koriya and Changbhakar. In 1753 Maratha armies climbed into the hills and reduced the raja to tributary status. British forces arrived after the Third Anglo-Maratha War, and Surguja became a protectorate in 1818; in 1820 its chief was confirmed in the hereditary title of Maharaja.
zh:
苏古贾是巴克尔根德以东的破碎高原，林岭纵横，地处松河与默哈讷迪河上游之间，迈恩帕特的高峻草甸隆起在娑罗双林之上。贡德、科尔瓦、奥朗等部族开垦谷地，耕种山坡田。拉姆加尔山中的悉多邦加洞与焦吉马拉洞凿于公元前3世纪至前1世纪：洞内的石台和成排座次，有人认为是印度次大陆最古老的剧场，也有人认为是古代森林商路上的驿舍；洞中留有一则婆罗米体的俗语铭文，还有亚洲已知最古老的彩色壁画之一。当地传说把这片山林与罗摩的流放相连，拉姆加尔、悉多本格拉、拉克什曼加尔皆因罗摩、悉多和罗什曼那而得名。1444年的苏古贾是贡德等部族罗阇拼合的世界，战时向强邻低头，平时各行其是。

山区长期由本地首领自守，直到1613年，一位拉克塞尔族的拉杰普特罗阇带着部众从巴拉穆攻入，自立为苏古贾之主。其家族以得名于安比卡女神的安比卡普尔为都，乌代布尔、杰斯布尔、科里亚、昌格巴卡尔等边缘小邦后来都承认其宗主权。1753年，马拉塔军队攻入山区，迫使罗阇纳贡称臣。第三次英国—马拉塔战争后，英军进入此地，苏古贾于1818年成为保护国；1820年，其首领获得世袭的摩诃罗阇称号。

en:
The wet highland valleys of the Mahaweli Ganga, terraced with rice fields and shut in by jungle ridges, were Sinhalese Buddhist country above the coastal plain. Buwanekabahu IV made Gampola his capital in the mid-fourteenth century, and the pilgrim road to Sri Pada still ran through its paddy lands; nearby Senkadagalapura, the future Kandy, had grown around its Asgiriya monastery. In 1444 the kings of Kotte claimed these mountains, but forest passes kept the coast at a distance and the hill chiefs kept their monasteries, rice rents and most of their own rule.

Senasammata Vikramabahu, a prince of Kotte blood, made Senkadagalapura the seat of a semi-independent kingdom in 1469. After Kotte broke up in 1521 Rajasinghe I of Sitawaka overran the hills, until Konnappu Bandara, whose father the king had murdered, returned from Portuguese territory and seized the throne as Wimaladharmasuriya I. A Portuguese army in the passes was destroyed at Danture in 1594, and the next year he brought the Buddha's tooth relic from Delgamuwa and housed it in the Temple of the Tooth beside his palace; the relic was the age-old mark of a rightful Sinhalese king, and Kandy became the last independent Sinhalese court. Rajasinha II destroyed another Portuguese army at Gannoruwa on 28 March 1638 and called in the Dutch, who took Colombo in 1656 and kept every port; Kandyan goods could then move only through Dutch harbours.

A Dutch army fitted for the jungle with machetes in place of bayonets reached a deserted Kandy in 1765, but disease and Kandyan sharpshooters wore it down, and the 1766 peace left the coast in Dutch hands. The British took the Dutch ports in 1796 and reached Kandy in 1803, crowned a puppet king and left a garrison that was wiped out with a single survivor. The last king undid himself: after Sri Vikrama Rajasinha of the Nayakkar dynasty executed the wife and children of his minister Ehelepola, the nobles led a British column in on 10 February 1815. The king was caught fleeing and exiled to Vellore, and on 2 March his chiefs signed the Kandyan Convention in the royal audience hall, accepting British rule on condition that Buddhism be protected.
zh:
马哈威利河上游湿润的高山谷地里，稻田沿坡层叠，四周是密林覆盖的山脊，这里是沿海平原上方的僧伽罗佛教地区。14世纪中期，布伐奈迦巴忽四世以甘波勒为都，通往圣足山的朝山路经过谷地的稻田；附近的森卡达加拉普拉（后来的康提）围着阿斯吉里亚寺形成聚落。1444年，科特国王对这片山地保有宗主权，但林隘阻隔，山地首领照旧掌管寺院、田租和自己的政务。

1469年，科特王族出身的塞纳萨马塔·维克拉马巴胡以森卡达加拉普拉为半独立王国的都治。1521年科特分裂后，锡达瓦卡的拉贾辛哈一世攻占山地；孔纳普·班达拉的父亲被国王杀害，他从葡占区逃回，夺取王位，称维马拉达尔马苏里亚一世。1594年，进山的葡军在丹图尔被全歼；次年他把佛牙舍利迎入康提，安放在王宫旁的佛牙寺。佛牙历来是僧伽罗正统君王的凭据，康提便成为最后一个独立的僧伽罗王廷。拉贾辛哈二世1638年3月28日在加诺鲁瓦再歼一支葡军，随后引荷兰人入岛；荷兰人1656年攻下科伦坡，把港口全部据为己有，康提的货物只能经荷兰港口进出。

1765年，一支以砍刀换下刺刀、适应丛林作战的荷兰军队开进已无人据守的康提，但疫病和康提狙击手不断消耗他们，1766年议和后沿海仍归荷兰。英国人1796年接管荷兰港口，1803年攻入康提，另立傀儡国王，留下的守军却被全歼，仅一人生还。末代国王自毁根基：纳亚克王朝的斯里·维克拉马·拉贾辛哈处死自己大臣的妻儿，贵族们便引导英军在1815年2月10日入城。国王出逃时被俘，流放韦洛尔；3月2日，贵族们在王宫觐见大殿签订《康提协定》，接受英国统治，条件是保全佛教。

en:
The Vanni is the forested mainland south of the Jaffna peninsula, a wide stretch of dry jungle, scrub and lagoons. Its rulers were Tamil chiefs called Vanniars, a title taken from vanam, the Tamil word for forest; each held a small forest fort with its surrounding villages, and their lands together, the Vannimai, made a buffer between the Tamil kings at Jaffna and the Sinhalese kingdoms further south. The chieftaincies grew up after the kingdom of Polonnaruwa broke apart in the thirteenth century, and in hard times the Vanniars sent tribute to whichever court was strongest. In 1444 the northern chiefs paid it to the Aryacakravarti kings of Jaffna, themselves recently brought under the overlordship of Vijayanagara, and elephants caught in the Vanni jungles were among the goods Jaffna sold abroad.

Around 1450, when Parakramabahu VI of Kotte attacked Jaffna, his adopted son Sapumal first marched through the Vanni and subdued its chiefs before crossing into the peninsula; the Jaffna king came back from Madurai with mercenaries in 1467 and the Vanni returned to him. Portuguese troops took Jaffna in 1621, and the chiefs afterwards answered in turn to Portuguese, Dutch and British masters, but the deep jungle let them keep most of their old autonomy. The last chief, Pandara Vanniyan, joined the kings of Kandy against the Europeans, until a Dutch-born officer in British service broke his revolt in 1803 and the Vanni passed under direct rule from Colombo.
zh:
万尼是贾夫纳半岛以南的林野，旱生丛林、灌木与潟湖绵延成片。统治者是称万尼亚尔的泰米尔酋长，名号出自泰米尔语「森林」一词；他们各据一座林中要塞和周围村庄，所辖领地合称万尼迈，横在北方贾夫纳的泰米尔国王与南方僧伽罗诸国之间。各酋长领是13世纪波隆纳鲁沃王国崩溃后兴起的，势弱时便向最强的朝廷纳贡。1444年，北部诸酋长向贾夫纳的阿利耶·查克拉瓦尔蒂王朝纳贡，而贾夫纳此时也刚被纳入毗奢耶那伽罗的宗主权之下；万尼丛林中捕来的大象，正是贾夫纳外销的货物之一。

1450年前后，科特国王波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世进攻贾夫纳，养子萨普马尔先攻入万尼压服诸酋长，再进入半岛；1467年，贾夫纳国王带着佣兵从马杜赖返国，万尼重归其治下。1621年葡萄牙军队攻占贾夫纳，此后诸酋长先后听命于葡萄牙人、荷兰人和英国人，但密林使他们保住了大部分旧有自治。末代酋长潘达拉·万尼扬与康提诸王联手对抗欧洲人，1803年被一名为英国效力的荷兰裔军官击败，起事瓦解，万尼改由科伦坡直接管辖。

en:
Tirunelveli lies on the west bank of the Thamirabarani, whose channels watered the rice country at the southern end of the Pandya lands. The Nellaiappar temple, dedicated to Shiva, was the later Pandyas' royal shrine, and its inscriptions link the town to the Pandya and Chola kings who built and enlarged the complex. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries Tirunelveli served as a secondary capital of Pandimandalam, a useful base between Madurai and the southern coast. When invasions broke Pandya power around Madurai, the surviving Tenkasi line held Tirunelveli and the far south from 1422 to 1499. In 1444 it remained a Tamil Hindu Pandya centre, fed by irrigated fields and linked by road to the coast.

The Madurai Nayaks made the town a subsidiary capital in the sixteenth century, and Vishwanatha Nayak rebuilt the town and its temples between 1529 and 1564. In 1647 the Chain Mandapam was built to link the Nellaiappar shrine with the Kanthimathi Amman temple. Power in the villages passed to palaiyakkarar chiefs with their own forts and troops. The Nawab of Arcot gained brief overlordship in 1743 and the Company first intervened in 1755, but the chiefs kept fighting. After Tinnevelly district was formed in 1790, Veerapandiya Kattabomman of Panchalankurichi led the polygar rising until he was hanged at Kayathar in 1799. When the wars ended in 1801, Palayamkottai became the garrison centre of the Company district.
zh:
蒂鲁内尔维利位于塔米拉巴拉尼河西岸，河渠灌溉着潘地亚疆域南端的稻米之乡。供奉湿婆的内莱亚帕尔神庙是后期潘地亚君主的王家神庙，庙中铭文把这座城与历代修建、扩建神庙的潘地亚和朱罗君主联系在一起。13至14世纪，蒂鲁内尔维利是潘迪曼达拉姆的副都，地处马杜赖和南部海岸之间，便于控制道路。苏丹国入侵瓦解了潘地亚在马杜赖周围的权力后，幸存的滕卡西王室于1422年至1499年据有蒂鲁内尔维利和极南之地。1444年，这里仍是泰米尔印度教徒的潘地亚中心，灌溉农田供给城邑，道路南通海岸。

16世纪，马杜赖纳亚克以此城为副都，维什瓦纳塔·纳亚克在1529年至1564年间重建城市和多处神庙。1647年，一条链形柱廊把内莱亚帕尔神殿与坎蒂马蒂·安曼神殿连接起来。地方实权随后落入帕莱亚卡尔首领手中，他们拥有堡垒和军队。阿尔果德纳瓦布1743年短暂取得宗主权，东印度公司1755年首次介入，但首领们仍继续作战。蒂内维利县于1790年设立后，潘恰兰库里奇的维拉潘迪亚·卡塔博曼领导波利加尔起事，最终于1799年在卡亚塔尔被绞死。战事1801年结束后，帕拉扬科泰成为东印度公司治下新县的驻军中心。

en:
Albazin is the cold upper Amur country, running from the Shilka and Argun confluence east toward the Urkan tributaries of the Zeya. In 1444 no outside garrison held it. Evenki clans followed elk and reindeer and trapped sable through the larch taiga, while Daur and Solon farmers kept the Amur bank in wooden strongholds ringed by fields. Sable furs carried their trade far into Siberia, but power stayed with the clans.

The first fort here rose in war. Hong Taiji's armies destroyed the Daur strongholds of Yaksa and Wukur in the 1639 campaign against the Solon leader Bombogor. In 1651 Yerofey Khabarov's Cossacks seized the stockade of the Daur prince Albaza, wintered in it and burned it when they moved on. In 1665 Nikifor Chernigovsky, a Polish exile who had murdered the voyevod of Ilimsk and fled to the Amur with a band of outlaws, rebuilt an ostrog on the ruins and called it Jaxa; he forwarded fur tribute to Siberia and played Moscow off against the Qing, whose letters to him were written in Polish. Moscow made Albazin a military district in 1682 under Aleksey Tolbuzin.

Once Taiwan fell, the Kangxi emperor turned north. In June 1685 a Qing army, its boats worked by former Zheng marines, heaped dry wood against the palisade, and Tolbuzin surrendered; his men withdrew to Nerchinsk, but some forty-five of them chose the Qing side and were enrolled in a Russian company of the banners in Beijing. Finding the crops still standing, the Russians slipped back to gather the harvest and rebuilt the fort in earth, and a Qing army returned in July 1686. Tolbuzin was killed by cannon fire on the fifth day, and Afanasy Baiton held out until scarcely a few dozen of more than eight hundred men remained alive, most of them dead of scurvy. The 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk ordered the fort abandoned and demolished.
zh:
阿勒巴沁（阿尔巴津）指黑龙江上游的寒冷地带，西起石勒喀河与额尔古纳河汇合处，向东延伸到结雅河的乌尔坎诸支流。1444年，这里没有外来驻军。鄂温克氏族在落叶松泰加林里追踪驼鹿和驯鹿、设套捕貂，达斡尔和索伦农人则在黑龙江边耕作，村外环绕木城。紫貂皮把他们的生意带到遥远的西伯利亚，但实权仍在各氏族手里。

这里的第一座堡垒诞生于战乱。1639年，皇太极征讨索伦首领博穆博果尔，摧毁了雅克萨、兀库尔等达斡尔木城。1651年，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫的哥萨克攻占达斡尔王公阿尔巴西的堡寨，在里面越冬，撤离时付之一炬。1665年，被流放西伯利亚的波兰人尼基弗尔·切尔尼戈夫斯基杀死伊利姆斯克督军，带着一伙亡命徒逃到黑龙江，在废墟上重建木堡，取名雅克萨；他向西伯利亚输送毛皮贡赋，在莫斯科和清朝之间两头周旋，清廷给他的文书甚至用波兰文书写。1682年，俄国设立阿尔巴津督军区，以阿列克谢·托尔布津为长官。

台湾平定后，康熙帝把兵锋转向北方。1685年6月，清军乘船而来，操舟的多为郑氏旧部水师，他们把干柴堆上木墙，托尔布津开城投降，部众撤往尼布楚，但有四十五人左右选择归附清朝，被编入北京八旗的俄罗斯佐领。俄人趁地里的庄稼尚未收割又潜回，改筑土城，清军1686年7月再度围城。托尔布津在围城第五天中炮身亡，阿法纳西·别伊顿继续据守，直到八百多人只剩数十，余众多死于坏血病。1689年《尼布楚条约》签订，要塞被奉命放弃拆毁。

en:
The Udi runs east from the Dzhagdy Mountains to Ud Bay on the Sea of Okhotsk, a cold forest corridor between the Stanovoy highlands and the coast. In 1444 Solon Evenki hunters used its upper woods and passes, while Lamut, or Even, families on the lower river and the shore lived from fishing and sea mammals. Sable moved out by forest track, river portage and coastal boat rather than through towns; winter camps were the most permanent settlements, and no fortress guarded the estuary.

Ivan Moskvitin's Cossacks, the first Russians to reach the Pacific overland, reached this coast in 1638 and explored the shore between the Tauy and the Udi; the local Lamuts told them of the Zeya and the Amur but would not guide them inland. In 1681 Cossacks built a winter hut on the lower river that grew into Udsk. Three years later a party fleeing the Manchus on the Zeya reached it and went on up the Maya to Yakutsk. At Nerchinsk in 1689 the Qing and Russian envoys left the country between the Khingan Mountains and the Udi without a settled boundary. Udsk never grew: about ten peasant families tried to grow grain and raise thin cattle, and seed corn sometimes had to be imported. A pood of rye flour that cost half a ruble at Irkutsk cost eight or ten rubles at Udsk, hauled seven to nine hundred miles along the Yakutsk track, at the end of which the pack horses were left as food for the post's sled dogs and the Yakut drivers walked home. The post held thirty people in 1690 and two hundred in 1800.
zh:
乌第河从贾格德山脉东流，注入鄂霍次克海乌第湾，是外兴安岭山地与海岸之间一条寒冷的森林通道。1444年，索伦鄂温克猎人在上游林地和山口间游猎，河口与海岸的拉穆特人（埃文人）以捕鱼和海兽为生。紫貂皮靠林间小路、河流转运和沿海船只外运，不经城镇；过冬营地比固定聚落更持久，河口无人戍守。

1638年，伊万·莫斯科维京率领最早从陆上抵达太平洋的俄国哥萨克到达这片海岸，探查了陶伊河与乌第河之间的岸线；拉穆特人对他们说起结雅河和黑龙江，却不肯带路入内陆。1681年，哥萨克在下游搭起过冬小屋，后来发展为乌德斯科耶；三年后，一队在结雅河躲避清军的哥萨克逃到此处，再溯马亚河退回雅库茨克。1689年《尼布楚条约》把外兴安岭与乌第河之间的土地留作待议，没有划界。乌德斯科耶始终没有长大：十来户农户试着种粮、养瘦牛，种子有时还要从外地运来。一普特黑麦粉在伊尔库茨克卖半卢布，到这里要八到十卢布，全靠雅库茨克商路辗转运上七八百英里；驮货的马匹到了站子通常被留下给雪橇犬充饥，雅库特车夫则步行或踏雪归去。这个据点1690年只有三十人，1800年有二百人。

en:
Birija is the Evenki word for 'river', the name Tungusic hunters gave to a long south-flowing tributary of the Amur, called the Niuman in Manchu and the Bureya on later maps. No town stood on its banks, only fishing camps and hunting stations. Evenki, Jurchen and Ducher families took sable from the hills and fish from the river, and pelts and dried fish moved out through tribute and barter. After the Ming withdrew from the Amur, no outside official or garrison remained in the valley by 1444.

The pelts brought the Russians. Poyarkov's Cossacks reached the Amur in 1643, and Yerofey Khabarov's boats worked into the Niuman in 1649-1651, entering the river in his record as the Fast River for its swift current. For forty years Cossack raiders and tribute parties fought Qing troops and local bands over the sable catch, until the Qing sieges of Albazin and the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689 put the whole Amur valley under Qing rule. No fortress was ever raised on the Bureya; through the next century its camps stayed quiet hunting grounds worked under the garrison at Aigun.
zh:
布列亚是埃文基语「河流」的意思，是通古斯猎人给这条南注黑龙江的长河起的名字，满语称牛满江，后来的地图上作布列亚河。河畔没有城镇，只有渔场和狩猎营地。鄂温克、女真和杜切尔人在山里猎紫貂、在河里捕鱼，皮货和鱼干通过朝贡与物物交换向外流通。明朝从黑龙江撤兵后，到1444年，河谷里已没有外来的官员和驻军。

把俄国人一路引来的是貂皮。波雅尔科夫的哥萨克1643年抵达黑龙江，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫的船队又在1649年至1651年驶入牛满江，因水流湍急，他的记录把这条河写作「快河」。此后四十年，哥萨克劫掠队和征贡队为争夺貂产，同清军和当地部落反复交战，直到清军围攻阿尔巴津、1689年《尼布楚条约》把整个黑龙江流域划归清朝。布列亚河畔始终没有筑起要塞，整个18世纪，各营地只是瑷珲驻军管下安静的渔猎之地。

en: The Kur, Kuru Bira in Manchu, runs 434 kilometres through a basin of 13,700 square kilometres to meet the Urmi and form the Tunguska, a left-bank tributary of the Amur. Its banks were country of the Hezhen, whom neighbouring peoples called the Fish-skin Tartars: they beat the skins of sturgeon and other great fish soft and sewed them into clothing, fished the flooded channels all summer, and dried salmon and sturgeon for the winter. Taimen, lenok and grayling lived in the river, and chum salmon ran almost to its springs. In 1444 Nanai-speaking fishing and hunting bands of the Kur-Urmi dialect camped along the banks, their shamans honouring the bear and the tiger. Nanai bands of the Amur fought the rising Manchus and gave in to Hong Taiji only in 1631. Qing geographers kept the Manchu name and counted the Kur the main stream of the Tunguska; through 1821 the valley held only scattered fishing camps.
zh: 库噜，满语称库噜必拉，全长434公里，流域面积13,700平方公里，与乌尔米河汇合后形成黑龙江左支流通古斯卡河。河畔是赫哲人的渔猎之地，邻部称他们为「鱼皮鞑子」：他们把鲟鳇等大鱼的鱼皮捶软，缝成衣服，整个夏天在漫水的河汊里捕鱼，把鲑鱼和鲟鱼风干过冬。水中有哲罗鲑、细鳞鲑和茴鱼，大马哈鱼几乎洄游到河源。1444年，说那乃语库噜—乌尔米方言的渔猎部落在两岸扎营，由萨满主持敬奉熊和虎。黑龙江一带的那乃部落曾抵抗新兴的满洲人，直到1631年才归降皇太极。清代地理书保留了满语河名，把库噜河算作通古斯卡河的正流；直到1821年，河谷里仍只有零星的渔村。

en:
Furdan is the lower Suifen River country, where the river breaks through the coastal ranges into the Sea of Japan. Its lowlands hold the ruins of two great walled towns: Shuaibin, the Balhae prefecture whose pastures were famous for horses, and Supin, the Jin circuit built on the same ground. On a hill above them Puxian Wannu, founder of the Jurchen kingdom of Eastern Xia, enlarged an old fort into his upper capital Kaiyuan, its walls enclosing some 180 hectares. The Mongols stormed Shuaibin and Kaiyuan in 1233, and in 1246 they carried the people left in the district off to the Liao River valley; the Ming later posted the Shuangcheng Guard over the emptied country. By 1444 Warka Jurchen of the Eastern Sea clans hunted, fished and dug ginseng among the old earthworks, their chiefs holding Ming patents and trading sable and ginseng with the Jianzhou and across the border with Korea.

The Suifen clans were the prize in the feud between Nurhaci's Jianzhou and Bujantai's Ula, both bidding for the Eastern Sea Jurchen. After Jianzhou troops broke Ula at Wujieyan in 1607, the clans of the Suifen submitted and entered the Manchu realm. Under the Qing the country became a sealed corner of the Ningguta banner garrison, its ginseng hills and sable forests closed to civilian settlers. In 1709 the French Jesuits Régis, Jartoux and Fridelli surveyed the district for the Kangxi Atlas and found the Balhae and Jin towns already heaps of weathered earth. Their notes went to the cartographer d'Anville, whose 1734 map of China carried the name Furdan onto European maps for the first time.
zh:
富尔丹即绥芬河下游之地，绥芬河在此穿过沿海群山注入日本海。河畔低地上存着两座大城的废墟：渤海率宾府的牧场以产马闻名，金朝恤品路的治所也设在同一处。附近山顶上，东夏开国者蒲鲜万奴把旧山城扩建为上都开元，城墙圈起约一百八十公顷。1233年蒙古军攻克率宾与开元，1246年又把残余人口迁往辽河流域；明朝后来在这片荒疏之地设双城卫。到1444年，东海女真瓦尔喀诸部在旧城的夯土残垣间渔猎采参，酋长持有明朝敕书，以紫貂、人参与建州女真和朝鲜往来贸易。

绥芬诸部是努尔哈赤的建州与布占泰的乌拉长期争夺的目标，两边都在招抚东海女真。1607年建州兵在乌碣岩大破乌拉之后，绥芬一带的部族归附，进入满洲版图。入清以后，这里成为宁古塔驻防辖下的封禁之地，参山貂林不许民人开垦。1709年，法国耶稣会士雷孝思、杜德美、费隐为《皇舆全览图》到此测绘，发现渤海与金朝的城镇已成风化的土堆；他们的资料交给制图师当维尔，后者1734年绘制的中国地图第一次把「傅尔丹」一名带进欧洲。

en:
Ningguta lies in the wooded valley of the Hurka, now the Mudan River, which runs north through the Changbai foothills to the Sungari. Its name means 'six' in Manchu, for six grandsons of the Jianzhou chief Möngke Temür guarded the place, and with Sanxing it was remembered as one of the two oldest seats of the Manchus-to-be. Upstream at Dongjingcheng stood the ruins of Shangjing Longquanfu, capital of Balhae until the Khitan ended the kingdom in 926. In 1444 the valley was Jianzhou Jurchen country: clans hunted sable, fished and grew millet, and bartered pelts at the Ming border markets for grain, iron and cloth.

After the Qing entered China the court still treated Ningguta as ancestral ground and the base against the Cossacks raiding down the Amur. In 1652 Sarhuda arrived with 2,000 horsemen, armed with bows, matchlocks and iron cannon, to raise the first Qing garrison beyond the Willow Palisade. In 1658 he led several dozen boats, carrying Korean musketeers under Shin Ryu, down the Hurka and Sungari and destroyed Onufriy Stepanov's Cossack flotilla near the Sungari's mouth, with most of the Russians killed or captured. His son Bahai became the first Ningguta military governor in 1662, and four years later the seat moved from the old stockade on the Hailang River to a new walled city on the Hurka, the later site of Ning'an. The governor moved to Jilin in 1676, leaving a deputy lieutenant-general whose reach ran east to the Sea of Japan.

From the 1650s Ningguta was the Qing empire's most feared place of exile. Fang Gongqian, himself sent there, wrote that a man who had reached Ningguta need not fear even ten roads to the Yellow Springs. The sea lord Zheng Zhilong was exiled to the town and, by one account, put to death there; the scholar Wu Zhaoqian, condemned in the Jiangnan examination case of 1657, came home only in 1681 after friends paid for his redemption, twenty-three years after he left. Traders followed the exiles: when Jesuits passed through in 1709 with an imperial ginseng party, Han merchants and banished farmers crowded the streets, and the town dealt in ginseng and sable pelts taxed from the Nanai on the lower Sungari.
zh:
宁古塔地处虎尔哈河（今牡丹江）的林谷，河水穿过长白山余脉北流，汇入松花江。其名在满语中意为「六个」，因建州酋长猛哥帖木儿的六个孙子分守此地而得名；它与三姓并称后来满族人最古老的两处居地之一。上游东京城一带留有上京龙泉府遗址，926年契丹灭渤海之前，那里长期是渤海王都。1444年的虎尔哈河谷是建州女真的土地：各部猎貂、捕鱼、种黍，到明朝边市上以皮张换取粮食、铁器和布帛。

清朝入关之后，仍把宁古塔视作龙兴故地，这里也成了对窜入黑龙江流域的哥萨克作战的基地。1652年，沙尔虎达率两千骑兵进驻，配备弓矢、鸟枪和铁炮，建立柳条边外第一处清军驻防。1658年，他率战船数十艘，会同申浏带领的朝鲜鸟枪手顺虎尔哈河、松花江而下，在松花江口击溃奥努弗里·斯捷潘诺夫的哥萨克船队，俄军大多被击毙或生俘。1662年，其子巴海出任首任宁古塔将军；四年后，治所从海浪河畔的旧城迁往虎尔哈河畔的新城，即后来的宁安城。1676年将军移治吉林，留下一名副都统，辖地向东一直到日本海。

从1650年代起，宁古塔是清朝最令人胆寒的流放地。也被流放至此的方拱乾写道：「人说黄泉路，若到了宁古塔，便有十个黄泉也不怕了。」海商郑芝龙被遣戍到此，一说即遇害于此；文人吴兆骞因1657年的丁酉科场案流放，友人纳资赎还，到1681年才得以回乡，前后已二十三年。与流人同来的还有商人：1709年耶稣会士随皇家采参队经过这里时，汉商和流放垦荒的农户挤满街巷，城中买卖人参，还有从松花江下游赫哲人那里征来的貂皮。

en:
Huncun is the lower Tumen River country, a short way inland from the Sea of Japan, where Korea, the Jurchen lands and the coast draw close. Balhae built its Eastern Capital, Longyuan Fu, at Baliancheng on this plain, and Fangchuan at the river mouth was the port of the Tang-era 'Japan Road', from which ships carried trade goods across to the home islands; local tradition also makes this the ground where the Jin dynasty's Wanyan clan founded its power. Later ages kept the district as a border stronghold, and the Ming Nurgan command posted its guards among the Warka Jurchen clans on the Huncun River, whom Korea called its 'subordinate barbarians'. In 1444 the clans lived by hunting and fishing under chiefs holding Ming patents, paying sable and ginseng tribute and bartering across the Tumen with Korea's six northern garrisons.

The district's fate turned on the feud between Nurhaci's Jianzhou and Bujantai's Ula for the Eastern Sea Jurchen. In the first month of 1607 Cemutehe, lord of the old walled town of Feiyou west of Huncun, offered his whole clan to Nurhaci to escape Ula. Nurhaci sent his brother Surhaci to escort them, and Jianzhou troops moved out the population and burned the town, then routed ten thousand Ula pursuers at Wujieyan near the Korean border town of Jongseong and killed their commander Bokeduo. Ula power never returned to the Tumen basin, and the remaining Eastern Sea clans submitted. Under the Qing the country was a closed imperial reserve under the Ningguta military government, its ginseng hills and pearl rivers barred to civilian settlers. The Huncun commandant was created in 1714, the first official use of the name; his yamen and the walled town rose on the north bank of the Huncun River the next year.

zh:
珲春地处图们江下游，东南距日本海不远，朝鲜、女真与海岸地带在此相接。渤海国在这片平原上建有东京龙原府八连城，江口的防川是唐代「日本道」的出海口，商船从这里载货东渡日本；相传金朝皇室的完颜部也在这一带肇基王业。历代都以此地为边寨要冲，明朝奴儿干都司在珲春河一带的瓦尔喀诸部中设置卫所，朝鲜则把这些人称作「藩胡」。1444年，瓦尔喀人在此渔猎，酋长持明朝敕书，贡纳紫貂、人参，并渡江与朝鲜六镇互市。

珲春的命运，系于努尔哈赤的建州与布占泰的乌拉对东海女真的争夺。1607年正月，珲春以西古城斐优城的城主策穆特黑为摆脱乌拉，举部投奔努尔哈赤。努尔哈赤派弟弟舒尔哈齐前往接应，建州兵迁出城中人口、焚城而走，随后在朝鲜边镇钟城附近的乌碣岩击溃一万乌拉追兵，阵斩主将博克多。乌拉势力再未回到图们江流域，其余东海女真各部相继归服。入清以后，此地归宁古塔统辖，划为封禁之地，参山珠河不许民人进入。1714年清朝设珲春协领，珲春之名首次见于官方文书，次年珲春协领衙门在珲春河北岸建成，城池也随之兴筑。

en:
Boduna lies where the Nen runs into the Sungari, among the reed marshes and lakes of the Songnen plain. The Sibe fished, hunted and pastured their herds here as vassals of the eastern Mongol clans, their camps strung along the rivers, for Boduna had no walled town. Its name is Mongolian for 'quail'. In 1444 the Qasarid Khorchin pastured beyond the Nen, and the Sibe country answered to them.

The southward-moving Khorchin subdued the Sibe in the mid-16th century, and Sibe riders marched in the nine-tribe army that Nurhaci destroyed at Gule Mountain in 1593. Once the Qing turned to face Russia on the Amur, Boduna became a link on the post road from Jilin to Qiqihar. In 1692 the throne redeemed the Sibe, Gualca and Daur from the Khorchin princes and enrolled the Sibe in the upper three banners. A vice commander took post at Boduna, and a brick New City went up beside the post station in 1693, one of the seven garrison towns beyond the willow palisade that fed and reinforced the Heilongjiang frontier. The Sibe did not stay long: in 1699 the companies here were moved south to Shengjing, and in 1764 more than a thousand Sibe soldiers with their families marched from Shengjing to Ili, over a year on the road, to hold the new Xinjiang border as the Sibe Eight Banners.
zh:
白都讷（伯都讷）在嫩江汇入松花江处，松嫩平原的芦苇泡沼之间。锡伯人在此渔猎放牧，臣属于东部蒙古诸部，营地沿河散布，因为白都讷没有城池。地名是蒙古语，意为鹌鹑。1444年，合撒儿后裔的科尔沁部在嫩江对岸游牧，锡伯之地受其役属。

16世纪中叶，南下的科尔沁收服锡伯；1593年，锡伯骑兵随九部联军攻伐努尔哈赤，在古勒山一战溃败。清朝转头经营黑龙江对俄防务后，白都讷成了吉林至齐齐哈尔驿道上的一站。1692年，朝廷向科尔沁王公赎买锡伯、卦尔察、达斡尔人丁，将锡伯编入上三旗；白都讷移驻副都统，1693年在驿站旁筑起砖城新城，是柳条边外七大驻防重镇之一，为黑龙江前线供粮增援。锡伯人没有在此久留：1699年，白都讷的锡伯佐领被南迁盛京；1764年，一千余名锡伯兵携家眷从盛京出发，跋涉一年有余抵达伊犁，编为锡伯营，戍守新疆新边。

en:
The Yehe River winds through wooded hills in southern Jilin, just beyond the Ming frontier at Kaiyuan; the Ming called this country the North Pass. In 1444 its valleys were hunting grounds of the Haixi Jurchens, one of the three Jurchen groupings, who lived in stockaded hill camps and farmed beside them. Yehe's rulers came from outside. Singgen Darhan, a Mongol of the Tümed, seized the Nara town of Zhang in Hulun, took the name Nara, and led his followers to the Yehe. His descendants Cinggiyanu and Yangginu united the local bands and raised two walled towns on the banks, and the brothers each ruled as beile. By the 1580s Yehe overawed the other three Hulun nations, Hada, Ula and Hoifa, and alone could face Nurhaci's Jianzhou.

Yangginu's daughter wed Nurhaci in 1588 and bore him Hong Taiji, but the marriage bond did not hold. In 1593 Yehe led a nine-tribe host, numbering 30,000 in Ming accounts, against him. At Mount Gule the allies were lured uphill into a Jianzhou ambush: the Yehe beile Bujai was thrown from his horse by a rolling log and killed, and the Ula beile Bujantai was captured. Nurhaci sent half of Bujai's corpse back to Yehe. To mend the feud, Bujai's daughter, the Old Lady of Ming records, was promised to Nurhaci and then offered to chiefs of Hada, Hoifa and Ula; past thirty, she was at last given to a Khalkha Mongol in 1615 and died within a year. Nurhaci named the broken match among his Seven Grievances in 1618.

In 1619, after his victory over the Ming at Sarhu, Nurhaci marched on the two towns. His sappers mined the east-town wall until it caved in. Hong Taiji, Gintaisi's nephew, called on his uncle to surrender; Gintaisi set fire to his tower, was caught fleeing and strangled. Buyanggu surrendered the west town and was put to death too, and the Yehe people were enrolled in the Eight Banners. The clan later served the dynasty it had fought. Gintaisi's grandson Mingzhu became a Kangxi grand secretary, and Mingzhu's son Nalan Xingde, dead at thirty, became one of the best-loved poets of the early Qing.
zh:
叶赫河穿行在吉林南部的丘陵林地间，河外不远便是明朝开原边墙，明人把这片地方称作「北关」。1444年，河谷两岸是海西女真的猎场。海西是明代女真三大部之一，部人依小山筑城寨而居，寨旁耕种。叶赫的统治者却来自外部：蒙古土默特部的星根达尔汉攻取扈伦国那拉氏的张城，改姓那拉，率部来到叶赫河畔。他的后代清佳砮、杨吉砮兄弟统一诸部，在河两岸各筑一城隔水相望，兄弟同称贝勒。到1580年代，叶赫已压过扈伦其余哈达、乌拉、辉发三部，唯有它能与努尔哈赤新兴的建州相抗。

两部先以联姻相连：1588年，杨吉砮之女嫁给努尔哈赤，生下皇太极。但盟约没有维持多久。1593年，叶赫率领九部联军来攻，明人记载兵力有三万。古勒山一战，建州兵诱联军仰攻、伏兵四起，叶赫贝勒布寨被滚木掀翻坐骑、当场战死，乌拉贝勒布占泰被生擒。努尔哈赤把布寨的尸首砍下一半送回叶赫。为修盟好，明人记载中的「老女」、布寨之女随后被许嫁努尔哈赤，此后又先后许给哈达、辉发、乌拉的酋长；直到三十多岁，她才在1615年嫁给蒙古喀尔喀部人，不到一年便去世。1618年，努尔哈赤把这桩毁婚列为对明七大恨之一。

1619年，努尔哈赤在萨尔浒大破明军之后，进围叶赫两城。后金军在东城墙下挖掘，直到墙陷。皇太极的生母是金台石之妹，他到城下唤舅父归降，金台石不肯，纵火焚台，逃跑时被擒，随后缢死。布扬古献出西城，也被处死，叶赫部众尽数编入八旗。这个与后金死战到底的氏族后来转而效力于它所对抗的王朝：金台石之孙在康熙朝官至保和殿大学士，曾孙纳兰性德三十岁早逝，是清初最受喜爱的词人之一。

en:
The Suzi River runs west out of the Changbai foothills to join the Hun, and Hetu Ala, the 'Horizontal Ridge' in Manchu, rises on a terrace above its south bank in the hills east of the Ming frontier town of Fushun. In 1444 these valleys were the new homeland of the Jianzhou Jurchens, who had moved south from the country around the Mudan and Sungari; the Ming enrolled them in the three Jianzhou guards and let each chief rule his people by their old customs. The camp on the ridge belonged to the chieftain Giocangga, and here in 1559 his grandson Nurhaci was born. Giocangga and Nurhaci's father Taksi were killed by Ming troops at a rival's fort in 1583, and Nurhaci set out with thirteen sets of inherited armour to avenge them.

His first walled camp, Fe Ala, rose nearby, and in 1603 he built on a larger scale at Hetu Ala. An inner wall of timber and stone, five li around, held his kin; an earthen outer rampart ten li long with nine gates held his veteran companies, and the two walls contained perhaps 20,000 households. Armorers worked outside the north gate forging armour, bowyers and fletchers crowded the south gate, and eighteen granary compounds stood beyond the east gate. In the Octagonal Hall in 1616 Nurhaci proclaimed himself Tianming Khan and founded the Later Jin; in 1618 he announced the Seven Grievances and marched on Fushun. After taking Liaoyang he raised the Eastern Capital there in 1621 and moved his court the next year, and Hetu Ala became the Old City; in 1634 Hong Taiji renamed it Xingjing. The family tombs followed the court, but Giocangga and Taksi were brought back to the Yong Mausoleum west of the walls, and the ridge remained the ancestral ground of the Qing.
zh:
苏子河从长白山余脉西流，汇入浑河；满语意为「横岗」的赫图阿拉，高踞在河南岸的一处台地上，地处明朝边镇抚顺以东的山林里。1444年，这片河谷是建州女真新近落脚的家园，他们从牡丹江、松花江汇流一带南徙而来，明朝把他们编入建州三卫，各部首领仍按旧俗统领部众。岗上的城寨属于酋长觉昌安，1559年，他的孙子努尔哈赤出生在这里。1583年，觉昌安和努尔哈赤之父塔克世在明军攻打别的女真城寨时死于乱军，努尔哈赤凭先人留下的十三副铠甲起兵复仇。

他的第一座城寨佛阿拉就筑在附近，1603年又在赫图阿拉大兴土木。内城以木石杂筑，周五里，住着他的亲族；夯土外城周十里，开九门，驻扎精锐旧部，两城之内约有两万户人家。北门外是专治铠甲的铁匠，南门外聚居着弓匠和箭匠，东门外列着十八座仓廒。1616年，努尔哈赤在八角殿称天命汗，建立后金；1618年他以七大恨告天，出兵抚顺。攻下辽阳后，他于1621年在当地营建东京城，次年迁都，赫图阿拉便只称老城；1634年皇太极下令改名兴京。家族陵寝随后迁走，觉昌安和塔克世的遗骨后来归葬城西的永陵，这座横岗一直是清朝的祖居之地。

en:
Andong is the country around the mouth of the Yalu, where the river dividing Liaodong from Korea leaves its wooded hills and runs into the Yellow Sea. The name is an old frontier title: after the Tang destroyed Goguryeo in 668 they set up the Andong Protectorate over these lands. The Liao built Laiyuan Fort at Jiuliancheng, where the river ferry met the road to Liaoyang, and under the Ming the country was held by scattered stockades and beacon posts rather than walled cities. In 1444 this was the quiet eastern edge of the Ming world, with the loyal tributary kingdom of Joseon on the far bank.

Late in the fifteenth century the Ming carried the eastern arm of their frontier wall down to the river at Hushan. The Later Jin overran the country after Sarhu in 1619, but in 1621 the guerrilla Mao Wenlong led 197 raiders through the Jin rear and stormed Zhenjiang Fort on the river, carrying off its commander in the first Ming success of the war, celebrated as the Zhenjiang Triumph. Driven out in his turn, Mao held Pi Island just beyond the Yalu mouth as the base of his Dongjiang fleet and harried the Jin flank until Yuan Chonghuan had him executed in 1629. Amin crossed the river to subdue Joseon in 1627, and the peace opened a border market at Chunggang on the river; Hong Taiji crossed again in 1636, King Injo submitted at Samjeondo the next year, and an army under Ajige stormed Pi Island and killed its commander Shen Shikui, clearing the last Ming force off the estuary. Under the Qing the Yalu remained a guarded but trading border, run by the Shengjing garrison general.
zh:
安东是鸭绿江入海口一带的地方——这条分隔辽东与朝鲜的大江流出群山，在丘陵间注入黄海。「安东」是个古老的边地名号：668年唐灭高句丽，便在这片土地上置安东都护府。辽代在九连城筑来远城，扼守江渡与通往辽阳的大路；明代此地不筑大城，归辽东都司管辖，只靠分散的堡寨和烽燧戍守。1444年，这里是大明世界最安静的东缘，江对岸是恭顺的藩属朝鲜国。

15世纪后期，明廷把边墙东段一直修到鸭绿江畔的虎山。1619年萨尔浒之战后，这片土地落入后金之手；但1621年，明游击毛文龙率一百九十七名死士深入敌后，奇袭江边的镇江堡，擒获守将，是为明朝对后金的首场胜仗「镇江大捷」。毛文龙随后退据鸭绿江口外的皮岛，开东江镇，以水师不断袭扰后金侧翼，直到1629年被袁崇焕诛杀。1627年阿敏跨江征讨朝鲜，战后盟约在江边的中江开设边市；1636年皇太极再次渡江，朝鲜仁祖次年在三田渡投降，阿济格又攻破皮岛、斩杀明将沈世魁，江口外再无明军。清代，鸭绿江是一条设防而通商的边界，归盛京将军管辖。

en:
Gaizhou stands on the northwest shore of the Liaodong Peninsula, where coastal hills fall to the Bohai Sea. Han settlers founded Pingguo County here; under Goguryeo the place was Gaimou and then Jian'an, whose fortress a Tang army took in 645, and after the Bohai and Liao renamings the Jin restored the name Gaizhou in 1195. In 1371 the Ming made it the Gaizhou Guard and walled a new city the next year. With the guards at Jinzhou, Fuzhou and Haizhou it formed the 'four southern guards', supplied and judged across the water from Shandong. The city's Xuanzhen Guan, founded in 1382 for the Dark Warrior, had an eight-bay main hall, a rare Ming timber hall in the northeast. In 1444 Gaizhou was a walled guard town and fishing port, its boats plying south to the Shandong coast.

The guard submitted to the Later Jin in 1621 with the fall of Shenyang and Liaoyang. Two men born in the guard helped the Qing win the south: Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming had both ridden with Mao Wenlong's island army and, after Mao's death, served the Ming governor Sun Yuanhua at Dengzhou. Ordered to relieve Dalinghe in 1631, they mutinied and took Dengzhou, then crossed to the Later Jin by sea in 1633 with their fleet and troops. Kong, made Prince Dingnan, campaigned into Guangxi and killed himself after his army was broken before Guilin in 1652. Geng, made Prince Jingnan, died on campaign in the south in 1649; his grandson Geng Jingzhong was one of the three feudatory princes who rose against the Qing in the 1670s.

The Qing made the city Gaiping County in 1664, joining characters from the old names Gaizhou and Pingguo. South of the city the old post of Xiongyue carried the military weight of south Liaodong. One of nine city-garrison posts set up beyond Shanhai Pass in 1644, it held a defense lieutenant and a thousand bannermen after 1687; Bargu Mongol horsemen arrived in 1692 and 131 Sibe in 1699. In 1727 a deputy lieutenant-general took his seat there over every banner post from the Yalu to the Liaodong Peninsula. Gaiping itself stayed the market town of a fishing and coasting shore.
zh:
盖州位于辽东半岛西北岸，滨海丘陵在此俯临渤海。汉代置平郭县；高句丽时先后称盖牟、建安，645年唐军攻下建安城；经渤海、辽代改名后，金朝于1195年复称盖州。1371年明朝改置盖州卫，次年筑起新城。它与金州、复州、海州三卫合称「南四卫」，粮秣刑名跨海归山东管辖。城内的玄贞观始建于1382年，供奉玄武大帝，八开间的大殿是东北少见的明代木构大殿。1444年，盖州是一座筑城屯守的渔业海港，卫里的船只往返于山东海岸。

1621年沈阳、辽阳失守，盖州卫随辽东各卫归降后金。卫城出身的两个人后来替清朝打下南方：孔有德、耿仲明都生于盖州卫，早年在毛文龙的岛军中效力，毛文龙死后转到登州巡抚孙元化麾下。1631年二人奉命赴援大凌河，中途兵变，攻占登州，1633年率船队和部众渡海归降后金。孔有德封定南王，一直打到广西，1652年所部在桂林覆灭后自尽；耿仲明封靖南王，1649年南征途中死去，其孙耿精忠正是1670年代起兵反清的三藩之一。

清代，1664年取盖州、平郭两地名之首字置盖平县。城南不远的熊岳城承担着辽南的军事：1644年它是关外最早设立的九处城守官驻地之一，1687年改设防守尉，驻兵一千；1692年巴尔虎蒙古骑兵调到此处，1699年又有一百三十一名锡伯兵入驻。1727年，熊岳置副都统，统辖鸭绿江至辽东半岛的各处旗营。盖平本身则一直是这片渔舟往来的海岸上的集镇。

en:
Ereen is named after the Ereen Dabsan Nuur, the variegated salt lake set in the Gobi steppe where the Xilingol grasslands run out into the Khalkha desert. Mongol herdsmen pastured sheep and camels around its brine pools, and the lake salt drew flocks and traders from both sides of the desert; armies and caravans used this narrow crossing to get through the Gobi. In 1444 the pastures belonged to Mongol otogs under the Northern Yuan khan Taisun, and the Sünid grazed here under their own lords. Real power sat with Taisun's Oirat taishi Esen, whose horsemen destroyed the Zhengtong Emperor's army at Tumu in 1449 and carried the emperor off.

After Dayan Khan, reigning from 1480 to 1517, reunited the Mongols, these pastures went to his left wing, and the Sünid became a tribe of the Chahar tumen. When Ligdan Khan pressed the southern tribes hard, their chiefs Tenggis and Susai led the Sünid north to the Khalkha and then submitted to Hong Taiji; in 1641 and 1642 the tribe was set in two banners under the Xilingol League. Tenggis rose against the Qing in 1646 at the Sechen Khan's urging, and an army under Dodo chased him as far as the Tula river before he surrendered in 1648. Qing peace opened the desert road, and the track from Kalgan to Khüree filled with camel trains carrying tea, silk and cotton north and Siberian furs south; the Gobi crossing alone took thirty to forty days. In 1820 the Yilin relay station was built beside the salt lake to water them.
zh:
二连浩特（额仁）得名于额仁达布散淖尔，即戈壁草原上的「斑斓盐湖」，地处锡林郭勒草原没入喀尔喀戈壁的过渡地带。蒙古牧人在湖畔盐碱滩放牧羊和骆驼，湖盐吸引着大漠南北的畜群与客商；兵马与商队也借这条狭窄旱路穿过戈壁。1444年，湖畔牧场属于北元岱总汗治下的蒙古鄂托克，苏尼特人在自己的领主率领下游牧于此，实权则握在岱总汗的瓦剌太师也先手中：1449年，他的兵马在土木堡消灭明英宗的大军，俘走皇帝。

达延汗1480年至1517年重新统一蒙古后，这片牧场划归左翼，苏尼特后来成为察哈尔万户之一部。林丹汗威逼漠南诸部时，首领腾机思、素塞率部北避喀尔喀，随后归附皇太极；1641年和1642年，苏尼特部编为两旗，会盟于锡林郭勒。1646年，腾机思在车臣汗鼓动下反清，多铎的大军一直追到土拉河，他才在1648年归降。清代承平使戈壁旱路畅通，张家口至库伦的驼队往来不绝，南运的是西伯利亚毛皮，北去的是茶叶、丝绸和棉布，单是横穿戈壁就要三四十天。1820年，湖畔设立伊林驿站，为驼队补给饮水。

en:
The Luan rises here in high pasture between the Gobi and the Ming wall. On this grassland stood Shangdu, Xanadu in Marco Polo's account: the monk-architect Liu Bingzhong built it as Kublai's Kaiping in 1256, Kublai was enthroned there in 1260, and from 1263 it was his summer capital of marble halls and a portable cane palace carried with the camp. Ming armies sacked it in 1369 and left the walls empty. The Chahar grew from the Yuan khans' personal guard and drifted north onto the steppe in the fifteenth century. In 1444 this was Northern Yuan pasture; Taisun Khan shared power with his Oirat strongman Esen, and the Chahar were not yet the Great Khan's own tumen.

Under Dayan Khan the Chahar became one of the six eastern tumens, the Great Khan's personal appanage of the left wing. When Altan Khan pressed from the west in the mid-sixteenth century, Daraisung Guden Khan led them east to the Liao. Ligdan Khan, the last Great Khan the Mongols recognised, tried to rebuild Mongol power: he took the Tümed city of Guihua in 1627, the Ming paid him 81,000 taels a year for the border-trade monopoly, and his campaigns drove the Khorchin and other tribes to the Later Jin. In 1632 Hong Taiji marched against him with a hundred thousand men; Ligdan fled toward Qinghai and died of smallpox on the Gansu steppe in 1634. His son Ejei surrendered the Yuan imperial seal the next year and was enfeoffed at Yizhou; in 1636 the southern Mongol lords met at Mukden and hailed Hong Taiji as their khan.

The Chahar princely line ended in 1675, when the young prince Burni rose with three thousand riders during the Revolt of the Three Feudatories. Qing troops broke him within two months and executed the Chahar royals after the battle of 20 April; the Qing moved the tribe to the Dolon Nor–Zhangjiakou line as the Chahar Eight Banners, answerable to the throne alone. In 1691 Kangxi came to Dolon Nor to receive the Khalkha khans and founded the Huizong Monastery, built through 1712, which drew pilgrims and caravans to the town.
zh:
滦河发源于此，高原草场铺展在戈壁与明长城之间。草原上立着上都的城址：马可·波罗曾到此，把大理石宫殿和可拆装行帐写进游记，使它在欧洲以「Xanadu」之名传开。僧人建筑师刘秉忠1256年为忽必烈建起开平城，忽必烈1260年在此即大汗位，1263年起作为避暑理政的夏都。1369年明军攻克上都，城垣就此空置。察哈尔人由元朝大汗的亲军护卫演变而来，15世纪间北迁到这片草原。1444年，这里是北元的牧场；脱脱不花汗与权臣也先同掌大权，察哈尔此时还不是大汗亲领的万户。

达延汗时，察哈尔成为东蒙古六万户之一，是左翼中大汗亲领的封地。16世纪中叶俺答汗从西边施压，达赉孙库登汗率部东迁到辽河流域。林丹汗是最后一位受公认的蒙古大汗，力图重振汗权：1627年他攻下土默特人的归化城，明朝年给白银八万一千两和边贸之利，他的连年用兵却把科尔沁等部逼向后金。1632年，皇太极率十万大军来攻，林丹汗西逃青海，1634年染天花死于甘肃大草滩。其子额哲第二年携传国玉玺归降，受封亲王、安置于义州；1636年，漠南蒙古各部在沈阳尊皇太极为汗。

察哈尔王公一系终结于1675年：年轻的亲王布尔尼趁三藩之乱率三千人起兵，清军不到两个月将其击败，王族在4月20日一战后被诛。部众被迁到多伦诺尔至张家口一线，编为察哈尔八旗，不设盟长，直属皇帝。1691年，康熙到多伦诺尔接受喀尔喀诸汗归附，下令营建汇宗寺，工程持续到1712年，朝觐者和商队随之来到这座新城。

en:
The Ih Huree country is the valley of the Tuul, where the river runs beneath the forested bulk of Bogd Khan Mountain: rich summer pasture on the road between Karakorum and the sacred Khentii. Toghrul, the Kerait khan known in Chinese records as Wang Khan, kept his palace camp in the Black Forest on this river and forbade hunting on the mountain; Marco Polo identified him with the legendary priest-king Prester John, and Genghis is said to have camped here in 1226 before his last campaign against the Tangut. No town stood here in 1444. The clans grazing the valley looked to the Chinggisid khan Taisun, whose Oirat taishi Esen held the real armed power, and the Buddhism that would one day fill the valley with monasteries had not yet crossed the Gobi.

In 1639 the Khalkha nobles pitched a great yurt monastery at Lake Shireet Tsagaan Nuur as the seat of Zanabazar, the four-year-old first Jebtsundamba Khutuktu. This was Örgöö, the palace camp, which moved its tents twenty-nine times along the Orkhon, Selenge and Tuul and was once carried into Inner Mongolia before Galdan's advance. Zanabazar, schooled in Tibet, became Mongolia's foremost sculptor and scholar, casting the White Tara and other famous images, and in 1686 he devised the Soyombo script to help translate Tibetan texts. After the Treaty of Kyakhta in 1727 the Beijing–Kyakhta caravan road ran through Khüree, where Siberian furs were bartered for Chinese cloth and tea, and a Chinese Maimaicheng grew up east of the camp; by the early eighteenth century it was called Ikh Khüree, the Great Enclosure. A Qing amban arrived in 1758, and in 1778 the monastery settled for good beneath Bogd Khan Mountain, the same year Beijing recognised the annual sacrifice there. Gandan Monastery was founded in 1809, and by 1810 some thirteen thousand monks lived in the camp; executions were carried out where its temples could not be seen.
zh:
大库伦一带是土拉河谷地，河水在林木茂密的博克多汗山下流过；这里水草丰美，处在哈拉和林通往神圣肯特山的大道上。克烈部可汗王罕的斡耳朵就设在土拉河畔的黑林，他禁止在博克多汗山狩猎；马可·波罗把他对应为传说中的祭司王约翰。相传1226年成吉思汗最后一次出征西夏前，也曾在此驻营。1444年此地还没有城镇，在河谷放牧的部众听命于成吉思汗后裔岱总汗，兵权却在卫拉特太师也先手里；日后让这里寺院林立的佛教，此时还没有越过戈壁。

1639年，喀尔喀贵族在希雷特查干湖畔支起大帐寺院，作为年仅四岁的一世哲布尊丹巴活佛扎那巴扎尔的驻锡地，这便是「乌尔嘎」，即宫殿之帐。此后它的帐篷沿鄂尔浑河、色楞格河和土拉河迁徙了二十九次，噶尔丹东进时还曾一度避入内蒙古。扎那巴扎尔在西藏学成，是蒙古首屈一指的造像师和学者，所铸白度母等像最为有名；1686年，他为翻译藏文经典创制了索永布文字。1727年《恰克图条约》后，北京通往恰克图的驼道经过库伦，西伯利亚毛皮在此换取中国布匹和茶叶，帐营以东兴起汉商的买卖城；18世纪初其地已称伊赫库伦，汉译大库伦。清朝自1758年派驻办事大臣；1778年，寺院在博克多汗山下定居，同年清廷认可每年的祭山大典。甘丹寺建于1809年，到1810年约有一万三千名僧人住在帐营中；就连行刑，也要选在看不见寺院的地方。

en:
Zasagt is the dry southern reach of what became the Khalkha western wing, where Gobi pastures rise toward the Govi-Altai and the headwaters of the Zag River. In 1444 the herdsmen moving between desert-edge winter camps and mountain summer pastures spoke Khalkha, but their grazing lands lay inside Esen Taishi's Oirat confederation. They followed the Tengri cult and lived on the long frontier where Khalkha princes pressed westward against Oirat power. Subadai became the first Zasagt Khan in 1596.

The khanate's feud with its Khalkha neighbour brought the Dzungar army down on it. Tüsheet Khan Chakhundorj killed Zasagt Khan Shar in 1687, and Galdan made the murder his pretext to invade the following year, his men carrying Russian firearms. A three-day battle at Olgoi Lake broke the Khalkha, and Tüsheet Khan fled south. In 1691 Shar's brother Tsevenjab joined the other Khalkha rulers at Dolonnuur in submitting to the Kangxi Emperor, and all the Khalkha came under Qing overlordship. The Qing parcelled the pastures into banners, nine by 1692 and nineteen under the Qianlong Emperor.
zh:
札萨克图这片干旱牧场后来成为喀尔喀右翼的南境，戈壁草原向戈壁阿尔泰山抬升，札克河发源于此。1444年，在荒漠边缘冬营地与山地夏牧场之间转场的牧民说喀尔喀语，牧场却在也先太师的瓦剌联盟境内。他们信奉腾格里，住在喀尔喀贵族向西进逼瓦剌的漫长边界上。1596年，素巴第成为第一代札萨克图汗。

这个汗部与喀尔喀邻部的仇杀，把准噶尔大军引了进来。1687年，土谢图汗察珲多尔济攻杀札萨克图汗沙喇，噶尔丹以此为借口在次年入侵，军中配备俄国火器。奥尔戈湖一战连打三天，喀尔喀溃败，土谢图汗南逃。1691年，沙喇之弟策旺扎布与其他喀尔喀首领在多伦诺尔一同向康熙帝归附，全体喀尔喀就此臣服清朝。清廷把这片牧场编为盟旗，1692年已有九旗，乾隆年间增至十九旗。

en:
Urzhar is the valley of a 206-kilometre river that comes down from the southern Tarbagatai range and loses itself in bitter Lake Alakol. The lake's Turkic name means 'motley lake', and in Timur's day it was called It-Ichmes, 'a dog will not drink', for its salt. Rashid al-Din's chronicle already names Urzhar with the Emil country among Mongol camping grounds. In 1444 the camps here belonged to Esen Taishi's Oirat confederation, on its western edge: mountain streams watered the seasonal herds and the saline shore yielded salt, but there was no town.

As the Kazakh Khanate spread east after about 1465, these pastures became a Kazakh-Oirat frontier where raiding ran on for two centuries. In 1723, after a harsh winter, more than 30,000 Dzungar horsemen struck the Kazakh steppe and took Turkistan and Samarkand; the Kazakhs remember those years as the Barefooted Flight, when whole clans fled west as far as Khiva and Bukhara. After the Qing broke Dzungar power in 1755-1758, the valley briefly held the dynasty's first garrison on this frontier: a military station was set up at Yahr, on the site of present Urzhar, in 1763, and six hundred Green Standard soldiers arrived from Urumqi the next year to farm military colonies. Summer swarms of gnats and the bitter cold defeated the experiment, the councillor Agui had the garrison withdrawn east to Chuguchak, and Kazakh tribes were then allowed to graze the vacated pastures.
zh:
乌尔贾尔是一条206公里长河谷，河出塔尔巴哈台山南坡，最终消失在苦咸的阿拉科尔湖中。湖名是突厥语「杂色之湖」，帖木儿时代人称「伊特奇梅斯」，意为「狗都不喝」，因为湖水含盐。拉施德丁的史书已把乌尔贾尔与额敏地方并列为蒙古营地。1444年，这里的营地属于也先太师的瓦剌联盟，地处联盟西缘：山溪滋养季节性牧群，咸岸出盐，但没有城镇。

哈萨克汗国约1465年以后向东扩展，这片牧场成为哈萨克与卫拉特的前沿，袭掠在此延续了两个世纪。1723年严冬过后，三万余准噶尔骑兵攻入哈萨克草原，连下突厥斯坦和撒马尔罕；哈萨克人把此后几年称作「赤脚逃亡」，整族整姓向西远逃至希瓦和布哈拉。1755年至1758年清军击灭准噶尔后，这条河谷一度成为清朝在此前沿的首个驻军地：1763年在雅尔（即今乌尔贾尔）设军台，次年六百名绿营兵从乌鲁木齐前来屯田。夏日成群的白蝇和严寒断送了这次尝试，参赞大臣阿桂把驻军东撤楚呼楚，哈萨克部落随后获准进入空旷的牧场放牧。

en:
Chuguchak, the Chuhuchu of Qing records, lies beneath the Tarbagatai range whose Mongol name means 'the place of marmots', after the tarbagan colonies of these hills; a Yuan postal station set up here in 1282 already carried the name. In 1444 the slopes were Oirat pasture within Esen Taishi's confederation. Herders moved between mountain and steppe camps, and marmot pelts, livestock and the furs of the northern forests counted for more than any market town. The Torghuts long grazed this country before most of them followed Kho Orluk west to the Volga in 1630.

In 1640 Oirat and Khalkha lords met in the Tarbagatai hills and issued a common legal code, an attempt to end their feuding and fix Mongol law while the Manchus and Russians pressed in from east and north. Qing armies reached Tarbagatai in 1755. The first garrison went to Yahr, west of here, where Zhaofeng City was built in 1764, but the site was bitterly cold and gnats made the summers unbearable; the councillor Agui secured its withdrawal. In 1766 a new walled town was completed at Chuhuchu, and the Qianlong Emperor named it Suijing. The Tarbagatai councillor made the town his seat, watching the Qing frontier opposite the Kazakh steppe.
zh:
楚古恰克在清代史料中作楚呼楚，地处塔尔巴哈台山麓；其蒙古语地名意为「有旱獭的地方」，得名于山中成群的塔尔巴干旱獭，1282年元朝在此设置的塔尔八合你驿已经用了这个名字。1444年，这片山坡是也先太师瓦剌联盟内的牧场，牧民在山地与草原营地间转场，旱獭皮、牲畜和北方森林的毛皮比任何市集都重要。土尔扈特人长期在此游牧，1630年大部随和鄂尔勒克西迁伏尔加河。

1640年，瓦剌与喀尔喀的领主在塔尔巴哈台山中会盟，颁布共同的法典，意在满洲与俄国自东、北两方进逼之时平息内争、统一蒙古法度。1755年清军抵达塔尔巴哈台。最初的驻军设在西边的雅尔，1764年筑起肇丰城，但那里酷寒，夏日白蝇又使人难以安居，参赞大臣阿桂奏准撤治。1766年，城墙环抱的新城在楚呼楚竣工，乾隆帝赐名绥靖城。塔尔巴哈台参赞大臣便驻在城中，节制面向哈萨克草原的清朝前沿。

en:
The Tekes and Künes rivers join to form the Ili, which waters a broad corridor between the Tianshan and Borohoro ranges before running west toward Lake Balkhash. Karluk traders and herdsmen founded Almaliq in this basin; its name referred to the crab apple trees around the town. Under Tughlugh Temur in the mid-fourteenth century it became a Chagatayid residence and an Islamic centre, though Nestorian graves and Catholic missionaries show that other believers still lived there. Warfare and the move back toward pastoral rule emptied much of the old city. In 1444 Esen Buqa's Moghul khanate held the Ili through tribal lords, mounted herdsmen and summer pastures.
