Under Rama I a Louang Phabang man named Phumi founded Khon San; in 1809 Luang Krai Singhanat brought Vientiane settlers to Phu Khiao. In 1819 the Vientiane official Lae led his following to land close to the deserted site that later became Chaiyaphum.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/จังหวัดชัยภูมิ
zh:
猜也蓬位于呵叻高原西缘，夹在林木覆盖的碧差汶山地与齐河上游之间；从昭披耶平原进入东北的老路，就穿过这一带山岭。陀罗钵地佛教徒以雕刻的界石标示僧院地界，后来的高棉统治留下普拉古（Prang Ku）等小型红土神祠。1186年阇耶跋摩七世的一方义诊碑铭，把这一带列入他施建医院的地区。到15世纪，古城多已缩小，西部山岭中住着与古孟人有亲缘的尼亚库尔人（Nyah Kur）。1444年，这片开阔原野是澜沧面向阿瑜陀耶的边远领地，居民以说高棉话的乡民为主，老挝人家族则沿溪流向南迁居。

农三满（Nong Sam Muen）的老挝式佛塔建于16世纪中叶赛塔提拉王时代，可见澜沧曾稳固控制这一带；到那莱王时期，这里已被记作那空叻差是玛的属地，旧城后来居民流散。1768年战事重开诸关，四木村（Ban Si Mum）头人阿赞堪率乡民加入郑昭讨伐披迈势力的军队，战后受封帕那林颂堪，其聚落被升为隶属呵叻的城。更多老挝人家族随后迁入空旷高原。拉玛一世时，琅勃拉邦人普密建立贡善（Khon San）；1809年，銮凯辛纳率万象移民定居普乔（Phu Khiao）。1819年，万象官员莱率部众迁到日后猜也蓬城那处荒废城址附近。

en:
Phetchaburi straddles the Phetchaburi River at the northern end of the Malay Peninsula, where the coastal road from Ayutthaya turns south; its Thai name means 'city of diamonds'. It began as a Dvaravati seaport on the India–China trade route, was abandoned with that civilisation around the eleventh century, and was refounded in the twelfth as the small polity of Phrip Phri, walls and a moat enclosing roughly a square kilometre with a Bayon-style temple at the centre. In the town stands the Khmer shrine of Wat Kamphaeng Laeng, raised under Jayavarman VII and later converted into a Buddhist wat. Ram Khamhaeng drew Phetchaburi into Sukhothai's orbit, and in 1351 it entered the new kingdom of Ayutthaya as a fortified frontier city. In 1444 it was a Siamese, Theravada Buddhist garrison and market guarding the road to the southern peninsula.

The frontier kept its wars. In 1581 a Cambodian raid stormed the town, and it returned to Siamese rule only after Naresuan's campaigns against Cambodia; Dutch and French captains marked it on their charts as Pipri. In early 1765 Maha Nawrahta's vanguard, sent ahead from his base at Tavoy, overran the western Siamese towns, and Phetchaburi was stormed on the road that ended at Ayutthaya in 1767. King Taksin recovered it after the collapse, and Phetchaburi levies went on campaigning under him and the early Chakri kings in the long Burmese wars that followed.
zh:
碧武里横跨碧武里河，地处马来半岛北端，阿瑜陀耶南下的沿海道路在此折向南方；泰语里它的名字意为「钻石之城」。它最初是堕罗钵底时期印度—中国商路上的海港，约11世纪随堕罗钵底文明一同废弃，12世纪重建为小城邦碧里，城墙和壕沟围出约一平方公里的城圈，正中是一座巴戎风格寺院。城里还有一座阇耶跋摩七世时所建的石宫（Wat Kamphaeng Laeng），原为高棉人的印度教神庙，后来改为佛寺。兰甘亨将碧武里纳入素可泰的势力范围，1351年它作为设防边城并入新生的阿瑜陀耶王国。1444年，这里是一座暹罗人的上座部佛教驻军兼商镇，扼守通往南部半岛的道路。

这座边城此后仍屡经战阵。1581年高棉军队攻破碧武里，直到纳黎萱征伐柬埔寨之后才重归暹罗；荷兰和法国船长在海图上把这里标作皮普里（Pipri）。1765年初，玛哈·瑙亚塔从土瓦基地派出前锋，连下暹罗西部诸城，碧武里在通往阿瑜陀耶的路上再遭攻破，都城于1767年陷落。都城沦亡后郑信收复此城，碧武里的军队后来又随郑信及曼谷王朝早期诸王，投身此后漫长的对缅战争。

en:
Phitsanulok lies on the fertile Nan River plain, where the roads from central Siam branch toward the northern hills, the Lao meuang of the Mekong and the Lanna kingdom at Chiang Mai. Its chief town grew out of Song Khwae, 'Two Rivers', seat of the later Sukhothai kings from 1378. A Sukhothai king founded Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat there in the fourteenth century and cast the Phra Phuttha Chinnarat, one of the most copied Buddha images in Siam, which many Thais hold to be the most beautiful in the country. The last Sukhothai king died at Song Khwae in 1438, and an Ayutthaya prince, Ramesuan, came north to govern the town. In 1444 it was still the working northern seat of the fading Sukhothai dynasty, bound to Ayutthaya and exposed to war with Lanna.

When Ramesuan took the Ayutthayan throne as King Borommatrailokanat, Song Khwae passed fully under Ayutthaya. In 1463, during the Ayutthaya–Lanna war, he moved his court to the town, joined its eastern and western settlements inside one wall and renamed it Phitsanulok, 'Vishnu's world'. It afterwards went to the heir apparent, the uparaja, who kept his Chantana Palace on the west bank. The town submitted to Bayinnaung's Burmese army in 1563, and King Maha Thammaracha later made his son Naresuan its lord; Naresuan had been born at Song Khwae in the mid-1550s, and in 1584 he emptied the region to starve a Burmese invasion, restoring the town nine years later as a first-class city under a governor rather than a prince.

After Ayutthaya fell to the Konbaung armies in 1767, the monk Chao Phra Fang made himself lord of the northern towns from Fang, until Taksin of Thonburi's forces retook Phitsanulok the following year. In 1775 the Burmese general Maha Thiha Thura besieged it for four months; Chakri, the future Rama I, and his brother Surasi held the walls until the town fell, and the Burmese left it in ruins. It was abandoned again during the invasion of 1785, and the old frontier capital lay half depopulated into the early nineteenth century.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/เทศบาลนครพิษณุโลก
https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/จังหวัดพิษณุโลก
zh:
彭世洛地处难河的肥沃平原，暹罗中部通往北部山地、湄公河流域老挝诸邦和兰纳清迈的道路在此分岔。主邑由旧城宋桂发展而来，宋桂意为「两河」，1378年起成为素可泰后期诸王的驻地。14世纪，一位素可泰王在此修建帕西雷达纳玛哈泰寺，铸成钦那拉佛；这尊佛像是暹罗被仿造最多的佛像之一，许多泰国人认为它是全国最美的佛像。1438年末代素可泰国王在宋桂去世，阿瑜陀耶王子拉梅萱北上接管此城。1444年，这里仍是衰微的素可泰王朝实际上的北方都城，依附阿瑜陀耶，又直面兰纳的战事。

拉梅萱即位为波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳王后，宋桂正式并入阿瑜陀耶。1463年阿瑜陀耶与兰那交战，他把朝廷迁到此城，把两岸聚落圈进同一道城墙，改名彭世洛，意为「毗湿奴的世界」。此后此城封给王储（乌巴腊），王储的占塔纳宫设在西岸。1563年此城向勃印曩的缅军投降；玛哈·探玛拉差王后来封其子纳黎萱为此地之主——纳黎萱1550年代中期就出生在宋桂，1584年他迁空这一带的人口，让来犯的缅军无从补给，九年后再把此城恢复为由总督而非王储治理的一等城市。

1767年阿瑜陀耶被贡榜大军攻灭后，僧侣出身的昭披耶方（Chao Phra Fang）自立为北方诸镇之主，直到吞武里王郑信的军队在次年夺回彭世洛。1775年，缅将马哈·蒂哈·图拉围城四个月；却克里（即后来的拉玛一世）和弟弟素拉西死守城墙，城终陷落，缅军撤退时留下一片废墟。1785年缅军再来，此城又遭放弃，这座北境旧都直到19世纪初仍是人烟萧条。

en:
Phra Bang, the town later called Nakhon Sawan, occupies the fork where the Ping and Nan rivers meet and the Chao Phraya begins its course toward Ayutthaya. Boats from the northern valleys gathered here before continuing downstream, and armies moving between Sukhothai, Phitsanulok and the central plain used the same crossing. A Dvaravati settlement stood here before the town became Sukhothai's southern frontier city. In 1444 Phra Bang was still counted among the Sukhothai towns, although a temple-land dispute of 1429 already placed its governor's district on Ayutthaya's side of the border.

After Borommatrailokanat brought the Sukhothai lands under Ayutthaya in 1448, Phra Bang served as a northern river market and as a mustering ground for campaigns upstream. Burmese commanders later used the river route in reverse. In 1765 Ne Myo Thihapate's northern army came down through the northern towns before joining the other Burmese column outside Ayutthaya, which fell in April 1767. Taksin then rearmed Phra Bang as a base for guarding the river road against further Burmese attacks.
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/จังหวัดนครสวรรค์
https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/หัวเมืองเหนือ
zh:
勃拉邦（后称那空沙旺）位于宾河与难河汇合处，昭披耶河从这里开始南下阿瑜陀耶。北方谷地的船只到此处集结，再沿同一条水路下行；素可泰、彭世洛与中央平原之间调动军队，也使用这里的渡口。陀罗钵地时期此地已有聚落，后来成为素可泰的南境边城。1444年，它在名义上仍属素可泰诸城，但1429年一场寺地争端已把其城主的辖地写在阿瑜陀耶边界一侧。

1448年波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳将素可泰故土纳入阿瑜陀耶后，勃拉邦成为北部河埠，也是上游战事的集结地。缅甸将领后来反向利用这条水路。1765年，内苗·西哈波底率领北路军扫过北方诸城，最终与另一路缅军在阿瑜陀耶城外会师，都城于1767年4月陷落。郑信复国后重新武装勃拉邦，把它作为守卫河道、防备缅军再犯的基地。

en:
Chaiya faces the Gulf of Siam on the Malay Peninsula's east coast and may be the oldest settled place on this stretch of shore. Between the seventh and thirteenth centuries it was a Srivijayan seaport: Tang ceramics, Indian pottery and Persian glass have been dug up at Laem Pho Beach, and matching finds at Takua Pa on the Andaman coast, 200 kilometres away across the isthmus, point to a porter route that let merchants skip the pirate-ridden Strait of Malacca. Its old Malay name may have been cahaya, 'light', and some scholars hear the name Srivijaya itself in Chai-ya. A stone inscription of 775 records the Srivijayan king erecting three stupas here. The Srivijaya-style chedi of Wat Phra Borommathat, rebuilt in later centuries, houses a relic of the Buddha and ranks with the great stupa of Nakhon Si Thammarat among the most venerated shrines of southern Siam. After Srivijaya's fall the town shrank into the small mueang of Chaiya, and in 1444 it lay on the northern approaches of Ligor, its people living from the Gulf's fishing grounds.

Unlike its neighbours, which answered to Ligor, Chaiya was administered directly from the Siamese capital, and through the Ayutthayan centuries it stayed a quiet Theravada market town, its old monastery drawing pilgrims to the stupa. Wars moved past it: Taksin retook the south in 1769 and a Burmese army sacked Ligor in 1786, but Chaiya's harbour went on landing fish for the coastal trade, not the Indian Ocean cargoes of its Srivijayan centuries.
zh:
猜亚位于马来半岛东岸、濒临暹罗湾，可能是这一带海岸最古老的定居点。7至13世纪，这里是三佛齐的海港：兰坡海滩出土过唐代瓷器、印度陶器和波斯玻璃器；在200公里外地峡另一侧的他古来，也有同类遗物出土，可见当时有一条横跨地峡的搬运道，商人可借此绕开海盗出没的马六甲海峡。其古名或为马来语cahaya，意为「光」，也有学者认为「猜亚」一名来自「室利佛逝」（三佛齐）。775年的一方碑铭记载三佛齐国王在此建起三座佛塔。帕波罗玛塔寺的三佛齐式佛塔后经历代重修，塔中供奉佛舍利，与那空是贪玛叻的大佛塔并称，是暹罗南方最受尊崇的圣地之一。三佛齐衰落后，此地缩为小城邦猜亚，1444年时地处洛坤北缘，居民以暹罗湾渔场为生。

与臣属洛坤的邻邦不同，猜亚由暹罗王都直接管辖。整个阿瑜陀耶时代，它都是一座安静的上座部佛教集镇，古寺吸引香客前来礼塔。战火多从旁掠过：郑信1769年重新征服南方，缅军1786年洗劫洛坤，而猜亚港湾卸下的依旧是供应沿海贸易的渔获，不再有三佛齐时代那些印度洋来的船货。

en:
Thalang was the old northern capital of the large Andaman Sea island later called Phuket. Malays knew the island as Tanjung Salang, 'Cape Salang', which European charts corrupted into Junk Ceylon. Between the seventh and thirteenth centuries it belonged to the maritime world of Srivijaya, and late in the thirteenth century it passed through Ligor into the orbit of Sukhothai and the Siamese kingdoms that followed. It lay on the sea lane from India to China, dealing in pearls, ambergris and forest produce, and Malay pirates made its coasts dangerous; its tin fields were what later drew European ships. In 1444 it was a small Malay-speaking Muslim island mueang on the edge of Ligor, whose people lived mainly by fishing.

Fernão Mendes Pinto found Junk Ceylon a port of call in 1545, already losing trade to pirates and rough seas. The Dutch opened a factory in 1626, after which Dutch, English and French bidders competed for the island's tin. To cut the Dutch and English out, King Narai set the French medical missionary René Charbonneau over the island with his seat at Thalang, and in 1685 granted the French a tin monopoly. After the Siamese revolution of 1688, General Desfarges retook Thalang on 10 April 1689 with an expedition from Pondicherry, but the French abandoned it within a year.

Thalang's best-known defence came in 1785, during the Nine Armies' War with Burma. Francis Light of the East India Company warned the island that a Burmese attack was coming, at a moment when its governor had just died. His widow Chan, a granddaughter of the Sultan of Kedah, and her sister Muk took command, held the town for a month with a few hundred defenders, and paraded the island's women on the walls dressed as soldiers; the Burmese overestimated the garrison and withdrew on 13 March. Rama I afterwards conferred on the sisters the titles Thao Thep Kasattri and Thao Si Sunthon. War returned in 1809, when Burmese forces stormed Thalang and Tha Rua, and by the peace of 1812 the island lay depopulated and its old town in ruins.
zh:
塔廊（中文维基译他朗，Thalang）在安达曼海上后来称普吉的大岛北部，是岛上旧都所在；全岛过去也叫塔廊。马来人称之为丹戎沙廊（Tanjung Salang），意为「沙廊角」，欧洲海图讹作养西岭（Junk Ceylon），中国清代载籍也用此名。7至13世纪，该岛属于三佛齐的海洋世界，13世纪末经洛坤纳入素可泰及此后暹罗诸王朝的势力范围。它地处印度至中国的航道，出产珍珠、龙涎香和山林特产，沿岸又有马来海盗出没；真正引来欧洲商船的，是岛上的锡矿。1444年，这里是洛坤边缘一个讲马来语的穆斯林海岛城邦，居民多以捕鱼为生。

1545年，葡萄牙旅行家费尔南·门德斯·平托到此，见养西岭仍是商船停靠港，却已因海盗和恶劣海况而衰落。荷兰人1626年开设商馆，荷兰、英国、法国随即为岛上的锡矿明争暗斗。为排挤荷兰人与英国人，那莱王派法国行医传教士勒内·沙博诺驻节塔廊、治理此岛，又在1685年把锡矿专营权授予法国。1688年暹罗革命后，德法尔热将军率本地治里远征军于1689年4月10日攻占塔廊，法军不到一年便弃岛而去。

塔廊最有名的保卫战发生在1785年对缅甸的九军之战期间。东印度公司的弗朗西斯·莱特事先报信，说缅军即将来犯，而岛上府尹刚刚去世。府尹的遗孀庄是吉打苏丹的孙女，她与妹妹穆接掌防务，率数百守军苦守一个月，又让岛上妇女扮成士兵在城头列队；缅军高估了守军人数，于3月13日撤退。拉玛一世后来封姐妹二人为帖卡撒隄与席顺通。1809年战火再起，缅军攻陷塔廊和呈娘港；到1812年和议达成时，全岛人口流散，旧城已成废墟。

en:
The Klang River reaches the Strait of Malacca at Klang, the oldest settlement on this coast: bronze axes and a bronze bell of the second century BC have been dug up near its estuary, and the sailing charts used by Zheng He's fleets mark the port there. In the fifteenth century the coast behind it was no single kingdom but a chain of river chiefdoms, Klang and Jeram among them, whose chiefs were appointed by the Sultan of Malacca. The Malay Annals say the great bendahara Tun Perak began as chief of Klang, and that Jeram was granted to Paduka Sri Cina, the son of Sultan Mansur Shah and the Chinese princess Hang Li Po. In 1444 rice, tin and jungle produce move down these rivers to Malacca's bazaars, and the estuaries count among the northern provinces of the Malaccan realm.

After Malacca fell to the Portuguese in 1511 the chiefdoms passed to Johor, whose wars brought Bugis mercenaries over from Sulawesi; they settled the Selangor and Klang estuaries in growing numbers, led by the kin of five Bugis brothers. In 1743 Raja Lumu, son of the Bugis Yam Tuan Muda Daeng Chelak, was made ruler of Selangor at Kuala Selangor, and his later coronation by the Sultan of Perak as Sultan Salehuddin Shah founded the only Bugis dynasty on the peninsula. The new sultanate's first great war was with the Dutch. In June 1784 Raja Haji, Lumu's younger brother and the Bugis viceroy of Riau, was killed while leading the assault on Dutch Malacca; on 13 July a Dutch fleet stormed the fort at Kuala Selangor and drove out Sultan Ibrahim, who retook it in a raid the next year with Pahang's help. Ibrahim opened political relations with the British in 1818, and the Klang valley entered the new century as an independent Bugis sultanate.
zh:
巴生河在巴生注入马六甲海峡，巴生是这片海岸最古老的定居点：河口一带出土过公元前2世纪的青铜斧和铜铃，郑和船队所用的航海图也标出了这里的港口。15世纪时，后方沿海并非统一王国，而是巴生、而榄等一连串河口领地，酋长由马六甲苏丹任命。《马来纪年》记载，宰相敦霹雳早年当过巴生酋长，而榄则封给了曼苏尔沙苏丹与中国公主汉丽宝所生之子。1444年，稻米、锡砂和林产顺这些河南下，进入马六甲的市集，各河口是马六甲版图的北方诸省。

1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙之手后，各河口领地转归柔佛；柔佛的战事从苏拉威西召来武吉斯雇佣兵，他们越来越多地定居在雪兰莪河和巴生河河口，五兄弟的族人势力最大。1743年，武吉斯副王邓切拉之子拉惹鲁穆在瓜拉雪兰莪受任为统治者，后来由霹雳苏丹为他加冕，称苏丹沙拉胡丁沙，开创了马来半岛唯一的武吉斯王朝。这个新国家的第一场大战是和荷兰人打的：1784年6月，拉惹鲁穆之弟、廖内的武吉斯副王拉惹哈只率军攻打荷属马六甲时战死；7月13日，荷兰舰队攻陷瓜拉雪兰莪要塞，驱逐苏丹依布拉欣，次年他借彭亨援兵突袭，收复要塞。依布拉欣1818年开始与英国通好，进入新世纪时，巴生河流域是一个独立的武吉斯苏丹国。

en:
Terengganu follows the South China Sea coast between Pahang and Kelantan across the longest coastal plain of the Malay Peninsula, cut through by short rivers whose mouths make a chain of open roadsteads where Chinese junks anchored. Chinese seafarers wrote down its name as early as the sixth century, and around 1330 Wang Dayuan visited and listed lakawood, beeswax, camphor and tortoiseshell among its exports. Up the Terengganu River at Kuala Berang lies the Terengganu Stone, a granite stele engraved in Jawi with the edicts of the Muslim ruler Seri Paduka Tuan; its date is damaged and can be read as 1303 or 1387, which makes it the oldest Islamic inscription in the Malay world. The ten sharia rules on it still carry Sanskrit words left from the older Hindu-Buddhist courts. In 1444 Muslim chiefs governed the river valleys, owing loose homage to Siam and to the rising sultanate of Malacca.

In the later fifteenth century Terengganu became a Malaccan dependency, and after Malacca's fall in 1511 it looked to Johor while still sending tribute to Ayutthaya. By 1699 it was the main pepper supplier for Chinese merchants on the east coast, though the country could barely put five hundred warriors in the field and had no fleet. An Ayutthayan invasion of 1710 broke off when the Siamese turned to meet a Vietnamese attack in Cambodia. In 1725 Tun Zainal Abidin, brother of a late sultan of Johor, was installed as Terengganu's first sultan. Sultan Mansur, who reigned from 1741 to 1793, built a Malay league against the Bugis, and European visitors praised the order of his government; in 1764 he extended his power over divided Kelantan. By the early nineteenth century Terengganu sent the annual bunga mas to Bangkok, and was largely left alone.
zh:
丁加奴（今登嘉楼）沿南海海岸展开，在彭亨与吉兰丹之间，占有马来半岛最漫长的沿海平原；短促河流横切平原入海，河口连成一串敞开的泊地，中国帆船常来停泊。中国水手早在6世纪就记下了它的名字，约1330年汪大渊到访，列举当地出口降真香、黄蜡、龙脑和玳瑁。丁加奴河上游的瓜拉伯浪有一方「丁加奴石碑」，花岗岩石碑上以爪夷文刻着穆斯林君主斯里·巴杜卡·端的谕令；纪年残损，可读作1303年或1387年，是马来世界最早的伊斯兰铭文。碑上的十条教法仍保留着梵文词，是更早印度教-佛教朝廷留下的痕迹。1444年，穆斯林酋长们统治着各河谷，同时向暹罗和崛起的马六甲松散称臣。

15世纪后期丁加奴成为马六甲属邦，1511年马六甲灭亡后改向柔佛称臣，同时仍向阿瑜陀耶纳贡。到1699年，它已是东海岸中国商人的主要胡椒供应地，全国却只能凑出五百名战士，也没有舰队。1710年阿瑜陀耶来犯，暹军却因要转赴柬埔寨抵御越南进攻而撤兵。1725年，已故柔佛苏丹之弟敦·再纳·阿比丁被拥立为丁加奴首任苏丹。满速沙苏丹1741年至1793年在位，组成马来联盟对抗武吉斯人，欧洲访客称赞其治下政令整肃；1764年他乘吉兰丹分裂将其纳入势力范围。到19世纪初，丁加奴每年向曼谷进献金花，受干涉也较少。

en:
Rice flats fill the coastal plain between jungle-covered hills and the Strait of Malacca, at the northern end of the great Malay rice belt; Kedah has fed the strait's shipping for as long as ships have used it. The old harbour stood at the mouth of the Kedah River, where navigators took their bearings from Kedah Peak, and the Bujang Valley behind it held marts and Hindu temples from the days of Srivijaya. The much later Kedah Annals derive the royal line from a Persian king storm-blown to the coast and, beyond him, from Alexander the Great. The date of the court's conversion to Islam is disputed, the annals giving 1136 and an Acehnese account 1474. In 1444 the ruler held a string of river-mouth capitals, sent the golden flowers of tribute north to Ayutthaya, and shipped rice and tin south to Malacca.

The Portuguese capture of Malacca in 1511 left Kedah open to every navy in the strait, and Portuguese squadrons raided its coast more than once. In 1619 the fleets of Aceh's Sultan Iskandar Muda sacked the kingdom and carried its sultan away to Aceh. On 30 December 1735 Sultan Muhammad Jiwa, the nineteenth ruler, founded Kota Setar, later Alor Setar, the eighth capital in Kedah's history; in 1770 a Bugis armada under Raja Haji burned his new palace there. The court then turned to Francis Light and the English East India Company, whose promised military aid was never authorised: Penang was ceded in 1786 and the mainland strip of Province Wellesley in 1800, against an annual rent in Spanish dollars. In November 1821 a Siamese army from Ligor stormed Kedah and drove Sultan Ahmad Tajuddin into exile, and direct Siamese rule settled over the old kingdom as the period closed.
zh:
这里地处马来大米产区北端，丛林丘陵与马六甲海峡之间展开一片稻米平川；自有船只通行海峡以来，吉打便为商船供粮。古港在吉打河口，海员以吉打峰辨认航向，港后的布秧谷自室利佛逝时代便有商埠和印度教寺庙。晚出的《吉打纪年》把王室先世说成一位被风暴吹到岸边的波斯王，再往上又接到亚历山大大帝。宫廷何时归信伊斯兰教说法不一，《纪年》作1136年，亚齐方面的记载作1474年。1444年，这里的君主在一连串河口设都，北方向阿瑜陀耶进贡金银花，稻米和锡砂南运马六甲。

1511年葡萄牙攻占马六甲后，吉打对海峡里的每一支舰队都门户大开，葡萄牙船队一再袭扰海岸。1619年，亚齐苏丹伊斯干达·穆达的大军洗劫吉打，把苏丹掳往亚齐。1735年12月30日，第十九任君主苏丹·莫哈末吉瓦兴建哥打士打，即后来的亚罗士打，是吉打历史上第八座都城；1770年，拉惹哈吉率领的武吉斯舰队焚毁他的新王宫。宫廷转而求助法兰西斯·莱特和英国东印度公司，承诺的军援却从未获得批准：1786年割让槟榔屿，1800年再割大陆上的威斯利省，只换取按年支付的西班牙元租金。1821年11月，洛坤派出的暹罗军队攻陷吉打，苏丹阿末塔祖丁流亡，这一时代结束时，古老王国已落入暹罗直接统治。

en: Hkamti Long, the 'Great Place of Gold' of the Hkamti Shan, fills the upper valley of the Mali River below the snow ridges north of Myitkyina; Myanmar's highest peak, Hkakabo Razi, stands above its chief town, Putao. The country was an outlying dependency of Möng Kawng, split into seven tiny principalities whose Buddhist rice villages lay on the valley floor while animist Kachin and Nung villagers held the hills around. Men washed gold from the gravel of the Mali and sent a trickle of hill goods south to Mogaung, and the roads were so remote that lowland kings reached the valley only through its Mogaung overlords. In 1444 the seven chiefs still ruled under Mogaung's name, and when Bodawpaya annexed Mogaung in 1796, Hkamti Long carried on alone as the remnant of the old principality.
zh: 坎底（Hkamti Long，当地又作坎底龍）在坎底掸语中意为「大金地」，地处密支那以北、迈立开江上游谷地，首镇葡萄背后矗立着缅甸最高峰开加博峰和一片雪岭。它本是孟拱的边陲属地，分为七个小酋邦：坝子里是坎底掸人信佛教的稻田村落，四周山里住着奉泛灵信仰的克钦人和侬人。人们从迈立开江的砂砾中淘金，把少量山货南销莫冈；道路过于僻远，低地王朝的势力只能透过孟拱的宗主间接抵达这里。1444年，七家酋长仍托名孟拱而治；1796年波道帕耶吞并孟拱后，坎底作为旧邦的残余单独存续下来。

en:
Möng Kawng, the Burmese Mogaung, had its seat in the Nam Kawng valley in the hills north of the Irrawaddy, through which Uyu jade travelled into China. Tai chronicles trace it to Sam Long Hpa, a Mong Mao tributary who ruled from the upper Mali to the Naga hills and was poisoned at Mogaung after rivals slandered him; they date him to 1215, though scholars place him in the mid-fourteenth century. By Ming times jadeite pebbles from the Uyu went by caravan through Mogaung into Yunnan, and local lore told of a Yunnanese trader who first recognised the stone after using one to balance his mule's load. In 1444 the sawbwa sheltered Si Jifa, son of Si Renfa, who had fled when the Ming broke Mong Mao, holding out against Chinese demands while Ava pressed from the south.

Ava stormed Mogaung in 1477 and carried the sawbwa off to rule Tagaung, and Ming armies occupied it from 1479 to 1483 and again a dozen years later. In 1524 a Mogaung host crossed the Patkai into Assam and was beaten back at Sadiya. The state submitted to Bayinnaung in 1557, and the sawbwa's young son Si Gefa went as a hostage to the Burmese court; the king raised him at his side and sent him back to rule Mogaung seven years later. Si Gefa joined the northern sawbwas' revolt in 1571 and fled into the snow mountains when Bayinnaung marched north himself. He once turned to the Ming after divining with wooden tablets, when the Chinese emperor's tablet stayed upright on his table and the Burmese king's fell. Worn down by years in the hills, his followers handed him over about 1580; the chronicles disagree on the year and on his end.

Burmese garrisons held Mogaung for most of the century after 1651 and again in the 1770s. In 1769 Fu Heng's Qing army crossed the upper Irrawaddy and the chiefs submitted with elephants, until the Kaungton treaty returned the country to Burma; Bodawpaya annexed it in 1796 and set wuns over it. The peace reopened the caravan road, and Mogaung jade went by the caravan load into Qianlong China, whose court had a passion for the green stone.
zh:
孟拱，缅语称莫冈，首府在南拱河（今莫冈河）畔、伊洛瓦底江以北的群山间，雾露河的翡翠就是经它的市集转往中国的。掸族编年史把孟拱追溯到三隆法：他作为麓川藩属，疆域北抵迈立开江上游、西达那加丘陵，后来遭人进谗，被宗主赐下的毒食毒死在孟拱；史书把他系于1215年，学者则考证他是14世纪中叶的人。到明代，雾露河（乌尤河）的翡翠卵石已由马帮经孟拱贩入云南；当地相传，一个云南行商随手拾起块石头压驮子，才头一回认出这是翡翠。1444年，孟拱诏法容留了思任法之子思机法：思机法在麓川被明朝攻破后逃入孟拱，诏法一面应付明朝的追索，一面抵挡南面的阿瓦。

1477年阿瓦攻破孟拱，把诏法掳走，改封他去统治太公城；1479至1483年明军占领其地，十余年后又再度占领。1524年，孟拱大军翻越巴特开山攻入阿萨姆的萨地亚，被击退。1557年孟拱臣服莽应龙，诏法十岁的儿子思个法入质缅廷，莽应龙把他带在身边教养，七年后送他回孟拱继位。1571年思个法参与北方诸诏法的叛乱，莽应龙亲征时他逃入大雪山。他曾以木牌占卜决定去就：刻着「天皇帝」名号的木牌立在案上，刻着缅王的木牌却坠落在地，于是归顺明朝。长年在山中流亡后，约1580年部下把他献出；中缅编年史对具体年份和他后来是获赦还是遇害说法不一。

1651年以后的大半个世纪里，孟拱由缅甸驻军掌控，1770年代又一度被占。1769年傅恒渡过大金沙江上段，孟拱土司归降献象，老官屯和议后其地复归缅甸；1796年波道帕耶正式吞并孟拱，改派温官治理。和议重开了马帮商路，早年轻零星出境的翠料，此后成批运往正热衷这种绿玉的乾隆朝中国。

en: Tamanthi is a riverside settlement on the upper Chindwin, where the river runs through forested hills between the Naga country and the gold-bearing Uyu River. In 1444 its Shan villagers and the hamlets around Homalin lived on the remote edge of Möng Yang, the Shan power usually called Mohnyin; they kept animist rites and exchanged hill produce beyond the close control of the Buddhist courts downriver. Bayinnaung's conquest of the northern Shan states in 1557 brought the upper Chindwin under Toungoo overlordship. Gardens planted around Tamanthi and nearby villages around 1700 produced pickled tea, called letpet. In 1820 Shan settlers said to have come from Hkamti Long founded Singkaling Hkamti on the Chindwin.
zh: 德曼迪是钦敦江上游江畔村落，江流在森林山地间穿行，西接那加地方，东邻河沙产金的乌尤河。1444年，村中的掸人和霍马林附近村寨位于孟养（莫宁）势力的边远北缘；他们保留泛灵祭仪，以山货同外界往来，下游佛教王朝还难以直接控制这里。1557年，勃印曩征服北方诸掸邦，钦敦江上游随之归入东吁势力。约1700年，德曼迪和附近村寨栽种茶树，出产缅甸腌茶。1820年，据说来自坎底一带的掸人移民在钦敦江畔建立辛卡林坎底。

en:
Thaungdut was the Burmese name of Hsawnghsup, called Somsok in the Manipur chronicles, a small Shan saopha state in the northern Kabaw Valley. The valley lies between the Chindwin and the forested ridge that parts Burma from Manipur, and its passes were the road by which Burmese armies marched west and Manipuri raiders rode east. Shan families grew rice on the valley floor while Chin villagers, whom the Manipuris called Kyangs, held the forests above. The saopha's first seat stood in the valley near the Aimol Pass road into Manipur. Thaungdut was one of the three old principalities of the Kale-Kabaw country, and in 1444 it acknowledged Kale as its overlord, squeezed between the kingdom of Ava and the Manipuris over the ridge.

In 1470 King Kiyamba of Manipur and the sawbwa of Pong, as the Manipur court called Mogaung, overran Thaungdut together and divided it; the Chindwin share passed to Pong and long stayed under it. After Bayinnaung's Toungoo empire claimed the whole valley, Manipuri raids beat on Thaungdut through the seventeenth century and Ava twice sent levies to drive them off. With Burmese backing the chief of Hsawnghsup then threw off Manipur, and around 1717 King Gharib Niwaz had his revenge: he wasted the supply village of Chanta, starved the Samjok Shans into surrender and carried their chief and his son away. The Konbaung kings answered down the same road. Alaungpaya invaded Manipur in 1758, withdrew after thirteen days and left permanent garrisons at Tamu and Thaungdut; Hsinbyushin's army followed in 1764 and brought back so many captives that the Manipur king himself spent four years in exile in Assam. In 1813 Bodawpaya pushed his forward bases into the valley to install a Manipuri claimant to the throne. By the Konbaung years the saopha had moved his seat to a stockaded post on the Chindwin, the riverside village that alone keeps the name Thaungdut.
zh:
当都是掸邦萨姆索克（Hsawnghsup，曼尼普尔编年史作Somsok）的缅语称呼。它坐落在格包河谷北部，河谷夹在钦敦江与分隔缅甸、曼尼普尔的密林山脊之间，谷中的隘道既是缅军西出的路，也是曼尼普尔骑兵东袭的路。掸人在坝子里种稻，被曼尼普尔人称作「羌」的钦人住在山上的林中，诏法最初的治所就在谷中、靠近通往曼尼普尔的隘道旁。当都是格礼—格包一带三个古老小邦之一，1444年它在名义上臣属格礼，夹在阿瓦王国与山脊另一侧的曼尼普尔之间两头受逼。

1470年，曼尼普尔王基亚姆巴与「蓬国」（曼尼普尔对孟拱的称呼）的诏法联手攻灭当都、瓜分其地，钦敦江一侧归蓬国，当都此后长期依附孟拱。莽应龙的东吁王朝对整条格包河谷提出主权后，整个17世纪曼尼普尔的袭掠不断砸向当都，阿瓦两度调兵驰援。后来当都借缅甸支持摆脱曼尼普尔，约1717年曼尼普尔王迦里卜·尼瓦兹还以颜色：先毁其补给村寨占达，再断粮围困萨姆索克的掸人，迫其投降，把酋长父子一并掳走。贡榜诸王沿同一条路还报：1758年雍笈牙亲征曼尼普尔，十三天后撤军，在德穆和当都留下永久驻军；1764年辛标信的大军再征，掳回大量人口，连曼尼普尔王自己也流亡阿萨姆四年。1813年，波道帕耶把前进基地推进格包河谷，用以扶立曼尼普尔的争位者。到贡榜年间，诏法已把治所迁到钦敦江畔的营寨，这个江畔村寨就是后来唯一保留「当都」之名的地方。

en:
Bagan lies on the east bank of the Irrawaddy in the dry belt of central Burma, the plain crowded with brick temples as far as the eye travels. The chronicles date its walls to 849 and King Pyinbya, and from Anawrahta's accession in 1044 it was the capital of the first kingdom to unite the Burmese lands. For two and a half centuries kings, nobles and monks raised more than 10,000 pagodas, temples and monasteries, and the city drew students of Pali from India, Sri Lanka and the Khmer lands. King Kyansittha dedicated the Ananda in 1105, four standing Buddhas facing the four directions; the Shwezigon, the Thatbyinnyu and the Sulamani joined it among the giant shrines above the rooftops. Repeated Mongol invasions after 1277 broke the kingdom, the court departed in 1297, and a city that had held 50,000 to 200,000 people shrank into a small town. In 1444 Bagan belongs to Ava and lives from pilgrimage to a score of great temples, while thousands more crumble slowly into the dry plain.

After the Mohnyin Shans sacked Ava in 1527, Bagan passed under Shan rule until Bayinnaung folded it into his Toungoo empire in 1555. It fell to the Mon armies of Pegu with the rest of Upper Burma in 1752 and was recovered by Alaungpaya's Konbaung forces soon after. Konbaung kings then sponsored sweeping, often clumsy renovations, painting new frescoes over the old ones and whitewashing the Thatbyinnyu and the Ananda with little regard for the original designs. Fewer than 200 new temples went up after 1500. Pilgrims kept to a score of famous shrines along an ancient ritual road, and their offerings paid for the upkeep of the temples still in use.
zh:
蒲甘位于缅甸中部干旱地带的伊洛瓦底江东岸，平原上砖构寺塔密密麻麻，一眼望不到头。据缅甸编年史记载，彬比亚王于849年筑起城墙；1044年阿奴律陀即位后，这里成为第一个统一缅甸诸地的王国王都。此后两个半世纪里，国王、贵族与僧侣建起上万座佛塔、寺庙和僧院，来学巴利经典的僧人远及印度、斯里兰卡和高棉。江喜陀王1105年建成阿难陀寺，四尊大佛各立一方；瑞喜宫、他冰瑜寺、苏拉曼尼寺也都是高出城阙的巨型大刹。1277年后蒙古大军连年入侵，王国瓦解，1297年宫廷迁出，这座曾有五万至二十万人的城市缩成一座小镇。1444年的蒲甘属于阿瓦，是一座靠二十来座大刹的香火供养的小城，其余数千座寺塔在干旱平原上慢慢倾颓。

1527年孟养掸军攻破阿瓦，蒲甘转入掸族统治，直到1555年勃印曩把它收入东吁帝国。1752年它又随上缅甸一同落入勃固孟族之手，不久由雍笈牙的贡榜军队收复。此后贡榜诸王大兴官修，手笔却常常粗笨：在古壁画上覆盖新画，又把他冰瑜寺和阿难陀寺通体刷白，全不顾原来的形制。1500年以后新建的寺庙不足两百座，朝圣只集中在古道旁的二十来座名刹，香客的布施维持着这些仍在使用的寺庙。

en:
Hsipaw, Thibaw in Burmese and Xibo in Ming records, lies where the Nam Tu, or Myitnge, leaves the northern Shan hills for the Irrawaddy side of Upper Burma. Armies moving between Yunnan and Ava used this valley, and the state's older name, Onbaung, came from the earlier capital of its saophas. The prince Burmese chronicles call Le Than Bwa gave the small court a large part in Ava's succession crises: he arranged the killing of King Thihathu in 1425, first supported and then deserted a claimant to the throne, and backed a long revolt against Ava. Ming pressure on the Mong Mao frontier finally brought him to Ava's side in 1444. In that year Hsipaw was a Theravada Buddhist Shan principality and the nearest useful Shan ally of the Ava court.

The alliance held through the war against the Mohnyin-led Confederation of Shan States; a son of the Hsipaw saopha Hkonmaing became king of Ava in 1543. Hsipaw submitted to Bayinnaung in March 1557, but Mone rebels seized it later that year and killed his nominee before Bayinnaung retook it in November. In 1605 Nyaungyan Min entered the town without a fight and died south of it while returning to Ava. Hsipaw's sharpest fighting for an outside invader came in 1767: Ming Rui's Qing army overran it within days and routed Maha Sithu at the Goteik Gorge below the town. The opening victory carried the Qing close to Ava, but their main army was destroyed at Maymyo the next March.
zh:
昔卜，缅语称迪波，明朝史籍作锡箔，位于南杜河（米界河）流出掸北山地、通向上缅甸伊洛瓦底江一侧的谷口。云南与阿瓦之间的军队多走这条谷地，其诏法出自翁榜世系，邦国的旧称也来自更早的都城翁榜。被缅人称为勒丹博的诏法，让这个小邦深深卷入阿瓦王位之争：他在1425年安排刺杀阿瓦国王梯诃都，先支持一名争位者又临阵背弃，还长期支援反对阿瓦的叛乱。1444年，明朝在勐卯边境的军事压力终于把他推向阿瓦一方；此时的昔卜是信奉上座部佛教的掸人小邦，也是阿瓦宫廷最近、最可借重的掸邦盟邦。

这层同盟在阿瓦对抗孟养为首的掸邦联盟时维持下来，昔卜诏法诃昆迈的儿子于1543年登上阿瓦王位。1557年3月，昔卜归顺勃印曩，同年孟乃叛军攻占它并杀死缅方任命的诏法，11月勃印曩再度将其收复。1605年，良渊王兵不血刃进入昔卜，却在返回阿瓦途中死于城南。1767年，昔卜迎来外敌入侵中最激烈的一战：明瑞的清军数日越过此城，随后在城南谷特峡谷击溃玛哈·西都。这场开局胜利把清军带到阿瓦附近，但主力于次年3月在眉苗被歼。

en:
Mong Pai, called Mobye in Burmese, was a small Shan state in the forested hills where the southern Shan Plateau drops into Karenni country. Its saopha ruled from a single chief town, and Shan families shared the ridges with Karenni and other Karen-speaking villagers. The tracks ran west to the Ava frontier and north to the greater Shan princes, above all Onbaung-Hsipaw. In 1444 Mong Pai was a minor highland chiefdom on Ava's troubled southeastern edge, pulled between the Shan confederation and the Burmese lowland courts.

The chief of this small backwater then took the throne of Ava itself. The saopha was a son of Hkonmaing of Onbaung-Hsipaw, who had appointed him to Mong Pai, and in 1545 he entered Ava as Narapati III, penultimate king of the Shan line that had ruled there since 1527. He ended the seven years' war with Toungoo as soon as he came to the throne, but spent his entire reign fighting Sithu Kyawhtin of Sagaing, who had Mohnyin behind him, and ended with a rump kingdom east of the Irrawaddy and north of Bagan. In October 1551 he was driven out of Ava and fled to Pegu, where Bayinnaung took him in and he lived out his years. Bayinnaung's campaigns of 1556 and 1557 broke the Shan confederation, and Mong Pai kept its local saopha under Toungoo overlordship.
zh:
孟拜，缅语称莫别，是南掸高原没入克耶山地一带森林中的掸人小邦。诏法只以一座首邑统辖全境，掸人家族与克耶人及其他讲克伦语的村民共居在道道山岭上。山路西通阿瓦边疆，北接翁包—昔卜等较大的掸邦。1444年，孟拜是阿瓦东南多事边陲上的小土邦，被掸邦同盟与缅甸低地诸廷的争夺夹在中间。

就是这个偏僻小邦的首领，后来登上了阿瓦王位。他是翁包—昔卜诏法孔迈之子，被父亲封到孟拜；1545年，他入主阿瓦，称那罗波蒂三世，是1527年以来统治阿瓦的掸人王统中倒数第二位国王。他一即位就结束了与东吁打了七年的战争，却在整个在位期间与背后有孟养支持的实皆首领西都觉丁交战，最终只保有伊洛瓦底江以东、蒲甘以北的残余领地。1551年10月，他被逐出阿瓦，南逃勃固，勃印曩收留了他，他便在那里度过余生。1556至1557年，勃印曩的征战击垮掸邦同盟，孟拜保留本地诏法，成为东吁治下的属邦。

en:
Sandoway, now Thandwe and called Dvaravati in Arakanese tradition, lies in a narrow hill-girt valley on the Sandoway River, a few miles inland from a Bay of Bengal roadstead. After the Launggyet kingdom collapsed, southern Arakan stood apart under Sandoway. In the 1420s Saw Yin Mi ruled there as queen after her husband died; when one of her sons killed the other and seized power, she offered the town to Mrauk U in 1437 and married King Min Khayi, becoming his queen. In 1444 Sandoway was therefore the southern port of the newly unified Arakanese kingdom, a Buddhist Arakanese market town between the Rakhine hills and the sea.

Min Khayi gave the coast a generation of stable rule, and in 1455 Ava recognised Mrauk U as a sovereign kingdom. As Mrauk U's southern gate the town took the weight of both great Toungoo invasions. Tabinshwehti's armies came in 1546 on behalf of Min Aung Hla, Sandoway's own displaced viceroy, overran southern Arakan, made peace outside Mrauk U in January 1547 and withdrew from the town by March. The second invasion reached Sandoway in 1581 and broke off when Bayinnaung died that year. Arab, Portuguese, Dutch and Danish ships frequented the kingdom's shores in its age of sea power. Bodawpaya's Konbaung armies ended the independent kingdom in 1785, and Sandoway became a provincial town of the Burmese empire, its river carrying out the rice, timber and salted fish of the surrounding hills.
zh:
山多威即今丹兑，在阿拉干传统中称德瓦拉瓦底，坐落在山多威河一片群山环抱的狭谷中，距孟加拉湾的锚地数英里。隆吉王国崩溃后，阿拉干南部以山多威为中心自立。1420年代，苏茵米在丈夫死后以女王身份统治；后来一个儿子杀死兄弟夺得权力，她便在1437年把山多威献给妙乌，并嫁给卡意王，成为他的王后。1444年，山多威已是重新统一的阿拉干王国南部门户，是若开山地与大海之间一座信奉上座部佛教的阿拉干人市镇。

卡意的统治给海岸带来一代人的安定，1455年阿瓦承认妙乌为主权王国。作为妙乌的南部门户，山多威两度承受东吁的大举进攻。1546年，德彬瑞梯以本城被废总督（Min Aung Hla）的名义出兵，11月攻克丹兑，横扫阿拉干南部，1547年1月在妙乌城外议和，3月退出丹兑。1581年缅军再度攻入丹兑，不久莽应龙去世，军队退去。在王国的海上盛世，阿拉伯、葡萄牙、荷兰和丹麦的商船出入海岸。1785年，波道帕耶的贡榜军队攻灭独立的阿拉干王国，山多威成为缅甸帝国的地方城镇，河道运出周围山地出产的稻米、木材和咸鱼。

en:
Moulmein, now called Mawlamyine, occupies the east bank of the Salween at its mouth, where the Gyaing and Ataran rivers join it and Bilu Island shelters the anchorage, with Martaban across the water. Its Mon name means 'damaged eye': legend tells of a Mon king with a third eye in his forehead that could see into neighbouring kingdoms, until a bride sent from one of them destroyed it. Above the harbour the Kyaikthanlan pagoda stands on its ridge, said to keep a hair of the Buddha given by a hermit at Thaton and a tooth relic brought from Sri Lanka. In 1444 Moulmein was a district town of the Martaban province of Hanthawaddy, sharing its roadstead with the far greater port on the opposite shore, where the jars called martabans were shipped across the Indian Ocean.

King Dhammazedi's Kalyani inscriptions at Pegu numbered Moulmein among the thirty-two Mon towns of the Martaban division. Tabinshwehti's armies took it with Martaban in May 1541. In 1594 its governor rebelled in league with Naresuan of Siam, and the town stayed Siamese until Burmese armies recovered the coast in 1614. It was later swept into the Mon restoration and retaken by the Konbaung kings, who used it as a staging post in their wars with Ayutthaya: the general Minkhaung Nawrahta repaired the town in 1760 on his way back from that front, and Maha Nawrahta began repairing the Kyaikthanlan pagoda in 1764 while marching on Tavoy, but Moulmein was destroyed before the work was finished.
zh:
摩棉，即今毛淡棉，位于萨尔温江口东岸，吉英河与阿特兰河在此汇入，比卢岛为港湾遮风挡浪，隔水便是马达班。它的孟语名字意为「损坏的眼睛」：相传一位孟人国王额前生有第三只眼，能窥见邻国的动静，后来邻国献来的新娘设计毁了这只眼。港湾上方的山脊上立着吉桃兰塔（Kyaikthanlan），相传塔中藏有一位直通隐士赠予的佛发，以及僧侣使团从斯里兰卡迎回的佛牙。1444年，摩棉是勃固王国马达班地区的一座属城，与对岸繁盛得多的马达班共用同一片锚地，被称作「马达班」的釉陶瓮就从对面装船，销往印度洋各地。

勃固国王达马塞底（Dhammazedi）所立的迦梨耶尼碑铭（Kalyani Inscriptions），把摩棉列为马达班地区三十二座孟人城镇之一。1541年5月，德彬瑞梯的军队在攻下马达班时连它一并取下。1594年，守将联合暹罗国王纳黎萱反叛，摩棉此后一直处于暹罗治下，直到1614年缅军收复海岸。后来它又被卷入孟人的勃固复兴，重归贡榜王朝后成为征讨阿瑜陀耶的兵站：1760年，明康瑙拉塔（Minkhaung Nawrahta）将军从阿瑜陀耶前线班师时修治此城；1764年，玛哈·瑙拉塔（Maha Nawrahta）进军土瓦途中着手修缮吉桃兰塔，但工程未完，摩棉便遭毁坏。

en:
Mergui faces the Andaman Sea behind a screen of more than eight hundred wooded islands, the Mergui Archipelago. From the eleventh to the thirteenth century it was the southernmost outpost of the Pagan Empire; after Pagan collapsed in 1287 the town passed to Sukhothai and then to Ayutthaya. Its harbour was the western end of the shortest crossing of the Malay Peninsula: merchants from across the Indian Ocean landed there, poled upriver to Tenasserim and crossed the hills to the Gulf of Siam and Ayutthaya. In 1444 Mergui was a Mon-speaking, Theravada Buddhist port, Siam's main window on the Andaman, and its trade with the Coromandel Coast was run chiefly by Muslim merchants from Golconda.

Bayinnaung's Burma held the town from 1564 until Naresuan recovered the coast in 1593. Under King Narai the port was drawn into European quarrels: his Greek minister Phaulkon built ships there and put Englishmen in command, Governor Richard Burnaby and the harbormaster Samuel White. When White used Siamese vessels to raid Indian shipping, the East India Company sent two warships from Madras. On the night of 14 June 1687, while the English were entertained on shore, Siamese troops led by the governor of Tenasserim fell on them and killed some eighty-seven men; Narai afterwards had that governor executed and gave Mergui to the French officer the Chevalier de Beauregard. The Siamese revolution of 1688 drove the French garrison out in its turn, the survivors seizing a Siamese warship to escape. The port stayed Siamese until 1765, when a Konbaung army stormed it, opening the invasion that destroyed Ayutthaya in 1767.
zh:
丹老面向安达曼海，港外横亘着丹老群岛，八百多个林木茂密的岛屿排成一道屏障。11至13世纪，这里是蒲甘帝国最南端的据点；1287年蒲甘崩溃后，此城先后归入素可泰与阿瑜陀耶。它的港湾是横越马来半岛最短通道的西端：印度洋各地的商人在此登岸，溯河而上抵达丹那沙林城，再翻过山岭前往暹罗湾和阿瑜陀耶。1444年的丹老是一座讲孟语、信上座部佛教的港口，也是暹罗面向安达曼海的主要窗口，同乌木海岸的贸易多由戈尔孔达来的穆斯林商人经营。

1564年，勃印曩的缅甸占了此城，纳黎萱1593年才为暹罗收复海岸。那莱王在位时，这个港口卷入欧洲人的争夺：国王的希腊籍大臣康斯坦丁·华尔康在此造船，把港务交给两个英国人，城主理查德·伯纳比和港务官塞缪尔·怀特。怀特调暹罗船去劫掠印度商船，英国东印度公司便从马德拉斯派来两艘军舰。1687年6月14日夜，英国人在岸上赴宴时，丹那沙林长官率暹罗兵士动手，杀死约八十七名英国人；事后那莱王将这名长官处死，把丹老交给法国军官博勒加德管辖。1688年暹罗革命，法国戍军也被赶走，残部夺取一艘暹罗战舰才突围出海。港口一直属暹罗所有，直到1765年贡榜王朝的军队将其攻陷，为1767年攻灭阿瑜陀耶的入侵打开通道。

en:
Tighina guarded the chief crossing of the lower Dniester, on the road from Moldavia to the Crimean steppe and the Black Sea. Genoese traders from Cetatea Albă knew the ford as Teghenaccio, and Prince Alexandru cel Bun named it in a charter of 8 October 1408 granting the merchants of Lviv passage through Moldavia, the town's first mention. It grew into Moldavia's busiest customs post, taking dues on the cattle and goods moving to the Crimea, and Stephen the Great threw up an earth-and-timber palanka there against Tatar raiders. In 1444 Tighina was an open toll town on the river bank, watching the steppe road into Moldavia.

In 1538, when Petru Rareș withheld the tribute and his boyars deserted him, Suleiman entered Tighina without a fight and annexed it with eighteen surrounding villages as an Ottoman raia, renaming it Bender. The fortress rebuilt there by Koca Mimar Sinan and finished in 1541 beat off every army sent against it for the rest of the century, those of John the Terrible and Michael the Brave and the raids of the Zaporozhian Cossacks among them. Antioh Cantemir enlarged the works for the sultan early in the next century, and the place's strangest years followed. Beaten at Poltava in 1709, Charles XII of Sweden and Ivan Mazepa pitched camp with their Swedish and Cossack following at nearby Varnița; on 5 April 1710 Pylyp Orlyk's Cossack constitution, which separated legislative, executive and judicial power, was accepted in the king's camp. When the Ottomans tired of their guest they brought up artillery and stormed the camp on 1 February 1713: Charles with some forty men held a burning house for seven hours until he tripped on his own spurs and was taken, the brawl that gave Swedish the word kalabalik for a scuffle. The fortress fell to the Russians twice in the later Russo-Turkish wars and opened its gates without a fight in 1806; the Treaty of Bucharest in 1812 attached Bender with all Bessarabia to Russia.
zh:
蒂吉纳扼守德涅斯特河下游最重要的渡口，位于摩尔达维亚通往克里米亚草原与黑海的道路上。来自白堡的热那亚商人把这个渡口称作特盖纳乔，1408年10月8日，善人亚历山德鲁在赐予利沃夫商人通行摩尔达维亚特权的诏书中提到此地，这是该城最早的文字记载。它发展为摩尔达维亚最繁忙的税卡，对运往克里米亚的牲畜和货物抽税；斯特凡大公又在这里筑起土木栅栏堡，防备鞑靼人来袭。1444年的蒂吉纳还是河岸上一座不设城墙的税镇，监视着通入摩尔达维亚的草原之路。

1538年，彼得·拉雷什停纳贡赋又被波雅尔背弃，苏莱曼一世兵不血刃进入蒂吉纳，把它连同周围18座村庄并为奥斯曼的拉亚，改名本德尔。科贾·米马尔·希南主持重建的要塞1541年完工，此后一个世纪里击退了所有来攻之敌，「可怖者」约翰三世、勇敢者米哈伊和扎波罗热哥萨克都奈何它不得。18世纪初，安东尼奥克·坎泰米尔奉苏丹之命扩建工事，随后便是此地最离奇的岁月。1709年在波尔塔瓦战败后，瑞典国王卡尔十二世与伊万·马泽帕带着瑞典人和哥萨克随从，在附近的瓦尔尼察扎营；1710年4月5日，规定立法、行政、司法三权分立的皮利普·奥尔利克哥萨克宪法在瑞典大营获得通过。奥斯曼人厌倦了这位客人，调来火炮，于1713年2月1日强攻营地：卡尔带约四十人在起火的屋子里死守七小时，最终被自己的马刺绊倒就擒，这场混战让瑞典语多了一个表示「混战」的词kalabalik。18世纪后期的俄土战争中，要塞两度落入俄军之手，1806年又不战而开城；1812年《布加勒斯特和约》把本德尔连同整个比萨拉比亚并入俄国。

en:
Ingil covers the steppe between the Inhul and the lower Dnieper. Its most valuable ground was the Tavan crossing, where the road from Kyiv to Caffa met the river and the islands gave ferries a foothold. In the late fourteenth century this was Lithuania's southern edge on the Dnieper. Vytautas built a small fort and customs post on the site of a former residence of Tokhtamysh, remembered as 'Vytautas's Customs'. In 1444 a few Ruthenian ferrymen and customs men held the grand duke's furthest river post, with Crimean pasture beginning immediately to the south.

The Crimean khanate built Dogan fortress at the crossing in 1484, and Cossack raiders destroyed it. The Ottomans replaced it in 1665–1666 with the stone fortress of Gazi-Kermen, called Kyzy-Kermen in Russian records. Together with Islam-Kermen and Tavan, it covered the crossing and kept Zaporozhian boats from reaching the sea; a later legend says chains were stretched across the Dnieper between the forts to inspect river traffic. Ivan Sirko, the Zaporozhian otaman, breached the works in 1670 and partly dismantled them the next year. In July 1695 the army of Boris Sheremetev and Ivan Mazepa, supported by a Zaporozhian flotilla, stormed the fortress after a long siege and took thirty guns. The Ottomans agreed to demolish the works in the 1700 Treaty of Constantinople. Russian forces rebuilt them during the war of 1735–1739 and handed the place back at the peace, until the 1774 Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca left it to Russia. The town re-founded on the ruins in 1784 was named Beryslav and settled chiefly by migrants from the Poltava and Chernihiv lands.
zh:
因吉尔位于因古尔河与第聂伯河下游之间的草原，境内最要紧的地点是塔万渡口：基辅通往卡法的商路在这里过河，河洲也为渡船提供了停靠处。14世纪末，这里是立陶宛在第聂伯河下游的南界。维陶塔斯在脱脱迷失旧驻地的旧址上建起小堡垒和税关，后世称为「维陶塔斯税关」。1444年，几名鲁塞尼亚渡夫和税吏守着大公最边远的河防据点，南面紧接着就是克里米亚鞑靼人的牧场。

1484年，克里米亚汗国在渡口修建多安堡，后来被哥萨克袭掠者摧毁。1665至1666年，奥斯曼人在原地建起石堡加济克尔缅，俄文记载称克孜克尔缅。它与伊斯兰克尔缅、塔万两堡共同控制渡口，阻挡扎波罗热哥萨克船只入海；后世传说称，堡垒间曾在第聂伯河上锁起铁链，检查河上往来。扎波罗热统领伊万·西尔科1670年攻破工事，次年又拆毁其中一部分。1695年7月，鲍里斯·舍列梅捷夫和伊万·马泽帕的军队在扎波罗热小船队支援下长期围攻后强克此堡，缴获三十门火炮。1700年君士坦丁堡和约规定奥斯曼拆毁工事。1735至1739年战争期间，俄军曾重建堡垒，战后又将此地归还；1774年库楚克开纳吉和约才把它划归俄国。1784年，废墟上重建的城镇得名别里斯拉夫，居民主要来自波尔塔瓦和切尔尼戈夫。

en:
Pereiaslav lies on the Trubizh near its junction with the Alta, southeast of Kyiv and close to the open steppe. A Rus' town of this name appears in the 911 treaty with Constantinople, and around 992 Grand Prince Vladimir built a large fortress here to hold the southern border against Pecheneg raiders. From the mid-eleventh century it was the capital of the Principality of Pereiaslav, whose princes also faced the Cumans. The Tatars destroyed the city in 1239, and Lithuania acquired the district in the fourteenth century. In 1444 a small Orthodox Ruthenian community lived among the old fortifications, farming fertile grain land on a frontier still vulnerable to steppe raids.

The town revived under Polish-Lithuanian lordship. In 1585 King Stephen Báthory authorized Prince Konstanty Ostrogski, grand hetman of Lithuania, to rebuild Pereiaslav and its castle; its Magdeburg rights and coat of arms were confirmed in 1620. After the Kurukove agreement of 1625 it became a Cossack regimental centre, and in the summer of 1648 Bohdan Khmelnytsky formed the eighteen-sotnia Pereiaslav Regiment as a supply and diplomatic base. The council that met here in January 1654 gave the town its lasting place in the region's politics: the Cossack leadership swore allegiance to Tsar Alexis in return for Muscovite protection, while the precise terms of the relationship remained disputed. The agreement brought on the Russo-Polish War of 1654-1667, and the Andrusovo truce assigned Pereiaslav to Moscow. Hetman Ivan Mazepa later paid for the Ascension Monastery cathedral in the town.
zh:
佩列亚斯拉夫位于特鲁比日河与阿尔塔河汇流处附近，在基辅东南，离开阔草原不远。911年罗斯与君士坦丁堡签订的条约中已经出现这个城镇的名字；约992年，弗拉基米尔大公在这里修建大型要塞，用以守卫南方边界、抵御佩切涅格人袭掠。11世纪中叶起，这里是佩列亚斯拉夫公国的都城，历任王公还要面对库曼人。1239年，鞑靼人摧毁城市；14世纪，这一地区归入立陶宛。1444年，一小群信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚人住在旧工事之间，在仍易受草原袭扰的边疆耕种肥沃粮田。

城镇在波兰立陶宛统治下复兴。1585年，国王斯蒂芬·巴托里授权立陶宛大盖特曼康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗兹基重建佩列亚斯拉夫和城堡；它的马格德堡权利和城徽在1620年得到确认。1625年《库鲁基夫协议》后，这里成为哥萨克团级中心；1648年夏，博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基组建下辖十八个百人队的佩列亚斯拉夫团，把它作为补给和外交基地。1654年1月在这里召开的会议，使这座城镇在此后地区政治中占有固定位置：哥萨克领导层向沙皇阿列克谢宣誓效忠，以换取莫斯科的保护，但双方关系的确切条款始终存在争议。这份协议引发1654至1667年的俄波战争，安德鲁索沃停战最终把佩列亚斯拉夫划给莫斯科。盖特曼伊万·马泽帕后来出资修建了城中的升天修道院大教堂。

en:
Yelets guards a crossing of the Bystraya Sosna, a Don tributary that winds through the black-earth steppe. A Rus town stood here by the mid-twelfth century and later gave its name to a small frontier principality, among the southernmost of the Russian lands. Timur's army sacked it in 1395, and in 1415 Tatar raiders killed its prince and drove many survivors toward Ryazan. Though the district then depended on Ryazan, in 1444 Yelets was little more than a name on a dangerous border, its old crossing and pastures open to the steppe.

In 1483 the prince of Ryazan handed administration of the deserted Yelets lands to Ivan III of Moscow, but a permanent town returned only at the end of 1591, when Tsar Feodor I ordered a fortress built under the voivode Ivan Myasnoy; service Cossacks, musketeers and gentry's sons from Tula and Livny settled the new district. It served False Dmitry I as a base for a planned Crimean campaign, and in 1606 the townsmen joined Ivan Bolotnikov's revolt when Istoma Pashkov defeated a royal army outside the walls. In 1618 Zaporozhian Cossacks under Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny burned and plundered Yelets and caught the tsar's envoy Stepan Khrushchev there. He was carrying gifts to the Crimean khan worth 10,000 rubles in furs and 9,000 in silver; before the fortress fell Khrushchev destroyed the inventory and hid all the silver, and torture never made him give the hoard away. Service families repopulated the county through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. The district passed through Azov and Voronezh Governorates into the new Oryol Governorate in 1796, and the grain trade took the place of the old garrison.
zh:
叶列茨扼守顿河支流贝斯纳亚索斯纳河的渡口，河流蜿蜒穿过黑土草原。12世纪中叶，这里已有一座罗斯城镇，后来成为一个小封邑公国的治所，也是罗斯土地最靠南的据点之一。1395年帖木儿的军队洗劫此地；1415年鞑靼袭扰者杀死叶列茨王公，把许多幸存者逐往梁赞。尽管这一地区此后依附梁赞，1444年的叶列茨几乎只是危险边线上的一个地名，旧渡口和牧场完全暴露在草原之前。

1483年，梁赞王公把荒废的叶列茨土地管辖权交给莫斯科的伊凡三世，但永久城镇要到1591年底才恢复：费奥多尔一世下诏筑城，由督军伊万·米亚斯诺伊主持，来自图拉、利夫内的服役哥萨克、火枪手和贵族子弟在新地区定居。伪德米特里一世时期，它充当计划征讨克里米亚的基地；1606年，伊斯托马·帕什科夫在城外击败王军，叶列茨随即响应伊万·博洛特尼科夫起义。1618年，彼得·科纳舍维奇-萨盖达奇内率领扎波罗热哥萨克焚掠叶列茨，还在城中截获沙皇使节斯捷潘·赫鲁晓夫一行：他带着献给克里米亚汗的礼品，包括价值一万卢布的毛皮和九千卢布银币。城破之前，赫鲁晓夫销毁礼单、把银币全部藏起，虽遭酷刑也没有吐露藏处。17至18世纪，服役家族陆续在县内定居；这片地方随区划先后划入亚速省和沃罗涅日省，1796年改隶新设立的奥廖尔省，取代旧要塞的是粮食贸易。

en:
Bakhmut lies on the Bakhmutka, a small tributary of the Siverskyi Donets, where chalk ridges cut the open steppe and the Izyum trail runs north, the road Crimean and Nogai raiders followed into Muscovy. Its brine springs had been boiled for salt since early times, but in 1444 there was no town here, only the pasture of Great Horde herds. A Muscovite border watch named after the Bakhmutka is first recorded in 1571; according to the service rolls that guard met on the far bank of the Donets, a patrol rendezvous where the men were not even allowed to light a fire.

Salt brought settlers. Through the seventeenth century fugitives and Cossacks boiled brine at the springs, and in the 1680s and 1690s Cossacks of the Izium Sloboda Regiment founded a permanent settlement. Their wooden ostrog on the Bakhmutka, raised with Moscow's leave, was finished in 1703 and first surveyed in 1704. Peter I had Cossacks settled to work the salt, and the saltworks opened in 1715. Kondraty Bulavin, later the leader of the great Don uprising, had been the Bakhmut sotnyk, and in the autumn of 1705 his men seized the salt mines and held the town until government troops retook it. Bakhmut became the seat of a province in 1719, and two years later a local official, Nikita Vepreisky, and the fortress commandant Semyon Chirkov found coal nearby, the first industrial seams of the Donbas.

From 1753 to 1764 Bakhmut was the capital of Slavo-Serbia, the military district settled by Serb, Bulgarian, Hungarian and other Balkan soldiers who were formed into the Bakhmut hussar regiment. The salt trade ebbed by the end of the century. The saltworks and the fortress were closed in 1782 and 1783, the year Bakhmut received city status, and the coat of arms granted in 1811 bore the salt vats that had made the place.
zh:
巴赫穆特在北顿涅茨河小支流巴赫穆特卡河畔，白垩山脊切开开阔草原，克里米亚与诺盖人北上奔袭莫斯科所走的伊久姆大道正经过此地。当地盐泉自古煮盐，但1444年这里没有城镇，只有大帐汗国牧群的草场。1571年的记载首见以巴赫穆特卡命名的莫斯科边防哨；不过按边防勤务册，那个哨卡在北顿涅茨河对岸，只是巡逻人员碰头换消息的会哨点，按规定连火都不许生。

是盐把定居者引来的。整个17世纪，逃亡者和哥萨克在盐泉煮盐；1680至1690年代，斯洛博达乌克兰伊久姆团的哥萨克建起固定聚落，经莫斯科政府许可，他们在巴赫穆特卡河畔修筑的木寨于1703年完工，1704年第一次接受查勘。彼得一世把哥萨克安置下来采盐，煮盐厂于1715年开工。孔德拉季·布拉文曾任巴赫穆特百人队长，后来领导了那场顿河大起义；1705年秋，他的部下夺取盐场、占据城镇，直到被官军收复。1719年巴赫穆特成为省治，两年后，地方官员尼基塔·韦普列伊斯基和要塞司令谢苗·奇尔科夫在附近发现煤田，那是顿巴斯最早的工业煤层。

1753至1764年，巴赫穆特是斯拉夫塞尔维亚的首府。这个军人屯垦区安置塞尔维亚、保加利亚、匈牙利及其他巴尔干来的军人，他们后来编成巴赫穆特骠骑兵团。盐业到18世纪末衰落，1782至1783年煮盐厂和要塞先后关闭；1783年巴赫穆特正式设市，1811年获颁城徽，徽上画着让此地起家的煮盐锅。

en:
The cliff city of Mangup, ancient Doros, perches on a plateau in the southwestern Crimean mountains, the capital of a country still called Gothia. Gothic-speaking highlanders had grazed these valleys since the third century; by the fourteenth they prayed and wrote in Greek and were ruled from the cliff by the Gabras princes, who paid tribute to the Golden Horde and fought the Genoese of Caffa for the southern harbours. A branch of the house left for Moscow around 1400, founded the Simonov Monastery and, as the Khovrins, served the grand princes as hereditary treasurers. Timur sacked Mangup in 1395, but Alexios I rebuilt its power: in 1426 his daughter Maria married David, the last emperor of Trebizond, and in 1433-34 backed a Greek rising in Genoese Cembalo and retook its port of Kalamita. In 1444 its mountain valleys were planted with vines, wine went out through Kalamita, and this Orthodox principality of Greek lords and Gothic herdsmen was the last Roman state.

Alexios died about 1445. In 1472 Prince Isaac married his sister Maria of Mangup to Stephen the Great of Moldavia, and in June 1475 that alliance put his brother Alexander on the throne with Moldavian troops. Three months later Gedik Ahmed Pasha reached the cliff with his Ottoman army, fresh from the fall of Caffa. Its garrison of about 2,000 Greeks, Moldavians and Tatars beat off five assaults and cut a Janissary corps to pieces, but famine opened the gates at the end of December 1475. Alexander was beheaded in Constantinople, his young son was converted to Islam, and the fugitive Crimean khan Meñli Giray, who had taken shelter in the citadel, was carried off as well. Mangup became an Ottoman district under Kefe, its Greek households falling from about eighty in 1520 to twenty-five in 1542. In 1560 the Habsburg envoy Busbecq took down sixty-nine words of old Germanic speech from two Gothic envoys in Istanbul, its last record. The Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca of 1774 assigned it to the Crimean khanate; by 1777 only about fifty Karaite and Tatar houses remained, and after the Russian annexation of 1783 the last Karaites left in 1790.
zh:
悬崖城曼古普古称多罗斯，高踞克里米亚西南山地的一处台地，是外界仍称作「哥提亚」之地的都城。讲哥特语的山民自3世纪起在这些山谷放牧，到14世纪他们已改用希腊语礼拜和书写，由崖上的加布拉斯家族统治，即狄奥多罗公侯；他们向金帐汗国纳贡，又为争夺南部港湾同卡法的热那亚人长期交战。约1400年，家族一支迁往莫斯科，建立西蒙诺夫修道院，改姓霍夫林，世代担任莫斯科大公的世袭司库。1395年帖木儿洗劫曼古普，阿列克修斯一世却重建了国力：1426年其女玛丽亚嫁给特拉布宗末代皇帝大卫，1433至1434年狄奥多罗支持热那亚人钦巴洛城中的希腊人起义，夺回自己的港口卡拉米塔。1444年，山谷里遍植葡萄，葡萄酒经卡拉米塔外运，这个由希腊贵族和哥特牧人组成的东正教小邦，已是最后的罗马政权。

阿列克修斯约1445年去世。1472年，公侯以撒把妹妹曼古普的玛丽亚嫁给摩尔达维亚大公斯特凡三世；1475年6月，凭借这层关系，其弟亚历山大在摩尔达维亚军队支持下夺位。三个月后，刚攻克拉法的格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏率奥斯曼大军兵临崖下。约两千名希腊人、摩尔达维亚人和鞑靼人组成的守军击退五次猛攻，还歼灭了一支耶尼切里部队，但饥荒最终在1475年12月底打开城门。亚历山大被押往君士坦丁堡斩首，幼子被迫改宗伊斯兰教，连在城中避难的克里米亚汗明里·格来也被一同掳走。曼古普成为凯费下辖的奥斯曼政区，希腊人住户从1520年的约八十户降到1542年的二十五户。1560年，哈布斯堡使节布斯贝克在伊斯坦布尔见到两名哥提亚使节，记下他们古日耳曼语里的六十九个词，这是克里米亚哥特语留下的最后记录。1774年《小凯纳尔贾条约》把悬崖诸城划归克里米亚汗国；到1777年，旅人所见崖上只剩约五十户卡拉伊姆人和鞑靼人，1783年随汗国并入俄国后，最后几户卡拉伊姆人于1790年离去。

en:
Mansur is the inland Azov steppe around the Vovchi Vody and upper Samara. Its centre was the moving camp of the Mansur ulus, set among pastures rather than stone walls. In 1444 these pastures belonged to Hacı I Giray's young Crimean khanate. Mangyt clans descended from Edigu, led by the Mansur mirzas, grazed their herds there and supplied the khan with some of his strongest cavalry; Crimean records called their following the Mansur ulus.

The horde's value was military. Under Divey-mirza, its bey from 1542 to 1572, Mansur riders held the grassland between the Mius and the Molochna, screened Perekop from the north and raided the southern borders of Muscovy. Divey became Devlet I Giray's karachibek and led Nogai detachments in the 1571 campaign that burned Moscow and carried off sixty to eighty thousand captives; he was captured at the Battle of Molodi the next year. His son Esinei later took part in Crimean succession wars and died fighting in 1584. In 1577 the Crimean prince Adil Giray founded Bali-Saray on the Azov edge of these pastures. The Mansur ulus disappears from the records in the 1630s, when Kantemir Diveyev led its remnants west to Perekop and the Budjak. After Peter the Great took Azov in 1696 the northern grazing grounds emptied. Russian armies crossed them in 1736, although the Treaty of Belgrade returned the steppe to the khan three years later. In 1770 the Nogai hordes accepted Russian protection and were eventually moved to the Kuban. After the Zaporozhian Sich was abolished in 1775, the adjoining Cossack grassland was opened to settlement under the Russian crown.
zh:
曼苏尔是沃夫奇沃季河与萨马拉河上游一带的亚速内陆草原。它的中心是曼苏尔乌鲁斯的移动牧帐，没有城墙围起的城镇。1444年，这片牧场属于哈吉一世·格来新建的克里米亚汗国。也迪该后裔的曼格特诸部在曼苏尔米尔扎率领下放牧，并向汗提供一支精锐骑兵；克里米亚档案把这支部众称为曼苏尔乌鲁斯。

这帐人马的价值在军力。季韦伊米尔扎1542至1572年担任比伊时，曼苏尔骑兵据有米乌斯河与莫洛奇纳亚河之间的草场，从北面掩护彼列科普，并南下袭扰莫斯科南疆。季韦伊成为德夫莱特一世·格来的卡拉奇别克，率诺盖队伍参加1571年远征：莫斯科在那次战事中被焚，六万至八万人被掳走；次年，他在莫洛季战役中被俘。他的儿子叶西涅伊后来卷入克里米亚继承战争，1584年战死。1577年，克里米亚王子阿迪尔·格来在这片牧场邻近亚速海的一侧修建巴雷萨莱堡。17世纪30年代，曼苏尔乌鲁斯从记载中消失，坎捷米尔·季韦耶夫率余部西迁彼列科普和布贾克。1696年彼得大帝夺取亚速后，北方牧场渐渐空弃。俄军1736年横穿草原，但三年后的贝尔格莱德和约又把它归还汗国。1770年，诺盖诸斡耳朵接受俄国保护，最终被迁往库班。1775年扎波罗热塞契被取缔后，相邻的哥萨克草原也在俄国治下开放移民。

en:
Kyzyl-Yar is the low shore where the Molochna enters a liman by the Sea of Azov. Salt lakes break the coastline, and open grassland runs north behind them. In 1444 these pastures belonged to Hacı I Giray's Crimean khanate. Jamboyluk Nogais camped by the lagoons with their herds, while the Sheep ford on the Molochna formed a junction between the Muravsky and Izyum trails. Tatar columns used those tracks to ride north into the Ruthenian and Muscovite borderlands. The Nogai aul beside the ford was called Kyzyl-Yar, the 'red bank'.

From 1478 the Crimean khanate stood under Ottoman protection. During the war of 1735–1739, a band of Zaporozhian Cossacks under Mykyta Moiseev routed a Kalmyk ulus near the Sheep ford. Russian troops held the coast in 1736, but the Treaty of Belgrade returned it three years later. A Russian redoubt garrisoned by Zaporozhians was built here in 1769. The Nogai hordes accepted Russian protection in 1771, confirmed by the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774, and the shore passed to Russia with the Crimea in 1783. Cossack families, retired soldiers and migrants settled near the ford in the mid-1780s. In 1803 Mennonites invited from Prussia founded Halbstadt on the Molochna, later the centre of the Molochna Mennonite district; each household received sixty desyatinas of good land, ten years' exemption from taxes, and access to a loan of up to three hundred rubles. The old aul was renamed Novoaleksandrovka in 1816.
zh:
克孜勒亚尔是莫洛奇纳亚河注入亚速海利曼处的低岸。盐湖截开海岸线，湖岸后方是向北铺开的开阔草原。1444年，这片牧场属于哈吉一世·格来的克里米亚汗国。詹布伊卢克诺盖人傍着水洼扎幕放牧，莫洛奇纳亚河上的羊渡连接穆拉夫斯基古道和伊久姆古道，鞑靼骑队沿这些道路北上，进入鲁塞尼亚和莫斯科边境。渡口旁的诺盖村庄叫克孜勒亚尔，意为「红岸」。

1478年起，克里米亚汗国受奥斯曼庇护。1735至1739年战争期间，米基塔·莫伊谢耶夫率领一队扎波罗热哥萨克在羊渡附近击溃一个卡尔梅克乌鲁斯。俄军1736年控制海岸，但三年后的贝尔格莱德和约又把它归还。1769年，俄国人在此修建由扎波罗热哥萨克戍守的多面堡。1771年，诺盖诸斡耳朵接受俄国保护，1774年库楚克开纳吉和约予以确认，1783年海岸随克里米亚并入俄国。18世纪80年代中期，哥萨克家庭、退伍士兵和移民开始在渡口附近定居。1803年，应俄国政府之邀从普鲁士迁来的门诺派教徒在莫洛奇纳亚河畔建立哈尔布施塔特，后来成为莫洛奇纳亚门诺派教区的中心；每户领到60俄亩良田，免税十年，还可申请最高300卢布的贷款。1816年，旧诺盖村改名为新亚历山德罗夫卡。

en:
Tyn is the dry Azov grassland crossed by the upper and middle Kalmius, whose valley runs south from the Donets Ridge to the Sea of Azov. On the Kalka river near the coast, the allied princes of Rus' and the Cumans were routed by the Mongol generals Jebe and Subutai in 1223, after which these pastures fell to the Golden Horde and later to the thinly held Wild Fields. In 1444 no town stood here: Crimean and Nogai herds moved along the river, the Kalmius raiding trail branched from the Muravsky road to carry Tatar columns north toward the Donets, and the steppe lay open between Hacı Giray's new Crimean khanate and Küçük Muhammad's Great Horde. Its wealth was in horses, cattle and sheep rather than walls.

Zaporozhian Cossacks entered the valley in the fifteenth century, using the river's rapids to slip down to the Azov fisheries and salt grounds; in the sixteenth century they built the Domakha watch above the mouth, later the seat of their Kalmius palanka, with winter camps and shelter for fugitives from the war-torn lands to the north. The Treaty of Constantinople in 1700 forbade settlements and fortifications on this coast as far as the Mius, and Peter I destroyed the Zaporozhian Sich in 1709. After the Cossacks returned in 1734, an imperial decree of 1746 made the Kalmius the boundary between the Zaporozhian and Don hosts, and the last great Tatar raid burned the river camps in 1769. The Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774 and the destruction of the Sich in 1775 opened the country to Russian settlement: a sloboda appeared on the Kalmius in 1776, Pavlovsk was laid out at the mouth in 1778, and in 1780 Crimean Greeks were resettled around the town renamed Mariupol.
zh:
提恩是卡利米乌斯河中上游穿过的干燥亚速草原，河谷顺顿涅茨海脊南下，通向亚速海。1223年，罗斯诸王公与钦察人的联军在近海的迦勒迦河畔被蒙古将领哲别、速不台击溃，这片牧场随后落入金帐汗国之手，后来又成为控制松散的荒野的一部分。1444年这里没有城镇：克里米亚和诺盖牧群沿河转场，卡利米乌斯袭扰路从穆拉夫斯基大道分出，鞑靼骑兵经此北上顿涅茨河，整片草原处在哈吉·格来新建的克里米亚汗国与库楚克·马哈麻的大帐汗国之间，财富是马、牛、羊，而不是城墙。

15世纪，扎波罗热哥萨克进入河谷，借河道急流潜往亚速海渔场和盐场；16世纪，他们在河口上方修筑多马哈哨所，后来成为卡利米乌斯帕兰卡的治所，设有冬营，也收容从北方战火中逃来的人。1700年《君士坦丁堡条约》规定直到米乌斯河的这段海岸不得设居、不得设防，彼得一世又在1709年摧毁扎波罗热塞契。1734年哥萨克返回后，1746年的女皇诏令以卡利米乌斯河为扎波罗热与顿河两支哥萨克的分界，1769年最后一次大规模鞑靼袭掠烧毁了河畔营寨。1774年《库楚克开纳吉条约》签订、1775年塞契被取缔后，这片土地向俄国移民开放：1776年卡利米乌斯河畔出现一座斯洛博达，1778年河口建起帕夫洛夫斯克，1780年克里米亚希腊人被安置到改名后的马里乌波尔周围。

en:
This is the open grassland between the lower Don and the Manych, where the Kalaus and Yegorlyk run east through country studded with Sarmatian burial mounds. Ptolemy marked a station called Azaraba on a river flowing to the Maeotis, and Sarmatian clans such as the Siraces grazed these pastures behind the Greek trading posts on the coast. Khazars, Cumans and the Mongols of the 1240s in turn used it as grazing ground, but no town ever rose here: its only roads were the tracks linking Azak on the Don with Majar on the Kuma. In 1444 it is a disputed march. The Tatar clans moving their herds here lean toward Hacı Giray's new Crimean khanate, while Küçük Muhammad's Sarai Horde still claims the fore-Caucasus beyond the Manych.

Meñli Giray settled the quarrel in June 1502 by destroying the Great Horde and dividing its lands. In 1557 Kazy-mirza led the Lesser Nogais west out of the breaking Nogai confederation to the Azov steppe and the Kuban, and from the 1590s their uluses moved along the Manych and the Kuma as vassals of the Girays and partners in their slave raids into Rus. Between 1628 and 1634 Kho-Urluk's Kalmyks overran the Volga pastures and pushed the Nogai remnants toward the Kuban, after which Kalmyk, Nogai and Don Cossack raiders harried one another across the grassland for a century and a half. In January 1771 Ubashi Khan led about 170,000 Kalmyks east on the march back to Dzungaria; raids, thirst, cold and hunger left roughly 70,000 alive at its end, and Catherine II used the exodus to abolish the Kalmyk khanate that October. Six years later Potemkin's Azov-Mozdok line pinned the country down with fortresses on the Kalaus and the Yegorlyk; after Suvorov broke the Nogai rising in 1782 and Russia annexed the Crimean khanate in 1783, Khoper and Volga Cossacks garrisoned the new stanitsas, and peasant villages of the 1790s ploughed the old wandering pastures into fields.
zh:
这是下顿河与马内奇河之间的开阔草原，卡劳乌斯河和叶戈尔雷克河向东流贯，原野上散落着萨尔马提亚牧人的坟丘。托勒密曾在一条注入迈奥提斯湖的河畔标出名为阿扎拉巴的驿站，西拉克等萨尔马提亚部落在沿海希腊商站身后的牧场游牧。可萨人、钦察人和1240年代的蒙古人先后把这里用作牧场，却始终没有兴起城镇，唯一的道路是连接顿河畔阿扎克与库马河畔马贾尔的牧道。1444年它是一块争议中的边地：迁来放牧的鞑靼部落倒向哈吉·格来新建的克里米亚汗国，库楚克·马哈麻的萨莱汗庭仍宣称马内奇河彼岸的前高加索草原归其所有。

1502年6月，明里·格来攻灭大帐汗国、瓜分其土地，争端就此了结。1557年，卡兹米尔扎率小诺盖人脱离崩解中的诺盖联盟西迁，进入亚速草原和库班；1590年代起，他们的兀鲁思沿马内奇河和库马河转场游牧，作为格来王朝的藩属，跟着汗军深入罗斯掳人为奴。1628至1634年，和鄂尔勒克的卡尔梅克人席卷伏尔加河牧场，把诺盖残部逼向库班，此后一个半世纪里，卡尔梅克人、诺盖人和顿河哥萨克的袭掠队伍在草原上互相攻伐。1771年1月，渥巴锡汗率约十七万卡尔梅克人踏上东归准噶尔的长路，一路遭袭掠、受饥渴严寒，抵达时只剩约七万人；叶卡捷琳娜二世趁这次出走于同年10月废除卡尔梅克汗国。六年后，波将金的亚速—莫兹多克防线以卡劳乌斯河和叶戈尔雷克河上的要塞把这片土地钉入版图；1782年苏沃洛夫击溃诺盖起义，1783年俄国兼并克里米亚汗国，霍皮奥尔和伏尔加哥萨克驻守新建村镇，1790年代的农民村落把旧日游牧牧场犁成农田。

en:
The forest-steppe around Etkara lies where the Atkara flows into the Medveditsa. Oak thickets cover the higher ground, and the river valleys open into pasture, ploughland and fishing water. Russian chronicle tradition places the Tatar khan Etkara's ulus here in 1358, in dense woodland that was easy to defend and close to hunting grounds and tilled fields. The small river took his name. His herdsmen were Mishar Tatars, and in 1444 the country was still counted among the lands of the Great Horde, then splitting into rival Tatar powers. Herds moved along the Medveditsa, and the same riverside tracks carried traders and raiders between the Volga towns and the steppe.

After Muscovy took Kazan in 1552 and Astrakhan in 1556, this frontier needed guarded settlements. In 1699 Peter I ordered a watch sloboda built on the strong, convenient ground at the Etkara's mouth; ploughing soldiers served as its garrison and sowed its grain. The settlement kept the older name Yetskara. Catherine II made it the town of Atkarsk in 1780 and seat of an uyezd in Saratov Viceroyalty. Its 1781 coat of arms showed three fish-eating birds over the river, taken from the Atkara's bird colonies. The town lost its urban status in 1798 and recovered it in 1804, when most of its roughly 1,200 people were still soldier-farmers rather than merchants or craftsmen.
zh:
埃特卡拉一带是森林草原，阿特卡拉河在此流入梅德韦季察河。高地上橡树林茂密，河谷间分布着牧场、耕地和渔场。俄国编年史传统称，鞑靼汗埃特卡拉1358年在密林中设立兀鲁思；那里便于防守，也靠近猎场和田地，小河后来以他得名。他的牧人是米萨鞑靼人。1444年，这片土地仍算大帐汗国的属地，而汗国正分裂成相互争战的鞑靼势力。畜群沿梅德韦季察河移动，同一些河畔小路也供商队和袭掠者往来于伏尔加城镇与草原之间。

莫斯科1552年征服喀山、1556年征服阿斯特拉罕后，这条边界需要设防聚落。1699年，彼得一世下令在阿特卡拉河口坚固合用的地方修建警戒集镇，屯田士兵既守城也种粮。集镇保留旧称耶茨卡拉。1780年，叶卡捷琳娜二世把它改设为城市阿特卡尔斯克，并作为萨拉托夫总督区的县城。1781年的城徽绘有三只在河上飞翔的食鱼鸟，图案来自阿特卡拉河上的鸟群。1798年城市地位被撤，1804年恢复；当时约1200名居民中，多数仍是军屯士兵，而不是商人或工匠。

en:
Majar was a Golden Horde city on the Kuma River, where caravan roads from Transcaucasia fanned out toward the Black Sea and the Volga. Its bazaars and workshops, served by public baths and clay water pipes, drew Turks, Alans, Russians and Jews, and Persian and Indian coins found in the ruins show how far its trade reached. The name Majar is linked to the Magyars, the Hungarians, whom medieval tradition placed on these steppes. In 1310-1311 the city held a special fiscal status and struck its own coin, and under Khan Janibeg, from 1342 to 1357, it served as one of the khan's residences. Ibn Battuta, visiting around 1332, called al-Machar one of the finest cities of the Turks, on a great river with gardens and abundant fruit. It belonged for a time to the warlord Mamai; legend has him marching from Majar on the Rus' campaign that ended at Kulikovo in 1380. Timur's general Miran Shah sacked the city in 1395, though local coins show a partial recovery. In 1444 Majar, weakened but still inhabited, belonged to the Great Horde, surrounded by the livestock pastures of the North Caucasian steppe.

From 1459 Majar belonged to the Astrakhan Khanate. After a small Cossack detachment entered Hajji-Tarkhan unopposed in 1556 and the khanate ended, the city emptied; neighbouring Muslims went on honouring its mausolea as an ancestral burial ground, and Nogai herds grazed the plain. Settlers returned only in the 1790s, when Armenian traders and craftsmen occupied the Old Majar site as Karabagly, and in 1799 Emperor Paul I authorised Armenians from Derbent to found the town of Svyatoy Krest. In 1821 it was a small frontier town living chiefly by trade, vineyards and wine.
zh:
马加尔是金帐汗国在库马河畔的城市，外高加索商路在此分赴黑海与伏尔加河流域。城中有公共浴场和陶制水管，市集与作坊吸引突厥人、阿兰人、俄罗斯人和犹太人混居；遗址出土的波斯和印度钱币，说明它的商路远达何地。马加尔之名与马扎尔人（匈牙利人）有关，中世传说把马扎尔人的故地安排在这片草原。1310—1311年，城市享有特殊财政地位，自铸钱币；札尼别汗在位的1342—1357年间，这里是汗的驻地之一。伊本·白图泰约1332年到访，称阿拉—马查尔是突厥人最美好的城市之一，依傍大河，园圃连绵、果实丰饶。城市一度归入军阀马迈麾下，相传他从马加尔起兵东征罗斯，1380年败于库里科沃。1395年，帖木儿的将领米兰沙洗劫城市，当地铸币显示此后略有恢复。1444年时，马加尔已经衰落但仍有人烟，属大帐所有，四周是北高加索草原的牧场。

1459年起，马加尔归属阿斯特拉罕汗国。1556年，一小队哥萨克兵不血刃进入哈吉—塔尔汗，汗国灭亡，城市随之荒废；邻近穆斯林仍把城中陵墓当作祖先墓地前来朝拜，诺盖牧群在平原上游牧。直到1790年代才有定居者回来：亚美尼亚商人和工匠占据老马加尔遗址，形成名为卡拉巴格雷的聚落；1799年，帕维尔一世准许来自杰尔宾特的亚美尼亚人建立圣十字城。到1821年，它还是一座小型边城，居民主要靠商业、葡萄园和酿酒为生。

en:
Kuma takes in the steppe along the Kuma, an 802-kilometre river that rises in the Greater Caucasus and runs north-east through the Caspian Depression to the Caspian's Kizlyar Gulf. In 1444 the river tied the Great Horde's pastures to the caravan towns of the lower Volga, the bazaars and ruins of Majar, and the roads up the Terek toward the Caucasian passes. Tatar and Nogai herders watered horses, cattle and sheep on its banks and moved camp between the dry steppe and the greener foothills. No walled town stood at the Kuma crossing; the place mattered for its grass, water and passage.

After the Astrakhan Khanate fell in 1556, the Kuma valley became a Muscovite frontier. In the 1630s Oirat Kalmyks moving in from the Volga steppe defeated the Great Nogai Horde and drove the Nogai survivors toward the Caucasian plain, the Terek and Crimean protection. Around 1,500 Don Cossack Old Believers settled on the river in the 1680s. On 24 April 1777 Catherine II ordered the Azov-Mozdok fortified line; Potemkin planned ten strongholds from Mozdok to Azov, and the fourth, on the Kuma, was to quarter the sector commander. Khopyor and Don Cossacks built the stanitsas along it, and after 1782 Potemkin's land grants brought gentry and peasant settlers into the valley. By 1821 the old nomad grazing ground had also become a military road between Astrakhan, Mozdok and the mountain approaches.
zh:
库马省辖境沿库马河展开。库马河全长802公里，发源于大高加索山脉，向东北流经里海低地，注入里海的基兹利亚尔湾。1444年时，这条河把大帐的牧场、伏尔加河下游的商队城镇、马加尔的市集与废墟，以及沿捷列克河通往高加索山口的道路连成一片。鞑靼与诺盖牧人在河畔饮马、牛、羊，在干旱草原和更湿润的山麓之间转场。库马渡口没有城墙环绕的城镇；这里的分量在于牧草、水源和通道。

1556年阿斯特拉罕汗国灭亡后，库马河谷成为莫斯科的边疆。1630年代，从伏尔加草原开来的卫拉特卡尔梅克人击败大诺盖帐，把诺盖残部赶向高加索平原、捷列克河和克里米亚的庇护。1680年代，约一千五百名顿河哥萨克旧礼仪派在河畔定居。1777年4月24日，叶卡捷琳娜二世下令修筑亚速—莫兹多克防线；波将金规划了从莫兹多克到亚速的十座要塞，第四座就设在库马河上，供该段指挥官驻扎。霍皮奥尔河与顿河的哥萨克沿防线建起村镇，1782年后波将金赏赐土地，贵族和农民移民随之进入河谷。到1821年，旧日的游牧牧场同时也是一条军用大道，连接阿斯特拉罕、莫兹多克和进山的路口。

en:
Ukek stood on the high right bank of the Volga where the river narrows to a convenient crossing, one of the first cities the Mongols built in the Golden Horde, in the 1250s and about halfway between Sarai and Bolghar. The Franciscan William of Rubruck found a new settlement at the crossing which the Tatars had settled with Russians and Saracens intermixed, and the Polo brothers stopped at Oukaka in 1262. The town grew into a craft and trading centre of nine or ten thousand people with an agricultural district around it; under Khan Tokhta its mint struck large quantities of silver and Mongol elite graves held goods brought from the west, though Khan Uzbek later withdrew its right to coin. During the Horde's civil wars the townspeople dug ditches and ramparts, and in 1334 Ibn Battuta recorded a town of middling size, fine buildings, abundant goods and extreme cold. Timur's army sacked Ukek in 1395 while pursuing Tokhtamysh. In 1444 it survived only as a much-reduced settlement within its old walls, a holding of the crumbling Great Horde.

The city did not quite die then: a dirham of the Great Horde khan Mahmud, struck at Ukek after the sack, has turned up in a Crimean hoard, and Fra Mauro's map of 1459 marks the place as Iochahi. When the English merchant Anthony Jenkinson passed in 1558 only a ruined fortress remained. Another English traveller, Christopher Burrough, later saw the remains and was told that a fine stone castle called Uvek had stood there beside a town the Russians called Sodom, which the earth had swallowed for the wickedness of its people; among the graves he made out a stone carved with a mounted bowman and others bearing what looked like Armenian letters. After Grigory Zasekin founded Saratov nearby in 1590, the old city's dressed stone was carried off to build the new town.
zh:
乌凯克位于伏尔加河右岸高地，正当河面收窄、便于涉渡之处，约在萨莱与保加尔两都之间的中点，是蒙古人在13世纪50年代为金帐汗国新建的最早一批城市之一。方济各会修士鲁布鲁克在这里见到一处新的渡口聚落，据他说鞑靼人让俄罗斯人与撒拉逊人混杂居住；波罗兄弟1262年曾路过此城，记其名为乌卡卡。它后来发展成手工业和贸易中心，居民上万，周围还有一片农业区。脱脱汗在位时，城中设厂大量铸造银币，蒙古权贵的墓葬出土过从西方运来的器物，到乌兹别克汗时铸币权被收回。汗国内战时期，居民在城外挖壕筑墙；1334年伊本·白图泰记载，此城规模中等、建筑精美、百货丰足，只是酷寒难耐。1395年帖木儿追击脱脱迷失时攻破并洗劫了乌凯克。到1444年，故城只剩旧墙内一个大为凋敝的聚落，是江河日下的大帐汗国手中一处据点。

城市并未就此彻底灭绝：一枚大帐汗马哈茂德的迪尔汗银币系城破之后在乌凯克铸造，出土于克里米亚的一处窖藏；弗拉·毛罗1459年的地图也把此地标作「约恰希」。1558年英国商人安东尼·詹金森经过时，所见只剩一座残破要塞。另一位英国旅行者克里斯托弗·巴罗后来见到废墟，听当地人讲，这里曾有一座精美的石堡名唤乌韦克，旁边的城被俄国人叫作所多玛，因居民作恶而被大地吞没；他在墓石间还辨认出一块雕着骑马弓手的石头，另一些石头上刻着看似亚美尼亚文的字母。1590年格里戈里·扎谢金在附近建起萨拉托夫后，故城的琢石被拆去营建新城。

en:
Kanadey lies in the forest-steppe between the Sura and the Volga, where the little Kanadeyka stream joins the Syzranka. A Tatar settlement of that name stood here from the thirteenth century, when the country belonged to the Golden Horde, and its name goes back to a Turkic-Mongol personal name; a nearby fortified site still keeps the stone ruins of a Horde-period town. In 1444 this was the open south-western march of the Khanate of Kazan, where Kazan and Mishar Tatars and their Mordvin neighbours pastured herds on empty grassland, and no Russian ploughland or fortress yet reached so far south-east.

For more than a century after the fall of Kazan it remained a grazing frontier. As Moscow's defence lines moved south, the Simbirsk voevoda Matvey Golovin planned the Syzran cherta, decreed in 1685, but the order was cancelled the following spring; instead a strong fortress called Kanadey, with a stone gate-tower, went up in the middle of the planned line and was attached to Simbirsk uyezd. The fortress soon became a village: by 1715 Senate papers knew it as Pokrovskoye, Kanadey likewise, after its lands passed to the Pechersky Monastery of Nizhny Novgorod, which settled its own peasants on them. Many were Old Believers of the Pomor agreement, about half the population in 1722, and the official church later had them re-baptised into Orthodoxy. A stone Intercession church was raised in 1739 at the expense of its priest, Pyotr Yakovlev. In 1780 Catherine II made Kanadey an uyezd town and granted it arms of three golden arrows, 'in token that the former dwellers of this place could wield that weapon with great agility'; sixteen years later the uyezd was abolished and Kanadey became a minor town within Syzran uyezd.
zh:
卡纳德伊地处苏拉河与伏尔加河之间的森林草原，卡纳德伊卡小河在此注入瑟兹兰卡河。早在13世纪金帐汗国时期，同名的鞑靼人聚落已存在于此，地名来自一个突厥-蒙古语人名；附近一处城址还留有汗国时代城镇的石构残迹。1444年，这里是喀山汗国开阔的西南边地，喀山鞑靼人、米萨鞑靼人和相邻的莫尔多瓦人在空旷草场上放牧畜群，俄国人的耕地和要塞尚未延伸到这么远的东南方。

喀山灭亡后的一个多世纪里，此地始终是放牧边地。随着莫斯科的筑垒防线南移，辛比尔斯克督军马特维·戈洛文规划了瑟兹兰鹿寨防线，1685年朝廷下诏修筑，次年春天又撤销成命；作为替代，人们在计划防线中段建起坚固的卡纳德伊要塞，配有一座石砌门楼，划归辛比尔斯克县。要塞不久就变成了村子：到1715年，枢密院的文书已称它为波克罗夫斯科耶村、又名卡纳德伊。此前当地土地已转入下诺夫哥罗德佩切尔斯基修道院名下，修道院把自己的农民迁来垦殖，其中许多是旧礼仪派北方沿海派信徒，1722年约占居民半数，后来由官办教会重新施洗，陆续归入正教会。1739年，靠本堂神父彼得·雅科夫列夫出资，石筑的圣母帡幪教堂落成。1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世将卡纳德伊设为县城，赐下红底三枚金箭的城徽，「以表明此地旧居民善使此器，身手矫捷」；16年后该县遭裁撤，卡纳德伊降为瑟兹兰县下属的小镇。

en:
The upper Belaya, the Aghidhel from which the province takes its name, cuts through the high valleys of the southern Urals, where the Nogai-road Bashkirs, the Burzyan, Usergan, Tamyan and Kipchak, pastured their herds. On the upper Yaik stood a mountain the Bashkirs called Atach, whose stone clung to iron; they had worked its lodestone ore for generations. In 1444 the country lay in the Nogai Horde's grazing world, and its southern edge lay open to Kazakh raiders.

The Russians reached the upper Yaik in 1734, when the Orenburg expedition set up its first post, the Verkhoyatskaya landing, with the leave of the Bashkir tarkhan Taymas Shaimov. A Bashkir attack on a supply convoy in 1736 left most of the garrison dead of hunger and frostbite and the rest evacuated, and Colonel Vasily Tatishchev, the historian commanding the Orenburg line, rebuilt it in 1737. In 1740 a Bashkir starshina, Baim Kidrayev, guided Russian miners to Atach, whose ore yielded seventy-five pounds of iron to the hundred, and the Magnitnaya fortress rose beside the mountain in 1743. The merchants Ivan Tverdyshev and Ivan Myasnikov claimed the unregistered mountain and in 1762 built the Beloretsk ironworks on the upper Belaya, on land bought from local Bashkirs, hauling Atach ore ninety versts across the steppe to their furnaces.

Beloretsk became Pugachev's headquarters in the spring of 1774. After his defeat before Orenburg he reached the works on 13 April with a handful of Bashkirs and Cossacks, and the workmen led by Vasily Akaev met him with bread and salt; for three weeks the works cast cannon while Kinzya Arslanov gathered Bashkir cavalry. On 6 May his men stormed the Magnitnaya fortress and abandoned it two days later. After the revolt Catherine II ordered the Yaik renamed the Ural, so that the rebellion might be forgotten, and Verkhoyatskaya became Verkhneuralsk, a town from 1781.
zh:
阿吉代尔即别拉亚河上游，纵贯南乌拉尔山的高山谷地；「诺盖路」的巴什基尔各部，布尔江、乌谢尔甘、塔缅、克普恰克，在此放牧。亚伊克河上游有一座巴什基尔人称作阿塔奇的山，石头能吸住铁，当地人早有开采磁石矿的传统。1444年时，这一带属于诺盖汗国的游牧世界，南缘随时面临哈萨克人的袭掠。

1734年，奥伦堡考察团经巴什基尔塔尔罕泰马斯·沙伊莫夫许可，在亚伊克河上游设立第一处据点上亚伊茨克码头。1736年巴什基尔人袭击运输队，守军大部冻饿而死，残余撤往奥伦堡；1737年，主持奥伦堡要塞线的瓦西里·塔季谢夫上校将其重建。这位塔季谢夫后来以《俄罗斯史》一书闻名，也是叶卡捷琳堡和彼尔姆的建立者。1740年，巴什基尔头人巴伊姆·基德拉耶夫把俄籍采矿人领到阿塔奇，那里的矿石百磅可炼铁七十五磅；1743年，山侧筑起马格尼特纳亚要塞。商人伊万·特维尔德舍夫和伊万·米亚斯尼科夫认下这座无主铁山，又于1762年在别拉亚河上游、购自附近巴什基尔人的土地上创办别洛列茨克铁厂，把阿塔奇的矿石越过九十俄里草原运到炉前。

1774年春，别洛列茨克铁厂成了普加乔夫起义的大本营。他在奥伦堡城下战败后，于4月13日带着少数巴什基尔人和哥萨克抵达铁厂，以瓦西里·阿卡耶夫为首的工人捧着面包和盐出迎；此后三周，铁厂铸造火炮，金贾·阿尔斯拉诺夫则四出征集巴什基尔骑兵。5月6日，义军经两日强攻拿下马格尼特纳亚要塞，两天后便将其放弃。起义平定后，叶卡捷琳娜二世下令把亚伊克河改名为乌拉尔河，好让这场叛乱被人遗忘；上亚伊茨克随之改称上乌拉尔斯克，1781年设城。

en:
Juketau, the Lime Mountain of the Volga Bulgars, stood on the left bank of the Kama at the mouth of the little Kilyovka, near later Chistopol. Founded at the end of the tenth century, it was the seat of the Juketau duchy and one of Volga Bulgaria's chief fur markets: pelts from the northern forests came down the Kama to its landing and moved on to the Muslim south. Batu Khan's army took the town in 1236, yet under the Golden Horde it remained a prince's seat, and Venetian and Catalan chart-makers marked it on their maps of 1367 and 1375. Novgorod river raiders plundered it in 1391, and by 1444 the new khanate at Kazan had drawn the trade and the court away. The town was abandoned around the middle of the century, leaving ramparts and Muslim graveyards above the river.

The earthen fort then belonged to the Kazan Khanate, and after Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in 1552 the lower Kama became Muscovite frontier. Tatar villagers and runaway Russian peasants later settled below the forgotten ramparts and called their village Chistoye Pole. Burned down in the early eighteenth century, it was rebuilt on the bare field the fire had left, and the village kept the name, which means clean field. In 1781 Catherine II raised it to a district town with a coat of arms under the name Chistopol, and grain had replaced furs as the cargo loaded at its landing.
zh:
朱克陶是伏尔加保加尔人的「椴树山」，坐落在卡马河左岸、小基廖夫卡河汇入处，日后的奇斯托波尔附近。它建于10世纪末，是朱克陶公国的都城，也是伏尔加保加利亚首要的毛皮市场之一：北方森林的毛皮沿卡马河运到它的码头，再转销穆斯林南方。1236年拔都的军队攻陷此城，但金帐汗国时期它仍是王公驻地，威尼斯和加泰罗尼亚的制图师在1367年和1375年的地图上都标出了这座卡马河畔的城镇。1391年诺夫哥罗德河上武装商队洗劫了它；到1444年，新兴的喀山汗国已把贸易和宫廷吸引过去，城镇在该世纪中叶废弃，只留下河畔的土墙和穆斯林墓地。

这座土城随后归属喀山汗国，1552年伊凡雷帝攻占喀山后，下卡马河一带成为莫斯科的边疆。后来，鞑靼村民和逃亡的俄罗斯农民在被遗忘的土墙下定居，村名称为「纯洁原野」。18世纪初村庄遭焚，人们在大火留下的空地上重建家园，仍用这个意为「洁净田野」的名字。1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世把它设为县城，赐下城徽，改以俄语称奇斯托波尔；码头上装船的货物也从毛皮换成了粮食。

en:
The high right bank of the Volga between Nizhny Novgorod and Kazan was Bulgar-Chuvash country, the Gornaya storona, the Mountain Side, of the Kazan tax rolls. After the Mongols ruined the old Bulgar cities in 1236 a new town grew on the Cheboksarka stream, shown on Italian charts as early as 1367 and marked 'Veda-Suar', the Middle Suvar, on Fra Mauro's map of 1459; under Tatar rule it was called Chabaksar. Its farmers were Chuvash, descendants of Volga Bulgar tribesmen, who grew grain on the river terraces while Volga boats called at the landing. With the breakup of the Golden Horde the land passed to the Kazan khans, and in 1444 Chabaksar was a small market town on the khanate's western road, run by Muslim governors while its Chuvash villagers kept mostly to the old Bulgar customs.

The Mountain Side defected in the last Russo-Kazan war. In May 1469 a Moscow flotilla under the voivode Ivan Runo merely 'spent the night at Cheboksar' on its way against Kazan, but in 1551 the Chuvash and hill Mari of the right bank came in to the tsar's commanders by hundreds and thousands and had to prove their loyalty in a fight beneath the walls of Kazan. That summer Sviyazhsk fortress was assembled in four weeks from timber cut near Uglich and floated down the Volga, and it became the base from which Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in 1552. The Chuvash became yasak-paying subjects, and in 1555 a wooden kremlin went up on the hill above the landing, its site consecrated by Archbishop Gury of Kazan; Cheboksary became a garrison town and the seat of a new uyezd. Volga commerce paid for the stone Vvedensky Cathedral of 1651, four monasteries and eight churches, and by the end of that century Cheboksary was counted among the chief commercial towns of the Volga. After the kremlin burned it was not rebuilt, and in 1708 Peter I made the place an uyezd town. Catherine II, passing through on her Volga journey, wrote that Cheboksary was in every way better than Nizhny Novgorod.
zh:
伏尔加河在下诺夫哥罗德与喀山之间的高峻右岸，是保加尔-楚瓦什人的土地，即喀山册籍上的「山那边」。1236年蒙古人摧毁旧保加尔诸城后，切博克萨尔卡河畔兴起一座新的河埠：1367年的意大利海图已画出它，1459年弗拉·毛罗地图把它标作「维达苏瓦尔」（楚瓦什语意为「中苏瓦尔」），鞑靼统治下称恰巴克萨尔。种地的乡民是楚瓦什人，伏尔加保加尔诸部的后裔，在河岸台地上种植谷物，伏尔加河上的船只在码头停靠。金帐汗国解体后这片土地归入喀山汗；1444年，恰巴克萨尔是汗国西路上一座小商城，由穆斯林长官管辖，楚瓦什村民则大体守着保加尔旧俗。

到最后一场莫斯科-喀山战争，山那边倒向了莫斯科。1469年5月，将领伊凡·鲁诺的船队进兵喀山，也不过在此「在切博克萨尔过夜」；1551年，右岸的楚瓦什人和山地马里人成百上千地投奔沙皇的将领，还要在喀山城下打一仗证明忠心。同年夏天，斯维亚日斯克要塞用乌格利奇附近伐好、顺伏尔加河漂来的木料四周拼装而成，成为伊凡雷帝1552年攻取喀山的基地。楚瓦什人成为缴纳雅萨克的属民；1555年，码头上的山头立起木构克里姆林宫，喀山大主教古里为城址祝圣，切博克萨雷既是要塞，也是新县的县治。伏尔加河的商利供养了1651年石建的圣母进堂大教堂、四座修道院和八座教堂，到该世纪末，切博克萨雷已被算作伏尔加河上首屈一指的商埠之一。克里姆林宫焚毁后不再重修，1708年彼得一世把此地定为县城。叶卡捷琳娜二世沿伏尔加河出巡经过此城，曾写道切博克萨雷处处都胜过下诺夫哥罗德。

en:
Alatyr stands where the Alatyr River enters the Sura, in the forest-steppe country of the Mordvins. An Erzya settlement, remembered in local place-names as Sandulei, occupied the river fork long before the Russians came, and finds there reach back to the tenth century. The first Russian stronghold in these parts was Kurmysh, founded on the Sura in 1372 by Prince Boris Konstantinovich of Nizhny Novgorod against Mordvin, Mari and Tatar raids; for two centuries it marked the eastern limit of settled Russian power. In 1444 the Alatyr fork itself held only the old Mordvin village, a debatable march between the outposts of Nizhny Novgorod and the Khanate of Kazan.

On 4 August 1552 Ivan IV, marching on his last campaign against Kazan, reached the high Sura bank at the river mouth and ordered a timbered fortress built in his presence, naming it after the Alatyr. With its pentagonal kremlin and adjoining ostrog, the new fort joined Vasilsursk and Kurmysh as one of three strongholds covering the Chuvash country on the khanate's flank, and Orthodox missionaries used it as a base among the Mordvins and Chuvash; the Trinity monastery was founded outside the walls in 1584. Razin's rising reached the Sura in 1670: rebels joined by local people seized the town, and Prince Baryatinsky retook it in November. In 1780, when Alatyr passed to the Simbirsk viceroyalty, Catherine II granted it arms of three golden quivers full of arrows, 'in token that the people of these parts knew how to wield that weapon with praise'. With two monasteries, Alatyr remained a missionary centre for the Chuvash lands, and in 1812 an infantry regiment formed here marched with the Simbirsk militia.
zh:
