While the rest of the works fell to ruin, the Raja Mahal and Rani Mahal, built of stone, brick and lime without timber, remained.
zh:
钱德拉吉里扼守蒂鲁帕蒂西南的山路，位于佩努孔达高地与泰米尔平原之间。要塞围以矩形棱堡，壕沟深陡，11世纪由以纳拉亚纳瓦纳姆为治所的首领伊马迪·纳拉辛哈·亚达瓦拉亚修建；其家族据守三百年，1367年转入毗奢耶那伽罗之手。1444年，这座要塞是帝国暴露北疆上的重镇，直面卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂。镇守此地的长官出自萨卢瓦家族：萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈的父亲曾任此职，纳拉辛哈本人也在1452年受封钱德拉吉里的「大曼达莱什瓦尔」，数十年后他才夺取帝国皇位。1460年，加贾帕蒂攻占这座要塞。

钱德拉吉里后来重归毗奢耶那伽罗，成为帝王驻跸之地。克里希那德瓦拉亚在佩努孔达加冕前曾居于此，相传他就是在这座堡中遇见未来的王后奇纳·德维；德瓦伊塔学派学者毗耶娑提尔塔曾先后担任萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈和克里希那德瓦拉亚的精神导师，也常驻这一宫廷。1565年塔利科塔战败后，戈尔康达进逼佩努孔达，阿拉维杜皇帝迁都至此，这里成为缩小后帝国的第四都城。1639年8月，朝廷把一段荒无人烟的沿海土地批给英国东印度公司的商馆官员弗朗西斯·戴；英国人在那里筑起的圣乔治堡是他们在印度的第一座要塞，后来发展为马德拉斯。1646年钱德拉吉里并入戈尔康达，其后转归迈索尔。其他工事纷纷倾圮，以石材、砖和石灰建成、不用一木的拉贾宫与拉尼宫却留存下来。

en:
Seringapatam is an island in the Kaveri, about four miles long, named for the Ranganathaswamy temple consecrated there around 984. The river cuts it off on every side, and walls along the banks made it the strongest place south of the Tungabhadra. Under the Vijayanagara emperors a mahamandaleshvara held the island as a viceregal seat, watching over the feudatory rajas of Mysore and Talakad; in 1444 the governor still holds it for the emperor, and the Wadiyar rajas across the water at Mysore are among his vassals.

Raja Wodeyar I took the island from the viceroy in 1610 and held Navaratri on it; in time two things came to mark sovereignty over Mysore, the nine-night festival of Chamundeshwari and possession of this fort. A Bijapuri army under Ranadulla Khan beat against the walls in 1638 and could not cross the river. Under Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan the island became the seat of Tipu's 'God-given' sultanate, crowded with palaces, mosques, arsenals and dungeons for British prisoners. Lord Cornwallis came before the walls on 5 February 1792 and in five weeks forced Tipu to give up half his kingdom. The British returned in 1799: after a month's siege, on 4 May, an army of the East India Company and Hyderabad under General Harris breached the rampart by the Water Gate, and Tipu was killed fighting in the gap. His treasure was carried to England, his sword and a wooden automaton of a tiger mauling a redcoat among the spoils. The Wadiyars were restored and the capital moved back to Mysore.
zh:
塞林伽巴丹是高韦里河中的一座河洲，长约四英里，因约984年落成的朗加纳塔斯瓦米神庙得名。河水四面环绕，沿岸又筑城墙，使它成为栋格珀德拉河以南最难攻取的据点。毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝以一位摩诃曼达莱什瓦拉驻守此洲，就近监视迈索尔、塔拉卡德的藩属罗阇；1444年，总督仍替皇帝守着河洲，对岸迈索尔的瓦迪亚罗阇还是他的臣属。

1610年，拉贾·瓦迪亚一世从总督手中夺取河洲，在岛上举行九夜节；后来在迈索尔宣示主权要看两件事：举办祭祀查蒙德斯瓦里的九夜庆典，以及据有这座要塞。1638年，拉纳杜拉汗率比贾布尔军队来攻，被挡在河外。海德尔·阿里与蒂普苏丹时代，河洲成为蒂普「神赐」苏丹国的都城，宫殿、清真寺、军械库和关押英国战俘的地牢遍布其间。1792年2月5日，康沃利斯兵临城下，五周后迫使蒂普割让半个王国。英军1799年再度来攻：围困一个月后，5月4日，哈里斯将军率领的东印度公司与海得拉巴联军在水门附近轰开城墙，蒂普在缺口处力战身亡。他的财宝被运往英国，战利品中有他的佩剑，还有一具老虎扑咬英兵的木制机关。瓦迪亚家族随后复位，都城迁回迈索尔。

en:
Sira lies on the dry northern edge of the Mysore plateau, on the road that leaves the Vijayanagara capital, threads the gaps of the eastern hills and runs on to the Tamil country. Grain from the surrounding villages gathers in its market before moving north toward the Tungabhadra, and the roads around it are ringed with the hill-forts of local palaigars. In 1444 it is a fortified market town of the empire, a staging post on the long route south into the Carnatic.

A Bijapuri army took Sira in 1638 and the Adil Shahis held it until 1687, when Aurangzeb, fresh from the fall of Bijapur, made the small town the capital of a new Mughal province, the Carnatic-Balaghat subah. Its first governor, Qasim Khan, ruled seven parganas reaching as far as Kolar, and even the rajas of Chitradurga and Mysore paid tribute at Sira; eight years later he died, either cut down by Maratha raiders or by his own hand after they seized a treasure in his charge. Governors after him lasted a year or two until Dilavar Khan's term of 1726 to 1756 gave the province a generation of order. The Marathas overran Sira in 1757 and again after the battle of Sira in 1767. The town is most closely tied to Hyder Ali, whose father had served the subah as faujdar of Kolar: when he took Sira in 1761 he styled himself Nawab of Sira. Tipu Sultan won it back from the Marathas in 1774.
zh:
锡拉位于迈索尔高原干燥的北缘，毗奢耶那伽罗帝都出城、穿过东山山口再通往泰米尔地区的大道经过此地。四乡征集的粮米在它的市上集中，再北上运往栋格珀德拉河；城外沿路林立着当地帕莱加尔的山寨。1444年，锡拉是帝国治下一座设防集镇，也是大军南下卡尔纳蒂克长途上的一站。

1638年，比贾布尔军队攻占锡拉，阿迪尔·沙希王朝守到1687年；刚攻灭比贾布尔的奥朗则布把这座小镇升格为莫卧儿新省卡尔纳蒂克-巴拉加特苏巴的治所。首任总督卡西姆汗下辖远及科拉尔的七个帕尔加纳，连吉德勒杜尔加和迈索尔的罗阇也到锡拉纳贡；八年后他死去，一说被马拉特突袭者砍杀，一说他们劫走他押运的财宝后他自尽。此后总督一年一换，直到迪拉瓦尔汗1726至1756年任职才给该省带来一代人的安定。马拉特人1757年攻陷锡拉，1767年又在锡拉之战后再占其地。这座城镇最出名的一段与海德尔·阿里有关：他的父亲曾在该苏巴担任科拉尔的法吉达尔，1761年海德尔夺取锡拉后便自称锡拉纳瓦卜。1774年，蒂普苏丹把它从马拉特人手中夺回。

en:
Gutti, also called Gooty, is a single fortified rock rising three hundred metres above the Rayalaseema plain, its summit girdled with ramparts, bastions and fifteen gateways, and a Narasimha temple stands within the walls. Eight damaged inscriptions cut into the rock near the temple belong to the Western Chalukya king Vikramaditya VI, and the oldest surviving works date from that late Chalukya period; the kings of Vijayanagara rebuilt the hill-fort, and an inscription of Bukka Raya calls Gooty a foremost durg. In 1444 a Telugu garrison held the rock for Deva Raya II, watching the dry road from the Tungabhadra into the Carnatic.

Under Venkata II the fort passed to the Qutb Shahis of Golconda, and with Golconda it fell to Aurangzeb in 1687. Around 1746 it was seized by Murari Rao Ghorpade, a Maratha general and grandnephew of Santaji Ghorpade who had once taken Tiruchirappalli and made the Carnatic commander Chanda Sahib his prisoner; he made Gooty his permanent seat eight years later, repaired the works and gave the small gateways their stucco ornamentation, and his territory ran east as far as Madras and Pondicherry. In 1775 Hyder Ali of Mysore besieged the hill and forced him to surrender when the garrison's water failed after two months. Gooty passed to the Nizam by the Treaty of Seringapatam in 1792 and was ceded to the East India Company with the Ceded Districts in 1800.
zh:
古提（又译戈奥特伊）是从拉雅拉西玛平原拔起三百米的一座独岩山堡，山顶以城墙、棱堡和十五座城门环绕，墙内还有一座那罗希摩神庙。寺旁岩壁上的八方残损铭文属于西遮娄其国王维克拉马迪亚六世，现存最古老的工事也建于遮娄其后期；毗奢耶那伽罗君主重修了这座山堡，布卡·拉亚的一方铭文把古提称作诸堡之首。1444年，一支泰卢固戍军替德瓦拉亚二世把守岩山，监视从栋格珀德拉通往卡纳蒂克的干旱大道。

文卡塔二世在位时，山堡转归高康达的库特卜沙希王朝，1687年随高康达一同落入奥朗则布之手。约1746年，穆拉里·拉奥·戈尔帕德夺取此山。他是马拉塔名将、桑塔吉·戈尔帕德的侄孙，曾攻下蒂鲁吉拉帕利、生擒卡纳蒂克将领昌达·萨希卜；八年后他把古提定为常驻据点，整修工事并给各小城门添上灰泥塑饰，领地向东一直伸展到马德拉斯和本地治里。1775年，迈索尔的海德尔·阿里围攻山堡，两个月后守军水源断绝，穆拉里·拉奥被迫出降。1792年《塞林伽巴丹条约》把古提划归尼扎姆，1800年它随「割让诸县」一并割让给东印度公司。

en:
Adavani, recorded as Adoni in later sources, guards the dry road between the Tungabhadra and the Deccan. Its fortress climbs three joined granite hills, its walls and gateways piled irregularly tier on tier; an observer who saw it in 1780 wrote that it needed a garrison of 30,000 men, and a visitor forty years later found its enclosures full of tanks, fountains and noble houses. The black soil of the plain below grows grain for the camps and markets of the Rayalaseema. From the fourteenth century Adoni was a north-western frontier fort of Vijayanagara, and in 1444 a Telugu garrison held the heights for Deva Raya II.

In the following century the fort passed to kinsmen of the imperial minister Aliya Rama Raya. After the rout of Talikota in 1565 its commander made himself independent, and in 1568 Ali Adil Shah I of Bijapur took Adoni. Its most notable Adil Shahi governor was Siddi Masud, a Habshi (Abyssinian-born) wazir of Bijapur who held it in the 1670s: he rebuilt the walls, cleared the forest around the town, laid out the new quarters of Imtiazgarh and Adilabad, built the Shahi Jama Masjid and kept painters of the Kurnool school at work. In 1688 he surrendered the fort to Aurangzeb's general Firuz Jang. Under the Nizams Adoni was a Deccan governorship; Salabat Jung, once its governor, was placed on the Nizam's throne with French backing in 1751. Tipu Sultan took it in 1786 after a month's siege, defeating the combined armies of the Nizam and the Marathas, and after its return to Hyderabad it was ceded to the East India Company with the Ceded Districts in 1800.
zh:
阿达瓦尼（后世文献记作阿多尼）扼守栋格珀德拉河与德干之间的干旱大道。堡垒沿三座相连的花岗岩山层层攀筑，城墙和门楼错落堆叠；1780年一名看过此堡的人写道，驻守它需要三万兵力，四十年后又有访客见到堡内遍布水塘、喷泉和显贵宅邸。山下平原的黑土种植谷物，供给拉雅拉西玛的军营与市集。14世纪起阿多尼是毗奢耶那伽罗的西北边关，1444年，一支泰卢固戍军在山头上为德瓦拉亚二世守堡。

进入16世纪，堡垒转到帝国权臣阿里亚·拉马·拉亚的亲族手中。1565年塔利科塔溃败后守将据堡自立，1568年比贾布尔的阿里·阿迪尔·沙阿一世攻占阿多尼。这里最出名的阿迪尔沙希长官是西迪·马苏德，一个出生于阿比西尼亚的哈布什人，官至比贾布尔维齐尔，1670年代出镇此地：他重修城墙、清除城镇周围的丛林、辟建伊姆蒂亚兹加尔和阿迪拉巴德两处新市街、兴建皇家聚礼清真寺，还养着一批卡努尔画派的画师。1688年，他向奥朗则布的将领菲鲁兹·江献堡。尼扎姆时期，阿多尼是德干的一处方镇；曾任此地总督的萨拉巴特·江1751年在法国支持下登上尼扎姆之位。1786年，提普苏丹围攻一个月后拿下城堡，击败尼扎姆与马拉塔联军；阿多尼交还海得拉巴后，于1800年随「割让诸县」移交东印度公司。

en:
Kondavidu is a ridge fortress in the Guntur country, high above the coastal plain between the Krishna and Godavari deltas. After the fall of Warangal in 1323, Prolaya Vema Reddy moved his capital from Addanki to the hill and strengthened its walls; his Reddy successors ruled the surrounding district for almost a century, endowing temples and tanks. Traffic below the ridge moved between the Krishna crossings and the delta roads, and gravels along the Krishna later yielded the diamonds sold as Golconda stones. In 1444 the Reddy line no longer held Kondavidu, leaving its forts in the border wars between Kapilendra Deva's Gajapatis, the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara; Reddy rulers at Rajahmundry kept the last remnant of the older kingdom.

The Bahmanis took Kondavidu in 1458 and fought Gajapati armies for its forts during the 1470s. Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara captured the ridge in 1516, and Golconda forces attacked it in 1531 and 1536 before storming it in 1579 and naming the fortress Murtazanagar. A short distance away, the Kollur pits were opened around 1619; English and Dutch visitors two years later reported 20,000 to 30,000 diggers and buyers from neighbouring kingdoms. Aurangzeb's Mughal army absorbed the fort with Golconda in 1687. The French repaired and extended its works in 1752, and the East India Company took it over with the Guntur Circar in 1788.
zh:
孔达维杜是贡土尔地方的山脊要塞，高耸在克里希纳河与戈达瓦里河三角洲之间的沿海平原上。1323年瓦朗加尔陷落后，普罗拉亚·韦马·雷迪把都城从阿丹基迁到山上，加固城墙；其后裔统治周边近一个世纪，修建寺院和水池。山脊下的道路连接克里希纳河各处渡口与三角洲通道，河畔砾石层后来出产的钻石以戈尔孔达钻石之名出售。1444年，雷迪王统已不再据守孔达维杜，各座堡垒陷入卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂、巴赫马尼苏丹国和毗奢耶那伽罗之间的边境战争；拉贾蒙德里的雷迪统治者保留着旧王国最后一支余脉。

巴赫马尼王朝1458年攻占孔达维杜，1470年代又与加贾帕蒂军队争夺各处堡垒。毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚1516年拿下山脊；戈尔孔达军队1531年和1536年两度来攻，最终于1579年破城，将要塞命名为穆尔塔扎讷格尔。不远的科卢尔矿坑约在1619年开凿，两年后英国和荷兰访客记载，那里有两三万名挖掘工，邻近各王国的珠宝商也前来购买。1687年，奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队随戈尔孔达一并吞并要塞。法军1752年修补并扩建工事；1788年，东印度公司随贡土尔萨尔卡尔接管此地。

en:
Chitradurga sits on the Vedavati in a valley choked with granite boulders, and its fort, the Kallina Kote or Stone Fort, rides a whole ridge of hills above the town. Raised in stages between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries by the Chalukyas and the Hoysalas, it was enlarged over the next four hundred years, most of all by its Nayaka chiefs, and runs to seven concentric walls with nineteen gateways, granaries and oil stores, temples and rain-fed tanks cut into the rock, so that a garrison on the hill could not easily be starved of water. The upper fort holds eighteen temples, the oldest of them the Hidimbeshwara. In 1444 this is a northern march of the Vijayanagara Empire, held by Bedar warrior chiefs, dandanayakas whose clans watch the roads north towards the Tungabhadra.

Governors who made themselves kings, the Nayakas of Chitradurga kept the fort for two centuries after Talikota, maneuvering between Bijapur, the Mughals and the Marathas; when Aurangzeb set up the subah of Sira in 1687 Chitradurga was counted among its tributaries. Bharamappa Nayaka, who ruled from 1689 to 1722 and is regarded as the greatest of the line, fought the Mughals and spent his reign raising walls, bastions, palaces, tanks and temples. The last ruler, Madakari Nayaka V, faced Hyder Ali of Mysore, who besieged the hill in 1760 and again in 1770 and took it at the third attempt in 1779, after the Marathas and some of the garrison's own officers deserted; Madakari was led away a prisoner and killed. During one of the sieges Obavva, a watchman's wife, is said to have killed the attackers as they squeezed one by one through a crack in the rock, using her onake, the long pestle for pounding rice. Hyder Ali added a mosque inside the walls, and after Tipu Sultan fell to the British in 1799 the district passed to the restored Kingdom of Mysore.
zh:
吉德勒杜尔加坐落在韦达瓦蒂河畔满是花岗岩巨石的河谷，城中的卡利纳科特意即「石堡」，骑跨着镇子上方的整条山脊。石堡于11至13世纪由遮娄其人和曷萨拉人分期修筑，此后四百年间不断扩建，出力最多的是历代纳亚卡首领。堡内共有七重同心围墙、十九座城门，还有凿入岩体的粮仓、油库、神庙和承接雨水的蓄水池，山上守军不易因缺水被困。上堡有十八座神庙，最古老的是希丁贝什瓦拉庙。1444年，这里是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的北部边镇，由贝达尔人武士首领丹达纳亚卡们据守，其族人警戒着通往栋格珀德拉河方向的道路。

纳亚卡们本是总督，后来自成一系之主，塔利科塔之战后在比贾布尔、莫卧儿与马拉特之间周旋，据守石堡两百年。1687年奥朗则布设立锡拉苏巴，吉德勒杜尔加被登记为纳贡国之一。1689至1722年在位的巴拉马帕·纳亚卡被视为这一系最杰出的统治者，他与莫卧儿交战，任内大修城墙、棱堡、宫殿、水池和神庙。末代马达卡里·纳亚卡五世遇上了迈索尔的海德尔·阿里：后者1760年和1770年两度围攻山寨，1779年第三次进攻才得手，当时马拉塔人和守军里的部分军官倒戈，马达卡里被俘遇害。相传在一次围城中，卫兵之妻奥巴瓦趁敌兵从岩石裂缝中逐个钻入，用舂米的长杵「奥纳克」将来犯者一一击毙。海德尔·阿里在堡内增建了一座清真寺；1799年蒂普苏丹败于英国人后，这一地区划归复辟的迈索尔王国。

en:
Honnavar is the roadstead where the Sharavati meets the Arabian Sea on the Kanara coast, loading pepper, betel nut and cardamom from the Western Ghats onto Arab dhows long before European ships came north. In 1342 Ibn Battuta landed here and found Hunawar under Sultan Jamaluddin, a ruler he praised for his power and justice; later the port passed, with the rest of Kanara, under Vijayanagara. In 1444 Kannada-speaking farmers and fishermen make up the town, local chiefs and Nawayath Muslim merchants run its wharves, and the spice trade pulls Arab shipping south of Goa.

Around 1470 the Bahmani armies of Mahmud Gawan campaigned down the Konkan to this coast. For fifty-four years the country behind the port belonged to Chennabhairadevi, the Jain queen of Gersoppa, whom the Portuguese called the Pepper Queen: from Honnavar, Mirjan and Karwar her ships carried pepper, saltpetre and betel nut to Surat and on to Europe, and she kept her court at Mirjan fort and built Jain basadis across her lands. When Vijayanagara broke at Talikota in 1565 she withdrew from Mirjan to an island in the Sharavati. Four years later the viceroy Luís de Ataíde took Honnavar and built a fort there; in the monsoon of July 1571 five thousand men of Gersoppa, two thousand of them supplied by the Adil Shah of Bijapur, attacked it with four hundred horse, but two hundred men Ataíde sent by sea got through the rains and the fort held.

In 1653 Keladi's general Timmanna Nayaka stormed the Portuguese fort during his drive down the coast, and Queen Chennamma carried Keladi's frontier to Mirjan in 1676. Maratha troops seized Mirjan in 1757 amid a Bednore succession feud, and when Hyder Ali extinguished Bednore in 1763 Honnavar passed to Mysore. In the war with Tipu Sultan, Major Torriano took Mirjan and pressed on to Honnavar in 1783-84, and with Tipu's fall in 1799 the port passed to the East India Company.
zh:
霍纳沃尔是卡纳达沿海沙拉瓦蒂河注入阿拉伯海处的外港，早在欧洲船只到来之前，西高止山的胡椒、槟榔和豆蔻就从这里装上阿拉伯单桅帆船。1342年伊本·白图泰登岸，见到胡纳瓦尔在苏丹贾马鲁丁治下，他称许这位君主国势强盛、断事公正；后来此港随整个卡纳达并入毗奢耶那伽罗。1444年，城中居民是说卡纳达语的农夫和渔民，码头由本地酋长和纳瓦亚特穆斯林商人经办，香料贸易把阿拉伯商船吸引到果阿以南。

1470年前后，马哈茂德·加万率领巴赫曼尼大军沿肯坎海岸南下，兵锋抵达此地。此后五十四年间，港口腹地属于格尔索帕的耆那教女王琴纳拜拉黛维，葡萄牙人称她「胡椒女王」：胡椒、硝石和槟榔从霍纳沃尔、米尔姜和卡尔瓦尔装船，运往苏拉特，再转销欧洲；她以米尔姜堡为居城，在境内广建耆那教巴沙迪庙。1565年毗奢耶那伽罗在塔利戈塔崩溃后，她从米尔姜退入沙拉瓦蒂河中的岛屿。四年后，葡属印度总督路易斯·德·阿塔伊德攻占霍纳沃尔、筑起堡垒；1571年7月雨季，格尔索帕出兵五千、骑兵四百围攻，其中两千人由比贾布尔的阿迪尔沙阿提供，阿塔伊德派两百人走海路冒雨赶到，堡垒守住了。

1653年，凯拉迪的大将蒂曼纳·纳亚卡南下途中攻克这座葡萄牙堡垒；1676年琴纳玛女王把凯拉迪边界推进到米尔姜。1757年，马拉塔军队趁贝德努尔继业内讧夺取米尔姜；1763年海德尔·阿里攻灭贝德努尔，霍纳沃尔并入迈索尔。与提普苏丹交战期间，托里亚诺少校于1783至1784年拿下米尔姜、进逼霍纳沃尔；1799年提普败亡，港口归入东印度公司。

en:
Mudgal stands on the southwestern edge of the Raichur Doab, the fertile triangle between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra, and its hill fort guarded the tracks running from the Tungabhadra crossings to the larger stronghold of Raichur. Seuna Yadava inscriptions in the town show an eleventh-century settlement, later an outpost of the Kakatiyas of Warangal, until Ala-ud-din Bahman Shah, the first Bahmani sultan, took it together with Raichur. Once the Bahmanis fixed their capital at Gulbarga, the two forts became the prizes over which the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara fought for generations. In 1444 Mudgal was a Bahmani garrison town set in a Kannada Hindu countryside, on a frontier that raiding armies crossed every few years.

With the break-up of the Bahmani kingdom Mudgal passed to the Adil Shahi sultans of Bijapur. Krishnadevaraya's decisive victory at Raichur in 1520 carried the doab to Vijayanagara and drove the Bijapur army back across the Krishna; Jesuits had already built a Roman Catholic church in the town before 1557, a trace of the Portuguese networks reaching into the Deccan. The Deccan sultans' confederate victory at Talikota in 1565 returned the doab to Bijapur. Aurangzeb's Mughals absorbed it in 1686, and after 1724 it passed to the Nizam of Hyderabad.
zh:
穆德格尔位于赖丘尔河间地西南缘，处在克里希纳河与栋格珀德拉河之间这片肥沃三角之中，城堡守卫着从栋格珀德拉河各渡口通往赖丘尔大要塞的道路。城中的塞乌纳·亚达瓦铭文表明，11世纪这里已有聚落，后来成为瓦朗加尔卡卡提雅王朝的前哨，直到巴赫曼尼开国苏丹阿拉丁·巴赫曼沙把它与赖丘尔一同攻取。巴赫曼尼定都古尔伯加后，两座堡垒成了巴赫曼尼苏丹与毗奢耶那伽罗世代争夺的目标。1444年，穆德格尔是一座巴赫曼尼驻军城镇，坐落在说卡纳达语的印度教乡野之间，边境每隔几年就有袭掠的军队经过。

巴赫曼尼王国瓦解后，穆德格尔转归比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙希苏丹。1520年，克里希纳德瓦拉亚在赖丘尔取得决定性胜利，把整个河间地带入毗奢耶那伽罗版图，比贾布尔军队被逐过克里希纳河；1557年之前，耶稣会士已在城中建起一座罗马天主教堂，留下葡萄牙人的关系网伸入德干的痕迹。1565年德干诸苏丹在塔利科塔合力获胜，河间地复归比贾布尔。1686年奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队吞并此地，1724年后转归海得拉巴尼扎姆。

en:
Rajapur lies a few miles up a navigable creek that opens into the Arabian Sea, midway between Dabhol and Goa. Tracks over the Western Ghats carried pepper, spices and textiles from the Deccan upland to its wharves, and ships carried them on to Arabia and the Red Sea. In 1444 it was a small Marathi-speaking creek town on Vijayanagara's southern Konkan border, quieter than the Muslim harbour of Dabhol to the north and close to the expanding Bahmani frontier.

Bijapur's rise gave the creek its busiest years. The sultans used it as an approach to their Deccan capital, and merchants and shipping moved south from war-battered Dabhol during the 1500s. By the late 1640s Henry Revington ran an English East India Company factory here, buying saltpetre, pepper, calicoes and cotton; Jacques Boureau opened a French lodge in 1669.

The European warehouses were drawn into Maratha and Bijapur wars. In January 1660 Shivaji's general Doroji sacked Rajapur, but Shivaji condemned the raid, dismissed Doroji and ordered the plunder restored. A few months later, English grenades and gunners from Rajapur helped Siddi Jauhar press the five-month siege of Panhala, the hill-fort guarding the route from Bijapur to the coast. Shivaji escaped, while Baji Prabhu Deshpande's rearguard died at Pavan Khind. Holding the factory responsible, Shivaji plundered it in December 1661 and carried Revington and three other factors into hill-fort captivity. He released them in 1663 after learning the company had not authorized aid to Siddi Jauhar, and in 1672 offered 5,000 pagodas toward the losses. The French lodge closed in 1688, and Rajapur returned to being a small Maratha creek port.
zh:
拉贾布尔在一条可通航河湾上游，北距达布尔、南距果阿都不远，河湾西入阿拉伯海。跨越西高止山的小路把德干高原的胡椒、香料和织物运到码头，再由海船转往阿拉伯与红海。1444年，它是毗奢耶那伽罗南康坎边境上一座讲马拉地语的河湾小镇，规模不及北方的穆斯林港口达布尔，附近又是巴赫马尼苏丹国不断推进的边界。

比贾布尔兴起后，这条河湾迎来最繁忙的年月。苏丹们把它作为进出德干都城的通道，16世纪里，商人与海船陆续从饱受战祸的达布尔南移。1640年代末，亨利·雷温顿已在此主持英国东印度公司商馆，收购硝石、胡椒、白布和棉花；雅克·布鲁则于1669年开设法国商馆。

欧洲商馆很快被卷入马拉塔与比贾布尔的战争。1660年1月，希瓦吉的部将多罗吉洗劫拉贾布尔，希瓦吉却谴责这次行动，将多罗吉革职并下令归还财物。几个月后，拉贾布尔流出的英国手榴弹和炮手帮助西迪·乔哈尔把帕纳哈拉堡围困五个月；这座山间堡垒扼守比贾布尔通往海岸的道路。希瓦吉最终脱身，巴吉·普拉布·德什潘德率领的后卫则在帕万金德战死。希瓦吉认定商馆应对此负责，于1661年12月将其洗劫，把雷温顿等四名商馆人员押往山间堡垒。得知公司并未批准援助西迪·乔哈尔后，他在1663年释放四人，又在1672年提出赔付五千帕戈达金币。法国商馆于1688年关闭，拉贾布尔重新成为马拉塔治下的小河湾港。

en:
Daman lies at the mouth of the Daman Ganga, where the river enters the Gulf of Khambhat: the older town of Moti Daman stands on one bank and the larger Nani Daman quarter on the other. In the thirteenth century the town belonged to the Ramnagar state, later a tributary of the Gujarat sultans. By 1444 it was a fortified port on the sultanate's southern edge. Its quays handled the traffic between Surat, the Konkan and the Arabian Sea ports, and its boatyards built and equipped the war fleets Gujarat sent against the Portuguese.

A storm drove Diogo de Melo's ships to Daman in 1523, the first Portuguese sight of the harbour. Knowing the town's yards fitted the fleets that fought them, Viceroy Nuno da Cunha sent António Silveira in 1534 to wreck the shore works and shipyards while Martim Afonso de Sousa bombarded the fortifications. Constantino de Braganza occupied the town in 1559 and rebuilt Moti Daman as a Portuguese fortress. A Mughal army that appeared before the walls in 1581 withdrew without pressing the siege, and the garrison crossed to the Nani Daman bank in 1614. The wars against the Siddis and Marathas cost the Portuguese Bassein in 1739 and Chaul a year later, yet Daman held out. The treaty of 1780 added seventy-two inland villages, the nucleus of the later Dadra and Nagar Haveli enclave, and in 1821 Daman was still a fortified Portuguese enclave on the coast.
zh:
达曼位于达曼甘加河注入坎贝湾的河口，较早的莫蒂达曼在河的一岸，面积更大的纳尼达曼在另一岸。十三世纪时这里属于拉姆讷格尔土邦，后来成为古吉拉特苏丹的藩属。到1444年，达曼已是苏丹国南缘的设防港口：码头和船坞既吞吐苏拉特、孔坎与阿拉伯海各港之间的商船，也建造、装配古吉拉特出海迎战葡萄牙人的战舰。

1523年，一场风暴把迪奥戈·德·梅洛的船只吹到达曼，葡萄牙人第一次见到这个港湾。1534年，印度总督努诺·达·库尼亚得知达曼船坞正为敌方舰队装配船只，便派安东尼奥·西尔韦拉捣毁岸防工事和船坞，马丁·阿方索·德·索萨同时炮击堡垒。1559年，总督康斯坦丁诺·德·布拉干萨占领达曼，把莫蒂达曼改建成葡萄牙要塞。1581年，一支莫卧儿军队进抵城下，未认真攻城便撤退；守军又在1614年进占纳尼达曼一侧河岸。此后与西迪人和马拉塔人的战争使葡萄牙人1739年丢掉巴塞因，次年又失焦尔，达曼却始终守住。1780年的条约为其增加七十二个内陆村庄，即后来达德拉—纳加尔哈维利飞地的由来；1821年时，达曼仍是海岸上的葡萄牙设防飞地。

en:
Kolhapur lies on the Panchganga in the southern Desh, with the Sahyadri hills to the west and the great hill-fort of Panhala on a spur eighteen kilometres to the north-west. Pilgrims call the town Dakshin Kashi, the Benares of the south: its Mahalakshmi or Ambabai temple, traditionally dated to 634, is one of the Shakti Pithas. Panhala, the largest of the Deccan hill-forts, was built between 1178 and 1209 for the Shilahara king Bhoja II; the Shilaharas had kept their capital at Kolhapur from about 940 and ruled southern Maharashtra until 1212, patronising Jain monasteries from the fort. Yadava and then Khalji rule followed, and in 1444 Kolhapur is a Marathi-speaking Hindu country under Bahmani governors, living by pilgrimage, millet and the teak of its western hills.

After the Bahmani break-up the country passed to the Adil Shahis of Bijapur, and the forts above the town became a Maratha target. Shivaji took Panhala in 1659 and on 28 December routed a Bijapuri army under Rustam Zaman outside Kolhapur. In 1660 a Bijapuri army under Siddi Jauhar besieged the fort; Shivaji slipped out to Vishalgad while Baji Prabhu Deshpande held the Pavan Khind pass with the rearguard and died there, and Panhala returned to Bijapur until Shivaji retook it in 1673. It fell to Aurangzeb in 1701, and the emperor received the English envoy Sir William Norris there before Maratha troops retook it within months. In 1707 the dowager Tarabai, worsted by Shahu in the Maratha succession war, retired here with her son Shivaji II and set up a Bhosle principality of her own; the treaty of Warna in 1731 confirmed its separation, and the court later moved down from Panhala to Kolhapur. The Marathi poet Moropant, born in the fort, wrote much of his verse in its Parashar caves. By the eighteenth century its vegetable-tanned leather sandals were known across the Deccan as Kolhapuris. British expeditions marched on Kolhapur late in the century, and after the Maratha confederacy collapsed in 1818 the state entered treaty relations with the East India Company.
zh:
戈尔哈布尔位于德什南部的五河之畔，西倚萨希亚德里山林，德干最大的山间要塞潘哈拉雄踞在西北18公里外的山嘴上。香客称这里为「南迦尸」：城中的摩诃拉克希米（又称阿姆巴巴伊）神庙相传建于634年，是印度教性力派圣地之一。潘哈拉堡1178至1209年间为什拉哈拉王波贾二世所建；什拉哈拉王朝约940年起以戈尔哈布尔为都，统治南马哈拉施特拉至1212年，王室在堡中供养耆那教僧院。此后历经亚达瓦与卡尔吉两代统治，1444年的戈尔哈布尔是巴赫曼尼总督治下一片说马拉地语的印度教乡土，靠朝圣、小米和西山出产的柚木为生。

巴赫曼尼王国解体后，此地归入比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙阿王朝，城外群山上的堡垒成了马拉塔人的目标。1659年希瓦吉夺取潘哈拉，12月28日又在戈尔哈布尔城外击溃鲁斯塔姆·扎曼率领的比贾布尔军队。1660年西迪·乔哈尔率军围堡，希瓦吉带少数人脱身退往维沙拉尔加尔，巴吉·普拉布·德什潘德率后卫扼守帕万金德隘口、战死阵中；潘哈拉复归比贾布尔，直到1673年希瓦吉才再次拿下。1701年堡垒落入奥朗则布之手，这位皇帝在堡中接见英国使节威廉·诺里斯爵士，几个月后马拉塔军队便又夺回。1707年，王太后塔拉拜在马拉塔继业之争中被夏胡击败，携儿子希瓦吉二世退守于此，另立邦斯莱封国；1731年的《瓦尔纳条约》确认了分治，王廷后来从潘哈拉迁至戈尔哈布尔。马拉地语诗人莫罗潘特出生在这座堡垒，多在堡中的波罗奢罗洞窟作诗。到18世纪，本地植鞣皮凉鞋已以「科尔哈普里」之名行销德干。18世纪末英国曾出兵远征戈尔哈布尔，1818年马拉塔联盟瓦解后，该土邦与东印度公司缔约。

en:
Junnar stands on the old caravan road where goods from the Konkan ports of Kalyan and Chaul climb through the Western Ghats into the Deccan, and the hill fort of Shivneri commands the pass above the town. Merchants have used the route for two thousand years: the Buddhist caves at Lenyadri and Manmodi, cut into the hills around Junnar in the early centuries AD, carry inscriptions left by Greek and Saka donors. In 1444 Junnar was a walled market town and a governor's seat of the Bahmani sultanate. The traffic passing beneath Shivneri's walls carried spices, salt and horses inland, and the cotton of the Desh down to the coast.

A generation later Afanasy Nikitin, a merchant from Tver in Russia, waited out a two-month monsoon in the town and left one of the few European eyewitness accounts of Bahmani India. He wrote that for four months water and mud lay everywhere day and night, the season when farmers ploughed and sowed wheat, rice and pulse. In 1490 Malik Ahmad made Junnar the first capital of his independent Nizam Shahi sultanate, before laying out his new city of Ahmadnagar in 1494; early in the 1600s Malik Ambar brought the hard-pressed court back while moving between capitals in his war with the Mughals. In 1595 Sultan Bahadur Nizam Shah granted Shivneri and Chakan as a fief to the Maratha chief Maloji Bhosale, and on 19 February 1630 Maloji's grandson Shivaji was born in the fort and spent his childhood there. He took his name from Shivai Devi, the goddess whose small temple stands inside the fort. An English traveller who visited Shivneri in 1673 reported that the fort could not be taken and held provisions for a thousand families for seven years. The town and fort changed hands repeatedly in the Maratha-Mughal wars of the later seventeenth century, and passed to the British only in 1819, after the Third Anglo-Maratha War.
zh:
朱尼尔（久纳尔）坐落在一条古商道上，卡利扬、焦尔等孔坎港口的货物经此翻过西高止山进入德干，城后山顶的希沃内里堡扼住山口。这条路上的商队已往来了两千年：城郊山间的石窟群（Lenyadri、Manmodi）开凿于公元初年，窟中留有希腊人与塞种施主的题记。1444年，朱尼尔是巴赫曼尼苏丹国一座有城墙的集镇和总督驻地，驮着香料、食盐和马匹进山、又把德什棉花运往海岸的商队，都要从希沃内里的墙下经过。

此后一代人，俄罗斯特维尔商人阿发那西·尼吉丁在城中避了两个月雨季，留下了少数出自欧洲目击者笔下的巴赫曼尼印度记录之一。他写到，连续四个月昼夜遍地是水和泥，农夫就在这时犁地，播种小麦、稻米和豆类。1490年，马利克·艾哈迈德以朱尼尔为自己独立的尼扎姆·沙希王朝的第一个都城，1494年才另建新都艾哈迈德讷格尔；17世纪初，马利克·安巴尔在与莫卧儿交战、辗转迁都之际，把处境艰难的朝廷又带回这里。1595年，苏丹巴哈杜尔·尼扎姆沙把希沃内里和查肯作为封地赐给马拉地首领马洛吉·邦斯莱；1630年2月19日，马洛吉之孙希瓦吉出生在这座堡垒，并在此度过幼年，他的名字就取自堡内小庙供奉的希瓦伊女神。1673年，一位到访希沃内里的英国旅人记述，此堡无法攻取，存粮可供千户人家吃七年。17世纪后期的马拉地—莫卧儿战争中，城与堡几度易手，直到1819年第三次英国—马拉地战争之后才归入英国。

en:
Nashik spreads along the upper Godavari, which rises in the Brahmagiri hills near Trimbak to the west before beginning its long course across the Deccan. Long before the Muslim conquests its river ghats and the Panchavati quarter drew Hindu pilgrims, and the town is one of the four places that share the twelve-year Kumbh festival; near the source stands Trimbakeshwar, one of the twelve jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva. The Buddhist Pandavleni caves nearby were carved in the early centuries AD. Delhi's armies took Nashik with Daulatabad early in the fourteenth century, and around 1350 it passed to the Bahmani sultans. In 1444 it was therefore an ancient Hindu tirtha of temples and Brahman houses set inside a Muslim-ruled marcher province, its pilgrim traffic and crafts overseen by Bahmani officers.

With the break-up of the Bahmani state the country around Nashik went to the Nizam Shahis of Ahmadnagar, and early in the seventeenth century the Mughals took it and renamed the town Gulshanabad, the City of Roses. The Kazipura gate of 1667 and the Delhi gate of 1681 remain from their building. In 1680 the Mughal governor of the Deccan destroyed twenty-five temples in the town, and Aurangzeb had the jyotirlinga temple at Trimbakeshwar torn down; it was rebuilt only under the Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao. Two years later the emperor's rebel son Prince Akbar sheltered briefly in Nashik on his flight to the Konkan. The Marathas were already pressing in, and the masonry of the sacred Ramkund pool was completed under their patronage in 1696. In 1751-52 the district passed to the Peshwa, the old name of Nashik returned, and over the next generation Maratha sardars lined the river with stone temples, ghats and mansions. War came back in April 1803, when Amrit Rao, adopted son of the former Peshwa Raghunath Rao, sacked the town. On 19 April 1818, during the Third Anglo-Maratha War, a British detachment entered Nashik without a fight, and the town passed to the Bombay Presidency.
zh:
纳西克建在戈达瓦里河上游两岸，河水发源于城西特里姆巴克附近的布拉哈吉里山间，东流横贯德干。早在穆斯林征服之前，这里的河坛与潘查瓦蒂街区就吸引着印度教香客，纳西克又是十二年一度的大壶节四大举办地之一；河源附近的特里姆巴克什瓦尔（Trimbakeshwar）是湿婆十二处林伽神庙之一，城郊的潘杜佛教石窟则开凿于公元初年。14世纪初，纳西克随道拉塔巴德被德里大军攻取，约1350年转归巴赫曼尼苏丹。1444年的纳西克，是穆斯林治下边省中一座古老的印度教圣地，寺院与婆罗门宅院栉比，香客往来和百工技艺都在巴赫曼尼官吏管辖之下。

巴赫曼尼瓦解后，纳西克一带归属艾哈迈德讷格尔的尼扎姆·沙希王朝，17世纪初被莫卧儿夺取，改城名为古尔尚纳巴德，意即「玫瑰城」；1667年的卡济普拉门和1681年的德里门都是那时所建。1680年，莫卧儿的德干总督毁掉城中二十五座神庙，奥朗则布还下令拆毁特里姆巴克什瓦尔的林伽神庙，这座庙直到佩什瓦巴拉吉·巴吉·拉奥时才重建。两年后，皇帝的叛子阿克巴王子逃往孔坎途中，曾在纳西克短暂避难。此时马拉地人已步步进逼，圣池拉姆昆德的石砌工程于1696年在他们资助下完工。1751至1752年，这一地区归入佩什瓦，纳西克旧名恢复；此后数十年间，马拉地诸将沿河次第建起石庙、河坛与宅邸。1803年4月战火再至，前佩什瓦拉古纳特·拉奥的养子阿姆里特·拉奥纵兵劫掠此城。1818年4月19日，第三次英国—马拉地战争期间，一支英国部队兵不血刃进入纳西克，城市并入孟买管辖区。

en:
Dharangaon lies in the black-soil cotton plain of eastern Khandesh, on the road carrying piece goods from Burhanpur toward Surat. In 1444 it was a weaving and market town under the Faruqi sultans, who ruled Khandesh from Burhanpur. Local cotton went to its looms and then on to buyers in the Deccan and Gujarat. By the Mughal conquest around 1600, two of its cloths, jirifaf and bhiran, were well enough known to be named in the Ain-i-Akbari.

English factors, writing the name as Dongong or Drongom, opened a factory here in 1674 to buy cotton cloth. Shivaji's Marathas sacked the town in March 1675 and returned in 1679 with the raja of Berar, striking one of the busiest marts in this part of Khandesh. The East India Company still loaded 20,000 pieces of cloth and 2,500 mans of turmeric in its 1683 purchase, but two years later Sambhaji's men burned the houses and the factors escaped after only two hours' warning. After Maratha forces took Khandesh in 1760, Bhil raiders repeatedly crossed the district and Maratha commanders answered with mass reprisals. Dharangaon came under British rule with the rest of the Peshwa's Khandesh lands in 1818.
zh:
达朗格阿奥恩位于坎德什东部的黑棉土平原，布尔汉布尔的布匹经这里运往苏拉特。1444年，它是法鲁克苏丹治下的纺织集镇，法鲁克王朝以布尔汉布尔为都统治坎德什。当地棉花先送入织机，再由商人带往德干和古吉拉特。到1600年前后莫卧儿征服时，这里出产的吉里法夫和比兰两种布已十分有名，连《阿克巴则例》都记下了名字。

英国商人把此地拼作东贡或德隆戈姆，1674年为采购棉布开设商馆。希瓦吉的马拉塔军队1675年3月洗劫此镇，1679年又与贝拉尔罗阇联兵返回，攻打的是坎德什这一带最繁忙的商埠之一。东印度公司仍在1683年购入两万匹布和2500芒德姜黄；两年后，桑巴吉的军队焚毁屋舍，商馆人员只提前两小时逃走。1760年马拉塔取得坎德什后，比尔袭掠者反复进入这一地区，马拉塔将领则以大规模报复维持秩序。1818年，达朗格阿奥恩随佩什瓦的坎德什领地一起归入英国统治。

en:
Sholapur lies on the black-cotton plain of the southern Deccan, where the Sina and Bhima water broad cotton lands. Marathi villagers grew cotton and wove cloth for inland markets before the Deccan sultanates took the region, and the fort beside Siddheshwar Lake guarded their roads and stores. Inscriptions there call the old town Sonnalage or Sonnalpur. In the twelfth century the Lingayat teacher Siddheshwar preached at Sholapur, set up sixty-eight lingas and gave his name to the lake and the town's patron shrine. In 1444 it was a Bahmani market and garrison town in the southern maidan, its Marathi-speaking Hindu population ruled by Muslim governors.

The break-up of the Bahmani kingdom turned that fort into a marriage prize between Bijapur and Ahmadnagar. Bijapur held Sholapur and its five and a half districts in 1511. In 1523 Ismail Adil Shah entertained Burhan Nizam Shah in the fort for a month during Burhan's wedding to the Bijapuri princess Mariam. Bijapur then refused to surrender the fort as her dowry, and the dispute fed forty years of war; an Ahmadnagar invasion in 1524 was broken between Sholapur and Naldurg.

The fort changed hands with every later Deccan war. Malik Ambar stormed it for Ahmadnagar in 1623, but the Mughal settlement of 1636 awarded Sholapur to Bijapur. It was ceded to Aurangzeb in 1668, and his camp stood here during the final siege of Bijapur in 1686. During the next half-century Hyderabad and the Marathas fought over it, and by the 1760s it was a Peshwa fortress. Thomas Munro's troops escaladed the town on 10 May 1818; five days later the garrison marched out, ending resistance at the last rallying point of Peshwa Baji Rao II.
zh:
绍拉布尔地处德干南部的黑棉土平原，西纳河与比马河浇灌着大片棉田。德干诸苏丹国控制这里以前，讲马拉地语的乡民已在种植棉花、织布供应内陆市场，悉德什瓦尔湖畔的堡垒则守护道路和仓储。堡内碑铭把旧城称作索纳拉吉或索纳尔布尔。12世纪时，林伽雅特派导师悉德什瓦尔在此传道，立下六十八座林伽，湖泊和城中守护祠庙后来都以他为名。1444年，它是南部马坦一座巴赫曼尼的商镇兼驻防城，讲马拉地语的印度教百姓由穆斯林官员统治。

巴赫马尼王国解体后，这座堡垒成了比贾布尔与艾哈迈德讷格尔之间的婚姻聘礼。1511年，比贾布尔保有绍拉布尔及其所辖五个半县区。1523年，布尔汉·尼扎姆沙迎娶比贾布尔公主玛丽亚姆，伊斯梅尔·阿迪尔沙在堡中设宴款待整整一个月。事后比贾布尔拒绝按嫁妆约定交出堡垒，争执延续成四十年战事；1524年，艾哈迈德讷格尔的入侵军队在绍拉布尔与纳尔杜尔格之间被击溃。

此后每一场德干战争都会牵动这座堡垒。1623年，马利克·安巴尔为艾哈迈德讷格尔强攻得手，但1636年的莫卧儿安排又把绍拉布尔判给比贾布尔。1668年，它被割让给奥朗则布；1686年最后围攻比贾布尔时，奥朗则布的大营就设在此地。随后半个世纪里，海得拉巴与马拉塔反复争夺绍拉布尔，到1760年代它已是佩什瓦的堡垒。1818年5月10日，托马斯·门罗所部攀城攻入城区；五天后守军开出堡垒，佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥二世最后一处集结据点的抵抗就此结束。

en:
Devarakonda takes its name from a granite hill fort in the Nalgonda country, raised in the fourteenth century by the Recherla Nayakas, the Velama warrior line also called Padmanayaka. The fort crowns one hill ringed by three others, so that no enemy force could easily get at it. Around 1360 Anapotanayaka made Rachakonda his chief seat and put his brother Madanayaka in command here. The Recherlas won Telangana in 1368, when their cavalry, fighting alongside Bahmani troops, killed Kapaya Nayaka at Bhimavaram; they helped defeat the Bahmanis in their turn at Pangal in 1419 with a Vijayanagara coalition. Rachakonda fell to the Bahmanis in 1430, but the southern hill fort held out. In 1444 Devarakonda was one of the last independent Telugu Hindu Nayaka strongholds, with Bahmani power to its west and the Kondavidu Reddy lands to its east.

The chiefs kept their freedom by changing patrons, fighting at one time for Vijayanagara, at another for the Bahmanis or the Gajapatis of Orissa. With an Orissan army under Hamviradeva they recovered Rachakonda and their other lost forts by 1461, only to hold them as Gajapati tributaries. A Bahmani campaign against Orugallu in 1475 ended their line, and the surviving chiefs took service with Vijayanagara. Devarakonda passed with the rest of Telangana to the Qutb Shahi sultans of Golconda in 1518, to Aurangzeb's Mughals in 1687, and to the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1724.
zh:
德瓦拉科恩达得名于纳勒贡达地区的一座花岗岩山寨，14世纪由雷切尔拉纳亚卡（又称帕德马纳亚卡·韦拉马）的武士首领修筑。城堡雄踞一座山头，另外三山环列，敌军很难逼近。约1360年，阿波塔纳亚卡以拉查孔达为大本营，派兄弟马达纳亚卡镇守此地。1368年，雷切尔拉骑兵与巴赫曼尼军队联兵，在比姆瓦拉姆（Bhimavaram）击杀卡帕亚·纳亚卡，夺得特伦甘纳；1419年他们又随毗奢耶那伽罗联军在潘加尔（Pangal）击败巴赫曼尼人。1430年拉查孔达失守，这座南方山寨却坚守不降。1444年，德瓦拉科恩达是泰卢固印度教纳亚卡首领仅存的独立据点之一，西临巴赫曼尼势力，东接孔达维杜·雷迪诸地。

首领们靠改换宗主维持局面，一时为毗奢耶那伽罗出战，一时又依附巴赫曼尼或奥里萨的加贾帕蒂王朝。他们借哈姆维拉提婆的奥里萨军队，到1461年前收复拉查孔达等失陷堡垒，却只能以加贾帕蒂藩属的身份据守。1475年，巴赫曼尼进攻奥鲁加卢，这一政权告终，幸存首领转投毗奢耶那伽罗效力。德瓦拉科恩达随后随特伦甘纳于1518年转归戈尔孔达的库特卜·沙希苏丹，1687年并入奥朗则布的莫卧儿帝国，1724年归海得拉巴尼扎姆。

en:
Pathri lies on the upper Godavari plain in the heart of Marathwada, ringed by the cotton-growing villages whose cloth passed through its bazaars. In 1444 it was the chief town of a revenue district in the Bahmani province of Berar, whose governor sat at Ellichpur. One Pathri family had already reached the Bahmani court: its Brahmin Kulkarni line produced Malik Hasan Bahri, vazir of the kingdom, and Hasan's son Malik Ahmad, founder of the Nizam Shahi sultanate of Ahmadnagar.

After the Bahmani collapse Pathri passed to the Imad Shahis of Berar. In 1526 Burhan Nizam Shah of Ahmadnagar came to reclaim his ancestors' home district, took Pathri from the king of Berar and overran the whole province. When Akbar's armies entered the Deccan, Berar was ceded to the Mughals by the treaty of March 1596; the attempt to win it back brought on the two-day battle of Sonpet on the Godavari, begun on 8 February 1597, where Abdur Rahim Khan-i-Khanan was first beaten and then routed the allied armies of Ahmadnagar, Bijapur and Golconda. The Ain-i-Akbari lists Pathri as one of Berar's sixteen sarkars, with eighteen parganas including Nanded and Parbhani, and notes a thriving jewel trade at Jetanpur within its lands. Malik Ambar swept through Berar in 1610 and again in 1620 before Shah Jahan restored Mughal rule. The old fort is ringed with the domed tombs of Sufi saints, the dargah of Shah Ismail Qadri among them; local tradition says the graves of forty aulias and four qutubs lie in the town. In 1724 Asaf Jah's victory at Sakharkherda made Pathri part of the Nizam's Hyderabad, though the Nagpur Bhosles long levied a share of its revenues.
zh:
帕特里地处戈达瓦里河上游平原、马拉特瓦达腹地，四周村庄广种棉花，织出的棉布在它的市集集散。1444年时，它是巴赫曼尼贝拉尔省（省督驻埃利奇布尔）下辖一个赋税区的首镇。镇上已有一个家族踏入巴赫曼尼朝堂：这一支婆罗门库卡尔尼（村吏）家族出了马利克·哈桑·巴赫里，官至王国的维齐尔，其子马利克·艾哈迈德正是艾哈迈德讷格尔尼扎姆·沙希苏丹国的建立者。

巴赫曼尼瓦解后，帕特里归入贝拉尔的伊马德·沙希王朝。1526年，艾哈迈德讷格尔的布尔汗·尼扎姆沙为收复祖先故里而来，从贝拉尔王手中夺取帕特里，进而横扫全省。阿克巴的大军进入德干后，贝拉尔依1596年3月的条约割让给莫卧儿；夺回此地的尝试引发1597年2月8日起在戈达瓦里河畔的松佩特两日大战，莫卧儿统帅阿卜杜勒·拉希姆汗-伊-汗纳南先败后胜，击溃艾哈迈德讷格尔、比贾普尔与戈尔康达的联军。《阿克巴则例》把帕特里列为贝拉尔十六个萨卡尔之一，下辖南德德、帕尔巴尼等十八个帕尔加纳，还记载境内杰坦普尔的珠宝生意十分兴旺。1610年和1620年，马利克·安巴尔两度席卷贝拉尔，最后由沙贾汗恢复莫卧儿统治。旧堡周围环布着苏菲圣徒的圆顶墓冢，沙·伊斯梅尔·卡迪里的陵寝即在其中；当地相传，四十位奥利亚和四位库特布葬在城中。1724年，阿萨夫·贾在萨卡尔凯尔达之战获胜，帕特里并入海得拉巴尼扎姆的领地，那格浦尔的邦斯莱家族则长期在这里分取一份赋税。

en:
Nander, more commonly written Nanded, is a river town on the north bank of the Godavari, where the Nandgiri fort guards a crossing on the road between the Bahmani capital at Bidar and the northern province of Berar. Older inscriptions name the place Nanditat or Nandigrama. Tughluq troops seized the crossing in 1318, and in the Bahmani century it changed hands more than once, taken by a Gond chief in 1398 and won back by Ahmad Shah in 1428. In 1444 it is a Marathi-speaking Hindu district inside the Bahmani sultanate. To the east the country is covered by Kandhar Fort, attributed to the Rashtrakuta king Krishna III.

Armies kept passing through. In 1527 Burhan Nizam Shah of Ahmadnagar defeated the sultan of Berar near the town, and in 1602 Malik Ambar lost a battle here to the Mughal commander Khan Khanan; Ambar was an Ethiopian-born slave who rose to be minister and de facto ruler of Ahmadnagar, and led its long wars against the Mughals. Mughal troops took Nanded fort in 1617 and forced Kandhar to surrender in 1631 after a siege of nineteen days. Shivaji's Marathas held the district in 1670 before Mughal rule returned.

The town's great name in history belongs to the Sikhs. Guru Gobind Singh reached Nanded in August 1707 in the camp of the emperor Bahadur Shah I, and stayed behind when the emperor marched south. Two assassins set on him there: he cut one down with his talwar, but the wound reopened while he strung a bow a few days later and he died in 1708. Before his death he named no human successor, making the Guru Granth Sahib the eternal guide of the Khalsa, and he initiated the ascetic Madho Das, who as Banda Singh Bahadur led the Khalsa armies against the Mughals. His cremation ground on the Godavari became Hazur Sahib, one of the five takhts of Sikhism. In 1725 Nanded passed to the Nizam of Hyderabad.
zh:
楠德尔（今多译楠代德）是戈达瓦里河北岸的河城，南德吉里堡扼守渡口，此地正处在巴赫曼尼首都比达尔通往北方贝拉尔省的路上。较早的铭文称这里为南迪塔特或南迪格拉马。图格鲁克军队1318年夺占渡口，进入巴赫曼尼的一个世纪里这里数度易手，1398年被一名冈德酋长占领，1428年由艾哈迈德沙阿收复。1444年，这里是巴赫曼尼苏丹国境内一片说马拉地语的印度教地区；东面的乡野由坎达尔堡屏障，该堡相传为罗湿陀罗拘陀国王克里希纳三世所建。

此后军队仍不断过境。1527年，艾哈迈德讷格尔的布尔汉·尼扎姆沙阿在城旁击败贝拉尔苏丹；1602年，马利克·安巴尔在此败给莫卧儿将领汗·哈南。安巴尔本是出身埃塞俄比亚的奴隶，后来官至艾哈迈德讷格尔的宰相，是该国实际的掌权者，主持对莫卧儿的长期战争。莫卧儿军队1617年拿下楠德尔堡，1631年围攻十九天，迫使坎达尔堡投降。1670年希瓦吉的马拉塔人据有此地，后来莫卧儿势力恢复。

这座城在历史上的大名与锡克人有关。1707年8月，古鲁·戈宾德·辛格随皇帝巴哈杜尔沙阿一世的大营抵达楠德尔，皇帝南征时他留了下来。两名刺客在此袭击他，他用弯刀亲手斩杀一人，但几天后拉弓时伤口迸裂，于1708年去世。临终前他没有指定人间继承者，而是立《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》为卡尔萨的永恒导师；他还在此度化苦行者马达·达斯，此人后来以班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔之名率领卡尔萨军队对抗莫卧儿。他在戈达瓦里河畔的火化地成为哈祖尔·萨希卜，锡克教五大塔赫特之一。1725年，楠德尔转入海得拉巴尼扎姆治下。

en:
Khamammet, Kambhamettu in the older inscriptions and later called Khammam, was a granite hill fort above the Munneru, a tributary of the Krishna. The Kakatiyas raised it first in earth and then in stone, and after Warangal fell the stronghold changed hands among the Musunuri Nayakas, Velama chiefs and the Gajapatis of Orissa. The hill was also called Stambhadri, from its temple of Narasimha, the man-lion avatar. In 1444 it was held by the Hindu chiefs of Telingana, covering the roads that ran from Warangal toward Kondavidu and the Andhra coast while Bahmani armies pressed in from the west.

Its best-known lord was Sitapathi Raju, a Telugu foot soldier in the army of the Bahmani sultan Humayun Shah who rose to a captain's rank and the title Shitab Khan; he used the title all his life but never converted to Islam. As governor at Warangal he and his minister Peddamatyudu tried to rebuild a Telugu kingdom in Telangana, and local tradition says he buried Shiva and Vishnu images in the ground to keep them safe in wartime. Sultan Quli Qutb-ul-Mulk defeated him and took the fort for Golconda in 1531. Khammam stayed with the Qutb Shahi kingdom until Aurangzeb's conquest of 1687, and in the 1720s it passed to the Nizam of Hyderabad.
zh:
卡玛姆梅特在古老碑铭中写作坎巴梅图，后来叫坎曼，是穆内鲁河畔的一座花岗岩山寨，穆内鲁河是克里希纳河的支流。卡卡提雅人先以土筑堡，后改用石材；瓦朗加尔陷落后，穆苏努里纳亚卡、韦拉马首领和奥里萨加贾帕蒂王朝曾反复争夺此堡。山丘又名斯坦巴德里，得名于山上的人狮那罗辛哈神庙。1444年，堡垒由特伦甘纳的印度教首领掌握，屏障着从瓦朗加尔通向孔达维杜和安得拉海岸的道路，西侧则有巴赫曼尼军队进逼。

这里最出名的领主是西塔帕蒂·拉朱：他本是巴赫曼尼苏丹胡马雍沙军中的泰卢固步卒，凭军功升为队长，受封「希塔卜汗」的称号，却终身没有改宗伊斯兰教。他出任瓦朗加尔长官时，与大臣佩达马蒂尤杜（Peddamatyudu）图谋在特伦甘纳重建泰卢固王国；当地相传，他把湿婆和毗湿奴的造像埋入地下，使它们在战乱中免遭损毁。1531年，苏丹·库利·库特卜—穆勒克击败他，把堡垒并入戈尔孔达。卡玛姆梅特此后属库特卜·沙希王朝，1687年奥朗则布征服后转归莫卧儿，1720年代又归海得拉巴尼扎姆。

en:
Narayanpur is a tract of north-bank Lakhimpur flats on the Brahmaputra, among old embankments and temple tanks on the western edge of the Chutia kingdom; the Petuwa Gosani shrine at nearby Dholpur dates from Chutia rule, and scholars trace the town's name to the Narayan title of its Chutia kings, for the place appears in Ahom chronicles before the Koch ever came. In 1444 it lay on the ill-marked border between the Chutias to the east and the Ahom kingdom upstream.

The Chutia state collapsed under Suhungmung in 1524 and the tract passed to the Ahoms. Later the Koch drove their great embanked road, the Gohain Kamal Ali, along the Himalayan foothills from Cooch Behar all the way to Narayanpur, and finished it in 1547. The fame of this quiet place is religious. Madhavdev, born at Letekupukhuri near the town in 1489, began as a worshipper of the goddess in the Shakta tradition, became Sankardev's foremost disciple and, after the master's death in 1568, led the Ekasarana faith; his hymn book, the Naam Ghosa, is recited in the sect's prayer houses. The Moamoria wars swept the old Chutia country after 1769, and by 1821 Burmese troops held the north bank with the rest of upper Assam.
zh:
纳拉延普尔地处布拉马普特拉河北岸的拉金普平原，古堤与寺塘错落，本是楚蒂亚王国西陲；附近多尔普尔的佩图瓦·戈萨尼神祠为楚蒂亚时代旧物，学者把城名追溯到楚蒂亚国王的「纳拉扬」尊号，阿洪姆史籍在科奇人到来之前就已提到此地，科奇戍军得名一说并不足据。1444年，它处在东方楚蒂亚与上游阿洪姆之间界限不清的边境上。

1524年楚蒂亚亡国于苏洪蒙，这片土地并入阿洪姆。后来科奇人沿喜马拉雅山麓修筑夯土军用大道戈哈因·卡马尔大道，从库奇比哈尔一直通到纳拉延普尔，1547年完工。这片宁静乡野的声名在宗教。1489年生于城边莱特库普库里的马塔布代夫起初信奉性力派女神，后来成为巽格尔代沃最重要的弟子，1568年尊师去世后接掌埃克萨尔纳教团；他的颂诗集《纳姆戈萨》在该派信众的礼拜中念诵。1769年以后摩亚马里亚战乱席卷楚蒂亚旧地，到1821年，北岸与阿萨姆上游各地一同落入缅甸军队之手。

en:
Ganjam is the southernmost coastal tract of Orissa, where the Rushikulya River reaches the Bay of Bengal through tidal creeks. The creeks are worked for karkatch salt, which banjara caravans carry inland, and the port of Ganjam, its name perhaps the Persian ganj, a market, grew on that traffic. Behind the coast rise the Garhjat hills, where twenty-two zamindars kept their forts. Thirty-five kilometres inland at Jaugada stand the rock edicts of Ashoka: the ruined fort is Samapa, the provincial capital he planted in newly conquered Kalinga, and his Prakrit edicts for the officers of the province are cut into a great rock. Under the Eastern Gangas and the Gajapatis the country was called Kalinga Dandapat. In 1444 it was the southern march of the empire of Kapilendra Deva at Cuttack, an Oriya Hindu land of salt-boilers and hill rajas.

Bahmani raiders had probed the coast before, but the conquest that held was Golconda's: Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah completed it in 1571, and Ganjam became the Chicacole sarkar of the Northern Circars. The governors never tamed the hills. In 1674 Vishwambhar Dev of Jeypore overthrew the Qutb Shahi faujdar, and after Aurangzeb annexed Golconda the Jeypore rajas defeated and killed the first two Mughal faujdars sent against them and ruled almost independently. On the coast the raja of Mohuri settled Devanga weavers brought from Rajahmundry in the 1660s at Brahmapur; their tussar patta silk made the town the silk mart of southern Orissa. The Nizams of Hyderabad later granted the Circars to the French East India Company, whose troops under Bussy dominated the Nizam's court. In 1759 Colonel Forde stormed Masulipatnam and the coast as far as Chilka Lake passed to the East India Company, though Ganjam stayed with the Nizam until the Company took direct charge in 1768 and opened its district headquarters in the star fort of Potagarh. An epidemic later drove the offices to Brahmapur.
zh:
甘贾姆（中文维基作根贾姆）是奥里萨最南端的沿海地带，鲁希库利亚河穿过潮沟纵横的滩涂注入孟加拉湾。潮沟里出产「卡尔卡奇」盐，由班贾拉商队驮往内陆；甘贾姆港（其名或来自波斯语「ganj」，意为市集）就靠这门买卖兴起。海岸后的迦贾德群山中，二十二个柴明达尔各守堡寨。深入内陆35公里的焦加达留有阿育王的摩崖诏书：这座废堡就是阿育王在新征服的羯陵伽设立的行都萨马帕，刻在巨石上的俗语诏书是颁给本省官员的文告。东恒伽王朝与伽贾帕蒂王朝时期，此地称羯陵伽丹达帕德。1444年，这里是定都克塔克的卡皮伦德拉·德瓦帝国的南边，一片奥里萨印度教的土地，住的是煮盐户和山寨罗阇的属民。

巴赫马尼的袭扰者此前也曾到过这里，但把海岸长期拿下的是戈尔孔达：1571年易卜拉欣·库利·库特布沙阿完成征服，甘贾姆成为北西尔卡尔的奇卡科莱专区。派来的长官始终没能制服山区：1674年，杰伊布尔的毗湿瓦姆巴尔·德瓦推翻库特布沙希的法乌吉达尔；奥朗则布吞并戈尔孔达后，杰伊布尔罗阇又把莫卧儿派来的头两任法乌吉达尔击败斩杀，几乎自立。沿海的莫胡里罗阇在1660年代把从拉贾蒙德里招来的德万加织工安置在布拉赫马普尔，他们织的柞蚕帕特丝绸使这座城镇成为南奥里萨的丝绸市集。海得拉巴的尼扎姆后来把北西尔卡尔赐给法国东印度公司，比西麾下的军队把持着尼扎姆的宫廷。1759年福德上校攻陷默苏利珀德姆，远至吉尔卡湖的海岸转归东印度公司，但甘贾姆仍属尼扎姆，直到1768年公司直接接管，在星形的波塔格尔堡开设县署。后来一场瘟疫迫使官署迁往布拉赫马普尔。

en:
Washim stands on the black-soil plains of Berar, where cotton fields supported weavers and roads linked the town with Ellichpur, Balapur and the Wardha valley. Its older name Vatsagulma reaches back to a Vakataka royal court: in the fourth century Sarvasena made it the capital of his branch, whose kings ruled from the Sahyadri hills to the Godavari and patronised Buddhist caves at Ajanta. Pilgrims still visited its old temples and tirthas. In 1444 it was a Marathi-speaking market and weaving town under Bahmani governors.

Washim followed whichever power controlled Berar. The Imad Shahis took it when the Bahmani realm split in 1490, Ahmadnagar absorbed Berar in 1574, and Chand Bibi ceded the province to Akbar in 1596. The Ain-i-Akbari listed Bashim as a revenue district and noted that the Hatkar Dhangars could bring one thousand cavalry and five thousand infantry to the field. Under Mughal and later Maratha rule Washim and Balapur remained cloth-producing towns, and Washim also kept a mint. During Madhavrao I's campaign against Janoji Bhonsle in 1768-69, the terms were settled at Washim; the treaty of Kanakpur required annual Washim and Balapur cloth worth five thousand rupees. Pindari raiders sacked the town in 1809.
zh:
瓦斯希姆（瓦辛）坐落在贝拉尔的黑土平原上，周围棉田供养织工，道路把它同埃利奇布尔、巴拉布尔和瓦尔达河谷连接起来。它旧称伐特萨古尔摩，4世纪时伐迦陀迦王子沙尔瓦犀那以此为都建立支系，其王据有萨希亚德里山至戈达瓦里河之间的土地，并施惠阿旃陀的佛教石窟。古老神庙和圣池仍吸引香客。1444年，它是巴赫曼尼总督治下一座说马拉地语的织布与市集城镇。

瓦斯希姆随控制贝拉尔的政权易主。1490年，伊马德·沙阿王朝趁巴赫曼尼疆域分裂取得此地；1574年，艾哈迈德讷格尔吞并贝拉尔；1596年，昌德·比比把该省割让给阿克巴。《阿克巴则例》把巴希姆列为税收区，还记载哈特卡尔丹加尔人能把一千名骑兵和五千名步兵带上战场。莫卧儿及后来的马拉塔统治时期，瓦斯希姆与巴拉普尔一直出产布匹，瓦斯希姆还设有铸币厂。1768至1769年马达夫拉奥一世征讨贾诺吉·邦斯勒时，双方在瓦斯希姆议定条件；《卡纳克普尔条约》规定每年进献两地所产、价值五千卢比的布匹。1809年，平达里骑兵洗劫此城。

en:
Karanja sits on the cotton plains of central Berar, on roads between Ellichpur and the Wardha valley. The old Karanjapur was named after the sage Karanja and praised in the Skanda Purana. Hindu pilgrims came to its Dattatreya shrines, and Narasimha Saraswati, the guru later regarded as an incarnation of Dattatreya, was born here in 1378. Wealthy Jain merchants of the Lad community were just as important to the town: they built temples and ran its market wards. In 1444 Bahmani governors taxed cotton carts and trade in a largely Hindu and Jain merchant town.

Karanja changed masters with the rest of Berar, passing to the Imad Shahi sultans in 1490, to Ahmadnagar in 1574 and to the Mughals in 1596. Its clearest Mughal landmark came from the local lord Nawab Subhan Khan, who ringed Karanja with a wall and four gates, named Delhi, Darwha, Mangrul and Poha, and built its Jami Masjid. After 1724 the Nizams of Hyderabad and the Maratha Bhonsles of Nagpur pressed competing claims over the town, while cotton dealers, Jain merchants and Hindu pilgrims continued to fill its bazaars.
zh:
迦兰阇旧称迦兰阇普尔，得名于仙人迦兰阇，《室犍陀往世书》中已有称扬，坐落在贝拉尔中部的棉花平原上，道路连通埃利奇布尔与瓦尔达河谷。印度教香客来此参拜达塔特雷亚系神庙；达塔特雷亚信仰中的大师那罗辛哈·萨拉斯瓦蒂1378年生于这里，后来被视为达塔特雷亚的化身。拉德群体中的富有的耆那教商人同样是城镇支柱，他们修建神庙、经营市集街区。1444年，巴赫曼尼总督在这座以印度教徒和耆那教徒为主的商镇向棉花车队和贸易征税。

迦兰阇随贝拉尔其余地区一同易主，1490年归伊马德·沙阿苏丹，1574年归艾哈迈德讷格尔，1596年归莫卧儿。当地纳瓦卜苏卜汗·汗留下了最清楚的莫卧儿地标：他环城筑墙，开设德里、达尔瓦、曼格鲁尔和波哈四座城门，又修建聚礼清真寺。1724年后，海得拉巴尼扎姆与那格浦尔的马拉塔邦斯勒家族都向此城施压、争夺主权，棉花商人、耆那教商人和印度教香客仍不断涌入市集。

en:
Manidurg is the black-stone ridge fort of Manikgad, set in the hills above the Wardha river country near the later town of Chandrapur; nearby Gadchandur takes its name from it. Its walls wrap around a wooded valley, and the forests along the ramparts yield hard hill timber and still hold leopard and wild boar. By about 1320 Bhim Ballal Singh of the Gond Atram clan had subdued the petty chiefs and founded the Gond kingdom of Chanda, ruling from Sirpur on the Wardha, and the old Mana fortress of Manikgarh was his chief stronghold. In 1444 the forested march answers to the Gond rajas of Chanda, even though Bahmani governors hold the Deccan districts on its west and south.

Later Gond kings built Ballarpur and laid out the walled town of Chandrapur, and their irrigation works and fixed land revenue were the first of their kind among the Gond kingdoms. Babji Ballal Shah kept Chanda independent in the years recorded by the Ain-i-Akbari, then paid tribute once the Mughals formed the Berar subah, and under Aurangzeb the kingdom was counted inside it. The Gond state lasted until 1751, when Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur conquered Chanda and the Manikgad hills passed into the Maratha state of Nagpur.
zh:
马尼杜格就是黑石山脊上的马尼加德堡，位于后来昌德拉布尔城附近、瓦尔达河乡野上方的丘陵中，旁边的格德昌杜尔即因它得名。城墙围出一个林木茂密的山谷，棱墙一带的森林出产坚硬的山地木材，林中仍有豹和野猪出没。约1320年，冈德人阿特拉姆氏族的比姆·巴拉尔·辛格已压服诸小首领，建立冈德人的钱达王国，以瓦尔达河畔的西尔布尔为都，马尼加德这座旧马纳要塞是他的主要堡垒。1444年，尽管巴赫曼尼的长官们据有其西面和南面的德干县区，这片森林边地实际听命于钱达的冈德罗阇。

后来的冈德国王修建巴拉尔布尔，并营建设防城市昌德拉布尔；他们的灌溉工程和固定土地税在冈德诸王国中开创先例。《阿克巴政典》记载的年代里，巴吉·巴拉尔·沙阿仍保住钱达的独立，莫卧儿设立贝拉尔苏巴后他开始纳贡，到奥朗则布时这个王国已被划入该省。冈德国家延续到1751年，那格浦尔的拉戈吉一世·邦斯莱征服钱达，马尼加德丘陵并入那格浦尔的马拉塔政权。

en:
Kanker is the forest country north of Bastar, where the Doodh River runs down from the hills toward the Mahanadi and the Gadiya hill rises above the raja's small capital. Teak, sal, rosewood and bijasal cover the slopes, and Gond, Halbi and Chhattisgarhi villages farm the river valleys and float timber and hill produce down to the plains. Local tradition explains the ruling house in its own way: Veer Kanhar Dev, a king of Jagannath Puri, is said to have abdicated with leprosy and withdrawn to Sihawa, where the Mahanadi rises; after a dream he bathed in a tank there and was cured, and the people made him their king. His Chandra line was remembered as ruling until 1404, though Bastar traditions instead described Kanker as a kingdom split off from Bastar later in the fifteenth century. In 1444 it was Bastar's northern march, facing the Haihaiyavansi plains around Raipur.

For centuries the raja of Kanker held Dhamtari as a tributary chief under the Haihaiyavansi kings of Chhattisgarh. When the Marathas overthrew that kingdom in 1740, Kanker passed first to the vassal ruler Mohan Singh and then to Bimbaji Bhonsle, the Maratha governor of Chhattisgarh, on condition that the raja furnish a military contingent five hundred strong. Nagpur occupied the state in 1809 and removed Bhup Deo; nine years later Richard Jenkins, the British Resident at Nagpur, restored him to the throne for an annual tribute of five hundred rupees. By 1821 the forest raja ruled again at Kanker, under Maratha and British supervision.
zh:
甘盖尔（坎凯尔）是巴斯塔尔以北的森林地带，杜德河顺山势流向默哈讷迪河，加迪亚山高耸在罗阇的小都城旁。坡地上长满柚木、萨尔木、花梨木和比贾萨尔木，贡德、哈尔比和恰蒂斯加尔村落耕作河谷，把木材和山货顺水运往平原。当地传说这样解释王室的来历：贾格纳特普里的国王维拉·坎哈尔·提婆身染麻风，退位后隐居到默哈讷迪河源头的锡哈瓦；他按梦中所示在一处水塘沐浴，病竟痊愈，当地人便拥他为王。他开创的月族王朝相传统治到1404年，但巴斯塔尔的传统另称甘盖尔是15世纪后期才从巴斯塔尔分出的王国。1444年，这里是巴斯塔尔的北境，面对着赖布尔一带的海海耶万西平原。

此后数百年，甘盖尔罗阇领有达姆塔里，作为恰蒂斯加尔海海耶万西王朝治下的藩属首领。1740年马拉塔人推翻海海耶万西王国后，甘盖尔先归附庸首领莫汉·辛格，再受恰蒂斯加尔的马拉塔总督宾巴吉·邦斯莱节制，条件是罗阇须提供一支五百人的部队。1809年那格浦尔出兵占领并废黜布普·提婆；九年后，英国驻那格浦尔代表理查德·詹肯斯恢复其王位，年缴贡赋五百卢比。到1821年，这位森林罗阇已在甘盖尔复位，只是处在马拉塔和英国的监督之下。

en:
Kalahandi is a forested plateau in southwestern Odisha, crossed by the Tel River and its tributaries; older records call it Mahakantara, the great forest. Its sal woods supplied timber, and the hills yielded corundum, garnets and sapphires, stones that writers as early as Panini and Kautilya, and later Ptolemy, already associated with this country. Its old name Karunda Mandala refers to the corundum, and the Naga rajas' clan goddess Manikeswari bears the word for ruby in her own name; their coat of arms showed two cobras facing each other. The Nagas succeeded the local Ganga governors in the fifteenth century as Eastern Ganga power weakened, and their coronation long kept a tribal stamp: the new raja sat on the lap of Pat Maghi, chief of the Khonds, at Jugasaipatna and took his crown from the tribesmen. In 1444 the chiefdom was being drawn into Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati monarchy, with Junagarh, later called Kalahandinagara, growing into its fortified centre on the Hati River.

Kalahandi paid tribute to the Gajapatis until the Odishan monarchy collapsed in 1568; afterwards the Naga rajas ruled on their own and claimed lordship over eighteen garhs, the hill forts of the plateau. At Junagarh they ringed their fort with temples, tanks and orchards, local memory counting 120 ponds and 180 fruit gardens; Odia inscriptions on the temples record the rajas' grants, some of the carvings taking the form of sati pillars. A Dadhivaman temple inscription of Maharaja Jugasai Dev in 1718, issued from Kalahandinagara, is the earliest known record to use the present name. In 1788 Marathas from Nagpur intervened in a succession and confirmed Purushottama Deo as raja under Raghuji Bhonsle. By 1821 a Naga ruler still kept court at Junagarh, but as a Maratha-protected Garjat chief rather than an independent highland king.
zh:
卡拉汉迪是奥里萨西南部的森林高原，特尔河及其支流纵横其间，古籍称摩诃坎塔罗，意为「大森林」。萨尔林出产木材，山地出产刚玉、石榴石和蓝宝石，早在波你尼、考底利耶的书里，以及后来托勒密的记述中，这一带的宝石已有其名。旧名卡隆达曼荼罗即来自刚玉，那伽罗阇奉祀的家族女神摩尼克什瓦里，名字里也含「红宝石」一词；他们的王徽是两条相对的眼镜蛇。15世纪东恒伽王权衰落，那伽家族接替当地的恒伽统治者兴起，其加冕礼长期保留着部落印记：新罗阇在朱伽赛帕特南坐在孔德人首领帕特·马吉的膝上，由部落人为他加冕。1444年，这个寨邦正被卷入卡皮伦德拉·提婆的伽贾帕蒂王权，哈蒂河畔的朱纳加尔（日后称卡拉汉迪纳加拉）正发展为设防都城。

卡拉汉迪向伽贾帕蒂纳贡，直到1568年奥里萨王权崩溃；此后那伽罗阇自主执政，号称统有高原上的十八个迦尔寨堡。他们在朱纳加尔的寨堡周围营建神庙、水塘和果园，当地传说有120口塘、180座果园；神庙上的奥里亚铭文记载着罗阇的施舍，其中一些石刻做成萨蒂柱的形制。1718年，摩诃罗阇朱伽赛·提婆以卡拉汉迪纳加拉名义发布的达迪瓦曼神庙铭文，是已知最早使用「卡拉汉迪」现名的文献。1788年，那格浦尔的马拉塔人插手继承，确认普鲁肖塔马·提婆为臣服于拉古吉·邦斯莱的罗阇。到1821年，那伽统治者仍在朱纳加尔临朝，但身份只是受马拉塔保护的迦贾德首领，不再是自主的高地之王。

en:
Patna is the plateau country of the upper Ang River in western Kosala, hemmed in between the Mahanadi and the Tel, with the old fort town of Patnagarh for its capital. Its rajas were Chauhan Rajputs who claimed descent from Prithviraj Chauhan of Ajmer: when Muhammad Ghori defeated him at Tarain in 1193, the clan scattered and a branch made its way into these hills. In 1360 Ramai Deva, a twenty-year-old of the line, overthrew the eight local warlords who had divided the country among themselves after the Eastern Ganga governor Hattahamir Deb died, and founded the kingdom. His successors made Patnagarh the head of the eighteen forts (garhs) of south Kosala, the Garhjat country. In 1444 a Chauhan raja still held the fort above the Ang, his barons kept the hill passes, and the plains below were planted with cotton for the markets of the Mahanadi valley.

Court Brahmins set the dynasty's story down on palm leaves, above all in the Kosalananda Kavya, the Sanskrit chronicle composed in the seventeenth century by Gangadhar Mishra of Puri. In 1540 Raja Narsingh Deva split the kingdom with his younger brother Balarama Deva, who took the northern lands and founded Sambalpur; Khariar and later Sonepur also grew out of Chauhan cadet branches. When the Marathas pushed into western Odisha the rajas came under the Bhonsles of Nagpur, and in 1797 Patna was placed under Sambalpur's overlordship. Chauhan rulers kept Patnagarh through the Maratha inroads of 1808 and 1817, and after the Bhonsles' collapse in 1818 the kingdom passed under British protection with the same dynasty still in its fort.
zh:
巴特那是西憍萨罗昂河上游的高原之地，夹在默哈讷迪河与泰勒河之间，以古堡城镇帕特纳加尔为都城。这里的罗阇是昌汗拉杰普特人，自称出自阿杰米尔的普利色毗罗阇·昌汗一脉：1193年穆罕默德·古尔在塔拉因击败普利色毗罗阇后，族人四散，一支辗转进入这片山区。1360年，族中二十岁的罗摩伊·提婆推翻八名割据首领、建立王国；自东恒伽长官哈塔哈米尔·德布死后，这些首领便各霸一方。后继诸王把帕特纳加尔经营成南憍萨罗十八堡（迦贾德地区）之首。1444年，仍有一位昌汗罗阇据守昂河高处的城堡，封臣把守山口，山下的平原种着棉花，销往默哈讷迪河谷的市集。

宫廷婆罗门把王朝的事迹记在贝叶上，其中最重要的是17世纪普里诗人甘加达尔·米什拉撰写的梵文编年史《科萨拉南达卡维亚》。1540年，那罗辛哈·提婆罗阇与其弟巴拉拉姆·提婆分家，后者得到北方土地，建立桑巴尔普尔；卡里亚尔和后来的索内布尔也出自昌汗支系。马拉塔人攻入西奥里萨后，罗阇们沦为那格浦尔朋斯勒的附庸，巴特那又于1797年改受桑巴尔普尔节制。1808年和1817年马拉塔两度入寇，昌汗王室始终保有帕特纳加尔；1818年朋斯勒败亡，王国转入英国保护，城堡中仍是同一家族。

en:
Parlakhimedi, the Parlakhemundi of later records, lies where the forested Maliya hills fall away to the Ganjam coastal plain; the Mahendra Tanaya River separates the town from Pathapatnam, and Odia, Telugu and Soura traders meet in its hill markets. In the fifteenth century the country was called Khemundi, a southern march of the Odishan monarchy guarding the passes against the Telugu plains. In 1444 Kapilendra Deva, founder of the Gajapati dynasty, held the tract amid his wars of succession, and later in the century his son Kolahomee founded the Parla ruling line, which built its palace on the wooded hill above the town.

The old Khemundi country stayed under one ruler until 1607, when it divided into Parlakhemundi, Badakhemundi and Sanakhemundi, with Subhalinga Bhanu remembered as the first Parla raja. The small Ganga state outlasted the Mughal and Maratha struggles for Odisha from its palace below the hill. In the late 1760s Gajapati Jagannatha Narayanadeva accepted British overlordship; when the authorities arrested him and his son, tribal people and the local Paika militia rose and forced the British to restore the raja. The poet Gopalakrusna Pattanayaka, born here in 1784, set Odia devotional verses in Odissi ragas and talas, and many of his songs became standard abhinaya pieces of Odissi dance. By 1821 the raja still held the forests and hill passes, but as a British-supervised feudatory.
zh:
伯尔拉基米迪在后世文献中称帕尔拉凯蒙迪，地处林木覆盖的马利亚山向甘贾姆沿海平原下降的地带；默亨德拉塔纳亚河把城镇与帕塔帕特南隔开，奥里雅、泰卢固和索拉商人在山地集市交易。15世纪时这里称凯蒙迪，是奥里萨王权的南边要地，扼守山口、防范泰卢固平原。1444年，伽贾帕蒂王朝的开创者卡皮伦德拉·提婆在夺权战争中控制此地；该世纪后期，他的儿子科洛霍米开创帕尔拉王统，在镇旁林木茂盛的山丘上修建王宫。

旧凯蒙迪地区由一位统治者统辖至1607年，随后分裂为帕尔拉凯蒙迪、巴达凯蒙迪和萨纳凯蒙迪，苏巴林加·巴努被追认为第一代帕尔拉罗阇。莫卧儿与马拉塔争夺奥里萨期间，这个恒伽小朝廷依托山下的王宫存续下来。1760年代末，伽贾帕蒂·阇伽那特·那罗衍那提婆接受英国宗主权；英国当局逮捕他和其子后，当地部民和派卡武装起事，迫使其将罗阇复位。诗人戈帕拉克鲁什那·帕特纳亚卡1784年生于此地，他把奥里亚虔诚诗谱成奥迪西的拉格调与塔拉节拍，不少歌曲成为奥迪西舞表演的经典曲目。到1821年，罗阇仍占有森林和山口，但只是受英国监督的藩属。

en:
Jammu sits in the Tawi valley, where the Punjab plain climbs into the first hills on the road to the Kashmir passes, and it has long been the chief town of the Dogra Rajputs of Duggar. Its old stronghold, the Bahu fort, stands on a height across the Tawi; the present walls were raised by Raja Autar Dev in 1585, and the fort temple holds the image of Mahakali, the Bawe Wali Mata, brought from Ayodhya. The town's many shrines give it its name of the city of temples. The Khokhar chieftain Jasrat killed Raja Bhim Dev in 1423 and ruled Jammu until his death in 1442, leaving his son-in-law Manik Dev as vassal raja. In 1444, therefore, Manik Dev holds a Hindu fortress-town of temples, bazaars and caravan traffic, newly quit of Jasrat and steering between Delhi, Lahore and the Muslim sultan of Kashmir.

Babur's memoirs still call Jammu a powerful state of the Punjab hills early in the sixteenth century. Its rajas took Mughal rank under Akbar but rose repeatedly, and in the revolt of 1616 Raja Sangram Dev killed the Lahore viceroy Raja Man; later rajas served in the Deccan, where Hari Dev died on Aurangzeb's campaigns. As Mughal power crumbled the neighbouring hill states looked to Jammu, and Ranjit Dev, raja from 1733 to 1782, gave the town its great age. He banned sati and female infanticide, welcomed merchants and refugees of every creed, and was recognised as chief of the twenty-two hill states; George Forster, passing through in 1783, found a thriving bazaar in the country between the Chenab and the Ravi. The Sikh misls had already forced him to pay tribute to the Bhangis, Mahan Singh Sukerchakia sacked the town, and his successor Braj Dev fell fighting at Rumal in 1787. Around 1808 Ranjit Singh annexed Jammu, and in 1820 he granted it as a hereditary fief to Kishore Singh Jamwal, whose son Gulab Singh already commanded Sikh troops.
zh:
查谟坐落在塔维河谷，旁遮普平原在这里升入通往克什米尔山口的第一道山地，自古是杜加尔道格拉拉杰普特人的首镇，城中神庙众多，有「神庙之城」的称呼。旧堡巴胡堡雄踞塔维河对岸的高地，现存城墙为拉杰奥塔尔·德夫1585年所筑，堡内神庙供奉摩诃迦梨，即当地所称的巴韦·瓦利女神，神像取自阿约提亚。1423年，霍哈尔酋长贾斯拉特杀死拉杰比姆·德夫，统治查谟直到1442年去世，留下女婿曼尼克·德夫为附庸拉杰。因此1444年的查谟，是曼尼克·德夫治下一座印度教要塞城镇，神庙、市集与商队往来其间，刚摆脱贾斯拉特的控制，在德里、拉合尔和克什米尔穆斯林苏丹之间小心周旋。

16世纪初，巴布尔的笔下仍把查谟称作旁遮普山地的强国。阿克巴时，查谟拉杰接受莫卧儿品级，却屡次举兵；1616年一役，桑格拉姆·德夫杀死拉合尔总督拉杰·曼。后来的拉杰出征德干，哈里·德夫便死于奥朗则布的军中。莫卧儿衰乱后，邻近山地诸邦转而听命查谟，1733至1782年在位的兰吉特·德夫开创了城镇的全盛期。他禁止萨蒂和溺杀女婴，善待各教的商人和避难者，被推为二十二个山地邦之首；1783年路过此地的乔治·福斯特，见到杰纳布河与拉维河之间市集殷盛。锡克米斯尔早已迫使他向班吉米斯尔纳贡，苏克尔查基亚的马安·辛格又洗劫了城镇，继位的布拉杰·德夫1787年战死于鲁马尔。约1808年，兰季德·辛格吞并查谟，1820年把它封给基肖尔·辛格·贾姆瓦尔作世袭领地，其子古拉卜·辛格此时已在锡克军中为将。

en:
Mayurbhanj is the great sal wilderness of the northern Orissa hills, where the Budhabalanga river and the Similipal ridges cross iron-bearing country, and Santal, Ho and Munda villages share the forest with elephants. Its rajas were the Bhanjas, a Kshatriya line of the old Khijjinga mandala whose own legend made them descendants of a peahen's eyes; two peacocks face each other on their arms, and mayura, a peacock, joined to Bhanja gives the land its name. Their early capital was Khiching, seat of the Kichakeshwari temple, and around 1400 Harihar Bhanj built a new fort-capital, Haripur, on the Budhabalanga. In 1444 the Bhanja raja held Haripur as one of the Garjat hill chiefs, a vassal of Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati empire; a brother branch of the same house ruled the adjoining Keonjhar.

When Muslim armies conquered Orissa in 1568 the Garjat chiefs kept their freedom by withdrawing into woods the invaders did not care to enter, and the Bhanjas spent the next two centuries as tributary hill lords under the Mughals. Their building years came under Raja Baidyanath Bhanj, who raised the tall brick Rasika Raya temple inside Haripur fort and a Jagannath temple at Baripada; the court moved to Baripada, which pilgrims called the second Srikhetra after Puri. In the eighteenth century Orissa and its Garjats passed to the Bhonsles of Nagpur, who took an annual tribute of six thousand rupees, and in 1804 Maharani Sumitra Devi built a new palace at Baripada.
zh:
马尤布汉杰是奥里萨北部山区的娑罗双林荒野，布达巴朗加河与锡米利帕尔山岭纵贯含铁的土地，桑塔尔、霍和蒙达人的村落与象群共享山林。统治这里的班贾家族源出古老克希金加曼陀罗的刹帝利世系，按家族传说，其祖先出自一只雌孔雀的双眼；纹章上两只孔雀相对，「摩由罗」（孔雀）加上「班贾」便成了地名。他们早期的都城在基钦，即基切克什瓦里神庙所在；约1400年，诃利诃罗·班贾在布达巴朗加河畔营建新的堡城哈里普尔。1444年，班贾罗阇坐镇江城哈里普尔，是卡皮伦德拉·德瓦加贾帕提帝国治下的加尔贾特山地首领之一，同宗的一支则统治着相邻的凯翁贾尔。

1568年穆斯林军队征服奥里萨时，加尔贾特诸首领退入入侵者不愿深入的山林，保住了自主；此后两个世纪，班贾人以纳贡山地首领的身份处于莫卧儿治下。拜迪亚纳特·班贾罗阇在位时是家族的营造期，他在哈里普尔堡内建起高耸的砖构拉西卡·拉亚神庙，又在巴里帕达修建贾格纳特神庙；宫廷随后迁往巴里帕达，香客把这里称作普里之后的第二个斯里克谢特拉。18世纪，奥里萨连同加尔贾特诸邦归于那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族，每年索取六千卢比贡金；1804年，苏米特拉·德维太后在巴里帕达兴建新王宫。

en:
Sonepur lies at the sangam where the Tel River runs into the Mahanadi, a green and jungly reach of western Odisha where pilgrims bathe at the meeting of the waters and temples, tantric shrines among them, crowd the bank. They call the town a second Prayag for its confluence and a second Varanasi for its temple cluster. The old fort above the river commands the Mahanadi traffic: salt and metalware come upstream by boat, while sal timber and other forest produce from the surrounding hills float down. The goddess Lankeswari, whose shrine stands in the river itself, guards the town. In 1444 this was the southern march of the Chauhan kingdom of Patna, though the Bhanja rajas of neighbouring Boudh still held the hill fastnesses and took the ferry dues.

Sonepur became a kingdom of its own in 1656, when Madhukar Dev, Chauhan raja of Sambalpur, took the tract from the Bhanjas and enfeoffed his younger son Madan Gopal, whose line held it for the next two and a half centuries. Its rajas built palaces and temples in the Patnagarh manner and grew rich on river dues and the timber of their forests. Through the later eighteenth century Sonepur, like the other Garhjat states, paid tribute to the Bhonsles of Nagpur. Rani Laxmipriya Devi governed as regent from 1802 through the Maratha inroads of 1808 and 1817, and after the Bhonsle collapse of 1818 the little river kingdom passed into the British orbit with its Chauhan dynasty still in place.
zh:
索内普尔（索内布尔）在泰勒河汇入默哈讷迪河的汇流处，是西奥里萨一段林木葱郁的河湾。朝圣者到两河相汇之处沐浴，河畔神庙林立，其中还有密教祠堂；凭这处汇流，人们把它称作「第二普拉亚格」，凭这片神庙群把它称作「第二贝拿勒斯」。临河的古堡居高临下，扼住默哈讷迪河的航运：盐和金属器皿乘船逆流而上，周围群山的娑罗双木和山林物产则顺流东下。兰克什瓦里女神的神祠立在河水之中，是这座城镇的守护神。1444年，此地是昌汗人巴特那王国的南疆，邻近博德的班贾罗阇仍据守山间要塞、收取渡资。

1656年，桑巴尔普尔的昌汗罗阇摩杜迦尔·提婆从班贾人手中夺得这片土地，封给幼子摩登·戈巴尔，索内普尔这才自立一邦，戈巴尔的后代在此统治了两个半世纪。诸王仿照帕特纳加尔的样式营造宫室神庙，靠河运税卡和山林木材致富。18世纪后期，索内普尔与其他迦贾德土邦一样向那格浦尔的朋斯勒纳贡。1802年起，拉克什米普里亚·德维王后以摄政身份主政，历经1808年和1817年的马拉塔入寇；1818年朋斯勒败亡，这个河畔小邦保留着昌汗王朝，转入英国势力范围。

en:
Ratanpur, the old Ratnapura, lies in the upper Mahanadi hills about twenty-five kilometres north of Bilaspur, ringed by jungle. Around the year 1000 Kalingaraja, a prince of the Kalachuris of Tripuri on the upper Narmada, conquered Dakshina Kosala and fixed his seat at Tummana; his grandson Ratnadeva, also called Ratnaraja, built Ratnapura ('the city of jewels') and moved the court there. The country was counted as thirty-six forts (garhs), which popular tradition makes the origin of the name Chhattisgarh, and Ratanpur remained the senior capital even after a junior branch was enfeoffed at Raipur in 1407. The Mahamaya temple crowns the old fort, and jungle-covered mountains shielded the kingdom on nearly every side, so that in 1444 no Muslim army had ever entered it.

In the fifteenth century King Vahara, remembered in local tradition as Bahar Sahai, fought off Afghan raiders and for a time moved his court to Kosgain; by the end of the sixteenth century his successors acknowledged Mughal overlordship. In December 1740 Bhaskar Pant, dewan and general of Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur, brought his guns before the fort. After the bombardment Queen Laxmi opened the gates, and the Haihaiyavanshi kingdom changed hands almost without a battle. Bhaskar Pant later led the Maratha raids into Bengal and was killed there by Alivardi Khan in 1744. Raja Raghunath Singh ruled on at Ratanpur as a Maratha tributary; after him the Bhonsles placed Mohan Singh of the Raipur line on the throne. In 1758 Bimbaji Bhonsle arrived to take direct charge, made Ratanpur his seat over all Chhattisgarh, and closed seven centuries of Haihaya rule.
zh:
拉坦普尔（拉坦布尔）古称罗多补拉（Ratnapura，意为「珠宝之城」），坐落在默哈讷迪河上游丘陵间，南距比拉斯布尔约25公里，四周丛林环抱。约1000年，纳马达河上游特里普里迦罗朱利王族的卡林加拉贾征服南憍萨罗，定都图姆马纳；其孙罗多提婆（又称罗多罗阇）兴建罗多补拉，迁都于此。全国按三十六堡（加尔）计数，后世相传，「恰蒂斯加尔」的地名就是「三十六堡」之意。1407年幼支受封赖布尔，拉坦普尔仍是长支都城。摩诃摩耶庙高踞古堡之上，丛林覆盖的群山几乎从四面护住这个王国，是以到1444年为止，还没有一支穆斯林军队进入过此地。

15世纪，瓦哈拉国王（后世传统称巴哈尔·萨海）抵御阿富汗人入寇，一度把王廷迁往科斯盖因；到16世纪末，后继诸王承认了莫卧儿的宗主权。1740年12月，那格浦尔拉戈吉一世·朋斯勒的将军兼财政大臣巴斯卡尔·潘特把炮队带到堡前，炮击之后拉克什米王后打开城门，海哈亚万希王国几乎未经一战便易了手。巴斯卡尔·潘特后来率领马拉塔人袭掠孟加拉，1744年在那里被阿里瓦尔迪·汗所杀。罗怙那特·辛格作为马拉塔附庸继续留在拉坦普尔；他死后，朋斯勒家族把赖布尔支系的莫汉·辛格扶上王位。1758年，宾巴吉·朋斯勒前来直接接管，以拉坦普尔为整个恰蒂斯加尔的治所，海哈亚人七百年的统治到此结束。

en:
Thalner stands on the north bank of the Tapi, where the Burhanpur road runs west toward Surat. Its fort takes its name from the Thaleshwar stone temple at its foot. In 1370 Firuz Shah Tughluq granted the surrounding lands to Malik Raja Faruqi, who made Thalner his headquarters and the first capital of the Faruqi kings of Khandesh. Malik Raja and two of the early sultans were buried here. After the court moved to Burhanpur, the fort kept watch on the western frontier and on cotton and cloth traffic along the river. In 1444 it was one of the chief strongholds of the Faruqi sultanate.

Mahmud Begada of Gujarat laid waste the district in 1498 and withdrew only after the arrears of tribute were paid. When Akbar's forces took Thalner in 1600, observers still called it a powerful fort despite its position on level ground; Jean-Baptiste Tavernier listed it sixty years later among the trade posts on the Surat-Burhanpur road. Around 1750 it was the central fort of thirty-two small chiefships, before passing to the Peshwa and then to Holkar. Holkar ceded it to Britain by the Treaty of Mandsaur in January 1818, but its garrison refused to surrender. On 27 February Sir Thomas Hislop's storming party forced four gates; at the fifth, Arab defenders killed Major Gordon and Captain MacGregor. The fort was then carried, its 300 defenders were put to death, and its commandant was hanged.
zh:
塔尔内位于塔普蒂河北岸，布尔汉布尔通往苏拉特的道路经过这里。城堡得名于脚下的塔莱什瓦尔石庙。1370年，菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克把周边土地封给马利克·拉贾·法鲁基；后者以塔尔内为大本营，这里成为坎德什法鲁克王朝的第一个都城。马利克·拉贾和两位早期苏丹都葬在此地。宫廷迁往布尔汉布尔后，这座堡垒继续把守西境，也监视沿河运输棉花和布匹的商队。1444年，它是法鲁克苏丹国的主要要塞之一。

1498年，古吉拉特的马哈茂德·贝加达纵兵蹂躏这一地区，直到积欠贡赋付清才撤走。1600年阿克巴的军队夺取塔尔内时，人们仍认为这座立于平地上的堡垒十分坚固；六十年后，让-巴蒂斯特·塔韦尼耶把它列为苏拉特至布尔汉布尔商路上的贸易站。1750年前后，它是三十二个小酋长国的中心堡垒，后来先后落入佩什瓦和霍尔卡手中。1818年1月，霍尔卡根据曼德索尔条约把塔尔内割让给英国，但守军拒绝投降。2月27日，托马斯·希斯洛普爵士的突击队攻破四道城门；在第五道门，阿拉伯守军杀死戈登少校和麦格雷戈上尉。堡垒随后失守，三百名守军被处死，司令被处以绞刑。

en:
Porbandar is a year-round harbour on the Arabian Sea below the Barda hills, on Saurashtra's western coast. Its lords were the Jethwa Rajputs, the oldest ruling clan of the peninsula, who bore the title of rana and claimed descent from Hanuman. The Mer herdsmen of the Barda country were their kinsmen in arms, and by custom the Mer headman cut the tip of his little finger at a rana's enthronement and marked the new lord's forehead with the blood. The Jethwas once ruled all the country west of the Barda range from their capital of Ghumli, until a Jadeja army sacked the city in 1313; local legend blames its fall on the curse of a sati named Sone, and the Jadeja chief built the Ashapura temple on the hill above the ruins. In 1444 the rana held his court at Ranpur, and the little port of Porbandar and the nearby settlement of Chhaya still belonged to his hard-pressed house.

Between 1525 and 1535 Jam Rawal of Nawanagar overran the greater part of Halar, took Nagnath, which his house renamed Nawanagar, and confined the Jethwas to the Barda coast. A rana's widow, Rani Kalabai, then raised an army of Mers and Rabaris and won back the country as far as Ranpur. In 1671 Rana Vikmatji Khimoji took Porbandar from its Mughal garrison and built a fort there, and his son Rana Saratanji II moved the capital from Chhaya in 1685 and raised the Darbargarh palace with its garden pavilion. Maratha armies overran the little state soon afterwards, and the rana paid tribute through the Gaekwad of Baroda and the Peshwa. He allied himself to the British in 1807, and a protectorate agreement with the East India Company followed on 5 December 1809.
zh:
博尔本德尔是阿拉伯海沿岸、巴尔达丘陵脚下一座全年可停泊的海港，地处索拉什特拉西岸。这里的领主是杰特瓦拉杰普特人，半岛上最古老的统治氏族，世代拥有「拉纳」称号，自称是哈奴曼的后裔。巴尔达山区的梅尔牧人世代为他们出战；按族中惯例，新拉纳登位时，梅尔人的首领要割破自己的小指尖，用鲜血在新主额头上点出提拉克。杰特瓦人曾以古姆利为都，领有巴尔达岭以西的整片土地，1313年贾德贾军队攻陷并摧毁了此城，当地传说城破缘于一位名叫索娜的萨蒂的诅咒，贾德贾首领随后在废墟上方的山丘建起阿沙普拉神庙。1444年，拉纳在兰布尔开府，博尔本德尔小港和邻近的查亚仍属这个处境艰难的家族。

1525至1535年间，纳瓦纳加尔的贾姆·拉瓦尔席卷哈拉尔大部，夺取纳格纳特并将其改名纳瓦纳加尔，把杰特瓦人压缩到巴尔达沿海。一位拉纳的遗孀卡拉巴伊王后召集梅尔人与拉巴里人组成军队，反攻收复失地，一直打到兰布尔。1671年，拉纳·维卡马吉·希莫吉从莫卧儿守军手中夺取博尔本德尔并修筑堡垒；其子拉纳·萨拉坦吉二世1685年把都城从查亚迁来，建起达尔巴尔堡宫和园林凉亭。不久马拉塔大军攻灭这个小国，拉纳经巴罗达的盖克瓦德和佩什瓦缴纳贡赋。1807年他与英国人结盟，1809年12月5日又与东印度公司签订保护协定。

en:
Diu is a low island off the southern coast of Saurashtra at the mouth of the Gulf of Khambhat, with a roadstead where ocean-going ships could anchor close inshore. In 1444 it belonged to the Gujarat Sultanate, whose governor farmed a customs house grown rich on the carrying trade of Gujarati merchants sailing to the Red Sea, Egypt and Malacca. The governor at the turn of the sixteenth century was Malik Ayyaz, a Dalmatian Christian taken prisoner and converted in youth, who had risen to command the sultan's fleet. Wealth and anchorage made the island the western anchor of Gujarati sea power, and the Portuguese were set on taking it.

In March 1508 Ayyaz and the Mamluk admiral Amir Husain al-Kurdi surprised a Portuguese fleet at Chaul and killed Lourenco, son of Viceroy Francisco de Almeida. On 3 February 1509 the viceroy took his revenge in the roadstead off Diu, destroying the combined fleets of Gujarat, Cairo and Calicut; Ayyaz gave back the Chaul prisoners, clothed and fed, and kept the victors from building a fort for the rest of his governorship. The Portuguese gained their foothold only in 1535, when Sultan Bahadur Shah, menaced by Humayun, allowed a fort and garrison on the island, and two years later he was killed at Diu while trying to undo the grant. In 1538 Khoja Zufar and the Ottoman captain Suleiman Pasha besieged the fort and were beaten off by its small garrison under Anthony Silveira. In 1546 Khoja Zufar returned and was killed, as was the viceroy's son Fernando de Castro, in the campaign that relieved the fort under Joao de Castro, who rebuilt it. Diu became a Portuguese town of churches and customs dues, beating off attacks by the Arabs of Muscat and by the Dutch later in the seventeenth century. English Bombay drew away its trade, but the Portuguese flag still flew over Diu in 1821.
zh:
第乌是横在索拉什特拉南岸外、扼守坎贝湾口的一座低平岛屿，岛边有远洋船可近岸停泊的避风锚地。1444年，第乌属古吉拉特苏丹国，岛上税关靠着古吉拉特商人的转运贸易十分富足，商船从这里驶向红海、埃及和满剌加。十六世纪初镇守此岛的是马利克·阿亚兹：他本是达尔马提亚的基督徒，少年时被俘为奴并改宗伊斯兰教，后来一路升任苏丹的舰队统帅。财富与良港使第乌成为古吉拉特海上力量的西方支柱，也让葡萄牙人志在必得。

1508年3月，阿亚兹与马穆鲁克海军将领埃米尔·侯赛因·库尔迪在焦尔突袭葡萄牙舰队，击毙总督弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达之子洛伦索。1509年2月3日，阿尔梅达在第乌锚地复仇，歼灭古吉拉特、开罗和卡利卡特的联合舰队；阿亚兹把焦尔战俘衣食用度周全地交回，并在余下的任期内始终阻止胜者在岛上筑堡。葡萄牙人直到1535年才得偿所愿：受胡马雍威胁的苏丹巴哈杜尔沙准许他们在岛上筑堡驻军，两年后他试图收回成命，在第乌岛边被杀。1538年，科贾·佐法尔会同奥斯曼将领苏莱曼帕夏围攻要塞，被安东尼·西尔韦拉率领的少量守军击退。1546年佐法尔卷土重来，在若昂·德·卡斯特罗指挥的解围之战中毙命，一同战死的还有总督之子费尔南多·德·卡斯特罗，卡斯特罗随后重修了要塞。此后第乌成为葡萄牙人的城市，教堂与税关并立，十七世纪后期又击退马斯喀特阿拉伯人与荷兰人的进攻。英属孟买吸走了岛上的贸易，但1821年时，第乌城头仍飘着葡萄牙旗帜。

en:
Jhalavad, the land of the Jhala Rajputs, covers the dry northern Kathiawar plains immediately south of the Little Rann of Kutch, where cotton villages border the white salt flat. Around 1090 Harpal Makwana led his clansmen out of Sindh to Patdi and founded the chiefdom, and later Jhalas served the Chaulukya kings of Gujarat as frontier lords. In 1408 Satarsalji moved the Jhala seat to Mandal and three times rebelled against Ahmad Shah I, the builder of Ahmedabad. In 1444 Jhalavad remained a Hindu frontier chiefdom under the Gujarat Sultanate's pressure, and the better-known Jhala fortress at Halvad did not yet exist.

The sultanate struck hard in 1486. Rana Vaghoji defeated Khalil Khan near Saidpur and took him prisoner, but Mahmud Begada himself then marched on the Jhala fort of Kuva. In the battle Vaghoji's standard fell, and his queens, reading it as his death, led 750 women in jumping into a well, the rite of jal jauhar; Vaghoji fell soon after, and Begada sacked Kuva, a day still named Kuva-no-ker, the disaster of Kuva. His son Rajodharji founded Halvad in 1488, walling a new capital on the edge of the Rann. Another heir, Ajajji, was driven into exile in Mewar and died fighting for his hosts at Khanwa against Babur in 1527. Abul Fazl later counted Jhalavad at 2,200 villages with 10,000 cavalry and as many foot.

Jhalavad tradition keeps two tales of Rai Singh I: when the sultan in Ahmedabad fined the Charans and then the Ahirs a lakh of rupees and threatened conversion, he paid both sums himself; and at Akbar's durbar in Fatehpur Sikri he is said to have killed the court wrestler Hebat Khan with one blow. Jaiwant Singh built the lakeside palace at Samatsar in 1709, and in 1742 Rai Singh II moved the capital inland to Dhrangadhra; the Jhala court stayed there through the succession disputes that followed.
zh:
恰拉瓦尔意为贾拉拉杰普特人的土地，地处小卡奇盐沼以南的北卡提阿瓦干旱平原，棉花村落与白色盐滩相接。约1090年，哈尔帕尔·马克瓦纳率族人从信德迁至帕特迪，建立首领政权，后来的贾拉人作为边地领主为古吉拉特的索兰基诸王效力。1408年，萨塔萨尔吉把治所迁到曼达尔，曾三次起兵对抗修建艾哈迈达巴德的艾哈迈德沙一世。1444年，恰拉瓦尔仍是一个顶着古吉拉特苏丹国压力的印度教边地首领政权，贾拉人后来闻名的哈尔瓦德堡垒当时还不存在。

1486年苏丹国大举来攻。拉纳·瓦戈吉在赛义德布尔附近击败并俘获哈利勒汗，马哈茂德·贝加达随即亲征贾拉人的库瓦堡。激战中瓦戈吉的帅旗倒下，王后们以为他已战死，带着750名妇女投井，举行贾尔焦哈尔；瓦戈吉随后也战死，贝加达洗劫库瓦，这一天被称为「库瓦之难」。他的儿子拉乔达尔吉于1488年另建哈尔瓦德，在盐沼边缘筑起有城墙的新都。另一位继承人阿贾吉流亡梅瓦尔，1527年在坎瓦替收留他的梅瓦尔迎战巴布尔时战死。到阿克巴时代，阿布勒·法兹勒记载恰拉瓦尔有2200个村庄、1万名骑兵和同样数目的步兵。

当地传说还留着拉伊·辛格一世的两件事：艾哈迈达巴德的苏丹先向查兰人、又向阿希尔人各罚10万卢比，威胁不交便改宗，他两次都代缴了罚金；据说他还在法塔赫布尔西格里的朝会上一拳打死宫廷力士希巴特汗。1709年，贾伊万特·辛格在萨曼特萨尔湖畔修建王宫；1742年，拉伊·辛格二世把都城内迁德朗格阿德拉，此后虽有继业之争，贾拉宫廷一直留在新都。

en:
Khambhat, the Cambay of older maps, stands at the head of the gulf that bears its name, where the rivers of Gujarat meet the sea and the tides rise and fall thirty feet twice a day. Arab ships already called there in the tenth century, and al-Mas'udi praised its trade. Marco Polo found Cambaet a busy harbour with a king of its own, shipping cotton, leather and indigo. Ibn Battuta in the 1340s thought its houses and mosques among the finest he had seen in India, and gave the reason: foreign merchants settled in the town and vied with one another to build the most splendid. Niccolò de' Conti, arriving about 1440, walked walls said to run twelve miles around. The port belonged to the Muzaffarid sultans, who had made Gujarat independent of Delhi and held court at Ahmedabad; in 1444, under Muhammad Shah II, Cambay was the busiest harbour in the sultanate.

Its merchants grew rich on cloth and beads. Coarse checked cottons sold across the Indian Ocean as Cambay cloth, and the agate and carnelian beads cut here from stone fetched from the Rajpipla hills were carried as far as China; local lore credits the craft to Baba Ghor, an Ethiopian holy man who led a band of Siddi settlers to the town. Duarte Barbosa watched ships load cloth and spices for Mogadishu and return with gold, wax and ivory. Akbar annexed Gujarat in 1573, and the looms and bazaars kept their fame under Mughal rule, but the gulf went on silting: the tides still rose thirty feet over a channel too shallow for ships, and the sea trade drifted to Surat. In 1721 English sailors played the first recorded cricket match in India here. A governor's line made the town the seat of a small nawabi in 1730, and Mumin Khan, the last Mughal governor of Gujarat, secured it in 1742. General Goddard took Cambay in 1780 and restored it to the Marathas three years later; in 1803 the Peshwa ceded it to the East India Company.
zh:
坎贝（又译肯帕德）在以它得名的海湾顶端，古吉拉特诸河在此入海，每日两次潮汐，涨落可达三十英尺。10世纪时阿拉伯商船已在此停泊，马苏迪曾称道这里的贸易。马可·波罗见到的「坎巴埃特」是一座自有国王的繁忙海港，运出棉花、皮革和靛蓝。14世纪40年代，伊本·白图泰认为这里的宅邸和清真寺是他在印度所见最精美的，他给出的缘故是：定居城中的外商争豪斗富，一个比一个盖得讲究。约1440年尼科洛·达·孔蒂到访，绕城的城墙据说周长十二英里。此港属于穆扎法尔王朝的苏丹，他们已使古吉拉特脱离德里独立，宫廷设在艾哈迈达巴德；1444年穆罕默德沙二世在位，坎贝是苏丹国最繁忙的港口。

商人的财富来自布匹和珠饰。粗格棉布以「坎贝布」之名行销印度洋，本地匠人用拉杰皮乌拉山区运来的石料琢磨玛瑙和红玉髓珠，销路远至中国；当地人把这门手艺的起源归于巴巴·古尔，这位埃塞俄比亚圣徒曾率领一批西迪移民来此定居。杜阿尔特·巴尔博萨眼见船只满载布匹和香料驶往摩加迪沙，换回黄金、蜂蜡和象牙。阿克巴1573年吞并古吉拉特，莫卧儿治下织机和商市维持着旧日名声，海湾却不断淤积：潮头仍有三十英尺高，航道却浅得行不了船，海贸渐渐转向苏拉特。1721年，英国水手在坎贝打了印度有记载的第一场板球赛。1730年，一任总督的家族以此城为都，建立小纳瓦布国；末代古吉拉特莫卧儿总督穆明汗于1742年在此站稳脚跟。戈达德将军1780年攻占坎贝，三年后交还马拉塔人，1803年佩什瓦依约将它割让给东印度公司。

en:
This province covers the middle Narmada valley, where the river runs between the Vindhya escarpment to the north and the Satpura forests to the south; its stronghold is Chauragarh, a peak-fort above the Chaugan pass. The Narmada crossings were marcher country for centuries, disputed between the sultans of Mandu and the Gond rajas, and the river itself is revered along its banks like the Ganges. In 1444 Malwa holds the river plain while Gond chiefs keep the wooded southern hills, the border running through the ghats and ferries of the holy river.

Sangram Shah of Garha built Chauragarh early in the sixteenth century as one of his fifty-two forts: its ramparts carry three gates and enclose the Revakund tank, a Narasimha temple and the Rangmahal palace. Rani Durgavati moved her capital here from Singhorgarh for the strength of its heights, and the fort became the last stand of her house. After she killed herself at Narrai in June 1564, Asaf Khan's Mughals hunted her young son Vir Narayan to the mountain fortress and slew him when they stormed it. A later raja, Prem Narayan, kept his palace inside the walls, but Bundela raiders out of Orchha sacked the fort and killed him, and the valley slipped by degrees between Mughal officers and local chiefs.
