Juan de Zumárraga, first bishop of Mexico, also held part of the grant in the 1530s, spending its maize and cattle income on the San Francisco convent in the capital. When silver was struck at Zacatecas and Guanajuato, the royal road to the mines, the Camino Real de Tierra Adentro, ran through Xilotepec carrying miners, cattle and supplies. Otomi warriors helped the Spanish pacify the Bajio and joined the founding of Querétaro and Apaseo; Guamare raiders reached the town in 1569. In 1810 Otomi villagers armed with bows and clubs left the district with Miguel Hidalgo and Ignacio Allende on the insurgent march south.
zh:
希洛特佩克的纳瓦特尔语含义是嫩玉米穗之山，位于墨西哥谷以北的林木丘陵中。它是奥托米人领主政权的中心，属城从索亚尼基尔潘、维查潘一直到诺帕拉，商路和亲属联系远及瓦斯特卡、米却肯和瓜纳华托边地。1379年，特诺奇蒂特兰的阿卡马皮奇特利征服此地，但当地居民经战斗恢复自治；后来阿沙亚卡特尔征讨希基皮尔科、索科蒂特兰和希洛特佩克，也发现这些人极难制服。1444年，希洛特佩克仍是奥托米人的政权，村落种植玉米、制作陶器和织物，更北面的干旱地带则是奇奇梅卡诸族之地。

阿维索特尔把这个领主政权重新纳入特诺奇蒂特兰治下：1487年为他的加冕而发动的战事摧毁了恰帕，数百名奥托米人被押往加冕典礼。1526年，西班牙人随方济各会传教区开始殖民，农地被划为委托监护地产。最有名的监护者是胡安·哈拉米略，他的妻子是科尔特斯的译员唐娜·玛丽娜，即玛琳切（纳瓦语名马林钦）；她死后哈拉米略续娶贝亚特丽丝·德·安德拉达，贝亚特丽丝与哈拉米略和玛丽娜所生的女儿玛丽亚争夺希洛特佩克地产，官司一直打到印度事务委员会。16世纪30年代，墨西哥首任主教胡安·德·苏马拉加也握有部分监护权，用玉米和畜牧的收入资助都城的圣弗朗西斯科修道院。萨卡特卡斯和瓜纳华托发现银矿后，通往矿区的王家大道「皇家内陆大道」经过希洛特佩克，运去矿工、牲畜和补给。奥托米战士协助西班牙人安抚巴希奥，并参与建立克雷塔罗和阿帕塞奥；1569年瓜马尔袭击者曾打到希洛特佩克。1810年，手持弓箭和棍棒的奥托米村民随米格尔·伊达尔戈和伊格纳西奥·阿连德离开此地，踏上向南的起义之路。

en:
The Pame, who call themselves Xi'ui, held the rugged ranges and valleys east of the Bajío: the Rio Verde country, the Sierra Gorda and the tracks leading on toward Tamaulipas and the Huasteca. In 1444 they lived by hunting, gathering, trade and seasonal maize, moving between rancherías and speaking an Oto-Pamean tongue. Closer to Mesoamerica than the desert peoples farther north, they traded with Nahua, Otomi and Purépecha frontier villages and sometimes settled beside them. Spanish colonists later called this country the Pamería.

The mountains mattered because the silver road from the Zacatecas mines to Mexico City ran along their edge. As ranching pressed in after 1530, Pame bands joined the fifty years of the Chichimeca War from 1550, raiding pack trains on the route: Spanish records first called them the most peaceful of the Chichimeca nations, then reported kidnappings and killings. Augustinian, Franciscan and Dominican missions in the Sierra Gorda were burned or abandoned one after another, and the mountains stayed unconquered until 1740, when José de Escandón's campaign ended at the Battle of Media Luna, breaking Jonaz and Ximpece resistance and opening the Guanajuato–Zacatecas road. Spanish soldiers burned Pame villages to settle their people around missions, and between 1750 and 1760 the Pame themselves built five Franciscan churches at Jalpan, Landa, Tancoyol, Concá and Tilaco, under Junípero Serra's mission scheme; Serra later carried the same plan north to California, and the Sierra Gorda missions were abandoned in 1770. When the independence rising came in 1810, Pame communities joined it and Zenón Fernández raised insurgents in the Rio Verde valley; royalist troops sacked Jalpan in 1819.
zh:
帕梅人自称希乌伊人（Xi'ui），据有巴希奥东侧崎岖的山地与谷地：里奥韦尔德、谢拉戈尔达，以及通往塔毛利帕斯和瓦斯特卡的山路。1444年，他们以狩猎、采集、贸易和季节性玉米种植为生，在小村落之间迁徙，操奥托-帕梅语族的语言。比起更北方的沙漠族群，他们离美索亚美利加的定居社会更近，会同边境上的纳瓦人、奥托米人和普雷佩查人贸易，有时毗邻而居。西班牙殖民者后来把这片土地称作帕梅里亚。

这片山地之所以要紧，是因为萨卡特卡斯银矿通往墨西哥城的银路就擦着它的边缘经过。1530年后牧场不断逼近，帕梅群体加入1550年起延续半个世纪的奇奇梅克战争，在路上袭掠驮队：西班牙记载起初称他们是奇奇梅克诸族中最平和的一支，后来却满是绑架和杀人的报告。奥斯定会、方济各会和多明我会在谢拉戈尔达的传教所相继被焚或被弃，山地始终未被征服，直到1740年何塞·德·埃斯坎东的远征以梅迪亚卢纳之战告终，击破霍纳斯人和欣佩塞人的抵抗，打通瓜纳华托至萨卡特卡斯的道路。西班牙军队焚毁帕梅村落，把人口集中到传教所；1750年至1760年，帕梅人亲手在哈尔潘、兰达、坦科约尔、孔卡和蒂拉科建起五座方济各会教堂，工程归在胡尼佩罗·塞拉的传教方案之下；塞拉后来把同样的方案带到北方的加利福尼亚，谢拉戈尔达的传教所却在1770年被弃。1810年独立起义爆发，帕梅社区起而响应，塞农·费尔南德斯在里奥韦尔德谷地拉起义兵；保王军1819年洗劫了哈尔潘。

en:
The high valleys of southern Zacatecas, around Nochistlán and Apulco and reaching south to the lakes of Pechichitán, belonged to the señorío of Xicconecan. Its people, the Xiconaques, spoke Caxcan and planted seasonal maize in the valleys, hunted deer and hare, and lived in circular houses of zacate grass. The Nahuas called them Iztachichimecah, the 'white Chichimecas', for their pale skin or the whitish earth of their country. Their lords Panen and Xahualotl held Teocaltiche as a tributary and warred with the Cuxtaques, and around 1400 their warriors joined the Guamare confederacy raised against the Aztec and Purépecha empires. In 1444 Xicconecan was still free, its people hardened by Zacateco pressure that was pushing fresh Caxcan bands south from the Juchipila.

Spaniards under Pedro Almíndez Chirino passed through in 1531, and the first Guadalajara was founded near Nochistlán on 5 January 1532, only to be abandoned when the camp moved west. In the Mixtón War of 1541–42 Xahualotl's son Tenamaztle led the Caxcanes: he besieged Guadalajara and held the peñol of Mixtón until the Spanish took Nochistlán and stormed the rock. Shipped to Spain for trial in 1552, he appealed to Charles I to justify the rising with the support of Bartolomé de las Casas, and died at Valladolid in 1556. Raiding went on through the Chichimeca War, and in 1551 the Xiconaques destroyed Diego de Ibarra's stock ranch, until Hernando Martel defeated them and on 31 March 1563 founded the Villa de Santa María de los Lagos with the surviving Xiconaque and Cuxtaque families. Cattle and sheep haciendas then spread over the plains, with twenty thousand head by 1600, and the Comanja silver mine had opened in 1561. Lagos produced two men of the independence age: the lawyer Francisco Primo de Verdad, among the first criollos to claim self-rule, who died in a Mexico City dungeon in 1808, and the guerrilla leader Pedro Moreno, killed in 1817.
zh:
萨卡特卡斯南部的高地山谷，以诺奇斯特兰和阿普尔科为中心，向南延伸到佩奇奇坦湖群，是西科内坎酋邦的土地。居民希科纳克人说卡克斯坎语，在谷地里种靠天吃饭的玉米，猎鹿和野兔，住萨卡特草搭成的圆形屋子。纳瓦人把他们叫作伊斯特塔奇奇梅卡，即「白奇奇梅克人」，得名于他们较浅的肤色，或是当地泛白的泥土。君长帕年和萨瓦洛特尔让特奥卡尔蒂切纳贡，又同库克斯坦人交战；约1400年，这里的战士加入瓜马尔联盟，一起对抗阿兹特克和普雷佩查两大帝国。1444年时西科内坎仍然自由，萨卡特科人不断施压、把新的卡克斯坎人群从胡奇皮拉方向挤向南方，也让本地人久经战阵。

1531年，佩德罗·阿尔明德斯·奇里诺率人穿过此地；1532年1月5日，第一座瓜达拉哈拉在诺奇斯特兰附近建立，却随着营地西迁而废弃。1541至1542年的米斯特翁战争中，萨瓦洛特尔之子特纳马斯特莱率领卡克斯坎人围攻瓜达拉哈拉，据守米斯特翁山崖，直到西班牙人攻下诺奇斯特兰、强攻山崖。1552年他被押往西班牙受审，在巴托洛梅·德·拉斯卡萨斯支持下向国王卡洛斯一世申诉，证明举事有理，1556年在巴利亚多利德病故。袭掠在奇奇梅克战争期间仍未停止，1551年希科纳克人摧毁了迭戈·德·伊瓦拉的牧场；埃尔南多·马特尔最终将他们击败，1563年3月31日同幸存的希科纳克和库克斯塔克家族一起建立圣马里亚·德洛斯拉戈斯镇。此后牛羊庄园遍布平原，到1600年牲畜已有两万头，科曼哈银矿则在1561年开坑。拉戈斯还走出两位独立年代的人物：律师弗朗西斯科·普里莫·德·贝尔达是最早主张克里奥尔人自治的人之一，1808年死于墨西哥城的地牢；游击队领袖佩德罗·莫雷诺1817年战死。

en:
North-western Chihuahua, the dry ranges and basins around Janos, was Jocome country. The Jocomes were close kin to, or a branch of, the Suma, hunter-gatherers who moved between waterholes without fixed villages. In 1444 their camps lay among Suma, Jano, Opata, Sobaipuri and Apache bands, trading, raiding and intermarrying as opportunity offered. The Franciscan Alonso de Benavides in 1630 counted the Janos and Suma among the 'ferocious tribes' living along the caravan road linking the mines of Mexico with New Mexico.

A mission founded among the Janos about 1640 was burned in the native rising of the 1680s, after which Jocome bands joined the Suma and Janos who held out in the Chiricahua Mountains. In 1686 Juan Fernández de la Fuente built the Presidio de San Felipe y Santiago de Janos, which became the main Spanish base on the Apache frontier. Apache bands were first recorded there in 1692, and although the Franciscans reopened a mission among the Janos and Jocomes in 1717, the Jocome name soon drops out of the records, its bearers absorbed into Apache bands. One Chiricahua Apache band, the Chokone, may take its name from them.
zh:
奇瓦瓦西北部、雅诺斯周围干旱的山岭与盆地，是霍科梅人的土地。霍科梅人是苏马人的近亲或分支，是逐水源迁徙、没有固定村落的狩猎采集者。1444年，他们的营地夹杂在苏马、雅诺、奥帕塔、索瓦伊普里和阿帕奇诸部之间，有机会就贸易、袭掠或通婚。1630年，方济各会修士阿隆索·德·贝纳维德斯把雅诺人和苏马人算作「凶悍诸部」，居住在连接墨西哥银矿区与新墨西哥的商队大道沿线。

1640年前后在雅诺人中间建立的传教站在1680年代的原住民起义中被烧毁，此后霍科梅游群加入退守奇里卡瓦山的苏马人和雅诺人。1686年，胡安·费尔南德斯·德·拉·富恩特建起圣费利佩—圣地亚哥·德·雅诺斯要塞，这里后来成为西班牙人在阿帕奇边疆的主要基地。阿帕奇诸部1692年首次在当地留下记载；方济各会虽于1717年在雅诺人和霍科梅人中间重开传教站，霍科梅之名不久便从文书中消失，部众被阿帕奇诸部吸收。奇里卡瓦阿帕奇的乔科内游群，名字可能就来自他们。

en:
Between the Sierra de Morones and the Sierra de Nochistlán, the Juchipila river cuts a deep warm canyon through southern Zacatecas. Around 1170 Caxcan warriors of Nahuatl speech came up the canyon, drove out its earlier inhabitants and built their seat at Tlaltan, the Peñol de Juchipila: a citadel above sheer cliffs reached by a single steep and narrow stairway, looking down on a town of more than twenty-five hectares. Their señorío was called Xochipillan, 'the place of fair flowers', and it drew tribute from Apotzolco, Xalpan, Tepechitlán and the other towns of the canyon; maize and cotton grew on the warm river terraces while raiding parties harried the Zacateco and Guachichil country to the north and east. In 1444 its lord Xiuhtecuhtli, like the rulers of Nochistlán and Xalpa, answered to no outside power.

Cristóbal de Oñate took Tlaltan in 1530–31, the canyon was granted in encomienda to Hernán Flores, and Franciscans raised its first monastery around 1532. The exactions that followed drove the Caxcan lords to conspire, and in June 1541 Xochipillan rose with Nochistlán and Xalpa. On the 24th the Caxcanes destroyed Pedro de Alvarado's army near Nochistlán; the conquistador of Guatemala, one of Cortés's old captains, was crushed by a horse in the rout and died on 4 July. Viceroy Mendoza came in person with more than fifty thousand men and stormed the Peñón del Mixtón on 16 December 1541. Fray Antonio de Segovia then talked more than six thousand survivors into coming down from the rocks, and Apozol and Juchipila were refounded. The Franciscan church of San Francisco went up in 1627, and from 1548 Juchipila headed an alcaldía mayor that reached across most of the southern canyon country. When the insurgency began in 1810, the Caxcan and mestizo families of the canyon joined it and held out until 1821.
zh:
在莫罗内斯山与诺奇斯特兰山之间，胡奇皮拉河在萨卡特卡斯南部切出一条幽深温暖的峡谷。约1170年，操纳瓦特尔语的卡克斯坎武士沿峡谷而上，逐走早先的居民，把大本营建在特拉尔坦，即胡奇皮拉山崖：陡崖之上立着城堡，只有一条又陡又窄的阶梯可登，崖下是一片超过二十五公顷的城镇。他们的酋邦称作索奇皮尔兰，意为「名花之乡」，向阿波特索尔科、哈尔潘、特佩奇特兰等河谷村镇收取贡赋；河阶上种着玉米和棉花，袭击队则北上东征，骚扰萨卡特科人和瓜奇奇尔人的土地。1444年时，君长休伊特莱库特利与诺奇斯特兰、哈尔帕的统治者一样，不受任何外来势力统属。

1530至1531年，克里斯托瓦尔·德·奥尼亚特攻下特拉尔坦，峡谷作为委托监护地封给埃尔南·弗洛雷斯，方济各会士约在1532年建起第一座修道院。监护主的盘剥终于把卡克斯坎君长们逼到密谋起事，1541年6月，索奇皮尔兰与诺奇斯特兰、哈尔帕一同举事。6月24日，卡克斯坎人在诺奇斯特兰附近歼灭佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多的军队；这位征服危地马拉的征服者、科尔特斯当年的老部将在溃乱中被马踩踏，7月4日死去。总督门多萨亲率五万多人前来，1541年12月16日强攻米斯特翁山崖。战后修士安东尼奥·德·塞戈维亚劝说六千多名幸存者从山上下来，阿波索尔和胡奇皮拉得以重建。圣方济各堂于1627年建成，而从1548年起，胡奇皮拉统辖一片大市政官区，覆盖南部河谷的大部。1810年独立起义爆发后，河谷的卡克斯坎和混血家族投身其中，一直坚持到1821年。

en:
The Rarámuri, whom the Spanish later called Tarahumara, held the pine-clad ridges and deep gorges of the Sierra Madre Occidental in western Chihuahua, including the Barranca del Cobre country. They spoke a Uto-Aztecan tongue, farmed maize and beans on the canyon floors and benches, and gathered for tesgüinadas, feasts held on corn beer. Scattered homesteads of logs or stone, sometimes caves, answered to no lord beyond their own elders. Long-distance running was part of their prayer and of their daily movement over the ridges and down the barrancas, and in 1444 the whole sierra belonged to them.

Jesuits reached the southern edge of their country early in the seventeenth century, and Juan Fonte opened the mission of San Pablo Balleza; he and seven fellow Jesuits died in the great Tepehuán rising of 1616, and the mission stood empty for more than a decade. The silver strike at Parral in 1631 pulled slavers, ranchers and missionaries into the eastern valleys, and missions multiplied at Satevó, Huejotitán, San Felipe and Las Bocas. A first Rarámuri rising burned San Francisco de Borja, and the Spanish answered by building the Villa de Aguilar in their upper country. Teporaca, a war captain who had himself helped build that villa, led a greater rising through the Papigochi valley in 1652; royal troops crushed it, and on 4 March 1653 he was hanged from the tallest pine at Tomochi. Mountain bands kept priests and settlers out until the Jesuits returned years later and baptised thousands, and a final war at the end of the century still ended in defeat, though the high sierra was never fully subdued. After the Jesuit expulsion of 1767 the Franciscans could not maintain the missions, and the Rarámuri withdrew deeper into the barrancas; in 1821 their mountains became part of Mexico.
zh:
拉拉穆里人被西班牙人称为塔拉乌马拉人，他们据有西奇瓦瓦西马德雷山脉的松岭与深峡，包括铜峡谷一带的峡谷之地。他们的语言属犹他—阿兹特克语系，在谷底和台地上种植玉米、菜豆，还会在名为特斯吉纳达的玉米酒宴上聚饮。原木或石块搭成的小屋散布各处，有时就栖身洞穴，除本族长老外不认任何君长。长距离奔跑既是他们祈祷的方式，也是翻越山脊、出入深谷的行路方式；1444年，整片群山都属于他们。

17世纪初，耶稣会士抵达其地南缘，胡安·丰特建起圣巴勃罗·巴列萨传教站；他和七名同会修士在1616年的特佩瓦大起义中遇难，传教站空废了十几年。1631年帕拉尔发现银矿，奴隶贩子、牧场主和传教士随之涌入东部谷地，萨特沃、韦霍蒂坦、圣费利佩和拉斯博卡斯很快都建起传教站。拉拉穆里人首次起事，焚毁圣弗朗西斯科·德·博尔哈传教站，西班牙人随即在其腹地修建阿吉拉尔镇作为回应。曾帮着修建这座镇子的军事首领特波拉卡，于1652年在帕皮戈奇谷领导了规模更大的起义；王室军队将起义镇压，1653年3月4日，特波拉卡被绞死在托莫奇最高的松树上。高山上的族人把神父和移民挡在山外，直到耶稣会士多年后返回、为数千人施洗；17世纪末最后一次战争仍告失败，但高高的群山从未被真正征服。1767年耶稣会被驱逐后，方济各会无力维持传教站，拉拉穆里人退入更深的峡谷；1821年，他们的群山成为墨西哥的一部分。

en:
The Náayeri, whom the Spaniards called the Cora, held the Sierra del Nayar, a knot of gorges and flat-topped mesas between the Pacific plain and the central plateau of Mexico. In scattered ranchos they grew maize, beans and amaranth and answered to no outside lord; the Muutzisti, Teacuacitzti and Ateacari, three kindred tribes, lived by their own laws on the northern edge of Mesoamerica. In 1444 no Spanish soldier had entered their gorges, and the trade roads kept to the lowlands below the mountains.

Popular tradition dates the kingdom of Huacica, also called Xécora, to 1493, when Na'ayarij united the three tribes and set his capital at Sacaymuta. When Nuño de Guzmán's conquistadores pushed into Nueva Galicia in the early 1530s, Na'ayarij beat them in several fights and in 1536 sealed an alliance with the Huichol king Goaxicar; he even accepted baptism, but the mountain kingdom kept its freedom. For nearly two hundred years no mine, hacienda or mission took root in the sierra, while Na'ayarij's successors raided the frontier towns of Acaponeta, Aztatlán and Sentispac below. The fifth and last king was Tonati. A Spanish expedition failed against him in 1716, and in 1720 he met the viceroy Baltasar de Zúñiga in person: offered the right to buy salt at Mexcaltitán if his people laid down their arms, Tonati refused and made Tlahuitole captain of the Cora and Huichol armies. The Spaniards came back in force in 1722. At the Mesa del Nayar the native army was broken and Tlahuitole killed, and Tonati was carried off to prison in Guadalajara, where he died in 1725. Friars and missions entered the sierra at last, though the old rites continued beneath the new faith. The mountains passed with New Spain into independent Mexico in 1821.
zh:
纳亚里人（西班牙人称之为科拉人）据有奈亚尔山区，那是横亘在太平洋沿岸平原与墨西哥中央高原之间的一片峡谷交错、高台壁立的山地。他们在分散的村落里种植玉米、菜豆和苋米，不认任何外来君长；穆齐斯蒂、特阿夸齐斯特和阿特阿卡利三个同源部落各按自己的古老规矩生活，地处美索亚美利加的北缘。1444年，还没有西班牙兵进入他们的峡谷，商路也只走山下的低地。

按民间口传，瓦西卡王国（又称塞科拉）始于1493年：纳亚里统一三个部落，定都萨凯穆塔。1530年代初，努尼奥·德·古斯曼的征服者队伍攻入新加利西亚，纳亚里数战皆胜，又在1536年与维乔尔人的国王戈阿西卡尔结盟；他本人甚至接受了洗礼，山中的王国却保住了自由。此后近两百年，矿场、庄园和传教站无一能在山区扎根，纳亚里的后继诸王不时下山袭掠阿卡波内塔、阿斯特兰和森蒂斯帕克等边镇。第五代、也是末代国王是托纳蒂。1716年一支西班牙远征队败于他手；1720年他亲自会见总督巴尔塔萨尔·德·苏尼加，对方许诺只要放下武器就可在梅斯卡尔蒂坦购盐，托纳蒂拒绝，随后任命特拉维托莱为科拉—维乔尔联军的统帅。1722年西班牙人大举重来，奈亚尔台地一役土著军队被击溃，特拉维托莱战死，托纳蒂被押往瓜达拉哈拉的监狱，1725年死于狱中。修士和传教站这才进入山区，但古老的仪式在新信仰之下延续。1821年，这片群山随新西班牙并入独立的墨西哥。

en:
The Acaxee held the gorges and pine ridges east of Culiacán, a sierra the Spaniards called Topia, running some two hundred kilometres through what is now eastern Sinaloa and western Durango. Around 1444 perhaps twenty thousand of them lived in small independent chiefdoms of farmsteads set far apart. They were sedentary farmers of maize, beans, squash, chile and cotton who hunted and fished wherever the steep slopes gave poor harvests; each extended family followed its elders and chose a war leader only in danger. They fought the Xixime to the south and the Tepehuán beyond the eastern ranges year after year, and Spanish chroniclers later accused them of eating foes taken in battle, a charge never proven. No outsider ruled their canyons.

The first Spanish foothold was the mining town of Topia, founded in 1564, and the rich silver veins struck in the 1580s drew encomenderos with slaves and forced Acaxee labour. Disease and the mines had cut the people to a few thousand by the end of the century. In 1600 the Jesuit Hernando de Santarén toured the sierra with Captain Diego de Ávila, resettling villagers into mission towns, burning their idols and cutting their hair. In December 1601 an elder named Perico raised the people, mixing Christian and native promises of deliverance: within weeks some fifty Spaniards were dead, the mining camps and forty churches burned, and forty settlers were trapped in the church at San Andrés until relief arrived from Durango. The mines stood idle for two years, until a Spanish army with Indian allies broke the rising in 1603 and executed Perico with forty-eight war leaders, selling the survivors into slavery. Smallpox carried off most of the remnant, and a few last fighters joined the Tepehuán revolt in 1616, after which the Acaxee vanish as a named people, their mountains left to missions, haciendas and the silver mines of Nueva Vizcaya.
zh:
阿卡塞人据有库利亚坎以东的峡谷与松脊，这片被西班牙人称作托皮亚的山地纵长约两百公里，纵贯今锡那罗亚东部和杜兰戈西部。1444年前后，约两万阿卡塞人分属许多彼此独立的小酋邦，农舍相隔很远。他们是定居农人，种玉米、菜豆、南瓜、辣椒和棉花，陡坡收成不足处便靠渔猎贴补；各大家族平日听从长老，遇有危险才共举首领。他们长年与南边的希希梅人、东山岭外的特佩瓦人交战，西班牙编年史家后来指控他们食用战场上的敌尸，此说始终没有证据。那时没有外人统治他们的峡谷。

西班牙人的第一个据点是1564年建立的矿业城镇托皮亚，1580年代打到的富银矿引来监护主，以及奴隶和被迫下矿的阿卡塞劳工。到世纪末，疾病和矿场已使人口减至数千。1600年，耶稣会士埃尔南多·德·桑塔伦偕队长迭戈·德·阿维拉巡视山区，把村民迁入传教村镇，焚毁神像、剃去长发。1601年12月，一位名叫佩里科的长老率众起事，把天主教与本土的得救许诺混在一起：几周之内约五十名西班牙人被杀，矿营和四十座教堂被焚，四十名殖民者困守圣安德烈斯的教堂，直到杜兰戈的援军赶到。银矿停采两年，1603年西班牙军队及其印第安盟友才将起义镇压，佩里科和四十八名军事首领被处死，幸存者卖为奴隶。天花随后带走了大部分残余部众，少数最后的战士参加了1616年的特佩瓦起义；此后阿卡塞人作为一个有名号的族群从记载中消失，群山留给了传教站、庄园和新比斯开亚的银矿。

en:
The Mayo, who call themselves Yoreme, farmed the hot coastal plain between the Mayo and Fuerte rivers on the Gulf of California. Seasonal floods watered their maize fields, the shallows gave fish, and their villages stood thick along the banks. Their Cahita speech was close to that of the Yaqui, and the river towns traded and intermarried with their Yaqui kinsmen upstream and fought beside them against outsiders, whom the Yoreme called yori, 'he who does not respect'. In 1444 the valley answered to no empire in central Mexico: its life ran on the river, the rains and the fishing coast.

Diego de Guzmán made the first recorded Spanish contact in 1533, but the river towns kept their arms and their autonomy for two generations even after the Spanish built the fort of El Fuerte on the Fuerte in 1584. Diego Martínez de Hurdaide's campaigns broke that resistance, and the Yoreme submitted to the Crown in 1599; the Jesuit Pedro Méndez then gathered them into mission towns such as Navojoa and Santa Cruz del Mayo. In 1740 the Mayo joined the great Yaqui rising led by Juan Calixto, which swept the Cahita country before Spanish troops crushed it. When Charles III expelled the Jesuits in 1767, Franciscan and secular clergy took over the missions. The river towns saw little of the independence fighting, and passed with New Spain into Mexico in 1821.
zh:
马约人自称约雷梅，耕种马约河与富埃尔特河之间临加利福尼亚湾的炎热平原。季节性洪水浇灌玉米地，海湾浅滩出产鱼鲜，河畔村落密布。他们的卡伊塔语与亚基语相近，河畔村镇同上游的亚基亲族贸易通婚，也和他们并肩抵御外来者；约雷梅把外人称作约里，意思是「不敬重传统的人」。1444年，墨西哥中部没有任何帝国能号令这片谷地，这里的日子跟着河流、雨水和捕鱼海岸走。

迭戈·德·古斯曼1533年留下有记载的首次西班牙接触，但即使西班牙人1584年在富埃尔特河畔筑起要塞，河畔村镇仍在两代人的时间里保住了武器和自治。迭戈·马丁内斯·德·乌尔戴德的征伐打破了这种局面，约雷梅人于1599年向西班牙王室臣服；耶稣会士佩德罗·门德斯随后把他们并入纳沃华、马约河圣克鲁斯等传教村。1740年，马约人加入胡安·卡利斯托领导的亚基人大起事，烽火席卷卡伊塔地区，最终被西班牙军队镇压。卡洛斯三世1767年驱逐耶稣会，方济各会士和世俗教士接管了传教区。河畔各镇很少卷入独立战争的战火，1821年随新西班牙并入墨西哥。

en:
The Opatería, the Opata country, covered the river valleys running from the Sonora River to the western canyons of the Sierra Madre Occidental. At Spanish contact the Opata were the most numerous people in Sonora, and their independent statelets were chains of agricultural towns on the Sonora, Moctezuma, Bavispe and Aros rivers: a central town of two- and three-storey adobe houses, satellite hamlets around it, and canal-watered fields of maize, beans, squash and cotton. Opata traders carried maize and cotton blankets to the Zuni and Concho countries and brought back turquoise, and their spear points were hammered from local iron ore; Opata oral tradition derives the people's name from that metal, reading it as 'iron people'. The Jova in the rugged eastern hills lived more by hunting and gathering. In 1444 the valley towns governed themselves and had no ties to the empires of central Mexico.

Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca crossed the country in 1538 and named one valley town Corazones. Francisco Vázquez de Coronado garrisoned San Jerónimo de los Corazones on his march north in 1540; the Opata burned the post within the year after the abuses of his officer Alcaraz, and fierce resistance checked Francisco de Ibarra in turn in 1565. Epidemics thinned the towns before Jesuits under Pedro Méndez opened missions in 1628, twenty-two of them by 1688. Many Opata then served the Crown as soldiers against the Apache, but forced mine labour and land seizures drew them into the native rising led by Juan Calixto in 1740.

The frontier town of Arizpe became capital of Sonora in 1778 and later seat of its bishopric. Juan Bautista de Anza, born at Fronteras near Arizpe, opened the overland road from Sonora to Alta California and in 1776 marked out the sites of the presidio and mission of San Francisco; after governing New Mexico he died at Arizpe in 1788 and was buried in its parish church. In 1820 the Opata military company at Bavispe revolted, and Sahuaripa, Arivechi and Tonichi joined before royal troops defeated them and executed the leaders Dorame and Espíritu on the eve of Mexican independence in 1821.
zh:
奥帕塔人之地称奥帕塔里亚，覆盖从索诺拉河到西马德雷山脉西缘峡谷的一条条河谷。与西班牙人接触之初，奥帕塔是索诺拉人口最多的族群；他们各自独立的小邦是沿索诺拉河、蒙特苏马河、巴维斯佩河和阿罗斯河分布的一连串农业城镇：中心城镇有两三层高的土坯房，周围散布卫星村落和引渠灌溉的田地，种玉米、豆类、南瓜和棉花。奥帕塔商人把玉米和棉毯带到祖尼人、孔乔人那里，换回绿松石；他们的矛头用本地铁矿石打制，奥帕塔口述传统也据此把族名解作「铁人」。东部崎岖山地的霍瓦人更多靠狩猎采集为生。1444年，这些河谷城镇自行治理，与墨西哥中部诸帝国没有往来。

阿尔瓦·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德·巴卡1538年经过此地，把一座河谷城镇命名为科拉索内斯。1540年，弗朗西斯科·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多北上途中在圣赫罗尼莫·德·洛斯科拉索内斯驻兵；他的军官阿尔卡拉斯虐待当地人，奥帕塔人不出一年便烧毁据点，1565年又以顽强抵抗挡住弗朗西斯科·德·伊瓦拉。疫病使各城镇人口锐减，此后佩德罗·门德斯率领的耶稣会士于1628年开始建立传教区，到1688年已有二十二处。许多奥帕塔人随后为西班牙王室当兵，同阿帕奇人作战，但强制矿役和土地掠夺仍把他们逼进1740年胡安·卡利斯托领导的原住民大起事。

边陲小镇阿里斯佩1778年成为索诺拉首府，后来又成为主教驻地。胡安·鲍提斯塔·德·安萨出生在阿里斯佩附近的弗龙特拉斯，他开辟了从索诺拉通往上加利福尼亚的陆路，1776年亲自选定圣弗朗西斯科要塞和传教站的地址；担任新墨西哥总督之后，他1788年在阿里斯佩去世，葬于当地堂区教堂。1820年，奥帕塔人在巴维斯佩的民兵连起兵，萨瓦里帕、阿里韦奇和托尼奇相继响应，最终被王军击败，首领多拉梅和埃斯皮里图在1821年墨西哥独立前夕被处决。

en:
Tsushima is a chain of mountainous islands in the Korea Strait, lying about halfway between Kyushu and the Korean peninsula. Its fields were too few and thin to feed the islanders on rice, and they fished the strait and sailed north and south to buy grain, as a third-century Chinese account already records. The Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281 struck Tsushima before Kyushu: the local commander So Sukekuni was killed in the fighting and the islands were briefly occupied. The So clan then made its home here and turned sea power into diplomacy. A Joseon army landed in 1419 to suppress wokou and withdrew after a month of fighting, and in 1443 So Sadamori concluded the Gyehae agreement, pledging to curb the pirates in return for a near-monopoly of Japanese trade with Busan. In 1444 Tsushima was therefore a fortified sea frontier whose lords lived by the Korean trade rather than their own soil.

That trade kept drawing Tsushima into Korean disorders. When Japanese residents rose at the Three Ports in the Sampo disturbance of 1510, a So relief force was beaten and the residents expelled, and relations were not restored until 1512; an agreement in 1547 confined the trade to Busan and the clan to twenty ships a year. In 1592 the So tried in vain to head off Hideyoshi's invasion of Korea, and during the war Tsushima served as the relay between Busan and the Nagoya headquarters in Hizen. Although the clan joined the western army at Sekigahara in 1600, Ieyasu confirmed its domain, rated at 100,000 koku though its rice crop came to less than 30,000, because he needed its Korean channel. Even under the seclusion laws the So kept their trading house at Busan, guided the Joseon embassies to Edo and handled the shogunate's Korean correspondence, some of it forged until the Yanagawa affair exposed the practice. The Confucian scholar Amenomori Hoshu, fluent in Chinese and Korean and ranked with Arai Hakuseki among Kinoshita Jun'an's ten foremost pupils, spent his career in the domain's Korean service.
zh:
对马是朝鲜海峡中一串多山岛屿，大致位于九州与朝鲜半岛中间。岛上耕地稀少贫瘠，居民一向靠海峡渔业为生，还乘船南北往返购粮，3世纪的中国史书《魏志倭人传》已有这样的记载。1274年和1281年元军两次侵日，都先攻对马：当地将领宗助国迎战阵亡，岛屿一度被占。宗氏随后在岛上立足，把海上力量转化为外交资本。1419年，朝鲜为镇压倭寇派大军登陆，交战一个月后撤退；宗贞盛又在1443年与朝鲜订立嘉吉条约，承诺约束海盗，换取日本对釜山贸易的近乎独占。因此1444年的对马虽是设防海疆，宗氏的生计却系于对朝贸易而非岛上田土。

这条贸易线也一再把对马卷入朝鲜的动荡。1510年，居留三浦的日本人起事，是为三浦之乱；宗氏援军战败，日侨被逐，双方往来直到1512年才恢复。1547年的约定又把贸易限定在釜山，宗氏每年只准派船二十艘。1592年，宗氏试图阻止丰臣秀吉侵朝未果，开战后对马成了釜山与肥前名护屋大本营之间的中继地。1600年关原之战宗氏虽加入西军，德川家康仍承认其领地，按十万石格定级，尽管其实际稻米产出不足三万石，为的是借重宗氏的对朝渠道。锁国之后，宗氏照旧在釜山经营倭馆，引导朝鲜通信使前往江户，承办幕府的对朝文书，其中有些国书经过篡改，直到柳川一件才败露。儒者雨森芳洲通晓汉语和朝鲜语，与新井白石同列木下顺庵门下「十哲」，一生在对马藩的对朝交涉机构任职。

en:
Haicheng lies behind the head of Liaodong Bay, where the Liao River winds through reed marshes into the Bohai Sea. Downstream at Niuzhuang the river reached the sea in Liao and Jin times, and cargo boats called niuzi crowded the anchorage so thickly that the place took its name from them. In 1376 the Ming sited the Haizhou Guard on the old Linming county ground near Niuzhuang under the Liaodong Regional Military Commission at Liaoyang. In 1444 it was a country of guard camps and fishing harbours, and the Liao mouth was one of the few links between inland Manchuria and the sea.

The guard submitted to the Later Jin with Liaoyang in 1621. The future Pingnan Prince Shang Kexi was born in the Haizhou Guard in 1604. He rode with Mao Wenlong's Dongjiang army, where his father was killed in the fighting, and in 1634 he crossed to the Later Jin with his men, a year after the Gaizhou officers Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming had done the same. Made Pingnan Prince in 1649, he led the Qing conquest of Guangdong and held Guangzhou through the feudatories' revolt, loyal to the court while rebel forces overran the province; in 1676 his son Shang Zhixin rose for Wu Sangui and confined him in his mansion, and he died the same year.

In 1644 Niuzhuang became one of nine banner garrison posts founded beyond Shanhai Pass, its city-officer controlling the shipping lanes of the Liao and Taizi and the ports at their mouth; nine years later the old Haizhou guard became Haicheng County. Grain from the Liao valley went out through those ports, and by 1817 the Mogouying anchorage under the Niuzhuang garrison shipped 400,000 to 500,000 shi of grain a year, more than any other seaport in Liaodong.
zh:
海城位于辽东湾湾顶内侧，辽河穿过芦荡蜿蜒注入渤海。下游的牛庄一带，辽金时辽河在附近入海，叫做「牛子」的商船云集停泊，牛庄也因这些牛子船得名。1376年，明朝在牛庄附近的旧临溟县地设置海州卫，归驻辽阳的辽东都指挥使司节制。1444年，这里遍布卫城与渔港，辽河入海口是辽东腹地通往海上为数不多的通道。

1621年辽阳失守，海州卫随入后金。后来的平南王尚可喜1604年就出生在海州卫。他随毛文龙的东江军征战，父亲也在军中战死；1634年，他率部渡海归降后金，比盖州籍将领孔有德、耿仲明晚了一年。1649年受封平南王后，他领兵打下广东，镇守广州；三藩之乱时他忠于清廷，1676年其子尚之信发兵响应吴三桂，把他困在府中，他同年死去。

1644年，牛庄成为关外最早设立的九处八旗城守官驻地之一，城守官管辖辽河、太子河的航道和入海口各码头；九年后海州改置海城县。辽河流域的粮米顺河运到海口，到1817年，归牛庄驻防管辖的没沟营口岸每年输出粮食四五十万石，为辽东各海口之冠。

en:
The wooded valley of the Tumen, east of the Changbai, was the country of the Maolian Jurchens; 'maolian' meant 'horse' in their language. They came of the same Hurga stock as the Jianzhou and were long joined by marriage and alliance, and the Maolian Guard with the Jianzhou Guard made up the main body of the Jianzhou Jurchens. In 1405 their chief Ba'ersun travelled to the Ming court with sixty-four clansmen and received the guard seal. Korea killed him in 1410, and the next year the Ming gave the guard to Mengge Buhua of the Jianzhou chief's house. Korea's campaign up the Pozhu River in 1433 broke the Jurchen guards of the lower Tumen and took their settlements, and many survivors followed Li Manzhu west to the Hun River. In 1444 the old Maolian lands were half-emptied country, the clans left along the river living as 'submitted barbarians' on Korea's border while Jianzhou still claimed them as kin.

The remnant clans came to be called the Warka, pressed between Korea, the Ula and the rising Jianzhou. In 1607 Cemuhe, lord of Feiyou on the Tumen, offered his city to Nurhaci, who sent his brother Šurhaci with an army to bring the people away. Ula troops sent to stop them were routed at Wujieyan near Korean Jongseong, their commander Bokdo killed, and the Ula gave up the Tumen valley. Over the following decades the Warka clans were enrolled in the Eight Banners. Under the Qing the country became a closed imperial reserve for ginseng and sable; from 1653 it was governed from Ningguta, and in 1714 an assistant commandant was posted at Hunchun to watch the Tumen line, his walled town begun the following year.
zh:
长白山以东、图们江两岸的林海，是毛怜女真人的故土，「毛怜」在女真语中意为「马」。他们与建州同出胡里改部，世代通婚结盟，毛怜卫与建州卫同为建州女真的主体。1405年，其首领把儿逊率六十四人入朝，明廷设毛怜卫，赐以诰印；1410年把儿逊被朝鲜所杀，次年明廷改以建州酋长世家的猛哥不花领卫事。1433年，朝鲜发动婆猪江之战，图们江下游的女真卫所被摧毁、定居点被占，残余部众随李满住西迁浑河流域。1444年的毛怜旧地人烟稀少，留在图们江沿岸的各部作为「藩胡」住在朝鲜边境，建州则仍以宗亲之名声称管辖他们。

这些遗部后来被称为瓦尔喀，夹在朝鲜、乌拉与兴起的建州之间。1607年，图们江畔蜚优城主策穆特黑举城投靠努尔哈赤，努尔哈赤派弟弟舒尔哈齐带兵前往接人。乌拉出兵截击，在朝鲜钟城附近的乌碣岩被建州军击败，主帅博克多阵亡，乌拉势力就此退出图们江流域。此后数十年间，瓦尔喀各部陆续被编入八旗。入清以后，这片地方划为封禁的皇家采参、猎貂之地，1653年起归宁古塔昂邦章京统辖；1714年，清廷在珲春设置协领，戍守图们江一线，协领衙门和城垣次年动工。

en:
The Fuerhe is forest country of the northern Changbai, where the Mudan and the Erdao Songhua rise among wooded ridges. The river takes its name from the Manchu word for poplar, after the tall stands on its banks. Around 698 Da Zuorong built his first capital at Aodong on the upper Mudan, and the Balhae court stayed there for fifty-seven years before moving south. After the Khitan overthrew Balhae in 926 the country became Jurchen hunting ground, and under the Ming it was counted among the lands of the Jianzhou Guard. When the Jianzhou clans drifted southwest to the Hun and Susu valleys in the 1430s, the woods swallowed their old trails: in 1444 only scattered bands wintered here, living on ginseng, sable and timber, with no walled town in the province.

Nurhaci drew these highland bands into his new order during his unification of the Jianzhou, from his first campaign in 1583 to the taking of the Wanggiya in 1588. After the Qing entered China the Changbai became a forbidden mountain. In 1677 the Kangxi Emperor sent the inner grandees Wumuna and Feiyaose to offer sacrifice there, and in 1678 Changbai was enfeoffed as a mountain god with rites equal to the Five Sacred Peaks, sacrificed to twice a year. The upper valleys were then sealed for two centuries as the dynasty's dragon-vein ground; licensed parties sent out from Ningguta came into these woods to dig ginseng and trap sable, and at Ningguta downstream the Qing ran a great boatyard, building vessels for the Mudan, Sungari and Amur. In 1709 Jesuits on the imperial survey entered these forests with a government ginseng party, and in 1821 the province was still sealed woodland without a town or a county seat.
zh:
富尔河是长白山北麓的林海之地，牡丹江与二道松花江都发源于这一带的山岭之间。河名得自满语「富尔」，意为杨树，因两岸昔日白杨成林而得名。698年前后，大祚荣在牡丹江上游修筑敖东城作为渤海国的第一个都城，渤海朝廷在此驻了五十七年才南迁。926年契丹灭渤海，此地重归女真人的猎场，明代被划入建州卫之地。1430年代建州各部陆续向西南迁到浑河、苏子河流域，旧日的山道重新没入林海：1444年的这里只有零星部众过冬，以采参、猎貂和采伐为生，全境没有一座城寨。

努尔哈赤统一建州期间，自1583年起兵到1588年攻克完颜城，山地间的这些部众也被卷入他的新秩序。清朝入关之后，长白山成了封禁之山。1677年，康熙帝派内大臣武默纳、费耀色前往拜谒，1678年册封长白山之神，祀典与五岳相同，每年春秋两祭。这片上游河谷随后被封禁两百年，作为王朝的龙脉所在：持照的刨夫从宁古塔进山采参猎貂；下游的宁古塔设有清朝的大船厂，为牡丹江、松花江和黑龙江水系造船。1709年，参与官方测绘的耶稣会士随皇家采参队进入这片森林；1821年，这里仍是封禁的林海，没有城镇，也没有设治。

en:
Shilimian is the high forest of the Sikhote-Alin, the wooded ridge between the Ussuri and the Sea of Japan, where interior streams gather under Korean pine and spruce. Its camps belong to Udeghe hunters, the people Jin records called the 'wild Udegei' and the Ming counted among the Wild Jurchen. They follow elk and sable through the timber and dig ginseng on the shaded slopes, and their mountains supplied the gyrfalcons Yuan parties came to collect until the Woji rose against the exactions in 1343 and again in 1346. The Ming set up the Shilimian guard over the Suifen and Ussuri clans in 1405 and ruled through patents inherited by their headmen. In 1444, with the Nurgan commission gone, no clerk visits the mountains and the patents are family heirlooms.

Headmen still asked Beijing to confirm those patents for generations; the last recorded request to inherit the guard office reached the throne in 1566. In November 1614 a Later Jin force of five hundred struck the Yalan and Xilin roads on the seaward slope of these mountains, received the submission of two hundred households and took a thousand captives. The Qing put no garrison in the highlands, confirming Kiyakara and Udeghe headmen instead: every two years they carried sable rolls to Sanxing and came back with the imperial 'forest bounty' of cloth and silk. Through 1821 the ridges held neither walled town nor ploughed field, only camps moving after elk and sable.
zh:
失里绵是锡霍特山脉主脊上的高山林地，处在乌苏里江与日本海之间，山溪在红松和云杉林下汇流。林中营地住的是乌德盖猎人，金朝史籍称他们为「野人兀的改」，明朝将其归入野人女真。他们在密林中游猎马鹿和紫貂，在背阴坡挖掘人参；元朝不断派人进山征收海东青和紫貂，吾者野人不堪征索，于1343年、1346年两度起兵反元。1405年，明朝在绥芬河与乌苏里江一带的部族中设失里绵卫，靠头人世袭的敕书统治。1444年，奴儿干都司已撤销，再没有书吏进山，敕书成了头人家里的传代之物。

此后很久，头人仍凭敕书向朝廷请袭，最后一次见于1566年。1614年十一月，后金五百人的队伍进攻这片山地靠海一侧的雅兰、锡林二路，收降二百户，俘获千人。清朝不在高地驻军，只确认恰喀拉和乌德盖头人的职分：他们每隔两年把成卷的紫貂皮解往三姓，领回朝廷名为「赏乌林」的布匹绸缎。直到1821年，山梁上仍没有城垣和耕地，只有追着马鹿、紫貂迁徙的营地。

en:
Wolanhe is the Samarga, a 218-kilometre river that leaves the eastern face of Mount Kupol in the Sikhote-Alin and runs through a forested trough into the Tatar Strait; its Manchu name Wolan means 'girth', the strap that tightens a saddle. The estuary marks the northern edge of the Udeghe coast, with the Kema river beyond it to the north. Lower-river Udeghe and Oroch coming down from the colder shore spend the autumn at the salmon runs and the winter trapping sable in the cedar shade. The Ming set up the Wolanhe guard here in February 1408 and ruled through patents inherited by headmen; after the Nurgan commission was withdrawn no clerk ever came to inspect them. In 1444 the shore clans live by fish and fur, and Beijing is little more than a name on the patent.

Those patents still had weight long afterwards: the last Wolanhe request to confirm succession reached the capital in 1593. In November 1614 a Later Jin force of five hundred campaigned against the Yalan and Xilin roads inland of this coast, taking a thousand captives and two hundred submitted households. The Qing posted no banner garrison at the river mouth; headmen carried sable to Sanxing every other year and came back with cloth and silk. Europeans first charted this shore in 1787, when Lapérouse's two French frigates sailed north to latitude 51 and mapped the strait between the mainland and Sakhalin. No settlement followed the charts, and in 1821 the clans still came to the Samarga mouth only for the summer fishing.
zh:
斡兰河就是俄国地图上的萨马尔加河，满语称「斡兰」（又作额勒），意为勒紧马鞍的肚带，河因此得名。它发源于锡霍特山脉库波尔山东坡，穿过林莽纵谷，奔流218公里注入鞑靼海峡；河口是乌德盖人滨海分布区的北缘，再往北便是克马河。下游的乌德盖人和从更寒冷的北方海岸南下的奥罗奇人，秋天赶鲑鱼汛，冬天在冷杉林里猎紫貂。明朝1408年二月在此设斡兰河卫，凭头人世袭的敕书统治；奴儿干都司撤销后，再没有书吏前来查验。1444年，河口各部靠鱼和皮毛为生，北京对他们不过是敕书上的一个名字。

敕书在很久以后仍有分量：斡兰河卫最后一次请求袭职的文书1593年才送达京城。1614年十一月，后金五百人的队伍征讨这片海岸内侧的雅兰、锡林二路，俘获千人，收降二百户。清朝不在河口设旗营，头人每隔两年把紫貂皮送往三姓，换回布匹绸缎。1787年，欧洲人首次测绘这段海岸：拉彼鲁兹率两艘法国护卫舰北上至北纬51度，绘下了大陆与库页岛之间的海峡。海图没有带来定居者，1821年时，各部仍只在夏季渔汛时来到萨马尔加河口。

en:
Nanghar takes its name from a Yuan tribute post on northwestern Sakhalin, near Langry on the Strait of Tartary. The strait is shallow here and freezes in winter, when dog-sledges could cross its ice to the Amur estuary. This was Nivkh country. Summer fishing camps faced the coast, and when the salmon ran in winter the families moved up streams to meet them; the catch was sliced and dried in the cold air without salt, and sheds beside the winter huts held sledges, skis, boats and the dogs that pulled them. Nivkh hunters supplied sable furs. Every January or February a clan mourning a kinsman held the Bear Festival: women raised a captured cub for years like a child of the house, feasted it in ceremonial dress and sent it to the mountain gods with gifts before sacrificing it. Nivkh belief made Sakhalin itself a giant beast lying in the water, whose uneasy turns caused earthquakes.

Mongol armies fought on the island from 1264 to 1308 to shield their Nivkh allies from Ainu raiders, and Nanghar afterwards became one of three posts where Ainu elders brought tribute and took gifts, with Wuliehe in the Tym basin and Boluohe on the Poronay. The Yuan withdrew after 1320, and Ming titles from the Nurgan commission followed after 1409, so in 1444 this coast was run by Nivkh clan networks rather than any distant dynasty. That island trade outlasted all the dynastic posts, linking Manchuria, Japan and Kamchatka through Sakhalin into the eighteenth century. In 1643 Vassily Poyarkov, gathering reports at the Amur, became the first Russian writer to describe these people under the Tungus name Gilyak. After the 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk, Qing officers entered the estuary and assessed a sable tribute by clan and village; the 1732 register counted six clans, eighteen village units and 148 households on Sakhalin. In 1787 La Perouse charted the strait and spoke with islanders in its narrow northern waters, and Ivan Kruzenshtern surveyed much of the coast in 1805. In 1808 Japanese expeditions surveyed the northern narrows and confirmed that Sakhalin was an island.
zh:
囊哈儿得名于萨哈林西北部、朗里附近鞑靼海峡沿岸的一处元朝朝贡站点。这一段海峡水浅，冬季封冻，狗橇可以踏着冰面一直走到阿穆尔河口。这里是尼夫赫人的土地。夏季渔营设在海岸，冬季鲑鱼溯流时，全家搬到上游溪边等候；捕来的鱼切成条，就着寒气风干，不加盐；冬屋旁的棚子里放着雪橇、滑雪板和船只，还有拉橇的狗。尼夫赫猎人以紫貂皮供应外来客商。每年一月或二月，有亲属亡故的氏族举办熊祭：妇女把捕来的幼熊当家中孩子一般养上几年，再给熊穿上礼服、设宴饯行，带着礼物送它回到山神那里，然后献祭。在尼夫赫人的观念里，萨哈林本身是一头伏在水中的巨兽，它不安地翻身就引发地震。

1264年至1308年，蒙古为庇护尼夫赫同盟、抵御阿伊努人来袭而多次用兵岛上；战后囊哈儿成为三处朝贡站点之一，阿伊努长老在此进贡方物、领受回赐，另外两处是特姆河流域的兀列河和波罗奈河畔的波罗河。1320年后元朝撤离，1409年后明朝又以奴儿干职衔维系当地，所以1444年时这片海岸由尼夫赫氏族网络自行管理，不受远方王朝节制。海岛贸易比所有王朝站点都长寿，以萨哈林为枢纽连接满洲、日本和堪察加的网络一直维持到18世纪。1643年，瓦西里·波亚尔科夫在阿穆尔河畔收集传闻，成为第一个用通古斯名称「吉利亚克」记载这些居民的俄国人。1689年《尼布楚条约》后，清朝官员进入河口，按氏族和村落征收紫貂贡，1732年的册籍登记了萨哈林岛上的6个氏族、18个村单位和148户人。1787年，拉彼鲁兹测绘鞑靼海峡，在北部窄水附近与岛民交谈；1805年，克鲁森施滕考察了大部分海岸。1808年，日本探险队测绘北部狭窄水道，确认萨哈林是一座岛屿。

en:
Tulutingshan is the Chinese name for the Turan Range, three hundred kilometres of larch and spruce taiga raised above the Zeya and Bureya hunting grounds. The people most at home in these valleys were Solon Evenki, who herded reindeer, camped on the high passes and trapped sable through the long winter. Ming rule over the country went no further than seals and patents granted to local headmen, and after the court pulled its officers back from the Amur the patents were never inspected again. In 1444 the range belonged to the hunters and to the fur trade.

Hong Taiji's armies brought the Solon country to the Qing. Some bands had submitted in 1634, but the Evenk chief Bombogor kept the field with Solon and Daur followers; his five hundred men met two Manchu regiments at the Gualar, and in 1640 the Manchus took four Evenk fortresses, Yakesa among them, and carried off droves of horses, cattle and pelts. Bombogor fled into Mongolia, was run down near Qiluotai and was executed at Mukden. Cossacks out of the Lena reached the Amur in 1643 and demanded sable tribute from the same clans until Albazin fell and the Treaty of Nerchinsk fixed the border in 1689. The Qing then registered the Evenki clans as banner companies, owing a yearly quota of sable pelts and service on the frontier patrols. The high taiga grew no towns through 1821.
zh:
土鲁亭山是图腊纳山的汉名，这条长约三百公里的山岭横在结雅河与布列亚河猎场的上方，满坡落叶松和云杉。最熟悉这些山谷的是索伦鄂温克人，他们牧放驯鹿，在高山隘口扎营，趁漫长的冬天进林捕紫貂。明朝对这里的统治不过是给头人颁发印信敕书，朝廷从黑龙江撤回官员后，敕书再也无人查验。1444年的山岭属于猎人，也属于貂皮生意。

皇太极的军队征服了索伦之地。一些部落1634年已经归附，鄂温克首领博木博果尔仍率索伦、达斡尔部众抵抗，他的五百人与两旗满洲兵交战；1640年，清军连克鄂温克人的四座城寨，雅克萨也在其中，掠走大批马牛和皮货。博木博果尔逃入蒙古，在半途被追上擒获，押往盛京处死。从勒拿河方向来的哥萨克1643年抵达黑龙江，向这些氏族强征貂贡，直到阿尔巴津陷落、1689年《尼布楚条约》划定边界。清朝随后把鄂温克氏族编入佐领，每年按额交纳貂皮、服役巡边。直到1821年，高山泰加林里也没有立起城镇。

en:
Tunhe is the valley of the Tangwang, the Jin-dynasty Tun river, which gathers the streams of the Xiao Hinggan forests and runs south some five hundred li into the Songhua above Yilan. At its mouth stood the walled town of Punuli, one of the Five Nations of the raw Jurchen, on the Liao 'falcon road' that carried gyrfalcons and sable to the Khitan court. Under the Jin the same town was the Tunhe moung-an, and under the Mongols the Taowen myriarchy, one of the five Jurchen myriarchies of the lower Sungari; its earthworks have yielded Liao, Jin, Yuan, Ming and Qing finds in turn, rare for a site on the Amur. Ming maps called the water the Tuowan and set a loose-reign guard there, the Chengtaowen, with a post station on the river road to Nurgan.

By the 1440s the guard had lapsed. Two sister myriarchies, the Hurka under Ahacu and the Odoli under Möngke Temür, had moved southeast to become the Jianzhou guards, from whom Nurhaci and his Later Jin came, and the Taowen townspeople scattered into the south-moving clans; only fishing and herding Jurchen stockades remained along the banks. For the rest of the period the valley was a Qing sealed hunting ground, its ginseng and sable a banner reserve. The old city dwindled to the fishing village of Boorha, with no garrison or magistrate placed on the river, and in 1821 the Tun still flowed through empty forest without a walled town.
zh:
屯河即今汤旺河，金代正名屯河，又叫涛温水，汇小兴安岭诸溪南流五百里，在汤原汇入松花江。河口的双河古城，本是辽代生女真五国部之一盆奴里的城寨，正当辽国索取海东青、貂皮的「鹰路」之上。金代在这里设屯河猛安，元代又置桃温军民万户府，为松花江下游五个女真万户府之一；同一道城垣里先后出土辽、金、元、明、清各代遗物，这在黑龙江流域很少见。明代河名写作托温江，旧城设羁縻的成讨温卫，还是通往奴儿干的海西东水陆城道上的托温城站。

到1440年代，卫所已经名存实亡。与它并列的胡里改、斡朵里两个万户府，已在阿哈出、猛哥帖木儿率领下东南迁走，后来建成建州三卫，努尔哈赤和他的后金就出在这一支；桃温旧城的部众离散南下，河谷两岸只剩打鱼放牧的女真木寨。清代这里始终是封禁的猎场，山中的人参与貂皮都是旗内的采捕之利，旧城退化成名叫布尔和噶珊的渔村，河边不设官、不驻兵。1821年时，屯河仍在空旷的林莽中流淌，河畔没有一座城。

en:
Edala takes its name from the Tala, the 'open field' river of the Manchu gazetteers, which winds through wooded hills southwest of Ningguta, between the Zhangguangcai ridges and the upper Mudan. In 1407 the Ming created the Dala River Guard for the Jurchen clans of this valley, one of the loose jimi guards posted between the Sungari and the Eastern Sea. They raised millet in the river bottoms, hunted sable and gathered ginseng in the surrounding woj, the great forests, and carried their pelts to the Ming border markets. In 1444 their chiefs held Ming patents, but the clans looked to the Hūlun confederation on the middle Sungari, the line that later produced the kingdom of Ula.

Buyan took the title beile and founded Ula in 1561, and within two generations it was one of the four great Hūlun states, with the Tala country under its rule. The valley's fate was settled by Ula's wars with Nurhaci of Jianzhou. In 1593 the Yehe gathered a nine-tribe host against him and were broken at Gure; Bujantai, the prince of Ula, was captured and spent three years among the Jianzhou before Nurhaci sealed the peace with marriages and sent him home to rule. Bujantai then took the title khan and leagued with the Yehe and the Mongols. After a second defeat at Wujieyan in 1607, Nurhaci marched thirty thousand men against Ula in 1613, scattered its army and destroyed the state; Bujantai fled to the Yehe and died there in 1618. The Tala valley passed to the Later Jin and then to the Qing. After the Ningguta military governor moved his seat to Jilin in 1676, the old track through these hills became a post road: Tala Station above Tala Lake and Emuhesoluo farther west linked the two garrison towns, and station farms grew grain for the banners. In 1821 nothing in the valley was larger than a posting station.
zh:
答剌河在清代官书中改译为塔拉河，满语意为「旷野」，河水穿行在宁古塔西南、张广才岭与牡丹江上游之间的山林里。1407年，明廷为这一河谷的女真各部设立答剌河卫，它是松花江与东海之间众多羁縻卫所中的一个。部众在河谷底部种黍，进「窝集」大森林猎貂采参，再把皮张拿到明朝边市上交易。1444年时，各部首领虽持有明朝敕书，真正追随的却是松花江中上游的扈伦联盟，日后的乌拉国就出自这一系。

1561年布颜称贝勒、建立乌拉国，经两代经营成为扈伦四部之一，塔拉一带也受它统属。决定这片河谷归属的是乌拉与建州努尔哈赤的战争。1593年，叶赫纠合九部联军来攻，在古勒山被击溃，乌拉贝勒布占泰被俘，留居建州三年；努尔哈赤以和亲笼络，护送他回乌拉继位。布占泰回国后称汗，又与叶赫和蒙古结盟。1607年乌碣岩再败之后，努尔哈赤于1613年亲率三万大军攻灭乌拉，打散其军，布占泰投奔叶赫，1618年死在那里。塔拉河谷归入后金，随后纳入清朝。1676年宁古塔将军移治吉林后，穿过这片山林的旧道改成驿路：塔拉泡上方的塔拉站和更西边的额穆赫索罗站把两座驻防城连在一起，站丁的官庄为八旗种粮。到1821年，谷中最大的聚落仍不过是一处驿站。

en:
Halacha, also written Sahalcha, was the Manchu name for the lower Zeya, the black-sable country; the pelt gave the place its name, but the valley's wealth came as much from its fields. In 1444 the Guobule, Dedule and other Daur clans ploughed the river lowlands and ran herds of horses and cattle, their walled villages lying between the Solon hunting grounds and the Amur. Their headmen held Ming patents and carried sable, grain and livestock into the tribute trade; no Chinese garrison sat on the river.

The Daur had fought in Bombogor's Evenk-Daur federation, which Hong Taiji's campaigns of 1639-1640 broke before the next invaders came. When the Cossacks pushed down the Amur for grain and fur tribute, these were the first ploughed fields they had seen. Poyarkov reached the Zeya in 1643; Khabarov's men later ordered the Daur villages to submit to the tsar and were told the villagers already paid tribute to the Shunzhi emperor. Town after town was stormed, the farmers burning their smaller settlements and falling back on the larger ones; at one Daur prince's town on the Amur Khabarov reported 661 of his enemies killed. Between 1654 and 1656 the Qing moved the survivors south to the Nen River and their old villages stood empty. The lower Zeya later fed the Qing armies mustering at Aigun against Albazin, and after 1689 it stayed a thinly held border country without a town.
zh:
哈剌察又作萨哈尔察，是满语对精奇里江下游的称呼，意为「黑貂」；地名来自貂皮，河谷的家底却有一半在农田。1444年，郭布勒、德都勒等达斡尔氏族在河畔低地耕种，牧放马牛，带围墙的村落夹在索伦猎场和黑龙江之间。头人持有明朝敕书，把貂皮、粮食和牲畜送入朝贡之路，河畔没有汉军戍堡。

达斡尔人曾随博木博果尔的鄂温克、达斡尔联盟作战，联盟在1639年至1640年被皇太极击垮。哥萨克顺黑龙江而下寻找粮食和贡物时，最先遇到的耕地就在这里。波雅尔科夫1643年抵达结雅河；哈巴罗夫的人后来命令达斡尔村落向沙皇臣服，得到的回答是，他们已经向顺治皇帝纳贡。城寨一座座被攻下，农人往往先烧掉小村、退入大城；在黑龙江畔一位头人的城寨，按哈巴罗夫自己的报告，被杀的达斡尔人有六百六十一人。1654年至1656年，清廷把幸存的达斡尔人南迁嫩江，旧日村落空无一人。结雅河下游后来为在瑷珲集结、围攻阿尔巴津的清军供给粮秣，1689年后仍是控制稀疏的边疆，没有城镇。

en:
Hurha is the forest country of the Muling River, between the Wanda Hills and the Ussuri lowlands north of Lake Khanka. In 1444 there were no walled towns, only scattered Jurchen bands who farmed a little, hunted elk and deer and dug ginseng. Sable pelts and ginseng roots went west through headmen who controlled the hunting paths, and came back as grain and iron. The Ming claimed the region only through the nominal guards of the Nurgan system; Chinese writers classed these Ussuri bands among the Wild Jurchens, and early Manchu records use Hurha or Kurka as names for the eastern forest groups.

Between 1596 and 1625 Nurhaci's Jianzhou armies campaigned through these woods again and again. Defeated bands were moved south or enrolled in the banners, and the Ussuri country passed under Manchu rule. After the Qing entered China the dynasty closed the region as a reserved homeland, barred ordinary settlers, and governed it from Ningguta on the Mudan River, garrisoned from 1652 and made a military governorship in 1662. Ningguta became the most feared place of Qing exile for political criminals: Zheng Zhilong, father of Koxinga, and the poet Wu Zhaoqian, condemned in the examination scandal of 1657, were both sent north to its snows. A few ginseng diggers and squatters aside, the Hurha country in 1821 remained a thinly held forest frontier.
zh:
虎尔哈是穆棱河流域的林地区，在完达山与兴凯湖以北的乌苏里江低地之间。1444年这里没有城郭，只有分散的女真群落，他们少量耕种，猎捕驼鹿和野鹿，进山采参。紫貂皮和人参经把持猎道的头人向西运出，换回粮食和铁器。明朝只以奴儿干都司名下的羁縻卫所遥领这一地区，汉文文献把乌苏里江诸部笼统归入野人女真，清初满文记录则以虎尔哈、库尔喀作为这些东海森林部落的称呼。

1596至1625年间，努尔哈赤的建州军队一再深入这片森林。被击败的部众或南迁，或编入八旗，乌苏里江地区就此归入满洲统治。清朝入关后将此地封禁为保留的故土，禁止普通民人迁入，由牡丹江边的宁古塔统辖，清军1652年起驻防，1662年改设宁古塔将军。宁古塔也是清初发配重犯最令人畏惧的去处：国姓爷郑成功之父郑芝龙、1657年科场案获罪的诗人吴兆骞，都被发往这片冰天雪地。除了零星的采参人和私垦者，1821年的虎尔哈仍是人烟稀少的森林边地。

en:
Oroqen covers the eastern woods of the Khingan, where the forested ridges fall away towards the Nonni and the Amur. In 1444 these taiga valleys belonged to Evenki-speaking hunters, and beyond the Amur, on the southern slopes of the Outer Khingan, roamed the bands the Manchus called Orochen, 'the people who keep reindeer'. They lived by the chase and the reindeer herd, clothed themselves in fur and skin, and honoured the spirits of forest and river after the shaman's manner.

When Cossacks came up the Amur in the mid-seventeenth century, the Orochen pulled south into the Greater and Lesser Khingan. The Qing gathered them with the rest of the Solon peoples into the Butha hunt-banners under the Heilongjiang general, and their horse and reindeer bands served the dynasty on its frontiers and paid tribute in sable. When the Qing took Yaksa in 1685, the Orochen who had lived beside the Cossacks went with the garrison into the banners as well.
zh:
鄂伦春一省是兴安岭东侧的林海，山林向嫩江与黑龙江方向缓缓低降。1444年，讲鄂温克语的猎手在这片泰加林谷中游猎；黑龙江以北、外兴安岭南坡的部众，被满洲人唤作「鄂伦春」，意为「养驯鹿的人」。他们以狩猎和驯鹿为生，以毛皮为衣，崇奉山林与江河之灵，行萨满之礼。

17世纪中叶哥萨克沿黑龙江而上，鄂伦春人南迁进入大、小兴安岭之间。清廷将他们与其余索伦诸部一并编入黑龙江将军治下的布特哈渔猎八旗，使马、使鹿的部众为朝廷戍边，以紫貂纳贡。1685年清军攻克雅克萨时，曾与哥萨克比邻而居的鄂伦春人也随守军一同被收入八旗。

en:
West Buteha covers the south-eastern skirt of the Greater Khingan, where the Yalu, Jiqin and Arun gather their waters and run east to the Nen through open woods that thin into Korchin pasture. Solon and Oroqen hunters took sable and elk in the high forest and broke reindeer to carry their loads; Mongol herdsmen held the grassy valleys below, and the pelts went downriver by barter. The hunters kept shamans rather than lamas. In 1444 there were no towns here, only camps that followed the hunt and good pasture, the western marches of the Khorchin.

Hong Taiji's armies subdued the Solon clans of these valleys in 1640. When the Butha hunters were enrolled as Eight Banners in 1731, the Plain Blue and Bordered Red banners were posted together on the Yalu, and a jalan-janggin kept his yamen at the camp that grew into Zhalantun. The next year the court levied 1,636 Solon soldiers with their families from these companies for the new Hulunbuir garrison on the Barga steppe, to watch the Russian frontier. The Arun valley also produced Hailancha. Born there in 1739 to a Dular-clan Solon family, he enlisted as a common trooper and rose to first-class duke, leading troops in the Dzungar, Burmese and Jinchuan wars, in Taiwan against Lin Shuangwen and against the Gurkhas in Nepal. He died in 1793, and the Qianlong emperor set precedent aside and had him enshrined in the Zhaozhong shrine, normally reserved for men killed in battle.
zh:
西布特哈在大兴安岭东南麓，雅鲁河、济沁河、阿伦河在此汇流，穿过疏林东入嫩江，林子尽头就是科尔沁草原。索伦和鄂伦春猎手在高山密林里猎貂捕鹿，役使驯鹿驮运；下方水草丰美的河谷归蒙古牧人，貂皮顺着河流拿去交换。猎手们奉的是萨满，不是喇嘛。1444年这里没有城镇，只有随猎物和水草迁徙的营地，是科尔沁部的西陲。

1640年，皇太极的大军征服了这些河谷里的索伦诸部。1731年布特哈猎户被编为八旗，正蓝、镶红两旗同驻雅鲁河，一名扎兰章京在后来发展成扎兰屯的营地开衙办事。次年，朝廷从这些佐领中征调一千六百三十六名索伦兵，连同家眷派往巴尔虎草原新设的呼伦贝尔驻防，盯防俄罗斯方向的边界。阿伦河谷还走出了海兰察。他1739年生于当地一户索伦多拉尔氏人家，以马甲入伍，积功封一等超勇公，先后领兵出征准噶尔、缅甸、大小金川，赴台湾平定林爽文，又到尼泊尔征讨廓尔喀。他1793年去世，按清朝旧例昭忠祠只祀阵亡将领，乾隆帝特准他入祀。

en:
Barag is the cold pasture country between the Onon and Ergune rivers and the western approaches to the Greater Khingan. The Barga take their name from the Barguzin lands east of Lake Baikal, which the Mongols of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries called Bargujin-Tukum, the land's end. Alan Gua, from whom Genghis Khan's Borjigin clan traced its descent, was a Barga woman of that country. After the Yuan collapse in 1368 the Barga joined the Oirats and scattered across the Mongol steppe, many clans drifting toward the Ergune and the Khingan. In 1444 this province was a frontier of seasonal camps and horse herds rather than a bounded tribal territory, where Mongols, Daurs and Solon Ewenkis pastured side by side under the competing reach of Oirat and Genghisid lords.

Russian pressure from Siberia and the Dzungar wars carried the Barga through the next upheavals. A Khori-Barga body fled back to the Onon in 1594, and others became subjects of the Setsen Khan in Khalkha, until Galdan's invasion of 1688 drove most of them south into Inner Mongolia. The Qing turned the fugitives into border troops. In 1732 the court conscripted 275 Barga men living in Manchuria into two Solon banners and moved them with wives, children and herds to Hulun Buir, the empty pasture facing Russia; these were the Old Barga. When the Barga who had defected to Russia in 1730-1732 were handed back in 1734, the Qing settled them nearby as the New Barga and organised them into eight banners on the Solon model. Through 1821 the Barga camps garrisoned the Qing-Russian steppe frontier.
zh:
巴尔虎是鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河与大兴安岭西麓之间的严寒牧场。巴尔虎人的族名来自贝加尔湖以东的巴尔古津地方，13至14世纪的蒙古人把那里称作「巴尔忽真·脱古木」，意为大地的尽头。成吉思汗所属的博尔济吉特氏尊为始祖母的阿阑豁阿，就是出身巴尔古津的巴尔虎女子。1368年元朝灭亡后，巴尔虎人归附瓦剌，散处于蒙古草原各部，不少部众逐渐迁到额尔古纳河与大兴安岭一带。1444年，这里没有边界固定的部落领地，只有随季节迁徙的营地和牧马之地，蒙古人、达斡尔人和索伦鄂温克人比邻游牧，瓦剌与成吉思汗后裔的势力在此交错。

俄国势力向西伯利亚扩张，加上准噶尔战争，把巴尔虎人卷入新一轮动荡。1594年一支霍里—巴尔虎人逃回鄂嫩河，另一些人做了喀尔喀车臣汗的属民；1688年噶尔丹东侵，大部分巴尔虎人南逃内蒙古。清朝把这些流民编成边军：1732年，清廷从居住在满洲的巴尔虎人中征调275名壮丁编入索伦两旗，连同妻儿和畜群迁往正对俄国的空旷牧场呼伦贝尔，是为陈巴尔虎。1730年至1732年投俄的巴尔虎人于1734年被俄方交还，清廷把他们安置在近旁，按索伦旗制编为八旗，称为新巴尔虎。到1821年，巴尔虎人的营地一直戍守着清朝与俄国之间的草原边界。

en:
Bayan-Uul, 'rich mountain', is the open grassland between the Onon and Kherlen rivers in eastern Mongolia, with the Ulz running through its northern camps. In 1444 the herders here moved seasonally with sheep, horses, cattle and gers under the loose authority of Taisun Khan's Northern Yuan; pasture rights, not walls, defined power.

These eastern pastures became the domain of the Setsen Khans after the descendants of Gersenji Khongtaiji built the Khalkha khanates from 1549. Sholoi, the first Setsen Khan, had his title confirmed by the Fifth Dalai Lama in the early 1630s. In 1688 Galdan's Dzungars invaded, and Ömkhei, the fourth Setsen Khan, fled south to Xilingol with his people. At Dolonnuur in 1691 he submitted to the Kangxi Emperor with the Tushiyet and Zasagt khans and more than five hundred noyans and taijis, bringing the Khalkha under Qing rule. After the 1696 campaign against Galdan the Setsen banners returned to the Kherlen, and Bayan-Uul remained remote herding country under Qing banner administration.
zh:
「巴彦乌拉」意为富饶的山，其地是东部蒙古鄂嫩河与克鲁伦河之间的开阔草原，乌勒吉河流经北部的牧地。1444年，牧民赶着绵羊、马、牛和毡帐随季节移牧，名义上奉岱总汗脱脱不花的北元为共主；在这里界定权力的是牧场使用权，而非城墙。

1549年格哷森札札赉尔的后裔建立喀尔喀诸汗部后，这片东部牧场归车臣汗世代领有。首任车臣汗硕垒的汗号在17世纪30年代初得到五世达赖喇嘛的承认。1688年噶尔丹率准噶尔军来攻，第四代车臣汗率部南逃锡林郭勒。1691年，他与土谢图汗、札萨克图汗及五百余名诺颜、台吉会于多伦诺尔，向康熙帝归附，喀尔喀就此归入清朝统辖。1696年征讨噶尔丹之役后，车臣汗部各旗返回克鲁伦河流域，巴彦乌拉在清朝盟旗体制下仍是偏远的游牧之地。

en:
The lower Orkhon country is where Mongolia's longest river leaves the Khangai, receives the Tamir and Tuul, and winds through wooded valleys north to the Selenge. Herders grazed cattle and sheep on the river meadows, fishermen took pike, carp and taimen, and trappers brought furs out of the northern woods. Farther up the same valley lay Khar Balgas and Karakorum, the old Uyghur and Mongol capitals, long since given over to nomad camps. In 1444 the Orkhon camps were Khalkha country: Toghtoa Bukha, the Taisun Khan, was nominal khagan of the Northern Yuan, while Esen the Oirat taishi kept the real power.

Later in the fifteenth century Dayan Khan formed the central Mongols into the Khalkha tümen, the shield of the northern frontier, and Gersenji's descendants divided the river otogs among their houses. They held the pastures against the Oirats until Galdan's invasion of 1688 delivered the Khalkha to Qing protection, and the old lordships were re-made into banners. The Treaty of Kyakhta in 1727 fixed the frontier with Russia and opened the market at Kyakhta-Maimaicheng on it; caravans between the border and the Qing interior travelled the Orkhon and Tuul valleys, carrying Siberian furs, leather and textiles south and tea, silk and rhubarb north. State caravans used the road until 1762, when the trade passed to private merchants bartering at the border. Under the eighteenth-century Khalkh Juram law code, the Orkhon marked the outer edge of the hunting reserve around Ikh Khüree, and the river's game was closed to the banners.
zh:
阿鲁浑（鄂尔浑）下游一带，是蒙古最长的河流离开杭爱山、汇纳塔米尔河与土拉河后，穿过林木河谷蜿蜒北去、注入色楞格河的地方。牧民在河漫滩放牧牛羊，渔人捕捞狗鱼、鲤鱼和哲罗鱼，猎户从北方林中运来毛皮。沿同一条河谷再往上，是回鹘旧都斡耳朵八里和蒙古旧都哈拉和林，两处早已让给游牧营地。1444年，鄂尔浑河畔的营地属喀尔喀：脱脱不花（岱总汗）是北元名义上的大汗，实权握在瓦剌太师也先手里。

15世纪后期，达延汗把中央蒙古编为喀尔喀万户，作为北方边境的屏障，格哷森札的后裔分领沿河诸鄂托克。他们与瓦剌周旋、保有牧场，直到1688年噶尔丹入侵，喀尔喀投附清朝，旧有领主领地被改编为旗分。1727年，《恰克图条约》划定对俄边界，并在边界上开设恰克图—买卖城市场；往来边境与清朝边内的驼道取道鄂尔浑河、土拉河河谷，西伯利亚的毛皮、皮革和织物南来，茶叶、丝绸和大黄北往。1762年以前走的是官营商队，此后贸易交给私商在边境以货易货。18世纪的《喀尔喀法规》把鄂尔浑河定为大库伦周边禁猎地的外界，河中猎物不许各旗擅取。

en:
Sainshand lies in the dry desert-steppe of the eastern Gobi, among the grazing grounds called Bayan Gobi and Khashaat Gobi. Groundwater, sparse saxaul thickets and seasonal wells watered horses, cattle, sheep, goats and Bactrian camels, but no walled market town grew up here. In 1444 the herdsmen belonged to the Northern Yuan: Taisun Khan held the title of Great Khan, while Esen taishi and the Oirat lords kept the real power behind the Borjigin throne.

Dayan Khan reunited the Eastern Mongols after 1480 and allotted these pastures to Khalkha princes. When Galdan's Dzungars invaded in 1688 the Khalkha khans fled to the Qing and submitted at Dolonnur in 1691, after which banner officials administered the desert wells. The place earned its fame from a teenage monk. In 1820 Danzanravjaa, seventeen years old and recognised as the fifth Noyon Khutagt, founded Khamar Monastery near Sainshand for the Nyingma Red Hat order, choosing the site for the spiritual energy he felt in the desert; caves in the hills north took monks on retreats of 108 days. Called the Terrible Noble Saint of the Gobi, he was a poet and a harsh critic of his society, and he equipped his monastery with a public library, a museum and a poetry recital hall, opened a children's school for Mongolian and Tibetan letters, mathematics and natural science, and ran Mongolia's first professional public theatre, whose troupe of some three hundred performers toured the Gobi. At its height Khamar held over eighty temples and about five hundred monks.
zh:
赛音山达地处东戈壁干旱的荒漠草原，周围是巴彦戈壁、哈沙图戈壁两片牧场。地下水、稀疏的梭梭林和季节性井泉养着马、牛、绵羊、山羊和双峰驼，却没有长出城墙环绕的市镇。1444年，这里的牧民属于北元：岱总汗保有大汗名号，也先太师和瓦剌贵族则在博尔济吉特氏汗廷背后执掌实权。

1480年后达延汗重新统一东蒙古，把这片牧场分给喀尔喀王公。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军入侵，喀尔喀诸汗南投清朝，1691年在多伦诺尔会盟称臣，戈壁上的井泉此后归旗官管辖。让这片地方出名的是一位少年僧人。1820年，被认定为诺因呼图克图五世的丹津拉布贾年方十七，在赛音山达附近为宁玛派红教建起哈玛尔寺；他说选址于此，是因为感到沙漠中发散的灵力，寺北山中的洞窟供僧人闭关，一次修满108天。人称「戈壁的可怖圣僧」的丹津拉布贾是诗人，也尖刻批评当世；他在寺中设了公共藏书楼、博物馆和诵诗堂，开办童学教授蒙藏文字、数学和自然科学，还办起蒙古第一所职业公共剧场，约三百名演员组成的戏班在戈壁巡回演出。极盛之时，哈玛尔寺有八十多座殿堂、约五百名僧人。

en:
Urad is the grassland behind the Yellow River's northern bend, where the irrigated fields of the back loop end and dry steppe begins at the foot of the Lang Shan. In 1444 the Ming kept neither garrison nor office here, and Tatar, Oirat and Uriankhai bands of the Northern Yuan followed their herds between the river and the edge of the Gobi. The people later called the Urad, a name meaning craftsmen, claimed Khasar, a brother of Genghis Khan, as their ancestor, but in those years they still grazed far to the north-east, in Hulunbuir.

In 1633 their chiefs Ombu, Tuba and Seleng submitted to Hong Taiji. In 1648 the Qing set three jasak banners over them and made Ombu's son Eban, Tuba and Seleng's son Bakbahai dukes; the next year the banners moved to the north bank of the Yellow River and took their place in the Ulanqab League. Their chief monastery was Mergen Juu, rebuilt at the mouth of the Mergen gorge in 1702 as the banner temple of the West Duke Banner. Its third incarnate lama, Lubsangdambijalsan, mastered Mongolian, Tibetan and Sanskrit, chanted the liturgy in Mongolian where other Gelug houses used Tibetan, and in 1765 finished a Mongol chronicle of the khans; at its height the house kept more than five hundred lamas. A run of disasters in the eighteenth century destroyed the herds of all three banners, and ruined families sold more than three hundred of their own people to buy grain.
zh:
乌拉特是黄河北套以北的草原，后套的灌溉田畴到狼山脚下为止，接下去就是干旱牧场。1444年，明朝在这里不设卫所、不置官吏，北元治下的鞑靼、瓦剌、兀良哈部众赶着畜群，往来于黄河与戈壁边缘之间。后来号为乌喇特（蒙古语意为「工匠」）的部落自称是成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿的后裔，那时他们还远在东北方的呼伦贝尔游牧。

1633年，首领鄂木布、图巴、色棱归附皇太极。1648年，清朝给他们编设三个札萨克旗，以鄂木布之子谔班、图巴和色棱之子巴克巴海掌旗，三人均封公爵；次年三旗移牧黄河北岸，会盟于乌兰察布。他们的主庙是梅力更召，1702年在梅力更沟口重建，为西公旗的旗庙。第三世活佛罗布桑丹毕佳拉森兼通蒙古文、藏文和梵文，别的格鲁派寺院用藏语诵经，梅力更召却用蒙古语；1765年，他写成一部蒙古文的诸汗编年史，香火最盛时庙里有五百多名喇嘛。18世纪连遭重灾，三旗畜群尽毁，走投无路的人家卖掉三百多口亲人换取口粮。

en:
Kalgan, Qaghalghan in Mongolian, the Gate, is the Great Wall pass the Chinese call Zhangjiakou, where the road climbs out of the Xuanhua basin on to the Mongolian plateau. In 1429 the commander Zhang Wen walled the fort of Zhangjiakoubu, a strongpoint of the Xuanfu garrison, one of the Nine Garrisons; in the Yongle reign Xuanfu held more than 150,000 troops. Beyond its gates in 1444 stood the Mongol power rebuilt by Taisun Khan and his taishi Esen. Five years later Esen destroyed the imperial army at Tumu, inside the Xuanfu sector, and led the Zhengtong Emperor away captive.

The wall went on growing, and in 1545-46 the governor Weng Wanda added more than 230 kilometres of rampart along the Xuanfu frontier. Peace proved more profitable than raiding. When the Ming invested Altan Khan as Prince of Shunyi in 1571, a tribute and horse market opened outside the gate at Yuanbaoshan, where Mongol horses, cattle and furs changed hands for silk, tea and porcelain. In 1619 Ivan Petlin led the first Russian mission to China through this gate. Before the Qing entered the pass, eight Shanxi merchant houses ran the Manchu trade here; once the dynasty was set in Beijing they were enrolled as the emperor's own merchants, answerable to the Imperial Household Department. The Qing built the Dajingmen, the Great Gate, in the wall in 1644, and after the Kyakhta treaty of 1727 long camel trains carried tea from here across the Gobi to Khüree and Russia, making the gate one of the busiest inland markets on the northern frontier.
zh:
哈喇罕，蒙古语 Qaghalghan，意为「大门」，就是长城脚下的张家口，宣府盆地的道路经此登上蒙古高原。1429年，指挥张文筑起张家口堡，隶属九边之一的宣府镇；永乐年间宣府驻军曾超过十五万。1444年，城门之外是岱总汗脱脱不花与太师也先重新整合起来的蒙古势力。五年后，也先在宣府防区内的土木堡击溃明军，俘走明英宗。

边墙此后继续增修，1545年至1546年，宣大总督翁万达沿宣府一线新筑长城四百六十余里。和平比入犯更有利可图：1571年明朝封俺答汗为顺义王，门外元宝山一带形成贡市与马市，蒙古的马匹、牲畜、皮货在此交换丝绸、茶叶与瓷器。1619年，伊万·佩特林率领首支俄国使团经这道门前往中国。入关之前，八家山西商人在张家口主持对满洲的贸易；清朝定都北京后，他们被收为内务府属下的皇商，替皇室采买物品。1644年，清朝在墙上建大境门；1727年《恰克图条约》之后，长长的驼队从这里载茶横穿戈壁，运往库伦和俄罗斯，使这道门成为北方边境最繁忙的内陆商埠之一。

en:
Josutu is the broken hill country of the western Liao, where the Mongol plateau drops towards the plains beyond the Shanhaiguan pass. The Xifengkou road climbs through these valleys on its way from the steppe to Beijing. The Ming once guarded the country from Daning and from Xingzhong, the old Longcheng of the Former, Later and Northern Yan, whose pagodas rose above the ruins. After the garrisons were withdrawn the Doyin Uriankhai, southernmost of the Three Guards, made it their pasture and sold horses at the border markets. In 1444 their chiefs owned only loose allegiance to Taisun Khan and lived as herdsmen, raiders and go-betweens on the road between the Great Wall and the steppe.

In the 16th century Kündülün, a grandson of Dayan Khan, pushed the Kharchin east from the upper Luan, and his people merged with the Doyin under the Kharchin name. Ligdan Khan shattered them at Zhao Cheng in 1628, and Subudi led the remnant to Hong Taiji. In 1629 the new Mongol allies opened the Xifengkou road to a Later Jin army of more than 100,000, which crossed the Great Wall and raided all the way to Beijing, the first Manchu invasion of the Chinese interior; in the same year Ombu Chokhur's Eastern Tümed submitted and were settled at Bayan Khoshuu, later the seat of the Tümed Right Banner. The Qing enrolled the tribes as banners from 1635, two Tümed and two Kharchin by 1648, and in 1681 their princes met the Kangxi Emperor beyond Xifengkou and gave up pasture for the Mulan hunting ground, where the court held its autumn hunts for the next century and more. A third Kharchin banner was added under Kangxi, and in 1702 the four older banners fixed their assembly at Josutu in the Tümed Right Banner, which gave the league its name. Chinese farmers came up the same road: the Tazigou hall opened in 1738 and the Sanzuota, or 'three pagodas', hall in 1774, named for the old pagodas standing at Longcheng; in 1778 the two became Jianchang and Chaoyang counties, and ploughland spread over the Mongol pastures.
zh:
卓索图是辽西的丘陵地带，蒙古高原从这里俯向山海关外的平原，喜峰口道穿越这些山谷，从草原直通北京。明朝曾以大宁和兴中屯守，兴中就是前燕、后燕、北燕故都龙城，古塔高出废墟。卫所撤废后，兀良哈三卫中最靠南的朵颜卫以此为牧场，在边口互市卖马。1444年，其首领对脱脱不花汗只有松散的臣属，在长城与草原之间的道路上亦牧亦盗，也做两边的居间人。

16世纪，达延汗之孙昆都力哈率喀喇沁从滦河上游东进，与朵颜人融合，皆称喀喇沁。1628年林丹汗在赵城大破其众，苏布地率余部归附皇太极。1629年，新附的蒙古诸部让出喜峰口道，十万余后金大军经喜峰口入塞，第一次直逼北京城下；同年，鄂木布楚琥尔率东土默特一支归附，被安置在巴彦和硕，后来这里成为土默特右翼旗的旗府。清廷自1635年起编设旗分，至1648年已有土默特、喀喇沁各两旗。1681年，喀喇沁、土默特等部王公在喜峰口口外朝见康熙帝，献出牧地辟为木兰围场，此后一个多世纪清帝多在此举行秋狝。康熙年间又增喀喇沁中旗；1702年，较早的四旗定盟于土默特右翼旗境内的卓索图，盟以地名。汉民也沿同一条路北上：1738年设塔子沟厅，1774年设三座塔厅，厅名取自龙城故地上的三座古塔；1778年两厅改设建昌县与朝阳县，农田随道路漫上蒙古牧场。

en:
The Ujimqin pastures are wide steppe in northeastern Xilin Gol. The name is an odd one for horse country: Mongolian üzem means grape, and Üzemchin means grape growers. In 1444 the camps here belonged to eastern Mongol lords of the Chahar tumen who recognised Taisun Khan as Northern Yuan khan; there was no walled town, and power followed pasture rights and Borjigin lineage.

The name first attached to the following of Ongon-Dural, a son of Bodi Alagh Khan, within the Chahar tumen. His son Dorji, titled Setsen Jinong, was hard pressed by Ligdan Khan and led his people north to the Kherlen to shelter with Sholoi Setsen Khan of the Khalkha. In 1637 Dorji and his nephew Sereng brought their people over to Hong Taiji; they joined the Qing campaign against the Khalkha the next year, and in 1641 their envoys presented camels, horses and sable furs at court. The Qing settled the tribe back on the Xilin Gol pastures as right and left banners in 1641 and 1646, enfeoffing Dorji as a jasagh prince and Sereng as a jasagh beile. A Ujimqin contingent rode on the 1646 expedition against the rebellious Sönid chief Tenggis, after which the two banners held these pastures under Qing rule.
zh:
乌珠穆沁草原是锡林郭勒东北部的开阔草原。这个名字用在牧马之地有些特别：蒙古语「乌珠穆」意为葡萄，乌珠穆沁就是种葡萄的人。1444年，这里的营地属于察哈尔万户的东部蒙古领主，他们奉岱总汗脱脱不花为北元大汗；当地没有城郭，权力随牧场分配和博尔济吉特血统而行。

这个部名最初指博迪阿拉克汗之子翁衮都喇尔的属部，当时该部是察哈尔万户的一部分。翁衮都喇尔之子多尔济号车臣济农，因受林丹汗逼迫，率部北走克鲁伦河，投奔喀尔喀的车臣汗硕垒。1637年，多尔济与侄子色棱率部归附皇太极，次年随军出征喀尔喀；1641年，部中使者把骆驼、马匹和貂皮送到清廷。清朝把该部安置回锡林郭勒牧场，于1641年和1646年分编右翼、左翼两札萨克旗，封多尔济为札萨克和硕亲王、色棱为札萨克多罗贝勒。1646年，一支乌珠穆沁兵参加了征讨反叛的苏尼特首领腾机思之役，两旗之后一直在清朝治下保有这片牧场。

en:
The Khorchin are the house of Khasar, Genghis Khan's younger brother, and in early Ming times their herds grazed the Onon and Argun country east of the Khingan. The Erdeni-yin tobchi counts the Adai Khan, raised by the eastern Mongols against the Oirat, as one of theirs; when Toghan taishi hunted Adai down at Ejene in 1438, the Khorchin drew back south. In 1444, under Esen's mastery of the steppe, the Qasarid princes kept their people and flocks east of the Khingan without a khan of their own, the strongest of the Mongol houses still outside Oirat rule.

They joined Dayan Khan's wars to reunite the eastern Mongols, and in 1510 helped him crush the Uriankhai; Dayan Khan enrolled them as a tümen honoured with the style 'Abaga Khorchin'. Early in the Jiajing reign their chief Kümüngkei Tasqal led them from the Onon and Argun across the Khingan to the Nen, absorbing the Jalayid, Dorbod and Gorlos and taking the Sibe as vassals, and the Nun Khorchin became the strongest Mongol power beyond the Liao frontier. They rode with the Hūlun confederation against Nurhaci, were broken at Gule Mountain in 1593 and again in 1608, then sought his friendship.

In 1624 their chief Ooba, hard pressed by Ligdan Khan of the Chahar, led the Khorchin over to Nurhaci, the first Mongol tribe to submit. The Qing court sealed the bond by marriage. In 1614 the lady Jerjer, daughter of Manggusi, married Hong Taiji and became his empress; in 1625 her niece Bumbutai married him as well, and Bumbutai's elder sister Harjol later entered the harem as his favourite consort. Bumbutai was the future Empress Xiaozhuang: after Hong Taiji's death she helped place her young son Fulin on the throne as the Shunzhi emperor, and as grand empress dowager she backed the young Kangxi against the regent Oboi and through the Revolt of the Three Feudatories. In 1636 the Khorchin were formed into five banners, the most favoured of the Mongol leagues, and their herds kept the court supplied with fermented mare's milk. From 1710 their princes met the allied Jalayid, Dorbod and Gorlos in assembly at Mount Jirim, which gave the Jirim league its name.
zh:
科尔沁是成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿的后裔，明初在鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河流域、大兴安岭以东游牧。据《蒙古源流》记载，东蒙古拥立起来对抗瓦剌的阿台汗就出自科尔沁；1438年，瓦剌太师脱欢在亦集乃捕杀阿台，部众向南退避。1444年也先雄霸草原，合撒儿后裔的诸王在大兴安岭以东保有部众和畜群而无共主，是瓦剌体系之外最强的蒙古宗支。

科尔沁后来参加达延汗统一东蒙古的战争，1510年助其击溃兀良哈，被编为一个万户，尊号「阿巴噶科尔沁」。嘉靖初年，首领奎蒙克塔斯哈喇率部从鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河翻过大兴安岭迁至嫩江，收服扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯诸部，役使锡伯人，号称嫩科尔沁，成为辽东边外势力最大的蒙古部落。他们随海西扈伦联军攻打努尔哈赤，1593年在古勒山战败，1608年再败，转而与建州通好。

1624年，首领奥巴被察哈尔林丹汗所迫，率部投奔努尔哈赤，科尔沁是最早归附后金的蒙古部落。清廷用联姻把这层关系系紧。1614年，莽古斯之女哲哲嫁与皇太极，后来正位中宫；1625年，她的侄女布木布泰也嫁过来；布木布泰的姐姐海兰珠随后入宫，是皇太极最宠爱的妃子。布木布泰就是孝庄文皇后：皇太极死后，她扶幼子福临即位，即顺治帝；康熙初年又以太皇太后之尊，支持少年康熙拿下权臣鳌拜、平定三藩之乱。1636年科尔沁部编设五旗，在清朝诸蒙古盟旗中恩遇最厚，其部还要为宫廷供奉马奶酒。1710年起，科尔沁诸王与扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯诸旗会盟于哲里木山，哲里木盟的名字便来自这座山。

en:
Bayisingtu lies on the south-eastern edge of the Khorchin steppe, where the grassland runs into the Ming frontier above Shenyang and the Yehe country. Its name means 'the place of houses': a bayising was a Chinese-style farmhouse of mud walls and plank roofs, the kind that began to dot Mongol pasture wherever settlers crossed the border to plough. In 1444 there were only herds here. The Fuyu Guard Mongols grazing the land traced their line to Khasar, Genghis Khan's brother, and had moved south after Adai Khan was killed in 1438; they were the ancestors of the Nen Khorchin left wing.

These were the first Mongols to make terms with the rising Manchus. Their chief Oba submitted to Nurhaci in 1624, and when Ligdan Khan marched on him in punishment, the approach of Manchu relief made the khan raise the siege after three days. The left-wing Khorchin became the Aisin Gioro's closest in-laws, their women entering the court as empresses and consorts; the future Empress Xiaozhuangwen, mother of the Shunzhi emperor and grandmother of Kangxi, was one of these Khorchin brides. The banners kept their old pastures beyond the willow palisade, the ditch and planted hedge with which the Qing marked off the Manchu homeland from the Mongol steppe. In 1802 the Khorchin Left Wing Rear Banner opened land at Tsantu Ereg, the 'frost-covered cliff', to Chinese farmers, and so many came through the old frontier gates that in 1806 the Qing created Changtu Subprefecture, the first Chinese administration seated inside Khorchin pasture. As mud-walled farmhouses multiplied across the ploughed steppe, Bayisingtu at last lived up to its name.
zh:
板申图在科尔沁草原的东南缘，草原在此接上沈阳以北、叶赫一带的辽东边墙。其名蒙古语意为「有房舍之地」：板申（板升）是土墙板筑的汉人式农舍，只要汉民出边垦种，这类房屋便会在牧场上出现。1444年这里还只有牧群。在此游牧的福余卫蒙古人自称是成吉思汗之弟合撒儿的后裔，1438年阿台汗败亡后南迁至此，他们就是嫩科尔沁左翼的先祖。

这一支是最早与崛起的满洲人讲和的蒙古人。1624年，首领奥巴归附努尔哈赤；林丹汗兴兵问罪，围城三日，因后金援军逼近而撤围。科尔沁左翼成为爱新觉罗家最亲密的姻亲，科尔沁女子入宫为后为妃，后来的孝庄文皇后、顺治帝的生母、康熙帝的祖母便是其中之一。旗人长期守着柳条边外的旧牧地，柳条边是清廷掘壕植柳、圈起龙兴之地并隔开蒙古草原的边障。1802年，科尔沁左翼后旗在「常突额尔克」（意为挂霜的悬崖）招汉民放垦；经旧日边门北上的人越来越多，1806年清廷设立昌图厅，这是科尔沁牧地内第一个汉人行政机构。土墙板筑的农舍在开垦的草原上成片出现，板申图终于名副其实。

en:
The Badain Jaran is the sand sea at the western end of the Alxa plateau, forty-nine thousand square kilometres of desert between the Gansu corridor and the roads to Outer Mongolia, and the third largest desert in China. Its stationary dunes rise more than five hundred metres in places, the tallest on earth, and over a hundred spring-fed lakes, fresh and brine, lie in the hollows between them; on some slopes the sand sings in the wind. One river crosses the desert, the Ruo Shui, which spreads into an alluvial plain before it reaches Juyan Lake. Herders grazed camels and sheep on the lake pastures, but the desert interior held no towns, and the only track of note followed its western rim past the black city of Khara-Khoto. After a Ming army took that city in 1372 and fell back behind the Jiayu Pass, the dunes and wells belonged to whoever pastured there; in 1444 they are Oirat Mongols of Esen's confederation.

After Esen's wars Oirat power ebbed westward, and for two centuries the desert was little more than a grazing march between the Gansu wall and the steppe khanates. In the 1670s the fugitive Khoshut prince Khoroli led his followers onto the Alxa pastures to the east, and when the Qing created the Alxa Banner for them in 1697, the scattered lake camps of the Badain Jaran became Alxa Mongol grazing as well. In 1755 a Geluk monastery was built on a lake deep in the dunes, Sumin Jaran, the 'lake of the temple'; its bricks and timbers had all been carried in by camel, and its lamas answered to the Yanfu Monastery at Dingyuanying. Herders gathered there for rites and festivals; otherwise the only strangers were caravans on the old western track.
zh:
巴丹吉林是阿拉善高原西端的大沙海，夹在河西走廊与漠北通道之间，广约四万九千平方公里，为中国第三大沙漠。固定沙丘有的高逾五百米，是世界最高的沙丘；沙山坳里散落着百余处泉水汇成的湖泊，咸淡不一，有些沙坡会在风中鸣响。横穿沙漠的河流只有弱水一条，在注入居延海前冲积出一片平原。牧人在湖畔草场放牧骆驼和羊，沙漠腹地没有城镇，唯一像样的路沿西缘经过黑水城。1372年明军攻取黑水城、退回嘉峪关之后，沙山和水井归在此放牧的人所有；1444年，在这里游牧的是也先联盟的瓦剌蒙古人。

也先的战乱之后瓦剌势力西退，此后两百年间，这片沙漠不过是甘肃边墙与草原汗国之间的游牧地。1670年代，避乱西来的和硕特台吉和啰理率部进入东边的阿拉善草场；1697年清朝为其编设阿拉善旗，巴丹吉林各处散落的湖畔营地也成了阿拉善蒙古人的牧地。1755年，沙海深处的湖畔建起一座格鲁派寺院，名唤苏敏吉林，意为「有庙的海子」；砖石木料全由骆驼驮进沙山，寺中喇嘛归定远营延福寺管辖。牧人到寺前聚会诵经，除此之外，沙海里的过客多半只是走西路旧道的商队。

en:
Noyon covers a water-scarce stretch of the South Gobi, where stone desert and a few scattered wells suited moving herds of Bactrian camels, horses, sheep and goats better than a fixed town; the place-name itself means 'lord'. In 1444 these grazing grounds stood on the Oirat side of the Mongol world. Esen taishi was the confederation's de facto ruler, while Taisun Khan kept the Borjigin title of Great Khan and lent Chinggisid authority to Oirat campaigns.

Five years later Esen's cavalry invaded Ming China and carried the Zhengtong Emperor off from Tumu, but his own seizure of the khan title ended in rebellion and his death, and Oirat power withdrew to the west. Khalkha lords then drew the South Gobi pastures into their order. One of them, Tümenkhen Sain Noyon (1558-1640), patronised the Gelug school and received the title 'Sain Noyon' from a Dalai Lama for his service to the teaching. After Galdan's invasion of 1688, the Yongzheng Emperor carved Sain Noyon Aimag out of nineteen western Tüsheet khoshuu in 1725, raising a new power to balance the Tüsheet khans. Through the eighteenth century these lands remained camel-breeding pasture run through the Qing banner system, with no settled town.
zh:
瑙云是南戈壁一片缺水的牧场，石质荒漠和零星井泉更适合驼、马、绵羊、山羊逐水草移动，不宜定居立镇；地名本身的意思就是「官人」。1444年，这片牧场处在蒙古世界的瓦剌一侧：也先太师是联盟的实际统治者，岱总汗保有博尔济吉特氏大汗的名号，给瓦剌的征战添上黄金家族的名分。

五年后，也先的骑兵攻入明朝，在土木堡俘走明英宗；但他自立为汗后死于叛乱，瓦剌势力也退回西方。喀尔喀贵族随后把南戈壁牧场纳入自己的秩序。其中的图蒙肯（1558—1640）护持格鲁派，因有功于教法而从达赖喇嘛处受号「赛音诺颜」。1688年噶尔丹入侵之后，雍正帝在1725年从土谢图汗部西境划出十九旗，设赛音诺颜部，扶植新的势力以分土谢图汗之势。整个18世纪，这里仍是清朝盟旗体制下牧驼的草场，没有形成定居的城镇。

en:
This is the Orkhon valley, sacred ground on the Mongol steppe, where the old Türk khans had ruled from Ötüken and the Uyghur khans from nearby Karabalgasun. Genghis Khan founded Karakorum here in 1220, and Ögedei walled the town and built the Palace of Myriad Peace in 1235. Möngke Khan set a silver tree in the palace courtyard, the work of Guillaume Boucher, a Parisian goldsmith carried off as a slave: an angel with a trumpet stood in its crown, four gilded serpents wound round the trunk, and when the khan feasted the serpents poured mare's milk, wine and mead into a silver basin. When William of Rubruck reached the court in 1254 he found four walled gates, twelve pagan temples, two mosques and a Nestorian church, though he thought the whole town no bigger than the abbey of Saint-Denis at home. After Kublai moved the court to Dadu the city shrank to a provincial garrison, and Ming troops razed it in 1380. In 1444 its walls and palace were ruins amid good pasture held by the Four Oirats, whose taishis ruled while the Chinggisid khan reigned in name; the herders were Khalkha Mongols who worshipped the eternal blue sky.

Early in the sixteenth century Dayan Khan reunited the tribes and for a time made Karakorum a khan's seat again, but after the wars between Oirats and Chinggisids the old city was given up for good. In 1585 Abtai Sain Khan of the Khalkha, newly converted to the Gelug teaching after meeting the Third Dalai Lama, built the Erdene Zuu monastery from Karakorum's carved stones, the first great Buddhist monastery of Mongolia. Galdan's Dzungars overran the Khalkha lands and damaged it in 1688, and in 1691 the Khalkha khans submitted to the Kangxi Emperor at Dolon Nor, bringing the Orkhon pastures into the Qing empire. In 1821 the valley was Khalkha grazing country, its flocks moving between the monastery walls and the ruins of the old imperial capital.
zh:
这里是鄂尔浑河谷，蒙古草原的圣地，突厥可汗曾以附近的于都斤发号施令，回鹘可汗的都城斡耳朵八里也在近旁。成吉思汗1220年在此营建哈拉和林，1235年窝阔台筑起城墙、建成万安宫。蒙哥汗在宫中庭院立起一棵银树，出自被掳为奴的巴黎金匠纪尧姆·布歇之手：树顶立着吹号的天使，四条鎏金的蛇盘绕树干，汗开宴时蛇口分别喷出马奶、葡萄酒和蜜酒，注入树下的银盆。1254年鲁不鲁乞抵达汗庭，看到城墙开四门，城内有十二座异教庙宇、两座清真寺和一座景教教堂，不过他觉得整座城还不如家乡的圣但尼修院大。忽必烈迁都大都后，和林降为边地驻军之城，1380年明军将其夷为平地。1444年的城墙宫殿已是水草丰美牧场上的废墟，牧场归四卫拉特所有，异密专权、黄金家族的汗徒拥虚名，牧人是信奉永恒苍天的喀尔喀蒙古人。

16世纪初达延汗统一诸部，一度再以哈拉和林为汗庭，但卫拉特与黄金家族几经征战，古城终被永久放弃。1585年，喀尔喀的阿巴岱赛音汗谒见三世达赖喇嘛、皈依格鲁派后，用和林废墟上凿好的石料建成光显寺，这是蒙古第一座大佛寺。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔人席卷喀尔喀，寺院在战火中受损；1691年喀尔喀诸汗在多伦诺尔归附康熙帝，鄂尔浑牧场纳入清帝国。1821年的河谷是喀尔喀牧区，畜群在寺院围墙与旧都残垣之间往来。

en:
Lake Khövsgöl fills a mountain basin south of the Sayan ranges in northern Mongolia. Its outlet, the Eg river, carries water to the Selenga, and the taiga along the shore holds some of the region's best sable country. Mongol speakers called the hunting bands here Uriankhai, the people who lived in the woods. In 1444 the lake district was Oirat borderland, governed through subject lords. Small camps of Tengri-worshipping hunters and herders moved between forest and pasture, and their pelts went south along the steppe roads.

Khotogoid Khalkhas entered the district in the 16th century and gave the lake country its best-known local dynasty. Around 1609 their prince Ubasi Khong Tayiji took the title Altan Khan, subdued the Yenisei Kirghiz and drove the Oirats westward; his envoys also dealt with the Russian forts advancing into Siberia, where Krasnoyarsk was founded in 1628. Wars with the Zasagtu khans later broke the Khotogoid polity. After the Khalkhas submitted to the Kangxi Emperor at Dolon Nor in 1691, the Khotogoids were registered as a Qing banner in 1694, and the 1727 Treaty of Kiakhta drew the Russian boundary along the Sayan ranges north of the lake. The Khotogoid prince Chingünjav led the Outer Mongolian revolt against Qing rule in 1756 and was defeated and killed in 1757. The Qing split his banner into five units and registered the lakeshore Uriankhai as the separate Khövsgöl banner.
zh:
库苏古尔湖位于蒙古北部萨彦岭南侧的山间盆地，湖水从额金河流入色楞格河，沿岸泰加林是这一带最好的紫貂产地之一。蒙古语使用者把林中狩猎的部落称作乌梁海，意为「林木中的百姓」。1444年，库苏古尔是瓦剌通过附庸领主控制的边地。崇拜长生天的猎户和牧人分成小营地，在林地与牧场间迁徙，猎得的皮货沿草原道路南运。

16世纪，和托辉特部喀尔喀人进入湖区，并在这里形成最有名的地方势力。约1609年，首领乌巴什珲台吉称阿勒坦汗，征服叶尼塞吉尔吉斯，把瓦剌逐向西方；他的使者也同推进到西伯利亚的俄国据点往来，克拉斯诺亚尔斯克堡于1628年建成。和托辉特政权后来在与扎萨克图汗的战争中瓦解。1691年喀尔喀在多伦诺尔归附康熙皇帝后，和托辉特于1694年被编为清朝的一旗；1727年《恰克图条约》沿湖北的萨彦岭划定中俄边界。1756年，和托辉特王公青衮杂卜领导外蒙古反清起义，1757年兵败被杀。清廷把他的旗分为五个单位，又将湖边的乌梁海人单编为库苏古尔旗。

en:
Zakhchin is the arid pasture country southeast of the Khovd borderlands, where Gobi steppe climbs toward the Altai ranges around the later grazing grounds of Mankhan, Zereg and Uyench. In 1444 the Zakhchin name did not exist; these were Oirat pastures within Esen Taishi's confederation, where herdsmen kept horses, cattle, sheep and camels, followed the Tengri cult, and lived between Oirat power in the west and Khalkha princes in the east.

Their name means 'border guards', for the Zakhchin were Oirat clans posted to watch the Dzungar Khanate's frontier; the Qing-era Mongol nomad records say the Dzungars called their watch-post men zakhchin. In 1754, as the Dzungar regime collapsed, their zaisan Mamuut submitted to the Qing and was put over his own people and the attached Baochin artillerymen, with the rank of third-class duke. He did not keep it long. When Amursana rose against the Qing, Mamuut refused to follow him and was killed. His grandson received pastures around Zereg in 1756 and the banner seal in 1761. War and migration scattered the tribe, and in 1777 the four hundred households left were reorganised into four companies under the Kobdo councilor; a company of Mamuut's heirs became a separate hereditary banner in 1800.
zh:
扎哈沁是科布多边地东南侧的干旱牧场，戈壁草原向阿尔泰山抬升，后世的曼汗、泽雷格、乌音奇等牧地都在这一带。1444年还没有「扎哈沁」这个名字，这里是也先太师瓦剌联盟境内的牧场。牧民牧放马、牛、羊和骆驼，信奉腾格里，夹在西边的瓦剌势力与东边的喀尔喀贵族之间。
